verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلُ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ جَاءَ ثَلاَثَةُ رَهْطٍ إِلَى بُيُوتِ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْأَلُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا أُخْبِرُوا كَأَنَّهُمْ تَقَالُّوهَا فَقَالُوا وَأَيْنَ نَحْنُ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ‏.‏ قَالَ أَحَدُهُمْ أَمَّا أَنَا فَإِنِّي أُصَلِّي اللَّيْلَ أَبَدًا‏.‏ وَقَالَ آخَرُ أَنَا أَصُومُ الدَّهْرَ وَلاَ أُفْطِرُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ آخَرُ أَنَا أَعْتَزِلُ النِّسَاءَ فَلاَ أَتَزَوَّجُ أَبَدًا‏.‏ فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَنْتُمُ الَّذِينَ قُلْتُمْ كَذَا وَكَذَا أَمَا وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَخْشَاكُمْ لِلَّهِ وَأَتْقَاكُمْ لَهُ، لَكِنِّي أَصُومُ وَأُفْطِرُ، وَأُصَلِّي وَأَرْقُدُ وَأَتَزَوَّجُ النِّسَاءَ، فَمَنْ رَغِبَ عَنْ سُنَّتِي فَلَيْسَ مِنِّي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, aakhbaranaa humaydu bnu aabiy humaydin alttawiylu, aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh yaquwlu jaa'a thalaathaau rahtin iilaa buyuwti aazwaaji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasaaluwna 'an 'ibaadaai alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa aukhbiruwa kaaannahum taqaalluwhaa faqaaluwa waaayna nahnu mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi wamaa taaakhhara‏.‏ qaala aahaduhum aammaa aanaa faiinniy ausalliy alllayla aabadana‏.‏ waqaala akharu aanaa aasuwmu alddahra walaa auftiru‏.‏ waqaala akharu aanaa aa'tazilu alnnisaa'a falaa aatazawwaju aabadana‏.‏ fajaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ aantumu alladhiyna qultum kadhaa wakadhaa aamaa waalllahi iinniy laakhshaakum lillahi waaatqaakum lahu, lakinniy aasuwmu waauftiru, waausalliy waaarqudu waaatazawwaju alnnisaa'a, faman raghiba 'an sunnatiy falaysa minniy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A group of three men came to the houses of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) asking how the Prophet (ﷺ) worshipped (Allah), and when they were informed about that, they considered their worship insufficient and said, "Where are we from the Prophet (ﷺ) as his past and future sins have been forgiven." Then one of them said, "I will offer the prayer throughout the night forever." The other said, "I will fast throughout the year and will not break my fast." The third said, "I will keep away from the women and will not marry forever." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to them and said, "Are you the same people who said so-and-so? By Allah, I am more submissive to Allah and more afraid of Him than you; yet I fast and break my fast, I do sleep and I also marry women. So he who does not follow my tradition in religion, is not from me (not one of my followers)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، سَمِعَ حَسَّانَ بْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَائِشَةَ عَنْ قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتَامَى فَانْكِحُوا مَا طَابَ لَكُمْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ مَثْنَى وَثُلاَثَ وَرُبَاعَ فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تَعْدِلُوا فَوَاحِدَةً أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ ذَلِكَ أَدْنَى أَنْ لاَ تَعُولُوا‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ يَا ابْنَ أُخْتِي، الْيَتِيمَةُ تَكُونُ فِي حَجْرِ وَلِيِّهَا، فَيَرْغَبُ فِي مَالِهَا وَجَمَالِهَا، يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَهَا بِأَدْنَى مِنْ سُنَّةِ صَدَاقِهَا، فَنُهُوا أَنْ يَنْكِحُوهُنَّ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُقْسِطُوا لَهُنَّ فَيُكْمِلُوا الصَّدَاقَ، وَأُمِرُوا بِنِكَاحِ مَنْ سِوَاهُنَّ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, sami'a hassaana bna iibraahiyma, 'an yuwnusa bni yaziyda, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau, aannahu saaala 'aaiishaaa 'an qawlihi ta'aalaa ‏{‏waiin khiftum aan laa tuqsituwa fiy alyataamaa faankihuwa maa taaba lakum mina alnnisaa'i mathnaa wathulaatha warubaa'a faiin khiftum aan laa ta'diluwa fawaahidaaan aaw maa malakat aaymaanukum dhalika aadnaa aan laa ta'uwluwa‏}‏‏.‏ qaalat yaa abna aukhtiy, alyatiymaau takuwnu fiy hajri waliyyihaa, fayarghabu fiy maalihaa wajamaalihaa, yuriydu aan yatazawwajahaa biaadnaa min sunnaai sadaaqihaa, fanuhuwa aan yankihuwhunna iilaaa aan yuqsituwa lahunna fayukmiluwa alssadaaqa, waaumiruwa binikaahi man siwaahunna mina alnnisaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Urwa:that he asked `Aisha about the Statement of Allah: 'If you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with the orphan girls, then marry (other) women of your choice, two or three or four; but if you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly (with them), then only one, or (the captives) that your right hands possess. That will be nearer to prevent you from doing injustice.' (4.3) `Aisha said, "O my nephew! (This Verse has been revealed in connection with) an orphan girl under the guardianship of her guardian who is attracted by her wealth and beauty and intends to marry her with a Mahr less than what other women of her standard deserve. So they (such guardians) have been forbidden to marry them unless they do justice to them and give them their full Mahr, and they are ordered to marry other women instead of them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَلَقِيَهُ عُثْمَانُ بِمِنًى فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنَّ لِي إِلَيْكَ حَاجَةً‏.‏ فَخَلَيَا فَقَالَ عُثْمَانُ هَلْ لَكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فِي أَنْ نُزَوِّجَكَ بِكْرًا، تُذَكِّرُكَ مَا كُنْتَ تَعْهَدُ، فَلَمَّا رَأَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَنْ لَيْسَ لَهُ حَاجَةٌ إِلَى هَذَا أَشَارَ إِلَىَّ فَقَالَ يَا عَلْقَمَةُ، فَانْتَهَيْتُ إِلَيْهِ وَهْوَ يَقُولُ أَمَا لَئِنْ قُلْتَ ذَلِكَ لَقَدْ قَالَ لَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا مَعْشَرَ الشَّبَابِ مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمُ الْبَاءَةَ فَلْيَتَزَوَّجْ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَعَلَيْهِ بِالصَّوْمِ فَإِنَّهُ لَهُ وِجَاءٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, qaala haddathaniy iibraahiymu, 'an 'alqamaaa, qaala kuntu ma'a 'abdi alllahi falaqiyahu 'uthmaanu biminana faqaala yaa aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani iinna liy iilayka haajaaan‏.‏ fakhalayaa faqaala 'uthmaanu hal laka yaa aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani fiy aan nuzawwijaka bikrana, tudhakkiruka maa kunta ta'hadu, falammaa raaaa 'abdu alllahi aan laysa lahu haajaaun iilaa hadhaa aashaara iilaaaa faqaala yaa 'alqamaau, faantahaytu iilayhi wahwa yaquwlu aamaa laiin qulta dhalika laqad qaala lanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa ma'shara alshhabaabi mani astataa'a minkumu albaa'aaa falyatazawwaj, waman lam yastati' fa'alayhi bialssawmi faiinnahu lahu wijaa'un ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Alqama:While I was with `Abdullah, `Uthman met him at Mina and said, "O Abu `Abdur-Rahman ! I have something to say to you." So both of them went aside and `Uthman said, "O Abu `Abdur-Rah. man! Shall we marry you to a virgin who will make you remember your past days?" When `Abdullah felt that he was not in need of that, he beckoned me (to join him) saying, "O 'Alqama!" Then I heard him saying (in reply to `Uthman), "As you have said that, (I tell you that) the Prophet (ﷺ) once said to us, 'O young people! Whoever among you is able to marry, should marry, and whoever is not able to marry, is recommended to fast, as fasting diminishes his sexual power
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُمَارَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ مَعَ عَلْقَمَةَ وَالأَسْوَدِ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَبَابًا لاَ نَجِدُ شَيْئًا فَقَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا مَعْشَرَ الشَّبَابِ مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ الْبَاءَةَ فَلْيَتَزَوَّجْ، فَإِنَّهُ أَغَضُّ لِلْبَصَرِ، وَأَحْصَنُ لِلْفَرْجِ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَعَلَيْهِ بِالصَّوْمِ، فَإِنَّهُ لَهُ وِجَاءٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsi bni ghiyaathin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, qaala haddathaniy 'umaaraau, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni yaziyda, qaala dakhaltu ma'a 'alqamaaa waalaaswadi 'alaa 'abdi alllahi faqaala 'abdu alllahi kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm shabaabana laa najidu shayiana faqaala lanaa rasuwlu alllahu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa ma'shara alshhabaabi mani astataa'a albaa'aaa falyatazawwaj, faiinnahu aaghaddu lilbasari, waaahsanu lilfarji, waman lam yastati' fa'alayhi bialssawmi, faiinnahu lahu wijaa'un ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) while we were young and had no wealth. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O young people! Whoever among you can marry, should marry, because it helps him lower his gaze and guard his modesty (i.e. his private parts from committing illegal sexual intercourse etc.), and whoever is not able to marry, should fast, as fasting diminishes his sexual power
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، قَالَ حَضَرْنَا مَعَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ جَنَازَةَ مَيْمُونَةَ بِسَرِفَ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ هَذِهِ زَوْجَةُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِذَا رَفَعْتُمْ نَعْشَهَا فَلاَ تُزَعْزِعُوهَا وَلاَ تُزَلْزِلُوهَا وَارْفُقُوا، فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تِسْعٌ، كَانَ يَقْسِمُ لِثَمَانٍ وَلاَ يَقْسِمُ لِوَاحِدَةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu yuwsufa, aanna abna jurayjin, aakhbarahum qaala aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, qaala hadarnaa ma'a abni 'abbaasin janaazaaa maymuwnaaa bisarifa, faqaala abnu 'abbaasin hadhihi zawjaau alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faiidhaa rafa'tum na'shahaa falaa tuza'zi'uwhaa walaa tuzalziluwhaa waarfuquwa, faiinnahu kaana 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm tis'un, kaana yaqsimu lithamaanin walaa yaqsimu liwaahidaain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ata:We presented ourselves along with Ibn `Abbas at the funeral procession of Maimuna at a place called Sarif. Ibn `Abbas said, "This is the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) so when you lift her bier, do not Jerk it or shake it much, but walk smoothly because the Prophet (ﷺ) had nine wives and he used to observe the night turns with eight of them, and for one of them there was no night turn
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَطُوفُ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ، وَلَهُ تِسْعُ نِسْوَةٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ لِي خَلِيفَةُ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ أَنَسًا، حَدَّثَهُمْ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yatuwfu 'alaa nisaaiihi fiy laylaain waahidaain, walahu tis'u niswaain‏.‏ waqaala liy khaliyfaau haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, aanna aanasana, haddathahum 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to go round (have sexual relations with) all his wives in one night, and he had nine wives
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ رَقَبَةَ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ الْيَامِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ هَلْ تَزَوَّجْتَ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَزَوَّجْ فَإِنَّ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الأُمَّةِ أَكْثَرُهَا نِسَاءً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu alhakami alaansaariyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an raqabaaa, 'an talhaaa alyaamiyyi, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala qaala liy abnu 'abbaasin hal tazawwajta qultu laa‏.‏ qaala fatazawwaj faiinna khayra hadhihi alaummaai aaktharuhaa nisaa'an‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:Ibn `Abbas asked me, "Are you married?" I replied, "No." He said, "Marry, for the best person of this (Muslim) nation (i.e., Muhammad) of all other Muslims, had the largest number of wives
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْعَمَلُ بِالنِّيَّةِ، وَإِنَّمَا لاِمْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى، فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى دُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا أَوِ امْرَأَةٍ يَنْكِحُهَا، فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu qaza'aaa, haddathanaa maalikun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an muhammadi bni iibraahiyma bni alhaarithi, 'an 'alqamaaa bni waqqaasin, 'an 'umara bni alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ al'amalu bialnniyyaai, waiinnamaa laimriiin maa nawaa, faman kaanat hijratuhu iilaa alllahi warasuwlihi fahijratuhu iilaa alllahi warasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm waman kaanat hijratuhu iilaa dunyaa yusiybuhaa aawi amraaaain yankihuhaa, fahijratuhu iilaa maa haajara iilayhi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The rewards (of deeds) are according to the intention, and everybody will get the reward for what he has intended. So whoever emigrated for Allah's and His Apostle's sake, his emigration was for Allah and His Apostle; and whoever emigrated for worldly benefits, or to marry a woman, then his emigration was for the thing for what he emigrated for
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي قَيْسٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا نَغْزُو مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَيْسَ لَنَا نِسَاءٌ فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلاَ نَسْتَخْصِي فَنَهَانَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy qaysun, 'ani abni mas'uwdin rda allh 'nh qaala kunnaa naghzuw ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm walaysa lanaa nisaa'un faqulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi aalaa nastakhsiy fanahaanaa 'an dhalika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Masud:We used to fight in the holy battles in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and we had no wives with us. So we said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we get castrated?" The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us to do so
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَدِمَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ فَآخَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ سَعْدِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ وَعِنْدَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ امْرَأَتَانِ، فَعَرَضَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُنَاصِفَهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمَالَهُ فَقَالَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ دُلُّونِي عَلَى السُّوقِ، فَأَتَى السُّوقَ فَرَبِحَ شَيْئًا مِنْ أَقِطٍ وَشَيْئًا مِنْ سَمْنٍ فَرَآهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ أَيَّامٍ وَعَلَيْهِ وَضَرٌ مِنْ صُفْرَةٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَهْيَمْ يَا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ تَزَوَّجْتُ أَنْصَارِيَّةً‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَمَا سُقْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَزْنَ نَوَاةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَوْلِمْ وَلَوْ بِشَاةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, 'an sufyaana, 'an humaydin alttawiyli, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, qaala qadima 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'awfin faakhaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm baynahu wabayna sa'di bni alrrabiy'i alaansaariyyi wa'inda alaansaariyyi amraaataani, fa'arada 'alayhi aan yunaasifahu aahlahu wamaalahu faqaala baaraka alllahu laka fiy aahlika wamaalika dulluwniy 'alaa alssuwqi, faaataa alssuwqa farabiha shayiana min aaqitin washayiana min samnin faraahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da aayyaamin wa'alayhi wadarun min sufraain faqaala ‏"‏ mahyam yaa 'abda alrrahmani ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala tazawwajtu aansaariyyaaan‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ famaa suqta ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala wazna nawaaain min dhahabin‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aawlim walaw bishaaain ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:`Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf came (from Mecca to Medina) and the Prophet (ﷺ) made a bond of brotherhood between him and Sa`d bin Ar-Rabi` Al-Ansari. Al-Ansari had two wives, so he suggested that `Abdur- Rahman take half, his wives and property. `Abdur-Rahman replied, "May Allah bless you with your wives and property. Kindly show me the market." So `Abdur-Rahman went to the market and gained (in bargains) some dried yoghurt and some butter. After a few days the Prophet (ﷺ) saw `Abdur-Rahman with some yellow stains on his clothes and asked him, "What is that, O `Abdur-Rahman?" He replied, "I had married an Ansari woman." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "How much Mahr did you give her?" He replied, "The weight of one (date) stone of gold." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Offer a banquet, even with one sheep
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، سَمِعَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، يَقُولُ رَدَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَظْعُونٍ التَّبَتُّلَ، وَلَوْ أَذِنَ لَهُ لاَخْتَصَيْنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, hadaathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, aakhbaranaa abnu shihaabin, sami'a sa'iyda bna almusayaabi, yaquwlu sami'tu sa'da bna aabiy waqaaasin, yaquwlu radaa rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa 'uthmaana bni maz'uwnin altaabatuula, walaw aadhina lahu laakhtasaynaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade `Uthman bin Maz'un to abstain from marrying (and other pleasures) and if he had allowed him, we would have gotten ourselves castrated
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، يَقُولُ لَقَدْ رَدَّ ذَلِكَ ـ يَعْنِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ عَلَى عُثْمَانَ، وَلَوْ أَجَازَ لَهُ التَّبَتُّلَ لاَخْتَصَيْنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzuuhriyii, qaala aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayaabi, aanaahu sami'a sa'da bna aabiy waqaaasin, yaquwlu laqad radaa dhalika ya'niy alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa 'uthmaana, walaw aajaaza lahu altaabatuula laakhtasaynaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:The Prophet (ﷺ) prevented `Uthman bin Mazun from that (not marrying), and had he allowed him, we would have got ourselves castrated
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ كُنَّا نَغْزُو مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَيْسَ لَنَا شَىْءٌ فَقُلْنَا أَلاَ نَسْتَخْصِي فَنَهَانَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ رَخَّصَ لَنَا أَنْ نَنْكِحَ الْمَرْأَةَ بِالثَّوْبِ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ عَلَيْنَا ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تُحَرِّمُوا طَيِّبَاتِ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلاَ تَعْتَدُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِينَ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, hadaathanaa jariyrun, 'an iismaa'iyla, 'an qaysin, qaala qaala 'abdu allaahi kunaaa naghzuw ma'a rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm walaysa lanaa shaa'un faqulnaa aalaa nastakhsiy fanahaanaa 'an dhalika thumaa rakhaasa lanaa aan nankiha almaraaaa bialthaawbi, thumaa qaraaa 'alaynaa ‏{‏yaa aayuuhaa alaadhiyna amanuwa laa tuhariimuwa tayiibaati maa aahalaa allaahu lakum walaa ta'taduwa iinaa allaaha laa yuhibuu almu'tadiyna‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Abdullah: We used to participate in the holy battles led by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we had nothing (no wives) with us. So we said, "Shall we get ourselves castrated?" He forbade us that and then allowed us to marry women with a temporary contract (2) and recited to us: -- 'O you who believe ! Make not unlawful the good things which Allah has made lawful for you, but commit no transgression
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ أَصْبَغُ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي رَجُلٌ شَابٌّ وَأَنَا أَخَافُ عَلَى نَفْسِي الْعَنَتَ وَلاَ أَجِدُ مَا أَتَزَوَّجُ بِهِ النِّسَاءَ، فَسَكَتَ عَنِّي، ثُمَّ قُلْتُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَسَكَتَ عَنِّي ثُمَّ قُلْتُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَسَكَتَ عَنِّي ثُمَّ قُلْتُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ جَفَّ الْقَلَمُ بِمَا أَنْتَ لاَقٍ، فَاخْتَصِ عَلَى ذَلِكَ أَوْ ذَرْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala aasbaghu aakhbaraniy abnu wahbin, 'an yuwnusa bni yaziyda, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qultu yaa rasuwla allaahi iiniiy rajulun shaabunn waaanaa aakhaafu 'alaa nafsiy al'anata walaa aajidu maa aatazawaaju bihi alniisaa'a, fasakata 'aniiy, thumaa qultu mithla dhalika, fasakata 'aniiy thumaa qultu mithla dhalika, fasakata 'aniiy thumaa qultu mithla dhalika, faqaala alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa aabaa hurayraaa jafaa alqalamu bimaa aanta laaqin, faakhtasi 'alaa dhalika aaw dhar ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I am a young man and I am afraid that I may commit illegal sexual intercourse and I cannot afford to marry." He kept silent, and then repeated my question once again, but he kept silent. I said the same (for the third time) and he remained silent. Then repeated my question (for the fourth time), and only then the Prophet said, "O Abu Huraira! The pen has dried after writing what you are going to confront. So (it does not matter whether you) get yourself castrated or not
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَخِي، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ نَزَلْتَ وَادِيًا وَفِيهِ شَجَرَةٌ قَدْ أُكِلَ مِنْهَا، وَوَجَدْتَ شَجَرًا لَمْ يُؤْكَلْ مِنْهَا، فِي أَيِّهَا كُنْتَ تُرْتِعُ بَعِيرَكَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فِي الَّذِي لَمْ يُرْتَعْ مِنْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ تَعْنِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَتَزَوَّجْ بِكْرًا غَيْرَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy aakhiy, 'an sulaymaana, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aaraaayta law nazalta waadiyana wafiyhi shajaraaun qad aukila minhaa, wawajadta shajarana lam yuukal minhaa, fiy aayyihaa kunta turti'u ba'iyraka qaala ‏ "‏ fiy alladhiy lam yurta' minhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ ta'niy aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lam yatazawwaj bikrana ghayrahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Suppose you landed in a valley where there is a tree of which something has been eaten and then you found trees of which nothing has been eaten, of which tree would you let your camel graze?" He said, "(I will let my camel graze) of the one of which nothing has been eaten before." (The sub-narrator added: `Aisha meant that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had not married a virgin besides herself
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أُرِيتُكِ فِي الْمَنَامِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، إِذَا رَجُلٌ يَحْمِلُكِ فِي سَرَقَةِ حَرِيرٍ فَيَقُولُ هَذِهِ امْرَأَتُكَ، فَأَكْشِفُهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ أَنْتِ، فَأَقُولُ إِنْ يَكُنْ هَذَا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ يُمْضِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ auriytuki fiy almanaami marratayni, iidhaa rajulun yahmiluki fiy saraqaai hariyrin fayaquwlu hadhihi amraaatuka, faaakshifuhaa faiidhaa hiya aanti, faaaquwlu iin yakun hadhaa min 'indi alllahi yumdihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to me), "You have been shown to me twice in (my) dreams. A man was carrying you in a silken cloth and said to me, 'This is your wife.' I uncovered it; and behold, it was you. I said to myself, 'If this dream is from Allah, He will cause it to come true
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سَيَّارٌ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَفَلْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ غَزْوَةٍ فَتَعَجَّلْتُ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ لِي قَطُوفٍ، فَلَحِقَنِي رَاكِبٌ مِنْ خَلْفِي، فَنَخَسَ بَعِيرِي بِعَنَزَةٍ كَانَتْ مَعَهُ، فَانْطَلَقَ بَعِيرِي كَأَجْوَدِ مَا أَنْتَ رَاءٍ مِنَ الإِبِلِ، فَإِذَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا يُعْجِلُكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ كُنْتُ حَدِيثَ عَهْدٍ بِعُرُسٍ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِكْرًا أَمْ ثَيِّبًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ ثَيِّبٌ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلاَّ جَارِيَةً تُلاَعِبُهَا وَتُلاَعِبُكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا ذَهَبْنَا لِنَدْخُلَ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمْهِلُوا حَتَّى تَدْخُلُوا لَيْلاً ـ أَىْ عِشَاءً ـ لِكَىْ تَمْتَشِطَ الشَّعِثَةُ وَتَسْتَحِدَّ الْمُغِيبَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw alnuu'maani, hadaathanaa hushaymun, hadaathanaa sayaaarun, 'ani alshaa'biyii, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi allaahi, qaala qafalnaa ma'a alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm min ghazwaain fata'ajaaltu 'alaa ba'iyrin liy qatuwfin, falahiqaniy raakibun min khalfiy, fanakhasa ba'iyriy bi'anazaain kaanat ma'ahu, faantalaqa ba'iyriy kaaajwadi maa aanta raa'in mina aliibili, faiidhaa alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ maa yu'jiluka ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu kuntu hadiytha 'ahdin bi'urusin‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ bikrana aam thayiibana ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu thayiibun‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fahalaaa jaariyaaan tulaa'ibuhaa watulaa'ibuka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala falamaaa dhahabnaa linadkhula qaala ‏"‏ aamhiluwa hataaa tadkhuluwa laylaan aaa 'ishaa'an likaa tamtashita alshaa'ithaau watastahidaa almughiybaau ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:While we were returning from a Ghazwa (Holy Battle) with the Prophet, I started driving my camel fast, as it was a lazy camel A rider came behind me and pricked my camel with a spear he had with him, and then my camel started running as fast as the best camel you may see. Behold! The rider was the Prophet (ﷺ) himself. He said, 'What makes you in such a hurry?" I replied, I am newly married " He said, "Did you marry a virgin or a matron? I replied, "A matron." He said, "Why didn't you marry a young girl so that you may play with her and she with you?" When we were about to enter (Medina), the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wait so that you may enter (Medina) at night so that the lady of unkempt hair may comb her hair and the one whose husband has been absent may shave her pubic region
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَارِبٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، رضى الله عنهما يَقُولُ تَزَوَّجْتُ فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا تَزَوَّجْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ تَزَوَّجْتُ ثَيِّبًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكَ وَلِلْعَذَارَى وَلِعَابِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِعَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ فَقَالَ عَمْرٌو سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلاَّ جَارِيَةً تُلاَعِبُهَا وَتُلاَعِبُكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa adamu, hadaathanaa shu'baau, hadaathanaa muhaaribun, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi allaahi, rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu tazawaajtu faqaala liy rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa tazawaajta ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu tazawaajtu thayiibana‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ maa laka walil'adhaaraa wali'aabihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ fadhakartu dhalika li'amriw bni diynaarin faqaala 'amrunw sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi allaahi yaquwlu qaala liy rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ halaaa jaariyaaan tulaa'ibuhaa watulaa'ibuka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:When I got married, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "What type of lady have you married?" I replied, "I have married a matron' He said, "Why, don't you have a liking for the virgins and for fondling them?" Jabir also said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Why didn't you marry a young girl so that you might play with her and she with you?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عِرَاكٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَطَبَ عَائِشَةَ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ إِنَّمَا أَنَا أَخُوكَ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَنْتَ أَخِي فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ وَكِتَابِهِ وَهْىَ لِي حَلاَلٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yaziyda, 'an 'iraakin, 'an 'urwaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm khataba 'aaiishaaa iilaa aabiy bakrin faqaala lahu aabuw bakrin iinnamaa aanaa aakhuwka, faqaala ‏ "‏ aanta aakhiy fiy diyni alllahi wakitaabihi wahaa liy halaalun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Urwa:The Prophet (ﷺ) asked Abu Bakr for `Aisha's hand in marriage. Abu Bakr said "But I am your brother." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You are my brother in Allah's religion and His Book, but she (Aisha) is lawful for me to marry
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ خَيْرُ نِسَاءٍ رَكِبْنَ الإِبِلَ صَالِحُو نِسَاءِ قُرَيْشٍ، أَحْنَاهُ عَلَى وَلَدٍ فِي صِغَرِهِ وَأَرْعَاهُ عَلَى زَوْجٍ فِي ذَاتِ يَدِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, hadaathanaa aabuw alziinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ khayru nisaa'in rakibna aliibila saalihuw nisaa'i qurayshin, aahnaahu 'alaa waladin fiy sigharihi waaar'aahu 'alaa zawjin fiy dhaati yadihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best women are the riders of the camels and the righteous among the women of Quraish. They are the kindest women to their children in their childhood and the more careful women of the property of their husbands
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الشَّعْبِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ كَانَتْ عِنْدَهُ وَلِيدَةٌ فَعَلَّمَهَا فَأَحْسَنَ تَعْلِيمَهَا، وَأَدَّبَهَا فَأَحْسَنَ تَأْدِيبَهَا، ثُمَّ أَعْتَقَهَا وَتَزَوَّجَهَا فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ، وَأَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ آمَنَ بِنَبِيِّهِ وَآمَنَ بِي فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ، وَأَيُّمَا مَمْلُوكٍ أَدَّى حَقَّ مَوَالِيهِ وَحَقَّ رَبِّهِ فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ خُذْهَا بِغَيْرِ شَىْءٍ قَدْ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ يَرْحَلُ فِيمَا دُونَهُ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَعْتَقَهَا ثُمَّ أَصْدَقَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, haddathanaa saalihu bnu saalihin alhamdaaniyyu, haddathanaa alshha'biyyu, qaala haddathaniy aabuw burdaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aayyumaa rajulin kaanat 'indahu waliydaaun fa'allamahaa faaahsana ta'liymahaa, waaaddabahaa faaahsana taadiybahaa, thumma aa'taqahaa watazawwajahaa falahu aajraani, waaayyumaa rajulin min aahli alkitaabi amana binabiyyihi waamana biy falahu aajraani, waaayyumaa mamluwkin aaddaa haqqa mawaaliyhi wahaqqa rabbihi falahu aajraani ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala alshha'biyyu khudhhaa bighayri shaa'in qad kaana alrrajulu yarhalu fiymaa duwnahu iilaa almadiynaai‏.‏ waqaala aabuw bakrin 'an aabiy hasiynin 'an aabiy burdaaa 'an aabiyhi 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aa'taqahaa thumma aasdaqahaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda's father:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, any man who has a slave girl whom he educates properly, teaches good manners, manumits and marries her, will get a double reward And if any man of the people of the Scriptures believes in his own prophet and then believes in me too, he will (also) get a double reward And any slave who fulfills his duty to his master and to his Lord, will (also) get a double reward
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ تَلِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏{‏قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏}‏ ‏ "‏ لَمْ يَكْذِبْ إِبْرَاهِيمُ إِلاَّ ثَلاَثَ كَذَبَاتٍ بَيْنَمَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ مَرَّ بِجَبَّارٍ وَمَعَهُ سَارَةُ ـ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ ـ فَأَعْطَاهَا هَاجَرَ قَالَتْ كَفَّ اللَّهُ يَدَ الْكَافِرِ وَأَخْدَمَنِي آجَرَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَتِلْكَ أُمُّكُمْ يَا بَنِي مَاءِ السَّمَاءِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu taliydin, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy jariyru bnu haazimin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ haddathanaa sulaymaanu 'an hammaadi bni zaydin 'an aayyuwba 'an muhammadin 'an aabiy hurayraaa ‏{‏qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏}‏ ‏ "‏ lam yakdhib iibraahiymu iilaaa thalaatha kadhabaatin baynamaa iibraahiymu marra bijabbaarin wama'ahu saaraau fadhakara alhadiytha faaa'taahaa haajara qaalat kaffa alllahu yada alkaafiri waaakhdamaniy ajara ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw hurayraaa fatilka aummukum yaa baniy maa'i alssamaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Abraham did not tell lies except three. (One of them was) when Abraham passed by a tyrant and (his wife) Sara was accompanying him (Abu Huraira then mentioned the whole narration and said:) (The tyrant) gave her Hajar. Sara said, "Allah saved me from the hands of the Kafir (i.e. infidel) and gave me Hajar to serve me." (Abu Huraira added:) That (Hajar) is your mother, O Banu Ma'-As-Sama' (i.e., the Arabs)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ خَيْبَرَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ثَلاَثًا يُبْنَى عَلَيْهِ بِصَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ حُيَىٍّ فَدَعَوْتُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ إِلَى وَلِيمَتِهِ فَمَا كَانَ فِيهَا مِنْ خُبْزٍ وَلاَ لَحْمٍ، أُمِرَ بِالأَنْطَاعِ فَأَلْقَى فِيهَا مِنَ التَّمْرِ وَالأَقِطِ وَالسَّمْنِ فَكَانَتْ وَلِيمَتَهُ، فَقَالَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ إِحْدَى أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَوْ مِمَّا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُهُ، فَقَالُوا إِنْ حَجَبَهَا فَهْىَ مِنْ أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَحْجُبْهَا فَهْىَ مِمَّا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُهُ، فَلَمَّا ارْتَحَلَ وَطَّى لَهَا خَلْفَهُ وَمَدَّ الْحِجَابَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ النَّاسِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an humaydin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala aaqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna khaybara waalmadiynaai thalaathana yubnaa 'alayhi bisafiyyaaa binti huyaaain fada'awtu almuslimiyna iilaa waliymatihi famaa kaana fiyhaa min khubzin walaa lahmin, aumira bialaantaa'i faaalqaa fiyhaa mina alttamri waalaaqiti waalssamni fakaanat waliymatahu, faqaala almuslimuwna iihdaa aummahaati almuuminiyna aaw mimmaa malakat yamiynuhu, faqaaluwa iin hajabahaa fahaa min aummahaati almuuminiyna, waiin lam yahjubhaa fahaa mimmaa malakat yamiynuhu, falammaa artahala wattaa lahaa khalfahu wamadda alhijaaba baynahaa wabayna alnnaasi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) stayed for three days between Khaibar and Medina, and there he consummated his marriage to Safiyya bint Huyai. I invited the Muslims to the wedding banquet in which neither meat nor bread was offered. He ordered for leather dining-sheets to be spread, and dates, dried yoghurt and butter were laid on it, and that was the Prophet's wedding banquet. The Muslims wondered, "Is she (Saffiyya) considered as his wife or his slave girl?" Then they said, "If he orders her to veil herself, she will be one of the mothers of the Believers; but if he does not order her to veil herself, she will be a slave girl. So when the Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded from there, he spared her a space behind him (on his she-camel) and put a screening veil between her and the people
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، وَشُعَيْبِ بْنِ الْحَبْحَابِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْتَقَ صَفِيَّةَ، وَجَعَلَ عِتْقَهَا صَدَاقَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, hadaathanaa hamaaadun, 'an thaabitin, washu'aybi bni alhabhaabi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanaa rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aa'taqa safiyaaaa, waja'ala 'itqahaa sadaaqahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) manumitted Safiyya and regarded her manumission as her Mahr
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، قَالَ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ جِئْتُ أَهَبُ لَكَ نَفْسِي قَالَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ فِيهَا وَصَوَّبَهُ ثُمَّ طَأْطَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأْسَهُ فَلَمَّا رَأَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَقْضِ فِيهَا شَيْئًا جَلَسَتْ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَكَ بِهَا حَاجَةٌ فَزَوِّجْنِيهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَهَلْ عِنْدَكَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اذْهَبْ إِلَى أَهْلِكَ فَانْظُرْ هَلْ تَجِدُ شَيْئًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَذَهَبَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَقَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا وَجَدْتُ شَيْئًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ انْظُرْ وَلَوْ خَاتَمًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَذَهَبَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَقَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلاَ خَاتَمًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ وَلَكِنْ هَذَا إِزَارِي ـ قَالَ سَهْلٌ مَا لَهُ رِدَاءٌ فَلَهَا نِصْفُهُ ـ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا تَصْنَعُ بِإِزَارِكَ إِنْ لَبِسْتَهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهَا مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ وَإِنْ لَبِسَتْهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْكَ شَىْءٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَلَسَ الرَّجُلُ حَتَّى إِذَا طَالَ مَجْلِسُهُ قَامَ فَرَآهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُوَلِّيًا فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَدُعِيَ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَاذَا مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ مَعِي سُورَةُ كَذَا وَسُورَةُ كَذَا عَدَّدَهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ تَقْرَؤُهُنَّ عَنْ ظَهْرِ قَلْبِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اذْهَبْ فَقَدْ مَلَّكْتُكَهَا بِمَا مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi, qaala jaa'ati amraaaaun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi jiitu aahabu laka nafsiy qaala fanazara iilayhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasa''ada alnnazara fiyhaa wasawwabahu thumma taataaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm raasahu falammaa raaati almaraaau aannahu lam yaqdi fiyhaa shayiana jalasat faqaama rajulun min aashaabihi faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iin lam yakun laka bihaa haajaaun fazawwijniyhaa‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ wahal 'indaka min shaa'in ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala laa waalllahi yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ adhhab iilaa aahlika faanzur hal tajidu shayiana ‏"‏‏.‏ fadhahaba thumma raja'a faqaala laa waalllahi maa wajadtu shayiana‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ anzur walaw khaatamana min hadiydin ‏"‏‏.‏ fadhahaba thumma raja'a faqaala laa waalllahi yaa rasuwla alllahi walaa khaatamana min hadiydin walakin hadhaa iizaariy qaala sahlun maa lahu ridaa'un falahaa nisfuhu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa tasna'u biiizaarika iin labistahu lam yakun 'alayhaa minhu shaa'un waiin labisathu lam yakun 'alayka shaa'un ‏"‏‏.‏ fajalasa alrrajulu hattaa iidhaa taala majlisuhu qaama faraahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm muwalliyana faaamara bihi fadu'iya falammaa jaa'a qaala ‏"‏ maadhaa ma'aka mina alqurani ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala ma'iy suwraau kadhaa wasuwraau kadhaa 'addadahaa‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ taqrauuhunna 'an zahri qalbika ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ adhhab faqad mallaktukahaa bimaa ma'aka mina alqurani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:A woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have come to give you myself in marriage (without Mahr)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) looked at her. He looked at her carefully and fixed his glance on her and then lowered his head. When the lady saw that he did not say anything, she sat down. A man from his companions got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If you are not in need of her, then marry her to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have you got anything to offer?" The man said, "No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Go to your family and see if you have something." The man went and returned, saying, "No, by Allah, I have not found anything." Allah's Apostle said, "(Go again) and look for something, even if it is an iron ring." He went again and returned, saying, "No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I could not find even an iron ring, but this is my Izar (waist sheet)." He had no rida. He added, "I give half of it to her." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "What will she do with your Izar? If you wear it, she will be naked, and if she wears it, you will be naked." So that man sat down for a long while and then got up (to depart). When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him going, he ordered that he be called back. When he came, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "How much of the Qur'an do you know?" He said, "I know such Sura and such Sura," counting them. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you know them by heart?" He replied, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go, I marry her to you for that much of the Qur'an which you have
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ أَبَا حُذَيْفَةَ بْنَ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ شَمْسٍ،، وَكَانَ، مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَبَنَّى سَالِمًا، وَأَنْكَحَهُ بِنْتَ أَخِيهِ هِنْدَ بِنْتَ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ وَهْوَ مَوْلًى لاِمْرَأَةٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ، كَمَا تَبَنَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَيْدًا، وَكَانَ مَنْ تَبَنَّى رَجُلاً فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ دَعَاهُ النَّاسُ إِلَيْهِ وَوَرِثَ مِنْ مِيرَاثِهِ حَتَّى أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏ادْعُوهُمْ لآبَائِهِمْ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏وَمَوَالِيكُمْ‏}‏ فَرُدُّوا إِلَى آبَائِهِمْ، فَمَنْ لَمْ يُعْلَمْ لَهُ أَبٌ كَانَ مَوْلًى وَأَخًا فِي الدِّينِ، فَجَاءَتْ سَهْلَةُ بِنْتُ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الْقُرَشِيِّ ثُمَّ الْعَامِرِيِّ ـ وَهْىَ امْرَأَةُ أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ ـ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَرَى سَالِمًا وَلَدًا وَقَدْ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِيهِ مَا قَدْ عَلِمْتَ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna aabaa hudhayfaaa bna 'utbaaa bni rabiy'aaa bni 'abdi shamsin, , wakaana, mimman shahida badrana ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm tabannaa saalimana, waaankahahu binta aakhiyhi hinda binta alwaliydi bni 'utbaaa bni rabiy'aaa wahwa mawlana laimraaaain mina alaansaari, kamaa tabannaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm zaydana, wakaana man tabannaa rajulaan fiy aljaahiliyyaai da'aahu alnnaasu iilayhi wawaritha min miyraathihi hattaa aanzala alllahu ‏{‏ad'uwhum labaaiihim‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏wamawaaliykum‏}‏ farudduwa iilaa abaaiihim, faman lam yu'lam lahu aabun kaana mawlana waaakhana fiy alddiyni, fajaa'at sahlaau bintu suhayli bni 'amrinw alqurashiyyi thumma al'aamiriyyi wahaa amraaaau aabiy hudhayfaaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaa kunnaa naraa saalimana waladana waqad aanzala alllahu fiyhi maa qad 'alimta fadhakara alhadiytha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Abu Hudhaifa bin `Utba bin Rabi`a bin `Abdi Shams who had witnessed the battle of Badr along with the Prophet (ﷺ) adopted Salim as his son, to whom he married his niece, Hind bint Al-Walid bin `Utba bin Rabi`a; and Salim was the freed slave of an Ansar woman, just as the Prophet (ﷺ) had adopted Zaid as his son. It was the custom in the Pre-Islamic Period that if somebody adopted a boy, the people would call him the son of the adoptive father and he would be the latter's heir. But when Allah revealed the Divine Verses: 'Call them by (the names of) their fathers . . . your freed-slaves,' (33.5) the adopted persons were called by their fathers' names. The one whose father was not known, would be regarded as a Maula and your brother in religion. Later on Sahla bint Suhail bin `Amr Al-Quraishi Al-`Amiri-- and she was the wife of Abu- Hudhaifa bin `Utba--came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We used to consider Salim as our (adopted) son, and now Allah has revealed what you know (regarding adopted sons)." The sub-narrator then mentioned the rest of the narration
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى ضُبَاعَةَ بِنْتِ الزُّبَيْرِ فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ لَعَلَّكِ أَرَدْتِ الْحَجَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَجِدُنِي إِلاَّ وَجِعَةً‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ حُجِّي وَاشْتَرِطِي، قُولِي اللَّهُمَّ مَحِلِّي حَيْثُ حَبَسْتَنِي ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَتْ تَحْتَ الْمِقْدَادِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat dakhala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa dubaa'aaa binti alzzubayri faqaala lahaa ‏"‏ la'allaki aaradti alhajja ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat waalllahi laa aajiduniy iilaaa waji'aaan‏.‏ faqaala lahaa ‏"‏ hujjiy waashtaritiy, quwliy alllahumma mahilliy haythu habastaniy ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaanat tahta almiqdaadi bni alaaswadi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered upon Dubaa bint Az-Zubair and said to her, "Do you have a desire to perform the Hajj?" She replied, "By Allah, I feel sick." He said to her, "Intend to perform Hajj and stipulate something by saying, 'O Allah, I will finish my Ihram at any place where You stop me (i.e. I am unable to go further)." She was the wife of Al-Miqdad bin Al-Aswad
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ تُنْكَحُ الْمَرْأَةُ لأَرْبَعٍ لِمَالِهَا وَلِحَسَبِهَا وَجَمَالِهَا وَلِدِينِهَا، فَاظْفَرْ بِذَاتِ الدِّينِ تَرِبَتْ يَدَاكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu aabiy sa'iydin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ tunkahu almaraaau laarba'in limaalihaa walihasabihaa wajamaalihaa walidiynihaa, faazfar bidhaati alddiyni taribat yadaaka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A woman is married for four things, i.e., her wealth, her family status, her beauty and her religion. So you should marry the religious woman (otherwise) you will be a losers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ رَجُلٌ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا تَقُولُونَ فِي هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا حَرِيٌّ إِنْ خَطَبَ أَنْ يُنْكَحَ، وَإِنْ شَفَعَ أَنْ يُشَفَّعَ، وَإِنْ قَالَ أَنْ يُسْتَمَعَ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ سَكَتَ فَمَرَّ رَجُلٌ مِنَ فُقَرَاءِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا تَقُولُونَ فِي هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا حَرِيٌّ إِنْ خَطَبَ أَنْ لاَ يُنْكَحَ وَإِنْ شَفَعَ أَنْ لاَ يُشَفَّعَ، وَإِنْ قَالَ أَنْ لاَ يُسْتَمَعَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَذَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ مِلْءِ الأَرْضِ مِثْلَ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu hamzaaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sahlin, qaala marra rajulun 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ maa taquwluwna fiy hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa hariyyun iin khataba aan yunkaha, waiin shafa'a aan yushaffa'a, waiin qaala aan yustama'a‏.‏ qaala thumma sakata famarra rajulun mina fuqaraa'i almuslimiyna faqaala ‏"‏ maa taquwluwna fiy hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa hariyyun iin khataba aan laa yunkaha waiin shafa'a aan laa yushaffa'a, waiin qaala aan laa yustama'a‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hadhaa khayrun min mil'i alaardi mithla hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl:A man passed by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Allah's Apostle asked (his companions) "What do you say about this (man)?" They replied "If he asks for a lady's hand, he ought to be given her in marriage; and if he intercedes (for someone) his intercessor should be accepted; and if he speaks, he should be listened to." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept silent, and then a man from among the poor Muslims passed by, an Allah's Apostle asked (them) "What do you say about this man?" They replied, "If he asks for a lady's hand in marriage he does not deserve to be married, and he intercedes (for someone), his intercession should not be accepted; And if he speaks, he should not be listened to.' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "This poor man is better than so many of the first as filling the earth
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ ‏{‏وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتَامَى‏}‏ قَالَتْ يَا ابْنَ أُخْتِي هَذِهِ الْيَتِيمَةُ تَكُونُ فِي حَجْرِ وَلِيِّهَا فَيَرْغَبُ فِي جَمَالِهَا وَمَالِهَا، وَيُرِيدُ أَنْ يَنْتَقِصَ صَدَاقَهَا، فَنُهُوا عَنْ نِكَاحِهِنَّ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُقْسِطُوا فِي إِكْمَالِ الصَّدَاقِ، وَأُمِرُوا بِنِكَاحِ مَنْ سِوَاهُنَّ، قَالَتْ وَاسْتَفْتَى النَّاسُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏وَيَسْتَفْتُونَكَ فِي النِّسَاءِ‏}‏ إِلَى ‏{‏وَتَرْغَبُونَ أَنْ تَنْكِحُوهُنَّ‏}‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ أَنَّ الْيَتِيمَةَ إِذَا كَانَتْ ذَاتَ جَمَالٍ وَمَالٍ رَغِبُوا فِي نِكَاحِهَا وَنَسَبِهَا فِي إِكْمَالِ الصَّدَاقِ، وَإِذَا كَانَتْ مَرْغُوبَةً عَنْهَا فِي قِلَّةِ الْمَالِ وَالْجَمَالِ تَرَكُوهَا وَأَخَذُوا غَيْرَهَا مِنَ النِّسَاءِ، قَالَتْ فَكَمَا يَتْرُكُونَهَا حِينَ يَرْغَبُونَ عَنْهَا فَلَيْسَ لَهُمْ أَنْ يَنْكِحُوهَا إِذَا رَغِبُوا فِيهَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يُقْسِطُوا لَهَا وَيُعْطُوهَا حَقَّهَا الأَوْفَى فِي الصَّدَاقِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau, aannahu saaala 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha ‏{‏waiin khiftum aan laa tuqsituwa fiy alyataamaa‏}‏ qaalat yaa abna aukhtiy hadhihi alyatiymaau takuwnu fiy hajri waliyyihaa fayarghabu fiy jamaalihaa wamaalihaa, wayuriydu aan yantaqisa sadaaqahaa, fanuhuwa 'an nikaahihinna iilaaa aan yuqsituwa fiy iikmaali alssadaaqi, waaumiruwa binikaahi man siwaahunna, qaalat waastaftaa alnnaasu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da dhalika, faaanzala alllahu ‏{‏wayastaftuwnaka fiy alnnisaa'i‏}‏ iilaa ‏{‏watarghabuwna aan tankihuwhunna‏}‏ faaanzala alllahu lahum aanna alyatiymaaa iidhaa kaanat dhaata jamaalin wamaalin raghibuwa fiy nikaahihaa wanasabihaa fiy iikmaali alssadaaqi, waiidhaa kaanat marghuwbaaan 'anhaa fiy qillaai almaali waaljamaali tarakuwhaa waaakhadhuwa ghayrahaa mina alnnisaa'i, qaalat fakamaa yatrukuwnahaa hiyna yarghabuwna 'anhaa falaysa lahum aan yankihuwhaa iidhaa raghibuwa fiyhaa iilaaa aan yuqsituwa lahaa wayu'tuwhaa haqqahaa alaawfaa fiy alssadaaqi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Urwa:that he asked `Aisha regarding the Verse: 'If you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with the orphans (4.3) She said, "O my nephew! This Verse refers to the orphan girl who is under the guardianship of her guardian who likes her beauty and wealth and wishes to (marry her and) curtails her Mahr. Such guardians have been forbidden to marry them unless they do justice by giving them their full Mahr, and they have been ordered to marry other than them. The people asked for the verdict of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) after that, so Allah revealed: 'They ask your instruction concerning the women . . . whom you desire to marry.' (4.127) So Allah revealed to them that if the orphan girl had beauty and wealth, they desired to marry her and for her family status. They can only marry them if they give them their full Mahr. And if they had no desire to marry them because of their lack of wealth and beauty, they would leave them and marry other women. So, as they used to leave them, when they had no interest, in them, they were forbidden to marry them when they had such interest, unless they treated them justly and gave them their full Mahr Apostle said, 'If at all there is evil omen, it is in the horse, the woman and the house." a lady is to be warded off. And the Statement of Allah: 'Truly, among your wives and your children, there are enemies for you (i.e may stop you from the obedience of Allah)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ، وَسَالِمٍ، ابْنَىْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الشُّؤْمُ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ وَالدَّارِ وَالْفَرَسِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an hamzaaa, wasaalimin, abnaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alshhuumu fiy almaraaai waalddaari waalfarasi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Evil omen is in the women, the house and the horse
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْعَسْقَلاَنِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ ذَكَرُوا الشُّؤْمَ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنْ كَانَ الشُّؤْمُ فِي شَىْءٍ فَفِي الدَّارِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ وَالْفَرَسِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu muhammadin al'asqalaaniyyu, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala dhakaruwa alshhuuma 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iin kaana alshhuumu fiy shaa'in fafiy alddaari waalmaraaai waalfarasi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Evil omen was mentioned before the Prophet: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If there is evil omen in anything, it is in the house, the woman and the horse
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ كَانَ فِي شَىْءٍ فَفِي الْفَرَسِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ وَالْمَسْكَنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iin kaana fiy shaa'in fafiy alfarasi waalmaraaai waalmaskani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If at all there is bad omen, it is in the horse, the woman, and the house
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيَّ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا تَرَكْتُ بَعْدِي فِتْنَةً أَضَرَّ عَلَى الرِّجَالِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sulaymaana alttaymiyyi, qaala sami'tu aabaa 'uthmaana alnnahdiyya, 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa taraktu ba'diy fitnaaan aadarra 'alaa alrrijaali mina alnnisaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "After me I have not left any trial more severe to men than women
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ فِي بَرِيرَةَ ثَلاَثُ سُنَنٍ عَتَقَتْ فَخُيِّرَتْ، وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَدَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبُرْمَةٌ عَلَى النَّارِ، فَقُرِّبَ إِلَيْهِ خُبْزٌ وَأُدْمٌ مِنْ أُدْمِ الْبَيْتِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَمْ أَرَ الْبُرْمَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لَحْمٌ تُصُدِّقَ عَلَى بَرِيرَةَ، وَأَنْتَ لاَ تَأْكُلُ الصَّدَقَةَ قَالَ ‏"‏ هُوَ عَلَيْهَا صَدَقَةٌ، وَلَنَا هَدِيَّةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an rabiy'aaa bni aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaana fiy bariyraaa thalaathu sunanin 'ataqat fakhuyyirat, waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alwalaa'u liman aa'taqa ‏"‏‏.‏ wadakhala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waburmaaun 'alaa alnnaari, faqurriba iilayhi khubzun waaudmun min audmi albayti faqaala ‏"‏ lam aara alburmaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqiyla lahmun tusuddiqa 'alaa bariyraaa, waaanta laa taakulu alssadaqaaa qaala ‏"‏ huwa 'alayhaa sadaqaaun, walanaa hadiyyaaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Three principles were established because of Barira: (i) When Banra was manumitted she was given the option (to remain with her slave husband or not). (ii) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "The Wala of the slave) is for the one who manumits (the slave). (iii) When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered (the house), he saw a cooking pot on the fire but he was given bread and meat soup from the soup of the home. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Didn't I see the cooking pot (on the fire)?" It was said, "That is the meat given in charity to Barira, and you do not eat the (things given in) charity." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is an object of charity for Barira, and it is a present for us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، ‏{‏وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ، تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتَامَى‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَتِ الْيَتِيمَةُ تَكُونُ عِنْدَ الرَّجُلِ وَهْوَ وَلِيُّهَا، فَيَتَزَوَّجُهَا عَلَى مَالِهَا، وَيُسِيءُ صُحْبَتَهَا، وَلاَ يَعْدِلُ فِي مَالِهَا، فَلْيَتَزَوَّجْ مَا طَابَ لَهُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ سِوَاهَا مَثْنَى وَثُلاَثَ وَرُبَاعَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, aakhbaranaa 'abdaau, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, ‏{‏waiin khiftum aan laa, tuqsituwa fiy alyataamaa‏}‏‏.‏ qaalati alyatiymaau takuwnu 'inda alrrajuli wahwa waliyyuhaa, fayatazawwajuhaa 'alaa maalihaa, wayusiy'u suhbatahaa, walaa ya'dilu fiy maalihaa, falyatazawwaj maa taaba lahu mina alnnisaa'i siwaahaa mathnaa wathulaatha warubaa'a‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha":(regarding) the Verse: 'And if you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with the orphans...' (4.3) It is about the orphan girl who is in the custody of a man who is her guardian, and he intends to marry her because of her wealth, but he treats her badly and does not manage her property fairly and honestly. Such a man should marry women of his liking other than her, two or three or four. 'Prohibited to you (for marriage) are: ...your foster-mothers (who suckled you).' (4.23) Marriage is prohibited between persons having a foster suckling relationship corresponding to a blood relationship which renders marriage unlawful
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ عِنْدَهَا، وَأَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ صَوْتَ رَجُلٍ يَسْتَأْذِنُ فِي بَيْتِ حَفْصَةَ، قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا رَجُلٌ يَسْتَأْذِنُ فِي بَيْتِكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أُرَاهُ فُلاَنًا ‏"‏‏.‏ لِعَمِّ حَفْصَةَ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ لَوْ كَانَ فُلاَنٌ حَيًّا، لِعَمِّهَا مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمِ الرَّضَاعَةُ تُحَرِّمُ مَا تُحَرِّمُ الْوِلاَدَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, 'an 'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarathaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana 'indahaa, waaannahaa sami'at sawta rajulin yastaadhinu fiy bayti hafsaaa, qaalat faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi hadhaa rajulun yastaadhinu fiy baytika‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ auraahu fulaanana ‏"‏‏.‏ li'ammi hafsaaa mina alrradaa'aai‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau law kaana fulaanun hayyana, li'ammihaa mina alrradaa'aai dakhala 'alaaaa faqaala ‏"‏ na'ami alrradaa'aau tuharrimu maa tuharrimu alwilaadaau ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) that while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was with her, she heard a voice of a man asking permission to enter the house of Hafsa. `Aisha added: I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This man is asking permission to enter your house." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I think he is so-and-so," naming the foster-uncle of Hafsa. `Aisha said, "If so-and-so," naming her foster uncle, "were living, could he enter upon me?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, for foster suckling relations make all those things unlawful which are unlawful through corresponding birth (blood) relations
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قِيلَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَلاَ تَزَوَّجُ ابْنَةَ حَمْزَةَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّهَا ابْنَةُ أَخِي مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ بِشْرُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an shu'baaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an jaabiri bni zaydin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qiyla lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aalaa tazawwaju abnaaa hamzaaa qaala ‏ "‏ iinnahaa abnaau aakhiy mina alrradaa'aai ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala bishru bnu 'umara haddathanaa shu'baau sami'tu qataadaaa sami'tu jaabira bna zaydin mithlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:It was said to the Prophet, "Won't you marry the daughter of Hamza?" He said, "She is my foster niece (brother's daughter)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ أَخْبَرَتْهَا أَنَّهَا، قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ انْكِحْ أُخْتِي بِنْتَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَوَتُحِبِّينَ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ، لَسْتُ لَكَ بِمُخْلِيَةٍ، وَأَحَبُّ مَنْ شَارَكَنِي فِي خَيْرٍ أُخْتِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ ذَلِكَ لاَ يَحِلُّ لِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّا نُحَدَّثُ أَنَّكَ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَنْكِحَ بِنْتَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِنْتَ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ أَنَّهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ رَبِيبَتِي فِي حَجْرِي مَا حَلَّتْ لِي إِنَّهَا لاَبْنَةُ أَخِي مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ، أَرْضَعَتْنِي وَأَبَا سَلَمَةَ ثُوَيْبَةُ فَلاَ تَعْرِضْنَ عَلَىَّ بَنَاتِكُنَّ وَلاَ أَخَوَاتِكُنَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ وَثُوَيْبَةُ مَوْلاَةٌ لأَبِي لَهَبٍ كَانَ أَبُو لَهَبٍ أَعْتَقَهَا فَأَرْضَعَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا مَاتَ أَبُو لَهَبٍ أُرِيَهُ بَعْضُ أَهْلِهِ بِشَرِّ حِيبَةٍ قَالَ لَهُ مَاذَا لَقِيتَ قَالَ أَبُو لَهَبٍ لَمْ أَلْقَ بَعْدَكُمْ غَيْرَ أَنِّي سُقِيتُ فِي هَذِهِ بِعَتَاقَتِي ثُوَيْبَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhakamu bnu naafi'in, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna zaynaba abnaaa aabiy salamaaa, aakhbarathu aanna aumma habiybaaa binta aabiy sufyaana aakhbarathaa aannahaa, qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi ankih aukhtiy binta aabiy sufyaana faqaala ‏"‏ aawatuhibbiyna dhalika ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu na'am, lastu laka bimukhliyaain, waaahabbu man shaarakaniy fiy khayrin aukhtiy‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna dhalika laa yahillu liy ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu faiinnaa nuhaddathu aannaka turiydu aan tankiha binta aabiy salamaaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ binta aummi salamaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu na'am‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ law aannahaa lam takun rabiybatiy fiy hajriy maa hallat liy iinnahaa laabnaau aakhiy mina alrradaa'aai, aarda'atniy waaabaa salamaaa thuwaybaau falaa ta'ridna 'alaaaa banaatikunna walaa aakhawaatikunna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'urwaau wathuwaybaau mawlaaaun laabiy lahabin kaana aabuw lahabin aa'taqahaa faaarda'ati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa maata aabuw lahabin auriyahu ba'du aahlihi bisharri hiybaain qaala lahu maadhaa laqiyta qaala aabuw lahabin lam aalqa ba'dakum ghayra aanniy suqiytu fiy hadhihi bi'ataaqatiy thuwaybaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Habiba:(daughter of Abu Sufyan) I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Marry my sister. the daughter of Abu Sufyan." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you like that?" I replied, "Yes, for even now I am not your only wife and I like that my sister should share the good with me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "But that is not lawful for me." I said, We have heard that you want to marry the daughter of Abu Salama." He said, "(You mean) the daughter of Um Salama?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Even if she were not my step-daughter, she would be unlawful for me to marry as she is my foster niece. I and Abu Salama were suckled by Thuwaiba. So you should not present to me your daughters or your sisters (in marriage)." Narrated 'Urwa: Thuwaiba was the freed slave girl of Abu Lahb whom he had manumitted, and then she suckled the Prophet. When Abu Lahb died, one of his relatives saw him in a dream in a very bad state and asked him, "What have you encountered?" Abu Lahb said, "I have not found any rest since I left you, except that I have been given water to drink in this (the space between his thumb and other fingers) and that is because of my manumitting Thuwaiba
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَشْعَثِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا وَعِنْدَهَا رَجُلٌ، فَكَأَنَّهُ تَغَيَّرَ وَجْهُهُ، كَأَنَّهُ كَرِهَ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّهُ أَخِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ انْظُرْنَ مَا إِخْوَانُكُنَّ، فَإِنَّمَا الرَّضَاعَةُ مِنَ الْمَجَاعَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alaash'athi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala 'alayhaa wa'indahaa rajulun, fakaaannahu taghayyara wajhuhu, kaaannahu kariha dhalika faqaalat iinnahu aakhiy‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ anzurna maa iikhwaanukunna, faiinnamaa alrradaa'aau mina almajaa'aai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:that the Prophet (ﷺ) entered upon her while a man was sitting with her. Signs of answer seemed to appear on his face as if he disliked that. She said, "Here is my (foster) brother." He said, "Be sure as to who is your foster brother, for foster suckling relationship is established only when milk is the only food of the child
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ أَفْلَحَ، أَخَا أَبِي الْقُعَيْسِ جَاءَ يَسْتَأْذِنُ عَلَيْهَا ـ وَهْوَ عَمُّهَا مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ ـ بَعْدَ أَنْ نَزَلَ الْحِجَابُ، فَأَبَيْتُ أَنْ آذَنَ لَهُ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرْتُهُ بِالَّذِي صَنَعْتُ، فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ آذَنَ لَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna aaflaha, aakhaa aabiy alqu'aysi jaa'a yastaadhinu 'alayhaa wahwa 'ammuhaa mina alrradaa'aai ba'da aan nazala alhijaabu, faaabaytu aan adhana lahu, falammaa jaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbartuhu bialladhiy sana'tu, faaamaraniy aan adhana lahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:that Aflah the brother of Abu Al-Qu'ais, her foster uncle, came, asking permission to enter upon her after the Verse of Al-Hijab (the use of veils by women) was revealed. `Aisha added: I did not allow him to enter, but when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came, I told him what I had done, and he ordered me to give him permission
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ، عُقْبَةَ لَكِنِّي لِحَدِيثِ عُبَيْدٍ أَحْفَظُ قَالَ تَزَوَّجْتُ امْرَأَةً، فَجَاءَتْنَا امْرَأَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ فَقَالَتْ أَرْضَعْتُكُمَا‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ تَزَوَّجْتُ فُلاَنَةَ بِنْتَ فُلاَنٍ فَجَاءَتْنَا امْرَأَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ فَقَالَتْ لِي إِنِّي قَدْ أَرْضَعْتُكُمَا‏.‏ وَهْىَ كَاذِبَةٌ فَأَعْرَضَ، فَأَتَيْتُهُ مِنْ قِبَلِ وَجْهِهِ، قُلْتُ إِنَّهَا كَاذِبَةٌ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ كَيْفَ بِهَا وَقَدْ زَعَمَتْ أَنَّهَا قَدْ أَرْضَعَتْكُمَا، دَعْهَا عَنْكَ ‏"‏ وَأَشَارَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ بِإِصْبَعَيْهِ السَّبَّابَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى يَحْكِي أَيُّوبَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa aayyuwbu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy mulaykaaa, qaala haddathaniy 'ubaydu bnu aabiy maryama, 'an 'uqbaaa bni alhaarithi, qaala waqad sami'tuhu min, 'uqbaaa lakinniy lihadiythi 'ubaydin aahfazu qaala tazawwajtu amraaaaan, fajaa'atnaa amraaaaun sawdaa'u faqaalat aarda'tukumaa‏.‏ faaataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu tazawwajtu fulaanaaa binta fulaanin fajaa'atnaa amraaaaun sawdaa'u faqaalat liy iinniy qad aarda'tukumaa‏.‏ wahaa kaadhibaaun faaa'rada, faaataytuhu min qibali wajhihi, qultu iinnahaa kaadhibaaun‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ kayfa bihaa waqad za'amat aannahaa qad aarda'atkumaa, da'haa 'anka ‏"‏ waaashaara iismaa'iylu biiisba'ayhi alssabbaabaai waalwustaa yahkiy aayyuwba‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Uqba bin Al-Harith:I married a woman and then a black lady came to us and said, "I have suckled you both (you and your wife)." So I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I married so-and-so and then a black lady came to us and said to me, 'I have suckled both of you.' But I think she is a liar." The Prophet (ﷺ) turned his face away from me and I moved to face his face, and said, "She is a liar." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "How (can you keep her as your wife) when that lady has said that she has suckled both of you? So abandon (i.e., divorce) her (your wife)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ لَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي حَبِيبٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، حَرُمَ مِنَ النَّسَبِ سَبْعٌ، وَمِنَ الصِّهْرِ سَبْعٌ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ أُمَّهَاتُكُمْ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏ وَجَمَعَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ بَيْنَ ابْنَةِ عَلِيٍّ وَامْرَأَةِ عَلِيٍّ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ‏.‏ وَكَرِهَهُ الْحَسَنُ مَرَّةً ثُمَّ قَالَ لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ‏.‏ وَجَمَعَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ بَيْنَ ابْنَتَىْ عَمٍّ فِي لَيْلَةٍ، وَكَرِهَهُ جَابِرُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ لِلْقَطِيعَةِ، وَلَيْسَ فِيهِ تَحْرِيمٌ لِقَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَأُحِلَّ لَكُمْ مَا وَرَاءَ ذَلِكُمْ‏}‏ وَقَالَ عِكْرِمَةُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ إِذَا زَنَى بِأُخْتِ امْرَأَتِهِ لَمْ تَحْرُمْ عَلَيْهِ امْرَأَتُهُ‏.‏ وَيُرْوَى عَنْ يَحْيَى الْكِنْدِيِّ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ وَأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، فِيمَنْ يَلْعَبُ بِالصَّبِيِّ إِنْ أَدْخَلَهُ فِيهِ، فَلاَ يَتَزَوَّجَنَّ أُمَّهُ، وَيَحْيَى هَذَا غَيْرُ مَعْرُوفٍ، لَمْ يُتَابَعْ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عِكْرِمَةُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ إِذَا زَنَى بِهَا لَمْ تَحْرُمْ عَلَيْهِ امْرَأَتُهُ‏.‏ وَيُذْكَرُ عَنْ أَبِي نَصْرٍ أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ حَرَّمَهُ‏.‏ وَأَبُو نَصْرٍ هَذَا لَمْ يُعْرَفْ بِسَمَاعِهِ مِنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ‏.‏ وَيُرْوَى عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ وَجَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ وَالْحَسَنِ وَبَعْضِ أَهْلِ الْعِرَاقِ تَحْرُمُ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ لاَ تَحْرُمُ حَتَّى يُلْزِقَ بِالأَرْضِ يَعْنِي يُجَامِعَ‏.‏ وَجَوَّزَهُ ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ وَعُرْوَةُ وَالزُّهْرِيُّ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ لاَ تَحْرُمُ‏.‏ وَهَذَا مُرْسَلٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala lanaa aahmadu bnu hanbalin haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an sufyaana, haddathaniy habiybun, 'an sa'iydin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, haruma mina alnnasabi sab'un, wamina alssihri sab'un‏.‏ thumma qaraaa ‏{‏hurrimat 'alaykum aummahaatukum‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏ wajama'a 'abdu alllahi bnu ja'farin bayna abnaai 'aliyyin waamraaaai 'aliyyin‏.‏ waqaala abnu siyriyna laa baasa bihi‏.‏ wakarihahu alhasanu marraaan thumma qaala laa baasa bihi‏.‏ wajama'a alhasanu bnu alhasani bni 'aliyyin bayna abnataa 'ammin fiy laylaain, wakarihahu jaabiru bnu zaydin lilqatiy'aai, walaysa fiyhi tahriymun liqawlihi ta'aalaa ‏{‏waauhilla lakum maa waraa'a dhalikum‏}‏ waqaala 'ikrimaau 'ani abni 'abbaasin iidhaa zanaa biaukhti amraaatihi lam tahrum 'alayhi amraaatuhu‏.‏ wayurwaa 'an yahyaa alkindiyyi 'ani alshha'biyyi waaabiy ja'farin, fiyman yal'abu bialssabiyyi iin aadkhalahu fiyhi, falaa yatazawwajanna aummahu, wayahyaa hadhaa ghayru ma'ruwfin, lam yutaaba' 'alayhi‏.‏ waqaala 'ikrimaau 'ani abni 'abbaasin iidhaa zanaa bihaa lam tahrum 'alayhi amraaatuhu‏.‏ wayudhkaru 'an aabiy nasrin aanna abna 'abbaasin harramahu‏.‏ waaabuw nasrin hadhaa lam yu'raf bisamaa'ihi mini abni 'abbaasin‏.‏ wayurwaa 'an 'imraana bni husaynin wajaabiri bni zaydin waalhasani waba'di aahli al'iraaqi tahrumu 'alayhi‏.‏ waqaala aabuw hurayraaa laa tahrumu hattaa yulziqa bialaardi ya'niy yujaami'a‏.‏ wajawwazahu abnu almusayyabi wa'urwaau waalzzuhriyyu‏.‏ waqaala alzzuhriyyu qaala 'aliyyun laa tahrumu‏.‏ wahadhaa mursalun‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas further said, "Seven types of marriages are unlawful because of blood relations, and seven because of marriage relations." Then Ibn 'Abbas recited the Verse:"Forbidden for you (for marriages) are your mothers..." (4:23). 'Abdullah bin Ja'far married the daughter and wife of 'Ali at the same time (they were step-daughter and mother). Ibn Sirin said, "There is no harm in that." But Al-Hasan Al-Basri disapproved of it at first, but then said that there was no harm in it. Al-Hasan bin Al-Hasan bin 'Ali married two of his cousins in one night. Ja'far bin Zaid disapproved of that because of it would bring hatred (between the two cousins), but it is not unlawful, as Allah said, "Lawful to you are all others [beyond those (mentioned)]. (4:24). Ibn 'Abbas said: "If somebody commits illegal sexual intercourse with his wife's sister, his wife does not become unlawful for him." And narrated Abu Ja'far, "If a person commits homosexuality with a boy, then the mother of that boy is unlawful for him to marry." Narrated Ibn 'Abbas, "If one commits illegal sexual intercourse with his mother in law, then his married relation to his wife does not become unlawful." Abu Nasr reported to have said that Ibn 'Abbas in the above case, regarded his marital relation to his wife unlawful, but Abu Nasr is not known well for hearing Hadith from Ibn 'Abbas. Imran bin Hussain, Jabir b. Zaid, Al-Hasan and some other Iraqi's, are reported to have judged that his marital relations to his wife would be unlawful. In the above case Abu Hurairah said, "The marital relation to one's wife does not become unlawful except if one as had sexual intercourse (with her mother)." Ibn Al-Musaiyab, 'Urwa, and Az-Zuhri allows such person to keep his wife. 'Ali said, "His marital relations to his wife does not become unlawful
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ، عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ، قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلْ لَكَ فِي بِنْتِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَفْعَلُ مَاذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ تَنْكِحُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَتُحِبِّينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَسْتُ لَكَ بِمُخْلِيَةٍ، وَأَحَبُّ مَنْ شَرِكَنِي فِيكَ أُخْتِي‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهَا لاَ تَحِلُّ لِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ تَخْطُبُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ابْنَةَ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ لَمْ تَكُنْ رَبِيبَتِي مَا حَلَّتْ لِي، أَرْضَعَتْنِي وَأَبَاهَا ثُوَيْبَةُ، فَلاَ تَعْرِضْنَ عَلَىَّ بَنَاتِكُنَّ وَلاَ أَخَوَاتِكُنَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ دُرَّةُ بِنْتُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ‏.‏
