verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَارِبُ بْنُ دِثَارٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ الرَّجُلُ أَهْلَهُ طُرُوقًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa muhaaribu bnu dithaarin, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yakrahu aan yaatiya alrrajulu aahlahu turuwqana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) disliked that one should go to one's family at night (on returning from a journey)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَطَالَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْغَيْبَةَ فَلاَ يَطْرُقْ أَهْلَهُ لَيْلاً ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa 'aasimu bnu sulaymaana, 'ani alshha'biyyi, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa aataala aahadukumu alghaybaaa falaa yatruq aahlahu laylaan ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you is away from his house for a long time, he should not return to his family at night
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، عَنْ هُشَيْمٍ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةٍ، فَلَمَّا قَفَلْنَا تَعَجَّلْتُ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ قَطُوفٍ فَلَحِقَنِي رَاكِبٌ مِنْ خَلْفِي، فَالْتَفَتُّ فَإِذَا أَنَا بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا يُعْجِلُكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ إِنِّي حَدِيثُ عَهْدٍ بِعُرْسٍ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَبِكْرًا تَزَوَّجْتَ أَمْ ثَيِّبًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ بَلْ ثَيِّبًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلاَّ جَارِيَةً تُلاَعِبُهَا وَتُلاَعِبُكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا ذَهَبْنَا لِنَدْخُلَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَمْهِلُوا حَتَّى تَدْخُلُوا لَيْلاً ـ أَىْ عِشَاءً ـ لِكَىْ تَمْتَشِطَ الشَّعِثَةُ وَتَسْتَحِدَّ الْمُغِيبَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي الثِّقَةُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏"‏ الْكَيْسَ الْكَيْسَ يَا جَابِرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ يَعْنِي الْوَلَدَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, 'an hushaymin, 'an sayyaarin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an jaabirin, qaala kuntu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghazwaain, falammaa qafalnaa ta'ajjaltu 'alaa ba'iyrin qatuwfin falahiqaniy raakibun min khalfiy, faaltafattu faiidhaa aanaa birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ maa yu'jiluka ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu iinniy hadiythu 'ahdin bi'ursin‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fabikrana tazawwajta aam thayyibana ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu bal thayyibana‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fahalaaa jaariyaaan tulaa'ibuhaa watulaa'ibuka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala falammaa qadimnaa dhahabnaa linadkhula faqaala ‏"‏ aamhiluwa hattaa tadkhuluwa laylaan aaa 'ishaa'an likaa tamtashita alshha'ithaau watastahidda almughiybaau ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala wahaddathaniy althhiqaau aannahu qaala fiy hadhaa alhadiythi ‏"‏ alkaysa alkaysa yaa jaabiru ‏"‏‏.‏ ya'niy alwalada‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:I was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a Ghazwa, and when we returned, I wanted to hurry, while riding a slow camel. A rider came behind me. I looked back and saw that the rider was Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . He said (to me), "What makes you in such a hurry?" I replied, "I am newly married." He said, "Did you marry a virgin or a matron?" I replied, "(Not a virgin but) a matron." He said, "Why didn't you marry a young girl with whom you could play and who could play with you?" Then when we approached (Medina) and were going to enter (it), the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wait till you enter (your homes) at night (in the first part of the night) so that the ladies with unkempt hair may comb their hair, and those whose husbands have been absent (for a long time) may shave their pubic hair." (The sub-narrator, Hashim said: A reliable narrator told me that the Prophet (ﷺ) added in this Hadith: "(Seek to beget) children! Children, O Jabir
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا دَخَلْتَ لَيْلاً فَلاَ تَدْخُلْ عَلَى أَهْلِكَ حَتَّى تَسْتَحِدَّ الْمُغِيبَةُ وَتَمْتَشِطَ الشَّعِثَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَعَلَيْكَ بِالْكَيْسِ الْكَيْسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ وَهْبٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْكَيْسِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu alwaliydi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sayyaarin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iidhaa dakhalta laylaan falaa tadkhul 'alaa aahlika hattaa tastahidda almughiybaau watamtashita alshha'ithaau ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ fa'alayka bialkaysi alkaysi ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu 'ubaydu alllahi 'an wahbin 'an jaabirin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alkaysi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you enter (your town) at night (after coming from a journey), do not enter upon your family till the woman whose husband was absent (from the house) shaves her pubic hair and the woman with unkempt hair, combs her hair" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) further said, "(O Jabir!) Seek to have offspring, seek to have offspring
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَيَّارٌ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةٍ، فَلَمَّا قَفَلْنَا كُنَّا قَرِيبًا مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ تَعَجَّلْتُ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ لِي قَطُوفٍ، فَلَحِقَنِي رَاكِبٌ مِنْ خَلْفِي فَنَخَسَ بَعِيرِي بِعَنَزَةٍ كَانَتْ مَعَهُ، فَسَارَ بَعِيرِي كَأَحْسَنِ مَا أَنْتَ رَاءٍ مِنَ الإِبِلِ، فَالْتَفَتُّ فَإِذَا أَنَا بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي حَدِيثُ عَهْدٍ بِعُرْسٍ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَزَوَّجْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَبِكْرًا أَمْ ثَيِّبًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ بَلْ ثَيِّبًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلاَّ بِكْرًا تُلاَعِبُهَا وَتُلاَعِبُكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا ذَهَبْنَا لِنَدْخُلَ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَمْهِلُوا حَتَّى تَدْخُلُوا لَيْلاً ـ أَىْ عِشَاءً ـ لِكَىْ تَمْتَشِطَ الشَّعِثَةُ، وَتَسْتَحِدَّ الْمُغِيبَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa sayyaarun, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghazwaain, falammaa qafalnaa kunnaa qariybana mina almadiynaai ta'ajjaltu 'alaa ba'iyrin liy qatuwfin, falahiqaniy raakibun min khalfiy fanakhasa ba'iyriy bi'anazaain kaanat ma'ahu, fasaara ba'iyriy kaaahsani maa aanta raa'in mina aliibili, faaltafattu faiidhaa aanaa birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy hadiythu 'ahdin bi'ursin‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aatazawwajta ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aabikrana aam thayyibana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala qultu bal thayyibana‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fahalaaa bikrana tulaa'ibuhaa watulaa'ibuka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala falammaa qadimnaa dhahabnaa linadkhula, faqaala ‏"‏ aamhiluwa hattaa tadkhuluwa laylaan aaa 'ishaa'an likaa tamtashita alshha'ithaau, watastahidda almughiybaau ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) in Ghazwa, and when we returned and approached Medina, I wanted to hurry while riding a slow camel. A rider overtook me and pricked my camel with a spear which he had, whereupon my camel started running as fast as any other fast camel you may see. I looked back, and behold, the rider was Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I am newly married " He asked, "Have you got married?" I replied, "Yes." He said, "A virgin or a matron?" I replied, "(Not a virgin) but a matron" He said, "Why didn't you marry a young girl so that you could play with her and she with you?" When we reached (near Medina) and were going to enter it, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wait till you enter your home early in the night so that the lady whose hair is unkempt may comb her hair and that the lady whose husband has been away may shave her pubic hair
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ اخْتَلَفَ النَّاسُ بِأَىِّ شَىْءٍ دُووِيَ جُرْحُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ، فَسَأَلُوا سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ، وَكَانَ مِنْ آخِرِ مَنْ بَقِيَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْمَدِينَةِ، فَقَالَ وَمَا بَقِيَ مِنَ النَّاسِ أَحَدٌ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي، كَانَتْ فَاطِمَةُ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ تَغْسِلُ الدَّمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ، وَعَلِيٌّ يَأْتِي بِالْمَاءِ عَلَى تُرْسِهِ، فَأُخِذَ حَصِيرٌ، فَحُرِّقَ فَحُشِيَ بِهِ جُرْحُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy haazimin, qaala akhtalafa alnnaasu biaaaai shaa'in duwwiya jurhu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma auhudin, fasaaaluwa sahla bna sa'din alssaa'idiyya, wakaana min akhiri man baqiya min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialmadiynaai, faqaala wamaa baqiya mina alnnaasi aahadun aa'lamu bihi minniy, kaanat faatimaau 'alayhaa alssalaamu taghsilu alddama 'an wajhihi, wa'aliyyun yaatiy bialmaa'i 'alaa tursihi, faaukhidha hasiyrun, fahurriqa fahushiya bihi jurhuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Hazim:The people differed about the type of treatment which had been given to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day (of the battle) of Uhud. So they asked Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`id who was the only surviving Companion (of the Prophet) at Medina. He replied, "Nobody Is left at Medina who knows it better than I. Fatima was washing the blood off his face and `Ali was bringing water in his shield, and then a mat of datepalm leaves was burnt and (the ash) was inserted into the wound
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَابِسٍ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ شَهِدْتَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعِيدَ أَضْحًى أَوْ فِطْرًا قَالَ نَعَمْ لَوْلاَ مَكَانِي مِنْهُ مَا شَهِدْتُهُ ـ يَعْنِي مِنْ صِغَرِهِ ـ قَالَ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَلَّى ثُمَّ خَطَبَ، وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَذَانًا وَلاَ إِقَامَةً، ثُمَّ أَتَى النِّسَاءَ فَوَعَظَهُنَّ وَذَكَّرَهُنَّ وَأَمَرَهُنَّ بِالصَّدَقَةِ، فَرَأَيْتُهُنَّ يَهْوِينَ إِلَى آذَانِهِنَّ وَحُلُوقِهِنَّ يَدْفَعْنَ إِلَى بِلاَلٍ، ثُمَّ ارْتَفَعَ هُوَ وَبِلاَلٌ إِلَى بَيْتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu muhammadin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'aabisin, sami'tu abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma saaalahu rajulun shahidta ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm al'iyda aadhana aaw fitrana qaala na'am lawlaa makaaniy minhu maa shahidtuhu ya'niy min sigharihi qaala kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallaa thumma khataba, walam yadhkur aadhaanana walaa iiqaamaaan, thumma aataa alnnisaa'a fawa'azahunna wadhakkarahunna waaamarahunna bialssadaqaai, faraaaytuhunna yahwiyna iilaa adhaanihinna wahuluwqihinna yadfa'na iilaa bilaalin, thumma artafa'a huwa wabilaalun iilaa baytihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin `Abis:I heard Ibn `Abbas answering a man who asked him, "Did you attend the prayer of `Id al Adha or `Idal- Fitr with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" Ibn `Abbas replied, "Yes, and had it not been for my close relationship with him, I could not have offered it." (That was because of his young age). Ibn `Abbas further said, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out and offered the Id prayer and then delivered the sermon." Ibn `Abbas did not mention anything about the Adhan (the call for prayer) or the Iqama. He added, "Then the Prophet (ﷺ) went to the women and instructed them and gave them religious advice and ordered them to give alms and I saw them reaching out (their hands to) their ears and necks (to take off the earrings and necklaces, etc.) and throwing (it) towards Bilal. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) returned with Bilal to his house
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ عَاتَبَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَجَعَلَ يَطْعُنُنِي بِيَدِهِ فِي خَاصِرَتِي فَلاَ يَمْنَعُنِي مِنَ التَّحَرُّكِ إِلاَّ مَكَانُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَأْسُهُ عَلَى فَخِذِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat 'aatabaniy aabuw bakrin waja'ala yat'ununiy biyadihi fiy khaasiratiy falaa yamna'uniy mina alttaharruki iilaaa makaanu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waraasuhu 'alaa fakhidhiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Abu Bakr admonished me and poked me with his hands in the flank, and nothing stopped me from moving at that time except the position of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whose head was on my thigh
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهْىَ حَائِضٌ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مُرْهُ فَلْيُرَاجِعْهَا، ثُمَّ لِيُمْسِكْهَا حَتَّى تَطْهُرَ ثُمَّ تَحِيضَ، ثُمَّ تَطْهُرَ، ثُمَّ إِنْ شَاءَ أَمْسَكَ بَعْدُ وَإِنْ شَاءَ طَلَّقَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمَسَّ، فَتِلْكَ الْعِدَّةُ الَّتِي أَمَرَ اللَّهُ أَنْ تُطَلَّقَ لَهَا النِّسَاءُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aannahu tallaqa amraaatahu wahaa haaiidun 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaala 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an dhalika faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ murhu falyuraaji'haa, thumma liyumsikhaa hattaa tathura thumma tahiyda, thumma tathura, thumma iin shaa'a aamsaka ba'du waiin shaa'a tallaqa qabla aan yamassa, fatilka al'iddaau allatiy aamara alllahu aan tutallaqa lahaa alnnisaa'u ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:that he had divorced his wife while she was menstruating during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . `Umar bin Al-Khattab asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about that. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Order him (your son) to take her back and keep her till she is clean and then to wait till she gets her next period and becomes clean again, whereupon, if he wishes to keep her, he can do so, and if he wishes to divorce her he can divorce her before having sexual intercourse with her; and that is the prescribed period which Allah has fixed for the women meant to be divorced
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ طَلَّقَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهْىَ حَائِضٌ، فَذَكَرَ عُمَرُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لِيُرَاجِعْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ تُحْتَسَبُ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَمَهْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَعَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ ‏"‏ مُرْهُ فَلْيُرَاجِعْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ تُحْتَسَبُ قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ عَجَزَ وَاسْتَحْمَقَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aanasi bni siyriyna, qaala sami'tu abna 'umara, qaala tallaqa abnu 'umara amraaatahu wahaa haaiidun, fadhakara 'umaru lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ liyuraaji'haa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu tuhtasabu qaala ‏"‏ famah ‏"‏‏.‏ wa'an qataadaaa 'an yuwnusa bni jubayrin 'ani abni 'umara qaala ‏"‏ murhu falyuraaji'haa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu tuhtasabu qaala aaraaayta iin 'ajaza waastahmaqa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Seereen:Ibn `Umar said: "I divorced my wife while she was menstruating. `Umar mentioned that to the Prophet . The Prophet (ﷺ) said, (to my father), "Let your son take her back." I asked (Ibn `Umar), "Is such a divorce counted (i.e. as one legal divorce)?" Ibn `Umar said, "Of course." Narrated Yunus bin Jubair: Ibn `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said to `Umar, 'Order him (Ibn `Umar) to take her back.' " I asked, "Is such a divorce counted (as one legal divorce)?" Ibn `Umar said, "What do you think if someone becomes helpless and foolish?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ حُسِبَتْ عَلَىَّ بِتَطْلِيقَةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala aabuw ma'marin haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala husibat 'alaaaa bitatliyqaain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:(Divorcing my wife during her menses) was counted as one legal divorce
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ أَىُّ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَعَاذَتْ مِنْهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ ابْنَةَ الْجَوْنِ لَمَّا أُدْخِلَتْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَدَنَا مِنْهَا قَالَتْ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏ "‏ لَقَدْ عُذْتِ بِعَظِيمٍ، الْحَقِي بِأَهْلِكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَوَاهُ حَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَبِي مَنِيعٍ عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhumaydiyyu, haddathanaa alwaliydu, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, qaala saaaltu alzzuhriyya aaaau aazwaaji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm asta'aadhat minhu qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna abnaaa aljawni lammaa audkhilat 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wadanaa minhaa qaalat aa'uwdhu bialllahi minka‏.‏ faqaala lahaa ‏ "‏ laqad 'udhti bi'aziymin, alhaqiy biaahliki ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi rawaahu hajjaaju bnu aabiy maniy'in 'an jaddihi 'ani alzzuhriyyi aanna 'urwaaa aakhbarahu aanna 'aaiishaaa qaalat‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Awza:I asked Az-Zuhri, "Which of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) sought refuge with Allah from him?" He said "I was told by 'Urwa that `Aisha said, 'When the daughter of Al-Jaun was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (as his bride) and he went near her, she said, "I seek refuge with Allah from you." He said, "You have sought refuge with The Great; return to your family
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ غَسِيلٍ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى انْطَلَقْنَا إِلَى حَائِطٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ الشَّوْطُ، حَتَّى انْتَهَيْنَا إِلَى حَائِطَيْنِ فَجَلَسْنَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اجْلِسُوا هَا هُنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَدَخَلَ وَقَدْ أُتِيَ بِالْجَوْنِيَّةِ، فَأُنْزِلَتْ فِي بَيْتٍ فِي نَخْلٍ فِي بَيْتٍ أُمَيْمَةُ بِنْتُ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ شَرَاحِيلَ وَمَعَهَا دَايَتُهَا حَاضِنَةٌ لَهَا، فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ هَبِي نَفْسَكِ لِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَهَلْ تَهَبُ الْمَلِكَةُ نَفْسَهَا لِلسُّوقَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَهْوَى بِيَدِهِ يَضَعُ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا لِتَسْكُنَ فَقَالَتْ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ قَدْ عُذْتِ بِمَعَاذٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا أُسَيْدٍ اكْسُهَا رَازِقِيَّتَيْنِ وَأَلْحِقْهَا بِأَهْلِهَا‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu ghasiylin, 'an hamzaaa bni aabiy ausaydin, 'an aabiy ausaydin rda allh 'nh qaala kharajnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa antalaqnaa iilaa haaiitin yuqaalu lahu alshhawtu, hattaa antahaynaa iilaa haaiitayni fajalasnaa baynahumaa faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ ajlisuwa haa hunaa ‏"‏‏.‏ wadakhala waqad autiya bialjawniyyaai, faaunzilat fiy baytin fiy nakhlin fiy baytin aumaymaau bintu alnnu'maani bni sharaahiyla wama'ahaa daayatuhaa haadinaaun lahaa, falammaa dakhala 'alayhaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ habiy nafsaki liy ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat wahal tahabu almalikaau nafsahaa lilssuwqaai‏.‏ qaala faaahwaa biyadihi yada'u yadahu 'alayhaa litaskuna faqaalat aa'uwdhu bialllahi minka‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ qad 'udhti bima'aadhin ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma kharaja 'alaynaa, faqaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa ausaydin aksuhaa raaziqiyyatayni waaalhiqhaa biaahlihaa‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Usaid:We went out with the Prophet (ﷺ) to a garden called Ash-Shaut till we reached two walls between which we sat down. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Sit here," and went in (the garden). The Jauniyya (a lady from Bani Jaun) had been brought and lodged in a house in a date-palm garden in the home of Umaima bint An- Nu`man bin Sharahil, and her wet nurse was with her. When the Prophet (ﷺ) entered upon her, he said to her, "Give me yourself (in marriage) as a gift." She said, "Can a princess give herself in marriage to an ordinary man?" The Prophet (ﷺ) raised his hand to pat her so that she might become tranquil. She said, "I seek refuge with Allah from you." He said, "You have sought refuge with One Who gives refuge. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) came out to us and said, "O Abu Usaid! Give her two white linen dresses to wear and let her go back to her family
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ النَّيْسَابُورِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، وَأَبِي، أُسَيْدٍ قَالاَ تَزَوَّجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُمَيْمَةَ بِنْتَ شَرَاحِيلَ، فَلَمَّا أُدْخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِ بَسَطَ يَدَهُ إِلَيْهَا فَكَأَنَّهَا كَرِهَتْ ذَلِكَ فَأَمَرَ أَبَا أُسَيْدٍ أَنْ يُجَهِّزَهَا وَيَكْسُوَهَا ثَوْبَيْنِ رَازِقِيَّيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala alhusaynu bnu alwaliydi alnnaysaabuwriyyu 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'abbaasi bni sahlin, 'an aabiyhi, waaabiy, ausaydin qaalaa tazawwaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aumaymaaa binta sharaahiyla, falammaa audkhilat 'alayhi basata yadahu iilayhaa fakaaannahaa karihat dhalika faaamara aabaa ausaydin aan yujahhizahaa wayaksuwahaa thawbayni raaziqiyyayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl and Abu Usaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) married Umaima bint Sharahil, and when she was brought to him, he stretched his hand towards her. It seemed that she disliked that, whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered Abu Usaid to prepare her and to provide her with two white linen dresses
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ أَبِي الْوَزِيرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، وَعَنْ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، بِهَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu aabiy alwaziyri, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, 'an hamzaaa, 'an aabiyhi, wa'an 'abbaasi bni sahli bni sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, bihadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:similarly as above
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي غَلاَّبٍ، يُونُسَ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ رَجُلٌ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهْىَ حَائِضٌ‏.‏ فَقَالَ تَعْرِفُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ إِنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهْىَ حَائِضٌ فَأَتَى عُمَرُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُرَاجِعَهَا فَإِذَا طَهُرَتْ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يُطَلِّقَهَا فَلْيُطَلِّقْهَا، قُلْتُ فَهَلْ عَدَّ ذَلِكَ طَلاَقًا قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ عَجَزَ وَاسْتَحْمَقَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa hammaamu bnu yahyaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aabiy ghalaaabin, yuwnusa bni jubayrin qaala qultu laibni 'umara rajulun tallaqa amraaatahu wahaa haaiidun‏.‏ faqaala ta'rifu abna 'umara iinna abna 'umara tallaqa amraaatahu wahaa haaiidun faaataa 'umaru alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara dhalika lahu faaamarahu aan yuraaji'ahaa faiidhaa tahurat faaaraada aan yutalliqahaa falyutalliqhaa, qultu fahal 'adda dhalika talaaqana qaala aaraaayta iin 'ajaza waastahmaqa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abi Ghallab Yunus bin Jubair:I asked Ibn `Umar,"(What is said regarding) a man divorces his wife during her period?" He said, "Do you know Ibn `Umar? Ibn `Umar divorced his wife while she was menstruating. `Umar then went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and mentioned that to him. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered him to take her back and when she became clean, he could divorce her if he wanted." I asked (Ibn `Umar), "Was that divorce counted as one legal divorce?" He said, "If one becomes helpless and foolish (will he be excused? Of course not)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عُوَيْمِرًا الْعَجْلاَنِيَّ جَاءَ إِلَى عَاصِمِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا عَاصِمُ أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلاً وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً، أَيَقْتُلُهُ فَتَقْتُلُونَهُ، أَمْ كَيْفَ يَفْعَلُ سَلْ لِي يَا عَاصِمُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَ عَاصِمٌ عَنْ ذَلِكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكَرِهَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَسَائِلَ وَعَابَهَا حَتَّى كَبُرَ عَلَى عَاصِمٍ مَا سَمِعَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ عَاصِمٌ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ جَاءَ عُوَيْمِرٌ فَقَالَ يَا عَاصِمُ مَاذَا قَالَ لَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ عَاصِمٌ لَمْ تَأْتِنِي بِخَيْرٍ، قَدْ كَرِهَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَسْأَلَةَ الَّتِي سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهَا‏.‏ قَالَ عُوَيْمِرٌ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَنْتَهِي حَتَّى أَسْأَلَهُ عَنْهَا فَأَقْبَلَ عُوَيْمِرٌ حَتَّى أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَسَطَ النَّاسِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلاً وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً، أَيَقْتُلُهُ فَتَقْتُلُونَهُ، أَمْ كَيْفَ يَفْعَلُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ قَدْ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِيكَ وَفِي صَاحِبَتِكَ فَاذْهَبْ فَأْتِ بِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سَهْلٌ فَتَلاَعَنَا وَأَنَا مَعَ النَّاسِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا فَرَغَا قَالَ عُوَيْمِرٌ كَذَبْتُ عَلَيْهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنْ أَمْسَكْتُهَا، فَطَلَّقَهَا ثَلاَثًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْمُرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ سُنَّةُ الْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna sahla bna sa'din alssaa'idiyya, aakhbarahu aanna 'uwaymirana al'ajlaaniyya jaa'a iilaa 'aasimi bni 'adiyyin alaansaariyyi, faqaala lahu yaa 'aasimu aaraaayta rajulaan wajada ma'a amraaatihi rajulaan, aayaqtuluhu fataqtuluwnahu, aam kayfa yaf'alu sal liy yaa 'aasimu 'an dhalika rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaala 'aasimun 'an dhalika rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakariha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almasaaiila wa'aabahaa hattaa kabura 'alaa 'aasimin maa sami'a min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa raja'a 'aasimun iilaa aahlihi jaa'a 'uwaymirun faqaala yaa 'aasimu maadhaa qaala laka rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala 'aasimun lam taatiniy bikhayrin, qad kariha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almasaalaaa allatiy saaaltuhu 'anhaa‏.‏ qaala 'uwaymirun waalllahi laa aantahiy hattaa aasaalahu 'anhaa faaaqbala 'uwaymirun hattaa aataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wasata alnnaasi faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aaraaayta rajulaan wajada ma'a amraaatihi rajulaan, aayaqtuluhu fataqtuluwnahu, aam kayfa yaf'alu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ qad aanzala alllahu fiyka wafiy saahibatika faadhhab faati bihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala sahlun fatalaa'anaa waaanaa ma'a alnnaasi 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa faraghaa qaala 'uwaymirun kadhabtu 'alayhaa yaa rasuwla alllahi, iin aamsaktuhaa, fatallaqahaa thalaathana qabla aan yaamurahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin fakaanat tilka sunnaau almutalaa'inayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:Uwaimir Al-`Ajlani came to `Asim bin Adi Al-Ansari and asked, "O `Asim! Tell me, if a man sees his wife with another man, should he kill him, whereupon you would kill him in Qisas, or what should he do? O `Asim! Please ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about that." `Asim asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about that. Allah's Apostle disliked that question and considered it disgraceful. What `Asim heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was hard on him. When he returned to his family, 'Uwaimir came to him and said "O `Asim! What did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say to you?" `Asim said, "You never bring me any good. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disliked to hear the problem which I asked him about." 'Uwaimir said, "By Allah, I will not leave the matter till I ask him about it." So 'Uwaimir proceeded till he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who was in the midst of the people and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If a man finds with his wife another man, should he kill him, whereupon you would kill him (in Qisas): or otherwise, what should he do?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah has revealed something concerning the question of you and your wife. Go and bring her here." So they both carried out the judgment of Lian, while I was present among the people (as a witness). When both of them had finished, 'Uwaimir said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If I should now keep my wife with me, then I have told a lie". Then he pronounced his decision to divorce her thrice before Allah's Apostle ordered him to do so. (Ibn Shihab said, "That was the tradition for all those who are involved in a case of Lian)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ امْرَأَةَ رِفَاعَةَ الْقُرَظِيِّ جَاءَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ رِفَاعَةَ طَلَّقَنِي فَبَتَّ طَلاَقِي، وَإِنِّي نَكَحْتُ بَعْدَهُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الزَّبِيرِ الْقُرَظِيَّ، وَإِنَّمَا مَعَهُ مِثْلُ الْهُدْبَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَعَلَّكِ تُرِيدِينَ أَنْ تَرْجِعِي إِلَى رِفَاعَةَ، لاَ، حَتَّى يَذُوقَ عُسَيْلَتَكِ وَتَذُوقِي عُسَيْلَتَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'ufayrin, qaala haddathaniy alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylun, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa, aakhbarathu aanna amraaaaa rifaa'aaa alquraziyyi jaa'at iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna rifaa'aaa tallaqaniy fabatta talaaqiy, waiinniy nakahtu ba'dahu 'abda alrrahmani bna alzzabiyri alquraziyya, waiinnamaa ma'ahu mithlu alhudbaai‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ la'allaki turiydiyna aan tarji'iy iilaa rifaa'aaa, laa, hattaa yadhuwqa 'usaylataki watadhuwqiy 'usaylatahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The wife of Rifa`a Al-Qurazi came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Rifa`a divorced me irrevocably. After him I married `Abdur-Rahman bin Az-Zubair Al-Qurazi who proved to be impotent." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to her, "Perhaps you want to return to Rifa`a? Nay (you cannot return to Rifa`a) until you and `Abdur-Rahman consummate your marriage
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ ثَلاَثًا، فَتَزَوَّجَتْ فَطَلَّقَ فَسُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَحِلُّ لِلأَوَّلِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ، حَتَّى يَذُوقَ عُسَيْلَتَهَا كَمَا ذَاقَ الأَوَّلُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy alqaasimu bnu muhammadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rajulaan, tallaqa amraaatahu thalaathana, fatazawwajat fatallaqa fasuiila alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aatahillu lilaawwali qaala ‏ "‏ laa, hattaa yadhuwqa 'usaylatahaa kamaa dhaaqa alaawwalu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:A man divorced his wife thrice (by expressing his decision to divorce her thrice), then she married another man who also divorced her. The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked if she could legally marry the first husband (or not). The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "No, she cannot marry the first husband unless the second husband consummates his marriage with her, just as the first husband had done
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ خَيَّرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاخْتَرْنَا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ، فَلَمْ يَعُدَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْنَا شَيْئًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, haddathanaa muslimun, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat khayyaranaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faakhtarnaa alllaha warasuwlahu, falam ya'udda dhalika 'alaynaa shayiana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave us the option (to remain with him or to be divorced) and we selected Allah and His Apostle . So, giving us that option was not regarded as divorce
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَامِرٌ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ عَنِ الْخِيَرَةِ،، فَقَالَتْ خَيَّرَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَفَكَانَ طَلاَقًا قَالَ مَسْرُوقٌ لاَ أُبَالِي أَخَيَّرْتُهَا وَاحِدَةً أَوْ مِائَةً بَعْدَ أَنْ تَخْتَارَنِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa 'aamirun, 'an masruwqin, qaala saaaltu 'aaiishaaa 'ani alkhiyaraai, , faqaalat khayyaranaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aafakaana talaaqana qaala masruwqun laa aubaaliy aakhayyartuhaa waahidaaan aaw miaiaaan ba'da aan takhtaaraniy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Masruq:I asked `Aisha about the option: She said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) gave us the option. Do you think that option was considered as a divorce?" I said, "It matters little to me if I give my wife the option once or a hundred times after she has chosen me
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ إِذَا سُئِلَ عَمَّنْ طَلَّقَ ثَلاَثًا قَالَ لَوْ طَلَّقْتَ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ فَإِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَنِي بِهَذَا، فَإِنْ طَلَّقْتَهَا ثَلاَثًا حَرُمَتْ حَتَّى تَنْكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala alllaythu 'an naafi'in, kaana abnu 'umara iidhaa suiila 'amman tallaqa thalaathana qaala law tallaqta marraaan aaw marratayni faiinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aamaraniy bihadhaa, faiin tallaqtahaa thalaathana harumat hattaa tankiha zawjana ghayraka‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' said:When Ibn 'Umar was asked about person who had given three divorces, he said, "Would that you gave one or two divorces, for the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me to do so. If you give three divorces then she cannot be lawful for you until she has married another husband (and is divorced by him)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ طَلَّقَ رَجُلٌ امْرَأَتَهُ فَتَزَوَّجَتْ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ فَطَلَّقَهَا، وَكَانَتْ مَعَهُ مِثْلُ الْهُدْبَةِ فَلَمْ تَصِلْ مِنْهُ إِلَى شَىْءٍ تُرِيدُهُ، فَلَمْ يَلْبَثْ أَنْ طَلَّقَهَا فَأَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ زَوْجِي طَلَّقَنِي، وَإِنِّي تَزَوَّجْتُ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ فَدَخَلَ بِي، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُ إِلاَّ مِثْلُ الْهُدْبَةِ فَلَمْ يَقْرَبْنِي إِلاَّ هَنَةً وَاحِدَةً، لَمْ يَصِلْ مِنِّي إِلَى شَىْءٍ، فَأَحِلُّ لِزَوْجِي الأَوَّلِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَحِلِّينَ لِزَوْجِكِ الأَوَّلِ حَتَّى يَذُوقَ الآخَرُ عُسَيْلَتَكِ، وَتَذُوقِي عُسَيْلَتَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat tallaqa rajulun amraaatahu fatazawwajat zawjana ghayrahu fatallaqahaa, wakaanat ma'ahu mithlu alhudbaai falam tasil minhu iilaa shaa'in turiyduhu, falam yalbath aan tallaqahaa faaatati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna zawjiy tallaqaniy, waiinniy tazawwajtu zawjana ghayrahu fadakhala biy, walam yakun ma'ahu iilaaa mithlu alhudbaai falam yaqrabniy iilaaa hanaaan waahidaaan, lam yasil minniy iilaa shaa'in, faaahillu lizawjiy alaawwali faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tahilliyna lizawjiki alaawwali hattaa yadhuwqa alakharu 'usaylataki, watadhuwqiy 'usaylatahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:A man divorced his wife and she married another man who proved to be impotent and divorced her. She could not get her satisfaction from him, and after a while he divorced her. Then she came to the Prophet and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My first husband divorced me and then I married another man who entered upon me to consummate his marriage but he proved to be impotent and did not approach me except once during which he benefited nothing from me. Can I remarry my first husband in this case?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is unlawful to marry your first husband till the other husband consummates his marriage with you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ صَبَّاحٍ، سَمِعَ الرَّبِيعَ بْنَ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ إِذَا حَرَّمَ امْرَأَتَهُ لَيْسَ بِشَىْءٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏{‏لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy alhasanu bnu sabbaahin, sami'a alrrabiy'a bna naafi'in, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an ya'laa bni hakiymin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, aannahu aakhbarahu aannahu, sami'a abna 'abbaasin, yaquwlu iidhaa harrama amraaatahu laysa bishaa'in‏.‏ waqaala ‏{‏laqad kaana lakum fiy rasuwli alllahi auswaaun hasanaaun‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:that he heard Ibn `Abbas saying, "If a man makes his wife unlawful for him, it does not mean that she is divorced." He added, "Indeed in the Messenger of Allah , you have a good example to follow
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ صَبَّاحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ زَعَمَ عَطَاءٌ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُبَيْدَ بْنَ عُمَيْرٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَمْكُثُ عِنْدَ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ جَحْشٍ، وَيَشْرَبُ عِنْدَهَا عَسَلاً، فَتَوَاصَيْتُ أَنَا وَحَفْصَةُ أَنَّ أَيَّتَنَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلْتَقُلْ إِنِّي أَجِدُ مِنْكَ رِيحَ مَغَافِيرَ، أَكَلْتَ مَغَافِيرَ فَدَخَلَ عَلَى إِحْدَاهُمَا فَقَالَتْ لَهُ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ بَلْ شَرِبْتُ عَسَلاً عِنْدَ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ جَحْشٍ وَلَنْ أَعُودَ لَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكَ‏}‏ إِلَى ‏{‏إِنْ تَتُوبَا إِلَى اللَّهِ‏}‏ لِعَائِشَةَ وَحَفْصَةَ ‏{‏وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ النَّبِيُّ إِلَى بَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِهِ‏}‏ لِقَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ بَلْ شَرِبْتُ عَسَلاً ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy alhasanu bnu muhammadi bni sabbaahin, haddathanaa hajjaajun, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala za'ama 'ataa'un aannahu sami'a 'ubayda bna 'umayrin, yaquwlu sami'tu 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yamkuthu 'inda zaynaba abnaai jahshin, wayashrabu 'indahaa 'asalaan, fatawaasaytu aanaa wahafsaau aanna aayyatanaa dakhala 'alayhaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faltaqul iinniy aajidu minka riyha maghaafiyra, aakalta maghaafiyra fadakhala 'alaa iihdaahumaa faqaalat lahu dhalika, faqaala ‏"‏ laa bal sharibtu 'asalaan 'inda zaynaba abnaai jahshin walan aa'uwda lahu ‏"‏‏.‏ fanazalat ‏{‏yaa aayyuhaa alnnabiyyu lima tuharrimu maa aahalla alllahu laka‏}‏ iilaa ‏{‏iin tatuwbaa iilaa alllahi‏}‏ li'aaiishaaa wahafsaaa ‏{‏waiidh aasarra alnnabiyyu iilaa ba'di aazwaajihi‏}‏ liqawlihi ‏"‏ bal sharibtu 'asalaan ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ubaid bin `Umar:I heard `Aisha saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to stay for a long while with Zanab bint Jahsh and drink honey at her house. So Hafsa and I decided that if the Prophet (ﷺ) came to anyone of us, she should say him, "I detect the smell of Maghafir (a nasty smelling gum) in you. Have you eaten Maghafir?' " So the Prophet (ﷺ) visited one of them and she said to him similarly. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Never mind, I have taken some honey at the house of Zainab bint Jahsh, but I shall never drink of it anymore." So there was revealed: 'O Prophet ! Why do you ban (for you) that which Allah has made lawful for you . . . If you two (wives of Prophet) turn in repentance to Allah,' (66.1-4) addressing Aisha and Hafsa. 'When the Prophet (ﷺ) disclosed a matter in confidence to some of his wives.' (66.3) namely his saying: But I have taken some honey
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحِبُّ الْعَسَلَ وَالْحَلْوَاءَ، وَكَانَ إِذَا انْصَرَفَ مِنَ الْعَصْرِ دَخَلَ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ، فَيَدْنُو مِنْ إِحْدَاهُنَّ، فَدَخَلَ عَلَى حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ عُمَرَ، فَاحْتَبَسَ أَكْثَرَ مَا كَانَ يَحْتَبِسُ، فَغِرْتُ فَسَأَلْتُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقِيلَ لِي أَهْدَتْ لَهَا امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهَا عُكَّةً مِنْ عَسَلٍ، فَسَقَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْهُ شَرْبَةً، فَقُلْتُ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَنَحْتَالَنَّ لَهُ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لِسَوْدَةَ بِنْتِ زَمْعَةَ إِنَّهُ سَيَدْنُو مِنْكِ، فَإِذَا دَنَا مِنْكِ فَقُولِي أَكَلْتَ مَغَافِيرَ فَإِنَّهُ سَيَقُولُ لَكِ لاَ‏.‏ فَقُولِي لَهُ مَا هَذِهِ الرِّيحُ الَّتِي أَجِدُ مِنْكَ فَإِنَّهُ سَيَقُولُ لَكِ سَقَتْنِي حَفْصَةُ شَرْبَةَ عَسَلٍ فَقُولِي لَهُ جَرَسَتْ نَحْلُهُ الْعُرْفُطَ‏.‏ وَسَأَقُولُ ذَلِكَ، وَقُولِي أَنْتِ يَا صَفِيَّةُ ذَاكِ‏.‏ قَالَتْ تَقُولُ سَوْدَةُ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا هُوَ إِلاَّ أَنْ قَامَ عَلَى الْبَابِ، فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أُبَادِيَهُ بِمَا أَمَرْتِنِي بِهِ فَرَقًا مِنْكِ، فَلَمَّا دَنَا مِنْهَا قَالَتْ لَهُ سَوْدَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَكَلْتَ مَغَافِيرَ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَمَا هَذِهِ الرِّيحُ الَّتِي أَجِدُ مِنْكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ سَقَتْنِي حَفْصَةُ شَرْبَةَ عَسَلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ جَرَسَتْ نَحْلُهُ الْعُرْفُطَ فَلَمَّا دَارَ إِلَىَّ قُلْتُ لَهُ نَحْوَ ذَلِكَ، فَلَمَّا دَارَ إِلَى صَفِيَّةَ قَالَتْ لَهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ فَلَمَّا دَارَ إِلَى حَفْصَةَ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلاَ أَسْقِيكَ مِنْهُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ حَاجَةَ لِي فِيهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ تَقُولُ سَوْدَةُ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ حَرَمْنَاهُ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَهَا اسْكُتِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa farwaau bnu aabiy almaghraa'i, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhibbu al'asala waalhalwaa'a, wakaana iidhaa ansarafa mina al'asri dakhala 'alaa nisaaiihi, fayadnuw min iihdaahunna, fadakhala 'alaa hafsaaa binti 'umara, faahtabasa aakthara maa kaana yahtabisu, faghirtu fasaaaltu 'an dhalika faqiyla liy aahdat lahaa amraaaaun min qawmihaa 'ukkaaan min 'asalin, fasaqati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm minhu sharbaaan, faqultu aamaa waalllahi lanahtaalanna lahu‏.‏ faqultu lisawdaaa binti zam'aaa iinnahu sayadnuw minki, faiidhaa danaa minki faquwliy aakalta maghaafiyra faiinnahu sayaquwlu laki laa‏.‏ faquwliy lahu maa hadhihi alrriyhu allatiy aajidu minka faiinnahu sayaquwlu laki saqatniy hafsaau sharbaaa 'asalin faquwliy lahu jarasat nahluhu al'urfuta‏.‏ wasaaaquwlu dhalika, waquwliy aanti yaa safiyyaau dhaaki‏.‏ qaalat taquwlu sawdaau fawaalllahi maa huwa iilaaa aan qaama 'alaa albaabi, faaaradtu aan aubaadiyahu bimaa aamartiniy bihi faraqana minki, falammaa danaa minhaa qaalat lahu sawdaau yaa rasuwla alllahi aakalta maghaafiyra qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat famaa hadhihi alrriyhu allatiy aajidu minka‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ saqatniy hafsaau sharbaaa 'asalin ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaalat jarasat nahluhu al'urfuta falammaa daara iilaaaa qultu lahu nahwa dhalika, falammaa daara iilaa safiyyaaa qaalat lahu mithla dhalika falammaa daara iilaa hafsaaa qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi aalaa aasqiyka minhu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laa haajaaa liy fiyhi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat taquwlu sawdaau waalllahi laqad haramnaahu‏.‏ qultu lahaa askutiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was fond of honey and sweet edible things and (it was his habit) that after finishing the `Asr prayer he would visit his wives and stay with one of them at that time. Once he went to Hafsa, the daughter of `Umar and stayed with her more than usual. I got jealous and asked the reason for that. I was told that a lady of her folk had given her a skin filled with honey as a present, and that she made a syrup from it and gave it to the Prophet (ﷺ) to drink (and that was the reason for the delay). I said, "By Allah we will play a trick on him (to prevent him from doing so)." So I said to Sa`da bint Zam`a "The Prophet (ﷺ) will approach you, and when he comes near you, say: 'Have you taken Maghafir (a bad-smelling gum)?' He will say, 'No.' Then say to him: 'Then what is this bad smell which i smell from you?' He will say to you, 'Hafsa made me drink honey syrup.' Then say: Perhaps the bees of that honey had sucked the juice of the tree of Al-`Urfut.' I shall also say the same. O you, Safiyya, say the same." Later Sa`da said, "By Allah, as soon as he (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) stood at the door, I was about to say to him what you had ordered me to say because I was afraid of you." So when the Prophet (ﷺ) came near Sa`da, she said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Have you taken Maghafir?" He said, "No." She said. "Then what is this bad smell which I detect on you?" He said, "Hafsa made me drink honey syrup." She said, "Perhaps its bees had sucked the juice of Al-`Urfut tree." When he came to me, I also said the same, and when he went to Safiyya, she also said the same. And when the Prophet (ﷺ) again went to Hafsa, she said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall I give you more of that drink?" He said, "I am not in need of it." Sa`da said, "By Allah, we deprived him (of it)." I said to her, "Keep quiet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَجَاوَزَ عَنْ أُمَّتِي مَا حَدَّثَتْ بِهِ أَنْفُسَهَا، مَا لَمْ تَعْمَلْ أَوْ تَتَكَلَّمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ إِذَا طَلَّقَ فِي نَفْسِهِ فَلَيْسَ بِشَىْءٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa hishaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an zuraaraaa bni aawfaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha tajaawaza 'an aummatiy maa haddathat bihi aanfusahaa, maa lam ta'mal aaw tatakallam ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala qataadaau iidhaa tallaqa fiy nafsihi falaysa bishaa'in‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has forgiven my followers the evil thoughts that occur to their minds, as long as such thoughts are not put into action or uttered." And Qatada said, "If someone divorces his wife just in his mind, such an unuttered divorce has no effect.:
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَصْبَغُ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنْ أَسْلَمَ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ قَدْ زَنَى‏.‏ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ، فَتَنَحَّى لِشِقِّهِ الَّذِي أَعْرَضَ فَشَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ، فَدَعَاهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هَلْ بِكَ جُنُونٌ هَلْ أُحْصِنْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ أَنْ يُرْجَمَ بِالْمُصَلَّى، فَلَمَّا أَذْلَقَتْهُ الْحِجَارَةُ جَمَزَ حَتَّى أُدْرِكَ بِالْحَرَّةِ فَقُتِلَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aasbaghu, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa, 'an jaabirin, aanna rajulaan, min aaslama aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa fiy almasjidi faqaala iinnahu qad zanaa‏.‏ faaa'rada 'anhu, fatanahhaa lishiqqihi alladhiy aa'rada fashahida 'alaa nafsihi aarba'a shahaadaatin, fada'aahu faqaala ‏ "‏ hal bika junuwnun hal auhsinta ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ faaamara bihi aan yurjama bialmusallaa, falammaa aadhlaqathu alhijaaraau jamaza hattaa audrika bialharraai faqutila‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:A man from the tribe of Bani Aslam came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was in the mosque and said, "I have committed illegal sexual intercourse." The Prophet (ﷺ) turned his face to the other side. The man turned towards the side towards which the Prophet (ﷺ) had turned his face, and gave four witnesses against himself. On that the Prophet (ﷺ) called him and said, "Are you insane?" (He added), "Are you married?" The man said, 'Yes." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered him to be stoned to the death in the Musalla (a praying place). When the stones hit him with their sharp edges and he fled, but he was caught at Al- Harra and then killed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أَتَى رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَسْلَمَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَنَادَاهُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الأَخِرَ قَدْ زَنَى ـ يَعْنِي نَفْسَهُ ـ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَتَنَحَّى لِشِقِّ وَجْهِهِ الَّذِي أَعْرَضَ قِبَلَهُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الأَخِرَ قَدْ زَنَى فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَتَنَحَّى لِشِقِّ وَجْهِهِ الَّذِي أَعْرَضَ قِبَلَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ ذَلِكَ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَتَنَحَّى لَهُ الرَّابِعَةَ، فَلَمَّا شَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ دَعَاهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ بِكَ جُنُونٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اذْهَبُوا بِهِ فَارْجُمُوهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ قَدْ أُحْصِنَ‏.‏ وَعَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، قَالَ كُنْتُ فِيمَنْ رَجَمَهُ فَرَجَمْنَاهُ بِالْمُصَلَّى بِالْمَدِينَةِ، فَلَمَّا أَذْلَقَتْهُ الْحِجَارَةُ جَمَزَ حَتَّى أَدْرَكْنَاهُ بِالْحَرَّةِ، فَرَجَمْنَاهُ حَتَّى مَاتَ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzuuhriyii, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alraahmani, wasa'iydu bnu almusayaabi, aanaa aabaa hurayraaa, qaala aataa rajulun min aaslama rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa fiy almasjidi fanaadaahu faqaala yaa rasuwla allaahi iinaa alaakhira qad zanaa ya'niy nafsahu faaa'rada 'anhu fatanahaaa lishiqii wajhihi alaadhiy aa'rada qibalahu faqaala yaa rasuwla allaahi iinaa alaakhira qad zanaa faaa'rada 'anhu fatanahaaa lishiqii wajhihi alaadhiy aa'rada qibalahu faqaala lahu dhalika faaa'rada 'anhu fatanahaaa lahu alraaabi'aaa, falamaaa shahida 'alaa nafsihi aarba'a shahaadaatin da'aahu faqaala ‏"‏ hal bika junuwnun ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala laa‏.‏ faqaala alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ adhhabuwa bihi faarjumuwhu ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana qad auhsina‏.‏ wa'ani alzuuhriyii, qaala aakhbaraniy man, sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi allaahi alaansaariyaa, qaala kuntu fiyman rajamahu farajamnaahu bialmusalaaa bialmadiynaai, falamaaa aadhlaqathu alhijaaraau jamaza hataaa aadraknaahu bialharaaai, farajamnaahu hataaa maata‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man from Bani Aslam came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was in the mosque and called (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have committed illegal sexual intercourse." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) turned his face from him to the other side, whereupon the man moved to the side towards which the Prophet (ﷺ) had turned his face, and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have committed illegal sexual intercourse." The Prophet turned his face (from him) to the other side whereupon the man moved to the side towards which the Prophet (ﷺ) had turned his face, and repeated his statement. The Prophet (ﷺ) turned his face (from him) to the other side again. The man moved again (and repeated his statement) for the fourth time. So when the man had given witness four times against himself, the Prophet (ﷺ) called him and said, "Are you insane?" He replied, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) then said (to his companions), "Go and stone him to death." The man was a married one. Jabir bin `Abdullah Al-Ansari said: I was one of those who stoned him. We stoned him at the Musalla (`Id praying place) in Medina. When the stones hit him with their sharp edges, he fled, but we caught him at Al-Harra and stoned him till he died
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَزْهَرُ بْنُ جَمِيلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،‏.‏ أَنَّ امْرَأَةَ، ثَابِتِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ثَابِتُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ مَا أَعْتُبُ عَلَيْهِ فِي خُلُقٍ وَلاَ دِينٍ، وَلَكِنِّي أَكْرَهُ الْكُفْرَ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَتَرُدِّينَ عَلَيْهِ حَدِيقَتَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اقْبَلِ الْحَدِيقَةَ وَطَلِّقْهَا تَطْلِيقَةً ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْد اللَّهِ لَا يُتَابَعُ فِيهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aazharu bnu jamiylin, hadaathanaa 'abdu alwahaaabi althaaqafiyuu, hadaathanaa khaalidun, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abaaasin, ‏.‏ aanaa amraaaaa, thaabiti bni qaysin aatati alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla allaahi thaabitu bnu qaysin maa aa'tubu 'alayhi fiy khuluqin walaa diynin, walakiniiy aakrahu alkufra fiy aliislaami‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aatarudiiyna 'alayhi hadiyqatahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat na'am‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aqbali alhadiyqaaa wataliiqhaa tatliyqaaan ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abd allaahi laa yutaaba'u fiyhi 'an abni 'abaaasin
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The wife of Thabit bin Qais came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I do not blame Thabit for defects in his character or his religion, but I, being a Muslim, dislike to behave in un-Islamic manner (if I remain with him)." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to her), "Will you give back the garden which your husband has given you (as Mahr)?" She said, "Yes." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to Thabit, "O Thabit! Accept your garden, and divorce her once
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، أَنَّ أُخْتَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُبَىٍّ، بِهَذَا، وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ تَرُدِّينَ حَدِيقَتَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَرَدَّتْهَا وَأَمَرَهُ يُطَلِّقْهَا‏.‏ وَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ عَنْ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَطَلِّقْهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu alwaasitiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an khaalidin alhadhhaa'i, 'an 'ikrimaaa, aanna aukhta 'abdi alllahi bni aubaaain, bihadhaa, waqaala ‏ "‏ taruddiyna hadiyqatahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat na'am‏.‏ faraddathaa waaamarahu yutalliqhaa‏.‏ waqaala iibraahiymu bnu tahmaana 'an khaalidin 'an 'ikrimaaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm watalliqhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ikrima:The sister of `Abdullah bin Ubai narrated (the above narration, 197) with the addition that the Prophet (ﷺ) said to Thabit's wife, "Will you return his garden?" She said, "Yes," and returned it, and (then) the Prophet ordered Thabit to divorce her
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَعَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي تَمِيمَةَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةُ ثَابِتِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي لاَ أَعْتُبُ عَلَى ثَابِتٍ فِي دِينٍ وَلاَ خُلُقٍ، وَلَكِنِّي لاَ أُطِيقُهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ فَتَرُدِّينَ عَلَيْهِ حَدِيقَتَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: wa'ani abni aabiy tamiymaaa, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aannahu qaala jaa'ati amraaaau thaabiti bni qaysin iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy laa aa'tubu 'alaa thaabitin fiy diynin walaa khuluqin, walakinniy laa autiyquhu‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ fataruddiyna 'alayhi hadiyqatahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat na'am‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The wife of Thabit bin Qais came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I do not blame Thabit for any defects in his character or his religion, but I cannot endure to live with him." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Will you return his garden to him?" She said, "Yes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ الْمُخَرِّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا قُرَادٌ أَبُو نُوحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، رضى الله عنهما قَالَ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةُ ثَابِتِ بْنِ قَيْسِ بْنِ شَمَّاسٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا أَنْقِمُ عَلَى ثَابِتٍ فِي دِينٍ وَلاَ خُلُقٍ، إِلاَّ أَنِّي أَخَافُ الْكُفْرَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ فَتَرُدِّينَ عَلَيْهِ حَدِيقَتَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَرَدَّتْ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَمَرَهُ فَفَارَقَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni almubaaraki almukharrimiyyu, haddathanaa quraadun aabuw nuwhin, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, rda allh 'nhma qaala jaa'ati amraaaau thaabiti bni qaysi bni shammaasin iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi maa aanqimu 'alaa thaabitin fiy diynin walaa khuluqin, iilaaa aanniy aakhaafu alkufra‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ fataruddiyna 'alayhi hadiyqatahu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaalat na'am‏.‏ faraddat 'alayhi, waaamarahu fafaaraqahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The wife of Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I do not blame Thabit for any defects in his character or his religion, but I am afraid that I (being a Muslim) may become unthankful for Allah's Blessings." On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to her), 'Will you return his garden to him?" She said, "Yes." So she returned his garden to him and the Prophet (ﷺ) told him to divorce her
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، أَنَّ جَمِيلَةَ، فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an 'ikrimaaa, aanna jamiylaaa, fadhakara alhadiytha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ikrima:that Jamila... Then he related the whole ,Hadith, (i.e)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ بَنِي الْمُغِيرَةِ اسْتَأْذَنُوا فِي أَنْ يَنْكِحَ عَلِيٌّ ابْنَتَهُمْ، فَلاَ آذَنُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, 'ani almiswari bni makhramaaa, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna baniy almughiyraai astaadhanuwa fiy aan yankiha 'aliyyun abnatahum, falaa adhanu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama Az-Zuhri:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Banu Al-Mughira have asked my leave to let `Ali marry their daughter, but I give no leave to this effect
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ كَانَ فِي بَرِيرَةَ ثَلاَثُ سُنَنٍ، إِحْدَى السُّنَنِ أَنَّهَا أُعْتِقَتْ، فَخُيِّرَتْ فِي زَوْجِهَا‏.‏ وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَدَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْبُرْمَةُ تَفُورُ بِلَحْمٍ، فَقُرِّبَ إِلَيْهِ خُبْزٌ وَأُدْمٌ مِنْ أُدْمِ الْبَيْتِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَمْ أَرَ الْبُرْمَةَ فِيهَا لَحْمٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا بَلَى، وَلَكِنْ ذَلِكَ لَحْمٌ تُصُدِّقَ بِهِ عَلَى بَرِيرَةَ، وَأَنْتَ لاَ تَأْكُلُ الصَّدَقَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ عَلَيْهَا صَدَقَةٌ، وَلَنَا هَدِيَّةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an rabiy'aaa bni aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat kaana fiy bariyraaa thalaathu sunanin, iihdaa alssunani aannahaa au'tiqat, fakhuyyirat fiy zawjihaa‏.‏ waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alwalaa'u liman aa'taqa ‏"‏‏.‏ wadakhala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalburmaau tafuwru bilahmin, faqurriba iilayhi khubzun waaudmun min audmi albayti faqaala ‏"‏ aalam aara alburmaaa fiyhaa lahmun ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa balaa, walakin dhalika lahmun tusuddiqa bihi 'alaa bariyraaa, waaanta laa taakulu alssadaqaaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ 'alayhaa sadaqaaun, walanaa hadiyyaaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Three traditions were established concerning situations in which Barra was involved: When she was manumitted, she was given the option to keep her husband or leave him; Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The wala is for the one who manumits, Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered the house while some meat was being cooked in a pot, but only bread and some soup of the house were placed before, him. He said, "Don't I see the pot containing meat?" They said, "Yes, but that meat was given to Barira in charity (by someone), and you do not eat what it given in charity."The Prophet (ﷺ) said "That meat is alms for her, but for us it is a present
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، وَهَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُهُ عَبْدًا يَعْنِي زَوْجَ بَرِيرَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, wahammaamun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala raaaytuhu 'abdana ya'niy zawja bariyraaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I saw him as a slave, (namely, Barira's husband)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ ذَاكَ مُغِيثٌ عَبْدُ بَنِي فُلاَنٍ ـ يَعْنِي زَوْجَ بَرِيرَةَ ـ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ يَتْبَعُهَا فِي سِكَكِ الْمَدِينَةِ، يَبْكِي عَلَيْهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa bnu hammaadin, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala dhaaka mughiythun 'abdu baniy fulaanin ya'niy zawja bariyraaa kaaanniy aanzuru iilayhi yatba'uhaa fiy sikaki almadiynaai, yabkiy 'alayhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:That was Mughith, the slave of Bani so-and-so, i.e., Barira's husband as if I am now looking at him following her (Barira) along the streets of Medina
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ زَوْجُ بَرِيرَةَ عَبْدًا أَسْوَدَ يُقَالُ لَهُ مُغِيثٌ، عَبْدًا لِبَنِي فُلاَنٍ، كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ يَطُوفُ وَرَاءَهَا فِي سِكَكِ الْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, 'an aayyuwba, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana zawju bariyraaa 'abdana aaswada yuqaalu lahu mughiythun, 'abdana libaniy fulaanin, kaaanniy aanzuru iilayhi yatuwfu waraa'ahaa fiy sikaki almadiynaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Barira's husband was a black slave called Mughith, the slave of Bani so-and-so-- as if I am seeing him now, walking behind her along the streets of Medina
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ زَوْجَ، بَرِيرَةَ كَانَ عَبْدًا يُقَالُ لَهُ مُغِيثٌ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ يَطُوفُ خَلْفَهَا يَبْكِي، وَدُمُوعُهُ تَسِيلُ عَلَى لِحْيَتِهِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِعَبَّاسٍ ‏"‏ يَا عَبَّاسُ أَلاَ تَعْجَبُ مِنْ حُبِّ مُغِيثٍ بَرِيرَةَ، وَمِنْ بُغْضِ بَرِيرَةَ مُغِيثًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ رَاجَعْتِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ تَأْمُرُنِي قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا أَنَا أَشْفَعُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ لاَ حَاجَةَ لِي فِيهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna zawja, bariyraaa kaana 'abdana yuqaalu lahu mughiythun kaaanniy aanzuru iilayhi yatuwfu khalfahaa yabkiy, wadumuw'uhu tasiylu 'alaa lihyatihi, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm li'abbaasin ‏"‏ yaa 'abbaasu aalaa ta'jabu min hubbi mughiythin bariyraaa, wamin bughdi bariyraaa mughiythana ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ law raaja'tihi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi taamuruniy qaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa aanaa aashfa'u ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat laa haajaaa liy fiyhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Barira's husband was a slave called Mughith, as if I am seeing him now, going behind Barira and weeping with his tears flowing down his beard. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to `Abbas, "O `Abbas ! are you not astonished at the love of Mughith for Barira and the hatred of Barira for Mughith?" The Prophet (ﷺ) then said to Barira, "Why don't you return to him?" She said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do you order me to do so?" He said, "No, I only intercede for him." She said, "I am not in need of him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، أَرَادَتْ أَنْ تَشْتَرِيَ، بَرِيرَةَ، فَأَبَى مَوَالِيهَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشْتَرِطُوا الْوَلاَءَ، فَذَكَرَتْ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اشْتَرِيهَا وَأَعْتِقِيهَا، فَإِنَّمَا الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِلَحْمٍ فَقِيلَ إِنَّ هَذَا مَا تُصُدِّقَ عَلَى بَرِيرَةَ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هُوَ لَهَا صَدَقَةٌ، وَلَنَا هَدِيَّةٌ ‏"‏‏. حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ وَزَادَ فَخُيِّرَتْ مِنْ زَوْجِهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'abdu allaahi bnu rajaa'in, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, aanaa 'aaiishaaa, aaraadat aan tashtariya, bariyraaa, faaabaa mawaaliyhaa iilaaa aan yashtarituwa alwalaa'a, fadhakarat lilnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ ashtariyhaa waaa'tiqiyhaa, faiinaamaa alwalaa'u liman aa'taqa ‏"‏‏.‏ waautiya alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm bilahmin faqiyla iinaa hadhaa maa tusudiiqa 'alaa bariyraaa, faqaala ‏"‏ huwa lahaa sadaqaaun, walanaa hadiyaaaun ‏"‏‏. hadaathanaa adamu hadaathanaa shu'baau wazaada fakhuyiirat min zawjihaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Aswad:Aisha intended to buy Barira, but her masters stipulated that her wala wound be for them. Aisha mentioned that to the Prophet (ﷺ) who said (to `Aisha), "Buy and manumit her, for the wala is for the one who manumits." Once some meat was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and was said, "This meat was given in charity to Barira. " The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is an object of charity for Barira and a gift for us." Narrated Adam: Shu`ba related the same Hadith and added: Barira was given the option regarding her husband
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، كَانَ إِذَا سُئِلَ عَنْ نِكَاحِ النَّصْرَانِيَّةِ، وَالْيَهُودِيَّةِ، قَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ الْمُشْرِكَاتِ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ الإِشْرَاكِ شَيْئًا أَكْبَرَ مِنْ أَنْ تَقُولَ الْمَرْأَةُ رَبُّهَا عِيسَى، وَهْوَ عَبْدٌ مِنْ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa laythun, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara, kaana iidhaa suiila 'an nikaahi alnnasraaniyyaai, waalyahuwdiyyaai, qaala iinna alllaha harrama almushrikaati 'alaa almuuminiyna, walaa aa'lamu mina aliishraaki shayiana aakbara min aan taquwla almaraaau rabbuhaa 'iysaa, wahwa 'abdun min 'ibaadi alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Whenever Ibn `Umar was asked about marrying a Christian lady or a Jewess, he would say: "Allah has made it unlawful for the believers to marry ladies who ascribe partners in worship to Allah, and I do not know of a greater thing, as regards to ascribing partners in worship, etc. to Allah, than that a lady should say that Jesus is her Lord although he is just one of Allah's slaves
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، وَقَالَ، عَطَاءٌ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، كَانَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ عَلَى مَنْزِلَتَيْنِ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ، كَانُوا مُشْرِكِي أَهْلِ حَرْبٍ يُقَاتِلُهُمْ وَيُقَاتِلُونَهُ، وَمُشْرِكِي أَهْلِ عَهْدٍ لاَ يُقَاتِلُهُمْ وَلاَ يُقَاتِلُونَهُ، وَكَانَ إِذَا هَاجَرَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْحَرْبِ لَمْ تُخْطَبْ حَتَّى تَحِيضَ وَتَطْهُرَ، فَإِذَا طَهُرَتْ حَلَّ لَهَا النِّكَاحُ، فَإِنْ هَاجَرَ زَوْجُهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْكِحَ رُدَّتْ إِلَيْهِ، وَإِنْ هَاجَرَ عَبْدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ أَمَةٌ فَهُمَا حُرَّانِ وَلَهُمَا مَا لِلْمُهَاجِرِينَ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعَهْدِ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ مُجَاهِدٍ وَإِنْ هَاجَرَ عَبْدٌ أَوْ أَمَةٌ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ أَهْلِ الْعَهْدِ لَمْ يُرَدُّوا، وَرُدَّتْ أَثْمَانُهُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, 'ani abni jurayjin, waqaala, 'ataa'un 'ani abni 'abbaasin, kaana almushrikuwna 'alaa manzilatayni mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalmuuminiyna, kaanuwa mushrikiy aahli harbin yuqaatiluhum wayuqaatiluwnahu, wamushrikiy aahli 'ahdin laa yuqaatiluhum walaa yuqaatiluwnahu, wakaana iidhaa haajarati amraaaaun min aahli alharbi lam tukhtab hattaa tahiyda watathura, faiidhaa tahurat halla lahaa alnnikaahu, faiin haajara zawjuhaa qabla aan tankiha ruddat iilayhi, waiin haajara 'abdun minhum aaw aamaaun fahumaa hurraani walahumaa maa lilmuhaajiriyna‏.‏ thumma dhakara min aahli al'ahdi mithla hadiythi mujaahidin waiin haajara 'abdun aaw aamaaun lilmushrikiyna aahli al'ahdi lam yuradduwa, waruddat aathmaanuhum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: The pagans were of two kinds as regards their relationship to the Prophet and the Believers. Some of them were those with whom the Prophet was at war and used to fight against, and they used to fight him; the others were those with whom the Prophet (ﷺ) made a treaty, and neither did the Prophet (ﷺ) fight them, nor did they fight him. If a lady from the first group of pagans emigrated towards the Muslims, her hand would not be asked in marriage unless she got the menses and then became clean. When she became clean, it would be lawful for her to get married, and if her husband emigrated too before she got married, then she would be returned to him. If any slave or female slave emigrated from them to the Muslims, then they would be considered free persons (not slaves) and they would have the same rights as given to other emigrants. The narrator then mentioned about the pagans involved with the Muslims in a treaty, the same as occurs in Mujahid's narration. If a male slave or a female slave emigrated from such pagans as had made a treaty with the Muslims, they would not be returned, but their prices would be paid (to the pagans)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ عَطَاءٌ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، كَانَتْ قَرِيبَةُ بِنْتُ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ عِنْدَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ فَطَلَّقَهَا، فَتَزَوَّجَهَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، وَكَانَتْ أُمُّ الْحَكَمِ ابْنَةُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ تَحْتَ عِيَاضِ بْنِ غَنْمٍ الْفِهْرِيِّ فَطَلَّقَهَا، فَتَزَوَّجَهَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ الثَّقَفِيُّ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala 'ataa'un 'ani abni 'abbaasin, kaanat qariybaau bintu aabiy aumayyaaa 'inda 'umara bni alkhattaabi fatallaqahaa, fatazawwajahaa mu'aawiyaau bnu aabiy sufyaana, wakaanat aummu alhakami abnaau aabiy sufyaana tahta 'iyaadi bni ghanmin alfihriyyi fatallaqahaa, fatazawwajahaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'uthmaana althhaqafiyyu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:Qariba, The daughter of Abi Umaiyya, was the wife of 'Umar bin Al-Khattab. 'Umar divorced her and then Mu'awiyya bin Abi Sufyan married her. Similarly, Um Al-Hakam, the daughter of Abi Sufyan was the wife of 'Iyad bin Ghanm Al-Fihri. He divorced her and then 'Abdullah bin 'Uthman Al-Thaqafi married her
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ،‏.‏ وَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ كَانَتِ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ إِذَا هَاجَرْنَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْتَحِنُهُنَّ بِقَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا جَاءَكُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ مُهَاجِرَاتٍ فَامْتَحِنُوهُنَّ‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَمَنْ أَقَرَّ بِهَذَا الشَّرْطِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فَقَدْ أَقَرَّ بِالْمِحْنَةِ، فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَقْرَرْنَ بِذَلِكَ مِنْ قَوْلِهِنَّ قَالَ لَهُنَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ انْطَلِقْنَ فَقَدْ بَايَعْتُكُنَّ ‏"‏، لاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا مَسَّتْ يَدُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَ امْرَأَةٍ قَطُّ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ بَايَعَهُنَّ بِالْكَلاَمِ، وَاللَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى النِّسَاءِ إِلاَّ بِمَا أَمَرَهُ اللَّهُ يَقُولُ لَهُنَّ إِذَا أَخَذَ عَلَيْهِنَّ ‏"‏ قَدْ بَايَعْتُكُنَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ كَلاَمًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, ‏.‏ waqaala iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri haddathaniy abnu wahbin, haddathaniy yuwnusu, qaala abnu shihaabin aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat kaanati almuuminaatu iidhaa haajarna iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yamtahinuhunna biqawli alllahi ta'aalaa ‏{‏yaa aayyuhaa alladhiyna amanuwa iidhaa jaa'akumu almuuminaatu muhaajiraatin faamtahinuwhunna‏}‏ iilaa akhiri alayaai qaalat 'aaiishaau faman aaqarra bihadhaa alshharti mina almuuminaati faqad aaqarra bialmihnaai, fakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aaqrarna bidhalika min qawlihinna qaala lahunna rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ antaliqna faqad baaya'tukunna ‏"‏, laa waalllahi maa massat yadu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yada amraaaain qattu, ghayra aannahu baaya'ahunna bialkalaami, waalllahi maa aakhadha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alnnisaa'i iilaaa bimaa aamarahu alllahu yaquwlu lahunna iidhaa aakhadha 'alayhinna ‏"‏ qad baaya'tukunna ‏"‏‏.‏ kalaamana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) When believing women came to the Prophet (ﷺ) as emigrants, he used to test them in accordance with the order of Allah. 'O you who believe! When believing women come to you as emigrants, examine them . . .' (60.10) So if anyone of those believing women accepted the above mentioned conditions, she accepted the conditions of faith. When they agreed on those conditions and confessed that with their tongues, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would say to them, "Go, I have accepted your oath of allegiance (for Islam). By Allah, and hand of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never touched the hand of any woman, but he only used to take their pledge of allegiance orally. By Allah, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not take the pledge of allegiance of the women except in accordance with what Allah had ordered him. When he accepted their pledge of allegiance he would say to them, "I have accepted your oath of allegiance
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي أُوَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ آلَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ نِسَائِهِ، وَكَانَتِ انْفَكَّتْ رِجْلُهُ فَأَقَامَ فِي مَشْرُبَةٍ لَهُ تِسْعًا وَعِشْرِينَ، ثُمَّ نَزَلَ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ آلَيْتَ شَهْرًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ الشَّهْرُ تِسْعٌ وَعِشْرُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu aabiy auwaysin, 'an aakhiyhi, 'an sulaymaana, 'an humaydin alttawiyli, aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu alaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min nisaaiihi, wakaanati anfakkat rijluhu faaaqaama fiy mashrubaain lahu tis'ana wa'ishriyna, thumma nazala faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi alayta shahrana‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ alshhahru tis'un wa'ishruwna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took an oath that he would abstain from his wives, and at that time his leg had been sprained (dislocated).
