So he stayed in the Mashruba (an attic room) of his for 29 days. Then he came down, and they (the people) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You took an oath to abstain from your wives for one month." He said, "The month is of twenty nine days
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، رضى الله عنهما كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي الإِيلاَءِ الَّذِي سَمَّى اللَّهُ لاَ يَحِلُّ لأَحَدٍ بَعْدَ الأَجَلِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُمْسِكَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ، أَوْ يَعْزِمَ بِالطَّلاَقِ، كَمَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara, rda allh 'nhma kaana yaquwlu fiy aliiylaa'i alladhiy sammaa alllahu laa yahillu laahadin ba'da alaajali iilaaa aan yumsika bialma'ruwfi, aaw ya'zima bialttalaaqi, kamaa aamara alllahu 'azza wajalla‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar used to say about the Ila (which Allah defined (in the Holy Book), "If the period of Ila expires, then the husband has either to retain his wife in a handsome manner or to divorce her as Allah has ordered
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ لِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، إِذَا مَضَتْ أَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ يُوقَفُ حَتَّى يُطَلِّقَ، وَلاَ يَقَعُ عَلَيْهِ الطَّلاَقُ حَتَّى يُطَلِّقَ‏.‏ وَيُذْكَرُ ذَلِكَ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ وَعَلِيٍّ وَأَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ وَعَائِشَةَ وَاثْنَىْ عَشَرَ رَجُلاً مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala liy iismaa'iylu haddathaniy maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, iidhaa madat aarba'aau aashhurin yuwqafu hattaa yutalliqa, walaa yaqa'u 'alayhi alttalaaqu hattaa yutalliqa‏.‏ wayudhkaru dhalika 'an 'uthmaana wa'aliyyin waaabiy alddardaa'i wa'aaiishaaa waathnaa 'ashara rajulaan min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn `Umar added:"When the period of four months has expired, the husband should be put in prison so that he should divorce his wife, but the divorce does not occur unless the husband himself declares it. This has been mentioned by `Uthman, `Ali, Abu Ad-Darda, `Aisha and twelve other companions of the Prophet (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنْ ضَالَّةِ الْغَنَمِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ خُذْهَا، فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ لَكَ أَوْ لأَخِيكَ أَوْ لِلذِّئْبِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَسُئِلَ عَنْ ضَالَّةِ الإِبِلِ، فَغَضِبَ وَاحْمَرَّتْ وَجْنَتَاهُ، وَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكَ وَلَهَا، مَعَهَا الْحِذَاءُ وَالسِّقَاءُ، تَشْرَبُ الْمَاءَ، وَتَأْكُلُ الشَّجَرَ، حَتَّى يَلْقَاهَا رَبُّهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَسُئِلَ عَنِ اللُّقَطَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اعْرِفْ وِكَاءَهَا وَعِفَاصَهَا، وَعَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً، فَإِنْ جَاءَ مَنْ يَعْرِفُهَا، وَإِلاَّ فَاخْلِطْهَا بِمَالِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ فَلَقِيتُ رَبِيعَةَ بْنَ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ـ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ وَلَمْ أَحْفَظْ عَنْهُ شَيْئًا غَيْرَ هَذَا ـ فَقُلْتُ أَرَأَيْتَ حَدِيثَ يَزِيدَ مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ فِي أَمْرِ الضَّالَّةِ، هُوَ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ يَحْيَى وَيَقُولُ رَبِيعَةُ عَنْ يَزِيدَ مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ فَلَقِيتُ رَبِيعَةَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an yaziyda, mawlaa almunba'ithi aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm suiila 'an daallaai alghanami faqaala ‏"‏ khudhhaa, faiinnamaa hiya laka aaw laakhiyka aaw lildhhiibi ‏"‏‏.‏ wasuiila 'an daallaai aliibili, faghadiba waahmarrat wajnataahu, waqaala ‏"‏ maa laka walahaa, ma'ahaa alhidhaa'u waalssiqaa'u, tashrabu almaa'a, wataakulu alshhajara, hattaa yalqaahaa rabbuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ wasuiila 'ani allluqataai faqaala ‏"‏ a'rif wikaa'ahaa wa'ifaasahaa, wa'arrifhaa sanaaan, faiin jaa'a man ya'rifuhaa, waiilaaa faakhlithaa bimaalika ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu falaqiytu rabiy'aaa bna aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani qaala sufyaanu walam aahfaz 'anhu shayiana ghayra hadhaa faqultu aaraaayta hadiytha yaziyda mawlaa almunba'ithi fiy aamri alddaallaai, huwa 'an zaydi bni khaalidin qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala yahyaa wayaquwlu rabiy'aau 'an yaziyda mawlaa almunba'ithi 'an zaydi bni khaalidin‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu falaqiytu rabiy'aaa faqultu lahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Yazid:(the Maula of Munba'ith) The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked regarding the case of a lost sheep. He said, "You should take it, because it is for you, or for your brother, or for the wolf." Then he was asked about a lost camel. He got angry and his face became red and he said (to the questioner), "You have nothing to do with it; it has its feet and its water container with it; it can go on drinking water and eating trees till its owner meets it." And then the Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about a Luqata (money found by somebody). He said, "Remember and recognize its tying material and its container, and make public announcement about it for one year. If somebody comes and identifies it (then give it to him), otherwise add it to your property
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ طَافَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى بَعِيرِهِ، وَكَانَ كُلَّمَا أَتَى عَلَى الرُّكْنِ أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ، وَكَبَّرَ‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ فُتِحَ مِنْ رَدْمِ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مِثْلُ هَذِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَعَقَدَ تِسْعِينَ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'abdu allaahi bnu muhamaadin, hadaathanaa aabuw 'aamirin 'abdu almaliki bnu 'amrinw, hadaathanaa iibraahiymu, 'an khaalidin, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abaaasin, qaala taafa rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa ba'iyrihi, wakaana kulaamaa aataa 'alaa alruukni aashaara iilayhi, wakabaara‏.‏ waqaalat zaynabu qaala alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ futiha min radmi yaajuwja wamaajuwja mithlu hadhihi ‏"‏‏.‏ wa'aqada tis'iyna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed the Tawaf (around the Ka`ba while riding his camel, and every time he reached the corner (of the Black Stone) he pointed at it with his hand and said, "Allahu Akbar." (Zainab said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "An opening has been made in the wall of Gog and Magog like this and this," forming the number 90 (with his thumb and index finger)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ فِي الْجُمُعَةِ سَاعَةٌ لاَ يُوَافِقُهَا مُسْلِمٌ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي، فَسَأَلَ اللَّهَ خَيْرًا، إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ، وَوَضَعَ أَنْمَلَتَهُ عَلَى بَطْنِ الْوُسْطَى وَالْخِنْصَرِ‏.‏ قُلْنَا يُزَهِّدُهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa bishru bnu almufaddali, haddathanaa salamaau bnu 'alqamaaa, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala aabuw alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ fiy aljumu'aai saa'aaun laa yuwaafiquhaa muslimun qaaiimun yusalliy, fasaaala alllaha khayrana, iilaaa aa'taahu ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala biyadihi, wawada'a aanmalatahu 'alaa batni alwustaa waalkhinsari‏.‏ qulnaa yuzahhiduhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: Abul Qasim (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) said, "There is an hour (or a moment) of particular significance on Friday. If it happens that a Muslim is offering a prayer and invoking Allah for some good at that very moment, Allah will grant him his request." (The sub-narrator placed the top of his finger on the palm of the other hand between the middle finger and the little one)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ الأُوَيْسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ عَدَا يَهُودِيٌّ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى جَارِيَةٍ، فَأَخَذَ أَوْضَاحًا كَانَتْ عَلَيْهَا وَرَضَخَ رَأْسَهَا، فَأَتَى بِهَا أَهْلُهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْىَ فِي آخِرِ رَمَقٍ، وَقَدْ أُصْمِتَتْ، فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ قَتَلَكِ فُلاَنٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ لِغَيْرِ الَّذِي قَتَلَهَا، فَأَشَارَتْ بِرَأْسِهَا أَنْ لاَ، قَالَ فَقَالَ لِرَجُلٍ آخَرَ غَيْرِ الَّذِي قَتَلَهَا، فَأَشَارَتْ أَنْ لاَ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ فَفُلاَنٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ لِقَاتِلِهَا فَأَشَارَتْ أَنْ نَعَمْ، فَأَمَرَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرُضِخَ رَأْسُهُ بَيْنَ حَجَرَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala alauwaysiyyu haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an shu'baaa bni alhajjaaji, 'an hishaami bni zaydin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala 'adaa yahuwdiyyun fiy 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa jaariyaain, faaakhadha aawdaahana kaanat 'alayhaa waradakha raasahaa, faaataa bihaa aahluhaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahaa fiy akhiri ramaqin, waqad ausmitat, faqaala lahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man qatalaki fulaanun ‏"‏‏.‏ lighayri alladhiy qatalahaa, faaashaarat biraasihaa aan laa, qaala faqaala lirajulin akhara ghayri alladhiy qatalahaa, faaashaarat aan laa, faqaala ‏"‏ fafulaanun ‏"‏‏.‏ liqaatilihaa faaashaarat aan na'am, faaamara bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm farudikha raasuhu bayna hajarayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik: During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a Jew attacked a girl and took some silver ornaments she was wearing and crushed her head. Her relative brought her to the Prophet (ﷺ) while she was in her last breaths, and she was unable to speak. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked her, "Who has hit you? so-and-so?", mentioning somebody other than her murderer. She moved her head, indicating denial. The Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned another person other than the murderer, and she again moved her head indicating denial. Then he asked, "Was it so-and-so?", mentioning the name of her killer. She nodded, agreeing. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ); ordered that the head of that Jew be crushed between two stones
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الْفِتْنَةُ مِنْ هَا هُنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَشَارَ إِلَى الْمَشْرِقِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alfitnaau min haa hunaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waaashaara iilaa almashriqi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Afflictions will emerge from here," pointing towards the East
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى، قَالَ كُنَّا فِي سَفَرٍ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ قَالَ لِرَجُلٍ ‏"‏ انْزِلْ فَاجْدَحْ لِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوْ أَمْسَيْتَ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ انْزِلْ فَاجْدَحْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوْ أَمْسَيْتَ إِنَّ عَلَيْكَ نَهَارًا‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ انْزِلْ فَاجْدَحْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَنَزَلَ فَجَدَحَ لَهُ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ، فَشَرِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ أَوْمَأَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى الْمَشْرِقِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا رَأَيْتُمُ اللَّيْلَ قَدْ أَقْبَلَ مِنْ هَا هُنَا فَقَدْ أَفْطَرَ الصَّائِمُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa jariyru bnu 'abdi alhamiydi, 'an aabiy iishaaqa alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy aawfaa, qaala kunnaa fiy safarin ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa gharabati alshhamsu qaala lirajulin ‏"‏ anzil faajdah liy ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi law aamsayta‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ anzil faajdah ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi law aamsayta iinna 'alayka nahaarana‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ anzil faajdah ‏"‏‏.‏ fanazala fajadaha lahu fiy althhaalithaai, fashariba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma aawmaaa biyadihi iilaa almashriqi faqaala ‏"‏ iidhaa raaaytumu alllayla qad aaqbala min haa hunaa faqad aaftara alssaaiimu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi A'ufa:We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on a journey, and when the sun set, he said to a man, "Get down and prepare a drink of Sawiq for me." The man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will you wait till it is evening?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) again said, "Get down and prepare a drink of Sawiq." The man said, "O Allah's Apostle! Will you wait till it is evening, for it is still daytime. " The Prophet (ﷺ) again said, "Get down and prepare a drink of Sawiq." So the third time the man got down and prepared a drink of sawiq for him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank thereof and pointed with his hand towards the East, saying, "When you see the night falling from this side, then a fasting person should break his fast
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَمْنَعَنَّ أَحَدًا مِنْكُمْ نِدَاءُ بِلاَلٍ ـ أَوْ قَالَ أَذَانُهُ ـ مِنْ سَحُورِهِ، فَإِنَّمَا يُنَادِي أَوْ قَالَ يُؤَذِّنُ لِيَرْجِعَ قَائِمُكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ أَنْ يَقُولَ كَأَنَّهُ يَعْنِي الصُّبْحَ أَوِ الْفَجْرَ، وَأَظْهَرَ يَزِيدُ يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ مَدَّ إِحْدَاهُمَا مِنَ الأُخْرَى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, 'an sulaymaana alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yamna'anna aahadana minkum nidaa'u bilaalin aaw qaala aadhaanuhu min sahuwrihi, faiinnamaa yunaadiy aaw qaala yuuadhhinu liyarji'a qaaiimukum ‏"‏‏.‏ walaysa aan yaquwla kaaannahu ya'niy alssubha aawi alfajra, waaazhara yaziydu yadayhi thumma madda iihdaahumaa mina alaukhraa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The call (or the Adhan) of Bilal should not stop you from taking the Suhur-meals for Bilal calls (or pronounces the Adhan) so that the one who is offering the night prayer should take a rest, and he does not indicate the daybreak or dawn." The narrator, Yazid, described (how dawn breaks) by stretching out his hands and then separating them wide apart
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَثَلُ الْبَخِيلِ وَالْمُنْفِقِ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا جُبَّتَانِ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ، مِنْ لَدُنْ ثَدْيَيْهِمَا إِلَى تَرَاقِيهِمَا، فَأَمَّا الْمُنْفِقُ فَلاَ يُنْفِقُ شَيْئًا إِلاَّ مَادَّتْ عَلَى جِلْدِهِ حَتَّى تُجِنَّ بَنَانَهُ وَتَعْفُوَ أَثَرَهُ، وَأَمَّا الْبَخِيلُ فَلاَ يُرِيدُ يُنْفِقُ إِلاَّ لَزِمَتْ كُلُّ حَلْقَةٍ مَوْضِعَهَا، فَهْوَ يُوسِعُهَا فَلاَ تَتَّسِعُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَيُشِيرُ بِإِصْبَعِهِ إِلَى حَلْقِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy ja'faru bnu rabiy'aaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni hurmuza, sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mathalu albakhiyli waalmunfiqi kamathali rajulayni 'alayhimaa jubbataani min hadiydin, min ladun thadyayhimaa iilaa taraaqiyhimaa, faaammaa almunfiqu falaa yunfiqu shayiana iilaaa maaddat 'alaa jildihi hattaa tujinna banaanahu wata'fuwa aatharahu, waaammaa albakhiylu falaa yuriydu yunfiqu iilaaa lazimat kullu halqaain mawdi'ahaa, fahwa yuwsi'uhaa falaa tattasi'u ‏"‏‏.‏ wayushiyru biiisba'ihi iilaa halqihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, The example of a miser and a generous person is like that of two persons wearing iron cloaks from the breast upto the neck When the generous person spends, the iron cloak enlarges and spread over his skin so much so that it covers his fingertips and obliterates his tracks. As for the miser, as soon as he thinks of spending every ring of the iron cloak sticks to its place (against his body) and he tries to expand it, but it does not expand. The Prophet (ﷺ) pointed with his hand towards his throat
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِخَيْرِ دُورِ الأَنْصَارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَنُو النَّجَّارِ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ بَنُو عَبْدِ الأَشْهَلِ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ بَنُو الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْخَزْرَجِ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ بَنُو سَاعِدَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ بِيَدِهِ، فَقَبَضَ أَصَابِعَهُ، ثُمَّ بَسَطَهُنَّ كَالرَّامِي بِيَدِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَفِي كُلِّ دُورِ الأَنْصَارِ خَيْرٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa laythun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin alaansaariyyi, aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aalaa aukhbirukum bikhayri duwri alaansaari ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa balaa yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ banuw alnnajjaari, thumma alladhiyna yaluwnahum banuw 'abdi alaashhali, thumma alladhiyna yaluwnahum banuw alhaarithi bni alkhazraji, thumma alladhiyna yaluwnahum banuw saa'idaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala biyadihi, faqabada aasaabi'ahu, thumma basatahunna kaalrraamiy biyadihi thumma qaala ‏"‏ wafiy kulli duwri alaansaari khayrun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Shall I tell you of the best families among the Ansar?" They (the people) said, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best are Banu- An-Najjar, and after them are Banu `Abdil Ash-hal, and after them are Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj, and after them are Banu Sa`ida." The Prophet (ﷺ) then moved his hand by closing his fingers and then opening them like one throwing something, and then said, "Anyhow, there is good in all the families of the Ansar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ أَبُو حَازِمٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ، سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ صَاحِبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ بُعِثْتُ أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةَ كَهَذِهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ أَوْ كَهَاتَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَرَنَ بَيْنَ السَّبَّابَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala aabuw haazimin sami'tuhu min, sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi saahibi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ bu'ithtu aanaa waalssaa'aaa kahadhihi min hadhihi aaw kahaatayni ‏"‏‏.‏ waqarana bayna alssabbaabaai waalwustaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:(a companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), holding out his middle and index fingers, said, "My advent and the Hour's are like this (or like these)," namely, the period between his era and the Hour is like the distance between those two fingers, i.e., very short
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَبَلَةُ بْنُ سُحَيْمٍ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الشَّهْرُ هَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ يَعْنِي ثَلاَثِينَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَهَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ يَعْنِي تِسْعًا وَعِشْرِينَ يَقُولُ، مَرَّةً ثَلاَثِينَ وَمَرَّةً تِسْعًا وَعِشْرِينَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa jabalaau bnu suhaymin, sami'tu abna 'umara, yaquwlu qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alshhahru hakadhaa wahakadhaa wahakadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ ya'niy thalaathiyna, thumma qaala ‏"‏ wahakadhaa wahakadhaa wahakadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ ya'niy tis'ana wa'ishriyna yaquwlu, marraaan thalaathiyna wamarraaan tis'ana wa'ishriyna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (holding out his ten fingers thrice), said, "The month is thus and thus and thus," namely thirty days. Then (holding out his ten fingers twice and then nine fingers), he said, "It may be thus and thus and thus," namely twenty nine days. He meant once thirty days and once twenty nine days
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ وَأَشَارَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ نَحْوَ الْيَمَنِ ‏ "‏ الإِيمَانُ هَا هُنَا ـ مَرَّتَيْنِ ـ أَلاَ وَإِنَّ الْقَسْوَةَ وَغِلَظَ الْقُلُوبِ فِي الْفَدَّادِينَ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ قَرْنَا الشَّيْطَانِ رَبِيعَةَ وَمُضَرَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an iismaa'iyla, 'an qaysin, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin, qaala waaashaara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadihi nahwa alyamani ‏ "‏ aliiymaanu haa hunaa marratayni aalaa waiinna alqaswaaa waghilaza alquluwbi fiy alfaddaadiyna haythu yatlu'u qarnaa alshhaytaani rabiy'aaa wamudara ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Masud:The Prophet (ﷺ) pointed with his hand towards Yemen and said twice, "Faith is there," and then pointed towards the East, and said, "Verily, sternness and mercilessness are the qualities of those who are busy with their camels and pay no attention to their religion, where the two sides of the head of Satan will appear," namely, the tribes of Rabl'a and Muqar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَنَا وَكَافِلُ الْيَتِيمِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ هَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَشَارَ بِالسَّبَّابَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى، وَفَرَّجَ بَيْنَهُمَا شَيْئًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu zuraaraaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sahlin, qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aanaa wakaafilu alyatiymi fiy aljannaai hakadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waaashaara bialssabbaabaai waalwustaa, wafarraja baynahumaa shayiana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I and the one who looks after an orphan will be like this in Paradise," showing his middle and index fingers and separating them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وُلِدَ لِي غُلاَمٌ أَسْوَدُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ لَكَ مِنْ إِبِلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَلْوَانُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ حُمْرٌ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ فِيهَا مِنْ أَوْرَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَنَّى ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لَعَلَّهُ نَزَعَهُ عِرْقٌ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلَعَلَّ ابْنَكَ هَذَا نَزَعَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu qaza'aaa, haddathanaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rajulaan, aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi wulida liy ghulaamun aaswadu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ hal laka min iibilin ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ maa aalwaanuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala humrun‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ hal fiyhaa min aawraqa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaannaa dhalika ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala la'allahu naza'ahu 'irqun‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fala'alla abnaka hadhaa naza'ahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! A black child has been born for me." The Prophet asked him, "Have you got camels?" The man said, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "What color are they?" The man replied, "Red." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Is there a grey one among them?' The man replied, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whence comes that?" He said, "May be it is because of heredity." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May be your latest son has this color because of heredity
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ قَذَفَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَأَحْلَفَهُمَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ فَرَّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iylu, haddathanaa juwayriyaau, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh aanna rajulaan mina alaansaari qadhafa amraaatahu faaahlafahumaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma farraqa baynahumaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:An Ansari man accused his wife (of committing illegal sexual intercourse). The Prophet (ﷺ) made both of them takes the oath of Lian, and separated them from each other (by divorce)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ هِلاَلَ بْنَ أُمَيَّةَ، قَذَفَ امْرَأَتَهُ، فَجَاءَ فَشَهِدَ وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمَا كَاذِبٌ، فَهَلْ مِنْكُمَا تَائِبٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَتْ فَشَهِدَتْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an hishaami bni hassaana, haddathanaa 'ikrimaau, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna hilaala bna aumayyaaa, qadhafa amraaatahu, fajaa'a fashahida waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha ya'lamu aanna aahadakumaa kaadhibun, fahal minkumaa taaiibun ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaamat fashahidat‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Hilal bin Umaiyya accused his wife of illegal sexual intercourse and came to the Prophet (ﷺ) to bear witness (against her), (taking the oath of Lian). The Prophet (ﷺ) was saying, "Allah knows that either of you is a liar. Will anyone of you repent (to Allah)?" Then the lady got up and gave her witness
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عُوَيْمِرًا الْعَجْلاَنِيَّ جَاءَ إِلَى عَاصِمِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ الأَنْصَارِيِّ فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا عَاصِمُ أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلاً وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً، أَيَقْتُلُهُ فَتَقْتُلُونَهُ، أَمْ كَيْفَ يَفْعَلُ سَلْ لِي يَا عَاصِمُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَسَأَلَ عَاصِمٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَكَرِهَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَسَائِلَ وَعَابَهَا، حَتَّى كَبُرَ عَلَى عَاصِمٍ مَا سَمِعَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ عَاصِمٌ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ جَاءَهُ عُوَيْمِرٌ فَقَالَ يَا عَاصِمُ مَاذَا قَالَ لَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ عَاصِمٌ لِعُوَيْمِرٍ لَمْ تَأْتِنِي بِخَيْرٍ، قَدْ كَرِهَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَسْأَلَةَ الَّتِي سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُوَيْمِرٌ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَنْتَهِي حَتَّى أَسْأَلَهُ عَنْهَا‏.‏ فَأَقْبَلَ عُوَيْمِرٌ حَتَّى جَاءَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَسَطَ النَّاسِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلاً وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً، أَيَقْتُلُهُ فَتَقْتُلُونَهُ أَمْ كَيْفَ يَفْعَلُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ قَدْ أُنْزِلَ فِيكَ وَفِي صَاحِبَتِكَ فَاذْهَبْ فَأْتِ بِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سَهْلٌ فَتَلاَعَنَا وَأَنَا مَعَ النَّاسِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا فَرَغَا مِنْ تَلاَعُنِهِمَا قَالَ عُوَيْمِرٌ كَذَبْتُ عَلَيْهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتُهَا‏.‏ فَطَلَّقَهَا ثَلاَثًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْمُرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَكَانَتْ سُنَّةَ الْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna sahla bna sa'din alssaa'idiyya, aakhbarahu aanna 'uwaymirana al'ajlaaniyya jaa'a iilaa 'aasimi bni 'adiyyin alaansaariyyi faqaala lahu yaa 'aasimu aaraaayta rajulaan wajada ma'a amraaatihi rajulaan, aayaqtuluhu fataqtuluwnahu, aam kayfa yaf'alu sal liy yaa 'aasimu 'an dhalika‏.‏ fasaaala 'aasimun rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an dhalika fakariha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almasaaiila wa'aabahaa, hattaa kabura 'alaa 'aasimin maa sami'a min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa raja'a 'aasimun iilaa aahlihi jaa'ahu 'uwaymirun faqaala yaa 'aasimu maadhaa qaala laka rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala 'aasimun li'uwaymirin lam taatiniy bikhayrin, qad kariha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almasaalaaa allatiy saaaltuhu 'anhaa‏.‏ faqaala 'uwaymirun waalllahi laa aantahiy hattaa aasaalahu 'anhaa‏.‏ faaaqbala 'uwaymirun hattaa jaa'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wasata alnnaasi faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aaraaayta rajulaan wajada ma'a amraaatihi rajulaan, aayaqtuluhu fataqtuluwnahu aam kayfa yaf'alu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ qad aunzila fiyka wafiy saahibatika faadhhab faati bihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala sahlun fatalaa'anaa waaanaa ma'a alnnaasi 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa faraghaa min talaa'unihimaa qaala 'uwaymirun kadhabtu 'alayhaa yaa rasuwla alllahi iin aamsaktuhaa‏.‏ fatallaqahaa thalaathana qabla aan yaamurahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin fakaanat sunnaaa almutalaa'inayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:'Uwaimir Al-Ajlani came to `Asim bin Ad Al-Ansari and said to him, "O `Asim! Suppose a man saw another man with his wife, would he kill him whereupon you would kill him; or what should he do? Please, O `Asim, ask about this on my behalf." `Asim asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), disliked that question and considered it disgraceful. What `Asim heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was hard on him. When `Asim returned to his family, 'Uwaimir came to him and said, "O `Asim! What did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). say to you?" `Asim said to 'Uwaimir, "You never bring me any good. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disliked the problem which I asked him about." 'Uwaimir said, "By Allah, I will not give up this matter until I ask the Prophet (ﷺ) about it." So 'Uwaimir proceeded till he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the midst of people, and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If a man sees another man with his wife, would he kill him, whereupon you would kill him, or what should he do?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah has revealed some decree as regards you and your wives case. Go and bring her." So they carried out the process of Lian while I was present among the people with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When they had finished their Lian, 'Uwaimir said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If I should now keep her with me as a wife, then I have told a lie." So he divorced her thrice before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered him. (Ibn Shihab said: So divorce was the tradition for all those who were involved in a case of Lian)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ الْمُلاَعَنَةِ، وَعَنِ السُّنَّةِ، فِيهَا عَنْ حَدِيثِ، سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ أَخِي بَنِي سَاعِدَةَ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ جَاءَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلاً وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً، أَيَقْتُلُهُ أَمْ كَيْفَ يَفْعَلُ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِي شَأْنِهِ مَا ذَكَرَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ أَمْرِ الْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قَدْ قَضَى اللَّهُ فِيكَ وَفِي امْرَأَتِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَلاَعَنَا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَأَنَا شَاهِدٌ، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَا قَالَ كَذَبْتُ عَلَيْهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتُهَا‏.‏ فَطَلَّقَهَا ثَلاَثًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْمُرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ فَرَغَا مِنَ التَّلاَعُنِ، فَفَارَقَهَا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ذَاكَ تَفْرِيقٌ بَيْنَ كُلِّ مُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَكَانَتِ السُّنَّةُ بَعْدَهُمَا أَنْ يُفَرَّقَ بَيْنَ الْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ، وَكَانَتْ حَامِلاً، وَكَانَ ابْنُهَا يُدْعَى لأُمِّهِ، قَالَ ثُمَّ جَرَتِ السُّنَّةُ فِي مِيرَاثِهَا أَنَّهَا تَرِثُهُ وَيَرِثُ مِنْهَا مَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنْ جَاءَتْ بِهِ أَحْمَرَ قَصِيرًا كَأَنَّهُ وَحَرَةٌ، فَلاَ أُرَاهَا إِلاَّ قَدْ صَدَقَتْ وَكَذَبَ عَلَيْهَا، وَإِنْ جَاءَتْ بِهِ أَسْوَدَ أَعْيَنَ ذَا أَلْيَتَيْنِ، فَلاَ أُرَاهُ إِلاَّ قَدْ صَدَقَ عَلَيْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَاءَتْ بِهِ عَلَى الْمَكْرُوهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu shihaabin, 'ani almulaa'anaai, wa'ani alssunnaai, fiyhaa 'an hadiythi, sahli bni sa'din aakhiy baniy saa'idaaa aanna rajulaan, mina alaansaari jaa'a iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aaraaayta rajulaan wajada ma'a amraaatihi rajulaan, aayaqtuluhu aam kayfa yaf'alu faaanzala alllahu fiy shaanihi maa dhakara fiy alqurani min aamri almutalaa'inayni, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ qad qadaa alllahu fiyka wafiy amraaatika ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fatalaa'anaa fiy almasjidi waaanaa shaahidun, falammaa faraghaa qaala kadhabtu 'alayhaa yaa rasuwla alllahi iin aamsaktuhaa‏.‏ fatallaqahaa thalaathana qabla aan yaamurahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna faraghaa mina alttalaa'uni, fafaaraqahaa 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ dhaaka tafriyqun bayna kulli mutalaa'inayni ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala abnu jurayjin qaala abnu shihaabin fakaanati alssunnaau ba'dahumaa aan yufarraqa bayna almutalaa'inayni, wakaanat haamilaan, wakaana abnuhaa yud'aa laummihi, qaala thumma jarati alssunnaau fiy miyraathihaa aannahaa tarithuhu wayarithu minhaa maa farada alllahu lahu‏.‏ qaala abnu jurayjin 'ani abni shihaabin 'an sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi fiy hadhaa alhadiythi iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iin jaa'at bihi aahmara qasiyrana kaaannahu waharaaun, falaa auraahaa iilaaa qad sadaqat wakadhaba 'alayhaa, waiin jaa'at bihi aaswada aa'yana dhaa aalyatayni, falaa auraahu iilaaa qad sadaqa 'alayhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ fajaa'at bihi 'alaa almakruwhi min dhalika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Juraij:Ibn Shihab informed me of Lian and the tradition related to it, referring to the narration of Sahl bin Sa`d, the brother of Bani Sa`idi He said, "An Ansari man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, 'O Allah's Apostle! If a man saw another man with his wife, should he kill him, or what should he do?' So Allah revealed concerning his affair what is mentioned in the Holy Qur'an about the affair of those involved in a case of Lian. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Allah has given His verdict regarding you and your wife.' So they carried out Lian in the mosque while I was present there. When they had finished, the man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If I should now keep her with me as a wife then I have told a lie about her. Then he divorced her thrice before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered him, when they had finished the Lian process. So he divorced her in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) ." Ibn Shihab added, "After their case, it became a tradition that a couple involved in a case of Lian should be separated by divorce. That lady was pregnant then, and later on her son was called by his mother's name. The tradition concerning their inheritance was that she would be his heir and he would inherit of her property the share Allah had prescribed for him." Ibn Shihab said that Sahl bin Sa`d As'Saidi said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said (in the above narration), "If that lady delivers a small red child like a lizard, then the lady has spoken the truth and the man was a liar, but if she delivers a child with black eyes and huge lips, then her husband has spoken the truth." Then she delivered it in the shape one would dislike (as it proved her guilty)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ ذُكِرَ التَّلاَعُنُ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ عَاصِمُ بْنُ عَدِيٍّ فِي ذَلِكَ قَوْلاً، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ، فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ يَشْكُو إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً، فَقَالَ عَاصِمٌ مَا ابْتُلِيتُ بِهَذَا إِلاَّ لِقَوْلِي، فَذَهَبَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ بِالَّذِي وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ امْرَأَتَهُ وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ مُصْفَرًّا قَلِيلَ اللَّحْمِ سَبْطَ الشَّعَرِ، وَكَانَ الَّذِي ادَّعَى عَلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ وَجَدَهُ عِنْدَ أَهْلِهِ خَدْلاً آدَمَ كَثِيرَ اللَّحْمِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ بَيِّنْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَاءَتْ شَبِيهًا بِالرَّجُلِ الَّذِي ذَكَرَ زَوْجُهَا أَنَّهُ وَجَدَهُ، فَلاَعَنَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَهُمَا‏.‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ هِيَ الَّتِي قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ رَجَمْتُ أَحَدًا بِغَيْرِ بَيِّنَةٍ رَجَمْتُ هَذِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ لاَ تِلْكَ امْرَأَةٌ كَانَتْ تُظْهِرُ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ السُّوءَ قَالَ أَبُو صَالِحٍ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ خَدِلاً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'ufayrin, qaala haddathaniy alllaythu, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aannahu dhukira alttalaa'unu 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala 'aasimu bnu 'adiyyin fiy dhalika qawlaan, thumma ansarafa, faaataahu rajulun min qawmihi yashkuw iilayhi aannahu wajada ma'a amraaatihi rajulaan, faqaala 'aasimun maa abtuliytu bihadhaa iilaaa liqawliy, fadhahaba bihi iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbarahu bialladhiy wajada 'alayhi amraaatahu wakaana dhalika alrrajulu musfarrana qaliyla alllahmi sabta alshha'ari, wakaana alladhiy adda'aa 'alayhi aannahu wajadahu 'inda aahlihi khadlaan adama kathiyra alllahmi faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alllahumma bayyin ‏"‏‏.‏ fajaa'at shabiyhana bialrrajuli alladhiy dhakara zawjuhaa aannahu wajadahu, falaa'ana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm baynahumaa‏.‏ qaala rajulun laibni 'abbaasin fiy almajlisi hiya allatiy qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ law rajamtu aahadana bighayri bayyinaain rajamtu hadhihi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala laa tilka amraaaaun kaanat tuzhiru fiy aliislaami alssuw'a qaala aabuw saalihin wa'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa khadilaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Qasim bin Muhammad:Ibn `Abbas; said, "Once Lian was mentioned before the Prophet (ﷺ) whereupon `Asim bin Adi said something and went away. Then a man from his tribe came to him, complaining that he had found a man with his wife. `Asim said, 'I have not been put to task except for my statement (about Lian).' `Asim took the man to the Prophet (ﷺ) and the man told him of the state in which he had found his wife. The man was pale, thin, and of lank hair, while the other man whom he claimed he had seen with his wife, was brown, fat and had much flesh on his calves. The Prophet (ﷺ) invoked, saying, 'O Allah! Reveal the truth.' So that lady delivered a child resembling the man whom her husband had mentioned he had found her with. The Prophet (ﷺ) then made them carry out Lian." Then a man from that gathering asked Ibn `Abbas, "Was she the same lady regarding which the Prophet (ﷺ) had said, 'If I were to stone to death someone without witness, I would have stoned this lady'?" Ibn `Abbas said, "No, that was another lady who, though being a Muslim, used to arouse suspicion by her outright misbehavior
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ رَجُلٌ قَذَفَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَقَالَ فَرَّقَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ أَخَوَىْ بَنِي الْعَجْلاَنِ، وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمَا كَاذِبٌ، فَهَلْ مِنْكُمَا تَائِبٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَبَيَا‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمَا كَاذِبٌ، فَهَلْ مِنْكُمَا تَائِبُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَبَيَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمَا كَاذِبٌ، فَهَلْ مِنْكُمَا تَائِبٌ ‏"‏ فَأَبَيَا فَفَرَّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا‏.‏ قَالَ أَيُّوبُ فَقَالَ لِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ إِنَّ فِي الْحَدِيثِ شَيْئًا لاَ أَرَاكَ تُحَدِّثُهُ قَالَ قَالَ الرَّجُلُ مَالِي قَالَ قِيلَ لاَ مَالَ لَكَ، إِنْ كُنْتَ صَادِقًا فَقَدْ دَخَلْتَ بِهَا، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ كَاذِبًا فَهْوَ أَبْعَدُ مِنْكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amruw bnu zuraaraaa, aakhbaranaa iismaa'iylu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala qultu laibni 'umara rajulun qadhafa amraaatahu faqaala farraqa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna aakhawaa baniy al'ajlaani, waqaala ‏"‏ alllahu ya'lamu aanna aahadakumaa kaadhibun, fahal minkumaa taaiibun ‏"‏‏.‏ faaabayaa‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ alllahu ya'lamu aanna aahadakumaa kaadhibun, fahal minkumaa taaiibu ‏"‏‏.‏ faaabayaa‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ alllahu ya'lamu aanna aahadakumaa kaadhibun, fahal minkumaa taaiibun ‏"‏ faaabayaa fafarraqa baynahumaa‏.‏ qaala aayyuwbu faqaala liy 'amruw bnu diynaarin iinna fiy alhadiythi shayiana laa aaraaka tuhaddithuhu qaala qaala alrrajulu maaliy qaala qiyla laa maala laka, iin kunta saadiqana faqad dakhalta bihaa, waiin kunta kaadhibana fahwa aab'adu minka‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I asked Ibn `Umar, "(What is the verdict if) a man accuses his wife of illegal sexual intercourse?" Ibn `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) separated (by divorce) the couple of Bani Al-Ajlan, and said, (to them), 'Allah knows that one of you two is a liar; so will one of you repent?' But both of them refused. He again said, 'Allah knows that one of you two is a liar; so will one of you repent?' But both of them refused. So he separated them by divorce." (Aiyub, a sub-narrator said: `Amr bin Dinar said to me, "There is something else in this Hadith which you have not mentioned. It goes thus: The man said, 'What about my money (i.e. the Mahr that I have given to my wife)?' It was said, 'You have no right to restore any money, for if you have spoken the truth (as regards the accusation), you have also consummated your marriage with her; and if you have told a lie, you are less rightful to have your money back
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ عَمْرٌو سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَنِ الْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ،، فَقَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ ‏"‏ حِسَابُكُمَا عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَدُكُمَا كَاذِبٌ، لاَ سَبِيلَ لَكَ عَلَيْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ مَالِي قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ مَالَ لَكَ، إِنْ كُنْتَ صَدَقْتَ عَلَيْهَا، فَهْوَ بِمَا اسْتَحْلَلْتَ مِنْ فَرْجِهَا، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ كَذَبْتَ عَلَيْهَا، فَذَاكَ أَبْعَدُ لَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ حَفِظْتُهُ مِنْ عَمْرٍو‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَيُّوبُ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ رَجُلٌ لاَعَنَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَقَالَ بِإِصْبَعَيْهِ ـ وَفَرَّقَ سُفْيَانُ بَيْنَ إِصْبَعَيْهِ السَّبَّابَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى ـ فَرَّقَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ أَخَوَىْ بَنِي الْعَجْلاَنِ، وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمَا كَاذِبٌ فَهَلْ مِنْكُمَا تَائِبٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ حَفِظْتُهُ مِنْ عَمْرٍو وَأَيُّوبَ كَمَا أَخْبَرْتُكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala 'amrunw sami'tu sa'iyda bna jubayrin, qaala saaaltu abna 'umara 'ani almutalaa'inayni, , faqaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm lilmutalaa'inayni ‏"‏ hisaabukumaa 'alaa alllahi aahadukumaa kaadhibun, laa sabiyla laka 'alayhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala maaliy qaala ‏"‏ laa maala laka, iin kunta sadaqta 'alayhaa, fahwa bimaa astahlalta min farjihaa, waiin kunta kadhabta 'alayhaa, fadhaaka aab'adu laka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu hafiztuhu min 'amrinw‏.‏ waqaala aayyuwbu sami'tu sa'iyda bna jubayrin qaala qultu laibni 'umara rajulun laa'ana amraaatahu faqaala biiisba'ayhi wafarraqa sufyaanu bayna iisba'ayhi alssabbaabaai waalwustaa farraqa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna aakhawaa baniy al'ajlaani, waqaala ‏"‏ alllahu ya'lamu iinna aahadakumaa kaadhibun fahal minkumaa taaiibun ‏"‏‏.‏ thalaatha marraatin‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu hafiztuhu min 'amrinw waaayyuwba kamaa aakhbartuka‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I asked Ibn `Umar about those who were involved in a case of Lien. He said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said to those who were involved in a case of Lien, 'Your accounts are with Allah. One of you two is a liar, and you (the husband) have no right over her (she is divorced)." The man said, 'What about my property (Mahr) ?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'You have no right to get back your property. If you have told the truth about her then your property was for the consummation of your marriage with her; and if you told a lie about her, then you are less rightful to get your property back.' " Sufyan, a sub-narrator said: I learned the Hadith from `Amr. Narrated Aiyub: I heard Sa`id bin Jubair saying, "I asked Ibn `Umar, 'If a man (accuses his wife for an illegal sexual intercourse and) carries out the process of Lian (what will happen)?' Ibn `Umar set two of his fingers apart. (Sufyan set his index finger and middle finger apart.) Ibn `Umar said, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) separated the couple of Bani Al-Ajlan by divorce and said thrice, "Allah knows that one of you two is a liar; so will one of you repent (to Allah)?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَّقَ بَيْنَ رَجُلٍ وَامْرَأَةٍ قَذَفَهَا، وَأَحْلَفَهُمَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa aanasu bnu 'iyaadin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm farraqa bayna rajulin waamraaaain qadhafahaa, waaahlafahumaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) separated (divorced) the wife from her husband who accused her for an illegal sexual intercourse, and made them take the oath of Lian
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ لاَعَنَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ رَجُلٍ وَامْرَأَةٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ، وَفَرَّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala laa'ana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna rajulin waamraaaain mina alaansaari, wafarraqa baynahumaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) made an Ansari man and his wife carry out Lian, and then separated them by divorce
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَعَنَ بَيْنَ رَجُلٍ وَامْرَأَتِهِ، فَانْتَفَى مِنْ وَلَدِهَا فَفَرَّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا، وَأَلْحَقَ الْوَلَدَ بِالْمَرْأَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa maalikun, qaala haddathaniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm laa'ana bayna rajulin waamraaatihi, faantafaa min waladihaa fafarraqa baynahumaa, waaalhaqa alwalada bialmaraaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) made a man and his wife carry out Lian, and the husband repudiated her child. So the Prophet got them separated (by divorce) and decided that the child belonged to the mother only
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ ذُكِرَ الْمُتَلاَعِنَانِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ عَاصِمُ بْنُ عَدِيٍّ فِي ذَلِكَ قَوْلاً، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ، فَذَكَرَ لَهُ أَنَّهُ وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً، فَقَالَ عَاصِمٌ مَا ابْتُلِيتُ بِهَذَا الأَمْرِ إِلاَّ لِقَوْلِي‏.‏ فَذَهَبَ بِهِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ بِالَّذِي وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ امْرَأَتَهُ، وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ مُصْفَرًّا قَلِيلَ اللَّحْمِ سَبْطَ الشَّعَرِ، وَكَانَ الَّذِي وَجَدَ عِنْدَ أَهْلِهِ آدَمَ خَدْلاً كَثِيرَ اللَّحْمِ جَعْدًا قَطَطًا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ بَيِّنْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَوَضَعَتْ شَبِيهًا بِالرَّجُلِ الَّذِي ذَكَرَ زَوْجُهَا أَنَّهُ وَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا، فَلاَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَهُمَا، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ هِيَ الَّتِي قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ رَجَمْتُ أَحَدًا بِغَيْرِ بَيِّنَةٍ لَرَجَمْتُ هَذِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ لاَ تِلْكَ امْرَأَةٌ كَانَتْ تُظْهِرُ السُّوءَ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu alqaasimi, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aannahu qaala dhukira almutalaa'inaani 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala 'aasimu bnu 'adiyyin fiy dhalika qawlaan, thumma ansarafa faaataahu rajulun min qawmihi, fadhakara lahu aannahu wajada ma'a amraaatihi rajulaan, faqaala 'aasimun maa abtuliytu bihadhaa alaamri iilaaa liqawliy‏.‏ fadhahaba bihi iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbarahu bialladhiy wajada 'alayhi amraaatahu, wakaana dhalika alrrajulu musfarrana qaliyla alllahmi sabta alshha'ari, wakaana alladhiy wajada 'inda aahlihi adama khadlaan kathiyra alllahmi ja'dana qatatana, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alllahumma bayyin ‏"‏‏.‏ fawada'at shabiyhana bialrrajuli alladhiy dhakara zawjuhaa aannahu wajada 'indahaa, falaa'ana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm baynahumaa, faqaala rajulun laibni 'abbaasin fiy almajlisi hiya allatiy qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ law rajamtu aahadana bighayri bayyinaain larajamtu hadhihi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala abnu 'abbaasin laa tilka amraaaaun kaanat tuzhiru alssuw'a fiy aliislaami‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Those involved in a case of Lian were mentioned before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) `Asim bin Adi said something about that and then left. Later on a man from his tribe came to him and told him that he had found another man with his wife. On that `Asim said, "I have not been put to task except for what I have said (about Lian)." `Asim took the man to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he told him of the state in which he found his wife. The man was pale, thin and lank-haired, while the other man whom he had found with his wife was brown, fat with thick calves and curly hair. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Reveal the truth." Then the lady delivered a child resembling the man whom her husband had mentioned he had found with her. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered them to carry out Lien. A man from that gathering said to Ibn `Abbas, "Was she the same lady regarding whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If I were to stone to death someone without witnesses, I would have stoned this lady'?" Ibn `Abbas said, "No, that was another lady who, though being a Muslim, used to arouse suspicion because of her outright misbehavior
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ رِفَاعَةَ، الْقُرَظِيَّ تَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةً، ثُمَّ طَلَّقَهَا فَتَزَوَّجَتْ آخَرَ فَأَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَتْ لَهُ أَنَّهُ لاَ يَأْتِيهَا، وَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ إِلاَّ مِثْلُ هُدْبَةٍ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ حَتَّى تَذُوقِي عُسَيْلَتَهُ، وَيَذُوقَ عُسَيْلَتَكِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna rifaa'aaa, alquraziyya tazawwaja amraaaaan, thumma tallaqahaa fatazawwajat akhara faaatati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakarat lahu aannahu laa yaatiyhaa, waiinnahu laysa ma'ahu iilaaa mithlu hudbaain faqaala ‏ "‏ laa hattaa tadhuwqiy 'usaylatahu, wayadhuwqa 'usaylataki ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Rifa`a Al-Qurazi married a lady and then divorced her whereupon she married another man. She came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said that her new husband did not approach her, and that he was completely impotent. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to her), "No (you cannot remarry your first husband) till you taste the second husband and he tastes you (i.e. till he consummates his marriage with you)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ الأَعْرَجِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ عَنْ أُمِّهَا أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنْ أَسْلَمَ يُقَالُ لَهَا سُبَيْعَةُ كَانَتْ تَحْتَ زَوْجِهَا، تُوُفِّيَ عَنْهَا وَهْىَ حُبْلَى، فَخَطَبَهَا أَبُو السَّنَابِلِ بْنُ بَعْكَكٍ، فَأَبَتْ أَنْ تَنْكِحَهُ، فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ مَا يَصْلُحُ أَنْ تَنْكِحِيهِ حَتَّى تَعْتَدِّي آخِرَ الأَجَلَيْنِ‏.‏ فَمَكُثَتْ قَرِيبًا مِنْ عَشْرِ لَيَالٍ ثُمَّ جَاءَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ انْكِحِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an ja'fari bni rabiy'aaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni hurmuza alaa'raji, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna zaynaba abnaaa aabiy salamaaa, aakhbarathu 'an aummihaa aummi salamaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna amraaaaan min aaslama yuqaalu lahaa subay'aau kaanat tahta zawjihaa, tuwuffiya 'anhaa wahaa hublaa, fakhatabahaa aabuw alssanaabili bnu ba'kakin, faaabat aan tankihahu, faqaala waalllahi maa yasluhu aan tankihiyhi hattaa ta'taddiy akhira alaajalayni‏.‏ famakuthat qariybana min 'ashri layaalin thumma jaa'ati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ ankihiy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Salama:(the wife of the Prophet) A lady from Bani Aslam, called Subai'a, become a widow while she was pregnant. Abu As-Sanabil bin Ba'kak demanded her hand in marriage, but she refused to marry him and said, "By Allah, I cannot marry him unless I have completed one of the two prescribed periods." About ten days later (after having delivered her child), she went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said (to her), "You can marry now
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ كَتَبَ إِلَى ابْنِ الأَرْقَمِ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ، سُبَيْعَةَ الأَسْلَمِيَّةَ كَيْفَ أَفْتَاهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ أَفْتَانِي إِذَا وَضَعْتُ أَنْ أَنْكِحَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, 'ani alllaythi, 'an yaziyda, aanna abna shihaabin, kataba iilayhi aanna 'ubayda alllahi bna 'abdi alllahi, aakhbarahu 'an aabiyhi, aannahu kataba iilaa abni alaarqami aan yasaala, subay'aaa alaaslamiyyaaa kayfa aaftaahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat aaftaaniy iidhaa wada'tu aan aankiha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abdullah:that his father had written to Ibn Al-Arqam a letter asking him to ask Subai'a Al-Aslamiya how the Prophet had given her the verdict. She said, "The Prophet, gave me his verdict that after I gave birth, I could marry
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، أَنَّ سُبَيْعَةَ الأَسْلَمِيَّةَ، نُفِسَتْ بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ زَوْجِهَا، بِلَيَالٍ فَجَاءَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَأْذَنَتْهُ أَنْ تَنْكِحَ، فَأَذِنَ لَهَا، فَنَكَحَتْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu qaza'aaa, haddathanaa maalikun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani almiswari bni makhramaaa, aanna subay'aaa alaaslamiyyaaa, nufisat ba'da wafaaai zawjihaa, bilayaalin fajaa'ati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faastaadhanathu aan tankiha, faaadhina lahaa, fanakahat‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Miswer bin Makhrama:Subai'a Al-Aslamiya gave birth to a child a few days after the death of her husband. She came to the Prophet and asked permission to remarry, and the Prophet (ﷺ) gave her permission, and she got married
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَذْكُرُ، أَنَّ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ، طَلَّقَ بِنْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، فَانْتَقَلَهَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، فَأَرْسَلَتْ عَائِشَةُ أُمُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِلَى مَرْوَانَ وَهْوَ أَمِيرُ الْمَدِينَةِ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَارْدُدْهَا إِلَى بَيْتِهَا‏.‏ قَالَ مَرْوَانُ فِي حَدِيثِ سُلَيْمَانَ إِنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ غَلَبَنِي‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ أَوَمَا بَلَغَكِ شَأْنُ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ قَالَتْ لاَ يَضُرُّكَ أَنْ لاَ تَذْكُرَ حَدِيثَ فَاطِمَةَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَرْوَانُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ إِنْ كَانَ بِكِ شَرٌّ فَحَسْبُكِ مَا بَيْنَ هَذَيْنِ مِنَ الشَّرِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, haddathanaa maalikun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, aannahu sami'ahu yadhkuru, aanna yahyaa bna sa'iydi bni al'aasi, tallaqa binta 'abdi alrrahmani bni alhakami, faantaqalahaa 'abdu alrrahmani, faaarsalat 'aaiishaau aummu almuuminiyna iilaa marwaana wahwa aamiyru almadiynaai attaqi alllaha waardudhaa iilaa baytihaa‏.‏ qaala marwaanu fiy hadiythi sulaymaana iinna 'abda alrrahmani bna alhakami ghalabaniy‏.‏ waqaala alqaasimu bnu muhammadin aawamaa balaghaki shaanu faatimaaa binti qaysin qaalat laa yadurruka aan laa tadhkura hadiytha faatimaaa‏.‏ faqaala marwaanu bnu alhakami iin kaana biki sharrun fahasbuki maa bayna hadhayni mina alshharri‏.‏
verses.translation: (Narrated Qasim bin Muhammad and Sulaiman bin Yasar:that Yahya bin Sa`id bin Al-`As divorced the daughter of `Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Hakarn. `Abdur- Rahman took her to his house. On that `Aisha sent a message to Marwan bin Al-Hakam who was the ruler of Medina, saying, "Fear Allah, and urge your brother) to return her to her house." Marwan (in Sulaiman's version) said, "Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Hakam did not obey me (or had a convincing argument)." (In Al-Qasim's versions Marwan said, "Have you not heard of the case of Fatima bint Qais?" Aisha said, "The case of Fatima bint Qais is not in your favor.' Marwan bin Al-Hakam said to `Aisha, "The reason that made Fatima bint Qais go to her father's house is just applicable to the daughter of `Abdur-Rahman)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ مَا لِفَاطِمَةَ أَلاَ تَتَّقِي اللَّهَ، يَعْنِي فِي قَوْلِهَا لاَ سُكْنَى وَلاَ نَفَقَةَ
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat maa lifaatimaaa aalaa tattaqiy alllaha, ya'niy fiy qawlihaa laa suknaa walaa nafaqaaa
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Qasim:Aisha said, "What is wrong with Fatima? Why doesn't she fear Allah?" by saying that a divorced lady is not entitled to be provided with residence and sustenance (by her husband)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ لِعَائِشَةَ أَلَمْ تَرَيْنَ إِلَى فُلاَنَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَكَمِ طَلَّقَهَا زَوْجُهَا الْبَتَّةَ فَخَرَجَتْ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ بِئْسَ مَا صَنَعَتْ‏.‏ قَالَ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعِي فِي قَوْلِ فَاطِمَةَ قَالَتْ أَمَا إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لَهَا خَيْرٌ فِي ذِكْرِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ‏.‏ وَزَادَ ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَابَتْ عَائِشَةُ أَشَدَّ الْعَيْبِ وَقَالَتْ إِنَّ فَاطِمَةَ كَانَتْ فِي مَكَانٍ وَحِشٍ فَخِيفَ عَلَى نَاحِيَتِهَا، فَلِذَلِكَ أَرْخَصَ لَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'amruw bnu 'abaaasin, hadaathanaa abnu mahdiyinn, hadaathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi alraahmani bni alqaasimi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala 'urwaau bnu alzuubayri li'aaiishaaa aalam tarayna iilaa fulaanaaa binti alhakami talaaqahaa zawjuhaa albataaaa fakharajat‏.‏ faqaalat biisa maa sana'at‏.‏ qaala aalam tasma'iy fiy qawli faatimaaa qaalat aamaa iinaahu laysa lahaa khayrun fiy dhikri hadhaa alhadiythi‏.‏ wazaada abnu aabiy alziinaadi 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'aabat 'aaiishaau aashadaa al'aybi waqaalat iinaa faatimaaa kaanat fiy makaanin wahishin fakhiyfa 'alaa naahiyatihaa, falidhalika aarkhasa lahaa alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qasim:Urwa said to Aisha, "Do you know so-and-so, the daughter of Al-Hakam? Her husband divorced her irrevocably and she left (her husband's house)." `Aisha said, "What a bad thing she has done!" 'Urwa said (to `Aisha), "Haven't you heard the statement of Fatima?" `Aisha replied, "It is not in her favor to mention." 'Urwa added, `Aisha reproached (Fatima) severely and said, "Fatima was in a lonely place, and she was prone to danger, so the Prophet (ﷺ) allowed her (to go out of her husband's house)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حِبَّانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، أَنْكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hibbaanu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, aanna 'aaiishaaa, aankarat dhalika 'alaa faatimaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Urwa:Aisha disapproved of what Fatima used to say
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ لَمَّا أَرَادَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَنْفِرَ إِذَا صَفِيَّةُ عَلَى باب خِبَائِهَا كَئِيبَةً، فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ عَقْرَى ـ أَوْ حَلْقَى ـ إِنَّكِ لَحَابِسَتُنَا أَكُنْتِ أَفَضْتِ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَانْفِرِي إِذًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat lammaa aaraada rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yanfira iidhaa safiyyaau 'alaa bab khibaaiihaa kaiiybaaan, faqaala lahaa ‏"‏ 'aqraa aaw halqaa iinnaki lahaabisatunaa aakunti aafadti yawma alnnahri ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faanfiriy iidhana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) decided to leave Mecca after the Hajj, he saw Safiyya, sad and standing at the entrance of her tent. He said to her, "Aqr (or) Halq! You will detain us. Did you perform Tawaf-al- Ifada on the day of Nahr? She said, "Yes." He said, "Then you can depart
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ زَوَّجَ مَعْقِلٌ أُخْتَهُ فَطَلَّقَهَا تَطْلِيقَةً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadun, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, haddathanaa yuwnusu, 'ani alhasani, qaala zawwaja ma'qilun aukhtahu fatallaqahaa tatliyqaaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Hasan:Ma'qil gave his sister in marriage and later her husband divorced her once
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، أَنَّ مَعْقِلَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ، كَانَتْ أُخْتُهُ تَحْتَ رَجُلٍ فَطَلَّقَهَا، ثُمَّ خَلَّى عَنْهَا حَتَّى انْقَضَتْ عِدَّتُهَا، ثُمَّ خَطَبَهَا فَحَمِيَ مَعْقِلٌ مِنَ ذَلِكَ أَنَفًا فَقَالَ خَلَّى عَنْهَا وَهْوَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَيْهَا، ثُمَّ يَخْطُبُهَا فَحَالَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهَا، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏وَإِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَبَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَلاَ تَعْضُلُوهُنَّ‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ، فَدَعَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَرَأَ عَلَيْهِ، فَتَرَكَ الْحَمِيَّةَ وَاسْتَقَادَ لأَمْرِ اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa alhasanu, aanna ma'qila bna yasaarin, kaanat aukhtuhu tahta rajulin fatallaqahaa, thumma khallaa 'anhaa hattaa anqadat 'iddatuhaa, thumma khatabahaa fahamiya ma'qilun mina dhalika aanafana faqaala khallaa 'anhaa wahwa yaqdiru 'alayhaa, thumma yakhtubuhaa fahaala baynahu wabaynahaa, faaanzala alllahu ‏{‏waiidhaa tallaqtumu alnnisaa'a fabalaghna aajalahunna falaa ta'duluwhunna‏}‏ iilaa akhiri alayaai, fada'aahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaraaa 'alayhi, fataraka alhamiyyaaa waastaqaada laamri alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Hasan:The sister of Ma'qil bin Yasar was married to a man and then that man divorced her and remained away from her till her period of the 'Iddah expired. Then he demanded for her hand in marriage, but Ma'qil got angry out of pride and haughtiness and said, "He kept away from her when he could still retain her, and now he demands her hand again?" So Ma'qil disagreed to remarry her to him. Then Allah revealed: 'When you have divorced women and they have fulfilled the term of their prescribed period, do not prevent them from marrying their (former) husbands.' (2.232) So the Prophet (ﷺ) sent for Ma'qil and recited to him (Allah's order) and consequently Ma'qil gave up his pride and haughtiness and yielded to Allah's order
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَةً لَهُ وَهْىَ حَائِضٌ تَطْلِيقَةً وَاحِدَةً، فَأَمَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُرَاجِعَهَا، ثُمَّ يُمْسِكَهَا حَتَّى تَطْهُرَ، ثُمَّ تَحِيضَ عِنْدَهُ حَيْضَةً أُخْرَى، ثُمَّ يُمْهِلَهَا حَتَّى تَطْهُرَ مِنْ حَيْضِهَا، فَإِنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُطَلِّقَهَا فَلْيُطَلِّقْهَا حِينَ تَطْهُرُ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يُجَامِعَهَا، فَتِلْكَ الْعِدَّةُ الَّتِي أَمَرَ اللَّهُ أَنْ تُطَلَّقَ لَهَا النِّسَاءُ‏.‏ وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ إِذَا سُئِلَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ قَالَ لأَحَدِهِمْ إِنْ كُنْتَ طَلَّقْتَهَا ثَلاَثًا فَقَدْ حَرُمَتْ عَلَيْكَ، حَتَّى تَنْكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِيهِ غَيْرُهُ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ لَوْ طَلَّقْتَ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ، فَإِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَنِي بِهَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara bni alkhattaabi rda allh 'nhma tallaqa amraaaaan lahu wahaa haaiidun tatliyqaaan waahidaaan, faaamarahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yuraaji'ahaa, thumma yumsikahaa hattaa tathura, thumma tahiyda 'indahu haydaaan aukhraa, thumma yumhilahaa hattaa tathura min haydihaa, faiin aaraada aan yutalliqahaa falyutalliqhaa hiyna tathuru min qabli aan yujaami'ahaa, fatilka al'iddaau allatiy aamara alllahu aan tutallaqa lahaa alnnisaa'u‏.‏ wakaana 'abdu alllahi iidhaa suiila 'an dhalika qaala laahadihim iin kunta tallaqtahaa thalaathana faqad harumat 'alayka, hattaa tankiha zawjana ghayrahu‏.‏ wazaada fiyhi ghayruhu 'ani alllaythi haddathaniy naafi'un qaala abnu 'umara law tallaqta marraaan aaw marratayni, faiinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aamaraniy bihadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar bin Al-Khattab divorced his wife during her menses. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered him to take her back till she became clean, and when she got another period while she was with him, she should wait till she became clean again and only then, if he wanted to divorce her, he could do so before having sexual relations with her. And that is the period Allah has fixed for divorcing women. Whenever `Abdullah (bin `Umar) was asked about that, he would say to the questioner, "If you divorced her thrice, she is no longer lawful for you unless she marries another man (and the other man divorces her in his turn).' Ibn `Umar further said, 'Would that you (people) only give one or two divorces, because the Prophet (ﷺ) has ordered me so
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِيرِينَ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ طَلَّقَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهْىَ حَائِضٌ، فَسَأَلَ عُمَرُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُرَاجِعَهَا، ثُمَّ يُطَلِّقَ مِنْ قُبُلِ عِدَّتِهَا، قُلْتُ فَتَعْتَدُّ بِتِلْكَ التَّطْلِيقَةِ قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ عَجَزَ وَاسْتَحْمَقَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaajun, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu siyriyna, haddathaniy yuwnusu bnu jubayrin, saaaltu abna 'umara faqaala tallaqa abnu 'umara amraaatahu wahaa haaiidun, fasaaala 'umaru alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faaamarahu aan yuraaji'ahaa, thumma yutalliqa min qubuli 'iddatihaa, qultu fata'taddu bitilka alttatliyqaai qaala aaraaayta iin 'ajaza waastahmaqa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Yunus Ibn Jubair:Ibn `Umar divorced his wife while she was having her menses. `Umar asked the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "Order him (your son) to take her back, and then divorced her before her period of the 'Iddah has elapsed." I asked Ibn `Umar, "Will that divorce (during the menses) be counted?" He replied, "If somebody behaves foolishly (will his foolishness be an excuse for his misbehavior)?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ هَذِهِ الأَحَادِيثَ الثَّلاَثَةَ، قَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ تُوُفِّيَ أَبُوهَا أَبُو سُفْيَانَ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، فَدَعَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ بِطِيبٍ فِيهِ صُفْرَةٌ خَلُوقٌ أَوْ غَيْرُهُ فَدَهَنَتْ مِنْهُ جَارِيَةً، ثُمَّ مَسَّتْ بِعَارِضَيْهَا، ثُمَّ قَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ مَا لِي بِالطِّيبِ مِنْ حَاجَةٍ، غَيْرَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ أَنْ تُحِدَّ عَلَى مَيِّتٍ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثِ لَيَالٍ، إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجٍ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakri bni muhammadi bni 'amriw bni hazmin, 'an humaydi bni naafi'in, 'an zaynaba abnaai aabiy salamaaa, aannahaa aakhbarathu hadhihi alaahaadiytha althhalaathaaa, qaalat zaynabu dakhaltu 'alaa aummi habiybaaa zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna tuwuffiya aabuwhaa aabuw sufyaana bnu harbin, fada'at aummu habiybaaa bitiybin fiyhi sufraaun khaluwqun aaw ghayruhu fadahanat minhu jaariyaaan, thumma massat bi'aaridayhaa, thumma qaalat waalllahi maa liy bialttiybi min haajaain, ghayra aanniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa yahillu laimraaaain tuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri aan tuhidda 'alaa mayyitin fawqa thalaathi layaalin, iilaaa 'alaa zawjin aarba'aaa aashhurin wa'ashrana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Humaid bin Nafi`:Zainab bint Abu Salama told me these three narrations: Zainab said: I went to Um Habiba, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) when her father, Abu- Sufyan bin Herb had died. Um ,Habiba asked for a perfume which contained yellow scent (Khaluq) or some other scent, and she first perfumed one of the girls with it and then rubbed her cheeks with it and said, "By Allah, I am not in need of perfume, but I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'It is not lawful for a lady who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for a dead person for more than three days unless he is her husband for whom she should mourn for four months and ten days
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ جَحْشٍ حِينَ تُوُفِّيَ أَخُوهَا، فَدَعَتْ بِطِيبٍ فَمَسَّتْ مِنْهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَتْ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ مَا لِي بِالطِّيبِ مِنْ حَاجَةٍ غَيْرَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ أَنْ تُحِدَّ عَلَى مَيِّتٍ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثِ لَيَالٍ إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجٍ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: qaalat zaynabu fadakhaltu 'alaa zaynaba abnaai jahshin hiyna tuwuffiya aakhuwhaa, fada'at bitiybin famassat minhu, thumma qaalat aamaa waalllahi maa liy bialttiybi min haajaain ghayra aanniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu 'alaa alminbari ‏ "‏ laa yahillu laimraaaain tuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri aan tuhidda 'alaa mayyitin fawqa thalaathi layaalin iilaaa 'alaa zawjin aarba'aaa aashhurin wa'ashrana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Zainab further said:I want to Zainab bint Jahsh when her brother died. She asked for perfume and used some of it and said, "By Allah, I am not in need of perfume, but I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying on the pulpit, 'It is not lawful for a lady who believes in Allah and the last day to mourn for more than three days except for her husband for whom she should mourn for four months and ten days
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ وَسَمِعْتُ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ، تَقُولُ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ ابْنَتِي تُوُفِّيَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا وَقَدِ اشْتَكَتْ عَيْنَهَا أَفَتَكْحُلُهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏‏.‏ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا كُلَّ ذَلِكَ يَقُولُ لاَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا هِيَ أَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرٌ، وَقَدْ كَانَتْ إِحْدَاكُنَّ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ تَرْمِي بِالْبَعَرَةِ عَلَى رَأْسِ الْحَوْلِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: qaalat zaynabu wasami'tu aumma salamaaa, taquwlu jaa'ati amraaaaun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna abnatiy tuwuffiya 'anhaa zawjuhaa waqadi ashtakat 'aynahaa aafatakhuluhaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏‏.‏ marratayni aaw thalaathana kulla dhalika yaquwlu laa, thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnamaa hiya aarba'aau aashhurin wa'ashrun, waqad kaanat iihdaakunna fiy aljaahiliyyaai tarmiy bialba'araai 'alaa raasi alhawli ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Zainab further said:"I heard my mother, Um Salama saying that a woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The husband of my daughter has died and she is suffering from an eye disease, can she apply kohl to her eye?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "No," twice or thrice. (Every time she repeated her question) he said, "No." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) added, "It is just a matter of four months and ten days. In the Pre-Islamic Period of ignorance a widow among you should throw a globe of dung when one year has elapsed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ حُمَيْدٌ فَقُلْتُ لِزَيْنَبَ وَمَا تَرْمِي بِالْبَعَرَةِ عَلَى رَأْسِ الْحَوْلِ فَقَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ كَانَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ إِذَا تُوُفِّيَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا دَخَلَتْ حِفْشًا، وَلَبِسَتْ شَرَّ ثِيَابِهَا، وَلَمْ تَمَسَّ طِيبًا حَتَّى تَمُرَّ بِهَا سَنَةٌ، ثُمَّ تُؤْتَى بِدَابَّةٍ حِمَارٍ أَوْ شَاةٍ أَوْ طَائِرٍ فَتَفْتَضُّ بِهِ، فَقَلَّمَا تَفْتَضُّ بِشَىْءٍ إِلاَّ مَاتَ، ثُمَّ تَخْرُجُ فَتُعْطَى بَعَرَةً فَتَرْمِي، ثُمَّ تُرَاجِعُ بَعْدُ مَا شَاءَتْ مِنْ طِيبٍ أَوْ غَيْرِهِ‏.‏ سُئِلَ مَالِكٌ مَا تَفْتَضُّ بِهِ قَالَ تَمْسَحُ بِهِ جِلْدَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala humaydun faqultu lizaynaba wamaa tarmiy bialba'araai 'alaa raasi alhawli faqaalat zaynabu kaanati almaraaau iidhaa tuwuffiya 'anhaa zawjuhaa dakhalat hifshana, walabisat sharra thiyaabihaa, walam tamassa tiybana hattaa tamurra bihaa sanaaun, thumma tuutaa bidaabbaain himaarin aaw shaaain aaw taaiirin fataftaddu bihi, faqallamaa taftaddu bishaa'in iilaaa maata, thumma takhruju fatu'taa ba'araaan fatarmiy, thumma turaaji'u ba'du maa shaa'at min tiybin aaw ghayrihi‏.‏ suiila maalikun maa taftaddu bihi qaala tamsahu bihi jildahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: I (Humaid) said to Zainab, "What does 'throwing a globe of dung when one year had elapsed' mean?" Zainab said, "When a lady was bereaved of her husband, she would live in a wretched small room and put on the worst clothes she had and would not touch any scent till one year had elapsed. Then she would bring an animal, e.g. a donkey, a sheep or a bird and rub her body against it. The animal against which she would rub her body would scarcely survive. Only then she would come out of her room, whereupon she would be given a globe of dung which she would throw away and then she would use the scent she liked or the like
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
