verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:When the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the use of certain containers (that were used for preparing alcoholic drinks), somebody said to the Prophet (ﷺ) . "But not all the people can find skins." So he allowed them to use clay jars not covered with pitch
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ بِهَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa musadaadun, hadaathanaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, hadaathaniy sulaymaanu, 'an iibraahiyma altaaymiyii, 'ani alhaarithi bni suwaydin, 'an 'aliyinn rda allh 'nh nahaa alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alduubaaa'i waalmuzafaati‏.‏ hadaathanaa 'uthmaanu hadaathanaa jariyrun 'ani alaa'mashi bihadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the use of Ad-Dubba' and Al Muzaffat. A'mash also narrated this
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُثْمَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قُلْتُ لِلأَسْوَدِ هَلْ سَأَلْتَ عَائِشَةَ أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَمَّا يُكْرَهُ أَنْ يُنْتَبَذَ فِيهِ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ قُلْتُ يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَمَّا نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُنْتَبَذَ فِيهِ قَالَتْ نَهَانَا فِي ذَلِكَ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ أَنْ نَنْتَبِذَ فِي الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَمَا ذَكَرْتِ الْجَرَّ وَالْحَنْتَمَ قَالَ إِنَّمَا أُحَدِّثُكَ مَا سَمِعْتُ، أَفَأُحَدِّثُ مَا لَمْ أَسْمَعْ
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'uthmaanu, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, qultu lilaaswadi hal saaalta 'aaiishaaa aumma almuuminiyna 'ammaa yukrahu aan yuntabadha fiyhi faqaala na'am qultu yaa aumma almuuminiyna 'ammaa nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yuntabadha fiyhi qaalat nahaanaa fiy dhalika aahla albayti aan nantabidha fiy alddubbaa'i waalmuzaffati‏.‏ qultu aamaa dhakarti aljarra waalhantama qaala iinnamaa auhaddithuka maa sami'tu, aafaauhaddithu maa lam aasma'
verses.translation: Narrated Ibrahim:I asked Al-Aswad, "Did you ask `Aisha, Mother of the Believers, about the containers in which it is disliked to prepare (non-alcoholic) drinks?" He said, "Yes, I said to her, 'O Mother of the Believers! What containers did the Prophet (ﷺ) forbid to use for preparing (non-alcoholic) drinks?" She said, 'The Prophet forbade us, (his family), to prepare (non-alcoholic) drinks in Ad-Dubba and Al-Muzaffat.' I asked, 'Didn't you mention Al Jar and Al Hantam?' She said, 'I tell what I have heard; shall I tell you what I have not heard?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْجَرِّ الأَخْضَرِ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَنَشْرَبُ فِي الأَبْيَضِ قَالَ لاَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, haddathanaa alshhaybaaniyyu, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna aabiy aawfaa rda allh 'nhma qaala nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani aljarri alaakhdari‏.‏ qultu aanashrabu fiy alaabyadi qaala laa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ash-Shaibani:I heard `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the use of green jars." I said, "Shall we drink out of white jars?" He said, "No
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا أُسَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ، دَعَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِعُرْسِهِ، فَكَانَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ خَادِمَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَهْىَ الْعَرُوسُ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ مَا تَدْرُونَ مَا أَنْقَعْتُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْقَعْتُ لَهُ تَمَرَاتٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فِي تَوْرٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyyu, 'an aabiy haazimin, qaala sami'tu sahla bna sa'din, aanna aabaa ausaydin alssaa'idiyya, da'aa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm li'ursihi, fakaanati amraaatuhu khaadimahum yawmaiidhin wahaa al'aruwsu‏.‏ faqaalat maa tadruwna maa aanqa'tu lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanqa'tu lahu tamaraatin mina alllayli fiy tawrin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Abu Usaid As Sa`idi invited the Prophet (ﷺ) to his wedding banquet. At that time his wife was serving them and she was the bride. She said, ''Do you know what (kind of syrup) I soaked (made) for Allah's Apostle? I soaked some dates in water in a Tur (bowl) overnight
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الْجُوَيْرِيَةِ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ الْبَاذَقِ،‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَبَقَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْبَاذَقَ، فَمَا أَسْكَرَ فَهْوَ حَرَامٌ‏.‏ قَالَ الشَّرَابُ الْحَلاَلُ الطَّيِّبُ‏.‏ قَالَ لَيْسَ بَعْدَ الْحَلاَلِ الطَّيِّبِ إِلاَّ الْحَرَامُ الْخَبِيثُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy aljuwayriyaai, qaala saaaltu abna 'abbaasin 'ani albaadhaqi, ‏.‏ faqaala sabaqa muhammadun sla allh 'lyh wslm albaadhaqa, famaa aaskara fahwa haraamun‏.‏ qaala alshharaabu alhalaalu alttayyibu‏.‏ qaala laysa ba'da alhalaali alttayyibi iilaaa alharaamu alkhabiythu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Al-Juwairiyya:I asked Ibn `Abbas about Al-Badhaq. He said, "Muhammad prohibited alcoholic drinks before It was called Al-Badhaq (by saying), 'Any drink that intoxicates is unlawful.' I said, 'What about good lawful drinks?' He said,'Apart from what is lawful and good, all other things are unlawful and not good (unclean Al-Khabith)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحِبُّ الْحَلْوَاءَ وَالْعَسَلَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhibbu alhalwaa'a waal'asala‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to like sweet edible things and honey
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ إِنِّي لأَسْقِي أَبَا طَلْحَةَ وَأَبَا دُجَانَةَ وَسُهَيْلَ ابْنَ الْبَيْضَاءِ خَلِيطَ بُسْرٍ وَتَمْرٍ إِذْ حُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ، فَقَذَفْتُهَا وَأَنَا سَاقِيهِمْ وَأَصْغَرُهُمْ، وَإِنَّا نَعُدُّهَا يَوْمَئِذٍ الْخَمْرَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ سَمِعَ أَنَسًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimun, haddathanaa hishaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala iinniy laasqiy aabaa talhaaa waaabaa dujaanaaa wasuhayla abna albaydaa'i khaliyta busrin watamrin iidh hurrimati alkhamru, faqadhaftuhaa waaanaa saaqiyhim waaasgharuhum, waiinnaa na'udduhaa yawmaiidhin alkhamra‏.‏ waqaala 'amruw bnu alhaarithi haddathanaa qataadaau sami'a aanasana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:While I was serving Abu Talha. Abu Dujana and Abu Suhail bin Al-Baida' with a drink made from a mixture of unripe and ripe dates, alcoholic drinks, were made unlawful, whereupon I threw it away, and I was their butler and the youngest of them, and we used to consider that drink as an alcoholic drink in those days
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الزَّبِيبِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَالرُّطَبِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, aannahu sami'a jaabirana rda allh 'nh yaquwlu nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alzzabiybi waalttamri waalbusri waalrrutabi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the drinking of alcoholic drinks prepared from raisins, dates, unripe dates and fresh ripe dates
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُجْمَعَ بَيْنَ التَّمْرِ وَالزَّهْوِ، وَالتَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ، وَلْيُنْبَذْ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا عَلَى حِدَةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimun, haddathanaa hishaamun, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu aabiy kathiyrin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yujma'a bayna alttamri waalzzahwi, waalttamri waalzzabiybi, walyunbadh kullu waahidin minhumaa 'alaa hidaain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Qatada:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the mixing of ripe and unripe dates and also the mixing of dates and raisins (for preparing a syrup) but the syrup of each kind of fruit should be prepared separately. ( One may have such drinks as long as it is fresh)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةَ أُسْرِيَ بِهِ بِقَدَحِ لَبَنٍ وَقَدَحِ خَمْرٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laylaaa ausriya bihi biqadahi labanin waqadahi khamrin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was presented a bowl of milk and a bowl of wine on the night he was taken on a journey (Al-Mi'raj)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، سَمِعَ سُفْيَانَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَالِمٌ أَبُو النَّضْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُمَيْرًا، مَوْلَى أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ، قَالَتْ شَكَّ النَّاسُ فِي صِيَامِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ، فَأَرْسَلْتُ إِلَيْهِ بِإِنَاءٍ فِيهِ لَبَنٌ فَشَرِبَ‏.‏ فَكَانَ سُفْيَانُ رُبَّمَا قَالَ شَكَّ النَّاسُ فِي صِيَامِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ فَأَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِ أُمُّ الْفَضْلِ‏.‏ فَإِذَا وُقِفَ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ هُوَ عَنْ أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhumaydiyyu, sami'a sufyaana, aakhbaranaa saalimun aabuw alnnadri, aannahu sami'a 'umayrana, mawlaa aummi alfadli yuhaddithu 'an aummi alfadli, qaalat shakka alnnaasu fiy siyaami rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma 'arafaaa, faaarsaltu iilayhi biiinaa'in fiyhi labanun fashariba‏.‏ fakaana sufyaanu rubbamaa qaala shakka alnnaasu fiy siyaami rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma 'arafaaa faaarsalat iilayhi aummu alfadli‏.‏ faiidhaa wuqifa 'alayhi qaala huwa 'an aummi alfadli‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Al-Fadl:The people doubted whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was fasting or the Day of `Arafat or not. So I sent a cup containing milk to him and he drank it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، وَأَبِي، سُفْيَانَ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْداللَّهِ، قَالَ جَاءَ أَبُو حُمَيْدٍ بِقَدَحٍ مِنْ لَبَنٍ مِنَ النَّقِيعِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَلاَّ خَمَّرْتَهُ وَلَوْ أَنْ تَعْرُضَ عَلَيْهِ عُودًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa qutaybaau, hadaathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, waaabiy, sufyaana 'an jaabiri bni 'abdallaahi, qaala jaa'a aabuw humaydin biqadahin min labanin mina alnaaqiy'i, faqaala lahu rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aalaaa khamaartahu walaw aan ta'ruda 'alayhi 'uwdana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Abu Humaid brought a cup of mix from a place called Al-Naqi. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him, "Will you not cover it, even by placing a stick across its
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا صَالِحٍ، يَذْكُرُ ـ أُرَاهُ ـ عَنْ جَابِرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ جَاءَ أَبُو حُمَيْدٍ ـ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ ـ مِنَ النَّقِيعِ بِإِنَاءٍ مِنْ لَبَنٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَلاَّ خَمَّرْتَهُ، وَلَوْ أَنْ تَعْرُضَ عَلَيْهِ عُودًا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سُفْيَانَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, qaala sami'tu aabaa saalihin, yadhkuru auraahu 'an jaabirin rda allh 'nh qaala jaa'a aabuw humaydin rajulun mina alaansaari mina alnnaqiy'i biiinaa'in min labanin iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aalaaa khammartahu, walaw aan ta'ruda 'alayhi 'uwdana ‏"‏‏.‏ wahaddathaniy aabuw sufyaana 'an jaabirin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:Abu Humaid, an Ansari man, came from AnNaqi carrying a cup of milk to the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Will you not cover it even by placing a stick across it?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مَحْمُودٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ مَكَّةَ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ مَعَهُ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مَرَرْنَا بِرَاعٍ وَقَدْ عَطِشَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَحَلَبْتُ كُثْبَةً مِنْ لَبَنٍ فِي قَدَحٍ، فَشَرِبَ حَتَّى رَضِيتُ، وَأَتَانَا سُرَاقَةُ بْنُ جُعْشُمٍ عَلَى فَرَسٍ فَدَعَا عَلَيْهِ، فَطَلَبَ إِلَيْهِ سُرَاقَةُ أَنْ لاَ يَدْعُوَ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَنْ يَرْجِعَ فَفَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy mahmuwdun, aakhbaranaa alnnadru, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a rda allh 'nh qaala qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm min makkaaa waaabuw bakrin ma'ahu qaala aabuw bakrin mararnaa biraa'in waqad 'atisha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh fahalabtu kuthbaaan min labanin fiy qadahin, fashariba hattaa radiytu, waaataanaa suraaqaau bnu ju'shumin 'alaa farasin fada'aa 'alayhi, fatalaba iilayhi suraaqaau aan laa yad'uwa 'alayhi, waaan yarji'a fafa'ala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) came from Mecca with Abu Bakr. Abu Bakr said "We passed by a shepherd and at that time Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was thirsty. I milked a little milk in a bowl and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank till I was pleased. Suraqa bin Ju'shum came to us riding a horse (chasing us). The Prophet (ﷺ) invoked evil upon him, whereupon Suraqa requested him not to invoke evil upon him, in which case he would go back. The Prophet (ﷺ) agreed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ نِعْمَ الصَّدَقَةُ اللِّقْحَةُ الصَّفِيُّ مِنْحَةً، وَالشَّاةُ الصَّفِيُّ مِنْحَةً، تَغْدُو بِإِنَاءٍ، وَتَرُوحُ بِآخَرَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ ni'ma alssadaqaau allliqhaau alssafiyyu minhaaan, waalshhaaau alssafiyyu minhaaan, taghduw biiinaa'in, wataruwhu biakhara ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The best object of charity is a she-camel which has (newly) given birth and gives plenty of milk, or a she-goat which gives plenty of milk; and is given to somebody to utilize its milk by milking one bowl in the morning and one in the evening
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَرِبَ لَبَنًا فَمَضْمَضَ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ لَهُ دَسَمًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shariba labanana famadmada waqaala ‏ "‏ iinna lahu dasamana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank milk and then rinsed his mouth and said, "It contains fat
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ رُفِعْتُ إِلَى السِّدْرَةِ فَإِذَا أَرْبَعَةُ أَنْهَارٍ، نَهَرَانِ ظَاهِرَانِ، وَنَهَرَانِ بَاطِنَانِ، فَأَمَّا الظَّاهِرَانِ النِّيلُ وَالْفُرَاتُ، وَأَمَّا الْبَاطِنَانِ فَنَهَرَانِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ فَأُتِيتُ بِثَلاَثَةِ أَقْدَاحٍ، قَدَحٌ فِيهِ لَبَنٌ، وَقَدَحٌ فِيهِ عَسَلٌ، وَقَدَحٌ فِيهِ خَمْرٌ، فَأَخَذْتُ الَّذِي فِيهِ اللَّبَنُ فَشَرِبْتُ فَقِيلَ لِي أَصَبْتَ الْفِطْرَةَ أَنْتَ وَأُمَّتُكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ هِشَامٌ وَسَعِيدٌ وَهَمَّامٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ صَعْصَعَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الأَنْهَارِ نَحْوَهُ، وَلَمْ يَذْكُرُوا ثَلاَثَةَ أَقْدَاحٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala iibraahiymu bnu tahmaana 'an shu'baaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ rufi'tu iilaa alssidraai faiidhaa aarba'aau aanhaarin, naharaani zaahiraani, wanaharaani baatinaani, faaammaa alzzaahiraani alnniylu waalfuraatu, waaammaa albaatinaani fanaharaani fiy aljannaai faautiytu bithalaathaai aaqdaahin, qadahun fiyhi labanun, waqadahun fiyhi 'asalun, waqadahun fiyhi khamrun, faaakhadhtu alladhiy fiyhi alllabanu fasharibtu faqiyla liy aasabta alfitraaa aanta waaummatuka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala hishaamun wasa'iydun wahammaamun 'an qataadaaa 'an aanasi bni maalikin 'an maaliki bni sa'sa'aaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alaanhaari nahwahu, walam yadhkuruwa thalaathaaa aaqdaahin‏.‏
verses.translation: The Prophet (ﷺ) added:I was raised to the Lote Tree and saw four rivers, two of which were coming out and two going in. Those which were coming out were the Nile and the Euphrates, and those which were going in were two rivers in paradise. Then I was given three bowls, one containing milk, and another containing honey, and a third containing wine. I took the bowl containing milk and drank it. It was said to me, "You and your followers will be on the right path (of Islam)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ كَانَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أَكْثَرَ أَنْصَارِيٍّ بِالْمَدِينَةِ مَالاً مِنْ نَخْلٍ، وَكَانَ أَحَبُّ مَالِهِ إِلَيْهِ بَيْرَحَاءَ، وَكَانَتْ مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْمَسْجِدِ، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْخُلُهَا وَيَشْرَبُ مِنْ مَاءٍ فِيهَا طَيِّبٍ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَلَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّى تُنْفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ‏}‏ قَامَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ ‏{‏لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّى تُنْفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ‏}‏ وَإِنَّ أَحَبَّ مَالِي إِلَىَّ بَيْرُحَاءَ، وَإِنَّهَا صَدَقَةٌ لِلَّهِ أَرْجُو بِرَّهَا وَذُخْرَهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ فَضَعْهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ حَيْثُ أَرَاكَ اللَّهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بَخٍ ذَلِكَ مَالٌ رَابِحٌ ـ أَوْ رَايِحٌ شَكَّ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ـ وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ مَا قُلْتَ وَإِنِّي أَرَى أَنْ تَجْعَلَهَا فِي الأَقْرَبِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أَفْعَلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَقَسَمَهَا أَبُو طَلْحَةَ فِي أَقَارِبِهِ وَفِي بَنِي عَمِّهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ وَيَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى رَايِحٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi, aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu kaana aabuw talhaaa aakthara aansaariyyin bialmadiynaai maalaan min nakhlin, wakaana aahabbu maalihi iilayhi bayrahaa'a, wakaanat mustaqbila almasjidi, wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadkhuluhaa wayashrabu min maa'in fiyhaa tayyibin‏.‏ qaala aanasun falammaa nazalat ‏{‏lan tanaaluwa albirra hattaa tunfiquwa mimmaa tuhibbuwna‏}‏ qaama aabuw talhaaa faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna alllaha yaquwlu ‏{‏lan tanaaluwa albirra hattaa tunfiquwa mimmaa tuhibbuwna‏}‏ waiinna aahabba maaliy iilaaaa bayruhaa'a, waiinnahaa sadaqaaun lillahi aarjuw birrahaa wadhukhrahaa 'inda alllahi fada'haa yaa rasuwla alllahi haythu aaraaka alllahu‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ bakhin dhalika maalun raabihun aaw raayihun shakka 'abdu alllahi waqad sami'tu maa qulta waiinniy aaraa aan taj'alahaa fiy alaaqrabiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aabuw talhaaa aaf'alu yaa rasuwla alllahi, faqasamahaa aabuw talhaaa fiy aaqaaribihi wafiy baniy 'ammihi‏.‏ waqaala iismaa'iylu wayahyaa bnu yahyaa raayihun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Talha had the largest number of datepalms from amongst the Ansars of Medina. The dearest of his property to him was Bairuha garden which was facing the (Prophet's) Mosque. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to enter it and drink of its good fresh water. When the Holy Verse:-- 'By no means shall you attain righteousness unless you spend (in charity) of that which you love.' (3.92) was revealed, Abu Talha got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allah says: By no means shall you attain righteousness unless you spend of that which you love,' and the dearest of my property to me is the Bairuha garden and I want to give it in charity in Allah's Cause, seeking to be rewarded by Allah for that. So you can spend it, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), where-ever Allah instructs you. ' Allah's Apostle said, "Good! That is a perishable (or profitable) wealth" (`Abdullah is in doubt as to which word was used.) He said, "I have heard what you have said but in my opinion you'd better give it to your kith and kin." On that Abu Talha said, "I will do so, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Abu Talha distributed that garden among his kith and kin and cousins
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ رَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَرِبَ لَبَنًا، وَأَتَى دَارَهُ فَحَلَبْتُ شَاةً فَشُبْتُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْبِئْرِ، فَتَنَاوَلَ الْقَدَحَ فَشَرِبَ، وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ أَعْرَابِيٌّ، فَأَعْطَى الأَعْرَابِيَّ فَضْلَهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الأَيْمَنَ فَالأَيْمَنَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aanasu bnu maalikin rda allh 'nh aannahu raaaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shariba labanana, waaataa daarahu fahalabtu shaaaan fashubtu lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina albiiri, fatanaawala alqadaha fashariba, wa'an yasaarihi aabuw bakrin wa'an yamiynihi aa'raabiyyun, faaa'taa alaa'raabiyya fadlahu, thumma qaala ‏ "‏ alaaymana faalaaymana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drinking milk. He came to my house and I milked a sheep and then mixed the milk with water from the well for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He took the bowl and drank while on his left there was sitting Abu Bakr, and on his right there was a bedouin. He then gave the remaining milk to the bedouin and said, "The right! The right (first)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ وَمَعَهُ صَاحِبٌ لَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنْ كَانَ عِنْدَكَ مَاءٌ بَاتَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةَ فِي شَنَّةٍ، وَإِلاَّ كَرَعْنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَالرَّجُلُ يُحَوِّلُ الْمَاءَ فِي حَائِطِهِ ـ قَالَ ـ فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عِنْدِي مَاءٌ بَائِتٌ فَانْطَلِقْ إِلَى الْعَرِيشِ ـ قَالَ ـ فَانْطَلَقَ بِهِمَا، فَسَكَبَ فِي قَدَحٍ، ثُمَّ حَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ دَاجِنٍ لَهُ ـ قَالَ ـ فَشَرِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ شَرِبَ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي جَاءَ مَعَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin, haddathanaa fulayhu bnu sulaymaana, 'an sa'iydi bni alhaarithi, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala 'alaa rajulin mina alaansaari wama'ahu saahibun lahu faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iin kaana 'indaka maa'un baata hadhihi alllaylaaa fiy shannaain, waiilaaa kara'naa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala waalrrajulu yuhawwilu almaa'a fiy haaiitihi qaala faqaala alrrajulu yaa rasuwla alllahi 'indiy maa'un baaiitun faantaliq iilaa al'ariyshi qaala faantalaqa bihimaa, fasakaba fiy qadahin, thumma halaba 'alayhi min daajinin lahu qaala fashariba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma shariba alrrajulu alladhiy jaa'a ma'ahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one of his companions entered upon an Ansari man and the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "If you have water kept overnight in a water skin, (give us), otherwise we will drink water by putting our mouth in it." The man was watering his garden then. He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have water kept overnight; let us go to the shade." So he took them both there and poured water into a bowl and milked a domestic goat of his in it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank, and then the man who had come along with him, drank
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعْجِبُهُ الْحَلْوَاءُ وَالْعَسَلُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, qaala aakhbaraniy hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yu'jibuhu alhalwaa'u waal'asalu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to like sweet edible things (syrup, etc.) and honey
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنِ النَّزَّالِ، قَالَ أَتَى عَلِيٌّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَلَى باب الرَّحَبَةِ، فَشَرِبَ قَائِمًا فَقَالَ إِنَّ نَاسًا يَكْرَهُ أَحَدُهُمْ أَنْ يَشْرَبَ وَهْوَ قَائِمٌ، وَإِنِّي رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَلَ كَمَا رَأَيْتُمُونِي فَعَلْتُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa mis'arun, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni maysaraaa, 'ani alnnazzaali, qaala aataa 'aliyyun rda allh 'nh 'alaa bab alrrahabaai, fashariba qaaiimana faqaala iinna naasana yakrahu aahaduhum aan yashraba wahwa qaaiimun, waiinniy raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fa'ala kamaa raaaytumuwniy fa'altu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated An-Nazzal:Ali came to the gate of the courtyard (of the Mosque) and drank (water) while he was standing and said, "Some people dislike to drink while standing, but I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) doing (drinking water) as you have seen me doing now
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، سَمِعْتُ النَّزَّالَ بْنَ سَبْرَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ ثُمَّ قَعَدَ فِي حَوَائِجِ النَّاسِ فِي رَحَبَةِ الْكُوفَةِ حَتَّى حَضَرَتْ صَلاَةُ الْعَصْرِ، ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِمَاءٍ فَشَرِبَ وَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ وَذَكَرَ رَأْسَهُ وَرِجْلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ قَامَ فَشَرِبَ فَضْلَهُ وَهْوَ قَائِمٌ ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنَّ نَاسًا يَكْرَهُونَ الشُّرْبَ قَائِمًا وَإِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَنَعَ مِثْلَ مَا صَنَعْتُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu maysaraaa, sami'tu alnnazzaala bna sabraaa, yuhaddithu 'an 'aliyyin rda allh 'nh aannahu sallaa alzzuhra thumma qa'ada fiy hawaaiiji alnnaasi fiy rahabaai alkuwfaai hattaa hadarat salaaau al'asri, thumma autiya bimaa'in fashariba waghasala wajhahu wayadayhi wadhakara raasahu warijlayhi, thumma qaama fashariba fadlahu wahwa qaaiimun thumma qaala iinna naasana yakrahuwna alshhurba qaaiimana waiinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sana'a mithla maa sana'tu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated An-Nazzal bin Sabra:`Ali offered the Zuhr prayer and then sat down in the wide courtyard (of the Mosque) of Kufa in order to deal with the affairs of the people till the `Asr prayer became due. Then water was brought to him and he drank of it, washed his face, hands, head and feet. Then he stood up and drank the remaining water while he was standing. and said, "Some people dislike to drink water while standing thought the Prophet did as I have just done
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ شَرِبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَائِمًا مِنْ زَمْزَمَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'aasimin alaahwali, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala shariba alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaiimana min zamzama‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) drank Zamzam (water) while standing
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النَّضْرِ، عَنْ عُمَيْرٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّهَا أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقَدَحِ لَبَنٍ، وَهُوَ وَاقِفٌ عَشِيَّةَ عَرَفَةَ، فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ فَشَرِبَهُ‏.‏ زَادَ مَالِكٌ عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ عَلَى بَعِيرِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa maaliku bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy salamaaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw alnnadri, 'an 'umayrin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin 'an aummi alfadli binti alhaarithi, aannahaa aarsalat iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm biqadahi labanin, wahuwa waaqifun 'ashiyyaaa 'arafaaa, faaakhadha biyadihi fasharibahu‏.‏ zaada maalikun 'an aabiy alnnadri 'alaa ba'iyrihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Al-Fadl:(daughter of Al-Harith) that she sent a bowl of milk to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was standing (at `Arafat) in the afternoon of the Day of `Arafat. He took it in his hands and drank it. Narrated Abu Nadr: The Prophet was on the back of his camel
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِلَبَنٍ قَدْ شِيبَ بِمَاءٍ، وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ أَعْرَابِيٌّ وَعَنْ شِمَالِهِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، فَشَرِبَ، ثُمَّ أَعْطَى الأَعْرَابِيَّ، وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ الأَيْمَنَ الأَيْمَنَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm autiya bilabanin qad shiyba bimaa'in, wa'an yamiynihi aa'raabiyyun wa'an shimaalihi aabuw bakrin, fashariba, thumma aa'taa alaa'raabiyya, waqaala ‏ "‏ alaaymana alaaymana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Milk mixed with water was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while a bedouin was on his right and Abu Bakr was on his left. He drank (of it) and then gave (it) to the bedouin and said, 'The right" "The right (first)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِشَرَابٍ فَشَرِبَ مِنْهُ، وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ غُلاَمٌ وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ الأَشْيَاخُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لِلْغُلاَمِ ‏ "‏ أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أُعْطِيَ هَؤُلاَءِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْغُلاَمُ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لاَ أُوثِرُ بِنَصِيبِي مِنْكَ أَحَدًا‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَلَّهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي يَدِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an aabiy haazimi bni diynaarin, 'an sahli bni sa'din rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm autiya bisharaabin fashariba minhu, wa'an yamiynihi ghulaamun wa'an yasaarihi alaashyaakhu‏.‏ faqaala lilghulaami ‏ "‏ aataadhanu liy aan au'tiya hauulaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala alghulaamu waalllahi yaa rasuwla alllahi laa auwthiru binasiybiy minka aahadana‏.‏ qaala fatallahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy yadihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was offered something to drink. He drank of it while on his right was a boy and on his left were some elderly people. He said to the boy, "May I give these (elderly) people first?" The boy said, "By Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I will not give up my share from you to somebody else." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) placed the cup in the hand of that boy
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ وَمَعَهُ صَاحِبٌ لَهُ، فَسَلَّمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصَاحِبُهُ، فَرَدَّ الرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي‏.‏ وَهْىَ سَاعَةٌ حَارَّةٌ، وَهْوَ يُحَوِّلُ فِي حَائِطٍ لَهُ ـ يَعْنِي الْمَاءَ ـ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنْ كَانَ عِنْدَكَ مَاءٌ بَاتَ فِي شَنَّةٍ وَإِلاَّ كَرَعْنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَالرَّجُلُ يُحَوِّلُ الْمَاءَ فِي حَائِطٍ فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عِنْدِي مَاءٌ بَاتَ فِي شَنَّةٍ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ إِلَى الْعَرِيشِ فَسَكَبَ فِي قَدَحٍ مَاءً، ثُمَّ حَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ دَاجِنٍ لَهُ، فَشَرِبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ أَعَادَ، فَشَرِبَ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي جَاءَ مَعَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu saalihin, haddathanaa fulayhu bnu sulaymaana, 'an sa'iydi bni alhaarithi, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala 'alaa rajulin mina alaansaari wama'ahu saahibun lahu, fasallama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wasaahibuhu, faradda alrrajulu faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi biaabiy aanta waaummiy‏.‏ wahaa saa'aaun haarraaun, wahwa yuhawwilu fiy haaiitin lahu ya'niy almaa'a faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iin kaana 'indaka maa'un baata fiy shannaain waiilaaa kara'naa ‏"‏‏.‏ waalrrajulu yuhawwilu almaa'a fiy haaiitin faqaala alrrajulu yaa rasuwla alllahi 'indiy maa'un baata fiy shannaain‏.‏ faantalaqa iilaa al'ariyshi fasakaba fiy qadahin maa'an, thumma halaba 'alayhi min daajinin lahu, fashariba alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma aa'aada, fashariba alrrajulu alladhiy jaa'a ma'ahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) and one of his companions entered upon an Ansari man. The Prophet (ﷺ) and his companion greeted (the man) and he replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you! It is hot," while he was watering his garden. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "If you have water kept overnight in a water skin, (give us), or else we will drink by putting our mouths in the basin." The man was watering the garden The man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have water kept overnight in a water-skin. He went to the shade and poured some water into a bowl and milked some milk from a domestic goat in it. The Prophet (ﷺ) drank and then gave the bowl to the man who had come along with him to drink
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنْتُ قَائِمًا عَلَى الْحَىِّ أَسْقِيهِمْ ـ عُمُومَتِي وَأَنَا أَصْغَرُهُمُ ـ الْفَضِيخَ، فَقِيلَ حُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَكْفِئْهَا‏.‏ فَكَفَأْنَا‏.‏ قُلْتُ لأَنَسٍ مَا شَرَابُهُمْ قَالَ رُطَبٌ وَبُسْرٌ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَنَسٍ وَكَانَتْ خَمْرَهُمْ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يُنْكِرْ أَنَسٌ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِي أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسًا يَقُولُ كَانَتْ خَمْرَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu aanasana rda allh 'nh qaala kuntu qaaiimana 'alaa alhaaai aasqiyhim 'umuwmatiy waaanaa aasgharuhumu alfadiykha, faqiyla hurrimati alkhamru‏.‏ faqaala aakfiihaa‏.‏ fakafaanaa‏.‏ qultu laanasin maa sharaabuhum qaala rutabun wabusrun‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakri bnu aanasin wakaanat khamrahum‏.‏ falam yunkir aanasun‏.‏ wahaddathaniy ba'du aashaabiy aannahu sami'a aanasana yaquwlu kaanat khamrahum yawmaiidhin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:I was waiting on my uncles, serving them with an alcoholic drink prepared from dates, and I was the youngest of them. (Suddenly) it was said that alcoholic drinks had been prohibited. So they said (to me), 'Throw it away." And I threw it away The sub-narrator said: I asked Anas what their drink was (made from), He replied, "(From) ripe dates and unripe dates
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا كَانَ جُنْحُ اللَّيْلِ ـ أَوْ أَمْسَيْتُمْ ـ فَكُفُّوا صِبْيَانَكُمْ، فَإِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ تَنْتَشِرُ حِينَئِذٍ، فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ سَاعَةٌ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَحُلُّوهُمْ، فَأَغْلِقُوا الأَبْوَابَ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ، فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لاَ يَفْتَحُ بَابًا مُغْلَقًا، وَأَوْكُوا قِرَبَكُمْ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ، وَخَمِّرُوا آنِيَتَكُمْ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ، وَلَوْ أَنْ تَعْرُضُوا عَلَيْهَا شَيْئًا وَأَطْفِئُوا، مَصَابِيحَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa kaana junhu alllayli aaw aamsaytum fakuffuwa sibyaanakum, faiinna alshhayaatiyna tantashiru hiynaiidhin, faiidhaa dhahaba saa'aaun mina alllayli fahulluwhum, faaaghliquwa alaabwaaba waadhkuruwa asma alllahi, faiinna alshhaytaana laa yaftahu baabana mughlaqana, waaawkuwa qirabakum waadhkuruwa asma alllahi, wakhammiruwa aniyatakum waadhkuruwa asma alllahi, walaw aan ta'ruduwa 'alayhaa shayiana waaatfiiuwa, masaabiyhakum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When night falls (or when it is evening), stop your children from going out, for the devils spread out at that time. But when an hour of the night has passed, release them and close the doors and mention Allah's Name, for Satan does not open a closed door. Tie the mouth of your waterskin and mention Allah's Name; cover your containers and utensils and mention Allah's Name. Cover them even by placing something across it, and extinguish your lamps
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَطْفِئُوا الْمَصَابِيحَ إِذَا رَقَدْتُمْ، وَغَلِّقُوا الأَبْوَابَ، وَأَوْكُوا الأَسْقِيَةَ، وَخَمِّرُوا الطَّعَامَ وَالشَّرَابَ ـ وَأَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ ـ وَلَوْ بِعُودٍ تَعْرُضُهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabirin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aatfiiuwa almasaabiyha iidhaa raqadtum, waghalliquwa alaabwaaba, waaawkuwa alaasqiyaaa, wakhammiruwa altta'aama waalshharaaba waaahsibuhu qaala walaw bi'uwdin ta'ruduhu 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Extinguish the lamps when you go to bed; close your doors; tie the mouths of your water skins, and cover the food and drinks." I think he added, ". . . even with a stick you place across the container
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ اخْتِنَاثِ الأَسْقِيَةِ‏.‏ يَعْنِي أَنْ تُكْسَرَ أَفْوَاهُهَا فَيُشْرَبَ مِنْهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani akhtinaathi alaasqiyaai‏.‏ ya'niy aan tuksara aafwaahuhaa fayushraba minhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the bending of the mouths of water skins for the sake of drinking from them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَى عَنِ اخْتِنَاثِ الأَسْقِيَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ أَوْ غَيْرُهُ هُوَ الشُّرْبُ مِنْ أَفْوَاهِهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi, aannahu sami'a aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yanhaa 'ani akhtinaathi alaasqiyaai‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi qaala ma'marun aaw ghayruhu huwa alshhurbu min aafwaahihaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding the drinking of water by bending the mouths of water skins, i.e., drinking from the mouths directly
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، قَالَ لَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِأَشْيَاءَ، قِصَارٍ حَدَّثَنَا بِهَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الشُّرْبِ مِنْ فَمِ الْقِرْبَةِ أَوِ السِّقَاءِ، وَأَنْ يَمْنَعَ جَارَهُ أَنْ يَغْرِزَ خَشَبَهُ فِي دَارِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, qaala lanaa 'ikrimaau aalaa aukhbirukum biaashyaa'a, qisaarin haddathanaa bihaa aabuw hurayraaa, nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alshhurbi min fami alqirbaai aawi alssiqaa'i, waaan yamna'a jaarahu aan yaghriza khashabahu fiy daarihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade drinking directly from the mouth of a water skin or other leather containers. and forbade preventing one's neighbor from fixing a peg in (the wall of) one's house
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُشْرَبَ مِنْ فِي السِّقَاءِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, aakhbaranaa aayyuwbu, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yushraba min fiy alssiqaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the drinking of water directly from the mouth of a water skin
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الشُّرْبِ مِنْ فِي السِّقَاءِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alshhurbi min fiy alssiqaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the drinking of water direct from the mouth of a water-skin
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا شَرِبَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلاَ يَتَنَفَّسْ فِي الإِنَاءِ، وَإِذَا بَالَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلاَ يَمْسَحْ ذَكَرَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ، وَإِذَا تَمَسَّحَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلاَ يَتَمَسَّحْ بِيَمِينِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an yahyaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa shariba aahadukum falaa yatanaffas fiy aliinaa'i, waiidhaa baala aahadukum falaa yamsah dhakarahu biyamiynihi, waiidhaa tamassaha aahadukum falaa yatamassah biyamiynihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Qatada:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When you drink (water), do not breath in the vessel; and when you urinate, do not touch your penis with your right hand. And when you cleanse yourself after defecation, do not use your right hand
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، وَأَبُو نُعَيْمٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَزْرَةُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ثُمَامَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ أَنَسٌ يَتَنَفَّسُ فِي الإِنَاءِ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا، وَزَعَمَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَتَنَفَّسُ ثَلاَثًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, waaabuw nu'aymin qaalaa haddathanaa 'azraau bnu thaabitin, qaala aakhbaraniy thumaamaau bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala kaana aanasun yatanaffasu fiy aliinaa'i marratayni aaw thalaathana, waza'ama aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yatanaffasu thalaathana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Thumama bin `Abdullah:Anas used to breathe twice or thrice in the vessel (while drinking) and used to say that the Prophet; used to take three breaths while drinking
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ كَانَ حُذَيْفَةُ بِالْمَدَايِنِ فَاسْتَسْقَى، فَأَتَاهُ دِهْقَانٌ بِقَدَحِ فِضَّةٍ، فَرَمَاهُ بِهِ فَقَالَ إِنِّي لَمْ أَرْمِهِ إِلاَّ أَنِّي نَهَيْتُهُ فَلَمْ يَنْتَهِ، وَإِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَانَا عَنِ الْحَرِيرِ وَالدِّيبَاجِ وَالشُّرْبِ فِي آنِيَةِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هُنَّ لَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَهْىَ لَكُمْ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'ani abni aabiy laylaa, qaala kaana hudhayfaau bialmadaayini faastasqaa, faaataahu dihqaanun biqadahi fiddaain, faramaahu bihi faqaala iinniy lam aarmihi iilaaa aanniy nahaytuhu falam yantahi, waiinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaanaa 'ani alhariyri waalddiybaaji waalshhurbi fiy aniyaai aldhhahabi waalfiddaai waqaala ‏ "‏ hunna lahum fiy alddunyaa wahaa lakum fiy alakhiraai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Abi Laila:While Hudhaita was at Mada'in, he asked for water. The chief of the village brought him a silver vessel. Hudhaifa threw it away and said, "I have thrown it away because I told him not to use it, but he has not stopped using it. The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us to wear clothes of silk or Dibaj, and to drink in gold or silver utensils, and said, 'These things are for them (unbelievers) in this world and for you (Muslims) in the Hereafter
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ حُذَيْفَةَ وَذَكَرَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَشْرَبُوا فِي آنِيَةِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ، وَلاَ تَلْبَسُوا الْحَرِيرَ وَالدِّيبَاجَ، فَإِنَّهَا لَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَلَكُمْ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'ani abni 'awnin, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni aabiy laylaa, qaala kharajnaa ma'a hudhayfaaa wadhakara alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tashrabuwa fiy aniyaai aldhhahabi waalfiddaai, walaa talbasuwa alhariyra waalddiybaaja, faiinnahaa lahum fiy alddunyaa walakum fiy alakhiraai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hudhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not drink in gold or silver utensils, and do not wear clothes of silk or Dibaj, for these things are for them (unbelievers) in this world and for you in the Hereafter
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الَّذِي يَشْرَبُ فِي إِنَاءِ الْفِضَّةِ إِنَّمَا يُجَرْجِرُ فِي بَطْنِهِ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maaliku bnu aanasin, 'an naafi'in, 'an zaydi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy bakrin alssiddiyqi, 'an aummi salamaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alladhiy yashrabu fiy iinaa'i alfiddaai iinnamaa yujarjiru fiy batnihi naara jahannama ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Salama:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "He who drinks in silver utensils is only filling his `Abdomen with Hell Fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنِ الأَشْعَثِ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ مُقَرِّنٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِسَبْعٍ، وَنَهَانَا عَنْ سَبْعٍ، أَمَرَنَا بِعِيَادَةِ الْمَرِيضِ، وَاتِّبَاعِ الْجِنَازَةِ، وَتَشْمِيتِ الْعَاطِسِ، وَإِجَابَةِ الدَّاعِي، وَإِفْشَاءِ السَّلاَمِ، وَنَصْرِ الْمَظْلُومِ وَإِبْرَارِ الْمُقْسِمِ، وَنَهَانَا عَنْ خَوَاتِيمِ الذَّهَبِ، وَعَنِ الشُّرْبِ فِي الْفِضَّةِ ـ أَوْ قَالَ آنِيَةِ الْفِضَّةِ ـ وَعَنِ الْمَيَاثِرِ وَالْقَسِّيِّ، وَعَنْ لُبْسِ الْحَرِيرِ وَالدِّيبَاجِ وَالإِسْتَبْرَقِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'ani alaash'athi bni sulaymin, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni suwaydi bni muqarrinin, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin, qaala aamaranaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bisab'in, wanahaanaa 'an sab'in, aamaranaa bi'iyaadaai almariydi, waattibaa'i aljinaazaai, watashmiyti al'aatisi, waiijaabaai alddaa'iy, waiifshaa'i alssalaami, wanasri almazluwmi waiibraari almuqsimi, wanahaanaa 'an khawaatiymi aldhhahabi, wa'ani alshhurbi fiy alfiddaai aaw qaala aniyaai alfiddaai wa'ani almayaathiri waalqassiyyi, wa'an lubsi alhariyri waalddiybaaji waaliistabraqi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered us to do seven things and forbade us from seven. He ordered us to visit the sick, to follow funeral processions, (to say) to a sneezer, (May Allah bestow His Mercy on you, if he says, Praise be to Allah), to accept invitations, to greet (everybody), to help the oppressed and to help others to fulfill their oaths. He forbade us to wear gold rings, to drink in silver (utensils), to use Mayathir (silken carpets placed on saddles), to wear Al-Qissi (a kind of silken cloth), to wear silk, Dibaj or Istabraq (two kinds of silk)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، عَنْ عُمَيْرٍ، مَوْلَى أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ عَنْ أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ، أَنَّهُمْ شَكُّوا فِي صَوْمِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ، فَبُعِثَ إِلَيْهِ بِقَدَحٍ مِنْ لَبَنٍ فَشَرِبَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amruw bnu 'abbaasin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an saalimin aabiy alnnadri, 'an 'umayrin, mawlaa aummi alfadli 'an aummi alfadli, aannahum shakkuwa fiy sawmi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma 'arafaaa, fabu'itha iilayhi biqadahin min labanin fasharibahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Al-Fadl:that the people were in doubt whether the Prophet (ﷺ) was fasting on the Day of `Arafat or not, so a (wooden) drinking vessel full of milk was sent to him, and he drank it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ ذُكِرَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ، فَأَمَرَ أَبَا أُسَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ أَنْ يُرْسِلَ إِلَيْهَا فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهَا، فَقَدِمَتْ فَنَزَلَتْ فِي أُجُمِ بَنِي سَاعِدَةَ، فَخَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى جَاءَهَا فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا فَإِذَا امْرَأَةٌ مُنَكِّسَةٌ رَأْسَهَا، فَلَمَّا كَلَّمَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ قَدْ أَعَذْتُكِ مِنِّي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا لَهَا أَتَدْرِينَ مَنْ هَذَا قَالَتْ لاَ‏.‏ قَالُوا هَذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَاءَ لِيَخْطُبَكِ‏.‏ قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَنَا أَشْقَى مِنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَأَقْبَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَئِذٍ حَتَّى جَلَسَ فِي سَقِيفَةِ بَنِي سَاعِدَةَ هُوَ وَأَصْحَابُهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اسْقِنَا يَا سَهْلُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَخَرَجْتُ لَهُمْ بِهَذَا الْقَدَحِ فَأَسْقَيْتُهُمْ فِيهِ، فَأَخْرَجَ لَنَا سَهْلٌ ذَلِكَ الْقَدَحَ فَشَرِبْنَا مِنْهُ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ اسْتَوْهَبَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَوَهَبَهُ لَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, haddathanaa aabuw ghassaana, qaala haddathaniy aabuw haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din rda allh 'nh qaala dhukira lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm amraaaaun mina al'arabi, faaamara aabaa ausaydin alssaa'idiyya aan yursila iilayhaa faaarsala iilayhaa, faqadimat fanazalat fiy aujumi baniy saa'idaaa, fakharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa jaa'ahaa fadakhala 'alayhaa faiidhaa amraaaaun munakkisaaun raasahaa, falammaa kallamahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat aa'uwdhu bialllahi minka‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ qad aa'adhtuki minniy ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaaluwa lahaa aatadriyna man hadhaa qaalat laa‏.‏ qaaluwa hadhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jaa'a liyakhtubaki‏.‏ qaalat kuntu aanaa aashqaa min dhalika‏.‏ faaaqbala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmaiidhin hattaa jalasa fiy saqiyfaai baniy saa'idaaa huwa waaashaabuhu, thumma qaala ‏"‏ asqinaa yaa sahlu ‏"‏‏.‏ fakharajtu lahum bihadhaa alqadahi faaasqaytuhum fiyhi, faaakhraja lanaa sahlun dhalika alqadaha fasharibnaa minhu‏.‏ qaala thumma astawhabahu 'umaru bnu 'abdi al'aziyzi ba'da dhalika fawahabahu lahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:An Arab lady was mentioned to the Prophet (ﷺ) so he asked Abu Usaid As-Sa`idi to send for her, and he sent for her and she came and stayed in the castle of Bani Sa`ida. The Prophet (ﷺ) came out and went to her and entered upon her. Behold, it was a lady sitting with a drooping head. When the Prophet (ﷺ) spoke to her, she said, "I seek refuge with Allah from you." He said, "I grant you refuge from me." They said to her, "Do you know who this is?" She said, "No." They said, "This is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who has come to command your hand in marriage." She said, "I am very unlucky to lose this chance." Then the Prophet and his companions went towards the shed of Bani Sa`ida and sat there. Then he said, "Give us water, O Sahl!" So I took out this drinking bowl and gave them water in it. The sub-narrator added: Sahl took out for us that very drinking bowl and we all drank from it. Later on `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz requested Sahl to give it to him as a present, and he gave it to him as a present
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُدْرِكٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ قَدَحَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، وَكَانَ قَدِ انْصَدَعَ فَسَلْسَلَهُ بِفِضَّةٍ قَالَ وَهْوَ قَدَحٌ جَيِّدٌ عَرِيضٌ مِنْ نُضَارٍ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسٌ لَقَدْ سَقَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي هَذَا الْقَدَحِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ كَذَا وَكَذَا‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ فِيهِ حَلْقَةٌ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ فَأَرَادَ أَنَسٌ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ مَكَانَهَا حَلْقَةً مِنْ ذَهَبٍ أَوْ فِضَّةٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ لاَ تُغَيِّرَنَّ شَيْئًا صَنَعَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَرَكَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu mudrikin, qaala haddathaniy yahyaa bnu hammaadin, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an 'aasimin alaahwali, qaala raaaytu qadaha alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'inda aanasi bni maalikin, wakaana qadi ansada'a fasalsalahu bifiddaain qaala wahwa qadahun jayyidun 'ariydun min nudaarin‏.‏ qaala qaala aanasun laqad saqaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hadhaa alqadahi aakthara min kadhaa wakadhaa‏.‏ qaala waqaala abnu siyriyna iinnahu kaana fiyhi halqaaun min hadiydin faaaraada aanasun aan yaj'ala makaanahaa halqaaan min dhahabin aaw fiddaain faqaala lahu aabuw talhaaa laa tughayyiranna shayiana sana'ahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fatarakahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Asim al-Ahwal:I saw the drinking bowl of the Prophet (ﷺ) with Anas bin Malik, and it had been broken, and he had mended it with silver plates. That drinking bowl was quite wide and made of Nadar wood, Anas said, "I gave water to the Prophet (ﷺ) in that bowl more than so-and-so (for a long period)." Ibn Seereen said: Around that bowl there was an iron ring, and Anas wanted to replace it with a silver or gold ring, but Abu Talha said to him, "Do not change a thing that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has made." So Anas left it as it was
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ قَالَ قَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ حَضَرَتِ الْعَصْرُ وَلَيْسَ مَعَنَا مَاءٌ غَيْرَ فَضْلَةٍ فَجُعِلَ فِي إِنَاءٍ، فَأُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهِ فَأَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِيهِ وَفَرَّجَ أَصَابِعَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ حَىَّ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْوُضُوءِ، الْبَرَكَةُ مِنَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ الْمَاءَ يَتَفَجَّرُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ، فَتَوَضَّأَ النَّاسُ وَشَرِبُوا، فَجَعَلْتُ لاَ آلُو مَا جَعَلْتُ فِي بَطْنِي مِنْهُ، فَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ بَرَكَةٌ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِجَابِرٍ كَمْ كُنْتُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ قَالَ أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعَمِائَةٍ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَمْرٌو عَنْ جَابِرٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ حُصَيْنٌ وَعَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةً‏.‏ وَتَابَعَهُ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, qaala haddathaniy saalimu bnu aabiy alja'di, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma hadhaa alhadiytha qaala qad raaaytuniy ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqad hadarati al'asru walaysa ma'anaa maa'un ghayra fadlaain faju'ila fiy iinaa'in, faautiya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bihi faaadkhala yadahu fiyhi wafarraja aasaabi'ahu thumma qaala ‏ "‏ haaaa 'alaa aahli alwuduw'i, albarakaau mina alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ falaqad raaaytu almaa'a yatafajjaru min bayni aasaabi'ihi, fatawaddaaa alnnaasu washaribuwa, faja'altu laa aluw maa ja'altu fiy batniy minhu, fa'alimtu aannahu barakaaun‏.‏ qultu lijaabirin kam kuntum yawmaiidhin qaala aalfana waaarba'amiaiaain‏.‏ taaba'ahu 'amrunw 'an jaabirin‏.‏ waqaala husaynun wa'amruw bnu murraaa 'an saalimin 'an jaabirin khamsa 'ashraaa miaiaaan‏.‏ wataaba'ahu sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi 'an jaabirin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) and the time for the `Asr prayer became due. We had no water with us except a little which was put in a vessel and was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) . He put his hand into it and spread out his fingers and then said, "Come along! Hurry up! All those who want to perform ablution. The blessing is from Allah.'' I saw the water gushing out from his fingers. So the people performed the ablution and drank, and I tried to drink more of that water (beyond my thirst and capacity), for I knew that it was a blessing. The sub-narrator said: I asked Jabir, "How many persons were you then?" He replied, "We were one-thousand four hundred men." Salim said: Jabir said
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ تُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا عَنْهُ، حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani alhakamu bnu naafi'in, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa min musiybaain tusiybu almuslima iilaaa kaffara alllahu bihaa 'anhu, hattaa alshhawkaai yushaakuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No calamity befalls a Muslim but that Allah expiates some of his sins because of it, even though it were the prick he receives from a thorn
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَلْحَلَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ هَمٍّ وَلاَ حُزْنٍ وَلاَ أَذًى وَلاَ غَمٍّ حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا، إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu 'amrinw, haddathanaa zuhayru bnu muhammadin, 'an muhammadi bni 'amriw bni halhalaaa, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, wa'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa yusiybu almuslima min nasabin walaa wasabin walaa hammin walaa huznin walaa aadhana walaa ghammin hattaa alshhawkaai yushaakuhaa, iilaaa kaffara alllahu bihaa min khataayaahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri and Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No fatigue, nor disease, nor sorrow, nor sadness, nor hurt, nor distress befalls a Muslim, even if it were the prick he receives from a thorn, but that Allah expiates some of his sins for that
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَالْخَامَةِ مِنَ الزَّرْعِ تُفَيِّئُهَا الرِّيحُ مَرَّةً، وَتَعْدِلُهَا مَرَّةً، وَمَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ كَالأَرْزَةِ لاَ تَزَالُ حَتَّى يَكُونَ انْجِعَافُهَا مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ زَكَرِيَّاءُ حَدَّثَنِي سَعْدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ كَعْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، كَعْبٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, 'an sa'din, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni ka'bin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mathalu almuumini kaalkhaamaai mina alzzar'i tufayyiiuhaa alrriyhu marraaan, wata'diluhaa marraaan, wamathalu almunaafiqi kaalaarzaai laa tazaalu hattaa yakuwna anji'aafuhaa marraaan waahidaaan ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala zakariyyaa'u haddathaniy sa'dun, haddathanaa abnu ka'bin, 'an aabiyhi, ka'bin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ka`b:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The example of a believer is that of a fresh tender plant, which the wind bends lt sometimes and some other time it makes it straight. And the example of a hypocrite is that of a pine tree which keeps straight till once it is uprooted suddenly
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُلَيْحٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، مِنْ بَنِي عَامِرِ بْنِ لُؤَىٍّ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَمَثَلِ الْخَامَةِ مِنَ الزَّرْعِ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَتَتْهَا الرِّيحُ كَفَأَتْهَا، فَإِذَا اعْتَدَلَتْ تَكَفَّأُ بِالْبَلاَءِ، وَالْفَاجِرُ كَالأَرْزَةِ صَمَّاءَ مُعْتَدِلَةً حَتَّى يَقْصِمَهَا اللَّهُ إِذَا شَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, qaala haddathaniy muhammadu bnu fulayhin, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an hilaali bni 'aliyyin, min baniy 'aamiri bni luuaaain 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mathalu almuumini kamathali alkhaamaai mina alzzar'i min haythu aatathaa alrriyhu kafaaathaa, faiidhaa a'tadalat takaffaau bialbalaa'i, waalfaajiru kaalaarzaai sammaa'a mu'tadilaaan hattaa yaqsimahaa alllahu iidhaa shaa'a ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The example of a believer is that of a fresh tender plant; from whatever direction the wind comes, it bends it, but when the wind becomes quiet, it becomes straight again. Similarly, a believer is afflicted with calamities (but he remains patient till Allah removes his difficulties.) And an impious wicked person is like a pine tree which keeps hard and straight till Allah cuts (breaks) it down when He wishes." (See Hadith No. 558, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ أَبَا الْحُبَابِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُصِبْ مِنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy sa'sa'aaa, aannahu qaala sami'tu sa'iyda bna yasaarin aabaa alhubaabi, yaquwlu sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man yuridi alllahu bihi khayrana yusib minhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If Allah wants to do good to somebody, He afflicts him with trials
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ،‏.‏ حَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ مَا رَأَيْتُ أَحَدًا أَشَدَّ عَلَيْهِ الْوَجَعُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, ‏.‏ haddathaniy bishru bnu muhammadin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat maa raaaytu aahadana aashadda 'alayhi alwaja'u min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:I never saw anybody suffering so much from sickness as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَرَضِهِ وَهْوَ يُوعَكُ وَعْكًا شَدِيدًا، وَقُلْتُ إِنَّكَ لَتُوعَكُ وَعْكًا شَدِيدًا‏.‏ قُلْتُ إِنَّ ذَاكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ أَجْرَيْنِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَجَلْ مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يُصِيبُهُ أَذًى، إِلاَّ حَاتَّ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ خَطَايَاهُ، كَمَا تَحَاتُّ وَرَقُ الشَّجَرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma alttaymiyyi, 'ani alhaarithi bni suwaydin, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh aataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy maradihi wahwa yuw'aku wa'kana shadiydana, waqultu iinnaka latuw'aku wa'kana shadiydana‏.‏ qultu iinna dhaaka biaanna laka aajrayni‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ aajal maa min muslimin yusiybuhu aadhana, iilaaa haatta alllahu 'anhu khataayaahu, kamaa tahaattu waraqu alshhajari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:I visited the Prophet (ﷺ) during his ailments and he was suffering from a high fever. I said, "You have a high fever. Is it because you will have a double reward for it?" He said, "Yes, for no Muslim is afflicted with any harm but that Allah will remove his sins as the leaves of a tree fall down
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ يُوعَكُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ تُوعَكُ وَعْكًا شَدِيدًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَجَلْ إِنِّي أُوعَكُ كَمَا يُوعَكُ رَجُلاَنِ مِنْكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ ذَلِكَ أَنَّ لَكَ أَجْرَيْنِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَجَلْ ذَلِكَ كَذَلِكَ، مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يُصِيبُهُ أَذًى شَوْكَةٌ فَمَا فَوْقَهَا، إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا سَيِّئَاتِهِ، كَمَا تَحُطُّ الشَّجَرَةُ وَرَقَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, 'an aabiy hamzaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma alttaymiyyi, 'ani alhaarithi bni suwaydin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala dakhaltu 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa yuw'aku faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaka tuw'aku wa'kana shadiydana‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aajal iinniy auw'aku kamaa yuw'aku rajulaani minkum ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu dhalika aanna laka aajrayni qaala ‏"‏ aajal dhalika kadhalika, maa min muslimin yusiybuhu aadhana shawkaaun famaa fawqahaa, iilaaa kaffara alllahu bihaa sayyiiaatihi, kamaa tahuttu alshhajaraau waraqahaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:I visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was suffering from a high fever. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You have a high fever." He said, "Yes, I have as much fever as two men of you." I said, "Is it because you will have a double reward?" He said, "Yes, it is so. No Muslim is afflicted with any harm, even if it were the prick of a thorn, but that Allah expiates his sins because of that, as a tree sheds its leaves
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَطْعِمُوا الْجَائِعَ، وَعُودُوا الْمَرِيضَ، وَفُكُّوا الْعَانِيَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aat'imuwa aljaaii'a, wa'uwduwa almariyda, wafukkuwa al'aaniya ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Muisa Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Feed the hungry, visit the sick, and set free the captives
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَشْعَثُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنَ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ مُقَرِّنٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِسَبْعٍ، وَنَهَانَا عَنْ سَبْعٍ، نَهَانَا عَنْ خَاتَمِ الذَّهَبِ، وَلُبْسِ الْحَرِيرِ، وَالدِّيبَاجِ، وَالإِسْتَبْرَقِ، وَعَنِ الْقَسِّيِّ، وَالْمِيثَرَةِ، وَأَمَرَنَا أَنْ نَتْبَعَ الْجَنَائِزَ، وَنَعُودَ الْمَرِيضَ، وَنُفْشِيَ السَّلاَمَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy aash'athu bnu sulaymin, qaala sami'tu mu'aawiyaaa bna suwaydi bni muqarrinin, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin rda allh 'nhma qaala aamaranaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bisab'in, wanahaanaa 'an sab'in, nahaanaa 'an khaatami aldhhahabi, walubsi alhariyri, waalddiybaaji, waaliistabraqi, wa'ani alqassiyyi, waalmiytharaai, waaamaranaa aan natba'a aljanaaiiza, wana'uwda almariyda, wanufshiya alssalaama‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered us to do seven things and forbade us to do seven other things. He forbade us to wear gold rings, silk, Dibaj, Istabriq, Qissy, and Maithara; and ordered us to accompany funeral processions, visit the sick and greet everybody. (See Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ مَرِضْتُ مَرَضًا، فَأَتَانِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُنِي وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَهُمَا مَاشِيَانِ، فَوَجَدَانِي أُغْمِيَ عَلَىَّ، فَتَوَضَّأَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ صَبَّ وَضُوءَهُ عَلَىَّ، فَأَفَقْتُ فَإِذَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ فِي مَالِي كَيْفَ أَقْضِي فِي مَالِي فَلَمْ يُجِبْنِي بِشَىْءٍ حَتَّى نَزَلَتْ آيَةُ الْمِيرَاثِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani abni almunkadiri, sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu maridtu maradana, faaataaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'uwduniy waaabuw bakrin wahumaa maashiyaani, fawajadaaniy aughmiya 'alaaaa, fatawaddaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma sabba waduw'ahu 'alaaaa, faaafaqtu faiidhaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa aasna'u fiy maaliy kayfa aaqdiy fiy maaliy falam yujibniy bishaa'in hattaa nazalat ayaau almiyraathi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Once I fell ill. The Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr came walking to pay me a visit and found me unconscious. The Prophet (ﷺ) performed ablution and then poured the remaining water on me, and I came to my senses to see the Prophet. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What shall I do with my property? How shall I dispose of (distribute) my property?" He did not reply till the Verse of inheritance was revealed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَلاَ أُرِيكَ امْرَأَةً مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ قُلْتُ بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ هَذِهِ الْمَرْأَةُ السَّوْدَاءُ أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي أُصْرَعُ، وَإِنِّي أَتَكَشَّفُ فَادْعُ اللَّهَ لِي‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ شِئْتِ صَبَرْتِ وَلَكِ الْجَنَّةُ وَإِنْ شِئْتِ دَعَوْتُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يُعَافِيَكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ أَصْبِرُ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي أَتَكَشَّفُ فَادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ لاَ أَتَكَشَّفَ، فَدَعَا لَهَا‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، أَنَّهُ رَأَى أُمَّ زُفَرَ تِلْكَ، امْرَأَةٌ طَوِيلَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ عَلَى سِتْرِ الْكَعْبَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'imraana aabiy bakrin, qaala haddathaniy 'ataa'u bnu aabiy rabaahin, qaala qaala liy abnu 'abbaasin aalaa auriyka amraaaaan min aahli aljannaai qultu balaa‏.‏ qaala hadhihi almaraaau alssawdaa'u aatati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat iinniy ausra'u, waiinniy aatakashhafu faad'u alllaha liy‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ iin shiiti sabarti walaki aljannaau waiin shiiti da'awtu alllaha aan yu'aafiyaki ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaalat aasbiru‏.‏ faqaalat iinniy aatakashhafu faad'u alllaha aan laa aatakashhafa, fada'aa lahaa‏.‏ haddathanaa muhammadun, aakhbaranaa makhladun, 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, aannahu raaaa aumma zufara tilka, amraaaaun tawiylaaun sawdaa'u 'alaa sitri alka'baai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ata bin Abi Rabah:Ibn `Abbas said to me, "Shall I show you a woman of the people of Paradise?" I said, "Yes." He said, "This black lady came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, 'I get attacks of epilepsy and my body becomes uncovered; please invoke Allah for me.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to her), 'If you wish, be patient and you will have (enter) Paradise; and if you wish, I will invoke Allah to cure you.' She said, 'I will remain patient,' and added, 'but I become uncovered, so please invoke Allah for me that I may not become uncovered.' So he invoked Allah for her." Narrated 'Ata: That he had seen Um Zafar, the tall black lady, at (holding) the curtain of the Ka`ba
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
