verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ الْهَادِ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، مَوْلَى الْمُطَّلِبِ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَالَ إِذَا ابْتَلَيْتُ عَبْدِي بِحَبِيبَتَيْهِ فَصَبَرَ عَوَّضْتُهُ مِنْهُمَا الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُرِيدُ عَيْنَيْهِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ أَشْعَثُ بْنُ جَابِرٍ وَأَبُو ظِلاَلٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy abnu alhaadi, 'an 'amrinw, mawlaa almuttalibi 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha qaala iidhaa abtalaytu 'abdiy bihabiybatayhi fasabara 'awwadtuhu minhumaa aljannaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ yuriydu 'aynayhi‏.‏ taaba'ahu aash'athu bnu jaabirin waaabuw zilaalin 'an aanasin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Allah said, 'If I deprive my slave of his two beloved things (i.e., his eyes) and he remains patient, I will let him enter Paradise in compensation for them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ لَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ وُعِكَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَبِلاَلٌ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَتْ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِمَا قُلْتُ يَا أَبَتِ كَيْفَ تَجِدُكَ وَيَا بِلاَلُ كَيْفَ تَجِدُكَ قَالَتْ وَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ إِذَا أَخَذَتْهُ الْحُمَّى يَقُولُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مُصَبَّحٌ فِي أَهْلِهِ وَالْمَوْتُ أَدْنَى مِنْ شِرَاكِ نَعْلِهِ وَكَانَ بِلاَلٌ إِذَا أَقْلَعَتْ عَنْهُ يَقُولُ أَلاَ لَيْتَ شِعْرِي هَلْ أَبِيتَنَّ لَيْلَةً بَوَادٍ وَحَوْلِي إِذْخِرٌ وَجَلِيلُ وَهَلْ أَرِدَنْ يَوْمًا مِيَاهَ مِجَنَّةٍ وَهَلْ تَبْدُوَنْ لِي شَامَةٌ وَطَفِيلُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَجِئْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ كَحُبِّنَا مَكَّةَ أَوْ أَشَدَّ، اللَّهُمَّ وَصَحِّحْهَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مُدِّهَا وَصَاعِهَا، وَانْقُلْ حُمَّاهَا فَاجْعَلْهَا بِالْجُحْفَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, 'an maalikin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat lammaa qadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa wu'ika aabuw bakrin wabilaalun rda allh 'nhma qaalat fadakhaltu 'alayhimaa qultu yaa aabati kayfa tajiduka wayaa bilaalu kayfa tajiduka qaalat wakaana aabuw bakrin iidhaa aakhadhathu alhummaa yaquwlu kullu amriiin musabbahun fiy aahlihi waalmawtu aadnaa min shiraaki na'lihi wakaana bilaalun iidhaa aaqla'at 'anhu yaquwlu aalaa layta shi'riy hal aabiytanna laylaaan bawaadin wahawliy iidhkhirun wajaliylu wahal aaridan yawmana miyaaha mijannaain wahal tabduwan liy shaamaaun watafiylu qaalat 'aaiishaau fajiitu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbartuhu faqaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma habbib iilaynaa almadiynaaa kahubbinaa makkaaa aaw aashadda, alllahumma wasahhihhaa, wabaarik lanaa fiy muddihaa wasaa'ihaa, waanqul hummaahaa faaj'alhaa bialjuhfaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) emigrated to Medina, Abu Bakr and Bilal got a fever. I entered upon them and asked, "O my father! How are you? O Bilal! How are you?" Whenever fever attacked Abu Bakr, he would recite the following poetic verses: 'Everybody is staying alive among his people, yet death is nearer to him than his shoe laces." And whenever the fever deserted Bilal, he would recite (two poetic lines): 'Would that I could stay overnight in a valley wherein I would be surrounded by Idhkhir and Jalil (two kinds of good smelling grass). Would that one day I would drink of the water of Majinna and would that Shama and Tafil (two mountains at Mecca) would appear to me.' Then I came and informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about that, whereupon he said, "O Allah! Make us love Medina as much or more than we love Mecca. O Allah! Make it healthy and bless its Mudd and Sa for us, and take away its fever and put it in Al Juhfa
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَاصِمٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ ابْنَةً لِلنَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِ وَهْوَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَسَعْدٍ وَأُبَىٍّ نَحْسِبُ أَنَّ ابْنَتِي قَدْ حُضِرَتْ فَاشْهَدْنَا فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهَا السَّلاَمَ وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ وَمَا أَعْطَى وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ عِنْدَهُ مُسَمًّى فَلْتَحْتَسِبْ وَلْتَصْبِرْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَرْسَلَتْ تُقْسِمُ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقُمْنَا، فَرُفِعَ الصَّبِيُّ فِي حَجْرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَفْسُهُ تَقَعْقَعُ فَفَاضَتْ عَيْنَا النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لَهُ سَعْدٌ مَا هَذَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَذِهِ رَحْمَةٌ وَضَعَهَا اللَّهُ فِي قُلُوبِ مَنْ شَاءَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ، وَلاَ يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ إِلاَّ الرُّحَمَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy 'aasimun, qaala sami'tu aabaa 'uthmaana, 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin rda allh 'nhma aanna abnaaan lilnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm aarsalat iilayhi wahwa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wasa'din waaubaaain nahsibu aanna abnatiy qad hudirat faashhadnaa faaarsala iilayhaa alssalaama wayaquwlu ‏"‏ iinna lillahi maa aakhadha wamaa aa'taa wakullu shaa'in 'indahu musammana faltahtasib waltasbir ‏"‏‏.‏ faaarsalat tuqsimu 'alayhi, faqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waqumnaa, farufi'a alssabiyyu fiy hajri alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wanafsuhu taqa'qa'u fafaadat 'aynaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala lahu sa'dun maa hadhaa yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ hadhihi rahmaaun wada'ahaa alllahu fiy quluwbi man shaa'a min 'ibaadihi, walaa yarhamu alllahu min 'ibaadihi iilaaa alrruhamaa'a ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu `Uthman:Usama bin Zaid said that while he. Sa`d and Ubai bin Ka`b were with the Prophet (ﷺ) a daughter of the Prophet sent a message to him, saying. 'My daughter is dying; please come to us." The Prophet (ﷺ) sent her his greetings and added "It is for Allah what He takes, and what He gives; and everything before His sight has a limited period. So she should hope for Allah's reward and remain patient." She again sent a message, beseeching him by Allah, to come. So the Prophet (ﷺ) got up. and so did we (and went there). The child was placed on his lap while his breath was irregular. Tears flowed from the eyes of the Prophet. Sa`d said to him, "What is this, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said. "This Is Mercy which Allah has embedded in the hearts of whomever He wished of His slaves. And Allah does not bestow His Mercy, except on the merciful among His slaves. (See Hadith No. 373 Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُخْتَارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَى أَعْرَابِيٍّ يَعُودُهُ ـ قَالَ ـ وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا دَخَلَ عَلَى مَرِيضٍ يَعُودُهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ ‏"‏ لاَ بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتَ طَهُورٌ، كَلاَّ بَلْ هِيَ حُمَّى تَفُورُ ـ أَوْ تَثُورُ ـ عَلَى شَيْخٍ كَبِيرٍ، تُزِيرُهُ الْقُبُورَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَنَعَمْ إِذًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu aasadin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu mukhtaarin, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala 'alaa aa'raabiyyin ya'uwduhu qaala wakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa dakhala 'alaa mariydin ya'uwduhu faqaala lahu ‏"‏ laa baasa tahuwrun iin shaa'a alllahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala qulta tahuwrun, kalaaa bal hiya hummaa tafuwru aaw tathuwru 'alaa shaykhin kabiyrin, tuziyruhu alqubuwra‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ fana'am iidhana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) went to visit a sick bedouin. Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went to a patient, he used to say to him, "Don't worry, if Allah will, it will be expiation (for your sins):" The bedouin said, "You say expiation? No, it is but a fever that is boiling or harassing an old man and will lead him to his grave without his will." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then, yes, it is so
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ غُلاَمًا، لِيَهُودَ كَانَ يَخْدُمُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَرِضَ‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَسْلِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَسْلَمَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، لَمَّا حُضِرَ أَبُو طَالِبٍ جَاءَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh aanna ghulaamana, liyahuwda kaana yakhdumu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm famarida‏.‏ faaataahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'uwduhu faqaala ‏ "‏ aaslim ‏"‏‏.‏ faaaslama‏.‏ waqaala sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi 'an aabiyhi, lammaa hudira aabuw taalibin jaa'ahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:A Jewish boy used to serve the Prophet (ﷺ) and became ill. The Prophet (ﷺ) went to pay him a visit and said to him, "Embrace Islam," and he did embrace Islam. Al-Musaiyab said: When Abu Talib was on his deathbed, the Prophet (ﷺ) visited him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ نَاسٌ يَعُودُونَهُ فِي مَرَضِهِ فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ جَالِسًا فَجَعَلُوا يُصَلُّونَ قِيَامًا، فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِمِ اجْلِسُوا، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الإِمَامَ لَيُؤْتَمُّ بِهِ، فَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَارْكَعُوا وَإِذَا رَفَعَ فَارْفَعُوا، وَإِنْ صَلَّى جَالِسًا فَصَلُّوا جُلُوسًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ مَنْسُوخٌ لأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم آخِرَ مَا صَلَّى صَلَّى قَاعِدًا وَالنَّاسُ خَلْفَهُ قِيَامٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, qaala aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala 'alayhi naasun ya'uwduwnahu fiy maradihi fasallaa bihim jaalisana faja'aluwa yusalluwna qiyaamana, faaashaara iilayhimi ajlisuwa, falammaa faragha qaala ‏ "‏ iinna aliimaama layuutammu bihi, faiidhaa raka'a faarka'uwa waiidhaa rafa'a faarfa'uwa, waiin sallaa jaalisana fasalluwa juluwsana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi qaala alhumaydiyyu hadhaa alhadiythu mansuwkhun laanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm akhira maa sallaa sallaa qaa'idana waalnnaasu khalfahu qiyaamun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:During the ailment of the Prophet (ﷺ) some people came to visits him. He led them in prayer while sitting. but they prayed standing, so he waved to them to sit down. When he had finished the prayer, he said, "An Imam is to be followed, so when he bows, you should bow. and when he raises his head, you should raise yours, and if he prays sitting. you should pray sitting." Abu `Abdullah said Al-Humaidi said, (The order of ) "This narration has been abrogated by the last action of the Prophet (ﷺ) as he led the prayer sitting, while the people prayed standing behind him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْجُعَيْدُ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ بِنْتِ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ أَبَاهَا، قَالَ تَشَكَّيْتُ بِمَكَّةَ شَكْوًا شَدِيدًا، فَجَاءَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُنِي، فَقُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَتْرُكُ مَالاً وَإِنِّي لَمْ أَتْرُكْ إِلاَّ ابْنَةً وَاحِدَةً، فَأُوصِي بِثُلُثَىْ مَالِي وَأَتْرُكُ الثُّلُثَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَأُوصِي بِالنِّصْفِ وَأَتْرُكُ النِّصْفَ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَأُوصِي بِالثُّلُثِ وَأَتْرُكُ لَهَا الثُّلُثَيْنِ قَالَ ‏"‏ الثُّلُثُ وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى جَبْهَتِهِ، ثُمَّ مَسَحَ يَدَهُ عَلَى وَجْهِي وَبَطْنِي ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اشْفِ سَعْدًا وَأَتْمِمْ لَهُ هِجْرَتَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَمَا زِلْتُ أَجِدُ بَرْدَهُ عَلَى كَبِدِي فِيمَا يُخَالُ إِلَىَّ حَتَّى السَّاعَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa almakkiyyu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa alju'aydu, 'an 'aaiishaaa binti sa'din, aanna aabaahaa, qaala tashakkaytu bimakkaaa shakwana shadiydana, fajaa'aniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'uwduniy, faqultu yaa nabiyya alllahi iinniy aatruku maalaan waiinniy lam aatruk iilaaa abnaaan waahidaaan, faauwsiy bithuluthaa maaliy waaatruku althhulutha faqaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu faauwsiy bialnnisfi waaatruku alnnisfa qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu faauwsiy bialthhuluthi waaatruku lahaa althhuluthayni qaala ‏"‏ althhuluthu waalthhuluthu kathiyrun ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma wada'a yadahu 'alaa jabhatihi, thumma masaha yadahu 'alaa wajhiy wabatniy thumma qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma ashfi sa'dana waaatmim lahu hijratahu ‏"‏‏.‏ famaa ziltu aajidu bardahu 'alaa kabidiy fiymaa yukhaalu iilaaaa hattaa alssaa'aai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d:I became seriously ill at Mecca and the Prophet (ﷺ) came to visit me. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I shall leave behind me a good fortune, but my heir is my only daughter; shall I bequeath two third of my property to be spent in charity and leave one third (for my heir)?" He said, "No." I said, "Shall I bequeath half and leave half?" He said, "No." I said, "Shall I bequeath one third and leave two thirds?" He said, "One third is alright, though even one third is too much." Then he placed his hand on his forehead and passed it over my face and `Abdomen and said, "O Allah! Cure Sa`d and complete his emigration." I feel as if I have been feeling the coldness of his hand on my liver ever since
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ يُوعَكُ فَمَسِسْتُهُ بِيَدِي فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ تُوعَكُ وَعْكًا شَدِيدًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَجَلْ إِنِّي أُوعَكُ كَمَا يُوعَكُ رَجُلاَنِ مِنْكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ ذَلِكَ أَنَّ لَكَ أَجْرَيْنِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَجَلْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يُصِيبُهُ أَذًى مَرَضٌ فَمَا سِوَاهُ إِلاَّ حَطَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ كَمَا تَحُطُّ الشَّجَرَةُ وَرَقَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma alttaymiyyi, 'ani alhaarithi bni suwaydin, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu mas'uwdin dakhaltu 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa yuw'aku famasistuhu biyadiy faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaka tuw'aku wa'kana shadiydana‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aajal iinniy auw'aku kamaa yuw'aku rajulaani minkum ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu dhalika aanna laka aajrayni‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aajal ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa min muslimin yusiybuhu aadhana maradun famaa siwaahu iilaaa hatta alllahu lahu sayyiiaatihi kamaa tahuttu alshhajaraau waraqahaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:I visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was suffering from a high fever. I touched him with my hand and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You have a high fever." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Yes, I have as much fever as two men of you have." I said, "Is it because you will get a double reward?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Yes, no Muslim is afflicted with harm because of sickness or some other inconvenience, but that Allah will remove his sins for him as a tree sheds its leaves
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَرَضِهِ فَمَسِسْتُهُ وَهْوَ يُوعَكُ وَعْكًا شَدِيدًا فَقُلْتُ إِنَّكَ لَتُوعَكُ وَعْكًا شَدِيدًا، وَذَلِكَ أَنَّ لَكَ أَجْرَيْنِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَجَلْ، وَمَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يُصِيبُهُ أَذًى إِلاَّ حَاتَّتْ عَنْهُ خَطَايَاهُ كَمَا تَحَاتُّ وَرَقُ الشَّجَرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma alttaymiyyi, 'ani alhaarithi bni suwaydin, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh qaala aataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy maradihi famasistuhu wahwa yuw'aku wa'kana shadiydana faqultu iinnaka latuw'aku wa'kana shadiydana, wadhalika aanna laka aajrayni‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ aajal, wamaa min muslimin yusiybuhu aadhana iilaaa haattat 'anhu khataayaahu kamaa tahaattu waraqu alshhajari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:I visited the Prophet (ﷺ) during his illness and touched him while he was having a fever. I said to him, "You have a high fever; is it because you will get a double reward?" He said, "Yes. No Muslim is afflicted with any harm, but that his sins will be annulled as the leave of a tree fall down
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَى رَجُلٍ يَعُودُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ كَلاَّ بَلْ حُمَّى تَفُورُ عَلَى شَيْخٍ كَبِيرٍ كَيْمَا تُزِيرَهُ الْقُبُورَ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَنَعَمْ إِذًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an khaalidin, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala 'alaa rajulin ya'uwduhu faqaala ‏"‏ laa baasa tahuwrun iin shaa'a alllahu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala kalaaa bal hummaa tafuwru 'alaa shaykhin kabiyrin kaymaa tuziyrahu alqubuwra‏.‏ qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ fana'am iidhana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered upon sick man to pay him a visit, and said to him, "Don't worry, Allah willing, (your sickness will be) an expiation for your sins." The man said, "No, it is but a fever that is boiling within an old man and will send him to his grave." On that, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then yes, it is so
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، أَنَّ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكِبَ عَلَى حِمَارٍ عَلَى إِكَافٍ عَلَى قَطِيفَةٍ فَدَكِيَّةٍ، وَأَرْدَفَ أُسَامَةَ وَرَاءَهُ يَعُودُ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَادَةَ قَبْلَ وَقْعَةِ بَدْرٍ فَسَارَ حَتَّى مَرَّ بِمَجْلِسٍ فِيهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ ابْنُ سَلُولَ وَذَلِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسْلِمَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، وَفِي الْمَجْلِسِ أَخْلاَطٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ عَبَدَةِ الأَوْثَانِ وَالْيَهُودِ، وَفِي الْمَجْلِسِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَوَاحَةَ، فَلَمَّا غَشِيَتِ الْمَجْلِسَ عَجَاجَةُ الدَّابَّةِ خَمَّرَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ أَنْفَهُ بِرِدَائِهِ، قَالَ لاَ تُغَيِّرُوا عَلَيْنَا فَسَلَّمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَوَقَفَ وَنَزَلَ فَدَعَاهُمْ إِلَى اللَّهِ فَقَرَأَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْآنَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَرْءُ إِنَّهُ لاَ أَحْسَنَ مِمَّا تَقُولُ إِنْ كَانَ حَقًّا، فَلاَ تُؤْذِنَا بِهِ فِي مَجْلِسِنَا، وَارْجِعْ إِلَى رَحْلِكَ فَمَنْ جَاءَكَ فَاقْصُصْ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ رَوَاحَةَ بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَاغْشَنَا بِهِ فِي مَجَالِسِنَا فَإِنَّا نُحِبُّ ذَلِكَ فَاسْتَبَّ الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَالْمُشْرِكُونَ وَالْيَهُودُ حَتَّى كَادُوا يَتَثَاوَرُونَ فَلَمْ يَزَلِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى سَكَتُوا فَرَكِبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَابَّتَهُ حَتَّى دَخَلَ عَلَى سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ فَقَالَ لَهُ ‏ "‏ أَىْ سَعْدُ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ مَا قَالَ أَبُو حُبَابٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُرِيدُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أُبَىٍّ‏.‏ قَالَ سَعْدٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اعْفُ عَنْهُ وَاصْفَحْ فَلَقَدْ أَعْطَاكَ اللَّهُ مَا أَعْطَاكَ وَلَقَدِ اجْتَمَعَ أَهْلُ هَذِهِ الْبَحْرَةِ أَنْ يُتَوِّجُوهُ فَيُعَصِّبُوهُ فَلَمَّا رَدَّ ذَلِكَ بِالْحَقِّ الَّذِي أَعْطَاكَ شَرِقَ بِذَلِكَ، فَذَلِكَ الَّذِي فَعَلَ بِهِ مَا رَأَيْتَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, aanna ausaamaaa bna zaydin, aakhbarahu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm rakiba 'alaa himaarin 'alaa iikaafin 'alaa qatiyfaain fadakiyyaain, waaardafa ausaamaaa waraa'ahu ya'uwdu sa'da bna 'ubaadaaa qabla waq'aai badrin fasaara hattaa marra bimajlisin fiyhi 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain abnu saluwla wadhalika qabla aan yuslima 'abdu alllahi, wafiy almajlisi aakhlaatun mina almuslimiyna waalmushrikiyna 'abadaai alaawthaani waalyahuwdi, wafiy almajlisi 'abdu alllahi bnu rawaahaaa, falammaa ghashiyati almajlisa 'ajaajaau alddaabbaai khammara 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain aanfahu biridaaiihi, qaala laa tughayyiruwa 'alaynaa fasallama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wawaqafa wanazala fada'aahum iilaa alllahi faqaraaa 'alayhimu alqurana, faqaala lahu 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain yaa aayyuhaa almar'u iinnahu laa aahsana mimmaa taquwlu iin kaana haqqana, falaa tuudhinaa bihi fiy majlisinaa, waarji' iilaa rahlika faman jaa'aka faaqsus 'alayhi‏.‏ qaala abnu rawaahaaa balaa yaa rasuwla alllahi faaghshanaa bihi fiy majaalisinaa faiinnaa nuhibbu dhalika faastabba almuslimuwna waalmushrikuwna waalyahuwdu hattaa kaaduwa yatathaawaruwna falam yazali alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa sakatuwa farakiba alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm daabbatahu hattaa dakhala 'alaa sa'di bni 'ubaadaaa faqaala lahu ‏ "‏ aaa sa'du aalam tasma' maa qaala aabuw hubaabin ‏"‏‏.‏ yuriydu 'abda alllahi bna aubaaain‏.‏ qaala sa'dun yaa rasuwla alllahi a'fu 'anhu waasfah falaqad aa'taaka alllahu maa aa'taaka walaqadi ajtama'a aahlu hadhihi albahraai aan yutawwijuwhu fayu'assibuwhu falammaa radda dhalika bialhaqqi alladhiy aa'taaka shariqa bidhalika, fadhalika alladhiy fa'ala bihi maa raaayta‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) rode a donkey having a saddle with a Fadakiyya velvet covering. He mounted me behind him and went to visit Sa`d bin 'Ubada, and that had been before the battle of Badr. The Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded till he passed by a gathering in which `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul was present, and that had been before `Abdullah embraced Islam. The gathering comprised of Muslims, polytheists, i.e., isolators and Jews. `Abdullah bin Rawaha was also present in that gathering. When dust raised by the donkey covered the gathering, `Abdullah bin Ubai covered his nose with his upper garment and said, "Do not trouble us with dust." The Prophet (ﷺ) greeted them, stopped and dismounted. Then he invited them to Allah (i.e., to embrace Islam) and recited to them some verses of the Holy Qur'an. On that, `Abdullah bin Ubai said, "O man ! There is nothing better than what you say if it is true. Do not trouble us with it in our gathering, but return to your house, and if somebody comes to you, teach him there." On that `Abdullah bin Rawaha said, Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Bring your teachings to our gathering, for we love that." So the Muslims, the pagans and the Jews started abusing each other till they were about to fight. The Prophet (ﷺ) kept on quietening them till they became calm. Thereupon the Prophet mounted his animal and proceeded till he entered upon Sa`d bin Ubada. He said to him "O Sa`d! Have you not heard what Abu Hubab (i.e., `Abdullah bin Ubai) said?" Sa`d said, 'O Allah's Apostle! Excuse and forgive him, for Allah has given you what He has given you. The people of this town (Medina decided unanimously to crown him and make him their chief by placing a turban on his head, but when that was prevented by the Truth which Allah had given you he (`Abdullah bin Ubai) was grieved out of jealously, and that was the reason which caused him to behave in the way you have seen
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ ـ عَنْ جَابِرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ جَاءَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُنِي لَيْسَ بِرَاكِبِ بَغْلٍ وَلاَ بِرْذَوْنٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'abbaasin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an muhammadin huwa abnu almunkadiri 'an jaabirin rda allh 'nh qaala jaa'aniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'uwduniy laysa biraakibi baghlin walaa birdhawnin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to visit me (while I was sick) and he was riding neither a mule, nor a horse
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، وَأَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه‏.‏ مَرَّ بِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا أُوقِدُ تَحْتَ الْقِدْرِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيُؤْذِيكَ هَوَامُّ رَأْسِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَدَعَا الْحَلاَّقَ فَحَلَقَهُ ثُمَّ أَمَرَنِي بِالْفِدَاءِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani abni aabiy najiyhin, waaayyuwba, 'an mujaahidin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa, 'an ka'bi bni 'ujraaa rda allh 'nh‏.‏ marra biya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa auwqidu tahta alqidri faqaala ‏ "‏ aayuudhiyka hawaammu raasika ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu na'am‏.‏ fada'aa alhalaaaqa fahalaqahu thumma aamaraniy bialfidaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ka`b bin 'Ujara:The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by me while I was kindling a fire under a (cooking) pot. He said, "Do the lice of your head trouble you?" I said, "Yes." So he called a barber to shave my head and ordered me to make expiation for that
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَبُو زَكَرِيَّاءَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَارَأْسَاهْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ذَاكِ لَوْ كَانَ وَأَنَا حَىٌّ، فَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكِ وَأَدْعُو لَكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَاثُكْلِيَاهْ، وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَظُنُّكَ تُحِبُّ مَوْتِي، وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَاكَ لَظَلِلْتَ آخِرَ يَوْمِكَ مُعَرِّسًا بِبَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بَلْ أَنَا وَارَأْسَاهْ لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَوْ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أُرْسِلَ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَابْنِهِ، وَأَعْهَدَ أَنْ يَقُولَ الْقَائِلُونَ أَوْ يَتَمَنَّى الْمُتَمَنُّونَ، ثُمَّ قُلْتُ يَأْبَى اللَّهُ وَيَدْفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ، أَوْ يَدْفَعُ اللَّهُ وَيَأْبَى الْمُؤْمِنُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa aabuw zakariyyaa'a, aakhbaranaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, qaala sami'tu alqaasima bna muhammadin, qaala qaalat 'aaiishaau waaraasaah‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ dhaaki law kaana waaanaa haaaun, faaastaghfiru laki waaad'uw laki ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaalat 'aaiishaau waathukliyaah, waalllahi iinniy laazunnuka tuhibbu mawtiy, walaw kaana dhaaka lazalilta akhira yawmika mu'arrisana biba'di aazwaajika‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ bal aanaa waaraasaah laqad hamamtu aaw aaradtu aan aursila iilaa aabiy bakrin waabnihi, waaa'hada aan yaquwla alqaaiiluwna aaw yatamannaa almutamannuwna, thumma qultu yaabaa alllahu wayadfa'u almuuminuwna, aaw yadfa'u alllahu wayaabaa almuuminuwna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Qasim bin Muhammad:`Aisha, (complaining of headache) said, "Oh, my head"! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I wish that had happened while I was still living, for then I would ask Allah's Forgiveness for you and invoke Allah for you." Aisha said, "Wa thuklayah! By Allah, I think you want me to die; and If this should happen, you would spend the last part of the day sleeping with one of your wives!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Nay, I should say, 'Oh my head!' I felt like sending for Abu Bakr and his son, and appoint him as my successor lest some people claimed something or some others wished something, but then I said (to myself), 'Allah would not allow it to be otherwise, and the Muslims would prevent it to be otherwise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ يُوعَكُ فَمَسِسْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّكَ لَتُوعَكُ وَعْكًا شَدِيدًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَجَلْ كَمَا يُوعَكُ رَجُلاَنِ مِنْكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لَكَ أَجْرَانِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يُصِيبُهُ أَذًى مَرَضٌ فَمَا سِوَاهُ إِلاَّ حَطَّ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ كَمَا تَحُطُّ الشَّجَرَةُ وَرَقَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muslimin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, 'an iibraahiyma alttaymiyyi, 'ani alhaarithi bni suwaydin, 'ani abni mas'uwdin rda allh 'nh qaala dakhaltu 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa yuw'aku famasistuhu faqultu iinnaka latuw'aku wa'kana shadiydana‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aajal kamaa yuw'aku rajulaani minkum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala laka aajraani qaala ‏"‏ na'am maa min muslimin yusiybuhu aadhana maradun famaa siwaahu iilaaa hatta alllahu sayyiiaatihi kamaa tahuttu alshhajaraau waraqahaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:I visited the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was having a high fever. I touched him an said, "You have a very high fever" He said, "Yes, as much fever as two me of you may have." I said. "you will have a double reward?" He said, "Yes No Muslim is afflicted with hurt caused by disease or some other inconvenience, but that Allah will remove his sins as a tree sheds its leaves
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ جَاءَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُنِي مِنْ وَجَعٍ اشْتَدَّ بِي زَمَنَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ فَقُلْتُ بَلَغَ بِي مَا تَرَى وَأَنَا ذُو مَالٍ وَلاَ يَرِثُنِي إِلاَّ ابْنَةٌ لِي أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِثُلُثَىْ مَالِي قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ بِالشَّطْرِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ الثُّلُثُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ، أَنْ تَدَعَ وَرَثَتَكَ أَغْنِيَاءَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَذَرَهُمْ عَالَةً يَتَكَفَّفُونَ النَّاسَ وَلَنْ تُنْفِقَ نَفَقَةً تَبْتَغِي بِهَا وَجْهَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ أُجِرْتَ عَلَيْهَا حَتَّى مَا تَجْعَلُ فِي فِي امْرَأَتِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy salamaaa, aakhbaranaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an 'aamiri bni sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, qaala jaa'anaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'uwduniy min waja'in ashtadda biy zamana hajjaai alwadaa'i faqultu balagha biy maa taraa waaanaa dhuw maalin walaa yarithuniy iilaaa abnaaun liy aafaaatasaddaqu bithuluthaa maaliy qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu bialshhatri qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu althhuluthu qaala ‏"‏ althhuluthu kathiyrun, aan tada'a warathataka aaghniyaa'a khayrun min aan tadharahum 'aalaaan yatakaffafuwna alnnaasa walan tunfiqa nafaqaaan tabtaghiy bihaa wajha alllahi iilaaa aujirta 'alayhaa hattaa maa taj'alu fiy fiy amraaatika ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to visit me during my ailment which had been aggravated during Hajjat-al- Wada`. I said to him, "You see how sick I am. I have much property but have no heir except my only daughter May I give two thirds of my property in charity?"! He said, "No." I said, "Half of it?" He said, "No." I said "One third?" He said, "One third is too much, for to leave your heirs rich is better than to leave them poor, begging of others. Nothing you spend seeking Allah's pleasure but you shall get a reward for it, even for what you put in the mouth of your wife
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا حُضِرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَفِي الْبَيْتِ رِجَالٌ فِيهِمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلُمَّ أَكْتُبْ لَكُمْ كِتَابًا لاَ تَضِلُّوا بَعْدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ غَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ الْوَجَعُ وَعِنْدَكُمُ الْقُرْآنُ، حَسْبُنَا كِتَابُ اللَّهِ فَاخْتَلَفَ أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ فَاخْتَصَمُوا، مِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ قَرِّبُوا يَكْتُبْ لَكُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كِتَابًا لَنْ تَضِلُّوا بَعْدَهُ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ مَا قَالَ عُمَرُ فَلَمَّا أَكْثَرُوا اللَّغْوَ وَالاِخْتِلاَفَ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قُومُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَكَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ إِنَّ الرَّزِيَّةَ كُلَّ الرَّزِيَّةِ مَا حَالَ بَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ لَهُمْ ذَلِكَ الْكِتَابَ مِنِ اخْتِلاَفِهِمْ وَلَغَطِهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an ma'marin, wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala lammaa hudira rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wafiy albayti rijaalun fiyhim 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ halumma aaktub lakum kitaabana laa tadilluwa ba'dahu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qad ghalaba 'alayhi alwaja'u wa'indakumu alquranu, hasbunaa kitaabu alllahi faakhtalafa aahlu albayti faakhtasamuwa, minhum man yaquwlu qarribuwa yaktub lakumu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm kitaabana lan tadilluwa ba'dahu, waminhum man yaquwlu maa qaala 'umaru falammaa aaktharuwa alllaghwa waalaikhtilaafa 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ quwmuwa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'ubaydu alllahi fakaana abnu 'abbaasin yaquwlu iinna alrraziyyaaa kulla alrraziyyaai maa haala bayna rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wabayna aan yaktuba lahum dhalika alkitaaba mini akhtilaafihim walaghatihim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was on his death-bed and in the house there were some people among whom was `Umar bin Al-Khattab, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Come, let me write for you a statement after which you will not go astray." `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) is seriously ill and you have the Qur'an; so the Book of Allah is enough for us." The people present in the house differed and quarrelled. Some said "Go near so that the Prophet (ﷺ) may write for you a statement after which you will not go astray," while the others said as `Umar said. When they caused a hue and cry before the Prophet, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Go away!" Narrated 'Ubaidullah: Ibn `Abbas used to say, "It was very unfortunate that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was prevented from writing that statement for them because of their disagreement and noise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ـ عَنِ الْجُعَيْدِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ السَّائِبَ، يَقُولُ ذَهَبَتْ بِي خَالَتِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ ابْنَ أُخْتِي وَجِعٌ فَمَسَحَ رَأْسِي وَدَعَا لِي بِالْبَرَكَةِ، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ فَشَرِبْتُ مِنْ وَضُوئِهِ وَقُمْتُ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى خَاتَمِ النُّبُوَّةِ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ مِثْلَ زِرِّ الْحَجَلَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu hamzaaa, haddathanaa haatimun huwa abnu iismaa'iyla 'ani alju'aydi, qaala sami'tu alssaaiiba, yaquwlu dhahabat biy khaalatiy iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna abna aukhtiy waji'un famasaha raasiy wada'aa liy bialbarakaai, thumma tawaddaaa fasharibtu min waduwiihi waqumtu khalfa zahrihi fanazartu iilaa khaatami alnnubuwwaai bayna katifayhi mithla zirri alhajalaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated As-Sa'ib:My aunt took me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My nephew is- ill." The Prophet (ﷺ) touched my head with his hand and invoked Allah to bless me. He then performed ablution and I drank of the remaining water of his ablution and then stood behind his back and saw "Khatam An- Nubuwwa" (The Seal of Prophethood) between his shoulders like a button of a tent
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ الْبُنَانِيُّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَتَمَنَّيَنَّ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَوْتَ مِنْ ضُرٍّ أَصَابَهُ، فَإِنْ كَانَ لاَ بُدَّ فَاعِلاً فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ أَحْيِنِي مَا كَانَتِ الْحَيَاةُ خَيْرًا لِي، وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا كَانَتِ الْوَفَاةُ خَيْرًا لِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa thaabitun albunaaniyyu, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yatamannayanna aahadukumu almawta min durrin aasaabahu, faiin kaana laa budda faa'ilaan falyaquli alllahumma aahyiniy maa kaanati alhayaaau khayrana liy, watawaffaniy iidhaa kaanati alwafaaau khayrana liy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None of you should wish for death because of a calamity befalling him; but if he has to wish for death, he should say: "O Allah! Keep me alive as long as life is better for me, and let me die if death is better for me
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ دَخَلْنَا عَلَى خَبَّابٍ نَعُودُهُ وَقَدِ اكْتَوَى سَبْعَ كَيَّاتٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَنَا الَّذِينَ سَلَفُوا مَضَوْا وَلَمْ تَنْقُصْهُمُ الدُّنْيَا وَإِنَّا أَصَبْنَا مَا لاَ نَجِدُ لَهُ مَوْضِعًا إِلاَّ التُّرَابَ وَلَوْلاَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَانَا أَنْ نَدْعُوَ بِالْمَوْتِ لَدَعَوْتُ بِهِ، ثُمَّ أَتَيْنَاهُ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى وَهْوَ يَبْنِي حَائِطًا لَهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمَ لَيُوجَرُ فِي كُلِّ شَىْءٍ يُنْفِقُهُ إِلاَّ فِي شَىْءٍ يَجْعَلُهُ فِي هَذَا التُّرَابِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, 'an qaysi bni aabiy haazimin, qaala dakhalnaa 'alaa khabbaabin na'uwduhu waqadi aktawaa sab'a kayyaatin faqaala iinna aashaabanaa alladhiyna salafuwa madawa walam tanqushumu alddunyaa waiinnaa aasabnaa maa laa najidu lahu mawdi'ana iilaaa altturaaba walawlaa aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaanaa aan nad'uwa bialmawti lada'awtu bihi, thumma aataynaahu marraaan aukhraa wahwa yabniy haaiitana lahu faqaala iinna almuslima layuwjaru fiy kulli shaa'in yunfiquhu iilaaa fiy shaa'in yaj'aluhu fiy hadhaa altturaabi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qais bin Abi Hazim:We went to pay a visit to Khabbab (who was sick) and he had been branded (cauterized) at seven places in his body. He said, "Our companions who died (during the lifetime of the Prophet) left (this world) without having their rewards reduced through enjoying the pleasures of this life, but we have got (so much) wealth that we find no way to spend It except on the construction of buildings Had the Prophet not forbidden us to wish for death, I would have wished for it.' We visited him for the second time while he was building a wall. He said, A Muslim is rewarded (in the Hereafter) for whatever he spends except for something that he spends on building
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لَنْ يُدْخِلَ أَحَدًا عَمَلُهُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا وَلاَ أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ، وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِي اللَّهُ بِفَضْلٍ وَرَحْمَةٍ فَسَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا وَلاَ يَتَمَنَّيَنَّ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَوْتَ إِمَّا مُحْسِنًا فَلَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يَزْدَادَ خَيْرًا، وَإِمَّا مُسِيئًا فَلَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يَسْتَعْتِبَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw 'ubaydin, mawlaa 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ lan yudkhila aahadana 'amaluhu aljannaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa walaa aanta yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ laa, walaa aanaa iilaaa aan yataghammadaniy alllahu bifadlin warahmaain fasaddiduwa waqaaribuwa walaa yatamannayanna aahadukumu almawta iimmaa muhsinana fala'allahu aan yazdaada khayrana, waiimmaa musiyiana fala'allahu aan yasta'tiba ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The good deeds of any person will not make him enter Paradise." (i.e., None can enter Paradise through his good deeds.) They (the Prophet's companions) said, 'Not even you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?' He said, "Not even myself, unless Allah bestows His favor and mercy on me." So be moderate in your religious deeds and do the deeds that are within your ability: and none of you should wish for death, for if he is a good doer, he may increase his good deeds, and if he is an evil doer, he may repent to Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ مُسْتَنِدٌ إِلَىَّ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an 'abbaadi bni 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri, qaala sami'tu 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa mustanidun iilaaaa yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma aghfir liy waarhamniy waaalhiqniy bialrrafiyqi alaa'laa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) , who was resting against me, saying, "O Allah! Excuse me and bestow Your Mercy on me and let me join with the highest companions (in Paradise)." See Qur'an
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا أَتَى مَرِيضًا ـ أَوْ أُتِيَ بِهِ ـ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، اشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي لاَ شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لاَ يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ أَبِي قَيْسٍ وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَأَبِي الضُّحَى إِذَا أُتِيَ بِالْمَرِيضِ، وَقَالَ جَرِيرٌ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى وَحْدَهُ، وَقَالَ إِذَا أَتَى مَرِيضًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa aataa mariydana aaw autiya bihi qaala ‏ "‏ aadhhibi albaasa rabba alnnaasi, ashfi waaanta alshhaafiy laa shifaa'a iilaaa shifaauuka, shifaa'an laa yughaadiru saqamana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'amruw bnu aabiy qaysin waiibraahiymu bnu tahmaana 'an mansuwrin 'an iibraahiyma waaabiy aldduhaa iidhaa autiya bialmariydi, waqaala jariyrun 'an mansuwrin 'an aabiy aldduhaa wahdahu, waqaala iidhaa aataa mariydana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) paid a visit to a patient, or a patient was brought to him, he used to invoke Allah, saying, "Take away the disease, O the Lord of the people! Cure him as You are the One Who cures. There is no cure but Yours, a cure that leaves no disease
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا مَرِيضٌ فَتَوَضَّأَ فَصَبَّ عَلَىَّ أَوْ قَالَ صُبُّوا عَلَيْهِ فَعَقَلْتُ فَقُلْتُ لاَ يَرِثُنِي إِلاَّ كَلاَلَةٌ، فَكَيْفَ الْمِيرَاثُ فَنَزَلَتْ آيَةُ الْفَرَائِضِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala dakhala 'alaaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa mariydun fatawaddaaa fasabba 'alaaaa aaw qaala subbuwa 'alayhi fa'aqaltu faqultu laa yarithuniy iilaaa kalaalaaun, fakayfa almiyraathu fanazalat ayaau alfaraaiidi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to me while I was ill. He performed ablution and threw the remaining water on me (or said, "Pour it on him) " When I came to my senses I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have no son or father to be my heir, so how will be my inheritance?" Then the Verse of inheritance was revealed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ لَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وُعِكَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَبِلاَلٌ قَالَتْ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِمَا فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَتِ كَيْفَ تَجِدُكَ وَيَا بِلاَلُ كَيْفَ تَجِدُكَ قَالَتْ وَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ إِذَا أَخَذَتْهُ الْحُمَّى يَقُولُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مُصَبَّحٌ فِي أَهْلِهِ وَالْمَوْتُ أَدْنَى مِنْ شِرَاكِ نَعْلِهِ وَكَانَ بِلاَلٌ إِذَا أُقْلِعَ عَنْهُ يَرْفَعُ عَقِيرَتَهُ فَيَقُولُ أَلاَ لَيْتَ شِعْرِي هَلْ أَبِيتَنَّ لَيْلَةً بِوَادٍ وَحَوْلِي إِذْخِرٌ وَجَلِيلُ وَهَلْ أَرِدَنْ يَوْمًا مِيَاهَ مِجَنَّةٍ وَهَلْ تَبْدُوَنْ لِي شَامَةٌ وَطَفِيلُ قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَجِئْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ كَحُبِّنَا مَكَّةَ أَوْ أَشَدَّ وَصَحِّحْهَا وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِهَا وَمُدِّهَا وَانْقُلْ حُمَّاهَا فَاجْعَلْهَا بِالْجُحْفَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, haddathaniy maalikun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aannahaa qaalat lammaa qadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wu'ika aabuw bakrin wabilaalun qaalat fadakhaltu 'alayhimaa faqultu yaa aabati kayfa tajiduka wayaa bilaalu kayfa tajiduka qaalat wakaana aabuw bakrin iidhaa aakhadhathu alhummaa yaquwlu kullu amriiin musabbahun fiy aahlihi waalmawtu aadnaa min shiraaki na'lihi wakaana bilaalun iidhaa auqli'a 'anhu yarfa'u 'aqiyratahu fayaquwlu aalaa layta shi'riy hal aabiytanna laylaaan biwaadin wahawliy iidhkhirun wajaliylu wahal aaridan yawmana miyaaha mijannaain wahal tabduwan liy shaamaaun watafiylu qaala qaalat 'aaiishaau fajiitu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbartuhu faqaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma habbib iilaynaa almadiynaaa kahubbinaa makkaaa aaw aashadda wasahhihhaa wabaarik lanaa fiy saa'ihaa wamuddihaa waanqul hummaahaa faaj'alhaa bialjuhfaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) emigrated to Medina, Abu Bakr and Bilal had a fever. I entered upon them and said, "O my father! How are you? O Bilal! How are you?" Whenever Abu Bakr got the fever he used to say, "Everybody is staying alive with his people, yet death is nearer to him than his shoe laces." And when fever deserted Bilal, he would recite (two poetic verses): "Would that I could stay overnight in a valley wherein I would be surrounded by Idhkhir and Jalil (two kinds of good smelling grass). Would that one day I could drink of the water of Majinna, and would that Shama and Tafil (two mountains at Mecca) would appear to me!" I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him about that. He said, "O Allah! Make us love Medina as much or more than we love Mecca, and make it healthy, and bless its Sa and its Mudd, and take away its fever and put it in Al-Juhfa." (See Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ الزُّبَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ دَاءً إِلاَّ أَنْزَلَ لَهُ شِفَاءً ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa aabuw aahmada alzzubayriyyu, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu sa'iydi bni aabiy husaynin, qaala haddathaniy 'ataa'u bnu aabiy rabaahin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa aanzala alllahu daa'an iilaaa aanzala lahu shifaa'an ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no disease that Allah has created, except that He also has created its treatment
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنْ رُبَيِّعَ بِنْتِ مُعَوِّذٍ ابْنِ عَفْرَاءَ، قَالَتْ كُنَّا نَغْزُو مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَسْقِي الْقَوْمَ، وَنَخْدُمُهُمْ، وَنَرُدُّ الْقَتْلَى وَالْجَرْحَى إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa bishru bnu almufaddali, 'an khaalidi bni dhakwaana, 'an rubayyi'a binti mu'awwidhin abni 'afraa'a, qaalat kunnaa naghzuw ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nasqiy alqawma, wanakhdumuhum, wanaruddu alqatlaa waaljarhaa iilaa almadiynaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Rubai bint Mu`adh bin Afra:We used to go for Military expeditions along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and provide the people with water, serve them and bring the dead and the wounded back to Medina
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحُسَيْنُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمٌ الأَفْطَسُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الشِّفَاءُ فِي ثَلاَثَةٍ شَرْبَةِ عَسَلٍ، وَشَرْطَةِ مِحْجَمٍ، وَكَيَّةِ نَارٍ، وَأَنْهَى أُمَّتِي عَنِ الْكَىِّ ‏"‏‏.‏ رَفَعَ الْحَدِيثَ وَرَوَاهُ الْقُمِّيُّ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْعَسَلِ وَالْحَجْمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy alhusaynu, haddathanaa aahmadu bnu maniy'in, haddathanaa marwaanu bnu shujaa'in, haddathanaa saalimun alaaftasu, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala ‏ "‏ alshhifaa'u fiy thalaathaain sharbaai 'asalin, washartaai mihjamin, wakayyaai naarin, waaanhaa aummatiy 'ani alkaaai ‏"‏‏.‏ rafa'a alhadiytha warawaahu alqummiyyu 'an laythin 'an mujaahidin 'ani abni 'abbaasin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy al'asali waalhajmi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(The Prophet (ﷺ) said), "Healing is in three things: A gulp of honey, cupping, and branding with fire (cauterizing)." But I forbid my followers to use (cauterization) branding with fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ أَبُو الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ الأَفْطَسِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الشِّفَاءُ فِي ثَلاَثَةٍ شَرْطَةِ مِحْجَمٍ، أَوْ شَرْبَةِ عَسَلٍ، أَوْ كَيَّةٍ بِنَارٍ، وَأَنْهَى أُمَّتِي عَنِ الْكَىِّ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahiymi, aakhbaranaa surayju bnu yuwnusa aabuw alhaarithi, haddathanaa marwaanu bnu shujaa'in, 'an saalimin alaaftasi, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alshhifaa'u fiy thalaathaain shartaai mihjamin, aaw sharbaai 'asalin, aaw kayyaain binaarin, waaanhaa aummatiy 'ani alkaaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Healing is in three things: cupping, a gulp of honey or cauterization, (branding with fire) but I forbid my followers to use cauterization (branding with fire)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعْجِبُهُ الْحَلْوَاءُ وَالْعَسَلُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, qaala aakhbaraniy hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yu'jibuhu alhalwaa'u waal'asalu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to like sweet edible things and honey
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْغَسِيلِ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنْ كَانَ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ أَدْوِيَتِكُمْ ـ أَوْ يَكُونُ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ أَدْوِيَتِكُمْ ـ خَيْرٌ فَفِي شَرْطَةِ مِحْجَمٍ، أَوْ شَرْبَةِ عَسَلٍ، أَوْ لَذْعَةٍ بِنَارٍ تُوَافِقُ الدَّاءَ، وَمَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَكْتَوِيَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu alghasiyli, 'an 'aasimi bni 'umara bni qataadaaa, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iin kaana fiy shaa'in min aadwiyatikum aaw yakuwnu fiy shaa'in min aadwiyatikum khayrun fafiy shartaai mihjamin, aaw sharbaai 'asalin, aaw ladh'aain binaarin tuwaafiqu alddaa'a, wamaa auhibbu aan aaktawiya ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "If there is any healing in your medicines, then it is in cupping, a gulp of honey or branding with fire (cauterization) that suits the ailment, but I don't like to be (cauterized) branded with fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَيَّاشُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَخِي يَشْتَكِي بَطْنَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اسْقِهِ عَسَلاً ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَتَى الثَّانِيَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اسْقِهِ عَسَلاً ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ فَقَالَ فَعَلْتُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ، وَكَذَبَ بَطْنُ أَخِيكَ، اسْقِهِ عَسَلاً ‏"‏‏.‏ فَسَقَاهُ فَبَرَأَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ayyaashu bnu alwaliydi, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aabiy almutawakkili, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, aanna rajulaan, aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala aakhiy yashtakiy batnahu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ asqihi 'asalaan ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma aataa althhaaniyaaa faqaala ‏"‏ asqihi 'asalaan ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma aataahu faqaala fa'altu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ sadaqa alllahu, wakadhaba batnu aakhiyka, asqihi 'asalaan ‏"‏‏.‏ fasaqaahu fabaraaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "My brother has some Abdominal trouble." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him "Let him drink honey." The man came for the second time and the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, 'Let him drink honey." He came for the third time and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Let him drink honey." He returned again and said, "I have done that ' The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Allah has said the truth, but your brother's `Abdomen has told a lie. Let him drink honey." So he made him drink honey and he was cured
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلاَّمُ بْنُ مِسْكِينٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ نَاسًا، كَانَ بِهِمْ سَقَمٌ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ آوِنَا وَأَطْعِمْنَا فَلَمَّا صَحُّوا قَالُوا إِنَّ الْمَدِينَةَ وَخِمَةٌ‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَهُمُ الْحَرَّةَ فِي ذَوْدٍ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اشْرَبُوا أَلْبَانَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا صَحُّوا قَتَلُوا رَاعِيَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاسْتَاقُوا ذَوْدَهُ، فَبَعَثَ فِي آثَارِهِمْ، فَقَطَعَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَرْجُلَهُمْ، وَسَمَرَ أَعْيُنَهُمْ، فَرَأَيْتُ الرَّجُلَ مِنْهُمْ يَكْدُمُ الأَرْضَ بِلِسَانِهِ حَتَّى يَمُوتَ‏.‏ قَالَ سَلاَّمٌ فَبَلَغَنِي أَنَّ الْحَجَّاجَ قَالَ لأَنَسٍ حَدِّثْنِي بِأَشَدِّ عُقُوبَةٍ عَاقَبَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَحَدَّثَهُ بِهَذَا‏.‏ فَبَلَغَ الْحَسَنَ فَقَالَ وَدِدْتُ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يُحَدِّثْهُ‏ بِهَذَا
verses.translit: hadaathanaa muslimu bnu iibraahiyma, hadaathanaa salaaamu bnu miskiynin, hadaathanaa thaabitun, 'an aanasin, aanaa naasana, kaana bihim saqamun qaaluwa yaa rasuwla allaahi awinaa waaat'imnaa falamaaa sahuuwa qaaluwa iinaa almadiynaaa wakhimaaun‏.‏ faaanzalahumu alharaaaa fiy dhawdin lahu faqaala ‏ "‏ ashrabuwa aalbaanahaa ‏"‏‏.‏ falamaaa sahuuwa qataluwa raa'iya alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm waastaaquwa dhawdahu, faba'atha fiy athaarihim, faqata'a aaydiyahum waaarjulahum, wasamara aa'yunahum, faraaaytu alraajula minhum yakdumu alaarda bilisaanihi hataaa yamuwta‏.‏ qaala salaaamun fabalaghaniy aanaa alhajaaaja qaala laanasin hadiithniy biaashadii 'uquwbaain 'aaqabahu alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm fahadaathahu bihadhaa‏.‏ fabalagha alhasana faqaala wadidtu aanaahu lam yuhadiithhu‏ bihadhaa
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Some people were sick and they said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Give us shelter and food. So when they became healthy they said, "The weather of Medina is not suitable for us." So he sent them to Al-Harra with some she-camels of his and said, "Drink of their milk." But when they became healthy, they killed the shepherd of the Prophet (ﷺ) and drove away his camels. The Prophet (ﷺ) sent some people in their pursuit. Then he got their hands and feet cut and their eyes were branded with heated pieces of iron. I saw one of them licking the earth with his tongue till he died
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ نَاسًا، اجْتَوَوْا فِي الْمَدِينَةِ فَأَمَرَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَلْحَقُوا بِرَاعِيهِ ـ يَعْنِي الإِبِلَ ـ فَيَشْرَبُوا مِنْ أَلْبَانِهَا وَأَبْوَالِهَا، فَلَحِقُوا بِرَاعِيهِ فَشَرِبُوا مِنْ أَلْبَانِهَا وَأَبْوَالِهَا، حَتَّى صَلَحَتْ أَبْدَانُهُمْ فَقَتَلُوا الرَّاعِيَ وَسَاقُوا الإِبِلَ، فَبَلَغَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَبَعَثَ فِي طَلَبِهِمْ، فَجِيءَ بِهِمْ فَقَطَعَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَرْجُلَهُمْ، وَسَمَرَ أَعْيُنَهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ فَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِيرِينَ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ كَانَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْزِلَ الْحُدُودُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh aanna naasana, ajtawawa fiy almadiynaai faaamarahumu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yalhaquwa biraa'iyhi ya'niy aliibila fayashrabuwa min aalbaanihaa waaabwaalihaa, falahiquwa biraa'iyhi fasharibuwa min aalbaanihaa waaabwaalihaa, hattaa salahat aabdaanuhum faqataluwa alrraa'iya wasaaquwa aliibila, fabalagha alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faba'atha fiy talabihim, fajiy'a bihim faqata'a aaydiyahum waaarjulahum, wasamara aa'yunahum‏.‏ qaala qataadaau fahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu siyriyna aanna dhalika kaana qabla aan tanzila alhuduwdu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The climate of Medina did not suit some people, so the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered them to follow his shepherd, i.e. his camels, and drink their milk and urine (as a medicine). So they followed the shepherd that is the camels and drank their milk and urine till their bodies became healthy. Then they killed the shepherd and drove away the camels. When the news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) he sent some people in their pursuit. When they were brought, he cut their hands and feet and their eyes were branded with heated pieces of iron
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا وَمَعَنَا غَالِبُ بْنُ أَبْجَرَ فَمَرِضَ فِي الطَّرِيقِ، فَقَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ وَهْوَ مَرِيضٌ، فَعَادَهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عَتِيقٍ فَقَالَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ بِهَذِهِ الْحُبَيْبَةِ السَّوْدَاءِ، فَخُذُوا مِنْهَا خَمْسًا أَوْ سَبْعًا فَاسْحَقُوهَا، ثُمَّ اقْطُرُوهَا فِي أَنْفِهِ بِقَطَرَاتِ زَيْتٍ فِي هَذَا الْجَانِبِ وَفِي هَذَا الْجَانِبِ، فَإِنَّ عَائِشَةَ حَدَّثَتْنِي أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ هَذِهِ الْحَبَّةَ السَّوْدَاءَ شِفَاءٌ مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ إِلاَّ مِنَ السَّامِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَمَا السَّامُ قَالَ الْمَوْتُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an mansuwrin, 'an khaalidi bni sa'din, qaala kharajnaa wama'anaa ghaalibu bnu aabjara famarida fiy alttariyqi, faqadimnaa almadiynaaa wahwa mariydun, fa'aadahu abnu aabiy 'atiyqin faqaala lanaa 'alaykum bihadhihi alhubaybaai alssawdaa'i, fakhudhuwa minhaa khamsana aaw sab'ana faashaquwhaa, thumma aqturuwhaa fiy aanfihi biqataraati zaytin fiy hadhaa aljaanibi wafiy hadhaa aljaanibi, faiinna 'aaiishaaa haddathatniy aannahaa sami'ati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna hadhihi alhabbaaa alssawdaa'a shifaa'un min kulli daa'in iilaaa mina alssaami ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu wamaa alssaamu qaala almawtu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Khalid bin Sa`d:We went out and Ghalib bin Abjar was accompanying us. He fell ill on the way and when we arrived at Medina he was still sick. Ibn Abi 'Atiq came to visit him and said to us, "Treat him with black cumin. Take five or seven seeds and crush them (mix the powder with oil) and drop the resulting mixture into both nostrils, for `Aisha has narrated to me that she heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'This black cumin is healing for all diseases except As-Sam.' Aisha said, 'What is As-Sam?' He said, 'Death
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُمَا أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ فِي الْحَبَّةِ السَّوْدَاءِ شِفَاءٌ مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ إِلاَّ السَّامَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَالسَّامُ الْمَوْتُ، وَالْحَبَّةُ السَّوْدَاءُ الشُّونِيزُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa, wasa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, aakhbarahumaa aannahu, sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ fiy alhabbaai alssawdaa'i shifaa'un min kulli daa'in iilaaa alssaama ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin waalssaamu almawtu, waalhabbaau alssawdaa'u alshhuwniyzu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "There is healing in black cumin for all diseases except death
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حِبَّانُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَأْمُرُ بِالتَّلْبِينِ لِلْمَرِيضِ وَلِلْمَحْزُونِ عَلَى الْهَالِكِ، وَكَانَتْ تَقُولُ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ التَّلْبِينَةَ تُجِمُّ فُؤَادَ الْمَرِيضِ، وَتَذْهَبُ بِبَعْضِ الْحُزْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hibbaanu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu bnu yaziyda, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aannahaa kaanat taamuru bialttalbiyni lilmariydi walilmahzuwni 'alaa alhaaliki, wakaanat taquwlu iinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna alttalbiynaaa tujimmu fuuaada almariydi, watadhhabu biba'di alhuzni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Urwa:Aisha used to recommend at-Talbina for the sick and for such a person as grieved over a dead person. She used to say, "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'at-Talbina gives rest to the heart of the patient and makes it active and relieves some of his sorrow and grief
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَأْمُرُ بِالتَّلْبِينَةِ وَتَقُولُ هُوَ الْبَغِيضُ النَّافِعُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa farwaau bnu aabiy almaghraa'i, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa kaanat taamuru bialttalbiynaai wataquwlu huwa albaghiydu alnnaafi'u‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hisham's father:`Aisha used to recommend at-Talbina and used to say, "It is disliked (by the patient) although it is beneficial
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ وَأَعْطَى الْحَجَّامَ أَجْرَهُ وَاسْتَعَطَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu aasadin, haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'ani abni taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ahtajama waaa'taa alhajjaama aajrahu waasta'ata‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was cupped and he paid the wages to the one who had cupped him and then took Su'ut (Medicine sniffed by nose)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتِ مِحْصَنٍ، قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ عَلَيْكُمْ بِهَذَا الْعُودِ الْهِنْدِيِّ، فَإِنَّ فِيهِ سَبْعَةَ أَشْفِيَةٍ‏.‏ يُسْتَعَطُ بِهِ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ، وَيُلَدُّ بِهِ مِنْ ذَاتِ الْجَنْبِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِابْنٍ لِي لَمْ يَأْكُلِ الطَّعَامَ فَبَالَ عَلَيْهِ، فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَرَشَّ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sadaqaau bnu alfadli, aakhbaranaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, qaala sami'tu alzzuhriyya, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an aummi qaysin binti mihsanin, qaalat sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ 'alaykum bihadhaa al'uwdi alhindiyyi, faiinna fiyhi sab'aaa aashfiyaain‏.‏ yusta'atu bihi mina al'udhraai, wayuladdu bihi min dhaati aljanbi ‏"‏‏.‏ wadakhaltu 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm biabnin liy lam yaakuli altta'aama fabaala 'alayhi, fada'aa bimaa'in farashha 'alayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Qais bint Mihsan:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Treat with the Indian incense, for it has healing for seven diseases; it is to be sniffed by one having throat trouble, and to be put into one side of the mouth of one suffering from pleurisy." Once I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with a son of mine who would not eat any food, and the boy passed urine on him whereupon he asked for some water and sprinkled it over the place of urine
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ احْتَجَمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ صَائِمٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala ahtajama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa saaiimun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was cupped while he was fasting
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، وَعَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ احْتَجَمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ مُحْرِمٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an taawusin, wa'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala ahtajama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa muhrimun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was cupped while he was in a state of Ihram
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدٌ الطَّوِيلُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ أَجْرِ الْحَجَّامِ، فَقَالَ احْتَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَجَمَهُ أَبُو طَيْبَةَ، وَأَعْطَاهُ صَاعَيْنِ مِنْ طَعَامٍ، وَكَلَّمَ مَوَالِيَهُ فَخَفَّفُوا عَنْهُ، وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَمْثَلَ مَا تَدَاوَيْتُمْ بِهِ الْحِجَامَةُ وَالْقُسْطُ الْبَحْرِيُّ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تُعَذِّبُوا صِبْيَانَكُمْ بِالْغَمْزِ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ، وَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالْقُسْطِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa humaydun alttawiylu, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh aannahu suiila 'an aajri alhajjaami, faqaala ahtajama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hajamahu aabuw taybaaa, waaa'taahu saa'ayni min ta'aamin, wakallama mawaaliyahu fakhaffafuwa 'anhu, waqaala ‏"‏ iinna aamthala maa tadaawaytum bihi alhijaamaau waalqustu albahriyyu ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ laa tu'adhhibuwa sibyaanakum bialghamzi mina al'udhraai, wa'alaykum bialqusti ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:that he was asked about the wages of the one who cups others. He said, 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was cupped by `Abd Taiba, to whom he gave two Sa of food and interceded for him with his masters who consequently reduced what they used to charge him daily. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best medicines you may treat yourselves with are cupping and sea incense.' He added, "You should not torture your children by treating tonsillitis by pressing the tonsils or the palate with the finger, but use incense
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ تَلِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، وَغَيْرُهُ، أَنَّ بُكَيْرًا، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَاصِمَ بْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَادَ الْمُقَنَّعَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لاَ أَبْرَحُ حَتَّى تَحْتَجِمَ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ فِيهِ شِفَاءً ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu taliydin, qaala haddathaniy abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, waghayruhu, aanna bukayrana, haddathahu aanna 'aasima bna 'umara bni qataadaaa haddathahu aanna jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma 'aada almuqanna'a thumma qaala laa aabrahu hattaa tahtajima faiinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna fiyhi shifaa'an ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:that he paid Al-Muqanna a visit during his illness and said, "I will not leave till he gets cupped, for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "There is healing in cupping
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ابْنَ بُحَيْنَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ بِلَحْىِ جَمَلٍ مِنْ طَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ، وَهْوَ مُحْرِمٌ، فِي وَسَطِ رَأْسِهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ فِي رَأْسِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy sulaymaanu, 'an 'alqamaaa, aannahu sami'a 'abda alrrahmani alaa'raja, aannahu sami'a 'abda alllahi abna buhaynaaa, yuhaddithu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ahtajama bilahai jamalin min tariyqi makkaaa, wahwa muhrimun, fiy wasati raasihi‏.‏ waqaala alaansaariyyu aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu hassaana, haddathanaa 'ikrimaau, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ahtajama fiy raasihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Buhaina:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was cupped on the middle of his head at Lahl Jamal on his way to Mecca while he was in a state of Ihram. Narrated Ibn `Abbas: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was cupped on his head
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، احْتَجَمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَأْسِهِ وَهْوَ مُحْرِمٌ مِنْ وَجَعٍ كَانَ بِهِ بِمَاءٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ لَحْىُ جَمَلٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَوَاءٍ أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ وَهْوَ مُحْرِمٌ فِي رَأْسِهِ مِنْ شَقِيقَةٍ كَانَتْ بِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an hishaamin, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, ahtajama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy raasihi wahwa muhrimun min waja'in kaana bihi bimaa'in yuqaalu lahu lahau jamalin‏.‏ waqaala muhammadu bnu sawaa'in aakhbaranaa hishaamun, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ahtajama wahwa muhrimun fiy raasihi min shaqiyqaain kaanat bihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was cupped on his head for an ailment he was suffering from while he was in a state of Ihram. at a water place called Lahl Jamal. Ibn `Abbas further said: Allah's Apostle was cupped on his head for unilateral headache while he was in a state of Ihram
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْغَسِيلِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَاصِمُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنْ كَانَ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ أَدْوِيَتِكُمْ خَيْرٌ فَفِي شَرْبَةِ عَسَلٍ أَوْ شَرْطَةِ مِحْجَمٍ أَوْ لَذْعَةٍ مِنْ نَارٍ، وَمَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَكْتَوِيَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu aabaana, haddathanaa abnu alghasiyli, qaala haddathaniy 'aasimu bnu 'umara, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iin kaana fiy shaa'in min aadwiyatikum khayrun fafiy sharbaai 'asalin aaw shartaai mihjamin aaw ladh'aain min naarin, wamaa auhibbu aan aaktawiya ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "If there is any good in your medicines, then it is in a gulp of honey, a cupping operation, or branding (cauterization), but I do not like to be (cauterized) branded
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُجَاهِدًا، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ كَعْبٍ، هُوَ ابْنُ عُجْرَةَ قَالَ أَتَى عَلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَمَنَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ، وَأَنَا أُوقِدُ تَحْتَ بُرْمَةٍ، وَالْقَمْلُ يَتَنَاثَرُ عَنْ رَأْسِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُؤْذِيكَ هَوَامُّكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاحْلِقْ وَصُمْ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ، أَوْ أَطْعِمْ سِتَّةً، أَوِ انْسُكْ نَسِيكَةً ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَيُّوبُ لاَ أَدْرِي بِأَيَّتِهِنَّ بَدَأَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, qaala sami'tu mujaahidana, 'ani abni aabiy laylaa, 'an ka'bin, huwa abnu 'ujraaa qaala aataa 'alaaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm zamana alhudaybiyaai, waaanaa auwqidu tahta burmaain, waalqamlu yatanaatharu 'an raasiy faqaala ‏"‏ aayuudhiyka hawaammuka ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faahliq wasum thalaathaaa aayyaamin, aaw aat'im sittaaan, aawi ansuk nasiykaaan ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aayyuwbu laa aadriy biaayyatihinna badaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ka`b bin Ujrah:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to me during the period of Al-Hudaibiya, while I was lighting fire underneath a cooking pot and lice were falling down my head. He said, "Do your lice hurt your?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Shave your head and fast for three days or feed six poor persons or slaughter a sheep as a sacrifice:
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، هِشَامُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الْغَسِيلِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ كَانَ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ أَدْوِيَتِكُمْ شِفَاءٌ فَفِي شَرْطَةِ مِحْجَمٍ أَوْ لَذْعَةٍ بِنَارٍ، وَمَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَكْتَوِيَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, hishaamu bnu 'abdi almaliki haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu sulaymaana bni alghasiyli, haddathanaa 'aasimu bnu 'umara bni qataadaaa, qaala sami'tu jaabirana, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iin kaana fiy shaa'in min aadwiyatikum shifaa'un fafiy shartaai mihjamin aaw ladh'aain binaarin, wamaa auhibbu aan aaktawiya ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If there is any healing in your medicines then it is a cupping operation, or branding (cauterization), but I do not like to be (cauterized) branded
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
