verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala sami'tu alzzuhriyya, qaala aakhbaraniy saalimun, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yalbasu almuhrimu alqamiysa, walaa al'imaamaaa, walaa alssaraawiyla, walaa alburnusa, walaa thawbana massahu za'faraanun, walaa warsun, walaa alkhuffayni, iilaaa liman lam yajidi alnna'layni, faiin lam yajidhumaa falyaqta'humaa aasfala mina alka'bayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A Muhrim should not wear a shirt, a turban, trousers, hooded cloaks, a garment touched with (perfumes) of saffron or wars, or Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather) except if one has no sandals in which case he should cut short the Khuffs below the ankles
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ هَاجَرَ إِلَى الْحَبَشَةِ نَاسٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَتَجَهَّزَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مُهَاجِرًا، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ عَلَى رِسْلِكَ، فَإِنِّي أَرْجُو أَنْ يُؤْذَنَ لِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَوَ تَرْجُوهُ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَحَبَسَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ نَفْسَهُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِصُحْبَتِهِ، وَعَلَفَ رَاحِلَتَيْنِ كَانَتَا عِنْدَهُ وَرَقَ السَّمُرِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ‏.‏ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَبَيْنَا نَحْنُ يَوْمًا جُلُوسٌ فِي بَيْتِنَا فِي نَحْرِ الظَّهِيرَةِ فَقَالَ قَائِلٌ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ هَذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُقْبِلاً مُتَقَنِّعًا، فِي سَاعَةٍ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَأْتِينَا فِيهَا‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فِدًا لَهُ بِأَبِي وَأُمِّي، وَاللَّهِ إِنْ جَاءَ بِهِ فِي هَذِهِ السَّاعَةِ إِلاَّ لأَمْرٍ‏.‏ فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَأْذَنَ، فَأَذِنَ لَهُ فَدَخَلَ، فَقَالَ حِينَ دَخَلَ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ ‏"‏ أَخْرِجْ مَنْ عِنْدَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّمَا هُمْ أَهْلُكَ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنِّي قَدْ أُذِنَ لِي فِي الْخُرُوجِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَالصُّحْبَةُ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَخُذْ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِحْدَى رَاحِلَتَىَّ هَاتَيْنِ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بِالثَّمَنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَجَهَّزْنَاهُمَا أَحَثَّ الْجِهَازِ، وَضَعْنَا لَهُمَا سُفْرَةً فِي جِرَابٍ، فَقَطَعَتْ أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قِطْعَةً مِنْ نِطَاقِهَا، فَأَوْكَتْ بِهِ الْجِرَابَ، وَلِذَلِكَ كَانَتْ تُسَمَّى ذَاتَ النِّطَاقِ، ثُمَّ لَحِقَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ بِغَارٍ فِي جَبَلٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ ثَوْرٌ، فَمَكُثَ فِيهِ ثَلاَثَ لَيَالٍ يَبِيتُ عِنْدَهُمَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَهْوَ غُلاَمٌ شَابٌّ لَقِنٌ ثَقِفٌ، فَيَرْحَلُ مِنْ عِنْدِهِمَا سَحَرًا، فَيُصْبِحُ مَعَ قُرَيْشٍ بِمَكَّةَ كَبَائِتٍ، فَلاَ يَسْمَعُ أَمْرًا يُكَادَانِ بِهِ إِلاَّ وَعَاهُ، حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُمَا بِخَبَرِ ذَلِكَ حِينَ يَخْتَلِطُ الظَّلاَمُ، وَيَرْعَى عَلَيْهِمَا عَامِرُ بْنُ فُهَيْرَةَ مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ مِنْحَةً مِنْ غَنَمٍ، فَيُرِيحُهَا عَلَيْهِمَا حِينَ تَذْهَبُ سَاعَةٌ مِنَ الْعِشَاءِ، فَيَبِيتَانِ فِي رِسْلِهَا حَتَّى يَنْعِقَ بِهَا عَامِرُ بْنُ فُهَيْرَةَ بِغَلَسٍ، يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْ تِلْكَ اللَّيَالِي الثَّلاَثِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat haajara iilaa alhabashaai naasun mina almuslimiyna, watajahhaza aabuw bakrin muhaajirana, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ 'alaa rislika, faiinniy aarjuw aan yuudhana liy ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin aawa tarjuwhu biaabiy aanta qaala ‏"‏ na'am ‏"‏‏.‏ fahabasa aabuw bakrin nafsahu 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm lisuhbatihi, wa'alafa raahilatayni kaanataa 'indahu waraqa alssamuri aarba'aaa aashhurin‏.‏ qaala 'urwaau qaalat 'aaiishaau fabaynaa nahnu yawmana juluwsun fiy baytinaa fiy nahri alzzahiyraai faqaala qaaiilun laabiy bakrin hadhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm muqbilaan mutaqanni'ana, fiy saa'aain lam yakun yaatiynaa fiyhaa‏.‏ qaala aabuw bakrin fidana lahu biaabiy waaummiy, waalllahi iin jaa'a bihi fiy hadhihi alssaa'aai iilaaa laamrin‏.‏ fajaa'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faastaadhana, faaadhina lahu fadakhala, faqaala hiyna dakhala laabiy bakrin ‏"‏ aakhrij man 'indaka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala iinnamaa hum aahluka biaabiy aanta yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinniy qad audhina liy fiy alkhuruwji ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faalssuhbaau biaabiy aanta yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ na'am ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fakhudh biaabiy aanta yaa rasuwla alllahi iihdaa raahilataaaa haatayni‏.‏ qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ bialthhamani ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat fajahhaznaahumaa aahathha aljihaazi, wada'naa lahumaa sufraaan fiy jiraabin, faqata'at aasmaa'u bintu aabiy bakrin qit'aaan min nitaaqihaa, faaawkat bihi aljiraaba, walidhalika kaanat tusammaa dhaata alnnitaaqi, thumma lahiqa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin bighaarin fiy jabalin yuqaalu lahu thawrun, famakutha fiyhi thalaatha layaalin yabiytu 'indahumaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy bakrin, wahwa ghulaamun shaabbun laqinun thaqifun, fayarhalu min 'indihimaa saharana, fayusbihu ma'a qurayshin bimakkaaa kabaaiitin, falaa yasma'u aamrana yukaadaani bihi iilaaa wa'aahu, hattaa yaatiyahumaa bikhabari dhalika hiyna yakhtalitu alzzalaamu, wayar'aa 'alayhimaa 'aamiru bnu fuhayraaa mawlaa aabiy bakrin minhaaan min ghanamin, fayuriyhuhaa 'alayhimaa hiyna tadhhabu saa'aaun mina al'ishaa'i, fayabiytaani fiy rislihaa hattaa yan'iqa bihaa 'aamiru bnu fuhayraaa bighalasin, yaf'alu dhalika kulla laylaain min tilka alllayaaliy althhalaathi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Some Muslim men emigrated to Ethiopia whereupon Abu Bakr also prepared himself for the emigration, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Wait, for I hope that Allah will allow me also to emigrate." Abu Bakr said, "Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you. Do you hope that (emigration)?" The Prophet said, 'Yes." So Abu Bakr waited to accompany the Prophet (ﷺ) and fed two she-camels he had on the leaves of As-Samur tree regularly for four months One day while we were sitting in our house at midday, someone said to Abu Bakr, "Here is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), coming with his head and a part of his face covered with a cloth-covering at an hour he never used to come to us." Abu Bakr said, "Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you, (O Prophet)! An urgent matter must have brought you here at this hour." The Prophet (ﷺ) came and asked the permission to enter, and he was allowed. The Prophet (ﷺ) entered and said to Abu Bakr, "Let those who are with you, go out." Abu Bakr replied, "(There is no stranger); they are your family. Let my father be sacrificed for you, O Allah's Apostle!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been allowed to leave (Mecca)." Abu Bakr said, " I shall accompany you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), Let my father be sacrificed for you!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes," Abu Bakr said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let my father be sacrificed for you. Take one of these two shecamels of mine" The Prophet (ﷺ) said. I will take it only after paying its price." So we prepared their baggage and put their journey food In a leather bag. And Asma' bint Abu Bakr cut a piece of her girdle and tied the mouth of the leather bag with it. That is why she was called Dhatan- Nitaqaln. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr went to a cave in a mountain called Thour and remained there for three nights. `Abdullah bin Abu Bakr. who was a young intelligent man. used to stay with them at night and leave before dawn so that in the morning, he would he with the Quraish at Mecca as if he had spent the night among them. If he heard of any plot contrived by the Quraish against the Prophet and Abu Bakr, he would understand it and (return to) inform them of it when it became dark. 'Amir bin Fuhaira, the freed slave of Abu Bakr used to graze a flock of milch sheep for them and he used to take those sheep to them when an hour had passed after the `Isha prayer. They would sleep soundly till 'Amir bin Fuhaira awakened them when it was still dark. He used to do that in each of those three nights
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ مَكَّةَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ وَعَلَى رَأْسِهِ الْمِغْفَرُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa maalikun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala makkaaa 'aama alfathi wa'alaa raasihi almighfaru‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:In the year of the conquest of Mecca the Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca, wearing a helmet on his head
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَمْشِي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعَلَيْهِ بُرْدٌ نَجْرَانِيٌّ غَلِيظُ الْحَاشِيَةِ، فَأَدْرَكَهُ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَجَبَذَهُ بِرِدَائِهِ جَبْذَةً شَدِيدَةً، حَتَّى نَظَرْتُ إِلَى صَفْحَةِ عَاتِقِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ أَثَّرَتْ بِهَا حَاشِيَةُ الْبُرْدِ مِنْ شِدَّةِ جَبْذَتِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ مُرْ لِي مِنْ مَالِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي عِنْدَكَ‏.‏ فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ ضَحِكَ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ لَهُ بِعَطَاءٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kuntu aamshiy ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'alayhi burdun najraaniyyun ghaliyzu alhaashiyaai, faaadrakahu aa'raabiyyun fajabadhahu biridaaiihi jabdhaaan shadiydaaan, hattaa nazartu iilaa safhaai 'aatiqi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad aathharat bihaa haashiyaau alburdi min shiddaai jabdhatihi, thumma qaala yaa muhammadu mur liy min maali alllahi alladhiy 'indaka‏.‏ faaltafata iilayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma dahika thumma aamara lahu bi'ataa'in‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once I was walking with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he was wearing a Najram Burd with thick margin. A bedouin followed him and pulled his Burd so violently that I noticed the side of the shoulder of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) affected by the margin of the Burd because of that violent pull. The Bedouin said, "O Muhammad! Give me some of Allah's wealth which is with you." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned and looked at him, and smiling, 'he ordered that he be given something
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ بِبُرْدَةٍ ـ قَالَ سَهْلٌ هَلْ تَدْرِي مَا الْبُرْدَةُ قَالَ نَعَمْ هِيَ الشَّمْلَةُ، مَنْسُوجٌ فِي حَاشِيَتِهَا ـ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي نَسَجْتُ هَذِهِ بِيَدِي أَكْسُوكَهَا‏.‏ فَأَخَذَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُحْتَاجًا إِلَيْهَا، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْنَا وَإِنَّهَا لإِزَارُهُ، فَجَسَّهَا رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اكْسُنِيهَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَلَسَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ، فَطَوَاهَا ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَ بِهَا إِلَيْهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْقَوْمُ مَا أَحْسَنْتَ، سَأَلْتَهَا إِيَّاهُ وَقَدْ عَرَفْتَ أَنَّهُ لاَ يَرُدُّ سَائِلاً‏.‏ فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ وَاللَّهِ مَا سَأَلْتُهَا إِلاَّ لِتَكُونَ كَفَنِي يَوْمَ أَمُوتُ‏.‏ قَالَ سَهْلٌ فَكَانَتْ كَفَنَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, qaala jaa'ati amraaaaun biburdaain qaala sahlun hal tadriy maa alburdaau qaala na'am hiya alshhamlaau, mansuwjun fiy haashiyatihaa qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy nasajtu hadhihi biyadiy aaksuwkahaa‏.‏ faaakhadhahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm muhtaajana iilayhaa, fakharaja iilaynaa waiinnahaa liizaaruhu, fajassahaa rajulun mina alqawmi faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aksuniyhaa‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ na'am ‏"‏‏.‏ fajalasa maa shaa'a alllahu fiy almajlisi, thumma raja'a, fatawaahaa thumma aarsala bihaa iilayhi‏.‏ faqaala lahu alqawmu maa aahsanta, saaaltahaa iiyyaahu waqad 'arafta aannahu laa yaruddu saaiilaan‏.‏ faqaala alrrajulu waalllahi maa saaaltuhaa iilaaa litakuwna kafaniy yawma aamuwtu‏.‏ qaala sahlun fakaanat kafanahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Hazim:Shahl bin Sa`d said, "A lady came with a Burda. Sahl then asked (the people), "Do you know what Burda is?" Somebody said, "Yes. it is a Shamla with a woven border." Sahl added, "The lady said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have knitted this (Burda) with my own hands for you to wear it." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took it and he was in need of it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out to us and he was wearing it as an Izar. A man from the people felt it and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Give it to me to wear.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Yes.' Then he sat there for some time (and when he went to his house), he folded it and sent it to him. The people said to that man, 'You have not done a right thing. You asked him for it, though you know that he does not put down anybody's request.' The man said, 'By Allah! I have only asked him so that it may be my shroud when I die." Sahl added, "Late it was his shroud
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي زُمْرَةٌ هِيَ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا، تُضِيءُ وُجُوهُهُمْ إِضَاءَةَ الْقَمَرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَامَ عُكَاشَةُ بْنُ مِحْصَنٍ الأَسَدِيُّ يَرْفَعُ نَمِرَةً عَلَيْهِ قَالَ ادْعُ اللَّهَ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ سَبَقَكَ عُكَاشَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, aanna aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ yadkhulu aljannaaa min aummatiy zumraaun hiya sab'uwna aalfana, tudiy'u wujuwhuhum iidaa'aaa alqamari ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaama 'ukaashaau bnu mihsanin alaasadiyyu yarfa'u namiraaan 'alayhi qaala ad'u alllaha liy yaa rasuwla alllahi aan yaj'alaniy minhum‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma aj'alhu minhum ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaama rajulun mina alaansaari faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi ‏"‏ sabaqaka 'ukaashaau ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "From among my followers, a group (o 70,000) will enter Paradise without being asked for their accounts, Their faces will be shining like the moon." 'Ukasha bin Muhsin Al-Asadi got up, lifting his covering sheet and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Invoke Allah for me that He may include me with them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said! "O Allah! Make him from them." Then another man from Al-Ansar got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah for me that He may include me with them." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "'Ukasha has anticipated you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ أَىُّ الثِّيَابِ كَانَ أَحَبَّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ الْحِبَرَةُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aasimin, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, qaala qultu lahu aaaau althhiyaabi kaana aahabba iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala alhibaraau‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qatada:I asked Anas, "What kind of clothes was most beloved to the Prophet?" He replied, "The Hibra (a kind of Yemenese cloth)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ أَحَبُّ الثِّيَابِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَلْبَسَهَا الْحِبَرَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy alaaswadi, haddathanaa mu'aadhun, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, rda allh 'nh qaala kaana aahabbu althhiyaabi iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yalbasahaa alhibaraaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The most beloved garment to the Prophet (ﷺ) to wear was the Hibra (a kind of Yemenese cloth)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ تُوُفِّيَ سُجِّيَ بِبُرْدٍ حِبَرَةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarathu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna tuwuffiya sujjiya biburdin hibaraain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died, he was covered with a Hibra Burd (green square decorated garment)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، وَعَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، رضى الله عنهم قَالاَ لَمَّا نَزَلَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم طَفِقَ يَطْرَحُ خَمِيصَةً لَهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ، فَإِذَا اغْتَمَّ كَشَفَهَا عَنْ وَجْهِهِ، فَقَالَ وَهْوَ كَذَلِكَ ‏ "‏ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الْيَهُودِ وَالنَّصَارَى اتَّخَذُوا قُبُورَ أَنْبِيَائِهِمْ مَسَاجِدَ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُحَذِّرُ مَا صَنَعُوا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, aanna 'aaiishaaa, wa'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin, rda allh 'nhm qaalaa lammaa nazala birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm tafiqa yatrahu khamiysaaan lahu 'alaa wajhihi, faiidhaa aghtamma kashafahaa 'an wajhihi, faqaala wahwa kadhalika ‏ "‏ la'naau alllahi 'alaa alyahuwdi waalnnasaaraa attakhadhuwa qubuwra aanbiyaaiihim masaajida ‏"‏‏.‏ yuhadhhiru maa sana'uwa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha and `Abdullah bin `Abbas:When the disease of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got aggravated, he covered his face with a Khamisa, but when he became short of breath, he would remove it from his face and say, "It is like that! May Allah curse the Jews Christians because they took the graves of their prophets as places of worship." By that he warned his follower of imitating them, by doing that which they did
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي خَمِيصَةٍ لَهُ لَهَا أَعْلاَمٌ، فَنَظَرَ إِلَى أَعْلاَمِهَا نَظْرَةً، فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اذْهَبُوا بِخَمِيصَتِي هَذِهِ إِلَى أَبِي جَهْمٍ، فَإِنَّهَا أَلْهَتْنِي آنِفًا عَنْ صَلاَتِي، وَائْتُونِي بِأَنْبِجَانِيَّةِ أَبِي جَهْمِ بْنِ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ غَانِمٍ مِنْ بَنِي عَدِيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, haddathanaa abnu shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy khamiysaain lahu lahaa aa'laamun, fanazara iilaa aa'laamihaa nazraaan, falammaa sallama qaala ‏ "‏ adhhabuwa bikhamiysatiy hadhihi iilaa aabiy jahmin, faiinnahaa aalhatniy anifana 'an salaatiy, waaituwniy biaanbijaaniyyaai aabiy jahmi bni hudhayfaaa bni ghaanimin min baniy 'adiyyi bni ka'bin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered prayer while he was wearing a Khamisa of his that had printed marks. He looked at its marks and when he finished prayer, he said, "Take this Khamisa of mine to Abu Jahm, for it has just now diverted my attention from my prayer, and bring to me the Anbijania (a plain thick sheet) of Abu Jahm bin Hudhaifa bin Ghanim who belonged to Bani Adi bin Ka`b
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، قَالَ أَخْرَجَتْ إِلَيْنَا عَائِشَةُ كِسَاءً وَإِزَارًا غَلِيظًا فَقَالَتْ قُبِضَ رُوحُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي هَذَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an humaydi bni hilaalin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, qaala aakhrajat iilaynaa 'aaiishaau kisaa'an waiizaarana ghaliyzana faqaalat qubida ruwhu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hadhayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda:Aisha brought out to us a Kisa and an Izar and said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) died while wearing these two." (Kisa, a square black piece of woolen cloth. Izar, a sheet cloth garment covering the lower half of the body)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ خُبَيْبٍ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمُلاَمَسَةِ، وَالْمُنَابَذَةِ، وَعَنْ صَلاَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَرْتَفِعَ الشَّمْسُ، وَبَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغِيبَ، وَأَنْ يَحْتَبِيَ بِالثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ، لَيْسَ عَلَى فَرْجِهِ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَأَنْ يَشْتَمِلَ الصَّمَّاءَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an khubaybin, 'an hafsi bni 'aasimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani almulaamasaai, waalmunaabadhaai, wa'an salaatayni ba'da alfajri hattaa tartafi'a alshhamsu, waba'da al'asri hattaa taghiyba, waaan yahtabiya bialthhawbi alwaahidi, laysa 'alaa farjihi minhu shaa'un baynahu wabayna alssamaa'i, waaan yashtamila alssammaa'a‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) had forbidden: (A) the Mulamasa and Munabadha (bargains), (B) the offering of two prayers, one after the morning compulsory prayer till the sun rises, and the others, after the `Asr prayer till the sun sets (C) He also forbade that one should sit wearing one garment, nothing of which covers his private parts (D) and prevent them from exposure to the sky; (E) he also forbade Ishtimalas- Samma
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ لِبْسَتَيْنِ وَعَنْ بَيْعَتَيْنِ، نَهَى عَنِ الْمُلاَمَسَةِ وَالْمُنَابَذَةِ فِي الْبَيْعِ، وَالْمُلاَمَسَةُ لَمْسُ الرَّجُلِ ثَوْبَ الآخَرِ بِيَدِهِ بِاللَّيْلِ أَوْ بِالنَّهَارِ، وَلاَ يُقَلِّبُهُ إِلاَّ بِذَلِكَ، وَالْمُنَابَذَةُ أَنْ يَنْبِذَ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ بِثَوْبِهِ، وَيَنْبِذَ الآخَرُ ثَوْبَهُ، وَيَكُونَ ذَلِكَ بَيْعَهُمَا، عَنْ غَيْرِ نَظَرٍ وَلاَ تَرَاضٍ، وَاللِّبْسَتَيْنِ اشْتِمَالُ الصَّمَّاءِ، وَالصَّمَّاءُ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ ثَوْبَهُ عَلَى أَحَدِ عَاتِقَيْهِ، فَيَبْدُو أَحَدُ شِقَّيْهِ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ ثَوْبٌ، وَاللِّبْسَةُ الأُخْرَى احْتِبَاؤُهُ بِثَوْبِهِ وَهْوَ جَالِسٌ، لَيْسَ عَلَى فَرْجِهِ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'aamiru bnu sa'din, aanna aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an libsatayni wa'an bay'atayni, nahaa 'ani almulaamasaai waalmunaabadhaai fiy albay'i, waalmulaamasaau lamsu alrrajuli thawba alakhari biyadihi bialllayli aaw bialnnahaari, walaa yuqallibuhu iilaaa bidhalika, waalmunaabadhaau aan yanbidha alrrajulu iilaa alrrajuli bithawbihi, wayanbidha alakharu thawbahu, wayakuwna dhalika bay'ahumaa, 'an ghayri nazarin walaa taraadin, waalllibsatayni ashtimaalu alssammaa'i, waalssammaa'u aan yaj'ala thawbahu 'alaa aahadi 'aatiqayhi, fayabduw aahadu shiqqayhi laysa 'alayhi thawbun, waalllibsaau alaukhraa ahtibaauuhu bithawbihi wahwa jaalisun, laysa 'alaa farjihi minhu shaa'un‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade two ways of wearing clothes and two kinds of dealings. (A) He forbade the dealings of the Mulamasa and the Munabadha. In the Mulamasa transaction the buyer just touches the garment he wants to buy at night or by daytime, and that touch would oblige him to buy it. In the Munabadha, one man throws his garment at another and the latter throws his at the former and the barter is complete and valid without examining the two objects or being satisfied with them (B) The two ways of wearing clothes were Ishtimal-as-Samma, i e., to cover one's shoulder with one's garment and leave the other bare: and the other way was to wrap oneself with a garment while one was sitting in such a way that nothing of that garment would cover one's private part
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ لِبْسَتَيْنِ أَنْ يَحْتَبِيَ الرَّجُلُ فِي الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ لَيْسَ عَلَى فَرْجِهِ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ، وَأَنْ يَشْتَمِلَ بِالثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ، لَيْسَ عَلَى أَحَدِ شِقَّيْهِ، وَعَنِ الْمُلاَمَسَةِ وَالْمُنَابَذَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an libsatayni aan yahtabiya alrrajulu fiy althhawbi alwaahidi laysa 'alaa farjihi minhu shaa'un, waaan yashtamila bialthhawbi alwaahidi, laysa 'alaa aahadi shiqqayhi, wa'ani almulaamasaai waalmunaabadhaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade two types of dresses: (A) To sit in an Ihtiba' posture in one garment nothing of which covers his private parts. (B) to cover one side of his body with one garment and leave the other side bare The Prophet (ﷺ) also forbade the Mulamasa and Munabadha
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْلَدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ اشْتِمَالِ الصَّمَّاءِ، وَأَنْ يَحْتَبِيَ الرَّجُلُ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ، لَيْسَ عَلَى فَرْجِهِ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadun, qaala aakhbaraniy makhladun, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani ashtimaali alssammaa'i, waaan yahtabiya alrrajulu fiy thawbin waahidin, laysa 'alaa farjihi minhu shaa'un‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade Ishtimal-as-Samma' and that a man should sit in an Ihtiba' posture in one garment, nothing of which covers his private parts
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، سَعِيدِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ ـ هُوَ عَمْرُو بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ ـ عَنْ أُمِّ خَالِدٍ بِنْتِ خَالِدٍ، أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِثِيَابٍ فِيهَا خَمِيصَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ صَغِيرَةٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ تَرَوْنَ نَكْسُو هَذِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَسَكَتَ الْقَوْمُ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْتُونِي بِأُمِّ خَالِدٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأُتِيَ بِهَا تُحْمَلُ فَأَخَذَ الْخَمِيصَةَ بِيَدِهِ فَأَلْبَسَهَا وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَبْلِي وَأَخْلِقِي ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ فِيهَا عَلَمٌ أَخْضَرُ أَوْ أَصْفَرُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أُمَّ خَالِدٍ هَذَا سَنَاهْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَسَنَاهْ بِالْحَبَشِيَّةِ حَسَنٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu sa'iydin, 'an aabiyhi, sa'iydi bni fulaanin huwa 'amruw bnu sa'iydi bni al'aasi 'an aummi khaalidin binti khaalidin, autiya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bithiyaabin fiyhaa khamiysaaun sawdaa'u saghiyraaun faqaala ‏"‏ man tarawna naksuw hadhihi ‏"‏‏.‏ fasakata alqawmu qaala ‏"‏ aituwniy biaummi khaalidin ‏"‏‏.‏ faautiya bihaa tuhmalu faaakhadha alkhamiysaaa biyadihi faaalbasahaa waqaala ‏"‏ aabliy waaakhliqiy ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana fiyhaa 'alamun aakhdaru aaw aasfaru faqaala ‏"‏ yaa aumma khaalidin hadhaa sanaah ‏"‏‏.‏ wasanaah bialhabashiyyaai hasanun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Khalid bint Khalid:The Prophet (ﷺ) was given some clothes including a black Khamisa. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To whom shall we give this to wear?" The people kept silent whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Fetch Um Khalid for me." I (Um Khalid) was brought carried (as I was small girl at that time). The Prophet (ﷺ) took the Khamisa in his hands and made me wear it and said, "May you live so long that your dress will wear out and you will mend it many times." On the Khamisa there were some green or pale designs (The Prophet (ﷺ) saw these designs) and said, "O Um Khalid! This is Sanah." (Sanah in a Ethiopian word meaning beautiful)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا وَلَدَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ قَالَتْ لِي يَا أَنَسُ انْظُرْ هَذَا الْغُلاَمَ فَلاَ يُصِيبَنَّ شَيْئًا حَتَّى تَغْدُوَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَنِّكُهُ‏.‏ فَغَدَوْتُ بِهِ، فَإِذَا هُوَ فِي حَائِطٍ وَعَلَيْهِ خَمِيصَةٌ حُرَيْثِيَّةٌ، وَهْوَ يَسِمُ الظَّهْرَ الَّذِي قَدِمَ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْفَتْحِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathaniy abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'ani abni 'awnin, 'an muhammadin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala lammaa waladat aummu sulaymin qaalat liy yaa aanasu anzur hadhaa alghulaama falaa yusiybanna shayiana hattaa taghduwa bihi iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhannikuhu‏.‏ faghadawtu bihi, faiidhaa huwa fiy haaiitin wa'alayhi khamiysaaun huraythiyyaaun, wahwa yasimu alzzahra alladhiy qadima 'alayhi fiy alfathi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:When Um Sulaim gave birth to a child. she said to me, "O Anas! Watch this boy carefully and do not give him anything to eat or drink until you have taken him to the Prophet (ﷺ) tomorrow morning for the Tahnik." So the next morning I took the child to the Prophet (ﷺ) who was sitting in a garden and was wearing a Huraithiya Khamisa and was branding the she-camel on which he had come during the Conquest of Mecca
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، أَنَّ رِفَاعَةَ، طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ، فَتَزَوَّجَهَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الزَّبِيرِ الْقُرَظِيُّ، قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَعَلَيْهَا خِمَارٌ أَخْضَرُ‏.‏ فَشَكَتْ إِلَيْهَا، وَأَرَتْهَا خُضْرَةً بِجِلْدِهَا، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنِّسَاءُ يَنْصُرُ بَعْضُهُنَّ بَعْضًا قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ مَا رَأَيْتُ مِثْلَ مَا يَلْقَى الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ، لَجِلْدُهَا أَشَدُّ خُضْرَةً مِنْ ثَوْبِهَا‏.‏ قَالَ وَسَمِعَ أَنَّهَا قَدْ أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَاءَ وَمَعَهُ ابْنَانِ لَهُ مِنْ غَيْرِهَا‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ مَا لِي إِلَيْهِ مِنْ ذَنْبٍ، إِلاَّ أَنَّ مَا مَعَهُ لَيْسَ بِأَغْنَى عَنِّي مِنْ هَذِهِ‏.‏ وَأَخَذَتْ هُدْبَةً مِنْ ثَوْبِهَا، فَقَالَ كَذَبَتْ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي لأَنْفُضُهَا نَفْضَ الأَدِيمِ، وَلَكِنَّهَا نَاشِزٌ تُرِيدُ رِفَاعَةَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَإِنْ كَانَ ذَلِكَ لَمْ تَحِلِّي لَهُ ـ أَوْ لَمْ تَصْلُحِي لَهُ ـ حَتَّى يَذُوقَ مِنْ عُسَيْلَتِكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَبْصَرَ مَعَهُ ابْنَيْنِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ بَنُوكَ هَؤُلاَءِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَذَا الَّذِي تَزْعُمِينَ مَا تَزْعُمِينَ، فَوَاللَّهِ لَهُمْ أَشْبَهُ بِهِ مِنَ الْغُرَابِ بِالْغُرَابِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, aakhbaranaa aayyuwbu, 'an 'ikrimaaa, aanna rifaa'aaa, tallaqa amraaatahu, fatazawwajahaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu alzzabiyri alquraziyyu, qaalat 'aaiishaau wa'alayhaa khimaarun aakhdaru‏.‏ fashakat iilayhaa, waaarathaa khudraaan bijildihaa, falammaa jaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalnnisaa'u yansuru ba'duhunna ba'dana qaalat 'aaiishaau maa raaaytu mithla maa yalqaa almuuminaatu, lajilduhaa aashaddu khudraaan min thawbihaa‏.‏ qaala wasami'a aannahaa qad aatat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fajaa'a wama'ahu abnaani lahu min ghayrihaa‏.‏ qaalat waalllahi maa liy iilayhi min dhanbin, iilaaa aanna maa ma'ahu laysa biaaghnaa 'anniy min hadhihi‏.‏ waaakhadhat hudbaaan min thawbihaa, faqaala kadhabat waalllahi yaa rasuwla alllahi, iinniy laanfuduhaa nafda alaadiymi, walakinnahaa naashizun turiydu rifaa'aaa‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ faiin kaana dhalika lam tahilliy lahu aaw lam tasluhiy lahu hattaa yadhuwqa min 'usaylatiki ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala waaabsara ma'ahu abnayni faqaala ‏"‏ banuwka hauulaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ hadhaa alladhiy taz'umiyna maa taz'umiyna, fawaalllahi lahum aashbahu bihi mina alghuraabi bialghuraabi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ikrima:Rifa`a divorced his wife whereupon `AbdurRahman bin Az-Zubair Al-Qurazi married her. `Aisha said that the lady (came), wearing a green veil (and complained to her (Aisha) of her husband and showed her a green spot on her skin caused by beating). It was the habit of ladies to support each other, so when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came, `Aisha said, "I have not seen any woman suffering as much as the believing women. Look! Her skin is greener than her clothes!" When `AbdurRahman heard that his wife had gone to the Prophet, he came with his two sons from another wife. She said, "By Allah! I have done no wrong to him but he is impotent and is as useless to me as this," holding and showing the fringe of her garment, `Abdur-Rahman said, "By Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! She has told a lie! I am very strong and can satisfy her but she is disobedient and wants to go back to Rifa`a." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, to her, "If that is your intention, then know that it is unlawful for you to remarry Rifa`a unless `Abdur-Rahman has had sexual intercourse with you." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) saw two boys with `Abdur- Rahman and asked (him), "Are these your sons?" On that `AbdurRahman said, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You claim what you claim (i.e.. that he is impotent)? But by Allah, these boys resemble him as a crow resembles a crow
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ بِشِمَالِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِيَمِينِهِ رَجُلَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا ثِيَابٌ بِيضٌ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ، مَا رَأَيْتُهُمَا قَبْلُ وَلاَ بَعْدُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa mis'arun, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sa'din, qaala raaaytu bishimaali alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wabiyamiynihi rajulayni 'alayhimaa thiyaabun biydun yawma auhudin, maa raaaytuhumaa qablu walaa ba'du‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d:On the day of the battle of Uhud, on the right and on the left of the Prophet (ﷺ) were two men wearing white clothes, and I had neither seen them before, nor did I see them afterwards
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ يَعْمَرَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا الأَسْوَدِ الدِّيلِيَّ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا ذَرٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعَلَيْهِ ثَوْبٌ أَبْيَضُ وَهْوَ نَائِمٌ، ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ وَقَدِ اسْتَيْقَظَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ ثُمَّ مَاتَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ، إِلاَّ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ عَلَى رَغْمِ أَنْفِ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ أَبُو ذَرٍّ إِذَا حَدَّثَ بِهَذَا قَالَ وَإِنْ رَغِمَ أَنْفُ أَبِي ذَرٍّ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ هَذَا عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ أَوْ قَبْلَهُ، إِذَا تَابَ وَنَدِمَ وَقَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ غُفِرَ لَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'ani alhusayni, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni buraydaaa, 'an yahyaa bni ya'mara, haddathahu aanna aabaa alaaswadi alddiyliyya haddathahu aanna aabaa dharrin rda allh 'nh haddathahu qaala aataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'alayhi thawbun aabyadu wahwa naaiimun, thumma aataytuhu waqadi astayqaza faqaala ‏"‏ maa min 'abdin qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu‏.‏ thumma maata 'alaa dhalika, iilaaa dakhala aljannaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu waiin zanaa waiin saraqa qaala ‏"‏ waiin zanaa waiin saraqa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu waiin zanaa waiin saraqa qaala ‏"‏ waiin zanaa waiin saraqa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu waiin zanaa waiin saraqa qaala ‏"‏ waiin zanaa waiin saraqa 'alaa raghmi aanfi aabiy dharrin ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana aabuw dharrin iidhaa haddatha bihadhaa qaala waiin raghima aanfu aabiy dharrin‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi hadhaa 'inda almawti aaw qablahu, iidhaa taaba wanadima waqaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu‏.‏ ghufira lahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Dharr:I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was wearing white clothes and sleeping. Then I went back to him again after he had got up from his sleep. He said, "Nobody says: 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah' and then later on he dies while believing in that, except that he will enter Paradise." I said, "Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft?" He said. 'Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft." I said, "Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft?" He said. 'Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft." I said, 'Even it he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft?' He said, "Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft, inspite of the Abu Dharr's dislike. Abu `Abdullah said, "This is at the time of death or before it if one repents and regrets and says "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah. He will be forgiven his sins
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيَّ، أَتَانَا كِتَابُ عُمَرَ وَنَحْنُ مَعَ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ فَرْقَدٍ بِأَذْرَبِيجَانَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْحَرِيرِ، إِلاَّ هَكَذَا، وَأَشَارَ بِإِصْبَعَيْهِ اللَّتَيْنِ تَلِيَانِ الإِبْهَامَ قَالَ فِيمَا عَلِمْنَا أَنَّهُ يَعْنِي الأَعْلاَمَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa qataadaau, qaala sami'tu aabaa 'uthmaana alnnahdiyya, aataanaa kitaabu 'umara wanahnu ma'a 'utbaaa bni farqadin biaadhrabiyjaana aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alhariyri, iilaaa hakadhaa, waaashaara biiisba'ayhi alllatayni taliyaani aliibhaama qaala fiymaa 'alimnaa aannahu ya'niy alaa'laama‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aba `Uthman An-Nahdi:While we were with `Utba bin Farqad at Adharbijan, there came `Umar's letter indicating that Allah's Apostle had forbidden the use of silk except this much, then he pointed with his index and middle fingers. To our knowledge, by that he meant embroidery
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، قَالَ كَتَبَ إِلَيْنَا عُمَرُ وَنَحْنُ بِأَذْرَبِيجَانَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ لُبْسِ الْحَرِيرِ إِلاَّ هَكَذَا، وَصَفَّ لَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِصْبَعَيْهِ‏.‏ وَرَفَعَ زُهَيْرٌ الْوُسْطَى وَالسَّبَّابَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa 'aasimun, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, qaala kataba iilaynaa 'umaru wanahnu biaadhrabiyjaana aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an lubsi alhariyri iilaaa hakadhaa, wasaffa lanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iisba'ayhi‏.‏ warafa'a zuhayrun alwustaa waalssabbaabaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu `Uthman:While we were at Adharbijan, `Umar wrote to us: 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade wearing silk except this much. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) approximated his two fingers (index and middle fingers) (to illustrate that) to us.' Zuhair (the sub-narrator) raised up his middle and index fingers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنِ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ عُتْبَةَ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يُلْبَسُ الْحَرِيرُ فِي الدُّنْيَا، إِلاَّ لَمْ يُلْبَسْ فِي الآخِرَةِ مِنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ،، وَأَشَارَ أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، بِإِصْبَعَيْهِ الْمُسَبِّحَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa musadaadun, hadaathanaa yahyaa, 'ani altaaymiyii, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, qaala kunaaa ma'a 'utbaaa fakataba iilayhi 'umaru rda allh 'nh aanaa alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yulbasu alhariyru fiy alduunyaa, iilaaa lam yulbas fiy alakhiraai minhu ‏"‏‏.‏ hadaathanaa alhasanu bnu 'umara, hadaathanaa mu'tamirun, hadaathanaa aabiy, hadaathanaa aabuw 'uthmaana, , waaashaara aabuw 'uthmaana, biiisba'ayhi almusabiihaai waalwustaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu `Uthman:While we were with `Utba. `Umar wrote to us: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is none who wears silk in this world except that he will wear nothing of it in the Hereafter." ' Abu `Uthman pointed out with his middle and index fingers. This hadith has also been narrated by Abu `Uthman
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ كَانَ حُذَيْفَةُ بِالْمَدَايِنِ فَاسْتَسْقَى، فَأَتَاهُ دِهْقَانٌ بِمَاءٍ فِي إِنَاءٍ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ فَرَمَاهُ بِهِ وَقَالَ إِنِّي لَمْ أَرْمِهِ إِلاَّ أَنِّي نَهَيْتُهُ فَلَمْ يَنْتَهِ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الذَّهَبُ وَالْفِضَّةُ وَالْحَرِيرُ وَالدِّيبَاجُ هِيَ لَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا، وَلَكُمْ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'ani abni aabiy laylaa, qaala kaana hudhayfaau bialmadaayini faastasqaa, faaataahu dihqaanun bimaa'in fiy iinaa'in min fiddaain faramaahu bihi waqaala iinniy lam aarmihi iilaaa aanniy nahaytuhu falam yantahi qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aldhhahabu waalfiddaau waalhariyru waalddiybaaju hiya lahum fiy alddunyaa, walakum fiy alakhiraai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Abi Laila:While Hudhaifa was at Al-Madain, he asked for water whereupon the chief of the village brought him water in a silver cup. Hudhaifa threw it at him and said, "I have thrown it only because I have forbidden him to use it, but he does not stop using it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Gold, silver, silk and Dibaj (a kind of silk) are for them (unbelievers) in this world and for you (Muslims) in the hereafter
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ فَقُلْتُ أَعَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ شَدِيدًا عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَبِسَ الْحَرِيرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا فَلَنْ يَلْبَسَهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu suhaybin, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin qaala shu'baau faqultu aa'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala shadiydana 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ man labisa alhariyra fiy alddunyaa falan yalbasahu fiy alakhiraai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Whoever wears silk in this world shall not wear it in the Hereafter
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، يَخْطُبُ يَقُولُ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَبِسَ الْحَرِيرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يَلْبَسْهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an thaabitin, qaala sami'tu abna alzzubayri, yakhtubu yaquwlu qaala muhammadun sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man labisa alhariyra fiy alddunyaa lam yalbashu fiy alakhiraai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Thabit:I heard Ibn Az-Zubair delivering a sermon, saying, "Muhammad said, 'Whoever wears silk in this world, shall not wear it in the Hereafter
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْجَعْدِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي ذُبْيَانَ، خَلِيفَةَ بْنِ كَعْبٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَبِسَ الْحَرِيرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يَلْبَسْهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ لَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، قَالَتْ مُعَاذَةُ أَخْبَرَتْنِي أُمُّ عَمْرٍو بِنْتُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، سَمِعَ عُمَرَ، سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏ نَحْوَهُ
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu alja'di, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy dhubyaana, khaliyfaaa bni ka'bin qaala sami'tu abna alzzubayri, yaquwlu sami'tu 'umara, yaquwlu qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man labisa alhariyra fiy alddunyaa lam yalbashu fiy alakhiraai ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala lanaa aabuw ma'marin hadaathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an yaziyda, qaalat mu'aadhaau aakhbaratniy aumuu 'amrinw bintu 'abdi allaahi, sami'tu 'abda allaahi bna alzuubayri, sami'a 'umara, sami'a alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm‏ nahwahu
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Az-Zubair:I heard `Umar saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever wears silk in this world, shall not wear it in the Hereafter." This hadith is also narrated through 'Umar ibn al-Khattab
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حِطَّانَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ عَنِ الْحَرِيرِ، فَقَالَتِ ائْتِ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَسَلْهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ سَلِ ابْنَ عُمَرَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو حَفْصٍ ـ يَعْنِي عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا يَلْبَسُ الْحَرِيرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا مَنْ لاَ خَلاَقَ لَهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ صَدَقَ وَمَا كَذَبَ أَبُو حَفْصٍ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنِي عِمْرَانُ‏.‏ وَقَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu almubaaraki, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an 'imraana bni hittaana, qaala saaaltu 'aaiishaaa 'ani alhariyri, faqaalati aiti abna 'abbaasin fasalhu‏.‏ qaala fasaaaltuhu faqaala sali abna 'umara‏.‏ qaala fasaaaltu abna 'umara faqaala aakhbaraniy aabuw hafsin ya'niy 'umara bna alkhattaabi aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa yalbasu alhariyra fiy alddunyaa man laa khalaaqa lahu fiy alakhiraai ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu sadaqa wamaa kadhaba aabuw hafsin 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ waqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu rajaa'in haddathanaa harbun 'an yahyaa haddathaniy 'imraanu‏.‏ waqassa alhadiytha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (ra):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "None wears silk in this world, but he who will have no share in the Hereafter
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أُهْدِيَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَوْبُ حَرِيرٍ، فَجَعَلْنَا نَلْمُسُهُ، وَنَتَعَجَّبُ مِنْهُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَتَعْجَبُونَ مِنْ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنَادِيلُ سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an iisraaiiyla, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i rda allh 'nh qaala auhdiya lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thawbu hariyrin, faja'alnaa nalmusuhu, wanata'ajjabu minhu, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aata'jabuwna min hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qulnaa na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ manaadiylu sa'di bni mu'aadhin fiy aljannaai khayrun min hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) was given a silk garment as a gift and we started touching it with our hands and admiring it. On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you wonder at this?" We said, "Yes." He said, "The handkerchiefs of Sa`d bin Mu`adh in Paradise are better than this
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ نَهَانَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نَشْرَبَ فِي آنِيَةِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ، وَأَنْ نَأْكُلَ فِيهَا، وَعَنْ لُبْسِ الْحَرِيرِ وَالدِّيبَاجِ، وَأَنْ نَجْلِسَ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, haddathanaa aabiy qaala, sami'tu abna aabiy najiyhin, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni aabiy laylaa, 'an hudhayfaaa rda allh 'nh qaala nahaanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan nashraba fiy aniyaai aldhhahabi waalfiddaai, waaan naakula fiyhaa, wa'an lubsi alhariyri waalddiybaaji, waaan najlisa 'alayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hudhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us to drink out of gold and silver vessels, or eat in it, Ann also forbade the wearing of silk and Dibaj or sitting on it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ مُقَرِّنٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ نَهَانَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمَيَاثِرِ الْحُمْرِ وَالْقَسِّيِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an aash'atha bni aabiy alshha'thaa'i, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau bnu suwaydi bni muqarrinin, 'ani abni 'aazibin, qaala nahaanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani almayaathiri alhumri waalqassiyyi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Azib:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us to use the red Mayathir and to use Al-Qassiy
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ رَخَّصَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلزُّبَيْرِ وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فِي لُبْسِ الْحَرِيرِ لِحِكَّةٍ بِهِمَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadun, aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, qaala rakhhasa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm lilzzubayri wa'abdi alrrahmani fiy lubsi alhariyri lihikkaain bihimaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) allowed Az-Zubair and `Abdur-Rahman to wear silk because they were suffering from an itch
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَسَانِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حُلَّةً سِيَرَاءَ، فَخَرَجْتُ فِيهَا، فَرَأَيْتُ الْغَضَبَ فِي وَجْهِهِ، فَشَقَّقْتُهَا بَيْنَ نِسَائِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'baau, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni maysaraaa, 'an zaydi bni wahbin, 'an 'aliyyin rda allh 'nh qaala kasaaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm hullaaan siyaraa'a, fakharajtu fiyhaa, faraaaytu alghadaba fiy wajhihi, fashaqqaqtuhaa bayna nisaaiiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali bin Abi Talib:The Prophet (ﷺ) gave me a silk suit. I went out wearing it, but seeing the signs of anger on his face, I tore it and distributed it among my wives
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ رَأَى حُلَّةً سِيَرَاءَ تُبَاعُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوِ ابْتَعْتَهَا، تَلْبَسُهَا لِلْوَفْدِ إِذَا أَتَوْكَ وَالْجُمُعَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا يَلْبَسُ هَذِهِ مَنْ لاَ خَلاَقَ لَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ إِلَى عُمَرَ حُلَّةَ سِيَرَاءَ حَرِيرٍ، كَسَاهَا إِيَّاهُ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ كَسَوْتَنِيهَا وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُكَ تَقُولُ فِيهَا مَا قُلْتَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا بَعَثْتُ إِلَيْكَ لِتَبِيعَهَا أَوْ تَكْسُوَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathaniy juwayriyaau, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'umara rda allh 'nh raaaa hullaaan siyaraa'a tubaa'u faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi lawi abta'tahaa, talbasuhaa lilwafdi iidhaa aatawka waaljumu'aai‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa yalbasu hadhihi man laa khalaaqa lahu ‏"‏‏.‏ waaanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'atha ba'da dhalika iilaa 'umara hullaaa siyaraa'a hariyrin, kasaahaa iiyyaahu faqaala 'umaru kasawtaniyhaa waqad sami'tuka taquwlu fiyhaa maa qulta faqaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa ba'athtu iilayka litabiy'ahaa aaw taksuwahaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar saw a silk suit being sold, so he said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why don't you buy it so that you may wear it when delegates come to you, and also on Fridays?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is worn only by him who has no share in the Hereafter." Afterwards the Prophet (ﷺ) sent to `Umar a silk suit suitable for wearing. `Umar said to the Prophet, "You have given it to me to wear, yet I have heard you saying about it what you said?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I sent it to you so that you might either sell it or give it to somebody else to wear
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ رَأَى عَلَى أُمِّ كُلْثُومٍ ـ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ ـ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بُرْدَ حَرِيرٍ سِيَرَاءَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aanasu bnu maalikin, aannahu raaaa 'alaa aummi kulthuwmin 'alayhaa alssalaamu binti rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm burda hariyrin siyaraa'a‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:that he had seen Um Kulthum, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , wearing a red silk garment
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَبِثْتُ سَنَةً وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَ عُمَرَ عَنِ الْمَرْأَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ تَظَاهَرَتَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَعَلْتُ أَهَابُهُ، فَنَزَلَ يَوْمًا مَنْزِلاً فَدَخَلَ الأَرَاكَ، فَلَمَّا خَرَجَ سَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ عَائِشَةُ وَحَفْصَةُ ـ ثُمَّ قَالَ ـ كُنَّا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ لاَ نَعُدُّ النِّسَاءَ شَيْئًا، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ الإِسْلاَمُ وَذَكَرَهُنَّ اللَّهُ، رَأَيْنَا لَهُنَّ بِذَلِكَ عَلَيْنَا حَقًّا، مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ نُدْخِلَهُنَّ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ أُمُورِنَا، وَكَانَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ امْرَأَتِي كَلاَمٌ فَأَغْلَظَتْ لِي فَقُلْتُ لَهَا وَإِنَّكِ لَهُنَاكِ‏.‏ قَالَتْ تَقُولُ هَذَا لِي وَابْنَتُكَ تُؤْذِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَيْتُ حَفْصَةَ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا إِنِّي أُحَذِّرُكِ أَنْ تَعْصِي اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ‏.‏ وَتَقَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْهَا فِي أَذَاهُ، فَأَتَيْتُ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ أَعْجَبُ مِنْكَ يَا عُمَرُ قَدْ دَخَلْتَ فِي أُمُورِنَا، فَلَمْ يَبْقَ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَدْخُلَ بَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَزْوَاجِهِ، فَرَدَّدَتْ، وَكَانَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ إِذَا غَابَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَشَهِدْتُهُ أَتَيْتُهُ بِمَا يَكُونُ، وَإِذَا غِبْتُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَشَهِدَ أَتَانِي بِمَا يَكُونُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ مَنْ حَوْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدِ اسْتَقَامَ لَهُ، فَلَمْ يَبْقَ إِلاَّ مَلِكُ غَسَّانَ بِالشَّأْمِ، كُنَّا نَخَافُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَنَا، فَمَا شَعَرْتُ إِلاَّ بِالأَنْصَارِيِّ وَهْوَ يَقُولُ إِنَّهُ قَدْ حَدَثَ أَمْرٌ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَهُ وَمَا هُوَ أَجَاءَ الْغَسَّانِيُّ قَالَ أَعْظَمُ مِنْ ذَاكَ، طَلَّقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نِسَاءَهُ‏.‏ فَجِئْتُ فَإِذَا الْبُكَاءُ مِنْ حُجَرِهَا كُلِّهَا، وَإِذَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ صَعِدَ فِي مَشْرُبَةٍ لَهُ، وَعَلَى باب الْمَشْرُبَةِ وَصِيفٌ فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ اسْتَأْذِنْ لِي‏.‏ فَدَخَلْتُ فَإِذَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى حَصِيرٍ قَدْ أَثَّرَ فِي جَنْبِهِ، وَتَحْتَ رَأْسِهِ مِرْفَقَةٌ مِنْ أَدَمٍ، حَشْوُهَا لِيفٌ، وَإِذَا أُهُبٌ مُعَلَّقَةٌ وَقَرَظٌ، فَذَكَرْتُ الَّذِي قُلْتُ لِحَفْصَةَ وَأُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، وَالَّذِي رَدَّتْ عَلَىَّ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ، فَضَحِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَبِثَ تِسْعًا وَعِشْرِينَ لَيْلَةً، ثُمَّ نَزَلَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an 'ubaydi bni hunaynin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala labithtu sanaaan waaanaa auriydu aan aasaala 'umara 'ani almaraatayni alllatayni tazaaharataa 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faja'altu aahaabuhu, fanazala yawmana manzilaan fadakhala alaaraaka, falammaa kharaja saaaltuhu faqaala 'aaiishaau wahafsaau thumma qaala kunnaa fiy aljaahiliyyaai laa na'uddu alnnisaa'a shayiana, falammaa jaa'a aliislaamu wadhakarahunna alllahu, raaaynaa lahunna bidhalika 'alaynaa haqqana, min ghayri aan nudkhilahunna fiy shaa'in min aumuwrinaa, wakaana bayniy wabayna amraaatiy kalaamun faaaghlazat liy faqultu lahaa waiinnaki lahunaaki‏.‏ qaalat taquwlu hadhaa liy waabnatuka tuudhiy alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faaataytu hafsaaa faqultu lahaa iinniy auhadhhiruki aan ta'siy alllaha warasuwlahu‏.‏ wataqaddamtu iilayhaa fiy aadhaahu, faaataytu aumma salamaaa faqultu lahaa‏.‏ faqaalat aa'jabu minka yaa 'umaru qad dakhalta fiy aumuwrinaa, falam yabqa iilaaa aan tadkhula bayna rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaazwaajihi, faraddadat, wakaana rajulun mina alaansaari iidhaa ghaaba 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm washahidtuhu aataytuhu bimaa yakuwnu, waiidhaa ghibtu 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm washahida aataaniy bimaa yakuwnu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaana man hawla rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qadi astaqaama lahu, falam yabqa iilaaa maliku ghassaana bialshhaami, kunnaa nakhaafu aan yaatiyanaa, famaa sha'artu iilaaa bialaansaariyyi wahwa yaquwlu iinnahu qad hadatha aamrun‏.‏ qultu lahu wamaa huwa aajaa'a alghassaaniyyu qaala aa'zamu min dhaaka, tallaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nisaa'ahu‏.‏ fajiitu faiidhaa albukaa'u min hujarihaa kullihaa, waiidhaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qad sa'ida fiy mashrubaain lahu, wa'alaa bab almashrubaai wasiyfun faaataytuhu faqultu astaadhin liy‏.‏ fadakhaltu faiidhaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa hasiyrin qad aathhara fiy janbihi, watahta raasihi mirfaqaaun min aadamin, hashwuhaa liyfun, waiidhaa auhubun mu'allaqaaun waqarazun, fadhakartu alladhiy qultu lihafsaaa waaummi salamaaa, waalladhiy raddat 'alaaaa aummu salamaaa, fadahika rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falabitha tis'ana wa'ishriyna laylaaan, thumma nazala‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:For one year I wanted to ask `Umar about the two women who helped each other against the Prophet (ﷺ) but I was afraid of him. One day he dismounted his riding animal and went among the trees of Arak to answer the call of nature, and when he returned, I asked him and he said, "(They were) `Aisha and Hafsa." Then he added, "We never used to give significance to ladies in the days of the Pre-Islamic period of ignorance, but when Islam came and Allah mentioned their rights, we used to give them their rights but did not allow them to interfere in our affairs. Once there was some dispute between me and my wife and she answered me back in a loud voice. I said to her, 'Strange! You can retort in this way?' She said, 'Yes. Do you say this to me while your daughter troubles Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?' So I went to Hafsa and said to her, 'I warn you not to disobey Allah and His Apostle.' I first went to Hafsa and then to Um Salama and told her the same. She said to me, 'O `Umar! It surprises me that you interfere in our affairs so much that you would poke your nose even into the affairs of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his wives.' So she rejected my advice. There was an Ansari man; whenever he was absent from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I was present there, I used to convey to him what had happened (on that day), and when I was absent and he was present there, he used to convey to me what had happened as regards news from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . During that time all the rulers of the nearby lands had surrendered to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) except the king of Ghassan in Sham, and we were afraid that he might attack us. All of a sudden the Ansari came and said, 'A great event has happened!' I asked him, 'What is it? Has the Ghassani (king) come?' He said, 'Greater than that! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has divorced his wives! I went to them and found all of them weeping in their dwellings, and the Prophet (ﷺ) had ascended to an upper room of his. At the door of the room there was a slave to whom I went and said, "Ask the permission for me to enter." He admitted me and I entered to see the Prophet (ﷺ) lying on a mat that had left its imprint on his side. Under his head there was a leather pillow stuffed with palm fibres. Behold! There were some hides hanging there and some grass for tanning. Then I mentioned what I had said to Hafsa and Um Salama and what reply Um Salama had given me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled and stayed there for twenty nine days and then came down." (See Hadith No. 648, Vol. 3 for details)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَتْنِي هِنْدُ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتِ اسْتَيْقَظَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَهْوَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، مَاذَا أُنْزِلَ اللَّيْلَةَ مِنَ الْفِتْنَةِ، مَاذَا أُنْزِلَ مِنَ الْخَزَائِنِ، مَنْ يُوقِظُ صَوَاحِبَ الْحُجُرَاتِ، كَمْ مِنْ كَاسِيَةٍ فِي الدُّنْيَا عَارِيَةٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَكَانَتْ هِنْدٌ لَهَا أَزْرَارٌ فِي كُمَّيْهَا بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa hishaamun, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaratniy hindu bintu alhaarithi, 'an aummi salamaaa, qaalati astayqaza alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alllayli wahwa yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu, maadhaa aunzila alllaylaaa mina alfitnaai, maadhaa aunzila mina alkhazaaiini, man yuwqizu sawaahiba alhujuraati, kam min kaasiyaain fiy alddunyaa 'aariyaain yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala alzzuhriyyu wakaanat hindun lahaa aazraarun fiy kummayhaa bayna aasaabi'ihaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Salama:One night the Prophet (ﷺ) woke up, saying, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah! How many afflictions have been sent down tonight, and how many treasures have been sent down (disclosed)! Who will go and wake up (for prayers) the lady dwellers of these rooms? Many well dressed soul (people) in this world, will be naked on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ خَالِدٍ بِنْتُ خَالِدٍ، قَالَتْ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِثِيَابٍ فِيهَا خَمِيصَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ تَرَوْنَ نَكْسُوهَا هَذِهِ الْخَمِيصَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأُسْكِتَ الْقَوْمُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْتُونِي بِأُمِّ خَالِدٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأُتِيَ بِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَلْبَسَهَا بِيَدِهِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَبْلِي وَأَخْلِقِي ‏"‏‏.‏ مَرَّتَيْنِ فَجَعَلَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى عَلَمِ الْخَمِيصَةِ، وَيُشِيرُ بِيَدِهِ إِلَىَّ وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ يَا أُمَّ خَالِدٍ هَذَا سَنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَالسَّنَا بِلِسَانِ الْحَبَشِيَّةِ الْحَسَنُ‏.‏ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ حَدَّثَتْنِي امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِي أَنَّهَا رَأَتْهُ عَلَى أُمِّ خَالِدٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu sa'iydi bni 'amriw bni sa'iydi bni al'aasi, qaala haddathaniy aabiy qaala, haddathatniy aummu khaalidin bintu khaalidin, qaalat autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bithiyaabin fiyhaa khamiysaaun sawdaa'u qaala ‏"‏ man tarawna naksuwhaa hadhihi alkhamiysaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faauskita alqawmu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aituwniy biaummi khaalidin ‏"‏‏.‏ faautiya biy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faaalbasahaa biyadihi waqaala ‏"‏ aabliy waaakhliqiy ‏"‏‏.‏ marratayni faja'ala yanzuru iilaa 'alami alkhamiysaai, wayushiyru biyadihi iilaaaa wayaquwlu ‏"‏ yaa aumma khaalidin hadhaa sanaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waalssanaa bilisaani alhabashiyyaai alhasanu‏.‏ qaala iishaaqu haddathatniy amraaaaun min aahliy aannahaa raaathu 'alaa aummi khaalidin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Khalid bint Khalid:Some clothes were presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as a gift and there was a black Khamisa with it. The Prophet asked (his companions), "To whom do you suggest we give this Khamisa?" The people kept quiet. Then he said, "Bring me Um Khalid," So I was brought to him and he dressed me with it with his own hands and said twice, "May you live so long that you will wear out many garments." He then started looking at the embroidery of that Khamisa and said, "O Um Khalid! This is Sana!" (Sana in Ethiopian language means beautiful.) 'Is-haq, a sub-narrator, said: A woman of my family had told me that she had seen the Khamisa worn by Um Khalid
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَتَزَعْفَرَ الرَّجُلُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi, 'an aanasin, qaala nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yataza'fara alrrajulu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade men to use saffron
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَلْبَسَ الْمُحْرِمُ ثَوْبًا مَصْبُوغًا بِوَرْسٍ أَوْ بِزَعْفَرَانٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yalbasa almuhrimu thawbana masbuwghana biwarsin aaw biza'faraanin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade Muhrims to wear clothes dyed with Wars or saffron
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، سَمِعَ الْبَرَاءَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرْبُوعًا، وَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ فِي حُلَّةٍ حَمْرَاءَ مَا رَأَيْتُ شَيْئًا أَحْسَنَ مِنْهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, sami'a albaraa'a rda allh 'nh yaquwlu kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm marbuw'ana, waqad raaaytuhu fiy hullaain hamraa'a maa raaaytu shayiana aahsana minhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) was of a modest height. I saw him wearing a red suit, and I did not see anything better than him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ مُقَرِّنٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَمَرَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِسَبْعٍ عِيَادَةِ الْمَرِيضِ، وَاتِّبَاعِ الْجَنَائِزِ، وَتَشْمِيتِ الْعَاطِسِ، وَنَهَانَا عَنْ لُبْسِ الْحَرِيرِ، وَالدِّيبَاجِ، وَالْقَسِّيِّ، وَالإِسْتَبْرَقِ، وَمَيَاثِرِ الْحُمْرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aash'atha, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni suwaydi bni muqarrinin, 'ani albaraa'i rda allh 'nh qaala aamaranaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bisab'in 'iyaadaai almariydi, waattibaa'i aljanaaiizi, watashmiyti al'aatisi, wanahaanaa 'an lubsi alhariyri, waalddiybaaji, waalqassiyyi, waaliistabraqi, wamayaathiri alhumri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to observe seven things: To visit the sick; follow funeral processions; say 'May Allah bestow His Mercy on you', to the sneezer if he says, 'Praise be to Allah!; He forbade us to wear silk, Dibaj, Qassiy and Istibarq (various kinds of silken clothes); or to use red Mayathir (silkcushions). (See Hadith No. 253 A, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسًا أَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي فِي نَعْلَيْهِ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an sa'iydin aabiy maslamaaa, qaala saaaltu aanasana aakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy fiy na'layhi qaala na'am‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id Abu Maslama:I asked Anas (bin Malik), "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to offer the prayers with his shoes on?" He said, "Yes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ رَأَيْتُكَ تَصْنَعُ أَرْبَعًا لَمْ أَرَ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِكَ يَصْنَعُهَا‏.‏ قَالَ مَا هِيَ يَا ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ رَأَيْتُكَ لاَ تَمَسُّ مِنَ الأَرْكَانِ إِلاَّ الْيَمَانِيَيْنِ، وَرَأَيْتُكَ تَلْبَسُ النِّعَالَ السِّبْتِيَّةَ، وَرَأَيْتُكَ تَصْبُغُ بِالصُّفْرَةِ، وَرَأَيْتُكَ إِذَا كُنْتَ بِمَكَّةَ أَهَلَّ النَّاسُ إِذَا رَأَوُا الْهِلاَلَ، وَلَمْ تُهِلَّ أَنْتَ حَتَّى كَانَ يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَمَّا الأَرْكَانُ فَإِنِّي لَمْ أَرَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمَسُّ إِلاَّ الْيَمَانِيَيْنِ، وَأَمَّا النِّعَالُ السِّبْتِيَّةُ فَإِنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَلْبَسُ النِّعَالَ الَّتِي لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَعَرٌ وَيَتَوَضَّأُ فِيهَا فَأَنَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَلْبَسَهَا، وَأَمَّا الصُّفْرَةُ فَإِنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصْبُغُ بِهَا، فَأَنَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَصْبُغَ بِهَا وَأَمَّا الإِهْلاَلُ فَإِنِّي لَمْ أَرَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُهِلُّ حَتَّى تَنْبَعِثَ بِهِ رَاحِلَتُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an 'ubaydi bni jurayjin, aannahu qaala li'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma raaaytuka tasna'u aarba'ana lam aara aahadana min aashaabika yasna'uhaa‏.‏ qaala maa hiya yaa abna jurayjin qaala raaaytuka laa tamassu mina alaarkaani iilaaa alyamaaniyayni, waraaaytuka talbasu alnni'aala alssibtiyyaaa, waraaaytuka tasbughu bialssufraai, waraaaytuka iidhaa kunta bimakkaaa aahalla alnnaasu iidhaa raaawua alhilaala, walam tuhilla aanta hattaa kaana yawma alttarwiyaai‏.‏ faqaala lahu 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara aammaa alaarkaanu faiinniy lam aara rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yamassu iilaaa alyamaaniyayni, waaammaa alnni'aalu alssibtiyyaau faiinniy raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yalbasu alnni'aala allatiy laysa fiyhaa sha'arun wayatawaddaau fiyhaa faaanaa auhibbu aan aalbasahaa, waaammaa alssufraau faiinniy raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasbughu bihaa, faaanaa auhibbu aan aasbugha bihaa waaammaa aliihlaalu faiinniy lam aara rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhillu hattaa tanba'itha bihi raahilatuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id Al-Maqburi:'Ubai bin Juraij said to `Abdullah Ben `Umar, "I see you doing four things which are not done by your friends." Ibn `Umar said, "What are they, O Ibn Juraij?" He said, "I see that you do not touch except the two Yemenite corners of the Ka`ba (while performing the Tawaf): and I see you wearing the Sabtiyya shoes; and I see you dyeing (your hair) with Sufra; and I see that when you are in Mecca, the people assume the state of Ihram on seeing the crescent (on the first day of Dhul-Hijja) while you do not assume the state of Ihram till the Day of Tarwiya (8th Dhul Hijja)." `Abdullah bin `Umar said to him, "As for the corners of the Ka`ba, I have not seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) touching except the two Yemenite corners, As for the Sabtiyya shoes, I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wearing leather shoes that had no hair, and he used to perform the ablution while wearing them. Therefore, I like to wear such shoes. As regards dyeing with Sufra, I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) dyeing his hair with it, so I like to dye (my hair) with it. As regards the crescent (of Dhul-Hijja), I have not seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assuming the state of Ihram till his she-camel set out (on the 8th of Dhul-Hijja)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَلْبَسَ الْمُحْرِمُ ثَوْبًا مَصْبُوغًا بِزَعْفَرَانٍ أَوْ وَرْسٍ، وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ نَعْلَيْنِ فَلْيَلْبَسْ خُفَّيْنِ، وَلْيَقْطَعْهُمَا أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yalbasa almuhrimu thawbana masbuwghana biza'faraanin aaw warsin, waqaala ‏ "‏ man lam yajid na'layni falyalbas khuffayni, walyaqta'humaa aasfala mina alka'bayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade that a Muhrim should wear clothes dyed with Saffron or Wars, and said, "Whoever has no shoes can put on Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather) after cutting it below the ankles
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ إِزَارٌ فَلْيَلْبَسِ السَّرَاوِيلَ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ نَعْلاَنِ فَلْيَلْبَسْ خُفَّيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an jaabiri bni zaydin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man lam yakun lahu iizaarun falyalbasi alssaraawiyla, waman lam yakun lahu na'laani falyalbas khuffayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever has no Izar (waist sheet), can wear trousers; and whoever has no sandals, can wear Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather, but cut them short below the ankles)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَشْعَثُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحِبُّ التَّيَمُّنَ فِي طُهُورِهِ وَتَرَجُّلِهِ وَتَنَعُّلِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy aash'athu bnu sulaymin, sami'tu aabiy yuhaddithu, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhibbu alttayammuna fiy tuhuwrihi watarajjulihi watana''ulihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to like starting from the right in performing ablution, combing his hair and putting on his shoes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا انْتَعَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَبْدَأْ بِالْيَمِينِ وَإِذَا نَزَعَ فَلْيَبْدَأْ بِالشِّمَالِ، لِتَكُنِ الْيُمْنَى أَوَّلَهُمَا تُنْعَلُ وَآخِرَهُمَا تُنْزَعُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa anta'ala aahadukum falyabdaa bialyamiyni waiidhaa naza'a falyabdaa bialshhimaali, litakuni alyumnaa aawwalahumaa tun'alu waakhirahumaa tunza'u ‏"‏‏.‏
