verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If you want to put on your shoes, put on the right shoe first; and if you want to take them off, take the left one first. Let the right shoe be the first to be put on and the last to be taken off
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَمْشِي أَحَدُكُمْ فِي نَعْلٍ وَاحِدَةٍ لِيُحْفِهِمَا جَمِيعًا، أَوْ لِيَنْعَلْهُمَا جَمِيعًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yamshiy aahadukum fiy na'lin waahidaain liyuhfihimaa jamiy'ana, aaw liyan'alhumaa jamiy'ana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "None of you should walk, wearing one shoe only; he should either put on both shoes or put on no shoes whatsoever
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ نَعْلَ، النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ لَهَا قِبَالاَنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa hajaaaju bnu minhaalin, hadaathanaa hamaaamun, 'an qataadaaa, hadaathanaa aanasun rda allh 'nh aanaa na'la, alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana lahaa qibaalaani‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The sandal of the Prophet (ﷺ) had two straps
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ طَهْمَانَ، قَالَ خَرَجَ إِلَيْنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ بِنَعْلَيْنِ لَهُمَا قِبَالاَنِ، فَقَالَ ثَابِتٌ الْبُنَانِيُّ هَذِهِ نَعْلُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathaniy muhamaadun, aakhbaranaa 'abdu allaahi, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu tahmaana, qaala kharaja iilaynaa aanasu bnu maalikin bina'layni lahumaa qibaalaani, faqaala thaabitun albunaaniyuu hadhihi na'lu alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Isaa bin Tahman:Anas bin Malik brought out for us, two sandals having two straps. Thabit Al-Banani said, "These were the sandals of the Prophet (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ فِي قُبَّةٍ حَمْرَاءَ مِنْ أَدَمٍ، وَرَأَيْتُ بِلاَلاً أَخَذَ وَضُوءَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّاسُ يَبْتَدِرُونَ الْوَضُوءَ، فَمَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا تَمَسَّحَ بِهِ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يُصِبْ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا أَخَذَ مِنْ بَلَلِ يَدِ صَاحِبِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ar'araaa, qaala haddathaniy 'umaru bnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'an 'awni bni aabiy juhayfaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala aataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa fiy qubbaain hamraa'a min aadamin, waraaaytu bilaalaan aakhadha waduw'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalnnaasu yabtadiruwna alwaduw'a, faman aasaaba minhu shayiana tamassaha bihi, waman lam yusib minhu shayiana aakhadha min balali yadi saahibihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was inside a red leather tent, and I saw Bilal taking the remaining water of the ablution of the Prophet, and the people were taking of that water and rubbing it on their faces; and whoever could not get anything of it, would share the moisture of the hand of his companion (and then rub it on his face)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، ح وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَرْسَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الأَنْصَارِ، وَجَمَعَهُمْ فِي قُبَّةٍ مِنْ أَدَمٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy aanasu bnu maalikin, h waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy aanasu bnu maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala aarsala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa alaansaari, wajama'ahum fiy qubbaain min aadamin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) called for the Ansar and gathered them in a leather tent
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَحْتَجِرُ حَصِيرًا بِاللَّيْلِ فَيُصَلِّي، وَيَبْسُطُهُ بِالنَّهَارِ فَيَجْلِسُ عَلَيْهِ، فَجَعَلَ النَّاسُ يَثُوبُونَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيُصَلُّونَ بِصَلاَتِهِ حَتَّى كَثُرُوا فَأَقْبَلَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ خُذُوا مِنَ الأَعْمَالِ مَا تُطِيقُونَ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَمَلُّ حَتَّى تَمَلُّوا، وَإِنَّ أَحَبَّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ مَا دَامَ وَإِنْ قَلَّ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yahtajiru hasiyrana bialllayli fayusalliy, wayabsutuhu bialnnahaari fayajlisu 'alayhi, faja'ala alnnaasu yathuwbuwna iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fayusalluwna bisalaatihi hattaa kathuruwa faaaqbala faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa aayyuhaa alnnaasu khudhuwa mina alaa'maali maa tutiyquwna, faiinna alllaha laa yamallu hattaa tamalluwa, waiinna aahabba alaa'maali iilaa alllahi maa daama waiin qalla ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to construct a loom with a Hasir at night m order to pray therein, and during the day he used to spread it out and sit on it. The people started coming to the Prophet (ﷺ) at night to offer the prayer behind him When their number increased, the Prophet (ﷺ) faced them and said. O people! Do only those good deeds which you can do, for Allah does not get tired (of giving reward) till you get tired, and the best deeds to Allah are the incessant ones though they were few
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، مَخْرَمَةَ قَالَ لَهُ يَا بُنَىَّ إِنَّهُ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدِمَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَقْبِيَةٌ فَهْوَ يَقْسِمُهَا، فَاذْهَبْ بِنَا إِلَيْهِ، فَذَهَبْنَا فَوَجَدْنَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَنْزِلِهِ، فَقَالَ لِي يَا بُنَىَّ ادْعُ لِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَعْظَمْتُ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَدْعُو لَكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا بُنَىَّ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِجَبَّارٍ‏.‏ فَدَعَوْتُهُ فَخَرَجَ وَعَلَيْهِ قَبَاءٌ مِنْ دِيبَاجٍ مُزَرَّرٌ بِالذَّهَبِ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا مَخْرَمَةُ هَذَا خَبَأْنَاهُ لَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy abnu aabiy mulaykaaa, 'ani almiswari bni makhramaaa, aanna aabaahu, makhramaaa qaala lahu yaa bunaaaa iinnahu balaghaniy aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qadimat 'alayhi aaqbiyaaun fahwa yaqsimuhaa, faadhhab binaa iilayhi, fadhahabnaa fawajadnaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy manzilihi, faqaala liy yaa bunaaaa ad'u liy alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faaa'zamtu dhalika‏.‏ faqultu aad'uw laka rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa bunaaaa iinnahu laysa bijabbaarin‏.‏ fada'awtuhu fakharaja wa'alayhi qabaa'un min diybaajin muzarrarun bialdhhahabi, faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa makhramaau hadhaa khabaanaahu laka ‏"‏‏.‏ faaa'taahu iiyyaahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:My father, Makhrama said to me, "I have come to know that some cloaks have come to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he is distributing them. So O my son! take me to him." We went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and found him in the house. My father said to me, "O my son! Call the Prophet (ﷺ) for me." I found it hard to do so, so I said surprisingly, "Shall I call Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for you ?" My father said, "O mu son! He is not a tyrant." So I called him and he came out wearing a Dibaj cloak having gold buttons, and said: "O Makhrama, I kept this for you." The Prophet (ﷺ) then gave it to him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَشْعَثُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنَ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ مُقَرِّنٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ نَهَانَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ سَبْعٍ نَهَى عَنْ خَاتَمِ الذَّهَبِ ـ أَوْ قَالَ حَلْقَةِ الذَّهَبِ ـ وَعَنِ الْحَرِيرِ، وَالإِسْتَبْرَقِ، وَالدِّيبَاجِ، وَالْمِيثَرَةِ الْحَمْرَاءِ، وَالْقَسِّيِّ، وَآنِيَةِ الْفِضَّةِ، وَأَمَرَنَا بِسَبْعٍ بِعِيَادَةِ الْمَرِيضِ، وَاتِّبَاعِ الْجَنَائِزِ، وَتَشْمِيتِ الْعَاطِسِ، وَرَدِّ السَّلاَمِ، وَإِجَابَةِ الدَّاعِي، وَإِبْرَارِ الْمُقْسِمِ، وَنَصْرِ الْمَظْلُومِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa aash'athu bnu sulaymin, qaala sami'tu mu'aawiyaaa bna suwaydi bni muqarrinin, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a bna 'aazibin rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu nahaanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an sab'in nahaa 'an khaatami aldhhahabi aaw qaala halqaai aldhhahabi wa'ani alhariyri, waaliistabraqi, waalddiybaaji, waalmiytharaai alhamraa'i, waalqassiyyi, waaniyaai alfiddaai, waaamaranaa bisab'in bi'iyaadaai almariydi, waattibaa'i aljanaaiizi, watashmiyti al'aatisi, waraddi alssalaami, waiijaabaai alddaa'iy, waiibraari almuqsimi, wanasri almazluwmi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us to use seven things: He forbade using gold rings, silk, Istabraq, Dibaj, red Mayathir, Al-Qassiy, and silver utensils. He ordered us to do seven other things. To pay a visit to the sick; to follow funeral processions; to say, "May Allah be merciful to you" to a sneezer if he says "Praise be to Allah"; to return greetings, to accept invitations; to help others to fulfil their oaths and to help the oppressed ones
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ نَهِيكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنْ خَاتَمِ الذَّهَبِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَمْرٌو أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ سَمِعَ النَّضْرَ سَمِعَ بَشِيرًا مِثْلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'ani alnnadri bni aanasin, 'an bashiyri bni nahiykin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu nahaa 'an khaatami aldhhahabi‏.‏ waqaala 'amrunw aakhbaranaa shu'baau 'an qataadaaa sami'a alnnadra sami'a bashiyrana mithlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the wearing of a gold ring
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اتَّخَذَ خَاتَمًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، وَجَعَلَ فَصَّهُ مِمَّا يَلِي كَفَّهُ، فَاتَّخَذَهُ النَّاسُ، فَرَمَى بِهِ، وَاتَّخَذَ خَاتَمًا مِنْ وَرِقٍ أَوْ فِضَّةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy naafi'un, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm attakhadha khaatamana min dhahabin, waja'ala fassahu mimmaa yaliy kaffahu, faattakhadhahu alnnaasu, faramaa bihi, waattakhadha khaatamana min wariqin aaw fiddaain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wore a gold or silver .. ring and placed its stone towards the palm of his hand. The people also started wearing gold rings like it, but when the Prophet (ﷺ) saw them wearing such rings, he threw away that golden ring and then wore a silver ring
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اتَّخَذَ خَاتَمًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ أَوْ فِضَّةٍ، وَجَعَلَ فَصَّهُ مِمَّا يَلِي كَفَّهُ، وَنَقَشَ فِيهِ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَاتَّخَذَ النَّاسُ مِثْلَهُ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُمْ قَدِ اتَّخَذُوهَا رَمَى بِهِ، وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ أَلْبَسُهُ أَبَدًا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ اتَّخَذَ خَاتَمًا مِنْ فِضَّةٍ، فَاتَّخَذَ النَّاسُ خَوَاتِيمَ الْفِضَّةِ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَلَبِسَ الْخَاتَمَ بَعْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبُو بَكْرٍ ثُمَّ عُمَرُ ثُمَّ عُثْمَانُ، حَتَّى وَقَعَ مِنْ عُثْمَانَ فِي بِئْرِ أَرِيسَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yuwsufu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm attakhadha khaatamana min dhahabin aaw fiddaain, waja'ala fassahu mimmaa yaliy kaffahu, wanaqasha fiyhi muhammadun rasuwlu alllahi‏.‏ faattakhadha alnnaasu mithlahu, falammaa raahum qadi attakhadhuwhaa ramaa bihi, waqaala ‏ "‏ laa aalbasuhu aabadana ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma attakhadha khaatamana min fiddaain, faattakhadha alnnaasu khawaatiyma alfiddaai‏.‏ qaala abnu 'umara falabisa alkhaatama ba'da alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aabuw bakrin thumma 'umaru thumma 'uthmaanu, hattaa waqa'a min 'uthmaana fiy biiri aariysa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn. `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wore a gold ring or a silver ring and placed its stone towards the palm of his hand and had the name 'Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah' engraved on it. The people also started wearing gold rings like it, but when the Prophet (ﷺ) saw them wearing such rings, he threw away his own ring and said. "I will never wear it," and then wore a silver ring, whereupon the people too started wearing silver rings. Ibn `Umar added: After the Prophet (ﷺ) Abu Bakr wore the ring, and then `Umar and then `Uthman wore it till it fell in the Aris well from `Uthman
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَلْبَسُ خَاتَمًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَنَبَذَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ أَلْبَسُهُ أَبَدًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَنَبَذَ النَّاسُ خَوَاتِيمَهُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yalbasu khaatamana min dhahabin fanabadhahu faqaala ‏ "‏ laa aalbasuhu aabadana ‏"‏‏.‏ fanabadha alnnaasu khawaatiymahum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wore a gold ring, then he threw it and said, "I will never wear it." The people also threw their (gold) rings
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ رَأَى فِي يَدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَاتَمًا مِنْ وَرِقٍ يَوْمًا وَاحِدًا، ثُمَّ إِنَّ النَّاسَ اصْطَنَعُوا الْخَوَاتِيمَ مِنْ وَرِقٍ وَلَبِسُوهَا، فَطَرَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَاتَمَهُ، فَطَرَحَ النَّاسُ خَوَاتِيمَهُمْ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ وَزِيَادٌ وَشُعَيْبٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ مُسَافِرٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ أَرَى خَاتَمًا مِنْ وَرِقٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy aanasu bnu maalikin rda allh 'nh aannahu raaaa fiy yadi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khaatamana min wariqin yawmana waahidana, thumma iinna alnnaasa astana'uwa alkhawaatiyma min wariqin walabisuwhaa, fataraha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khaatamahu, fataraha alnnaasu khawaatiymahum‏.‏ taaba'ahu iibraahiymu bnu sa'din waziyaadun washu'aybun 'ani alzzuhriyyi‏.‏ waqaala abnu musaafirin 'ani alzzuhriyyi aaraa khaatamana min wariqin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:that he saw a silver ring on the hand of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for one day only. Then the people had silver rings made for themselves and wore it. On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) threw away their rings as well. (For the details of this Hadith, see Fath-ul-Bari, Vol. 12, page)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، قَالَ سُئِلَ أَنَسٌ هَلِ اتَّخَذَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَاتَمًا قَالَ أَخَّرَ لَيْلَةً صَلاَةَ الْعِشَاءِ إِلَى شَطْرِ اللَّيْلِ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ، فَكَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ خَاتَمِهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ صَلَّوْا وَنَامُوا، وَإِنَّكُمْ لَمْ تَزَالُوا فِي صَلاَةٍ مَا انْتَظَرْتُمُوهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, aakhbaranaa humaydun, qaala suiila aanasun hali attakhadha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm khaatamana qaala aakhhara laylaaan salaaaa al'ishaa'i iilaa shatri alllayli, thumma aaqbala 'alaynaa biwajhihi, fakaaanniy aanzuru iilaa wabiysi khaatamihi‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alnnaasa qad sallawa wanaamuwa, waiinnakum lam tazaaluwa fiy salaaain maa antazartumuwhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Humaid:Anas was asked, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) wear a ring?" Anas said, "Once he delayed the: `Isha' prayer till midnight. Then he came, facing us ..... as if I am now Looking at the glitter of his ring ..... and said, "The people have offered their prayers and slept but you have been in prayer as you have been waiting for it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ حُمَيْدًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ خَاتَمُهُ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ وَكَانَ فَصُّهُ مِنْهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدٌ سَمِعَ أَنَسًا عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa mu'tamirun, qaala sami'tu humaydana, yuhaddithu 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana khaatamuhu min fiddaain wakaana fassuhu minhu‏.‏ waqaala yahyaa bnu aayyuwba haddathaniy humaydun sami'a aanasana 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The ring of the Prophet (ﷺ) was of silver, and its stone was of silver too
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَهْلاً، يَقُولُ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ جِئْتُ أَهَبُ نَفْسِي‏.‏ فَقَامَتْ طَوِيلاً فَنَظَرَ وَصَوَّبَ، فَلَمَّا طَالَ مُقَامُهَا فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ زَوِّجْنِيهَا، إِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ لَكَ بِهَا حَاجَةٌ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ عِنْدَكَ شَىْءٌ تُصْدِقُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ انْظُرْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَذَهَبَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ إِنْ وَجَدْتُ شَيْئًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اذْهَبْ فَالْتَمِسْ وَلَوْ خَاتَمًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَذَهَبَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ قَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ وَلاَ خَاتَمًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ‏.‏ وَعَلَيْهِ إِزَارٌ مَا عَلَيْهِ رِدَاءٌ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أُصْدِقُهَا إِزَارِي فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِزَارُكَ إِنْ لَبِسَتْهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْكَ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ، وَإِنْ لَبِسْتَهُ لَمَ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهَا مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَتَنَحَّى الرَّجُلُ فَجَلَسَ فَرَآهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُوَلِّيًا فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَدُعِيَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سُورَةُ كَذَا وَكَذَا لِسُوَرٍ عَدَّدَهَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ قَدْ مَلَّكْتُكَهَا بِمَا مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu sami'a sahlaan, yaquwlu jaa'ati amraaaaun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat jiitu aahabu nafsiy‏.‏ faqaamat tawiylaan fanazara wasawwaba, falammaa taala muqaamuhaa faqaala rajulun zawwijniyhaa, iin lam takun laka bihaa haajaaun‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ 'indaka shaa'un tusdiquhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala laa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ anzur ‏"‏‏.‏ fadhahaba thumma raja'a faqaala waalllahi iin wajadtu shayiana‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ adhhab faaltamis walaw khaatamana min hadiydin ‏"‏‏.‏ fadhahaba thumma raja'a qaala laa waalllahi walaa khaatamana min hadiydin‏.‏ wa'alayhi iizaarun maa 'alayhi ridaa'un‏.‏ faqaala ausdiquhaa iizaariy faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iizaaruka iin labisathu lam yakun 'alayka minhu shaa'un, waiin labistahu lama yakun 'alayhaa minhu shaa'un ‏"‏‏.‏ fatanahhaa alrrajulu fajalasa faraahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm muwalliyana faaamara bihi fadu'iya faqaala ‏"‏ maa ma'aka mina alqurani ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala suwraau kadhaa wakadhaa lisuwarin 'addadahaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ qad mallaktukahaa bimaa ma'aka mina alqurani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl:A woman came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I have come to present myself to you (for marriage)." She kept standing for a long period during which period the Prophet (ﷺ) looked at her carefully. When she stayed for a Long period, a man said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "If you are not in need of her, then marry her to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have you got anything to give her (as Mahr)?" The man said, "No." The Prophet said, "Go (to your house) and search for something." The man went and came back to say, "By Allah, I could not find anything." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go again and search for something, even if it be an iron ring." He went again and came back saying, "No, by Allah, I could not get even an iron ring." The man had only an Izar and had no Rida' (upper garment). He said, "I will give her my Izar as Mahr." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your Izar? If she wears it, nothing of it will remain on you, and if you wear it nothing of it will be on her" The man went aside and sat down When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw him leaving (after a while), he called back and asked. "How much Qur'an do you know (by heart)? He said, 'I know such and such Suras," naming some Suras. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I marry her to you for the amount of Qur'an you know (by heart)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرَادَ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ إِلَى رَهْطٍ أَوْ أُنَاسٍ مِنَ الأَعَاجِمِ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّهُمْ لاَ يَقْبَلُونَ كِتَابًا إِلاَّ عَلَيْهِ خَاتَمٌ، فَاتَّخَذَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَاتَمًا مِنْ فِضَّةٍ نَقْشُهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَكَأَنِّي بِوَبِيصِ أَوْ بِبَصِيصِ الْخَاتَمِ فِي إِصْبَعِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْ فِي كَفِّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaraada aan yaktuba iilaa rahtin aaw aunaasin mina alaa'aajimi, faqiyla lahu iinnahum laa yaqbaluwna kitaabana iilaaa 'alayhi khaatamun, faattakhadha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm khaatamana min fiddaain naqshuhu muhammadun rasuwlu alllahi fakaaanniy biwabiysi aaw bibasiysi alkhaatami fiy iisba'i alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaw fiy kaffihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wanted to write a letter to a group of people or some non-Arabs. It was said to him, "They do not accept any letter unless it is stamped." So the Prophet (ﷺ) had a silver ring made for himself, and on it was engraved: 'Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah'. .. as if I am now looking at the glitter of the ring on the finger (or in the palm) of the Prophet (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ اتَّخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَاتَمًا مِنْ وَرِقٍ، وَكَانَ فِي يَدِهِ، ثُمَّ كَانَ بَعْدُ فِي يَدِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، ثُمَّ كَانَ بَعْدُ فِي يَدِ عُمَرَ، ثُمَّ كَانَ بَعْدُ فِي يَدِ عُثْمَانَ، حَتَّى وَقَعَ بَعْدُ فِي بِئْرِ أَرِيسَ، نَقْشُهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu salaamin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala attakhadha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khaatamana min wariqin, wakaana fiy yadihi, thumma kaana ba'du fiy yadi aabiy bakrin, thumma kaana ba'du fiy yadi 'umara, thumma kaana ba'du fiy yadi 'uthmaana, hattaa waqa'a ba'du fiy biiri aariysa, naqshuhu muhammadun rasuwlu alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a silver ring made for himself and it was worn by him on his hand. Afterwards it was worn by Abu Bakr, and then by `Umar, and then by `Uthman till it fell in the Aris well. (On that ring) was engraved: 'Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ صَنَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَاتَمًا قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّا اتَّخَذْنَا خَاتَمًا، وَنَقَشْنَا فِيهِ نَقْشًا، فَلاَ يَنْقُشْ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنِّي لأَرَى بَرِيقَهُ فِي خِنْصَرِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu suhaybin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala sana'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm khaatamana qaala ‏ "‏ iinnaa attakhadhnaa khaatamana, wanaqashnaa fiyhi naqshana, falaa yanqush 'alayhi aahadun ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faiinniy laaraa bariyqahu fiy khinsarihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) got a ring made for himself and said, "I have got a ring made (for myself) and engraved a certain engraving on it so none of you should get such an engraving on his ring." I saw the glitter of the ring on his little finger
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا أَرَادَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَكْتُبَ إِلَى الرُّومِ قِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يَقْرَءُوا كِتَابَكَ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ مَخْتُومًا‏.‏ فَاتَّخَذَ خَاتَمًا مِنْ فِضَّةٍ، وَنَقْشُهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَكَأَنَّمَا أَنْظُرُ إِلَى بَيَاضِهِ فِي يَدِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu bnu aabiy iiyaasin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala lammaa aaraada alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yaktuba iilaa alrruwmi qiyla lahu iinnahum lan yaqra'uwa kitaabaka iidhaa lam yakun makhtuwmana‏.‏ faattakhadha khaatamana min fiddaain, wanaqshuhu muhammadun rasuwlu alllahi‏.‏ fakaaannamaa aanzuru iilaa bayaadihi fiy yadihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to write to the Byzantines, it was said to him, "Those people do not read your letter unless it is stamped." So the Prophet (ﷺ) took a silver ring and got 'Muhammad, the Apostle of Allah' engraved on it .... as if I am now looking at its glitter in his hand
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اصْطَنَعَ خَاتَمًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، جَعَلَ فَصَّهُ فِي بَطْنِ كَفِّهِ إِذَا لَبِسَهُ، فَاصْطَنَعَ النَّاسُ خَوَاتِيمَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، فَرَقِيَ الْمِنْبَرَ، فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي كُنْتُ اصْطَنَعْتُهُ، وَإِنِّي لاَ أَلْبَسُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَنَبَذَهُ فَنَبَذَ النَّاسُ‏.‏ قَالَ جُوَيْرِيَةُ وَلاَ أَحْسِبُهُ إِلاَّ قَالَ فِي يَدِهِ الْيُمْنَى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa juwayriyaau, 'an naafi'in, aanna 'abda alllahi, haddathahu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm astana'a khaatamana min dhahabin, ja'ala fassahu fiy batni kaffihi iidhaa labisahu, faastana'a alnnaasu khawaatiyma min dhahabin, faraqiya alminbara, fahamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi faqaala ‏ "‏ iinniy kuntu astana'tuhu, waiinniy laa aalbasuhu ‏"‏‏.‏ fanabadhahu fanabadha alnnaasu‏.‏ qaala juwayriyaau walaa aahsibuhu iilaaa qaala fiy yadihi alyumnaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) had a golden ring made for himself, and when he wore it. he used to turn its stone toward the palm of his! hand. So the people too had gold made for themselves. The Prophet (ﷺ) then ascended the pulpit, and after glorifying and praising Allah, he said, "I had it made for me, but now I will never wear it again." He threw it away, and then the people threw away their rings too. (Juwairiya, a subnarrator, said: I think Anas said that the Prophet (ﷺ) was wearing the ring in his right hand
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اتَّخَذَ خَاتَمًا مِنْ فِضَّةٍ، وَنَقَشَ فِيهِ، مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي اتَّخَذْتُ خَاتَمًا مِنْ وَرِقٍ، وَنَقَشْتُ فِيهِ، مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَلاَ يَنْقُشَنَّ أَحَدٌ عَلَى نَقْشِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni suhaybin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm attakhadha khaatamana min fiddaain, wanaqasha fiyhi, muhammadun rasuwlu alllahi‏.‏ waqaala ‏ "‏ iinniy attakhadhtu khaatamana min wariqin, wanaqashtu fiyhi, muhammadun rasuwlu alllahi‏.‏ falaa yanqushanna aahadun 'alaa naqshihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took a silver ring and had 'Muhammad, the Apostle' of Allah' engraved on it. The Prophet then said (to us), 'I have a silver ring with 'Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah engraved on it, so none of you should have the same engraving on his ring
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ لَمَّا اسْتُخْلِفَ كَتَبَ لَهُ، وَكَانَ نَقْشُ الْخَاتَمِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَسْطُرٍ‏.‏ مُحَمَّدٌ سَطْرٌ، وَرَسُولُ سَطْرٌ، وَاللَّهِ سَطْرٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyu, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an thumaamaaa, 'an aanasin, aanna aabaa bakrin rda allh 'nh lammaa astukhlifa kataba lahu, wakaana naqshu alkhaatami thalaathaaa aasturin‏.‏ muhammadun satrun, warasuwlu satrun, waalllahi satrun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:that when Abu Bakr became the Caliph, he wrote a letter to him (and stamped it with the Prophet's ring) and the engraving of the ring was in three lines: Muhammad in one line, 'Apostle' in another line, and 'Allah' in a third line
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَزَادَنِي أَحْمَدُ حَدَّثَنَا الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ خَاتَمُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي يَدِهِ، وَفِي يَدِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ بَعْدَهُ، وَفِي يَدِ عُمَرَ بَعْدَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ عُثْمَانُ جَلَسَ عَلَى بِئْرِ أَرِيسَ ـ قَالَ ـ فَأَخْرَجَ الْخَاتَمَ، فَجَعَلَ يَعْبَثُ بِهِ فَسَقَطَ قَالَ فَاخْتَلَفْنَا ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ مَعَ عُثْمَانَ فَنَنْزَحُ الْبِئْرَ فَلَمْ نَجِدْهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: wazaadaniy aahmadu haddathanaa alaansaariyyu, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an thumaamaaa, 'an aanasin, qaala kaana khaatamu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy yadihi, wafiy yadi aabiy bakrin ba'dahu, wafiy yadi 'umara ba'da aabiy bakrin, falammaa kaana 'uthmaanu jalasa 'alaa biiri aariysa qaala faaakhraja alkhaatama, faja'ala ya'bathu bihi fasaqata qaala faakhtalafnaa thalaathaaa aayyaamin ma'a 'uthmaana fananzahu albiira falam najidhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas added:The ring of the Prophet (ﷺ) was in his hand, and after him, in Abu Bakr's hand, and then in `Umar's hand after Abu Bakr. When `Uthman was the Caliph, once he was sitting at the well of Aris. He removed the ring from his hand and while he was trifling with it, dropped into the well. We kept on going to the well with `Uthman for three days looking for the ring, and finally the well was drained, but the ring was not found
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ شَهِدْتُ الْعِيدَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَلَّى قَبْلَ الْخُطْبَةِ‏.‏ وَزَادَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ فَأَتَى النِّسَاءَ فَجَعَلْنَ يُلْقِينَ الْفَتَخَ وَالْخَوَاتِيمَ فِي ثَوْبِ بِلاَلٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaranaa alhasanu bnu muslimin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma shahidtu al'iyda ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallaa qabla alkhutbaai‏.‏ wazaada abnu wahbin 'ani abni jurayjin faaataa alnnisaa'a faja'alna yulqiyna alfatakha waalkhawaatiyma fiy thawbi bilaalin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I offered the `Id prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and he offered prayer before the Khutba (sermon). ibn `Abbas added: After the prayer the Prophet (ﷺ) came towards (the rows of) the women and ordered them to give alms, and the women started putting their big and small rings in the garment of Bilal
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ عِيدٍ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، لَمْ يُصَلِّ قَبْلُ وَلاَ بَعْدُ، ثُمَّ أَتَى النِّسَاءَ فَأَمَرَهُنَّ بِالصَّدَقَةِ، فَجَعَلَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ تَصَدَّقُ بِخُرْصِهَا وَسِخَابِهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa muhamaadu bnu 'ar'araaa, hadaathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'adiyii bni thaabitin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abaaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala kharaja alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma 'iydin fasalaaa rak'atayni, lam yusalii qablu walaa ba'du, thumaa aataa alniisaa'a faaamarahunaa bialsaadaqaai, faja'alati almaraaau tasadaaqu bikhursihaa wasikhaabihaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) came out on the day of `Id and offered a two-rak`at prayer, and he did not pray any rak`a before it, nor after it. Then he went towards the women and ordered them to give alms. The women started donating their earring and necklaces
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ هَلَكَتْ قِلاَدَةٌ لأَسْمَاءَ، فَبَعَثَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي طَلَبِهَا رِجَالاً، فَحَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ وَلَيْسُوا عَلَى وُضُوءٍ وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا مَاءً، فَصَلَّوْا وَهُمْ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ، فَذَكَرُوا ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ آيَةَ التَّيَمُّمِ‏.‏ زَادَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ اسْتَعَارَتْ مِنْ أَسْمَاءَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa 'abdaau, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat halakat qilaadaaun laasmaa'a, faba'atha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy talabihaa rijaalaan, fahadarati alssalaaau walaysuwa 'alaa wuduw'in walam yajiduwa maa'an, fasallawa wahum 'alaa ghayri wuduw'in, fadhakaruwa dhalika lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaanzala alllahu ayaaa alttayammumi‏.‏ zaada abnu numayrin 'an hishaamin 'an aabiyhi 'an 'aaiishaaa asta'aarat min aasmaa'a‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:A necklace belonging to Asma' was lost, and the Prophet (ﷺ) sent men in its search. The time for the prayer became due and they were without ablution and they could not find water; therefore they prayed without ablution, They mentioned that to the Prophet (ﷺ) . Then Allah revealed the Verse of Tayammum. (`Aisha added: that she had borrowed (the necklace) from Asma
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَدِيٌّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدًا، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى يَوْمَ الْعِيدِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، لَمْ يُصَلِّ قَبْلَهَا وَلاَ بَعْدَهَا ثُمَّ أَتَى النِّسَاءَ وَمَعَهُ بِلاَلٌ فَأَمَرَهُنَّ بِالصَّدَقَةِ، فَجَعَلَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ تُلْقِي قُرْطَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy 'adiyyun, qaala sami'tu sa'iydana, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa yawma al'iydi rak'atayni, lam yusalli qablahaa walaa ba'dahaa thumma aataa alnnisaa'a wama'ahu bilaalun faaamarahunna bialssadaqaai, faja'alati almaraaau tulqiy qurtahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:"The Prophet (ﷺ) offered a two-rak`at prayer on `Id day and he did not offer any (Nawafil prayer) before or after it. He then went towards the women, and Bilal was accompanying him, and ordered them to give alms. And so the women started giving their earrings (etc)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَرْقَاءُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سُوقٍ مِنْ أَسْوَاقِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَانْصَرَفَ فَانْصَرَفْتُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ لُكَعُ ـ ثَلاَثًا ـ ادْعُ الْحَسَنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَامَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ يَمْشِي وَفِي عُنُقِهِ السِّخَابُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ هَكَذَا، فَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ بِيَدِهِ، هَكَذَا فَالْتَزَمَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحِبُّهُ، فَأَحِبَّهُ، وَأَحِبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَمَا كَانَ أَحَدٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَىَّ مِنَ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ بَعْدَ مَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا قَالَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa warqaa'u bnu 'umara, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy yaziyda, 'an naafi'i bni jubayrin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala kuntu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy suwqin min aaswaaqi almadiynaai faansarafa faansaraftu faqaala ‏"‏ aayna luka'u thalaathana ad'u alhasana bna 'aliyyin ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaama alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin yamshiy wafiy 'unuqihi alssikhaabu, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadihi hakadhaa, faqaala alhasanu biyadihi, hakadhaa faaltazamahu faqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma iinniy auhibbuhu, faaahibbahu, waaahibba man yuhibbuhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw hurayraaa famaa kaana aahadun aahabba iilaaaa mina alhasani bni 'aliyyin ba'da maa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa qaala‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in one of the Markets of Medina. He left (the market) and so did I. Then he asked thrice, "Where is the small (child)?" Then he said, "Call Al-Hasan bin `Ali." So Al-Hasan bin `Ali got up and started walking with a necklace (of beads) around his neck. The Prophet (ﷺ) stretched his hand out like this, and Al-Hasan did the same. The Prophet (ﷺ) embraced him and said, "O Allah! I love him, so please love him and love those who love him." Since Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that. nothing has been dearer to me than Al-Hasan
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمُتَشَبِّهِينَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ بِالنِّسَاءِ، وَالْمُتَشَبِّهَاتِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ بِالرِّجَالِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَمْرٌو أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala la'ana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almutashabbihiyna mina alrrijaali bialnnisaa'i, waalmutashabbihaati mina alnnisaa'i bialrrijaali‏.‏ taaba'ahu 'amrunw aakhbaranaa shu'baau‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cursed those men who are in the similitude (assume the manners) of women and those women who are in the similitude (assume the manners) of men
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لَعَنَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمُخَنَّثِينَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ، وَالْمُتَرَجِّلاَتِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَخْرِجُوهُمْ مِنْ بُيُوتِكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَخْرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فُلاَنًا، وَأَخْرَجَ عُمَرُ فُلاَنًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu fadaalaaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an yahyaa, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala la'ana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm almukhannathiyna mina alrrijaali, waalmutarajjilaati mina alnnisaa'i waqaala ‏ "‏ aakhrijuwhum min buyuwtikum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faaakhraja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fulaanana, waaakhraja 'umaru fulaanana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) cursed effeminate men (those men who are in the similitude (assume the manners of women) and those women who assume the manners of men, and he said, "Turn them out of your houses ." The Prophet (ﷺ) turned out such-and-such man, and `Umar turned out such-and-such woman
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ أَخْبَرَتْهَا أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ عِنْدَهَا وَفِي الْبَيْتِ مُخَنَّثٌ، فَقَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَخِي أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ إِنْ فُتِحَ لَكُمْ غَدًا الطَّائِفُ، فَإِنِّي أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى بِنْتِ غَيْلاَنَ، فَإِنَّهَا تُقْبِلُ بِأَرْبَعٍ وَتُدْبِرُ بِثَمَانٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَدْخُلَنَّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَلَيْكُنَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ تُقْبِلُ بِأَرْبَعٍ وَتُدْبِرُ بِثَمَانٍ يَعْنِي أَرْبَعَ عُكَنِ بَطْنِهَا، فَهْىَ تُقْبِلُ بِهِنَّ، وَقَوْلُهُ وَتُدْبِرُ بِثَمَانٍ‏.‏ يَعْنِي أَطْرَافَ هَذِهِ الْعُكَنِ الأَرْبَعِ، لأَنَّهَا مُحِيطَةٌ بِالْجَنْبَيْنِ حَتَّى لَحِقَتْ وَإِنَّمَا قَالَ بِثَمَانٍ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ بِثَمَانِيَةٍ‏.‏ وَوَاحِدُ الأَطْرَافِ وَهْوَ ذَكَرٌ، لأَنَّهُ لَمْ يَقُلْ ثَمَانِيَةَ أَطْرَافٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa maaliku bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, aanna 'urwaaa, aakhbarahu aanna zaynaba abnaaa aabiy salamaaa aakhbarathu aanna aumma salamaaa aakhbarathaa aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana 'indahaa wafiy albayti mukhannathun, faqaala li'abdi alllahi aakhiy aummi salamaaa yaa 'abda alllahi iin futiha lakum ghadana alttaaiifu, faiinniy aadulluka 'alaa binti ghaylaana, faiinnahaa tuqbilu biaarba'in watudbiru bithamaanin‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yadkhulanna hauulaa'i 'alaykunna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi tuqbilu biaarba'in watudbiru bithamaanin ya'niy aarba'a 'ukani batnihaa, fahaa tuqbilu bihinna, waqawluhu watudbiru bithamaanin‏.‏ ya'niy aatraafa hadhihi al'ukani alaarba'i, laannahaa muhiytaaun bialjanbayni hattaa lahiqat waiinnamaa qaala bithamaanin‏.‏ walam yaqul bithamaaniyaain‏.‏ wawaahidu alaatraafi wahwa dhakarun, laannahu lam yaqul thamaaniyaaa aatraafin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Salama:that once the Prophet (ﷺ) was in her house, and an effeminate man was there too. The effeminate man said to `Abdullah, (Um Salama's brother) "0 `Abdullah! If Ta'if should be conquered tomorrow, I recommend you the daughter of Ghailan, for she is so fat that she has four curves in the front (of her belly) and eight at the back." So the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to his wives) "These effeminate (men) should not enter upon you (your houses)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ أَصْحَابُنَا عَنِ الْمَكِّيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مِنَ الْفِطْرَةِ قَصُّ الشَّارِبِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa almakkiyyu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an hanzalaaa, 'an naafi'in, qaala aashaabunaa 'ani almakkiyyi, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mina alfitraai qassu alshhaaribi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To get the moustaches cut 'short is characteristic of the Fitra
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، رِوَايَةً ‏ "‏ الْفِطْرَةُ خَمْسٌ ـ أَوْ خَمْسٌ مِنَ الْفِطْرَةِ ـ الْخِتَانُ، وَالاِسْتِحْدَادُ، وَنَتْفُ الإِبْطِ، وَتَقْلِيمُ الأَظْفَارِ، وَقَصُّ الشَّارِبِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala alzzuhriyyu haddathanaa 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, riwaayaaan ‏ "‏ alfitraau khamsun aaw khamsun mina alfitraai alkhitaanu, waalaistihdaadu, wanatfu aliibti, wataqliymu alaazfaari, waqassu alshhaaribi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Five practices are characteristics of the Fitra: circumcision, shaving the pubic region, clipping the nails and cutting the moustaches short
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ حَنْظَلَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مِنَ الْفِطْرَةِ حَلْقُ الْعَانَةِ، وَتَقْلِيمُ الأَظْفَارِ، وَقَصُّ الشَّارِبِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu aabiy rajaa'in, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu sulaymaana, qaala sami'tu hanzalaaa, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mina alfitraai halqu al'aanaai, wataqliymu alaazfaari, waqassu alshhaaribi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "To shave the pubic hair. to clip the nails and to cut the moustaches short, are characteristics of the Fitra
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الْفِطْرَةُ خَمْسٌ الْخِتَانُ، وَالاِسْتِحْدَادُ، وَقَصُّ الشَّارِبِ، وَتَقْلِيمُ الأَظْفَارِ، وَنَتْفُ الآبَاطِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, haddathanaa abnu shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alfitraau khamsun alkhitaanu, waalaistihdaadu, waqassu alshhaaribi, wataqliymu alaazfaari, wanatfu alabaati ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying. "Five practices are characteristics of the Fitra: circumcision, shaving the pubic hair, cutting the moustaches short, clipping the nails, and depilating the hair of the armpits
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ خَالِفُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ، وَفِّرُوا اللِّحَى، وَأَحْفُوا الشَّوَارِبَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ إِذَا حَجَّ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَ قَبَضَ عَلَى لِحْيَتِهِ، فَمَا فَضَلَ أَخَذَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu muhammadi bni zaydin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ khaalifuwa almushrikiyna, waffiruwa alllihaa, waaahfuwa alshhawaariba ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana abnu 'umara iidhaa hajja aawi a'tamara qabada 'alaa lihyatihi, famaa fadala aakhadhahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar said, The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Do the opposite of what the pagans do. Keep the beards and cut the moustaches short.' Whenever Ibn `Umar performed the Hajj or `Umra, he used to hold his beard with his hand and cut whatever remained outside his hold
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ انْهَكُوا الشَّوَارِبَ، وَأَعْفُوا اللِّحَى ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadun, aakhbaranaa 'abdaau, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ anhakuwa alshhawaariba, waaa'fuwa alllihaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Cut the moustaches short and leave the beard (as it is)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسًا أَخَضَبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَمْ يَبْلُغِ الشَّيْبَ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu aasadin, haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, qaala saaaltu aanasana aakhadaba alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lam yablughi alshhayba iilaaa qaliylaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muhammad bin Seereen:I asked Anas, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) dye his hair?" Anas replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) did not have except a few grey hairs
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ سُئِلَ أَنَسٌ عَنْ خِضَابِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَبْلُغْ مَا يَخْضِبُ، لَوْ شِئْتُ أَنْ أَعُدَّ شَمَطَاتِهِ فِي لِحْيَتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an thaabitin, qaala suiila aanasun 'an khidaabi alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala iinnahu lam yablugh maa yakhdibu, law shiitu aan aa'udda shamataatihi fiy lihyatihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Thabit:Anas was asked whether the Prophet (ﷺ) used a a hair dye or not. He replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) did not have enough grey hair to dye, (such that) if I wanted to count the fading hairs in his beard (I could have)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، قَالَ أَرْسَلَنِي أَهْلِي إِلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ بِقَدَحٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ ـ وَقَبَضَ إِسْرَائِيلُ ثَلاَثَ أَصَابِعَ ـ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ فِيهِ شَعَرٌ مِنْ شَعَرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ إِذَا أَصَابَ الإِنْسَانَ عَيْنٌ أَوْ شَىْءٌ بَعَثَ إِلَيْهَا مِخْضَبَهُ، فَاطَّلَعْتُ فِي الْجُلْجُلِ فَرَأَيْتُ شَعَرَاتٍ حُمْرًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa maaliku bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an 'uthmaana bni 'abdi alllahi bni mawhabin, qaala aarsalaniy aahliy iilaa aummi salamaaa biqadahin min maa'in waqabada iisraaiiylu thalaatha aasaabi'a min fiddaain fiyhi sha'arun min sha'ari alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaana iidhaa aasaaba aliinsaana 'aynun aaw shaa'un ba'atha iilayhaa mikhdabahu, faattala'tu fiy aljuljuli faraaaytu sha'araatin humrana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated IsraiI:`Uthman bin `Abdullah bin Mauhab said, "My people sent me with a bowl of water to Um Salama." Isra'il approximated three fingers ('indicating the small size of the container in which there was some hair of the Prophet. `Uthman added, "If any person suffered from evil eye or some other disease, he would send a vessel (containing water) to Um Salama. I looked into the container (that held the hair of the Prophet) and saw a few red hairs in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلاَّمٌ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ فَأَخْرَجَتْ إِلَيْنَا شَعَرًا مِنْ شَعَرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَخْضُوبًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa salaaamun, 'an 'uthmaana bni 'abdi alllahi bni mawhabin, qaala dakhaltu 'alaa aummi salamaaa faaakhrajat iilaynaa sha'arana min sha'ari alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm makhduwbana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Uthman bin `Abdullah bin Mauhab:I went to Um Salama and she brought out for us some of the dyed hair of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ لَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا نُصَيْرُ بْنُ أَبِي الأَشْعَثِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ، أَرَتْهُ شَعَرَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْمَرَ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala lanaa aabuw nu'aymin haddathanaa nusayru bnu aabiy alaash'athi, 'ani abni mawhabin, aanna aumma salamaaa, aarathu sha'ara alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahmara‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Mauhab also said that Um Salama had shown him the red hair of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، وَسُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْيَهُودَ وَالنَّصَارَى لاَ يَصْبُغُونَ فَخَالِفُوهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhumaydiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an aabiy salamaaa, wasulaymaana bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alyahuwda waalnnasaaraa laa yasbughuwna fakhaalifuwhum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Jews and Christians do not dye their hair so you should do the opposite of what they do
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْسَ بِالطَّوِيلِ الْبَائِنِ، وَلاَ بِالْقَصِيرِ، وَلَيْسَ بِالأَبْيَضِ الأَمْهَقِ، وَلَيْسَ بِالآدَمِ، وَلَيْسَ بِالْجَعْدِ الْقَطَطِ، وَلاَ بِالسَّبْطِ، بَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَأْسِ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً، فَأَقَامَ بِمَكَّةَ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ، وَبِالْمَدِينَةِ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ، وَتَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَأْسِ سِتِّينَ سَنَةً، وَلَيْسَ فِي رَأْسِهِ وَلِحْيَتِهِ عِشْرُونَ شَعَرَةً بَيْضَاءَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maaliku bnu aanasin, 'an rabiy'aaa bni aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aannahu sami'ahu yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laysa bialttawiyli albaaiini, walaa bialqasiyri, walaysa bialaabyadi alaamhaqi, walaysa bialadami, walaysa bialja'di alqatati, walaa bialssabti, ba'athahu alllahu 'alaa raasi aarba'iyna sanaaan, faaaqaama bimakkaaa 'ashra siniyna, wabialmadiynaai 'ashra siniyna, watawaffaahu alllahu 'alaa raasi sittiyna sanaaan, walaysa fiy raasihi walihyatihi 'ishruwna sha'araaan baydaa'a‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) was neither conspicuously tall, nor short; neither, very white, nor tawny. His hair was neither much curled, nor very straight. Allah sent him (as an Apostle) at the age of forty (and after that) he stayed for ten years in Mecca, and for ten more years in Medina. Allah took him unto Him at the age of sixty, and he scarcely had ten white hairs on his head and in his beard
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، يَقُولُ مَا رَأَيْتُ أَحَدًا أَحْسَنَ فِي حُلَّةٍ حَمْرَاءَ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِي عَنْ مَالِكٍ إِنَّ جُمَّتَهُ لَتَضْرِبُ قَرِيبًا مِنْ مَنْكِبَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ سَمِعْتُهُ يُحَدِّثُهُ غَيْرَ مَرَّةٍ، مَا حَدَّثَ بِهِ قَطُّ إِلاَّ ضَحِكَ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ شُعْبَةُ شَعَرُهُ يَبْلُغُ شَحْمَةَ أُذُنَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa maaliku bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, sami'tu albaraa'a, yaquwlu maa raaaytu aahadana aahsana fiy hullaain hamraa'a mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ qaala ba'du aashaabiy 'an maalikin iinna jummatahu latadribu qariybana min mankibayhi‏.‏ qaala aabuw iishaaqa sami'tuhu yuhaddithuhu ghayra marraain, maa haddatha bihi qattu iilaaa dahika‏.‏ taaba'ahu shu'baau sha'aruhu yablughu shahmaaa audhunayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara':I did not see anybody in a red cloak looking more handsome than the Prophet. Narrated Malik: The hair of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to hang near his shoulders. Abu Ishaq said, "I heard him relate it more than once. He always laughed when he related it." Narrated Shu`ba: The hair of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to hang down to the earlobes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أُرَانِي اللَّيْلَةَ عِنْدَ الْكَعْبَةِ، فَرَأَيْتُ رَجُلاً آدَمَ كَأَحْسَنِ مَا أَنْتَ رَاءٍ مِنْ أُدْمِ الرِّجَالِ، لَهُ لِمَّةٌ كَأَحْسَنِ مَا أَنْتَ رَاءٍ مِنَ اللِّمَمِ، قَدْ رَجَّلَهَا، فَهْىَ تَقْطُرُ مَاءً مُتَّكِئًا عَلَى رَجُلَيْنِ، أَوْ عَلَى عَوَاتِقِ رَجُلَيْنِ، يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ فَسَأَلْتُ مَنْ هَذَا فَقِيلَ الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ‏.‏ وَإِذَا أَنَا بِرَجُلٍ جَعْدٍ، قَطَطٍ، أَعْوَرِ الْعَيْنِ الْيُمْنَى كَأَنَّهَا عِنَبَةٌ طَافِيَةٌ، فَسَأَلْتُ مَنْ هَذَا فَقِيلَ الْمَسِيحُ الدَّجَّالُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ auraaniy alllaylaaa 'inda alka'baai, faraaaytu rajulaan adama kaaahsani maa aanta raa'in min audmi alrrijaali, lahu limmaaun kaaahsani maa aanta raa'in mina alllimami, qad rajjalahaa, fahaa taqturu maa'an muttakiiana 'alaa rajulayni, aaw 'alaa 'awaatiqi rajulayni, yatuwfu bialbayti fasaaaltu man hadhaa faqiyla almasiyhu abnu maryama‏.‏ waiidhaa aanaa birajulin ja'din, qatatin, aa'wari al'ayni alyumnaa kaaannahaa 'inabaaun taafiyaaun, fasaaaltu man hadhaa faqiyla almasiyhu alddajjaalu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Today I saw myself in a dream near the Ka`ba. I saw a whitish brown man, the handsomest of all brown men you might ever see. He had the most beautiful Limma (hair hanging down to the earlobes) you might ever see. He had combed it and it was dripping water; and he was performing the Tawaf around the Ka`ba leaning on two men or on the shoulders of two men. I asked, "Who is this?" It was said. "Messiah, the son of Mary." Suddenly I saw a curly-haired man, blind in the right eye which looked like a protruding out grape. I asked, "Who is this?" It was said, "He is Masiah Ad-Dajjal
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَبَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَضْرِبُ شَعَرُهُ مَنْكِبَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa habbaanu, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, haddathanaa aanasun, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yadribu sha'aruhu mankibayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas : The hair of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to hang down up to his shoulders
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، كَانَ يَضْرِبُ شَعَرُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَنْكِبَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, kaana yadribu sha'aru alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mankibayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas: The head-hair of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to hang down to his shoulders
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنْ شَعَرِ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ كَانَ شَعَرُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجِلاً، لَيْسَ بِالسَّبِطِ، وَلاَ الْجَعْدِ، بَيْنَ أُذُنَيْهِ وَعَاتِقِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, qaala saaaltu aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh 'an sha'ari, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala kaana sha'aru rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajilaan, laysa bialssabiti, walaa alja'di, bayna audhunayhi wa'aatiqihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qatada:l asked Anas bin Malik about the hair of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He said, "The hair of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was neither much straight, nor much curly, and it used to hang down till between his shoulders and his earlobes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَخْمَ الْيَدَيْنِ، لَمْ أَرَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَكَانَ شَعَرُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجِلاً، لاَ جَعْدَ، وَلاَ سَبِطَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimun, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhma alyadayni, lam aara ba'dahu mithlahu, wakaana sha'aru alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajilaan, laa ja'da, walaa sabita‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) had big hands, and I have never seen anybody like him after him. The hair of the Prophet was wavy, neither curly nor straight
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَخْمَ الْيَدَيْنِ وَالْقَدَمَيْنِ حَسَنَ الْوَجْهِ، لَمْ أَرَ بَعْدَهُ وَلاَ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَكَانَ بَسِطَ الْكَفَّيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhma alyadayni waalqadamayni hasana alwajhi, lam aara ba'dahu walaa qablahu mithlahu, wakaana basita alkaffayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) had big hands and feet, and I have not seen anybody like him, neither before nor after him, and his palms were soft
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ،‏.‏ أَوْ عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَخْمَ الْقَدَمَيْنِ، حَسَنَ الْوَجْهِ، لَمْ أَرَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu haaniiin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, ‏.‏ aaw 'an rajulin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhma alqadamayni, hasana alwajhi, lam aara ba'dahu mithlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) had big feet and a good-looking face and I have not seen anybody like him after him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ هِشَامٌ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَثْنَ الْقَدَمَيْنِ وَالْكَفَّيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala hishaamun 'an ma'marin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm shathna alqadamayni waalkaffayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) had big feet and hands
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ أَبُو هِلاَلٍ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ،‏.‏ أَوْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَخْمَ الْكَفَّيْنِ وَالْقَدَمَيْنِ، لَمْ أَرَ بَعْدَهُ شَبَهًا لَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala aabuw hilaalin haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasin, ‏.‏ aaw jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhma alkaffayni waalqadamayni, lam aara ba'dahu shabahana lahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas or Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) had big hands and feet and I have not seen anybody like him after him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ فَذَكَرُوا الدَّجَّالَ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ مَكْتُوبٌ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ كَافِرٌ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ لَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ قَالَ ذَاكَ وَلَكِنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَمَّا إِبْرَاهِيمُ فَانْظُرُوا إِلَى صَاحِبِكُمْ، وَأَمَّا مُوسَى فَرَجُلٌ آدَمُ جَعْدٌ، عَلَى جَمَلٍ أَحْمَرَ مَخْطُومٍ بِخُلْبَةٍ، كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ إِذِ انْحَدَرَ فِي الْوَادِي يُلَبِّي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathaniy abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'ani abni 'awnin, 'an mujaahidin, qaala kunnaa 'inda abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma fadhakaruwa alddajjaala faqaala iinnahu maktuwbun bayna 'aynayhi kaafirun‏.‏ waqaala abnu 'abbaasin lam aasma'hu qaala dhaaka walakinnahu qaala ‏ "‏ aammaa iibraahiymu faanzuruwa iilaa saahibikum, waaammaa muwsaa farajulun adamu ja'dun, 'alaa jamalin aahmara makhtuwmin bikhulbaain, kaaanniy aanzuru iilayhi iidhi anhadara fiy alwaadiy yulabbiy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mujahid:We were with Ibn `Abbas and the people mentioned Ad-Dajjal. Someone said, "The word 'Kafir' (unbeliever) is written in between his (Ad-Dajjal's) eyes." Ibn `Abbas said, "I have not heard the Prophet saying this, but he said, 'As regards Abraham, he looks like your companion (i.e. the Prophet, Muhammad), and as regards Moses, he is a brown curly haired man riding a camel and reigned with a strong jute rope, as if I am now looking at him getting down in the valley and saying, "Labbaik
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ مَنْ ضَفَّرَ فَلْيَحْلِقْ، وَلاَ تَشَبَّهُوا بِالتَّلْبِيدِ‏.‏ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُلَبِّدًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, qaala sami'tu 'umara rda allh 'nh yaquwlu man daffara falyahliq, walaa tashabbahuwa bialttalbiydi‏.‏ wakaana abnu 'umara yaquwlu laqad raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mulabbidana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard `Umar saying, "Whoever braids his hair should shave it (on finishing Ihram). You'd better not do, something like Talbid." Ibn `Umar used to say: "I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with his hair stuck together with gum
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حِبَّانُ بْنُ مُوسَى، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُهِلُّ مُلَبِّدًا يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ لاَ يَزِيدُ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy hibbaanu bnu muwsaa, waaahmadu bnu muhammadin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhillu mulabbidana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ labbayka alllahumma labbayka, labbayka laa shariyka laka labbayka, iinna alhamda waalnni'maaa laka waalmulka laa shariyka laka ‏"‏‏.‏ laa yaziydu 'alaa hauulaa'i alkalimaati‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), while he was in the state of Ihram and his hair was stuck together with gum, saying, "Labbaik, Allahumma Labbaik, Labbaik La Sharika laka Labbaik. Inn-al-Hamda Wan-Ni'mata Laka wal-Mulk, La Sharika Lak." He did not add anything to those words
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا شَأْنُ النَّاسِ حَلُّوا بِعُمْرَةٍ، وَلَمْ تَحْلِلْ أَنْتَ مِنْ عُمْرَتِكَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لَبَّدْتُ رَأْسِي، وَقَلَّدْتُ هَدْيِي، فَلاَ أَحِلُّ حَتَّى أَنْحَرَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an hafsaaa rda allh 'nha zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi maa shaanu alnnaasi halluwa bi'umraain, walam tahlil aanta min 'umratika qaala ‏ "‏ iinniy labbadtu raasiy, waqalladtu hadyiy, falaa aahillu hattaa aanhara ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hafsa:(the wife of the Prophet) I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why have the people finished their Ihram after performing the `Umra while you have not finished your Ihram after your `Umra?" He said, "I have done Talbid (of my hair) and have decorated my Hadis with garlands, so I shall not finish my Ihram till I have slaughtered my Hadi (animal for sacrifice)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحِبُّ مُوَافَقَةَ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ فِيمَا لَمْ يُؤْمَرْ فِيهِ، وَكَانَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ يَسْدِلُونَ أَشْعَارَهُمْ، وَكَانَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ يَفْرُقُونَ رُءُوسَهُمْ، فَسَدَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَاصِيَتَهُ، ثُمَّ فَرَقَ بَعْدُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, haddathanaa abnu shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhibbu muwaafaqaaa aahli alkitaabi fiymaa lam yuumar fiyhi, wakaana aahlu alkitaabi yasdiluwna aash'aarahum, wakaana almushrikuwna yafruquwna ru'uwsahum, fasadala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm naasiyatahu, thumma faraqa ba'du‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to copy the people of the Scriptures in matters in which there was no order from Allah. The people of the Scripture used to let their hair hang down while the pagans used to part their hair. So the Prophet (ﷺ) let his hair hang down first, but later on he parted it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ الطِّيبِ فِي مَفَارِقِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ مُحْرِمٌ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فِي مَفْرِقِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, wa'abdu alllahi bnu rajaa'in, qaalaa haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaaanniy aanzuru iilaa wabiysi alttiybi fiy mafaariqi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa muhrimun‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi fiy mafriqi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:As if I am now looking at the shine of the hair parting of the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was in the state of Ihram
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَنْبَسَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بِتُّ لَيْلَةً عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ خَالَتِي، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَهَا فِي لَيْلَتِهَا ـ قَالَ ـ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي مِنَ اللَّيْلِ، فَقُمْتُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ ـ قَالَ ـ فَأَخَذَ بِذُؤَابَتِي فَجَعَلَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، بِهَذَا، وَقَالَ بِذُؤَابَتِي أَوْ بِرَأْسِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa alfadlu bnu 'anbasaaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa aabuw bishrin, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa hushaymun, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala bittu laylaaan 'inda maymuwnaaa binti alhaarithi khaalatiy, wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'indahaa fiy laylatihaa qaala faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy mina alllayli, faqumtu 'an yasaarihi qaala faaakhadha bidhuuaabatiy faja'alaniy 'an yamiynihi‏.‏ haddathanaa 'amruw bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa aabuw bishrin, bihadhaa, waqaala bidhuuaabatiy aaw biraasiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once I stayed overnight in the house of my aunt Maimuna bint Al-Harith and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was with her as it was her turn. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up to offer the night prayer. I stood on his left but he took hold of my two locks of hair and made me stand on his right. Narrated Abu Bishr: (the above Hadith) but he quoted: Ibn `Abbas said, (took hold of) my two braids on my head
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْلَدٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ نَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَى عَنِ الْقَزَعِ‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ قُلْتُ وَمَا الْقَزَعُ فَأَشَارَ لَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ قَالَ إِذَا حَلَقَ الصَّبِيَّ وَتَرَكَ هَا هُنَا شَعَرَةً وَهَا هُنَا وَهَا هُنَا‏.‏ فَأَشَارَ لَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ إِلَى نَاصِيَتِهِ وَجَانِبَىْ رَأْسِهِ‏.‏ قِيلَ لِعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ فَالْجَارِيَةُ وَالْغُلاَمُ قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي هَكَذَا قَالَ الصَّبِيِّ‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ وَعَاوَدْتُهُ فَقَالَ أَمَّا الْقُصَّةُ وَالْقَفَا لِلْغُلاَمِ فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِهِمَا وَلَكِنَّ الْقَزَعَ أَنْ يُتْرَكَ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ شَعَرٌ، وَلَيْسَ فِي رَأْسِهِ غَيْرُهُ، وَكَذَلِكَ شَقُّ رَأْسِهِ هَذَا وَهَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadun, qaala aakhbaraniy makhladun, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu hafsin, aanna 'umara bna naafi'in, aakhbarahu 'an naafi'in, mawlaa 'abdi alllahi aannahu sami'a abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yanhaa 'ani alqaza'i‏.‏ qaala 'ubaydu alllahi qultu wamaa alqaza'u faaashaara lanaa 'ubaydu alllahi qaala iidhaa halaqa alssabiyya wataraka haa hunaa sha'araaan wahaa hunaa wahaa hunaa‏.‏ faaashaara lanaa 'ubaydu alllahi iilaa naasiyatihi wajaanibaa raasihi‏.‏ qiyla li'ubaydi alllahi faaljaariyaau waalghulaamu qaala laa aadriy hakadhaa qaala alssabiyyi‏.‏ qaala 'ubaydu alllahi wa'aawadtuhu faqaala aammaa alqussaau waalqafaa lilghulaami falaa baasa bihimaa walakinna alqaza'a aan yutraka binaasiyatihi sha'arun, walaysa fiy raasihi ghayruhu, wakadhalika shaqqu raasihi hadhaa wahadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ubaidullah bin Hafs:that `Umar bin Nafi` told him that Nafi`, Maula `Abdullah had heard `Umar saying, "I heard Allah's Apostle forbidding Al-Qaza'." 'Ubaidullah added: I said, "What is Al-Qaza'?" 'Ubaidullah pointed (towards his head) to show us and added, "Nafi` said, 'It is when a boy has his head shaved leaving a tuft of hair here and a tuft of hair there." Ubaidullah pointed towards his forehead and the sides of his head. 'Ubaidullah was asked, "Does this apply to both girls and boys?" He said, "I don't know, but Nafi` said, 'The boy.'" 'Ubaidullah added, "I asked Nafi` again, and he said, 'As for leaving hair on the temples and the back part of the boy's head, there is no harm, but Al-Qaza' is to leave a tuft of hair on his forehead unshaved while there is no hair on the rest of his head, and also to leave hair on either side of his head
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْقَزَعِ‏.‏
