verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu almuthannaa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aanasi bni maalikin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu diynaarin, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alqaza'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated (Abdullah) bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Al-Qaza' (leaving a tuft of hair here and there after shaving one's head)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ طَيَّبْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِي لِحُرْمِهِ، وَطَيَّبْتُهُ بِمِنًى قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفِيضَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu muhammadin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu alqaasimi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat tayyabtu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadiy lihurmihi, watayyabtuhu biminana qabla aan yufiyda‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I applied perfume to the Prophet (ﷺ) with my own hands when he wanted to assume the state of Ihram, and I also perfumed him at Mina before he departed from there (to perform Tawaf-al-Ifada)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أُطَيِّبُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِأَطْيَبِ مَا يَجِدُ، حَتَّى أَجِدَ وَبِيصَ الطِّيبِ فِي رَأْسِهِ وَلِحْيَتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu nasrin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alaaswadi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kuntu autayyibu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm biaatyabi maa yajidu, hattaa aajida wabiysa alttiybi fiy raasihi walihyatihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I used to perfume Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with the best scent available till I saw the shine of the scent on his head and shine beard
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، اطَّلَعَ مِنْ جُحْرٍ فِي دَارِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَحُكُّ رَأْسَهُ بِالْمِدْرَى فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّكَ تَنْظُرُ لَطَعَنْتُ بِهَا فِي عَيْنِكَ، إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الإِذْنُ مِنْ قِبَلِ الأَبْصَارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu bnu aabiy iiyaasin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sahli bni sa'din, aanna rajulaan, attala'a min juhrin fiy daari alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yahukku raasahu bialmidraa faqaala ‏ "‏ law 'alimtu aannaka tanzuru lata'antu bihaa fiy 'aynika, iinnamaa ju'ila aliidhnu min qibali alaabsaari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d:A man peeped into the house of the Prophet (ﷺ) through a hole while the Prophet (ﷺ) was scratching his head with a Midrai (a certain kind of comb). On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "If I had known you had been looking, then I would have pierced your eye with that instrument, because the asking of permission has been ordained so that one would not see things unlawfully
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أُرَجِّلُ رَأْسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، مِثْلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kuntu aurajjilu raasa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa haaiidun‏.‏ haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, mithlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I used to comb the hair of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during my periods. This hadith also reaches us through another chain
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُعْجِبُهُ التَّيَمُّنُ مَا اسْتَطَاعَ فِي تَرَجُّلِهِ وَوُضُوئِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aash'atha bni sulaymin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu kaana yu'jibuhu alttayammunu maa astataa'a fiy tarajjulihi wawuduwiihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to like to start from the right side as far as possible in combing and in performing ablution
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ كُلُّ عَمَلِ ابْنِ آدَمَ لَهُ، إِلاَّ الصَّوْمَ فَإِنَّهُ لِي، وَأَنَا أَجْزِي بِهِ، وَلَخَلُوفُ فَمِ الصَّائِمِ أَطْيَبُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ رِيحِ الْمِسْكِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa hishaamun, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'ani abni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ kullu 'amali abni adama lahu, iilaaa alssawma faiinnahu liy, waaanaa aajziy bihi, walakhaluwfu fami alssaaiimi aatyabu 'inda alllahi min riyhi almiski ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(Allah said), 'Every good deed of Adam's son is for him except fasting; it is for Me. and I shall reward (the fasting person) for it.' Verily, the smell of the mouth of a fasting person is better to Allah than the smell of musk
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أُطَيِّبُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ إِحْرَامِهِ بِأَطْيَبِ مَا أَجِدُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an 'uthmaana bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kuntu autayyibu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'inda iihraamihi biaatyabi maa aajidu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:used to perfume the Prophet (ﷺ) before his assuming the state of with the best scent available
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَزْرَةُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ثُمَامَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ كَانَ لاَ يَرُدُّ الطِّيبَ، وَزَعَمَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ لاَ يَرُدُّ الطِّيبَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa 'azraau bnu thaabitin alaansaariyyu, qaala haddathaniy thumaamaau bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh aannahu kaana laa yaruddu alttiyba, waza'ama aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana laa yaruddu alttiyba‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Thumama bin `Abdullah;:Anas never used to refuse (a gift of) scent and used to say that the Prophet (ﷺ) never used to refuse (a gift of) scent
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ الْهَيْثَمِ، أَوْ مُحَمَّدٌ عَنْهُ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، سَمِعَ عُرْوَةَ، وَالْقَاسِمَ، يُخْبِرَانِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ طَيَّبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدَىَّ بِذَرِيرَةٍ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، لِلْحِلِّ وَالإِحْرَامِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu alhaythami, aaw muhammadun 'anhu 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'umaru bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'urwaaa, sami'a 'urwaaa, waalqaasima, yukhbiraani 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat tayyabtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadaaaa bidhariyraain fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i, lilhilli waaliihraami‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:During Hajjat-al-Wada`, I perfumed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with Dharira with my own hands, both on his assuming Ihram and on finishing it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْوَاشِمَاتِ، وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَاتِ، وَالْمُتَنَمِّصَاتِ وَالْمُتَفَلِّجَاتِ لِلْحُسْنِ، الْمُغَيِّرَاتِ خَلْقَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى، مَالِي لاَ أَلْعَنُ مَنْ لَعَنَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ ‏{‏وَمَا آتَاكُمُ الرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, la'ana alllahu alwaashimaati, waalmustawshimaati, waalmutanammisaati waalmutafallijaati lilhusni, almughayyiraati khalqa alllahi ta'aalaa, maaliy laa aal'anu man la'ana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa fiy kitaabi alllahi ‏{‏wamaa ataakumu alrrasuwlu fakhudhuwhu‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah has cursed those women who practise tattooing and those who get themselves tattooed, and those who remove their face hairs, and those who create a space between their teeth artificially to look beautiful, and such women as change the features created by Allah. Why then should I not curse those whom the Prophet (ﷺ) has cursed? And that is in Allah's Book. i.e. His Saying: 'And what the Apostle gives you take it and what he forbids you abstain (from it)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَامَ حَجَّ وَهْوَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، وَهْوَ يَقُولُ ـ وَتَنَاوَلَ قُصَّةً مِنْ شَعَرٍ كَانَتْ بِيَدِ حَرَسِيٍّ ـ أَيْنَ عُلَمَاؤُكُمْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَى عَنْ مِثْلِ هَذِهِ وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا هَلَكَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ حِينَ اتَّخَذَ هَذِهِ نِسَاؤُهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin, aannahu sami'a mu'aawiyaaa bna aabiy sufyaana, 'aama hajja wahwa 'alaa alminbari, wahwa yaquwlu watanaawala qussaaan min sha'arin kaanat biyadi harasiyyin aayna 'ulamaauukum sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yanhaa 'an mithli hadhihi wayaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinnamaa halakat banuw iisraaiiyla hiyna attakhadha hadhihi nisaauuhum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Humaid bin `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf:that in the year he performed Hajj. he heard Mu'awiya bin Abi Sufyan, who was on the pulpit and was taking a tuft of hair from one of his guards, saying, "Where are your religious learned men? I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding this (false hair) and saying, 'The children of Israel were destroyed when their women started using this
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْوَاصِلَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةَ، وَالْوَاشِمَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala abnu aabiy shaybaaa haddathanaa yuwnusu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa fulayhun, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ la'ana alllahu alwaasilaaa waalmustawsilaaa, waalwaashimaaa waalmustawshimaaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has cursed the lady who artificially lengthens (her or someone else's) hair and the one who gets her hair lengthened and the One who tattoos (herself or someone else) and the one who gets herself tattooed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ بْنَ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ يَنَّاقٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ جَارِيَةً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ تَزَوَّجَتْ، وَأَنَّهَا مَرِضَتْ فَتَمَعَّطَ شَعَرُهَا، فَأَرَادُوا أَنْ يَصِلُوهَا فَسَأَلُوا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْوَاصِلَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, qaala sami'tu alhasana bna muslimi bni yannaaqin, yuhaddithu 'an safiyyaaa binti shaybaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna jaariyaaan, mina alaansaari tazawwajat, waaannahaa maridat fatama''ata sha'aruhaa, faaaraaduwa aan yasiluwhaa fasaaaluwa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ la'ana alllahu alwaasilaaa waalmustawsilaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu abnu iishaaqa 'an aabaana bni saalihin 'ani alhasani 'an safiyyaaa 'an 'aaiishaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:An Ansari girl was married and she became sick and all her hair fell out intending to provide her with false hair. They asked the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "Allah has cursed the lady who artificially lengthens (her or someone else's) hair and also the one who gets her hair lengthened
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْمِقْدَامِ، حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمِّي، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، جَاءَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي أَنْكَحْتُ ابْنَتِي، ثُمَّ أَصَابَهَا شَكْوَى فَتَمَرَّقَ رَأْسُهَا، وَزَوْجُهَا يَسْتَحِثُّنِي بِهَا أَفَأَصِلُ رَأْسَهَا فَسَبَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْوَاصِلَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu almiqdaami, haddathanaa fudaylu bnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa mansuwru bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala haddathatniy aummiy, 'an aasmaa'a binti aabiy bakrin rda allh 'nhma aanna amraaaaan, jaa'at iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat iinniy aankahtu abnatiy, thumma aasaabahaa shakwaa fatamarraqa raasuhaa, wazawjuhaa yastahithhuniy bihaa aafaaasilu raasahaa fasabba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alwaasilaaa waalmustawsilaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Asma:(the daughter of Abu' Bakr) A woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "I married my daughter to someone, but she became sick and all her hair fell out, and (because of that) her husband does not like her. May I let her use false hair?" On that the Prophet (ﷺ) cursed such a lady as artificially lengthening (her or someone else's) hair or got her hair lengthened artificially
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنِ امْرَأَتِهِ، فَاطِمَةَ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَتْ لَعَنَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْوَاصِلَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'ani amraaatihi, faatimaaa 'an aasmaa'a binti aabiy bakrin, qaalat la'ana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alwaasilaaa waalmustawsilaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Asma':(the daughter of Abu Bakr) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has cursed such a lady as artificially lengthening (her or someone else's) hair or gets her hair lengthened
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْوَاصِلَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةَ، وَالْوَاشِمَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَافِعٌ الْوَشْمُ فِي اللِّثَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ la'ana alllahu alwaasilaaa waalmustawsilaaa, waalwaashimaaa waalmustawshimaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala naafi'un alwashmu fiy alllithaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah has cursed such a lady as lengthens (her or someone else's) hair artificially or gets it lengthened, and also a lady who tattoos (herself or someone else) or gets herself tattooed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ، سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، قَالَ قَدِمَ مُعَاوِيَةُ الْمَدِينَةَ آخِرَ قَدْمَةٍ قَدِمَهَا، فَخَطَبَنَا فَأَخْرَجَ كُبَّةً مِنْ شَعَرٍ قَالَ مَا كُنْتُ أَرَى أَحَدًا يَفْعَلُ هَذَا غَيْرَ الْيَهُودِ، إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمَّاهُ الزُّورَ‏.‏ يَعْنِي الْوَاصِلَةَ فِي الشَّعَرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu murraaa, sami'tu sa'iyda bna almusayyabi, qaala qadima mu'aawiyaau almadiynaaa akhira qadmaain qadimahaa, fakhatabanaa faaakhraja kubbaaan min sha'arin qaala maa kuntu aaraa aahadana yaf'alu hadhaa ghayra alyahuwdi, iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sammaahu alzzuwra‏.‏ ya'niy alwaasilaaa fiy alshha'ari‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:Mu'awiya came to Medina for the last time and delivered a sermon. He took out a tuft of hair and said, "I thought that none used to do this (i.e. use false hair) except Jews. The Prophet (ﷺ) labelled such practice, (i.e. the use of false hair), as cheating
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، قَالَ لَعَنَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ الْوَاشِمَاتِ، وَالْمُتَنَمِّصَاتِ، وَالْمُتَفَلِّجَاتِ لِلْحُسْنِ، الْمُغَيِّرَاتِ خَلْقَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ يَعْقُوبَ مَا هَذَا قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَمَا لِيَ لاَ أَلْعَنُ مَنْ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَفِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ قَرَأْتُ مَا بَيْنَ اللَّوْحَيْنِ فَمَا وَجَدْتُهُ‏.‏ قَالَ وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ قَرَأْتِيهِ لَقَدْ وَجَدْتِيهِ ‏{‏وَمَا آتَاكُمُ الرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ وَمَا نَهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ فَانْتَهُوا‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, qaala la'ana 'abdu alllahi alwaashimaati, waalmutanammisaati, waalmutafallijaati lilhusni, almughayyiraati khalqa alllahi‏.‏ faqaalat aummu ya'quwba maa hadhaa qaala 'abdu alllahi wamaa liya laa aal'anu man la'ana rasuwlu alllahi, wafiy kitaabi alllahi‏.‏ qaalat waalllahi laqad qaraatu maa bayna alllawhayni famaa wajadtuhu‏.‏ qaala waalllahi laiin qaraatiyhi laqad wajadtiyhi ‏{‏wamaa ataakumu alrrasuwlu fakhudhuwhu wamaa nahaakum 'anhu faantahuwa‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Alqama:`Abdullah cursed those women who practiced tattooing and those who removed hair from their faces and those who created spaces between their teeth artificially to look beautiful, such ladies as changed what Allah has created. Um Ya'qub said, "What is that?" `Abdullah said, "Why should I not curse those who were cursed by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and are referred to in Allah's Book?" She said to him "By Allah, I have read the whole Qur'an but I have not found such a thing. `Abdullah said, "By Allah, if you had read it (carefully) you would have found it. (Allah says:) 'And what the Apostle gives you take it and what he forbids you abstain (from it)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَعَنَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْوَاصِلَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةَ، وَالْوَاشِمَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadun, haddathanaa 'abdaau, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala la'ana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alwaasilaaa waalmustawsilaaa, waalwaashimaaa waalmustawshimaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) has cursed the lady who lengthens her hair artificially and the one who gets her hair lengthened, and also the lady who tattoos (herself or others) and the one who gets herself tattooed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ الْمُنْذِرِ، تَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَسْمَاءَ، قَالَتْ سَأَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ ابْنَتِي أَصَابَتْهَا الْحَصْبَةُ، فَامَّرَقَ شَعَرُهَا، وَإِنِّي زَوَّجْتُهَا أَفَأَصِلُ فِيهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْوَاصِلَةَ وَالْمَوْصُولَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhumaydiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa hishaamun, aannahu sami'a faatimaaa binta almundhiri, taquwlu sami'tu aasmaa'a, qaalat saaalati amraaaaun alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna abnatiy aasaabathaa alhasbaau, faammaraqa sha'aruhaa, waiinniy zawwajtuhaa aafaaasilu fiyhi faqaala ‏ "‏ la'ana alllahu alwaasilaaa waalmawsuwlaaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Asma':A woman asked the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My daughter got measles and her hair fell out. Now that I got her married, may I let her use false hair?" He said (to her), "Allah has cursed the lady who lengthens hair artificially and the one who gets her hair lengthened artificially
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا صَخْرُ بْنُ جُوَيْرِيَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْوَاشِمَةُ وَالْمُوتَشِمَةُ، وَالْوَاصِلَةُ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ يَعْنِي لَعَنَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yuwsufu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa alfadlu bnu dukaynin, haddathanaa sakhru bnu juwayriyaaa, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aaw qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alwaashimaau waalmuwtashimaau, waalwaasilaau waalmustawsilaau ‏"‏‏.‏ ya'niy la'ana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, (or the Prophet (ﷺ) said), "Allah has cursed the lady who practices tattooing and that who gets it done for herself, and also the lady who lengthens hair artificially and that who gets her hair lengthened artificially." The Prophet (ﷺ) has cursed such ladies
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْوَاشِمَاتِ، وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَاتِ، وَالْمُتَنَمِّصَاتِ وَالْمُتَفَلِّجَاتِ لِلْحُسْنِ، الْمُغَيِّرَاتِ خَلْقَ اللَّهِ، مَا لِي لاَ أَلْعَنُ مَنْ لَعَنَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'ani abni mas'uwdin rda allh 'nh qaala la'ana alllahu alwaashimaati, waalmustawshimaati, waalmutanammisaati waalmutafallijaati lilhusni, almughayyiraati khalqa alllahi, maa liy laa aal'anu man la'anahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa fiy kitaabi alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:Allah has cursed those women who practise tattooing or get it done for themselves, and those who remove hair from their faces, and those who create spaces between their teeth artificially to look beautiful, such ladies as change the features created by Allah. Why then shall I not curse those whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has cursed and who are cursed in Allah's Book too?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْعَيْنُ حَقٌّ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَنَهَى عَنِ الْوَشْمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, 'an ma'marin, 'an hammaamin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ al'aynu haqqun ‏"‏‏.‏ wanahaa 'ani alwashmi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The evil eye is a fact," and he forbade tattooing
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ ذَكَرْتُ لِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَابِسٍ حَدِيثَ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،، فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ أُمِّ يَعْقُوبَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ مَنْصُورٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy abnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa abnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala dhakartu li'abdi alrrahmani bni 'aabisin hadiytha mansuwrin 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, , faqaala sami'tuhu min aummi ya'quwba, 'an 'abdi alllahi, mithla hadiythi mansuwrin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:(As above)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ أَبِي فَقَالَ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ ثَمَنِ الدَّمِ، وَثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ، وَآكِلِ الرِّبَا وَمُوكِلِهِ، وَالْوَاشِمَةِ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'awni bni aabiy juhayfaaa, qaala raaaytu aabiy faqaala iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an thamani alddami, wathamani alkalbi, waakili alrribaa wamuwkilihi, waalwaashimaai waalmustawshimaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the use of the price of blood and the price of a dog, the one who takes (eats) usury the one who gives usury, the woman who practises tattooing and the woman who gets herself tattooed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أُتِيَ عُمَرُ بِامْرَأَةٍ تَشِمُ فَقَامَ فَقَالَ أَنْشُدُكُمْ بِاللَّهِ مَنْ سَمِعَ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْوَشْمِ فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَقُمْتُ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنَا سَمِعْتُ‏.‏ قَالَ مَا سَمِعْتَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَشِمْنَ وَلاَ تَسْتَوْشِمْنَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an 'umaaraaa, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala autiya 'umaru biamraaaain tashimu faqaama faqaala aanshudukum bialllahi man sami'a mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alwashmi faqaala aabuw hurayraaa faqumtu faqultu yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna aanaa sami'tu‏.‏ qaala maa sami'ta qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa tashimna walaa tastawshimna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:A woman who used to practise tattooing was brought to `Umar. `Umar got up and said, "I beseech you by Allah, which of you heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying something about tattooing?" I got up and said, "O chief of the Believers! I heard something." He said, "What did you hear?" I said, "I heard the Prophet (addressing the ladies), saying, 'Do not practise tattooing and do not get yourselves tattooed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ لَعَنَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْوَاصِلَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةَ، وَالْوَاشِمَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala la'ana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alwaasilaaa waalmustawsilaaa, waalwaashimaaa waalmustawshimaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) has cursed the lady who lengthens hair artificially and that who gets her hair lengthened in such away, and the lady who practises tattooing and that who gets it done for herself
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْوَاشِمَاتِ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَاتِ، وَالْمُتَنَمِّصَاتِ وَالْمُتَفَلِّجَاتِ لِلْحُسْنِ، الْمُغَيِّرَاتِ خَلْقَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ مَا لِي لاَ أَلْعَنُ مَنْ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, 'an sufyaana, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh la'ana alllahu alwaashimaati waalmustawshimaati, waalmutanammisaati waalmutafallijaati lilhusni, almughayyiraati khalqa alllahi‏.‏ maa liy laa aal'anu man la'ana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa fiy kitaabi alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah has cursed those women who practise tattooing and those who get it done for themselves, and those who remove hair from their faces, and those who artificially create spaces between their teeth to look beautiful, such women as alter the features created by Allah. Why should I not then curse those whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has cursed and that is in Allah's Book?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَلاَ تَصَاوِيرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا طَلْحَةَ، سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an aabiy talhaaa rda allh 'nhm qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tadkhulu almalaaiikaau baytana fiyhi kalbun walaa tasaawiyru ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi, sami'a abna 'abbaasin, sami'tu aabaa talhaaa, sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Talha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or there are pictures
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ مَسْرُوقٍ فِي دَارِ يَسَارِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، فَرَأَى فِي صُفَّتِهِ تَمَاثِيلَ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَشَدَّ النَّاسِ عَذَابًا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الْمُصَوِّرُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhumaydiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an muslimin, qaala kunnaa ma'a masruwqin fiy daari yasaari bni numayrin, faraaaa fiy suffatihi tamaathiyla faqaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna aashadda alnnaasi 'adhaabana 'inda alllahi yawma alqiyaamaai almusawwiruwna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muslim:We were with Masruq at the house of Yasar bin Numair. Masruq saw pictures on his terrace and said, "I heard `Abdullah saying that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The people who will receive the severest punishment from Allah will be the picture makers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَصْنَعُونَ هَذِهِ الصُّوَرَ يُعَذَّبُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُقَالُ لَهُمْ أَحْيُوا مَا خَلَقْتُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa aanasu bnu 'iyaadin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara rda allh 'nhma aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alladhiyna yasna'uwna hadhihi alssuwara yu'adhhabuwna yawma alqiyaamaai yuqaalu lahum aahyuwa maa khalaqtum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Those who make these pictures will be punished on the Day of Resurrection, and it will be said to them. 'Make alive what you have created
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حِطَّانَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَكُنْ يَتْرُكُ فِي بَيْتِهِ شَيْئًا فِيهِ تَصَالِيبُ إِلاَّ نَقَضَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu fadaalaaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an yahyaa, 'an 'imraana bni hittaana, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha haddathathu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm lam yakun yatruku fiy baytihi shayiana fiyhi tasaaliybu iilaaa naqadahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I never used to leave in the Prophet (ﷺ) house anything carrying images or crosses but he obliterated it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُرْعَةَ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ مَعَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ دَارًا بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَرَأَى أَعْلاَهَا مُصَوِّرًا يُصَوِّرُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذَهَبَ يَخْلُقُ كَخَلْقِي، فَلْيَخْلُقُوا حَبَّةً، وَلْيَخْلُقُوا ذَرَّةً ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِتَوْرٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى بَلَغَ إِبْطَهُ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ أَشَىْءٌ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ مُنْتَهَى الْحِلْيَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, haddathanaa 'umaaraau, haddathanaa aabuw zur'aaa, qaala dakhaltu ma'a aabiy hurayraaa daarana bialmadiynaai faraaaa aa'laahaa musawwirana yusawwiru, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ waman aazlamu mimman dhahaba yakhluqu kakhalqiy, falyakhluquwa habbaaan, walyakhluquwa dharraaan ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma da'aa bitawrin min maa'in faghasala yadayhi hattaa balagha iibtahu faqultu yaa aabaa hurayraaa aashaa'un sami'tahu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala muntahaa alhilyaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Zur'a:l entered a house in Medina with Abu Huraira, and he saw a man making pictures at the top of the house. Abu Huraira said, "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying that Allah said, 'Who would be more unjust than the one who tries to create the like of My creatures? Let them create a grain: let them create a gnat.' "Abu Huraira then asked for a water container and washed his arms up to his armpits. I said, "0 Abu i Huraira! Is this something you have heard I from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "The limit for ablution is up to the place where the ornaments will reach on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الْقَاسِمِ ـ وَمَا بِالْمَدِينَةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَفْضَلُ مِنْهُ ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ سَفَرٍ وَقَدْ سَتَرْتُ بِقِرَامٍ لِي عَلَى سَهْوَةٍ لِي فِيهَا تَمَاثِيلُ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَتَكَهُ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَشَدُّ النَّاسِ عَذَابًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الَّذِينَ يُضَاهُونَ بِخَلْقِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ وِسَادَةً أَوْ وِسَادَتَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala sami'tu 'abda alrrahmani bna alqaasimi wamaa bialmadiynaai yawmaiidhin aafdalu minhu qaala sami'tu aabiy qaala sami'tu 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min safarin waqad satartu biqiraamin liy 'alaa sahwaain liy fiyhaa tamaathiylu, falammaa raahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hatakahu waqaala ‏ "‏ aashaddu alnnaasi 'adhaabana yawma alqiyaamaai alladhiyna yudaahuwna bikhalqi alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat faja'alnaahu wisaadaaan aaw wisaadatayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned from a journey when I had placed a curtain of mine having pictures over (the door of) a chamber of mine. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw it, he tore it and said, "The people who will receive the severest punishment on the Day of Resurrection will be those who try to make the like of Allah's creations." So we turned it (i.e., the curtain) into one or two cushions
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ سَفَرٍ، وَعَلَّقْتُ دُرْنُوكًا فِيهِ تَمَاثِيلُ، فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَنْزِعَهُ، فَنَزَعْتُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu daawuda, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm min safarin, wa'allaqtu durnuwkana fiyhi tamaathiylu, faaamaraniy aan aanzi'ahu, fanaza'tuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) returned from a journey when I had hung a thick curtain having pictures (in front of a door). He ordered me to remove it and I removed it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَكُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: wakuntu aaghtasilu aanaa waalnnabiyyu, sla allh 'lyh wslm min iinaa'in waahidin‏.‏
verses.translation: Aisha added:The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take a bath from one container (of water)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّهَا اشْتَرَتْ نُمْرُقَةً فِيهَا تَصَاوِيرُ، فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْبَابِ فَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَتُوبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِمَّا أَذْنَبْتُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا هَذِهِ النُّمْرُقَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِتَجْلِسَ عَلَيْهَا وَتَوَسَّدَهَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ هَذِهِ الصُّوَرِ يُعَذَّبُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، يُقَالُ لَهُمْ أَحْيُوا مَا خَلَقْتُمْ‏.‏ وَإِنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ لاَ تَدْخُلُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ الصُّورَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa juwayriyaau, 'an naafi'in, 'ani alqaasimi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aannahaa ashtarat numruqaaan fiyhaa tasaawiyru, faqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bialbaabi falam yadkhul‏.‏ faqultu aatuwbu iilaa alllahi mimmaa aadhnabtu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ maa hadhihi alnnumruqaau ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu litajlisa 'alayhaa watawassadahaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinna aashaaba hadhihi alssuwari yu'adhhabuwna yawma alqiyaamaai, yuqaalu lahum aahyuwa maa khalaqtum‏.‏ waiinna almalaaiikaaa laa tadkhulu baytana fiyhi alssuwraau ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I purchased a cushion with pictures on it. The Prophet (came and) stood at the door but did not enter. I said (to him), "I repent to Allah for what (the guilt) I have done." He said, "What is this cushion?" I said, "It is for you to sit on and recline on." He said, "The makers of these pictures will be punished on the Day of Resurrection and it will be said to them, 'Make alive what you have created.' Moreover, the angels do not enter a house where there are pictures
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، صَاحِبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ لاَ تَدْخُلُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ الصُّورَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ بُسْرٌ ثُمَّ اشْتَكَى زَيْدٌ فَعُدْنَاهُ، فَإِذَا عَلَى بَابِهِ سِتْرٌ فِيهِ صُورَةٌ فَقُلْتُ لِعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ رَبِيبِ مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَلَمْ يُخْبِرْنَا زَيْدٌ عَنِ الصُّوَرِ يَوْمَ الأَوَّلِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعْهُ حِينَ قَالَ إِلاَّ رَقْمًا فِي ثَوْبٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرٌو ـ هُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ ـ حَدَّثَهُ بُكَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَهُ بُسْرٌ، حَدَّثَهُ زَيْدٌ، حَدَّثَهُ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an bukayrin, 'an busri bni sa'iydin, 'an zaydi bni khaalidin, 'an aabiy talhaaa, saahibi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna almalaaiikaaa laa tadkhulu baytana fiyhi alssuwraau ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala busrun thumma ashtakaa zaydun fa'udnaahu, faiidhaa 'alaa baabihi sitrun fiyhi suwraaun faqultu li'ubaydi alllahi rabiybi maymuwnaaa zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aalam yukhbirnaa zaydun 'ani alssuwari yawma alaawwali‏.‏ faqaala 'ubaydu alllahi aalam tasma'hu hiyna qaala iilaaa raqmana fiy thawbin‏.‏ waqaala abnu wahbin aakhbaranaa 'amrunw huwa abnu alhaarithi haddathahu bukayrun, haddathahu busrun, haddathahu zaydun, haddathahu aabuw talhaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Talha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Angels (of mercy) do not enter a house where there are pictures.'" The subnarrator Busr added: "Then Zaid fell ill and we paid him a visit. Behold! There was, hanging at his door, a curtain decorated with a picture. I said to 'Ubaidullah Al-Khaulani, the step son of Maimuna, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) , "Didn't Zaid tell us about the picture the day before yesterday?" 'Ubaidullah said, "Didn't you hear him saying: 'except a design in a garment'?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ قِرَاَمٌ لِعَائِشَةَ سَتَرَتْ بِهِ جَانِبَ بَيْتِهَا، فَقَالَ لَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَمِيطِي عَنِّي، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ تَزَالُ تَصَاوِيرُهُ تَعْرِضُ لِي فِي صَلاَتِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'imraanu bnu maysaraaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu suhaybin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala kaana qiraaamun li'aaiishaaa satarat bihi jaaniba baytihaa, faqaala lahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aamiytiy 'anniy, faiinnahu laa tazaalu tasaawiyruhu ta'ridu liy fiy salaatiy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Aisha had a thick curtain (having pictures on it) and she screened the side of her i house with it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to her, "Remove it from my sight, for its pictures are still coming to my mind in my prayers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ـ عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ وَعَدَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جِبْرِيلُ فَرَاثَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى اشْتَدَّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَقِيَهُ، فَشَكَا إِلَيْهِ مَا وَجَدَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّا لاَ نَدْخُلُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ صُورَةٌ وَلاَ كَلْبٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sulaymaana, qaala haddathaniy abnu wahbin, qaala haddathaniy 'umaru huwa abnu muhammadin 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala wa'ada alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm jibriylu faraatha 'alayhi hattaa ashtadda 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm falaqiyahu, fashakaa iilayhi maa wajada, faqaala lahu ‏ "‏ iinnaa laa nadkhulu baytana fiyhi suwraaun walaa kalbun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salim's father:Once Gabriel promised to visit the Prophet (ﷺ) but he delayed and the Prophet (ﷺ) got worried about that. At last he came out and found Gabriel and complained to him of his grief (for his delay). Gabriel said to him, "We do not enter a place in which there is a picture or a dog
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّهَا اشْتَرَتْ نُمْرُقَةً فِيهَا تَصَاوِيرُ، فَلَمَّا رَآهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ عَلَى الْبَابِ فَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ، فَعَرَفَتْ فِي وَجْهِهِ الْكَرَاهِيَةَ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتُوبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَإِلَى رَسُولِهِ، مَاذَا أَذْنَبْتُ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَالُ هَذِهِ النُّمْرُقَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتِ اشْتَرَيْتُهَا لِتَقْعُدَ عَلَيْهَا وَتَوَسَّدَهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ هَذِهِ الصُّوَرِ يُعَذَّبُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ أَحْيُوا مَا خَلَقْتُمْ ـ وَقَالَ ـ إِنَّ الْبَيْتَ الَّذِي فِيهِ الصُّوَرُ لاَ تَدْخُلُهُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa aakhbarathu aannahaa ashtarat numruqaaan fiyhaa tasaawiyru, falammaa raahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaama 'alaa albaabi falam yadkhul, fa'arafat fiy wajhihi alkaraahiyaaa qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi aatuwbu iilaa alllahi waiilaa rasuwlihi, maadhaa aadhnabtu qaala ‏"‏ maa baalu hadhihi alnnumruqaai ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaalati ashtaraytuhaa litaq'uda 'alayhaa watawassadahaa‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna aashaaba hadhihi alssuwari yu'adhhabuwna yawma alqiyaamaai, wayuqaalu lahum aahyuwa maa khalaqtum waqaala iinna albayta alladhiy fiyhi alssuwaru laa tadkhuluhu almalaaiikaau ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) I bought a cushion having pictures on it. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw it, he stopped at the gate and did not enter. I noticed the signs of hatred (for that) on his face! I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I turn to Allah and His Apostle in repentance! What sin have I committed?" He said, "What about this cushion?" I said, 'I bought it for you to sit on and recline on." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The makers of these pictures will be punished (severely) on the Day of Resurrection and it will be said to them, 'Make alive what you have created.'" He added, "Angels do not enter a house in which there are pictures
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ اشْتَرَى غُلاَمًا حَجَّامًا فَقَالَ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ ثَمَنِ الدَّمِ، وَثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ، وَكَسْبِ الْبَغِيِّ، وَلَعَنَ آكِلَ الرِّبَا وَمُوكِلَهُ وَالْوَاشِمَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَةَ وَالْمُصَوِّرَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathaniy ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'awni bni aabiy juhayfaaa, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu ashtaraa ghulaamana hajjaamana faqaala iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an thamani alddami, wathamani alkalbi, wakasbi albaghiyyi, wala'ana akila alrribaa wamuwkilahu waalwaashimaaa waalmustawshimaaa waalmusawwira‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:that he had bought a slave whose profession was cupping. The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade taking the price of blood and the price of a dog and the earnings of a prostitute, and cursed the one who took or gave (Riba') usury, and the lady who tattooed others or got herself tattooed, and the picture-maker
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَيَّاشُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّضْرَ بْنَ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، يُحَدِّثُ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَهُمْ يَسْأَلُونَهُ وَلاَ يَذْكُرُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى سُئِلَ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ صَوَّرَ صُورَةً فِي الدُّنْيَا كُلِّفَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَنْ يَنْفُخَ فِيهَا الرُّوحَ، وَلَيْسَ بِنَافِخٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ayyaashu bnu alwaliydi, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa sa'iydun, qaala sami'tu alnnadra bna aanasi bni maalikin, yuhaddithu qataadaaa qaala kuntu 'inda abni 'abbaasin wahum yasaaluwnahu walaa yadhkuru alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa suiila faqaala sami'tu muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man sawwara suwraaan fiy alddunyaa kullifa yawma alqiyaamaai aan yanfukha fiyhaa alrruwha, walaysa binaafikhin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I heard Muhammad saying, "Whoever makes a picture in this world will be asked to put life into it on the Day of Resurrection, but he will not be able to do so
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَفْوَانَ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكِبَ عَلَى حِمَارٍ، عَلَى إِكَافٍ عَلَيْهِ قَطِيفَةٌ فَدَكِيَّةٌ، وَأَرْدَفَ أُسَامَةَ وَرَاءَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa aabuw safwaana, 'an yuwnusa bni yaziyda, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rakiba 'alaa himaarin, 'alaa iikaafin 'alayhi qatiyfaaun fadakiyyaaun, waaardafa ausaamaaa waraa'ahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode a donkey saddled with a saddle covered with a Fadakiyya velvet sheet, and he made me ride behind him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَكَّةَ اسْتَقْبَلَهُ أُغَيْلِمَةُ بَنِي عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، فَحَمَلَ وَاحِدًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَالآخَرَ خَلْفَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala lammaa qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm makkaaa astaqbalahu aughaylimaau baniy 'abdi almuttalibi, fahamala waahidana bayna yadayhi waalakhara khalfahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived at Mecca, the children of Bani `Abdul Muttalib received him. He then mounted one of them in front of him and the other behind him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، ذُكِرَ الأَشَرُّ الثَّلاَثَةُ عِنْدَ عِكْرِمَةَ فَقَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَتَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ حَمَلَ قُثَمَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، وَالْفَضْلَ خَلْفَهُ، أَوْ قُثَمَ خَلْفَهُ، وَالْفَضْلَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، فَأَيُّهُمْ شَرٌّ أَوْ أَيُّهُمْ خَيْرٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, dhukira alaasharru althhalaathaau 'inda 'ikrimaaa faqaala qaala abnu 'abbaasin aataa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqad hamala quthama bayna yadayhi, waalfadla khalfahu, aaw quthama khalfahu, waalfadla bayna yadayhi, faaayyuhum sharrun aaw aayyuhum khayrun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aiyub:The worst of three (persons riding one, animal) was mentioned in `Ikrima's presence `Ikrima said, "Ibn `Abbas said, '(In the year of the conquest of Mecca) the Prophet (ﷺ) came and mounted Qutham in front of him and Al-Fadl behind him, or Qutham behind him and Al-Fadl in front of him.' Now which of them was the worst off and which was the best?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَيْنَا أَنَا رَدِيفُ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْسَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ إِلاَّ أَخِرَةُ الرَّحْلِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَسَعْدَيْكَ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَارَ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَسَعْدَيْكَ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَارَ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَسَعْدَيْكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ تَدْرِي مَا حَقُّ اللَّهِ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ حَقُّ اللَّهِ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ أَنْ يَعْبُدُوهُ وَلاَ يُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَارَ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ بْنَ جَبَلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَسَعْدَيْكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ تَدْرِي مَا حَقُّ الْعِبَادِ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِذَا فَعَلُوهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ حَقُّ الْعِبَادِ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ لاَ يُعَذِّبَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hudbaau bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, 'an mu'aadhi bni jabalin rda allh 'nh qaala baynaa aanaa radiyfu alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm laysa bayniy wabaynahu iilaaa aakhiraau alrrahli faqaala ‏"‏ yaa mu'aadhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labbayka rasuwla alllahi wasa'dayka‏.‏ thumma saara saa'aaan thumma qaala ‏"‏ yaa mu'aadhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labbayka rasuwla alllahi wasa'dayka‏.‏ thumma saara saa'aaan thumma qaala ‏"‏ yaa mu'aadhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labbayka rasuwla alllahi wasa'dayka‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ hal tadriy maa haqqu alllahi 'alaa 'ibaadihi ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ haqqu alllahi 'alaa 'ibaadihi aan ya'buduwhu walaa yushrikuwa bihi shayiana ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma saara saa'aaan thumma qaala ‏"‏ yaa mu'aadhu bna jabalin ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labbayka rasuwla alllahi wasa'dayka‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ hal tadriy maa haqqu al'ibaadi 'alaa alllahi iidhaa fa'aluwhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ haqqu al'ibaadi 'alaa alllahi aan laa yu'adhhibahum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mu`adh bin Jabal:While I was riding behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and between me and him and between me and him there was only the back of the saddle, he said, "0 Mu`adh!" I replied, "Labbaik, 0 Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Sa`daik!" he said, "Do you know what is Allah's right upon his slave?" I said, "Allah and His Apostle know best" He said "Allah's right upon his slaves is that they should worship Him alone and not worship anything else besides Him." Then he proceeded for a while and then said, "O Mu`adh bin Jabal!" I replied, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ):, Sa`daik!' He said, "Do you know what is the right of the slaves upon Allah if they do that?" I replied, "Allah and His Apostle know best." He said, "The right of the slaves upon Allah is that He will not punish them (if they do that)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ صَبَّاحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَقْبَلْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ خَيْبَرَ، وَإِنِّي لَرَدِيفُ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ وَهْوَ يَسِيرُ وَبَعْضُ نِسَاءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَدِيفُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ عَثَرَتِ النَّاقَةُ فَقُلْتُ الْمَرْأَةَ‏.‏ فَنَزَلْتُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّهَا أُمُّكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَشَدَدْتُ الرَّحْلَ وَرَكِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا دَنَا أَوْ رَأَى الْمَدِينَةَ قَالَ ‏"‏ آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا، حَامِدُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu muhammadi bni sabbaahin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu 'abbaadin, haddathanaa shu'baau, aakhbaraniy yahyaa bnu aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala aaqbalnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min khaybara, waiinniy laradiyfu aabiy talhaaa wahwa yasiyru waba'du nisaa'i rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm radiyfu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh 'atharati alnnaaqaau faqultu almaraaaa‏.‏ fanazaltu‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnahaa aummukum ‏"‏‏.‏ fashadadtu alrrahla warakiba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa danaa aaw raaaa almadiynaaa qaala ‏"‏ ayibuwna taaiibuwna, 'aabiduwna lirabbinaa, haamiduwna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We were coming from Khaibar along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while I was riding behind Abu Talha and he was proceeding. While one of the wives of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was riding behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), suddenly the foot of the camel Slipped and I said, "The woman!" and alighted (hurriedly). Allah's Apostle said, "She is your mother." Sol resaddled the she-camel and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mounted it. When he approached or saw Medina, he said, "Ayibun, ta'ibun, 'abidun, li-Rabbina hami-dun
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، أَنَّهُ أَبْصَرَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَضْطَجِعُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، رَافِعًا إِحْدَى رِجْلَيْهِ عَلَى الأُخْرَى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, haddathanaa abnu shihaabin, 'an 'abbaadi bni tamiymin, 'an 'ammihi, aannahu aabsara alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yadtaji'u fiy almasjidi, raafi'ana iihdaa rijlayhi 'alaa alaukhraa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim's uncle:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) lying-down in the mosque and placing one leg on the other
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ عَيْزَارٍ أَخْبَرَنِي قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيَّ، يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَنَا صَاحِبُ، هَذِهِ الدَّارِ ـ وَأَوْمَأَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى دَارِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الْعَمَلِ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ الصَّلاَةُ عَلَى وَقْتِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ أَىُّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ بِرُّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ أَىّ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي بِهِنَّ وَلَوِ اسْتَزَدْتُهُ لَزَادَنِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala alwaliydu bnu 'ayzaarin aakhbaraniy qaala sami'tu aabaa 'amrinw alshhaybaaniyya, yaquwlu aakhbaranaa saahibu, hadhihi alddaari waaawmaaa biyadihi iilaa daari 'abdi alllahi qaala saaaltu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aaaau al'amali aahabbu iilaa alllahi qaala ‏"‏ alssalaaau 'alaa waqtihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala thumma aaaau qaala ‏"‏ thumma birru alwaalidayni ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala thumma aaaa qaala ‏"‏ aljihaadu fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala haddathaniy bihinna walawi astazadtuhu lazaadaniy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Walid bin 'Aizar:I heard Abi `Amr 'Ash-Shaibani saying, "The owner of this house." he pointed to `Abdullah's house, "said, 'I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) 'Which deed is loved most by Allah?" He replied, 'To offer prayers at their early (very first) stated times.' " `Abdullah asked, "What is the next (in goodness)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To be good and dutiful to one's parents," `Abdullah asked, "What is the next (in goodness)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To participate in Jihad for Allah's Cause." `Abdullah added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) narrated to me these three things, and if I had asked more, he would have told me more
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ بْنِ شُبْرُمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَنْ أَحَقُّ بِحُسْنِ صَحَابَتِي قَالَ ‏"‏ أُمُّكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ مَنْ قَالَ ‏"‏ أُمُّكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ مَنْ قَالَ ‏"‏ أُمُّكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ مَنْ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ أَبُوكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ شُبْرُمَةَ وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُرْعَةَ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an 'umaaraaa bni alqa'qaa'i bni shubrumaaa, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi man aahaqqu bihusni sahaabatiy qaala ‏"‏ aummuka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala thumma man qaala ‏"‏ aummuka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala thumma man qaala ‏"‏ aummuka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala thumma man qaala ‏"‏ thumma aabuwka ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala abnu shubrumaaa wayahyaa bnu aayyuwba haddathanaa aabuw zur'aaa mithlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who is more entitled to be treated with the best companionship by me?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your mother." The man said. "Who is next?" The Prophet said, "Your mother." The man further said, "Who is next?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your mother." The man asked for the fourth time, "Who is next?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your father
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، وَشُعْبَةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبٌ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَبَّاسِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُجَاهِدُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَكَ أَبَوَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَفِيهِمَا فَجَاهِدْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, washu'baaa, qaalaa haddathanaa habiybun, h qaala wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an habiybin, 'an aabiy al'abbaasi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, qaala qaala rajulun lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aujaahidu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laka aabawaani ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fafiyhimaa fajaahid ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:A man said to the Prophet, "Shall I participate in Jihad?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Are your parents living?" The man said, "Yes." the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do Jihad for their benefit
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ مِنْ أَكْبَرِ الْكَبَائِرِ أَنْ يَلْعَنَ الرَّجُلُ وَالِدَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَكَيْفَ يَلْعَنُ الرَّجُلُ وَالِدَيْهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَسُبُّ الرَّجُلُ أَبَا الرَّجُلِ، فَيَسُبُّ أَبَاهُ، وَيَسُبُّ أَمَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna min aakbari alkabaaiiri aan yal'ana alrrajulu waalidayhi ‏"‏‏.‏ qiyla yaa rasuwla alllahi wakayfa yal'anu alrrajulu waalidayhi qaala ‏"‏ yasubbu alrrajulu aabaa alrrajuli, fayasubbu aabaahu, wayasubbu aammahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. "It is one of the greatest sins that a man should curse his parents." It was asked (by the people), "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How does a man curse his parents?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "'The man abuses the father of another man and the latter abuses the father of the former and abuses his mother
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ بَيْنَمَا ثَلاَثَةُ نَفَرٍ يَتَمَاشَوْنَ أَخَذَهُمُ الْمَطَرُ، فَمَالُوا إِلَى غَارٍ فِي الْجَبَلِ، فَانْحَطَّتْ عَلَى فَمِ غَارِهِمْ صَخْرَةٌ مِنَ الْجَبَلِ، فَأَطْبَقَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ انْظُرُوا أَعْمَالاً عَمِلْتُمُوهَا لِلَّهِ صَالِحَةً، فَادْعُوا اللَّهَ بِهَا لَعَلَّهُ يَفْرُجُهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِي وَالِدَانِ شَيْخَانِ كَبِيرَانِ، وَلِي صِبْيَةٌ صِغَارٌ كُنْتُ أَرْعَى عَلَيْهِمْ، فَإِذَا رُحْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ فَحَلَبْتُ بَدَأْتُ بِوَالِدَىَّ أَسْقِيهِمَا قَبْلَ وَلَدِي، وَإِنَّهُ نَاءَ بِيَ الشَّجَرُ فَمَا أَتَيْتُ حَتَّى أَمْسَيْتُ، فَوَجَدْتُهُمَا قَدْ نَامَا، فَحَلَبْتُ كَمَا كُنْتُ أَحْلُبُ، فَجِئْتُ بِالْحِلاَبِ فَقُمْتُ عِنْدَ رُءُوسِهِمَا، أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أُوقِظَهُمَا مِنْ نَوْمِهِمَا، وَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَبْدَأَ بِالصِّبْيَةِ قَبْلَهُمَا، وَالصِّبْيَةُ يَتَضَاغَوْنَ عِنْدَ قَدَمَىَّ، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ ذَلِكَ دَأْبِي وَدَأْبَهُمْ حَتَّى طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ، فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ، فَافْرُجْ لَنَا فُرْجَةً نَرَى مِنْهَا السَّمَاءَ، فَفَرَجَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ فُرْجَةً حَتَّى يَرَوْنَ مِنْهَا السَّمَاءَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الثَّانِي اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ كَانَتْ لِي ابْنَةُ عَمٍّ، أُحِبُّهَا كَأَشَدِّ مَا يُحِبُّ الرِّجَالُ النِّسَاءَ، فَطَلَبْتُ إِلَيْهَا نَفْسَهَا، فَأَبَتْ حَتَّى آتِيَهَا بِمِائَةِ دِينَارٍ، فَسَعَيْتُ حَتَّى جَمَعْتُ مِائَةَ دِينَارٍ، فَلَقِيتُهَا بِهَا، فَلَمَّا قَعَدْتُ بَيْنَ رِجْلَيْهَا قَالَتْ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ، وَلاَ تَفْتَحِ الْخَاتَمَ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ عَنْهَا، اللَّهُمَّ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي قَدْ فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ فَافْرُجْ لَنَا مِنْهَا فَفَرَجَ لَهُمْ فُرْجَةً‏.‏ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي كُنْتُ اسْتَأْجَرْتُ أَجِيرًا بِفَرَقِ أَرُزٍّ فَلَمَّا قَضَى عَمَلَهُ قَالَ أَعْطِنِي حَقِّي‏.‏ فَعَرَضْتُ عَلَيْهِ حَقَّهُ، فَتَرَكَهُ وَرَغِبَ عَنْهُ، فَلَمْ أَزَلْ أَزْرَعُهُ حَتَّى جَمَعْتُ مِنْهُ بَقَرًا وَرَاعِيَهَا، فَجَاءَنِي فَقَالَ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تَظْلِمْنِي، وَأَعْطِنِي حَقِّي‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ اذْهَبْ إِلَى ذَلِكَ الْبَقَرِ وَرَاعِيهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تَهْزَأْ بِي‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي لاَ أَهْزَأُ بِكَ، فَخُذْ ذَلِكَ الْبَقَرَ وَرَاعِيَهَا‏.‏ فَأَخَذَهُ فَانْطَلَقَ بِهَا، فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ، فَافْرُجْ مَا بَقِيَ، فَفَرَجَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma bni 'uqbaaa, qaala aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ baynamaa thalaathaau nafarin yatamaashawna aakhadhahumu almataru, famaaluwa iilaa ghaarin fiy aljabali, faanhattat 'alaa fami ghaarihim sakhraaun mina aljabali, faaatbaqat 'alayhim, faqaala ba'duhum liba'din anzuruwa aa'maalaan 'amiltumuwhaa lillahi saalihaaan, faad'uwa alllaha bihaa la'allahu yafrujuhaa‏.‏ faqaala aahaduhumu alllahumma iinnahu kaana liy waalidaani shaykhaani kabiyraani, waliy sibyaaun sighaarun kuntu aar'aa 'alayhim, faiidhaa ruhtu 'alayhim fahalabtu badaatu biwaalidaaaa aasqiyhimaa qabla waladiy, waiinnahu naa'a biya alshhajaru famaa aataytu hattaa aamsaytu, fawajadtuhumaa qad naamaa, fahalabtu kamaa kuntu aahlubu, fajiitu bialhilaabi faqumtu 'inda ru'uwsihimaa, aakrahu aan auwqizahumaa min nawmihimaa, waaakrahu aan aabdaaa bialssibyaai qablahumaa, waalssibyaau yatadaaghawna 'inda qadamaaaa, falam yazal dhalika daabiy wadaabahum hattaa tala'a alfajru, faiin kunta ta'lamu aanniy fa'altu dhalika abtighaa'a wajhika, faafruj lanaa furjaaan naraa minhaa alssamaa'a, fafaraja alllahu lahum furjaaan hattaa yarawna minhaa alssamaa'a‏.‏ waqaala althhaaniy alllahumma iinnahu kaanat liy abnaau 'ammin, auhibbuhaa kaaashaddi maa yuhibbu alrrijaalu alnnisaa'a, fatalabtu iilayhaa nafsahaa, faaabat hattaa atiyahaa bimiaiaai diynaarin, fasa'aytu hattaa jama'tu miaiaaa diynaarin, falaqiytuhaa bihaa, falammaa qa'adtu bayna rijlayhaa qaalat yaa 'abda alllahi attaqi alllaha, walaa taftahi alkhaatama‏.‏ faqumtu 'anhaa, alllahumma faiin kunta ta'lamu aanniy qad fa'altu dhalika abtighaa'a wajhika faafruj lanaa minhaa fafaraja lahum furjaaan‏.‏ waqaala alakharu alllahumma iinniy kuntu astaajartu aajiyrana bifaraqi aaruzzin falammaa qadaa 'amalahu qaala aa'tiniy haqqiy‏.‏ fa'aradtu 'alayhi haqqahu, fatarakahu waraghiba 'anhu, falam aazal aazra'uhu hattaa jama'tu minhu baqarana waraa'iyahaa, fajaa'aniy faqaala attaqi alllaha walaa tazlimniy, waaa'tiniy haqqiy‏.‏ faqultu adhhab iilaa dhalika albaqari waraa'iyhaa‏.‏ faqaala attaqi alllaha walaa tahzaa biy‏.‏ faqultu iinniy laa aahzaau bika, fakhudh dhalika albaqara waraa'iyahaa‏.‏ faaakhadhahu faantalaqa bihaa, faiin kunta ta'lamu aanniy fa'altu dhalika abtighaa'a wajhika, faafruj maa baqiya, fafaraja alllahu 'anhum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While three persons were traveling, they were overtaken by rain and they took shelter in a cave in a mountain. A big rock fell from the mountain over the mouth of the cave and blocked it. They said to each other. 'Think of such good (righteous) deeds which, you did for Allah's sake only, and invoke Allah by giving reference to those deeds so that Allah may relieve you from your difficulty. one of them said, 'O Allah! I had my parents who were very old and I had small children for whose sake I used to work as a shepherd. When I returned to them at night and milked (the sheep), I used to start giving the milk to my parents first before giving to my children. And one day I went far away in search of a grazing place (for my sheep), and didn't return home till late at night and found that my parents had slept. I milked (my livestock) as usual and brought the milk vessel and stood at their heads, and I disliked to wake them up from their sleep, and I also disliked to give the milk to my children before my parents though my children were crying (from hunger) at my feet. So this state of mine and theirs continued till the day dawned. (O Allah!) If you considered that I had done that only for seeking Your pleasure, then please let there be an opening through which we can see the sky.' So Allah made for them an opening through which they could see the sky. Then the second person said, 'O Allah! I had a she-cousin whom I loved as much as a passionate man love a woman. I tried to seduce her but she refused till I paid her one-hundred Dinars So I worked hard till I collected one hundred Dinars and went to her with that But when I sat in between her legs (to have sexual intercourse with her), she said, 'O Allah's slave! Be afraid of Allah ! Do not deflower me except legally (by marriage contract). So I left her O Allah! If you considered that I had done that only for seeking Your pleasure then please let the rock move a little to have a (wider) opening.' So Allah shifted that rock to make the opening wider for them. And the last (third) person said 'O Allah ! I employed a laborer for wages equal to a Faraq (a certain measure: of rice, and when he had finished his job he demanded his wages, but when I presented his due to him, he gave it up and refused to take it. Then I kept on sowing that rice for him (several times) till managed to buy with the price of the yield, some cows and their shepherd Later on the laborer came to me an said. '(O Allah's slave!) Be afraid o Allah, and do not be unjust to me an give me my due.' I said (to him). 'Go and take those cows and their shepherd. So he took them and went away. (So, O Allah!) If You considered that I had done that for seeking Your pleasure, then please remove the remaining part of the rock.' And so Allah released them (from their difficulty)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ وَرَّادٍ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ عُقُوقَ الأُمَّهَاتِ، وَمَنْعَ وَهَاتِ، وَوَأْدَ الْبَنَاتِ، وَكَرِهَ لَكُمْ قِيلَ وَقَالَ، وَكَثْرَةَ السُّؤَالِ، وَإِضَاعَةَ الْمَالِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'du bnu hafsin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an mansuwrin, 'ani almusayyabi, 'an warraadin, 'ani almughiyraai, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha harrama 'alaykum 'uquwqa alaummahaati, waman'a wahaati, wawaada albanaati, wakariha lakum qiyla waqaala, wakathraaa alssuuaali, waiidaa'aaa almaali ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Mughira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has forbidden you ( 1 ) to be undutiful to your mothers (2) to withhold (what you should give) or (3) demand (what you do not deserve), and (4) to bury your daughters alive. And Allah has disliked that (A) you talk too much about others ( B), ask too many questions (in religion), or (C) waste your property
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلاَ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِأَكْبَرِ الْكَبَائِرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ الإِشْرَاكُ بِاللَّهِ، وَعُقُوقُ الْوَالِدَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ مُتَّكِئًا فَجَلَسَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ وَقَوْلُ الزُّورِ وَشَهَادَةُ الزُّورِ، أَلاَ وَقَوْلُ الزُّورِ وَشَهَادَةُ الزُّورِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَمَا زَالَ يَقُولُهَا حَتَّى قُلْتُ لاَ يَسْكُتُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu, haddathanaa khaalidun alwaasitiyyu, 'ani aljurayriyyi, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy bakraaa, 'an aabiyhi rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aalaa aunabbiiukum biaakbari alkabaaiiri ‏"‏‏.‏ qulnaa balaa yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aliishraaku bialllahi, wa'uquwqu alwaalidayni ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana muttakiiana fajalasa faqaala ‏"‏ aalaa waqawlu alzzuwri washahaadaau alzzuwri, aalaa waqawlu alzzuwri washahaadaau alzzuwri ‏"‏‏.‏ famaa zaala yaquwluhaa hattaa qultu laa yaskutu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Bakra:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said thrice, "Shall I not inform you of the biggest of the great sins?" We said, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)" He said, "To join partners in worship with Allah: to be undutiful to one's parents." The Prophet (ﷺ) sat up after he had been reclining and added, "And I warn you against giving forged statement and a false witness; I warn you against giving a forged statement and a false witness." The Prophet kept on saying that warning till we thought that he would not stop
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ ذَكَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْكَبَائِرَ، أَوْ سُئِلَ عَنِ الْكَبَائِرِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ الشِّرْكُ بِاللَّهِ، وَقَتْلُ النَّفْسِ، وَعُقُوقُ الْوَالِدَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِأَكْبَرِ الْكَبَائِرِ ـ قَالَ ـ قَوْلُ الزُّورِ ـ أَوْ قَالَ ـ شَهَادَةُ الزُّورِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَأَكْثَرُ ظَنِّي أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ شَهَادَةُ الزُّورِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu alwaliydi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu aabiy bakrin, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala dhakara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alkabaaiira, aaw suiila 'ani alkabaaiiri faqaala ‏"‏ alshhirku bialllahi, waqatlu alnnafsi, wa'uquwqu alwaalidayni ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aalaa aunabbiiukum biaakbari alkabaaiiri qaala qawlu alzzuwri aaw qaala shahaadaau alzzuwri ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala shu'baau waaaktharu zanniy aannahu qaala ‏"‏ shahaadaau alzzuwri ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned the greatest sins or he was asked about the greatest sins. He said, "To join partners in worship with Allah; to kill a soul which Allah has forbidden to kill; and to be undutiful or unkind to one's parents." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Shall I inform you of the biggest of the great sins? That is the forged statement or the false witness." Shu`ba (the sub-narrator) states that most probably the Prophet said, "the false witness
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، أَخْبَرَتْنِي أَسْمَاءُ ابْنَةُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَتْ أَتَتْنِي أُمِّي رَاغِبَةً فِي عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم آصِلُهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى فِيهَا ‏{‏لاَ يَنْهَاكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يُقَاتِلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhumaydiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, aakhbaraniy aabiy, aakhbaratniy aasmaa'u abnaau aabiy bakrin rda allh 'nhma qaalat aatatniy aummiy raaghibaaan fiy 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaaltu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm asiluhaa qaala ‏"‏ na'am ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala abnu 'uyaynaaa faaanzala alllahu ta'aalaa fiyhaa ‏{‏laa yanhaakumu alllahu 'ani alladhiyna lam yuqaatiluwkum fiy alddiyni‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Asma' bint Abu Bakr:My mother came to me, hoping (for my favor) during the lifetime of the Prophet. I asked the Prophet, "May I treat her kindly?" He replied, "Yes."
