verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَهْجُرَ أَخَاهُ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ، يَلْتَقِيَانِ فَيَصُدُّ هَذَا، وَيَصُدُّ هَذَا، وَخَيْرُهُمَا الَّذِي يَبْدَأُ بِالسَّلاَمِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَذَكَرَ سُفْيَانُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ مِنْهُ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ataa'i bni yaziyda alllaythiyyi, 'an aabiy aayyuwba rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yahillu limuslimin aan yahjura aakhaahu fawqa thalaathin, yaltaqiyaani fayasuddu hadhaa, wayasuddu hadhaa, wakhayruhumaa alladhiy yabdaau bialssalaami ‏"‏‏.‏ wadhakara sufyaanu aannahu sami'ahu minhu thalaatha marraatin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Aiyub:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is not lawful for a Muslim to desert (not to speak to) his brother Muslim for more than three days while meeting, one turns his face to one side and the other turns his face to the other side. Lo! The better of the two is the one who starts greeting the other
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ ابْنَ عَشْرِ سِنِينَ مَقْدَمَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ، فَخَدَمْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَشْرًا حَيَاتَهُ، وَكُنْتُ أَعْلَمَ النَّاسِ بِشَأْنِ الْحِجَابِ حِينَ أُنْزِلَ، وَقَدْ كَانَ أُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ يَسْأَلُنِي عَنْهُ، وَكَانَ أَوَّلَ مَا نَزَلَ فِي مُبْتَنَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِزَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ جَحْشٍ، أَصْبَحَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَا عَرُوسًا فَدَعَا الْقَوْمَ، فَأَصَابُوا مِنَ الطَّعَامِ ثُمَّ خَرَجُوا، وَبَقِيَ مِنْهُمْ رَهْطٌ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَطَالُوا الْمُكْثَ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَرَجَ وَخَرَجْتُ مَعَهُ كَىْ يَخْرُجُوا، فَمَشَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَشَيْتُ مَعَهُ حَتَّى جَاءَ عَتَبَةَ حُجْرَةِ عَائِشَةَ، ثُمَّ ظَنَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُمْ خَرَجُوا فَرَجَعَ وَرَجَعْتُ مَعَهُ، حَتَّى دَخَلَ عَلَى زَيْنَبَ فَإِذَا هُمْ جُلُوسٌ لَمْ يَتَفَرَّقُوا، فَرَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَجَعْتُ مَعَهُ، حَتَّى بَلَغَ عَتَبَةَ حُجْرَةِ عَائِشَةَ، فَظَنَّ أَنْ قَدْ خَرَجُوا، فَرَجَعَ وَرَجَعْتُ مَعَهُ، فَإِذَا هُمْ قَدْ خَرَجُوا، فَأُنْزِلَ آيَةُ الْحِجَابِ، فَضَرَبَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ سِتْرًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy aanasu bnu maalikin, aannahu kaana abna 'ashri siniyna maqdama rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa, fakhadamtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ashrana hayaatahu, wakuntu aa'lama alnnaasi bishaani alhijaabi hiyna aunzila, waqad kaana aubaaau bnu ka'bin yasaaluniy 'anhu, wakaana aawwala maa nazala fiy mubtanaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bizaynaba abnaai jahshin, aasbaha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bihaa 'aruwsana fada'aa alqawma, faaasaabuwa mina altta'aami thumma kharajuwa, wabaqiya minhum rahtun 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaataaluwa almuktha faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakharaja wakharajtu ma'ahu kaa yakhrujuwa, famashaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wamashaytu ma'ahu hattaa jaa'a 'atabaaa hujraai 'aaiishaaa, thumma zanna rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahum kharajuwa faraja'a waraja'tu ma'ahu, hattaa dakhala 'alaa zaynaba faiidhaa hum juluwsun lam yatafarraquwa, faraja'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waraja'tu ma'ahu, hattaa balagha 'atabaaa hujraai 'aaiishaaa, fazanna aan qad kharajuwa, faraja'a waraja'tu ma'ahu, faiidhaa hum qad kharajuwa, faaunzila ayaau alhijaabi, fadaraba bayniy wabaynahu sitrana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:that he was a boy of ten at the time when the Prophet (ﷺ) emigrated to Medina. He added: I served Allah's Apostle for ten years (the last part of his life time) and I know more than the people about the occasion whereupon the order of Al-Hijab was revealed (to the Prophet). Ubai b n Ka`b used to ask me about it. It was revealed (for the first time) during the marriage of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with Zainab bint Jahsh. In the morning, the Prophet (ﷺ) was a bride-groom of her and he Invited the people, who took their meals and went away, but a group of them remained with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and they prolonged their stay. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up and went out, and I too, went out along with him till he came to the lintel of `Aisha's dwelling place. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) thought that those people had left by then, so he returned, and I too, returned with him till he entered upon Zainab and found that they were still sitting there and had not yet gone. The Prophet (ﷺ) went out again, and so did I with him till he reached the lintel of `Aisha's dwelling place, and then he thought that those people must have left by then, so he returned, and so did I with him, and found those people had gone. At that time the Divine Verse of Al-Hijab was revealed, and the Prophet (ﷺ) set a screen between me and him (his family)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ أَبِي حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مِجْلَزٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا تَزَوَّجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَيْنَبَ دَخَلَ الْقَوْمُ فَطَعِمُوا، ثُمَّ جَلَسُوا يَتَحَدَّثُونَ فَأَخَذَ كَأَنَّهُ يَتَهَيَّأُ لِلْقِيَامِ فَلَمْ يَقُومُوا، فَلَمَّا رَأَى ذَلِكَ قَامَ، فَلَمَّا قَامَ قَامَ مَنْ قَامَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ وَقَعَدَ بَقِيَّةُ الْقَوْمِ، وَإِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَاءَ لِيَدْخُلَ، فَإِذَا الْقَوْمُ جُلُوسٌ، ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ قَامُوا فَانْطَلَقُوا فَأَخْبَرْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَاءَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ، فَذَهَبْتُ أَدْخُلُ فَأَلْقَى الْحِجَابَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ، وَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتَ النَّبِيِّ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْد اللَّهِ فِيهِ مِنْ الْفِقْهِ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَسْتَأْذِنْهُمْ حِينَ قَامَ وَخَرَجَ وَفِيهِ أَنَّهُ تَهَيَّأَ لِلْقِيَامِ وَهُوَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَقُومُوا
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw alnuu'maani, hadaathanaa mu'tamirun, qaala aabiy hadaathanaa aabuw mijlazin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala lamaaa tazawaaja alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm zaynaba dakhala alqawmu fata'imuwa, thumaa jalasuwa yatahadaathuwna faaakhadha kaaanaahu yatahayaaau lilqiyaami falam yaquwmuwa, falamaaa raaaa dhalika qaama, falamaaa qaama qaama man qaama mina alqawmi waqa'ada baqiyaaau alqawmi, waiinaa alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm jaa'a liyadkhula, faiidhaa alqawmu juluwsun, thumaa iinaahum qaamuwa faantalaquwa faaakhbartu alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm fajaa'a hataaa dakhala, fadhahabtu aadkhulu faaalqaa alhijaaba bayniy wabaynahu, waaanzala allaahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏yaa aayuuhaa alaadhiyna amanuwa laa tadkhuluwa buyuwta alnaabiyii‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abd allaahi fiyhi min alfiqhi aanaahu lam yastaadhinhum hiyna qaama wakharaja wafiyhi aanaahu tahayaaaa lilqiyaami wahuwa yuriydu aan yaquwmuwa
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) married Zainab, the people came and were offered a meal, and then they sat down (after finishing their meals) and started chatting. The Prophet (ﷺ) showed as if he wanted to get up, but they did not get up. When he noticed that, he got up, and some of the people also got up and went away, while some others kept on sitting. When the Prophet (ﷺ) returned to enter, he found the people still sitting, but then they got up and left. So I told the Prophet (ﷺ) of their departure and he came and went in. I intended to go in but the Prophet (ﷺ) put a screen between me and him, for Allah revealed:-- 'O you who believe! Enter not the Prophet's houses
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ كَانَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ يَقُولُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْجُبْ نِسَاءَكَ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَلَمْ يَفْعَلْ، وَكَانَ أَزْوَاجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْرُجْنَ لَيْلاً إِلَى لَيْلٍ قِبَلَ الْمَنَاصِعِ، خَرَجَتْ سَوْدَةُ بِنْتُ زَمْعَةَ، وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَةً طَوِيلَةً فَرَآهَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ وَهْوَ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ فَقَالَ عَرَفْتُكِ يَا سَوْدَةُ‏.‏ حِرْصًا عَلَى أَنْ يُنْزَلَ الْحِجَابُ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ آيَةَ الْحِجَابِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa ya'quwbu, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat kaana 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi yaquwlu lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ahjub nisaa'aka‏.‏ qaalat falam yaf'al, wakaana aazwaaju alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhrujna laylaan iilaa laylin qibala almanaasi'i, kharajat sawdaau bintu zam'aaa, wakaanati amraaaaan tawiylaaan faraahaa 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi wahwa fiy almajlisi faqaala 'araftuki yaa sawdaau‏.‏ hirsana 'alaa aan yunzala alhijaabu‏.‏ qaalat faaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla ayaaa alhijaabi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) `Umar bin Al-Khattab used to say to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "Let your wives be veiled" But he did not do so. The wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to go out to answer the call of nature at night only at Al-Manasi.' Once Sauda, the daughter of Zam`a went out and she was a tall woman. `Umar bin Al-Khattab saw her while he was in a gathering, and said, "I have recognized you, O Sauda!" He (`Umar) said so as he was anxious for some Divine orders regarding the veil (the veiling of women.) So Allah revealed the Verse of veiling. (Al-Hijab; a complete body cover excluding the eyes). (See Hadith No. 148, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ حَفِظْتُهُ كَمَا أَنَّكَ هَا هُنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَالَ اطَّلَعَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ جُحْرٍ فِي حُجَرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِدْرًى يَحُكُّ بِهِ رَأْسَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَنْظُرُ لَطَعَنْتُ بِهِ فِي عَيْنِكَ، إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الاِسْتِئْذَانُ مِنْ أَجْلِ الْبَصَرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala alzzuhriyyu hafiztuhu kamaa aannaka haa hunaa 'an sahli bni sa'din qaala attala'a rajulun min juhrin fiy hujari alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wama'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm midrana yahukku bihi raasahu faqaala ‏ "‏ law aa'lamu aannaka tanzuru lata'antu bihi fiy 'aynika, iinnamaa ju'ila alaistiidhaanu min aajli albasari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:A man peeped through a round hole into the dwelling place of the Prophet, while the Prophet (ﷺ) had a Midray (an iron comb) with which he was scratching his head. the Prophet (ﷺ) said, " Had known you were looking (through the hole), I would have pierced your eye with it (i.e., the comb)." Verily! The order of taking permission to enter has been enjoined because of that sight, (that one should not look unlawfully at the state of others). (See Hadith No. 807, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، اطَّلَعَ مِنْ بَعْضِ حُجَرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِشْقَصٍ ـ أَوْ بِمَشَاقِصَ ـ فَكَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ يَخْتِلُ الرَّجُلَ لِيَطْعُنَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rajulaan, attala'a min ba'di hujari alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaama iilayhi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bimishqasin aaw bimashaaqisa fakaaanniy aanzuru iilayhi yakhtilu alrrajula liyat'unahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A man peeped into a room of the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up, holding an arrow head. It is as if I am just looking at him, trying to stab the man
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمْ أَرَ شَيْئًا أَشْبَهَ بِاللَّمَمِ مِنْ قَوْلِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنِي مَحْمُودٌ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ مَا رَأَيْتُ شَيْئًا أَشْبَهَ بِاللَّمَمِ مِمَّا قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ عَلَى ابْنِ آدَمَ حَظَّهُ مِنَ الزِّنَا، أَدْرَكَ ذَلِكَ لاَ مَحَالَةَ، فَزِنَا الْعَيْنِ النَّظَرُ، وَزِنَا اللِّسَانِ الْمَنْطِقُ، وَالنَّفْسُ تَمَنَّى وَتَشْتَهِي، وَالْفَرْجُ يُصَدِّقُ ذَلِكَ كُلَّهُ وَيُكَذِّبُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhumaydiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani abni taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala lam aara shayiana aashbaha bialllamami min qawli aabiy hurayraaa‏.‏ haddathaniy mahmuwdun aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi aakhbaranaa ma'marun 'ani abni taawusin 'an aabiyhi 'ani abni 'abbaasin qaala maa raaaytu shayiana aashbaha bialllamami mimmaa qaala aabuw hurayraaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha kataba 'alaa abni adama hazzahu mina alzzinaa, aadraka dhalika laa mahaalaaa, fazinaa al'ayni alnnazaru, wazinaa alllisaani almantiqu, waalnnafsu tamannaa watashtahiy, waalfarju yusaddiqu dhalika kullahu wayukadhhibuhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I have not seen a thing resembling 'lamam' (minor sins) than what Abu Huraira 'narrated from the Prophet who said "Allah has written for Adam's son his share of adultery which he commits inevitably. The adultery of the eyes is the sight (to gaze at a forbidden thing), the adultery of the tongue is the talk, and the inner self wishes and desires and the private parts testify all this or deny it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ثُمَامَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا سَلَّمَ سَلَّمَ ثَلاَثًا، وَإِذَا تَكَلَّمَ بِكَلِمَةٍ أَعَادَهَا ثَلاَثًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alssamadi, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa thumaamaau bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa sallama sallama thalaathana, waiidhaa takallama bikalimaain aa'aadahaa thalaathana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) greeted somebody, he used to greet him three times, and if he spoke a sentence, he used to repeat it thrice
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ خُصَيْفَةَ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ كُنْتُ فِي مَجْلِسٍ مِنْ مَجَالِسِ الأَنْصَارِ إِذْ جَاءَ أَبُو مُوسَى كَأَنَّهُ مَذْعُورٌ فَقَالَ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ عَلَى عُمَرَ ثَلاَثًا، فَلَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لِي فَرَجَعْتُ فَقَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ قُلْتُ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ ثَلاَثًا، فَلَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لِي فَرَجَعْتُ، وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنَ أَحَدُكُمْ ثَلاَثًا فَلَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لَهُ، فَلْيَرْجِعْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ لَتُقِيمَنَّ عَلَيْهِ بِبَيِّنَةٍ‏.‏ أَمِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ سَمِعَهُ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ وَاللَّهِ لاَ يَقُومُ مَعَكَ إِلاَّ أَصْغَرُ الْقَوْمِ، فَكُنْتُ أَصْغَرَ الْقَوْمِ، فَقُمْتُ مَعَهُ فَأَخْبَرْتُ عُمَرَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ عَنْ بُسْرٍ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ بِهَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu khusayfaaa, 'an busri bni sa'iydin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala kuntu fiy majlisin min majaalisi alaansaari iidh jaa'a aabuw muwsaa kaaannahu madh'uwrun faqaala astaadhantu 'alaa 'umara thalaathana, falam yuudhan liy faraja'tu faqaala maa mana'aka qultu astaadhantu thalaathana, falam yuudhan liy faraja'tu, waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa astaadhana aahadukum thalaathana falam yuudhan lahu, falyarji' ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala waalllahi latuqiymanna 'alayhi bibayyinaain‏.‏ aaminkum aahadun sami'ahu mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala aubaaau bnu ka'bin waalllahi laa yaquwmu ma'aka iilaaa aasgharu alqawmi, fakuntu aasghara alqawmi, faqumtu ma'ahu faaakhbartu 'umara aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala dhalika‏.‏ waqaala abnu almubaaraki aakhbaraniy abnu 'uyaynaaa haddathaniy yaziydu 'an busrin sami'tu aabaa sa'iydin bihadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:While I was present in one of the gatherings of the Ansar, Abu Musa came as if he was scared, and said, "I asked permission to enter upon `Umar three times, but I was not given the permission, so I returned." (When `Umar came to know about it) he said to Abu Musa, "Why did you not enter?'. Abu Musa replied, "I asked permission three times, and I was not given it, so I returned, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you asks the permission to enter thrice, and the permission is not given, then he should return.' " `Umar said, "By Allah! We will ask Abu Musa to bring witnesses for it." (Abu Musa went to a gathering of the Ansar and said). "Did anyone of you hear this from the Prophet (ﷺ) ?" Ubai bin Ka`b said, "By Allah, none will go with you but the youngest of the people (as a witness)." (Abu Sa`id) was the youngest of them, so I went with Abu Musa and informed `Umar that the Prophet (ﷺ) had said so. (See Hadith No. 277, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ ذَرٍّ،‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ ذَرٍّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُجَاهِدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَجَدَ لَبَنًا فِي قَدَحٍ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَبَا هِرٍّ الْحَقْ أَهْلَ الصُّفَّةِ فَادْعُهُمْ إِلَىَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَتَيْتُهُمْ فَدَعَوْتُهُمْ، فَأَقْبَلُوا فَاسْتَأْذَنُوا فَأُذِنَ لَهُمْ، فَدَخَلُوا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu dharrin, ‏.‏ wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa 'umaru bnu dharrin, aakhbaranaa mujaahidun, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala dakhaltu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fawajada labanana fiy qadahin faqaala ‏ "‏ aabaa hirrin alhaq aahla alssuffaai faad'uhum iilaaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faaataytuhum fada'awtuhum, faaaqbaluwa faastaadhanuwa faaudhina lahum, fadakhaluwa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I entered (the house) along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . There he found milk in a basin. He said, "O Abu Hirr! Go and call the people of Suffa to me." I went to them and invited them. They came and asked permission to enter, and when it was given, they entered. (See Hadith No. 459 for details)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْجَعْدِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّهُ مَرَّ عَلَى صِبْيَانٍ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَقَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَفْعَلُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu alja'di, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an sayyaarin, 'an thaabitin albunaaniyyi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aannahu marra 'alaa sibyaanin fasallama 'alayhim waqaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaf'aluhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:that he passed by a group of boys and greeted them and said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to do so
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَفْرَحُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَلِمَ قَالَ كَانَتْ لَنَا عَجُوزٌ تُرْسِلُ إِلَى بُضَاعَةَ ـ قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ نَخْلٍ بِالْمَدِينَةِ ـ فَتَأْخُذُ مِنْ أُصُولِ السِّلْقِ فَتَطْرَحُهُ فِي قِدْرٍ، وَتُكَرْكِرُ حَبَّاتٍ مِنْ شَعِيرٍ، فَإِذَا صَلَّيْنَا الْجُمُعَةَ انْصَرَفْنَا وَنُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْهَا فَتُقَدِّمُهُ إِلَيْنَا، فَنَفْرَحُ مِنْ أَجْلِهِ، وَمَا كُنَّا نَقِيلُ وَلاَ نَتَغَدَّى إِلاَّ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sahlin, qaala kunnaa nafrahu yawma aljumu'aai‏.‏ qultu walima qaala kaanat lanaa 'ajuwzun tursilu iilaa budaa'aaa qaala abnu maslamaaa nakhlin bialmadiynaai fataakhudhu min ausuwli alssilqi fatatrahuhu fiy qidrin, watukarkiru habbaatin min sha'iyrin, faiidhaa sallaynaa aljumu'aaa ansarafnaa wanusallimu 'alayhaa fatuqaddimuhu iilaynaa, fanafrahu min aajlihi, wamaa kunnaa naqiylu walaa nataghaddaa iilaaa ba'da aljumu'aai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Hazim:Sahl said, "We used to feel happy on Fridays." I asked Sahl, "Why?" He said, "There was an old woman of our acquaintance who used to send somebody to Buda'a (Ibn Maslama said, "Buda'a was a garden of date-palms at Medina). She used to pull out the silq (a kind of vegetable) from its roots and put it in a cooking pot, adding some powdered barley over it (and cook it). After finishing the Jumua (Friday) prayer we used to (pass by her and) greet her, whereupon she would present us with that meal, so we used to feel happy because of that. We used to have neither a midday nap, nor meals, except after the Friday prayer." (See Hadith No. 60, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ هَذَا جِبْرِيلُ يَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكِ السَّلاَمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ وَعَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ، تَرَى مَا لاَ نَرَى‏.‏ تُرِيدُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ شُعَيْبٌ‏.‏ وَقَالَ يُونُسُ وَالنُّعْمَانُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa 'aaiishaau hadhaa jibriylu yaqraau 'alayki alssalaama ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat qultu wa'alayhi alssalaamu warahmaau alllahi, taraa maa laa naraa‏.‏ turiydu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ taaba'ahu shu'aybun‏.‏ waqaala yuwnusu waalnnu'maanu 'ani alzzuhriyyi wabarakaatuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O `Aisha! This is Gabriel sending his greetings to you." I said, "Peace, and Allah's Mercy be on him (Gabriel). You see what we do not see." (She was addressing Allah's Apostle)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، هِشَامُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي دَيْنٍ كَانَ عَلَى أَبِي فَدَقَقْتُ الْبَابَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ ذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَنَا أَنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ كَأَنَّهُ كَرِهَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, hishaamu bnu 'abdi almaliki haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, qaala sami'tu jaabirana rda allh 'nh yaquwlu aataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy daynin kaana 'alaa aabiy fadaqaqtu albaaba faqaala ‏"‏ man dhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu aanaa‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aanaa aanaa ‏"‏‏.‏ kaaannahu karihahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) in order to consult him regarding my father's debt. When I knocked on the door, he asked, "Who is that?" I replied, "I" He said, "I, I?" He repeated it as if he disliked it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّ رَجُلاً، دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَالِسٌ فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَصَلَّى، ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلاَمُ ارْجِعْ فَصَلِّ فَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تُصَلِّ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَجَعَ فَصَلَّى، ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَسَلَّمَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلاَمُ فَارْجِعْ فَصَلِّ، فَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تُصَلِّ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ أَوْ فِي الَّتِي بَعْدَهَا عَلِّمْنِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا قُمْتَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ فَأَسْبِغِ الْوُضُوءَ، ثُمَّ اسْتَقْبِلِ الْقِبْلَةَ فَكَبِّرْ، ثُمَّ اقْرَأْ بِمَا تَيَسَّرَ مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ، ثُمَّ ارْكَعْ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ رَاكِعًا، ثُمَّ ارْفَعْ حَتَّى تَسْتَوِيَ قَائِمًا، ثُمَّ اسْجُدْ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ سَاجِدًا، ثُمَّ ارْفَعْ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ جَالِسًا، ثُمَّ اسْجُدْ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ سَاجِدًا، ثُمَّ ارْفَعْ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ جَالِسًا، ثُمَّ افْعَلْ ذَلِكَ فِي صَلاَتِكَ كُلِّهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو أُسَامَةَ فِي الأَخِيرِ ‏"‏ حَتَّى تَسْتَوِيَ قَائِمًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rajulaan, dakhala almasjida warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jaalisun fiy naahiyaai almasjidi fasallaa, thumma jaa'a fasallama 'alayhi faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ wa'alayka alssalaamu arji' fasalli faiinnaka lam tusalli ‏"‏‏.‏ faraja'a fasallaa, thumma jaa'a fasallama‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ wa'alayka alssalaamu faarji' fasalli, faiinnaka lam tusalli ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala fiy althhaaniyaai aaw fiy allatiy ba'dahaa 'allimniy yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iidhaa qumta iilaa alssalaaai faaasbighi alwuduw'a, thumma astaqbili alqiblaaa fakabbir, thumma aqraa bimaa tayassara ma'aka mina alqurani, thumma arka' hattaa tatmaiinna raaki'ana, thumma arfa' hattaa tastawiya qaaiimana, thumma asjud hattaa tatmaiinna saajidana, thumma arfa' hattaa tatmaiinna jaalisana, thumma asjud hattaa tatmaiinna saajidana, thumma arfa' hattaa tatmaiinna jaalisana, thumma af'al dhalika fiy salaatika kullihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala aabuw ausaamaaa fiy alaakhiyri ‏"‏ hattaa tastawiya qaaiimana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man entered the mosque while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting in one side of the mosque. The man prayed, came, and greeted the Prophet. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him, "Wa 'Alaikas Salam (returned his greeting). Go back and pray as you have not prayed (properly)." The man returned, repeated his prayer, came back and greeted the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wa alaika-s-Salam (returned his greeting). Go back and pray again as you have not prayed (properly)." The man said at the second or third time, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Kindly teach me how to pray". The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When you stand for prayer, perform ablution properly and then face the Qibla and say Takbir (Allahu-Akbar), and then recite what you know from the Qur'an, and then bow with calmness till you feel at ease then rise from bowing, till you stand straight, and then prostrate calmly (and remain in prostration) till you feel at ease, and then raise (your head) and sit with calmness till you feel at ease and then prostrate with calmness (and remain in prostration) till you feel at ease, and then raise (your head) and sit with calmness till you feel at ease in the sitting position, and do likewise in whole of your prayer." And Abu Usama added, "Till you stand straight." (See Hadith No. 759, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ثُمَّ ارْفَعْ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ جَالِسًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu bashhaarin, qaala haddathaniy yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, haddathaniy sa'iydun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ thumma arfa' hattaa tatmaiinna jaalisana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said (in the above narration No. 268), "And then raise your head till you feel at ease while sitting
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَامِرًا، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهَا ‏ "‏ إِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ يُقْرِئُكِ السَّلاَمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَعَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, qaala sami'tu 'aamirana, yaquwlu haddathaniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha haddathathu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lahaa ‏ "‏ iinna jibriyla yuqriiuki alssalaama ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat wa'alayhi alssalaamu warahmaau alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said to her, "Gabriel sends Salam (greetings) to you." She replied, "Wa 'alaihi-s- Salam Wa Rahmatu-l-lah." (Peace and Allah's Mercy be on him)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكِبَ حِمَارًا عَلَيْهِ إِكَافٌ، تَحْتَهُ قَطِيفَةٌ فَدَكِيَّةٌ، وَأَرْدَفَ وَرَاءَهُ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ وَهْوَ يَعُودُ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَادَةَ فِي بَنِي الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْخَزْرَجِ، وَذَلِكَ قَبْلَ وَقْعَةِ بَدْرٍ حَتَّى مَرَّ فِي مَجْلِسٍ فِيهِ أَخْلاَطٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ عَبَدَةِ الأَوْثَانِ وَالْيَهُودِ، وَفِيهِمْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ ابْنُ سَلُولَ، وَفِي الْمَجْلِسِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَوَاحَةَ، فَلَمَّا غَشِيَتِ الْمَجْلِسَ عَجَاجَةُ الدَّابَّةِ خَمَّرَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ أَنْفَهُ بِرِدَائِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لاَ تُغَبِّرُوا عَلَيْنَا‏.‏ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ وَقَفَ فَنَزَلَ، فَدَعَاهُمْ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَقَرَأَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْآنَ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ ابْنُ سَلُولَ أَيُّهَا الْمَرْءُ لاَ أَحْسَنَ مِنْ هَذَا، إِنْ كَانَ مَا تَقُولُ حَقًّا، فَلاَ تُؤْذِنَا فِي مَجَالِسِنَا، وَارْجِعْ إِلَى رَحْلِكَ، فَمَنْ جَاءَكَ مِنَّا فَاقْصُصْ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ رَوَاحَةَ اغْشَنَا فِي مَجَالِسِنَا، فَإِنَّا نُحِبُّ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَاسْتَبَّ الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَالْمُشْرِكُونَ وَالْيَهُودُ حَتَّى هَمُّوا أَنْ يَتَوَاثَبُوا، فَلَمْ يَزَلِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُخَفِّضُهُمْ، ثُمَّ رَكِبَ دَابَّتَهُ حَتَّى دَخَلَ عَلَى سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَىْ سَعْدُ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ مَا قَالَ أَبُو حُبَابٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُرِيدُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أُبَىٍّ قَالَ كَذَا وَكَذَا قَالَ اعْفُ عَنْهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَاصْفَحْ فَوَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَعْطَاكَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي أَعْطَاكَ، وَلَقَدِ اصْطَلَحَ أَهْلُ هَذِهِ الْبَحْرَةِ عَلَى أَنْ يُتَوِّجُوهُ فَيُعَصِّبُونَهُ بِالْعِصَابَةِ، فَلَمَّا رَدَّ اللَّهُ ذَلِكَ بِالْحَقِّ الَّذِي أَعْطَاكَ شَرِقَ بِذَلِكَ، فَذَلِكَ فَعَلَ بِهِ مَا رَأَيْتَ، فَعَفَا عَنْهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, qaala aakhbaraniy ausaamaau bnu zaydin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm rakiba himaarana 'alayhi iikaafun, tahtahu qatiyfaaun fadakiyyaaun, waaardafa waraa'ahu ausaamaaa bna zaydin wahwa ya'uwdu sa'da bna 'ubaadaaa fiy baniy alhaarithi bni alkhazraji, wadhalika qabla waq'aai badrin hattaa marra fiy majlisin fiyhi aakhlaatun mina almuslimiyna waalmushrikiyna 'abadaai alaawthaani waalyahuwdi, wafiyhim 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain abnu saluwla, wafiy almajlisi 'abdu alllahi bnu rawaahaaa, falammaa ghashiyati almajlisa 'ajaajaau alddaabbaai khammara 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain aanfahu biridaaiihi thumma qaala laa tughabbiruwa 'alaynaa‏.‏ fasallama 'alayhimu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma waqafa fanazala, fada'aahum iilaa alllahi waqaraaa 'alayhimu alqurana faqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain abnu saluwla aayyuhaa almar'u laa aahsana min hadhaa, iin kaana maa taquwlu haqqana, falaa tuudhinaa fiy majaalisinaa, waarji' iilaa rahlika, faman jaa'aka minnaa faaqsus 'alayhi‏.‏ qaala abnu rawaahaaa aghshanaa fiy majaalisinaa, faiinnaa nuhibbu dhalika‏.‏ faastabba almuslimuwna waalmushrikuwna waalyahuwdu hattaa hammuwa aan yatawaathabuwa, falam yazali alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yukhaffiduhum, thumma rakiba daabbatahu hattaa dakhala 'alaa sa'di bni 'ubaadaaa faqaala ‏ "‏ aaa sa'du aalam tasma' maa qaala aabuw hubaabin ‏"‏‏.‏ yuriydu 'abda alllahi bna aubaaain qaala kadhaa wakadhaa qaala a'fu 'anhu yaa rasuwla alllahi waasfah fawaalllahi laqad aa'taaka alllahu alladhiy aa'taaka, walaqadi astalaha aahlu hadhihi albahraai 'alaa aan yutawwijuwhu fayu'assibuwnahu bial'isaabaai, falammaa radda alllahu dhalika bialhaqqi alladhiy aa'taaka shariqa bidhalika, fadhalika fa'ala bihi maa raaayta, fa'afaa 'anhu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa-bin Az-Zubair:Usama bin Zaid said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) rode over a donkey with a saddle underneath which there was a thick soft Fadakiya velvet sheet. Usama bin Zaid was his companion rider, and he was going to pay a visit to Sa`d bin Ubada (who was sick) at the dwelling place of Bani Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj, and this incident happened before the battle of Badr. The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a gathering in which there were Muslims and pagan idolators and Jews, and among them there was `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul, and there was `Abdullah bin Rawaha too. When a cloud of dust raised by the animal covered that gathering, `Abdullah bin Ubai covered his nose with his Rida (sheet) and said (to the Prophet), "Don't cover us with dust." The Prophet (ﷺ) greeted them and then stopped, dismounted and invited them to Allah (i.e., to embrace Islam) and also recited to them the Holy Qur'an. `Abdullah bin Ubai' bin Salul said, "O man! There is nothing better than what you say, if what you say is the truth. So do not trouble us in our gatherings. Go back to your mount (or house,) and if anyone of us comes to you, tell (your tales) to him." On that `Abdullah bin Rawaha said, "(O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!) Come to us and bring it(what you want to say) in our gatherings, for we love that." So the Muslims, the pagans and the Jews started quarreling till they were about to fight and clash with one another. The Prophet (ﷺ) kept on quietening them (till they all became quiet). He then rode his animal, and proceeded till he entered upon Sa`d bin 'Ubada, he said, "O Sa`d, didn't you hear what Abu Habbab said? (He meant `Abdullah bin Ubai). He said so-and-so." Sa`d bin 'Ubada said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Excuse and forgive him, for by Allah, Allah has given you what He has given you. The people of this town decided to crown him (as their chief) and make him their king. But when Allah prevented that with the Truth which He had given you, it choked him, and that was what made him behave in the way you saw him behaving." So the Prophet excused him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ كَعْبَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يُحَدِّثُ حِينَ تَخَلَّفَ عَنْ تَبُوكَ، وَنَهَى، رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ كَلاَمِنَا، وَآتِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْهِ، فَأَقُولُ فِي نَفْسِي هَلْ حَرَّكَ شَفَتَيْهِ بِرَدِّ السَّلاَمِ أَمْ لاَ حَتَّى كَمَلَتْ خَمْسُونَ لَيْلَةً، وَآذَنَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِتَوْبَةِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْنَا حِينَ صَلَّى الْفَجْرَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna ka'bin, qaala sami'tu ka'ba bna maalikin, yuhaddithu hiyna takhallafa 'an tabuwka, wanahaa, rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an kalaaminaa, waatiy rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faausallimu 'alayhi, faaaquwlu fiy nafsiy hal harraka shafatayhi biraddi alssalaami aam laa hattaa kamalat khamsuwna laylaaan, waadhana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bitawbaai alllahi 'alaynaa hiyna sallaa alfajra‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b:I heard Ka`b bin Malik narrating (when he did not join the battle of Tabuk): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade all the Muslims to speak to us. I would come to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and greet him, and I would wonder whether the Prophet (ﷺ) did move his lips to return to my greetings or not till fifty nights passed away. The Prophet (ﷺ) then announced (to the people) Allah's forgiveness for us (acceptance of our repentance) at the time when he had offered the Fajr (morning) prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ دَخَلَ رَهْطٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا السَّامُ عَلَيْكَ‏.‏ فَفَهِمْتُهَا فَقُلْتُ عَلَيْكُمُ السَّامُ وَاللَّعْنَةُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَهْلاً يَا عَائِشَةُ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَوَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ مَا قَالُوا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَقَدْ قُلْتُ وَعَلَيْكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat dakhala rahtun mina alyahuwdi 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa alssaamu 'alayka‏.‏ fafahimtuhaa faqultu 'alaykumu alssaamu waallla'naau‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ mahlaan yaa 'aaiishaau, faiinna alllaha yuhibbu alrrifqa fiy alaamri kullihi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aawalam tasma' maa qaaluwa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ faqad qultu wa'alaykum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:A group of Jews came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "As-samu 'Alaika " (Death be on you), and I understood it and said to them, "Alaikum AsSamu wa-l-la'na (Death and curse be on you)." Allah's Apostle said, "Be calm! O `Aisha, for Allah loves that one should be kind and lenient in all matters." I said. "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Haven't you heard what they have said?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have (already) said (to them), 'Alaikum (upon you)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَهُودُ فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ أَحَدُهُمُ السَّامُ عَلَيْكَ‏.‏ فَقُلْ وَعَلَيْكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa sallama 'alaykumu alyahuwdu faiinnamaa yaquwlu aahaduhumu alssaamu 'alayka‏.‏ faqul wa'alayka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the Jews greet you, they usually say, 'As-Samu 'alaikum (Death be on you),' so you should say (in reply to them), 'Wa'alaikum (And on you)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا وَعَلَيْكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu aabiy bakri bni aanasin, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa sallama 'alaykum aahlu alkitaabi faquwluwa wa'alaykum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If the people of the Scripture greet you, then you should say (in reply), 'Wa'alaikum (And on you)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ بُهْلُولٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي حُصَيْنُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَعَثَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالزُّبَيْرَ بْنَ الْعَوَّامِ وَأَبَا مَرْثَدٍ الْغَنَوِيَّ وَكُلُّنَا فَارِسٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ انْطَلِقُوا حَتَّى تَأْتُوا رَوْضَةَ خَاخٍ، فَإِنَّ بِهَا امْرَأَةً مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ مَعَهَا صَحِيفَةٌ مِنْ حَاطِبِ بْنِ أَبِي بَلْتَعَةَ إِلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَدْرَكْنَاهَا تَسِيرُ عَلَى جَمَلٍ لَهَا حَيْثُ قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ قُلْنَا أَيْنَ الْكِتَابُ الَّذِي مَعَكِ قَالَتْ مَا مَعِي كِتَابٌ‏.‏ فَأَنَخْنَا بِهَا، فَابْتَغَيْنَا فِي رَحْلِهَا فَمَا وَجَدْنَا شَيْئًا، قَالَ صَاحِبَاىَ مَا نَرَى كِتَابًا‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتُ مَا كَذَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالَّذِي يُحْلَفُ بِهِ لَتُخْرِجِنَّ الْكِتَابَ أَوْ لأُجَرِّدَنَّكِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا رَأَتِ الْجِدَّ مِنِّي أَهْوَتْ بِيَدِهَا إِلَى حُجْزَتِهَا وَهْىَ مُحْتَجِزَةٌ بِكِسَاءٍ فَأَخْرَجَتِ الْكِتَابَ ـ قَالَ ـ فَانْطَلَقْنَا بِهِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا حَمَلَكَ يَا حَاطِبُ عَلَى مَا صَنَعْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ مَا بِي إِلاَّ أَنْ أَكُونَ مُؤْمِنًا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ، وَمَا غَيَّرْتُ وَلاَ بَدَّلْتُ، أَرَدْتُ أَنْ تَكُونَ لِي عِنْدَ الْقَوْمِ يَدٌ يَدْفَعُ اللَّهُ بِهَا عَنْ أَهْلِي وَمَالِي، وَلَيْسَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِكَ هُنَاكَ إِلاَّ وَلَهُ مَنْ يَدْفَعُ اللَّهُ بِهِ عَنْ أَهْلِهِ وَمَالِهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ صَدَقَ فَلاَ تَقُولُوا لَهُ إِلاَّ خَيْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ إِنَّهُ قَدْ خَانَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ، فَدَعْنِي فَأَضْرِبَ عُنُقَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا عُمَرُ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ قَدِ اطَّلَعَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَدْرٍ فَقَالَ اعْمَلُوا مَا شِئْتُمْ فَقَدْ وَجَبَتْ لَكُمُ الْجَنَّةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَدَمَعَتْ عَيْنَا عُمَرَ وَقَالَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yuwsufu bnu buhluwlin, haddathanaa abnu iidriysa, qaala haddathaniy husaynu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an sa'di bni 'ubaydaaa, 'an aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani alssulamiyyi, 'an 'aliyyin rda allh 'nh qaala ba'athaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalzzubayra bna al'awwaami waaabaa marthadin alghanawiyya wakullunaa faarisun faqaala ‏"‏ antaliquwa hattaa taatuwa rawdaaa khaakhin, faiinna bihaa amraaaaan mina almushrikiyna ma'ahaa sahiyfaaun min haatibi bni aabiy balta'aaa iilaa almushrikiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faaadraknaahaa tasiyru 'alaa jamalin lahaa haythu qaala lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala qulnaa aayna alkitaabu alladhiy ma'aki qaalat maa ma'iy kitaabun‏.‏ faaanakhnaa bihaa, faabtaghaynaa fiy rahlihaa famaa wajadnaa shayiana, qaala saahibaaaa maa naraa kitaabana‏.‏ qaala qultu laqad 'alimtu maa kadhaba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalladhiy yuhlafu bihi latukhrijinna alkitaaba aaw laujarridannaki‏.‏ qaala falammaa raaati aljidda minniy aahwat biyadihaa iilaa hujzatihaa wahaa muhtajizaaun bikisaa'in faaakhrajati alkitaaba qaala faantalaqnaa bihi iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ maa hamalaka yaa haatibu 'alaa maa sana'ta ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala maa biy iilaaa aan aakuwna muuminana bialllahi warasuwlihi, wamaa ghayyartu walaa baddaltu, aaradtu aan takuwna liy 'inda alqawmi yadun yadfa'u alllahu bihaa 'an aahliy wamaaliy, walaysa min aashaabika hunaaka iilaaa walahu man yadfa'u alllahu bihi 'an aahlihi wamaalihi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ sadaqa falaa taquwluwa lahu iilaaa khayrana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faqaala 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi iinnahu qad khaana alllaha warasuwlahu waalmuuminiyna, fada'niy faaadriba 'unuqahu‏.‏ qaala faqaala ‏"‏ yaa 'umaru wamaa yudriyka la'alla alllaha qadi attala'a 'alaa aahli badrin faqaala a'maluwa maa shiitum faqad wajabat lakumu aljannaau ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fadama'at 'aynaa 'umara waqaala alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me, Az-Zubair bin Al-Awwam and Abu Marthad Al-Ghanawi, and all of us were horsemen, and he said, "Proceed till you reach Rawdat Khakh, where there is a woman from the pagans carrying a letter sent by Hatib bin Abi Balta'a to the pagans (of Mecca)." So we overtook her while she was proceeding on her camel at the same place as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told us. We said (to her) "Where is the letter which is with you?" She said, "I have no letter with me." So we made her camel kneel down and searched her mount (baggage etc) but could not find anything. My two companions said, "We do not see any letter." I said, "I know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not tell a lie. By Allah, if you (the lady) do not bring out the letter, I will strip you of your clothes' When she noticed that I was serious, she put her hand into the knot of her waist sheet, for she was tying a sheet round herself, and brought out the letter. So we proceeded to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with the letter. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to Habib), "What made you o what you have done, O Hatib?" Hatib replied, "I have done nothing except that I believe in Allah and His Apostle, and I have not changed or altered (my religion). But I wanted to do the favor to the people (pagans of Mecca) through which Allah might protect my family and my property, as there is none among your companions but has someone in Mecca through whom Allah protects his property (against harm). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Habib has told you the truth, so do not say to him (anything) but good." `Umar bin Al-Khattab said, "Verily he has betrayed Allah, His Apostle, and the believers! Allow me to chop his neck off!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O `Umar! What do you know; perhaps Allah looked upon the Badr warriors and said, 'Do whatever you like, for I have ordained that you will be in Paradise.'" On that `Umar wept and said, "Allah and His Apostle know best
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ بْنَ حَرْبٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ هِرَقْلَ أَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ فِي نَفَرٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ وَكَانُوا تِجَارًا بِالشَّأْمِ، فَأَتَوْهُ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ قَالَ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِكِتَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُرِئَ فَإِذَا فِيهِ ‏ "‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ، مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ إِلَى هِرَقْلَ عَظِيمِ الرُّومِ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَى مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الْهُدَى، أَمَّا بَعْدُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin aabuw alhasani, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, aanna abna 'abbaasin, aakhbarahu aanna aabaa sufyaana bna harbin aakhbarahu aanna hiraqla aarsala iilayhi fiy nafarin min qurayshin wakaanuwa tijaarana bialshhaami, faaatawhu fadhakara alhadiytha qaala thumma da'aa bikitaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faquriia faiidhaa fiyhi ‏ "‏ bismi alllahi alrrahmani alrrahiymi, min muhammadin 'abdi alllahi warasuwlihi iilaa hiraqla 'aziymi alrruwmi, alssalaamu 'alaa mani attaba'a alhudaa, aammaa ba'du ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sufyan bin Harb:that Heraclius had sent for him to come along with a group of the Quraish who were trading in Sha'm, and they came to him. Then Abu Sufyan mentioned the whole narration and said, "Heraclius asked for the letter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . When the letter was read, its contents were as follows: 'In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. From Muhammad, Allah's slave and His Apostle to Heraclius, the Chief of Byzantines: Peace be upon him who follows the right path (guidance)! Amma ba'du (to proceed )...' (See Hadith No 6, Vol 1 for details)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ ذَكَرَ رَجُلاً مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَخَذَ خَشَبَةً فَنَقَرَهَا، فَأَدْخَلَ فِيهَا أَلْفَ دِينَارٍ وَصَحِيفَةً مِنْهُ إِلَى صَاحِبِهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ نَجَرَ خَشَبَةً، فَجَعَلَ الْمَالَ فِي جَوْفِهَا، وَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ صَحِيفَةً مِنْ فُلاَنٍ إِلَى فُلاَنٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy ja'faru bnu rabiy'aaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni hurmuza, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu dhakara rajulaan min baniy iisraaiiyla aakhadha khashabaaan fanaqarahaa, faaadkhala fiyhaa aalfa diynaarin wasahiyfaaan minhu iilaa saahibihi‏.‏ waqaala 'umaru bnu aabiy salamaaa 'an aabiyhi sami'a aabaa hurayraaa qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ najara khashabaaan, faja'ala almaala fiy jawfihaa, wakataba iilayhi sahiyfaaan min fulaanin iilaa fulaanin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Hurairah (ra):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned a person from Bani Israel who took a piece of wood, made a hole in it, and put therein one thousand Dinar and letter from him to his friend. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(That man) cut a piece of wood and put the money inside it and wrote a letter from such and such a person to such and such a person
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ أَهْلَ، قُرَيْظَةَ نَزَلُوا عَلَى حُكْمِ سَعْدٍ فَأَرْسَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَيْهِ فَجَاءَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ قُومُوا إِلَى سَيِّدِكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ خَيْرِكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَعَدَ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَؤُلاَءِ نَزَلُوا عَلَى حُكْمِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنِّي أَحْكُمُ أَنْ تُقْتَلَ مُقَاتِلَتُهُمْ، وَتُسْبَى ذَرَارِيُّهُمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ حَكَمْتَ بِمَا حَكَمَ بِهِ الْمَلِكُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَفْهَمَنِي بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِي عَنْ أَبِي الْوَلِيدِ مِنْ قَوْلِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ إِلَى حُكْمِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'an aabiy aumaamaaa bni sahli bni hunayfin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, aanna aahla, qurayzaaa nazaluwa 'alaa hukmi sa'din faaarsala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilayhi fajaa'a faqaala ‏"‏ quwmuwa iilaa sayyidikum ‏"‏‏.‏ aaw qaala ‏"‏ khayrikum ‏"‏‏.‏ faqa'ada 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ hauulaa'i nazaluwa 'alaa hukmika ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faiinniy aahkumu aan tuqtala muqaatilatuhum, watusbaa dharaariyyuhum‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ laqad hakamta bimaa hakama bihi almaliku ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi aafhamaniy ba'du aashaabiy 'an aabiy alwaliydi min qawli aabiy sa'iydin iilaa hukmika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The people of (the tribe of) Quraiza agreed upon to accept the verdict of Sa`d. The Prophet (ﷺ) sent for him (Sa`d) and he came. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to those people), "Get up for your chief or the best among you!" Sa`d sat beside the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "These people have agreed to accept your verdict." Sa`d said, "So I give my judgment that their warriors should be killed and their women and children should be taken as captives." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You have judged according to the King's (Allah's) judgment." (See Hadith No. 447, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَنَسٍ أَكَانَتِ الْمُصَافَحَةُ فِي أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aasimin, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an qataadaaa, qaala qultu laanasin aakaanati almusaafahaau fiy aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala na'am‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qatada:I asked Anas, "Was it a custom of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) to shake hands with one another?" He said, "Yes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي حَيْوَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عَقِيلٍ، زُهْرَةُ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ سَمِعَ جَدَّهُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ آخِذٌ بِيَدِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sulaymaana, qaala haddathaniy abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy haywaau, qaala haddathaniy aabuw 'aqiylin, zuhraau bnu ma'badin sami'a jaddahu 'abda alllahi bna hishaamin, qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa akhidhun biyadi 'umara bni alkhattaabi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Hisham:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he was holding the hand of `Umar bin Al-Khattab
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَيْفٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُجَاهِدًا، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَخْبَرَةَ أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، يَقُولُ عَلَّمَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَفِّي بَيْنَ كَفَّيْهِ التَّشَهُّدَ، كَمَا يُعَلِّمُنِي السُّورَةَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ‏.‏ وَهْوَ بَيْنَ ظَهْرَانَيْنَا، فَلَمَّا قُبِضَ قُلْنَا السَّلاَمُ‏.‏ يَعْنِي عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sayfun, qaala sami'tu mujaahidana, yaquwlu haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu sakhbaraaa aabuw ma'marin, qaala sami'tu abna mas'uwdin, yaquwlu 'allamaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaffiy bayna kaffayhi alttashahhuda, kamaa yu'allimuniy alssuwraaa mina alqurani alttahiyyaatu lillahi waalssalawaatu waalttayyibaatu, alssalaamu 'alayka aayyuhaa alnnabiyyu warahmaau alllahi wabarakaatuhu, alssalaamu 'alaynaa wa'alaa 'ibaadi alllahi alssaalihiyna, aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waaashhadu aanna muhammadana 'abduhu warasuwluhu‏.‏ wahwa bayna zahraanaynaa, falammaa qubida qulnaa alssalaamu‏.‏ ya'niy 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) taught me the Tashah-hud as he taught me a Sura from the Qur'an, while my hand was between his hands. (Tashah-hud was) all the best compliments and the prayers and the good things are for Allah. Peace and Allah's Mercy and Blessings be on you, O Prophet! Peace be on us and on the pious slaves of Allah, I testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and I also testify that Muhammad is Allah's slave and His Apostle. (We used to recite this in the prayer) during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) , but when he had died, we used to say, "Peace be on the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ كَعْبٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا ـ يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ ـ خَرَجَ مِنْ عِنْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَنْبَسَةُ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ خَرَجَ مِنْ عِنْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي وَجَعِهِ الَّذِي تُوُفِّيَ فِيهِ فَقَالَ النَّاسُ يَا أَبَا حَسَنٍ كَيْفَ أَصْبَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أَصْبَحَ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ بَارِئًا فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ الْعَبَّاسُ فَقَالَ أَلاَ تَرَاهُ أَنْتَ وَاللَّهِ بَعْدَ الثَّلاَثِ عَبْدُ الْعَصَا وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأُرَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَيُتَوَفَّى فِي وَجَعِهِ، وَإِنِّي لأَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِ بَنِي عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ الْمَوْتَ، فَاذْهَبْ بِنَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَسْأَلَهُ فِيمَنْ يَكُونُ الأَمْرُ فَإِنْ كَانَ فِينَا عَلِمْنَا ذَلِكَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ فِي غَيْرِنَا أَمَرْنَاهُ فَأَوْصَى بِنَا‏.‏ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ سَأَلْنَاهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَمْنَعُنَا لاَ يُعْطِينَاهَا النَّاسُ أَبَدًا، وَإِنِّي لاَ أَسْأَلُهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبَدًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa bishru bnu shu'aybin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi bnu ka'bin, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin, aakhbarahu aanna 'aliyyana ya'niy abna aabiy taalibin kharaja min 'indi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu saalihin haddathanaa 'anbasaau haddathanaa yuwnusu 'ani abni shihaabin qaala aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi bnu ka'bi bni maalikin aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin aakhbarahu aanna 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin rda allh 'nh kharaja min 'indi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy waja'ihi alladhiy tuwuffiya fiyhi faqaala alnnaasu yaa aabaa hasanin kayfa aasbaha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala aasbaha bihamdi alllahi baariiana faaakhadha biyadihi al'abbaasu faqaala aalaa taraahu aanta waalllahi ba'da althhalaathi 'abdu al'asaa waalllahi iinniy lauraa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sayutawaffaa fiy waja'ihi, waiinniy laa'rifu fiy wujuwhi baniy 'abdi almuttalibi almawta, faadhhab binaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fanasaalahu fiyman yakuwnu alaamru faiin kaana fiynaa 'alimnaa dhalika, waiin kaana fiy ghayrinaa aamarnaahu faaawsaa binaa‏.‏ qaala 'aliyyun waalllahi laiin saaalnaahaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fayamna'unaa laa yu'tiynaahaa alnnaasu aabadana, waiinniy laa aasaaluhaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aabadana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:`Ali bin Abu Talib came out of the house of the Prophet (ﷺ) during his fatal ailment. The people asked (`Ali), "O Abu Hasan! How is the health of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) this morning?" `Ali said, "This morning he is better, with the grace of Allah." Al-`Abbas held `Ali by the hand and said, "Don't you see him (about to die)? By Allah, within three days you will be the slave of the stick (i.e., under the command of another ruler). By Allah, I think that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) will die from his present ailment, for I know the signs of death on the faces of the offspring of `Abdul Muttalib. So let us go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to ask him who will take over the Caliphate. If the authority is given to us, we will know it, and if it is given to somebody else we will request him to recommend us to him. " `Ali said, "By Allah! If we ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for the rulership and he refuses, then the people will never give it to us. Besides, I will never ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for it." (See Hadith No 728, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ مُعَاذٍ، قَالَ أَنَا رَدِيفُ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ مِثْلَهُ ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏ هَلْ تَدْرِي مَا حَقُّ اللَّهِ عَلَى الْعِبَادِ أَنْ يَعْبُدُوهُ وَلاَ يُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَارَ سَاعَةً فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ تَدْرِي مَا حَقُّ الْعِبَادِ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِذَا فَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ أَنْ لاَ يُعَذِّبَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ مُعَاذٍ، بِهَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, hadaathanaa hamaaamun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, 'an mu'aadhin, qaala aanaa radiyfu alnaabiyii, sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ yaa mu'aadhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labaayka wasa'dayka‏.‏ thumaa qaala mithlahu thalaathana ‏"‏ hal tadriy maa haquu allaahi 'alaa al'ibaadi aan ya'buduwhu walaa yushrikuwa bihi shayiana ‏"‏‏.‏ thumaa saara saa'aaan faqaala ‏"‏ yaa mu'aadhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labaayka wasa'dayka‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ hal tadriy maa haquu al'ibaadi 'alaa allaahi iidhaa fa'aluwa dhalika aan laa yu'adhiibahum ‏"‏‏.‏ hadaathanaa hudbaau, hadaathanaa hamaaamun, hadaathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasin, 'an mu'aadhin, bihadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mu`adh:While I was a companion rider with the Prophet (ﷺ) he said, "O Mu`adh!" I replied, "Labbaik wa Sa`daik." He repeated this call three times and then said, "Do you know what Allah's Right on His slaves is?" I replied, "No." He said, Allah's Right on His slaves is that they should worship Him (Alone) and should not join partners in worship with Him." He said, "O Mu`adh!" I replied, "Labbaik wa Sa`daik." He said, "Do you know what the right of (Allah's) salves on Allah is, if they do that (worship Him Alone and join none in His worship)? It is that He will not punish them." (another chain through Mu'adh)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَاللَّهِ أَبُو ذَرٍّ، بِالرَّبَذَةِ كُنْتُ أَمْشِي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَرَّةِ الْمَدِينَةِ عِشَاءً اسْتَقْبَلَنَا أُحُدٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ مَا أُحِبُّ أَنَّ أُحُدًا لِي ذَهَبًا يَأْتِي عَلَىَّ لَيْلَةٌ أَوْ ثَلاَثٌ عِنْدِي مِنْهُ دِينَارٌ، إِلاَّ أُرْصِدُهُ لِدَيْنٍ، إِلاَّ أَنْ أَقُولَ بِهِ فِي عِبَادِ اللَّهِ هَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَرَانَا بِيَدِهِ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ الأَكْثَرُونَ هُمُ الأَقَلُّونَ إِلاَّ مَنْ قَالَ هَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي ‏"‏ مَكَانَكَ لاَ تَبْرَحْ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ حَتَّى أَرْجِعَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ حَتَّى غَابَ عَنِّي، فَسَمِعْتُ صَوْتًا فَخَشِيتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ عُرِضَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَذْهَبَ، ثُمَّ ذَكَرْتُ قَوْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَبْرَحْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَمَكُثْتُ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ سَمِعْتُ صَوْتًا خَشِيتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ عُرِضَ لَكَ، ثُمَّ ذَكَرْتُ قَوْلَكَ فَقُمْتُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ذَاكَ جِبْرِيلُ أَتَانِي، فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّهُ مَنْ مَاتَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِزَيْدٍ إِنَّهُ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّهُ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَشْهَدُ لَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو ذَرٍّ بِالرَّبَذَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ الأَعْمَشُ وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ نَحْوَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ ‏"‏ يَمْكُثُ عِنْدِي فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, haddathanaa zaydu bnu wahbin, haddathanaa waalllahi aabuw dharrin, bialrrabadhaai kuntu aamshiy ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy harraai almadiynaai 'ishaa'an astaqbalanaa auhudun faqaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa dharrin maa auhibbu aanna auhudana liy dhahabana yaatiy 'alaaaa laylaaun aaw thalaathun 'indiy minhu diynaarun, iilaaa aursiduhu lidaynin, iilaaa aan aaquwla bihi fiy 'ibaadi alllahi hakadhaa wahakadhaa wahakadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waaaraanaa biyadihi‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa dharrin ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labbayka wasa'dayka yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ alaaktharuwna humu alaaqalluwna iilaaa man qaala hakadhaa wahakadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala liy ‏"‏ makaanaka laa tabrah yaa aabaa dharrin hattaa aarji'a ‏"‏‏.‏ faantalaqa hattaa ghaaba 'anniy, fasami'tu sawtana fakhashiytu aan yakuwna 'urida lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaaradtu aan aadhhaba, thumma dhakartu qawla rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa tabrah ‏"‏‏.‏ famakuthtu qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi sami'tu sawtana khashiytu aan yakuwna 'urida laka, thumma dhakartu qawlaka faqumtu‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ dhaaka jibriylu aataaniy, faaakhbaraniy aannahu man maata min aummatiy laa yushriku bialllahi shayiana dakhala aljannaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi waiin zanaa waiin saraqa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ waiin zanaa waiin saraqa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu lizaydin iinnahu balaghaniy aannahu aabuw alddardaa'i‏.‏ faqaala aashhadu lahaddathaniyhi aabuw dharrin bialrrabadhaai‏.‏ qaala alaa'mashu wahaddathaniy aabuw saalihin 'an aabiy alddardaa'i nahwahu‏.‏ waqaala aabuw shihaabin 'ani alaa'mashi ‏"‏ yamkuthu 'indiy fawqa thalaathin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Dhar:While I was walking with the Prophet (ﷺ) at the Hurra of Medina in the evening, the mountain of Uhud appeared before us. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Dhar! I would not like to have gold equal to Uhud (mountain) for me, unless nothing of it, not even a single Dinar remains of it with me, for more than one day or three days, except that single Dinar which I will keep for repaying debts. I will spend all of it (the whole amount) among Allah's slaves like this and like this and like this." The Prophet (ﷺ) pointed out with his hand to illustrate it and then said, "O Abu Dhar!" I replied, "Labbaik wa Sa`daik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "Those who have much wealth (in this world) will be the least rewarded (in the Hereafter) except those who do like this and like this (i.e., spend their money in charity)." Then he ordered me, "Remain at your place and do not leave it, O Abu Dhar, till I come back." He went away till he disappeared from me. Then I heard a voice and feared that something might have happened to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and I intended to go (to find out) but I remembered the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that I should not leave, my place, so I kept on waiting (and after a while the Prophet (ﷺ) came), and I said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I heard a voice and I was afraid that something might have happened to you, but then I remembered your statement and stayed (there). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That was Gabriel who came to me and informed me that whoever among my followers died without joining others in worship with Allah, would enter Paradise." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft?" He said, "Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يُقِيمُ الرَّجُلُ الرَّجُلَ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ، ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ فِيهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yuqiymu alrrajulu alrrajula min majlisihi, thumma yajlisu fiyhi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man should not make another man get up from his (the latter's) seat (in a gathering) in order to sit there
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلاَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى أَنْ يُقَامَ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ وَيَجْلِسَ فِيهِ آخَرُ، وَلَكِنْ تَفَسَّحُوا وَتَوَسَّعُوا‏.‏ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَقُومَ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ، ثُمَّ يُجْلِسَ مَكَانَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalaaadu bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu nahaa aan yuqaama alrrajulu min majlisihi wayajlisa fiyhi akharu, walakin tafassahuwa watawassa'uwa‏.‏ wakaana abnu 'umara yakrahu aan yaquwma alrrajulu min majlisihi, thumma yujlisa makaanahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade that a man should be made to get up from his seat so that another might sit on it, but one should make room and spread out. Ibn `Umar disliked that a man should get up from his seat and then somebody else sit at his place
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَذْكُرُ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا تَزَوَّجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةَ جَحْشٍ دَعَا النَّاسَ طَعِمُوا ثُمَّ جَلَسُوا يَتَحَدَّثُونَ ـ قَالَ ـ فَأَخَذَ كَأَنَّهُ يَتَهَيَّأُ لِلْقِيَامِ فَلَمْ يَقُومُوا، فَلَمَّا رَأَى ذَلِكَ قَامَ، فَلَمَّا قَامَ قَامَ مَنْ قَامَ مَعَهُ مِنَ النَّاسِ، وَبَقِيَ ثَلاَثَةٌ، وَإِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَاءَ لِيَدْخُلَ فَإِذَا الْقَوْمُ جُلُوسٌ، ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ قَامُوا فَانْطَلَقُوا ـ قَالَ ـ فَجِئْتُ فَأَخْبَرْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُمْ قَدِ انْطَلَقُوا، فَجَاءَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ فَذَهَبْتُ أَدْخُلُ، فَأَرْخَى الْحِجَابَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ، وَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتَ النَّبِيِّ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏إِنَّ ذَلِكُمْ كَانَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَظِيمًا‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, sami'tu aabiy yadhkuru, 'an aabiy mijlazin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala lammaa tazawwaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm zaynaba abnaaa jahshin da'aa alnnaasa ta'imuwa thumma jalasuwa yatahaddathuwna qaala faaakhadha kaaannahu yatahayyaau lilqiyaami falam yaquwmuwa, falammaa raaaa dhalika qaama, falammaa qaama qaama man qaama ma'ahu mina alnnaasi, wabaqiya thalaathaaun, waiinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm jaa'a liyadkhula faiidhaa alqawmu juluwsun, thumma iinnahum qaamuwa faantalaquwa qaala fajiitu faaakhbartu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahum qadi antalaquwa, fajaa'a hattaa dakhala fadhahabtu aadkhulu, faaarkhaa alhijaaba bayniy wabaynahu, waaanzala alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏yaa aayyuhaa alladhiyna amanuwa laa tadkhuluwa buyuwta alnnabiyyi iilaaa aan yuudhana lakum‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏iinna dhalikum kaana 'inda alllahi 'aziymana‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married Zainab bint Jahsh, he invited the people who took their meals and then remained sitting and talking. The Prophet (ﷺ) pretended to be ready to get up, but the people did not get up. When he noticed that, he got up, and when he had got up, some of those people got up along with him and there remained three (who kept on sitting). Then the Prophet (ﷺ) came back and found those people still sitting. Later on those people got up and went away. So I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him that they had left. The Prophet (ﷺ) came, and entered (his house). I wanted to enter(along with him) but he dropped a curtain between me and him. Allah then revealed: 'O you who believe! Do not enter the Prophet's Houses until leave is given... (to His statement)... Verily! That shall be an enormity, in Allah's sight
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي غَالِبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ الْحِزَامِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُلَيْحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِفِنَاءِ الْكَعْبَةِ مُحْتَبِيًا بِيَدِهِ هَكَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy ghaalibin, aakhbaranaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri alhizaamiyyu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fulayhin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bifinaa'i alka'baai muhtabiyana biyadihi hakadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the courtyard of the Ka`ba in the Ihtiba.' posture putting his hand round his legs like this
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِأَكْبَرِ الْكَبَائِرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ الإِشْرَاكُ بِاللَّهِ، وَعُقُوقُ الْوَالِدَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa bishru bnu almufaddali, haddathanaa aljurayriyyu, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy bakraaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aalaa aukhbirukum biaakbari alkabaaiiri ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa balaa yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aliishraaku bialllahi, wa'uquwqu alwaalidayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Bakra:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Shall I inform you of the biggest of the great sins?" They said, "Yes, O Allah's Apostle!" He said, "To join partners in worship with Allah, and to be undutiful to one's parents
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، مِثْلَهُ، وَكَانَ مُتَّكِئًا فَجَلَسَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلاَ وَقَوْلُ الزُّورِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَمَا زَالَ يُكَرِّرُهَا حَتَّى قُلْنَا لَيْتَهُ سَكَتَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa bishrun, mithlahu, wakaana muttakiiana fajalasa faqaala ‏ "‏ aalaa waqawlu alzzuwri ‏"‏‏.‏ famaa zaala yukarriruhaa hattaa qulnaa laytahu sakata‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Bishr:as above (No. 290) adding: The Prophet (ﷺ) was reclining (leaning) and then he sat up saying, "And I warn you against giving a false statement." And he kept on saying that warning so much so that we said, "Would that he had stopped
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، أَنَّ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعَصْرَ، فَأَسْرَعَ، ثُمَّ دَخَلَ الْبَيْتَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'an 'umara bni sa'iydin, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, aanna 'uqbaaa bna alhaarithi, haddathahu qaala sallaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm al'asra, faaasra'a, thumma dakhala albayta‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Uqba bin Al-Harith:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the `Asr prayer and then he walked quickly and entered his house
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي وَسْطَ السَّرِيرِ، وَأَنَا مُضْطَجِعَةٌ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْقِبْلَةِ تَكُونُ لِيَ الْحَاجَةُ، فَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَقُومَ فَأَسْتَقْبِلَهُ فَأَنْسَلُّ انْسِلاَلاً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy wasta alssariyri, waaanaa mudtaji'aaun baynahu wabayna alqiblaai takuwnu liya alhaajaau, faaakrahu aan aaquwma faaastaqbilahu faaansallu ansilaalaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer his prayer (while standing) in the midst of the bed, and I used to lie in front of him between him and the Qibla It I had any necessity for getting up and I used to dislike to get up and face him (while he was in prayer), but I would gradually slip away from the bed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ،‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الْمَلِيحِ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ مَعَ أَبِيكَ زَيْدٍ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو فَحَدَّثَنَا أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذُكِرَ لَهُ صَوْمِي، فَدَخَلَ عَلَىَّ، فَأَلْقَيْتُ لَهُ وِسَادَةً مِنْ أَدَمٍ حَشْوُهَا لِيفٌ، فَجَلَسَ عَلَى الأَرْضِ، وَصَارَتِ الْوِسَادَةُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ، فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ أَمَا يَكْفِيكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَهْرٍ ثَلاَثَةُ أَيَّامٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ خَمْسًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ سَبْعًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ تِسْعًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ صَوْمَ فَوْقَ صَوْمِ دَاوُدَ، شَطْرَ الدَّهْرِ، صِيَامُ يَوْمٍ، وَإِفْطَارُ يَوْمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, haddathanaa khaalidun, ‏.‏ wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'awnin, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an khaalidin, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw almaliyhi, qaala dakhaltu ma'a aabiyka zaydin 'alaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw fahaddathanaa aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dhukira lahu sawmiy, fadakhala 'alaaaa, faaalqaytu lahu wisaadaaan min aadamin hashwuhaa liyfun, fajalasa 'alaa alaardi, wasaarati alwisaadaau bayniy wabaynahu, faqaala liy ‏"‏ aamaa yakfiyka min kulli shahrin thalaathaau aayyaamin ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ khamsana ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ sab'ana ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ tis'ana ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iihdaa 'ashraaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laa sawma fawqa sawmi daawuda, shatra alddahri, siyaamu yawmin, waiiftaaru yawmin ‏"‏‏.‏
