verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The news of my fasting was mentioned to the Prophet (ﷺ) . So he entered upon me and I put for him a leather cushion stuffed with palm-fibres. The Prophet (ﷺ) sat on the floor and the cushion was between me and him. He said to me, "Isn't it sufficient for you (that you fast) three days a month?" I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (I can fast more than this)." He said, "You may fast) five days a month." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! (I can fast more than this)." He said, "(You may fast) seven days." I said, "O Allah's Apostle!" He said, "Nine." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "Eleven." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "No fasting is superior to the fasting of (the Prophet David (ﷺ)) which was one half of a year, and he used, to fast on alternate days. (See Hadith No. 300, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَدِمَ الشَّأْمَ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ ذَهَبَ عَلْقَمَةُ إِلَى الشَّأْمِ، فَأَتَى الْمَسْجِدَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي جَلِيسًا‏.‏ فَقَعَدَ إِلَى أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ فَقَالَ مِمَّنْ أَنْتَ قَالَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ فِيكُمْ صَاحِبُ السِّرِّ الَّذِي كَانَ لاَ يَعْلَمُهُ غَيْرُهُ ـ يَعْنِي حُذَيْفَةَ ـ أَلَيْسَ فِيكُمْ ـ أَوْ كَانَ فِيكُمُ ـ الَّذِي أَجَارَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى لِسَانِ رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ ـ يَعْنِي عَمَّارًا ـ أَوَلَيْسَ فِيكُمْ صَاحِبُ السِّوَاكِ وَالْوِسَادِ ـ يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ ـ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَقْرَأُ ‏{‏وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ ‏{‏وَالذَّكَرِ وَالأُنْثَى‏}‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَا زَالَ هَؤُلاَءِ حَتَّى كَادُوا يُشَكِّكُونِي، وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُهَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa yaziydu, 'an shu'baaa, 'an mughiyraaa, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, aannahu qadima alshhaama‏.‏ wahaddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an mughiyraaa, 'an iibraahiyma, qaala dhahaba 'alqamaau iilaa alshhaami, faaataa almasjida fasallaa rak'atayni faqaala alllahumma arzuqniy jaliysana‏.‏ faqa'ada iilaa aabiy alddardaa'i faqaala mimman aanta qaala min aahli alkuwfaai‏.‏ qaala aalaysa fiykum saahibu alssirri alladhiy kaana laa ya'lamuhu ghayruhu ya'niy hudhayfaaa aalaysa fiykum aaw kaana fiykumu alladhiy aajaarahu alllahu 'alaa lisaani rasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alshhaytaani ya'niy 'ammaarana aawalaysa fiykum saahibu alssiwaaki waalwisaadi ya'niy abna mas'uwdin kayfa kaana 'abdu alllahi yaqraau ‏{‏waalllayli iidhaa yaghshaa‏}‏‏.‏ qaala ‏{‏waaldhhakari waalaunthaa‏}‏‏.‏ faqaala maa zaala hauulaa'i hattaa kaaduwa yushakkikuwniy, waqad sami'tuhaa min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibrahim:'Alaqama went to Sham and came to the mosque and offered a two-rak`at prayer, and invoked Allah: "O Allah! Bless me with a (pious) good companion." So he sat beside Abu Ad-Darda' who asked, "From where are you?" He said, "From the people of Kufa." Abu Darda' said, "Wasn't there among you the person who keeps the secrets (of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) which nobody knew except him (i.e., Hudhaifa (bin Al-Yaman)). And isn't there among you the person whom Allah gave refuge from Satan through the request (tongue) of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? (i.e., `Ammar). Isn't there among you the one who used to carry the Siwak and the cushion (or pillows (of the Prophets)? (i.e., Ibn Mas`ud). How did Ibn Mas`ud use to recite 'By the night as it conceals (the light)?" (Sura 92). 'Alqama said, "Wadhdhakari Wal Untha' (And by male and female.") Abu Ad-Darda added. 'These people continued to argue with me regarding it till they were about to cause me to have doubts although I heard it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَقِيلُ وَنَتَغَدَّى بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, qaala kunnaa naqiylu wanataghaddaa ba'da aljumu'aai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:We used to have a midday nap and take our meals after the Jumua (prayer)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ مَا كَانَ لِعَلِيٍّ اسْمٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ أَبِي تُرَابٍ، وَإِنْ كَانَ لَيَفْرَحُ بِهِ إِذَا دُعِيَ بِهَا، جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْتَ فَاطِمَةَ ـ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ ـ فَلَمْ يَجِدْ عَلِيًّا فِي الْبَيْتِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ ابْنُ عَمِّكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ كَانَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ شَىْءٌ، فَغَاضَبَنِي فَخَرَجَ فَلَمْ يَقِلْ عِنْدِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لإِنْسَانٍ ‏"‏ انْظُرْ أَيْنَ هُوَ ‏"‏ فَجَاءَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هُوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ رَاقِدٌ‏.‏ فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ مُضْطَجِعٌ، قَدْ سَقَطَ رِدَاؤُهُ عَنْ شِقِّهِ، فَأَصَابَهُ تُرَابٌ، فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْسَحُهُ عَنْهُ ـ وَهْوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ قُمْ أَبَا تُرَابٍ، قُمْ أَبَا تُرَابٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, qaala maa kaana li'aliyyin asmun aahabba iilayhi min aabiy turaabin, waiin kaana layafrahu bihi iidhaa du'iya bihaa, jaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bayta faatimaaa 'alayhaa alssalaamu falam yajid 'aliyyana fiy albayti faqaala ‏"‏ aayna abnu 'ammiki ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaalat kaana bayniy wabaynahu shaa'un, faghaadabaniy fakharaja falam yaqil 'indiy‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm liinsaanin ‏"‏ anzur aayna huwa ‏"‏ fajaa'a faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi huwa fiy almasjidi raaqidun‏.‏ fajaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa mudtaji'un, qad saqata ridaauuhu 'an shiqqihi, faaasaabahu turaabun, faja'ala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yamsahuhu 'anhu wahwa yaquwlu ‏"‏ qum aabaa turaabin, qum aabaa turaabin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:There was no name dearer to `Ali than his nickname Abu Turab (the father of dust). He used to feel happy whenever he was called by this name. Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to the house of Fatima but did not find `Ali in the house. So he asked "Where is your cousin?" She replied, "There was something (a quarrel) between me and him whereupon he got angry with me and went out without having a midday nap in my house." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked a person to look for him. That person came, and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He (Ali) is sleeping in the mosque." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went there and found him lying. His upper body cover had fallen off to one side of his body, and so he was covered with dust. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started cleaning the dust from him, saying, "Get up, O Abu Turab! Get up, Abu Turab!" (See Hadith No. 432, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ، كَانَتْ تَبْسُطُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نِطَعًا فَيَقِيلُ عِنْدَهَا عَلَى ذَلِكَ النِّطَعِ ـ قَالَ ـ فَإِذَا نَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخَذَتْ مِنْ عَرَقِهِ وَشَعَرِهِ، فَجَمَعَتْهُ فِي قَارُورَةٍ، ثُمَّ جَمَعَتْهُ فِي سُكٍّ ـ قَالَ ـ فَلَمَّا حَضَرَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ الْوَفَاةُ أَوْصَى أَنْ يُجْعَلَ فِي حَنُوطِهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ السُّكِّ ـ قَالَ ـ فَجُعِلَ فِي حَنُوطِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, hadaathanaa muhamaadu bnu 'abdi allaahi alaansaariyuu, qaala hadaathaniy aabiy, 'an thumaamaaa, 'an aanasin, aanaa aumaa sulaymin, kaanat tabsutu lilnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm nita'ana fayaqiylu 'indahaa 'alaa dhalika alniita'i qaala faiidhaa naama alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhadhat min 'araqihi washa'arihi, fajama'athu fiy qaaruwraain, thumaa jama'athu fiy sukinn qaala falamaaa hadara aanasa bna maalikin alwafaaau aawsaa aan yuj'ala fiy hanuwtihi min dhalika alsuukii qaala faju'ila fiy hanuwtihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Thumama:Anas said, "Um Sulaim used to spread a leather sheet for the Prophet (ﷺ) and he used to take a midday nap on that leather sheet at her home." Anas added, "When the Prophet (ﷺ) had slept, she would take some of his sweat and hair and collect it (the sweat) in a bottle and then mix it with Suk (a kind of perfume) while he was still sleeping. "When the death of Anas bin Malik approached, he advised that some of that Suk be mixed with his Hanut (perfume for embalming the dead body), and it was mixed with his Hanut
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا ذَهَبَ إِلَى قُبَاءٍ يَدْخُلُ عَلَى أُمِّ حَرَامٍ بِنْتِ مِلْحَانَ فَتُطْعِمُهُ، وَكَانَتْ تَحْتَ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، فَدَخَلَ يَوْمًا فَأَطْعَمَتْهُ، فَنَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظَ يَضْحَكُ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ مَا يُضْحِكُكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ نَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي عُرِضُوا عَلَىَّ غُزَاةً فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، يَرْكَبُونَ ثَبَجَ هَذَا الْبَحْرِ، مُلُوكًا عَلَى الأَسِرَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ـ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ مِثْلُ الْمُلُوكِ عَلَى الأَسِرَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ شَكَّ إِسْحَاقُ ـ قُلْتُ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ فَدَعَا ثُمَّ وَضَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَنَامَ، ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظَ يَضْحَكُ فَقُلْتُ مَا يُضْحِكُكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي عُرِضُوا عَلَىَّ، غُزَاةً فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، يَرْكَبُونَ ثَبَجَ هَذَا الْبَحْرِ، مُلُوكًا عَلَى الأَسِرَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ أَوْ ‏"‏ مِثْلَ الْمُلُوكِ عَلَى الأَسِرَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْتِ مِنَ الأَوَّلِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَكِبَتِ الْبَحْرَ زَمَانَ مُعَاوِيَةَ، فَصُرِعَتْ عَنْ دَابَّتِهَا حِينَ خَرَجَتْ مِنَ الْبَحْرِ، فَهَلَكَتْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aannahu sami'ahu yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa dhahaba iilaa qubaa'in yadkhulu 'alaa aummi haraamin binti milhaana fatut'imuhu, wakaanat tahta 'ubaadaaa bni alssaamiti, fadakhala yawmana faaat'amathu, fanaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma astayqaza yadhaku‏.‏ qaalat faqultu maa yudhikuka yaa rasuwla alllahi faqaala ‏"‏ naasun min aummatiy 'uriduwa 'alaaaa ghuzaaaan fiy sabiyli alllahi, yarkabuwna thabaja hadhaa albahri, muluwkana 'alaa alaasirraai ‏"‏‏.‏ aaw qaala ‏"‏ mithlu almuluwki 'alaa alaasirraai ‏"‏‏.‏ shakka iishaaqu qultu ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum‏.‏ fada'aa thumma wada'a raasahu fanaama, thumma astayqaza yadhaku faqultu maa yudhikuka yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ naasun min aummatiy 'uriduwa 'alaaaa, ghuzaaaan fiy sabiyli alllahi, yarkabuwna thabaja hadhaa albahri, muluwkana 'alaa alaasirraai ‏"‏‏.‏ aaw ‏"‏ mithla almuluwki 'alaa alaasirraai ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aanti mina alaawwaliyna ‏"‏‏.‏ farakibati albahra zamaana mu'aawiyaaa, fasuri'at 'an daabbatihaa hiyna kharajat mina albahri, fahalakat‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to Quba, he used to visit Um Haram bint Milhan who would offer him meals; and she was the wife of 'Ubada bin As-samit. One day he went to her house and she offered him a meal, and after that he slept, and then woke up smiling. She (Um Haram) said, "I asked him, 'What makes you laugh, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?' He said, 'Some people of my followers were displayed before me as warriors fighting for Allah's Cause and sailing over this sea, kings on thrones,' or said, 'like kings on thrones.' (The narrator, 'Is-haq is in doubt about it.) I (Um Haram) said, 'O Allah's Apostle! Invoke Allah that He may make me one of them.' He invoked (Allah) for her and then lay his head and slept again and then woke up smiling. I asked, 'What makes you laugh, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?' He said, 'Some people of my followers were displayed before me as warriors fighting for Allah's Cause and sailing over this sea, kings on the thrones,' or said, 'like kings on the thrones.' I (Um Haram) said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah that He may make me one of them.' He said, You will be amongst the first ones." It is said that Um Haram sailed over the sea at the time of Muawiya, and on coming out of the sea, she fell down from her riding animal and died
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ لِبْسَتَيْنِ، وَعَنْ بَيْعَتَيْنِ اشْتِمَالِ الصَّمَّاءِ، وَالاِحْتِبَاءِ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ، لَيْسَ عَلَى فَرْجِ الإِنْسَانِ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ، وَالْمُلاَمَسَةِ، وَالْمُنَابَذَةِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ مَعْمَرٌ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَفْصَةَ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُدَيْلٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ataa'i bni yaziyda alllaythiyyi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh qaala nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an libsatayni, wa'an bay'atayni ashtimaali alssammaa'i, waalaihtibaa'i fiy thawbin waahidin, laysa 'alaa farji aliinsaani minhu shaa'un, waalmulaamasaai, waalmunaabadhaai‏.‏ taaba'ahu ma'marun wamuhammadu bnu aabiy hafsaaa wa'abdu alllahi bnu budaylin 'ani alzzuhriyyi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade two kinds of dresses and two kinds of bargains; Ishtimal As-Samma and Al- Ihtiba in one garment with no part of it covering one's private parts. (The two kinds of bargains were:) Al-Mulamasa and Al-Munabadha
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، عَنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا فِرَاسٌ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، حَدَّثَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ أُمُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، قَالَتْ إِنَّا كُنَّا أَزْوَاجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَهُ جَمِيعًا، لَمْ تُغَادَرْ مِنَّا وَاحِدَةٌ، فَأَقْبَلَتْ فَاطِمَةُ ـ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ ـ تَمْشِي، لاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا تَخْفَى مِشْيَتُهَا مِنْ مِشْيَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا رَآهَا رَحَّبَ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَرْحَبًا بِابْنَتِي ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَجْلَسَهَا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ أَوْ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ، ثُمَّ سَارَّهَا فَبَكَتْ بُكَاءً شَدِيدًا، فَلَمَّا رَأَى حُزْنَهَا سَارَّهَا الثَّانِيَةَ إِذَا هِيَ تَضْحَكُ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا أَنَا مِنْ بَيْنِ نِسَائِهِ خَصَّكِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالسِّرِّ مِنْ بَيْنِنَا، ثُمَّ أَنْتِ تَبْكِينَ، فَلَمَّا قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَأَلْتُهَا عَمَّا سَارَّكِ قَالَتْ مَا كُنْتُ لأُفْشِيَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سِرَّهُ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ قُلْتُ لَهَا عَزَمْتُ عَلَيْكِ بِمَا لِي عَلَيْكِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ لَمَّا أَخْبَرْتِنِي‏.‏ قَالَتْ أَمَّا الآنَ فَنَعَمْ‏.‏ فَأَخْبَرَتْنِي قَالَتْ أَمَّا حِينَ سَارَّنِي فِي الأَمْرِ الأَوَّلِ، فَإِنَّهُ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ كَانَ يُعَارِضُهُ بِالْقُرْآنِ كُلَّ سَنَةٍ مَرَّةً ‏"‏ وَإِنَّهُ قَدْ عَارَضَنِي بِهِ الْعَامَ مَرَّتَيْنِ، وَلاَ أَرَى الأَجَلَ إِلاَّ قَدِ اقْتَرَبَ، فَاتَّقِي اللَّهَ وَاصْبِرِي، فَإِنِّي نِعْمَ السَّلَفُ أَنَا لَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَبَكَيْتُ بُكَائِي الَّذِي رَأَيْتِ، فَلَمَّا رَأَى جَزَعِي سَارَّنِي الثَّانِيَةَ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا فَاطِمَةُ أَلاَ تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ تَكُونِي سَيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ـ أَوْ ـ سَيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ هَذِهِ الأُمَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, 'an aabiy 'awaanaaa, haddathanaa firaasun, 'an 'aamirin, 'an masruwqin, haddathatniy 'aaiishaau aummu almuuminiyna, qaalat iinnaa kunnaa aazwaaja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'indahu jamiy'ana, lam tughaadar minnaa waahidaaun, faaaqbalat faatimaau 'alayhaa alssalaamu tamshiy, laa waalllahi maa takhfaa mishyatuhaa min mishyaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa raahaa rahhaba qaala ‏"‏ marhabana biabnatiy ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma aajlasahaa 'an yamiynihi aaw 'an shimaalihi, thumma saarrahaa fabakat bukaa'an shadiydana, falammaa raaaa huznahaa saarrahaa althhaaniyaaa iidhaa hiya tadhaku‏.‏ faqultu lahaa aanaa min bayni nisaaiihi khassaki rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialssirri min bayninaa, thumma aanti tabkiyna, falammaa qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm saaaltuhaa 'ammaa saarraki qaalat maa kuntu laufshiya 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sirrahu‏.‏ falammaa tuwuffiya qultu lahaa 'azamtu 'alayki bimaa liy 'alayki mina alhaqqi lammaa aakhbartiniy‏.‏ qaalat aammaa alana fana'am‏.‏ faaakhbaratniy qaalat aammaa hiyna saarraniy fiy alaamri alaawwali, faiinnahu aakhbaraniy aanna jibriyla kaana yu'aariduhu bialqurani kulla sanaain marraaan ‏"‏ waiinnahu qad 'aaradaniy bihi al'aama marratayni, walaa aaraa alaajala iilaaa qadi aqtaraba, faattaqiy alllaha waasbiriy, faiinniy ni'ma alssalafu aanaa laka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat fabakaytu bukaaiiy alladhiy raaayti, falammaa raaaa jaza'iy saarraniy althhaaniyaaa qaala ‏"‏ yaa faatimaau aalaa tardayna aan takuwniy sayyidaaa nisaa'i almuuminiyna aaw sayyidaaa nisaa'i hadhihi alaummaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Mother of the Believers: We, the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) were all sitting with the Prophet (ﷺ) and none of us had left when Fatima came walking, and by Allah, her gait was very similar to that of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) .' When he saw her, he welcomed her, saying, "Welcome, O my daughter!" Then he made her sit on his right or his left, confided something to her, whereupon she wept bitterly. When he noticed her sorrow, he confided something else to her for the second time, and she started laughing. Only I from among the Prophet's wives said to her, "(O Fatima), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) selected you from among us for the secret talk and still you weep?" When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up (and went away), I asked her, "What did he confide to you?" She said, "I wouldn't disclose the secrets of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)" But when he died I asked her, "I beseech you earnestly by what right I have on you, to tell me (that secret talk which the Prophet had with you)" She said, "As you ask me now, yes, (I will tell you)." She informed me, saying, "When he talked to me secretly the first time, he said that Gabriel used to review the Qur'an with him once every year. He added, 'But this year he reviewed it with me twice, and therefore I think that my time of death has approached. So, be afraid of Allah, and be patient, for I am the best predecessor for you (in the Hereafter).' " Fatima added, "So I wept as you (`Aisha) witnessed. And when the Prophet (ﷺ) saw me in this sorrowful state, he confided the second secret to me saying, 'O Fatima! Will you not be pleased that you will be chief of all the believing women (or chief of the women of this nation i.e. my followers?)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبَّادُ بْنُ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَسْجِدِ مُسْتَلْقِيًا، وَاضِعًا إِحْدَى رِجْلَيْهِ عَلَى الأُخْرَى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, qaala aakhbaraniy 'abbaadu bnu tamiymin, 'an 'ammihi, qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy almasjidi mustalqiyana, waadi'ana iihdaa rijlayhi 'alaa alaukhraa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated the uncle of `Abbas bin Tamim:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lying on his back in the mosque and putting one of his legs over the other
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ،‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، رضى الله عنه أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا كَانُوا ثَلاَثَةٌ فَلاَ يَتَنَاجَى اثْنَانِ دُونَ الثَّالِثِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, ‏.‏ wahaddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi, rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa kaanuwa thalaathaaun falaa yatanaajaa athnaani duwna althhaalithi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:the Prophet (ﷺ) said "When three persons are together, then no two of them should hold secret counsel excluding the third person
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَبَّاحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، أَسَرَّ إِلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سِرًّا فَمَا أَخْبَرْتُ بِهِ أَحَدًا بَعْدَهُ، وَلَقَدْ سَأَلَتْنِي أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ فَمَا أَخْبَرْتُهَا بِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu sabbaahin, haddathanaa mu'tamiru bnu sulaymaana, qaala sami'tu aabiy qaala, sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, aasarra iilaaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm sirrana famaa aakhbartu bihi aahadana ba'dahu, walaqad saaalatniy aummu sulaymin famaa aakhbartuhaa bihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) confided to me a secret which I did not disclose to anybody after him. And Um Sulaim asked me (about that secret) but I did not tell her
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏إِذَا كُنْتُمْ ثَلاَثَةً فَلاَ يَتَنَاجَى رَجُلاَنِ دُونَ الآخَرِ، حَتَّى تَخْتَلِطُوا بِالنَّاسِ، أَجْلَ أَنْ يُحْزِنَهُ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏{‏iidhaa kuntum thalaathaaan falaa yatanaajaa rajulaani duwna alakhari, hattaa takhtalituwa bialnnaasi, aajla aan yuhzinahu‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When you are three persons sitting together, then no two of you should hold secret counsel excluding the third person until you are with some other people too, for that would grieve him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَسَمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا قِسْمَةً فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ إِنَّ هَذِهِ لَقِسْمَةٌ مَا أُرِيدَ بِهَا وَجْهُ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لآتِيَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَيْتُهُ وَهْوَ فِي مَلأٍ، فَسَارَرْتُهُ فَغَضِبَ حَتَّى احْمَرَّ وَجْهُهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى مُوسَى، أُوذِيَ بِأَكْثَرَ مِنْ هَذَا فَصَبَرَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, 'an aabiy hamzaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala qasama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmana qismaaan faqaala rajulun mina alaansaari iinna hadhihi laqismaaun maa auriyda bihaa wajhu alllahi‏.‏ qultu aamaa waalllahi latiyanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faaataytuhu wahwa fiy malain, fasaarartuhu faghadiba hattaa ahmarra wajhuhu, thumma qaala ‏ "‏ rahmaau alllahi 'alaa muwsaa, auwdhiya biaakthara min hadhaa fasabara ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:One day the Prophet (ﷺ) divided and distributed something amongst the people whereupon an Ansari man said, "In this division Allah's Countenance has not been sought." I said, "By Allah! I will go (and inform) the Prophet." So I went to him while he was with a group of people, and I secretly informed him of that, whereupon he became so angry that his face became red, and he then said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on Moses (for) he was hurt more than that, yet he remained patient
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَس ٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ وَرَجُلٌ يُنَاجِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَا زَالَ يُنَاجِيهِ حَتَّى نَامَ أَصْحَابُهُ، ثُمَّ قَامَ فَصَلَّى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi, 'an aanas in rda allh 'nh qaala auqiymati alssalaaau warajulun yunaajiy rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm famaa zaala yunaajiyhi hattaa naama aashaabuhu, thumma qaama fasallaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Iqama for the prayer was announced while a man was talking to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) privately. He continued talking in that way till the Prophet's companions slept, and afterwards the Prophet (ﷺ) got up and offered the prayer with them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏{‏لاَ تَتْرُكُوا النَّارَ فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ حِينَ تَنَامُونَ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏{‏laa tatrukuwa alnnaara fiy buyuwtikum hiyna tanaamuwna‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salim's father:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not keep the fire burning in your houses when you go to bed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ احْتَرَقَ بَيْتٌ بِالْمَدِينَةِ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ، فَحُدِّثَ بِشَأْنِهِمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ هَذِهِ النَّارَ إِنَّمَا هِيَ عَدُوٌّ لَكُمْ، فَإِذَا نِمْتُمْ فَأَطْفِئُوهَا عَنْكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa rda allh 'nh qaala ahtaraqa baytun bialmadiynaai 'alaa aahlihi mina alllayli, fahudditha bishaanihimu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna hadhihi alnnaara iinnamaa hiya 'aduwwun lakum, faiidhaa nimtum faaatfiiuwhaa 'ankum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:One night a house in Medina was burnt with its occupants. The Prophet (ﷺ) spoke about them, saying, "This fire is indeed your enemy, so whenever you go to bed, put it out to protect yourselves
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ خَمِّرُوا الآنِيَةَ وَأَجِيفُوا الأَبْوَابَ، وَأَطْفِئُوا الْمَصَابِيحَ، فَإِنَّ الْفُوَيْسِقَةَ رُبَّمَا جَرَّتِ الْفَتِيلَةَ فَأَحْرَقَتْ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an kathiyrin, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ khammiruwa alaniyaaa waaajiyfuwa alaabwaaba, waaatfiiuwa almasaabiyha, faiinna alfuwaysiqaaa rubbamaa jarrati alfatiylaaa faaahraqat aahla albayti ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(At bedtime) cover the utensils, close the doors, and put out the lights, lest the evil creature (the rat) should pull away the wick and thus burn the people of the house
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَّانُ بْنُ أَبِي عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَطْفِئُوا الْمَصَابِيحَ بِاللَّيْلِ إِذَا رَقَدْتُمْ، وَغَلِّقُوا الأَبْوَابَ، وَأَوْكُوا الأَسْقِيَةَ، وَخَمِّرُوا الطَّعَامَ وَالشَّرَابَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ـ قَالَ هَمَّامٌ وَأَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ ـ ‏"‏وَلَوْ بِعُودٍ يَعْرُضُهُ
verses.translit: hadaathanaa hasaaanu bnu aabiy 'abaaadin, hadaathanaa hamaaamun, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aatfiiuwa almasaabiyha biallaayli iidhaa raqadtum, waghaliiquwa alaabwaaba, waaawkuwa alaasqiyaaa, wakhamiiruwa altaa'aama waalshaaraaba ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala hamaaamun waaahsibuhu qaala ‏"‏walaw bi'uwdin ya'ruduhu
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:Allah's Apostle said, "When you intend going to bed at night, put out the lights, close the doors, tie the mouths of the water skins, and cover your food and drinks." Hamrnam said, "I think he (the other narrator) added, 'even with piece of wood across the utensil
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قُزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْفِطْرَةُ خَمْسٌ الْخِتَانُ، وَالاِسْتِحْدَادُ، وَنَتْفُ الإِبْطِ، وَقَصُّ الشَّارِبِ، وَتَقْلِيمُ الأَظْفَارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu quza'aaa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alfitraau khamsun alkhitaanu, waalaistihdaadu, wanatfu aliibti, waqassu alshhaaribi, wataqliymu alaazfaari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said "Five things are in accordance with Al Fitra (i.e. the tradition of prophets): to be circumcised, to shave the pelvic region, to pull out the hair of the armpits, to cut short the moustaches, and to clip the nails
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ اخْتَتَنَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بَعْدَ ثَمَانِينَ سَنَةً، وَاخْتَتَنَ بِالْقَدُومِ ‏"‏‏.‏ مُخَفَّفَةً‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏بِالْقَدُّومِ"‏‏ وَهُوَ مَوْضِعٌ مُشَدَّدٌ
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybu bnu aabiy hamzaaa, hadaathanaa aabuw alziinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanaa rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ akhtatana iibraahiymu ba'da thamaaniyna sanaaan, waakhtatana bialqaduwmi ‏"‏‏.‏ mukhafaafaaan‏.‏ hadaathanaa qutaybaau hadaathanaa almughiyraau 'an aabiy alziinaadi waqaala ‏"‏bialqaduuwmi"‏‏ wahuwa mawdi'un mushadaadun
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "The Prophet) Abraham circumcised himself after he had passed the age of eighty years and he circumcised himself with an adze
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ سُئِلَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ مِثْلُ مَنْ أَنْتَ حِينَ قُبِضَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أَنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ مَخْتُونٌ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانُوا لاَ يَخْتِنُونَ الرَّجُلَ حَتَّى يُدْرِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahiymi, aakhbaranaa 'abbaadu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an iisraaiiyla, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala suiila abnu 'abbaasin mithlu man aanta hiyna qubida alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala aanaa yawmaiidhin makhtuwnun‏.‏ qaala wakaanuwa laa yakhtinuwna alrrajula hattaa yudrika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Said bin Jubair:Ibn 'Abbas was asked, "How old were you when the Prophet (ﷺ) died?" He replied. "At that time I had been circumcised." At that time, people did not circumcise the boys till they attained the age of puberty. Sa'id bin Jubair said, "Ibn 'Abbas said, 'When the Prophet died, I had already been circumcised
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قُبِضَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا خَتِينٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala abnu iidriysa 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qubida alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa khatiynun‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id ibn Jubair said, "Ibn 'Abbas said, 'When the Prophet (ﷺ) died, I had already been circumcised
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ حَلَفَ مِنْكُمْ فَقَالَ فِي حَلِفِهِ بِاللاَّتِ وَالْعُزَّى‏.‏ فَلْيَقُلْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ وَمَنْ قَالَ لِصَاحِبِهِ تَعَالَ أُقَامِرْكَ‏.‏ فَلْيَتَصَدَّقْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy humaydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man halafa minkum faqaala fiy halifihi biallaaati waal'uzzaa‏.‏ falyaqul laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu‏.‏ waman qaala lisaahibihi ta'aala auqaamirka‏.‏ falyatasaddaq ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever among you takes an oath wherein he says, 'By Al-Lat and Al-`Uzza,' names of two Idols worshipped by the Pagans, he should say, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah; And whoever says to his friend, 'Come, let me gamble with you ! He should give something in charity. " (See Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ ـ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ رَأَيْتُنِي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَنَيْتُ بِيَدِي بَيْتًا، يُكِنُّنِي مِنَ الْمَطَرِ، وَيُظِلُّنِي مِنَ الشَّمْسِ، مَا أَعَانَنِي عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa iishaaqu huwa abnu sa'iydin 'an sa'iydin, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala raaaytuniy ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm banaytu biyadiy baytana, yukinnuniy mina almatari, wayuzilluniy mina alshhamsi, maa aa'aananiy 'alayhi aahadun min khalqi alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:During the life-time of the Prophet (ﷺ) I built a house with my own hands so that it might protect me from the rain and shade me from the sun; and none of Allah's creatures assisted me in building it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ عَمْرٌو قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَاللَّهِ مَا وَضَعْتُ لَبِنَةً عَلَى لَبِنَةٍ، وَلاَ غَرَسْتُ نَخْلَةً، مُنْذُ قُبِضَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ فَذَكَرْتُهُ لِبَعْضِ أَهْلِهِ قَالَ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ بَنَى بَيْتًا‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ قُلْتُ فَلَعَلَّهُ قَالَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَبْنِيَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala 'amrunw qaala abnu 'umara waalllahi maa wada'tu labinaaan 'alaa labinaain, walaa gharastu nakhlaaan, mundhu qubida alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu fadhakartuhu liba'di aahlihi qaala waalllahi laqad banaa baytana‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu qultu fala'allahu qaala qabla aan yabniya‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amr:Ibn `Umar said, "By Allah, I have not put a brick over a brick (i.e. constructed a building) or planted any date-palm tree since the death of the Prophet." Sufyan (the sub narrator) said, "I told this narration (of Ibn `Umar) to one of his (Ibn `Umar's) relatives, and he said, 'By Allah, he did build (something.' "Sufyan added, "I said, 'He must have said (the above narration) before he built
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ دَعْوَةٌ مُسْتَجَابَةٌ يَدْعُو بِهَا، وَأُرِيدُ أَنْ أَخْتَبِئَ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لأُمَّتِي فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ likulli nabiyyin da'waaun mustajaabaaun yad'uw bihaa, waauriydu aan aakhtabiia da'watiy shafaa'aaan laummatiy fiy alakhiraai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "For every prophet there is one (special invocation (that will not be rejected) with which he appeals (to Allah), and I want to keep such an invocation for interceding for my followers in the Hereafter
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ لِي خَلِيفَةُ قَالَ مُعْتَمِرٌ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ كُلُّ نَبِيٍّ سَأَلَ سُؤْلاً ـ أَوْ قَالَ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ دَعْوَةٌ قَدْ دَعَا بِهَا ـ فَاسْتُجِيبَ، فَجَعَلْتُ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لأُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala liy khaliyfaau qaala mu'tamirun sami'tu aabiy, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ kullu nabiyyin saaala suulaan aaw qaala likulli nabiyyin da'waaun qad da'aa bihaa faastujiyba, faja'altu da'watiy shafaa'aaan laummatiy yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas: that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "For every prophet there is an invocation that surely will be responded by Allah," (or said), "For every prophet there was an invocation with which he appealed to Allah, and his invocation was accepted (in his lifetime), but I kept my (this special) invocation to intercede for my followers on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ الْعَدَوِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي شَدَّادُ بْنُ أَوْسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سَيِّدُ الاِسْتِغْفَارِ أَنْ تَقُولَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَىَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ النَّهَارِ مُوقِنًا بِهَا، فَمَاتَ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُمْسِيَ، فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَمَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَهْوَ مُوقِنٌ بِهَا، فَمَاتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصْبِحَ، فَهْوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw ma'marin, hadaathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, hadaathanaa alhusaynu, hadaathanaa 'abdu allaahi bnu buraydaaa, 'an bushayri bni ka'bin al'adawiyii, qaala hadaathaniy shadaaadu bnu aawsin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ sayiidu alaistighfaari aan taquwla allaahumaa aanta rabiiy, laa iilaha iilaaa aanta, khalaqtaniy waaanaa 'abduka, waaanaa 'alaa 'ahdika wawa'dika maa astata'tu, aa'uwdhu bika min sharii maa sana'tu, aabuw'u laka bini'matika 'alaaaa waaabuw'u laka bidhanbiy, faaghfir liy, faiinaahu laa yaghfiru aldhuunuwba iilaaa aanta ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ waman qaalahaa mina alnaahaari muwqinana bihaa, famaata min yawmihi qabla aan yumsiya, fahuwa min aahli aljanaaai, waman qaalahaa mina allaayli wahwa muwqinun bihaa, famaata qabla aan yusbiha, fahwa min aahli aljanaaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Shaddad bin Aus:The Prophet (ﷺ) said "The most superior way of asking for forgiveness from Allah is: 'Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta, Khalaqtani wa ana `Abduka, wa ana `ala `ahdika wa wa`dika mastata`tu, A`udhu bika min Sharri ma sana`tu, abu'u Laka bini`matika `alaiya, wa abu'u laka bidhanbi faghfir lee fa innahu la yaghfiru adhdhunuba illa anta." The Prophet (ﷺ) added. "If somebody recites it during the day with firm faith in it, and dies on the same day before the evening, he will be from the people of Paradise; and if somebody recites it at night with firm faith in it, and dies before the morning, he will be from the people of Paradise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala qaala aabuw hurayraaa sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ waalllahi iinniy laastaghfiru alllaha waaatuwbu iilayhi fiy alyawmi aakthara min sab'iyna marraaan ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying." By Allah! I ask for forgiveness from Allah and turn to Him in repentance more than seventy times a day
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدِيثَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالآخَرُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ، قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ يَرَى ذُنُوبَهُ كَأَنَّهُ قَاعِدٌ تَحْتَ جَبَلٍ يَخَافُ أَنْ يَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ، وَإِنَّ الْفَاجِرَ يَرَى ذُنُوبَهُ كَذُبَابٍ مَرَّ عَلَى أَنْفِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ بِهِ هَكَذَا قَالَ أَبُو شِهَابٍ بِيَدِهِ فَوْقَ أَنْفِهِ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَلَّهُ أَفْرَحُ بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ مِنْ رَجُلٍ نَزَلَ مَنْزِلاً، وَبِهِ مَهْلَكَةٌ، وَمَعَهُ رَاحِلَتُهُ عَلَيْهَا طَعَامُهُ وَشَرَابُهُ، فَوَضَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَنَامَ نَوْمَةً، فَاسْتَيْقَظَ وَقَدْ ذَهَبَتْ رَاحِلَتُهُ، حَتَّى اشْتَدَّ عَلَيْهِ الْحَرُّ وَالْعَطَشُ أَوْ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، قَالَ أَرْجِعُ إِلَى مَكَانِي‏.‏ فَرَجَعَ فَنَامَ نَوْمَةً، ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ، فَإِذَا رَاحِلَتُهُ عِنْدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ أَبُو عَوَانَةَ وَجَرِيرٌ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو أُسَامَةَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ سَمِعْتُ الْحَارِثَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَأَبُو مُسْلِمٍ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَعَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa aabuw shihaabin, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'umaaraaa bni 'umayrin, 'ani alhaarithi bni suwaydin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi, hadiythayni aahaduhumaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalakharu 'an nafsihi, qaala ‏"‏ iinna almuumina yaraa dhunuwbahu kaaannahu qaa'idun tahta jabalin yakhaafu aan yaqa'a 'alayhi, waiinna alfaajira yaraa dhunuwbahu kadhubaabin marra 'alaa aanfihi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala bihi hakadhaa qaala aabuw shihaabin biyadihi fawqa aanfihi‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ lallahu aafrahu bitawbaai 'abdihi min rajulin nazala manzilaan, wabihi mahlakaaun, wama'ahu raahilatuhu 'alayhaa ta'aamuhu washaraabuhu, fawada'a raasahu fanaama nawmaaan, faastayqaza waqad dhahabat raahilatuhu, hattaa ashtadda 'alayhi alharru waal'atashu aaw maa shaa'a alllahu, qaala aarji'u iilaa makaaniy‏.‏ faraja'a fanaama nawmaaan, thumma rafa'a raasahu, faiidhaa raahilatuhu 'indahu ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu aabuw 'awaanaaa wajariyrun 'ani alaa'mashi‏.‏ waqaala aabuw ausaamaaa haddathanaa alaa'mashu haddathanaa 'umaaraau sami'tu alhaaritha‏.‏ waqaala shu'baau waaabuw muslimin 'ani alaa'mashi 'an iibraahiyma alttaymiyyi 'ani alhaarithi bni suwaydin‏.‏ waqaala aabuw mu'aawiyaaa haddathanaa alaa'mashu 'an 'umaaraaa 'ani alaaswadi 'an 'abdi alllahi wa'an iibraahiyma alttaymiyyi 'ani alhaarithi bni suwaydin 'an 'abdi alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Harith bin Suwaid:`Abdullah bin Mas`ud related to us two narrations: One from the Prophet (ﷺ) and the other from himself, saying: A believer sees his sins as if he were sitting under a mountain which, he is afraid, may fall on him; whereas the wicked person considers his sins as flies passing over his nose and he just drives them away like this." Abu Shihab (the sub-narrator) moved his hand over his nose in illustration. (Ibn Mas`ud added): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His slave than a man who encamps at a place where his life is jeopardized, but he has his riding beast carrying his food and water. He then rests his head and sleeps for a short while and wakes to find his riding beast gone. (He starts looking for it) and suffers from severe heat and thirst or what Allah wished (him to suffer from). He then says, 'I will go back to my place.' He returns and sleeps again, and then (getting up), he raises his head to find his riding beast standing beside him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَبَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُ أَفْرَحُ بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ مِنْ أَحَدِكُمْ سَقَطَ عَلَى بَعِيرِهِ، وَقَدْ أَضَلَّهُ فِي أَرْضِ فَلاَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa habbaanu, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ wahaddathanaa hudbaau, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alllahu aafrahu bitawbaai 'abdihi min aahadikum saqata 'alaa ba'iyrihi, waqad aadallahu fiy aardi falaaain ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His slave than anyone of you is pleased with finding his camel which he had lost in the desert
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي مِنَ اللَّيْلِ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً، فَإِذَا طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ عَلَى شِقِّهِ الأَيْمَنِ، حَتَّى يَجِيءَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فَيُؤْذِنَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy mina alllayli iihdaa 'ashraaa rak'aaan, faiidhaa tala'a alfajru sallaa rak'atayni khafiyfatayni, thumma adtaja'a 'alaa shiqqihi alaaymani, hattaa yajiy'a almuuadhhinu fayuudhinahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray eleven rak`at in the late part of the night, and when dawn appeared, he would offer two rak`at and then lie on his right side till the Muadhdhin came to inform him (that the morning prayer was due)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَنْصُورًا، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْبَرَاءُ بْنُ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا أَتَيْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ فَتَوَضَّأْ وَضُوءَكَ لِلصَّلاَةِ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجِعْ عَلَى شِقِّكَ الأَيْمَنِ، وَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ‏.‏ فَإِنْ مُتَّ مُتَّ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ، فَاجْعَلْهُنَّ آخِرَ مَا تَقُولُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَسْتَذْكِرُهُنَّ وَبِرَسُولِكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, qaala sami'tu mansuwrana, 'an sa'di bni 'ubaydaaa, qaala haddathaniy albaraa'u bnu 'aazibin rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iidhaa aatayta madja'aka fatawaddaa waduw'aka lilssalaaai, thumma adtaji' 'alaa shiqqika alaaymani, waquli alllahumma aaslamtu wajhiy iilayka, wafawwadtu aamriy iilayka, waaaljaatu zahriy iilayka, raghbaaan warahbaaan iilayka, laa maljaaa walaa manjaa minka iilaaa iilayka, amantu bikitaabika alladhiy aanzalta, wabinabiyyika alladhiy aarsalta‏.‏ faiin mutta mutta 'alaa alfitraai, faaj'alhunna akhira maa taquwlu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu aastadhkiruhunna wabirasuwlika alladhiy aarsalta‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laa, wabinabiyyika alladhiy aarsalta ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara bin `Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "When you want to go to bed, perform ablution as you do for prayer, then lie down on your right side and say: 'Allahumma aslamtu wajhi ilaika, wa fawwadtu 'amri ilaika wa alja'tu dhahri ilaika, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika, la malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Amantu bikitabik al-ladhi anzalta wa binabiyyika al-ladhi arsalta'. If you should die then (after reciting this) you will die on the religion of Islam (i.e., as a Muslim); so let these words be the last you say (before going to bed)" While I was memorizing it, I said, "Wa birasulika al-ladhi arsalta (in Your Apostle whom You have sent).' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No, but say: Wa binabiyyika al-ladhi arsalta (in Your Prophet whom You have sent)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَإِذَا قَامَ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ ‏"‏‏.‏ تُنْشِرُهَا: تُخْرِجُهَا
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi almaliki, 'an rib'iyyi bni hiraashin, 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aawaa iilaa firaashihi qaala ‏"‏ biasmika aamuwtu waaahyaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waiidhaa qaama qaala ‏"‏ alhamdu lillahi alladhiy aahyaanaa ba'da maa aamaatanaa waiilayhi alnnushuwru ‏"‏‏.‏ tunshiruhaa: tukhrijuhaa
verses.translation: Narrated Hudhaifa:When the Prophet (ﷺ) went to bed, he would say: "Bismika amutu wa ahya." and when he got up he would say:" Al-hamdu li l-lahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilaihin-nushur
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، سَمِعَ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ رَجُلاً‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْصَى رَجُلاً فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَرَدْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ فَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ‏.‏ فَإِنْ مُتَّ مُتَّ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu alrrabiy'i, wamuhammadu bnu 'ar'araaa, qaalaa haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, sami'a albaraa'a bna 'aazibin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aamara rajulaan‏.‏ wahaddathanaa adamu haddathanaa shu'baau haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa alhamdaaniyyu 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aawsaa rajulaan faqaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa aaradta madja'aka faquli alllahumma aaslamtu nafsiy iilayka, wafawwadtu aamriy iilayka, wawajjahtu wajhiy iilayka, waaaljaatu zahriy iilayka, raghbaaan warahbaaan iilayka, laa maljaaa walaa manjaa minka iilaaa iilayka, amantu bikitaabika alladhiy aanzalta, wabinabiyyika alladhiy aarsalta‏.‏ faiin mutta mutta 'alaa alfitraai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara bin `Azib:That the Prophet (ﷺ) advised a man, saying, "If you intend to lie down (i.e. go to bed), say, 'Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilaika wa fauwadtu `Amri ilaika, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilaika wa alja'tu zahri ilaika, reghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika. La malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Amantu bikitabikal-ladhi anzalta; wa nabiyyikalladhi arsalta.' And if you should die then (after reciting this before going to bed) you will die on the religion of Islam
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ رِبْعِيٍّ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ تَحْتَ خَدِّهِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَإِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an 'abdi almaliki, 'an rib'iyyin, 'an hudhayfaaa rda allh 'nh qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aakhadha madja'ahu mina alllayli wada'a yadahu tahta khaddihi thumma yaquwlu ‏"‏ alllahumma biasmika aamuwtu waaahyaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waiidhaa astayqaza qaala ‏"‏ alhamdu lillahi alladhiy aahyaanaa ba'da maa aamaatanaa waiilayhi alnnushuwru ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hudhaifa:When the Prophet (ﷺ) went to bed at night, he would put his hand under his cheek and then say, "Allahumma bismika amutu wa ahya," and when he got up, he would say, "Al-Hamdu lil-lahi al-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana, wa ilaihi an-nushur
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْعَلاَءُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ نَامَ عَلَى شِقِّهِ الأَيْمَنِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ قَالَهُنَّ ثُمَّ مَاتَ تَحْتَ لَيْلَتِهِ مَاتَ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ‏{‏اسْتَرْهَبُوهُمْ‏}‏ مِنَ الرَّهْبَةِ، مَلَكُوتٌ مُلْكٌ مَثَلُ رَهَبُوتٌ خَيْرٌ مِنْ رَحَمُوتٍ، تَقُولُ تَرْهَبُ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَرْحَمَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi bnu ziyaadin, haddathanaa al'alaa'u bnu almusayyabi, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aawaa iilaa firaashihi naama 'alaa shiqqihi alaaymani thumma qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma aaslamtu nafsiy iilayka, wawajjahtu wajhiy iilayka, wafawwadtu aamriy iilayka, waaaljaatu zahriy iilayka, raghbaaan warahbaaan iilayka, laa maljaaa walaa manjaa minka iilaaa iilayka, amantu bikitaabika alladhiy aanzalta, wanabiyyika alladhiy aarsalta‏.‏ waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man qaalahunna thumma maata tahta laylatihi maata 'alaa alfitraai ‏"‏‏.‏ ‏{‏astarhabuwhum‏}‏ mina alrrahbaai, malakuwtun mulkun mathalu rahabuwtun khayrun min rahamuwtin, taquwlu tarhabu khayrun min aan tarhama‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to bed, he used to sleep on his right side and then say, "All-ahumma aslamtu nafsi ilaika, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilaika, wa fauwadtu `Amri ilaika, wa alja'tu zahri ilaika, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika. La Malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Amantu bikitabika al-ladhi anzalta wa nabiyyika al-ladhi arsalta! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever recites these words (before going to bed) and dies the same night, he will die on the Islamic religion (as a Muslim)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بِتُّ عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَى حَاجَتَهُ، غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ نَامَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ فَأَتَى الْقِرْبَةَ فَأَطْلَقَ شِنَاقَهَا، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءًا بَيْنَ وُضُوءَيْنِ لَمْ يُكْثِرْ، وَقَدْ أَبْلَغَ، فَصَلَّى، فَقُمْتُ فَتَمَطَّيْتُ كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ يَرَى أَنِّي كُنْتُ أَتَّقِيهِ، فَتَوَضَّأْتُ، فَقَامَ يُصَلِّي، فَقُمْتُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ، فَأَخَذَ بِأُذُنِي فَأَدَارَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، فَتَتَامَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ فَنَامَ حَتَّى نَفَخَ ـ وَكَانَ إِذَا نَامَ نَفَخَ ـ فَآذَنَهُ بِلاَلٌ بِالصَّلاَةِ، فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ، وَكَانَ يَقُولُ فِي دُعَائِهِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَسَارِي نُورًا، وَفَوْقِي نُورًا، وَتَحْتِي نُورًا، وَأَمَامِي نُورًا، وَخَلْفِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ كُرَيْبٌ وَسَبْعٌ فِي التَّابُوتِ‏.‏ فَلَقِيتُ رَجُلاً مِنْ وَلَدِ الْعَبَّاسِ فَحَدَّثَنِي بِهِنَّ، فَذَكَرَ عَصَبِي وَلَحْمِي وَدَمِي وَشَعَرِي وَبَشَرِي، وَذَكَرَ خَصْلَتَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa abnu mahdiyyin, 'an sufyaana, 'an salamaaa, 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala bittu 'inda maymuwnaaa faqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faaataa haajatahu, ghasala wajhahu wayadayhi, thumma naama, thumma qaama faaataa alqirbaaa faaatlaqa shinaaqahaa, thumma tawaddaaa wuduw'ana bayna wuduw'ayni lam yukthir, waqad aablagha, fasallaa, faqumtu fatamattaytu karaahiyaaa aan yaraa aanniy kuntu aattaqiyhi, fatawaddaatu, faqaama yusalliy, faqumtu 'an yasaarihi, faaakhadha biaudhuniy faaadaaraniy 'an yamiynihi, fatataammat salaatuhu thalaatha 'ashraaa rak'aaan thumma adtaja'a fanaama hattaa nafakha wakaana iidhaa naama nafakha faadhanahu bilaalun bialssalaaai, fasallaa walam yatawaddaa, wakaana yaquwlu fiy du'aaiihi ‏ "‏ alllahumma aj'al fiy qalbiy nuwrana, wafiy basariy nuwrana, wafiy sam'iy nuwrana, wa'an yamiyniy nuwrana, wa'an yasaariy nuwrana, wafawqiy nuwrana, watahtiy nuwrana, waaamaamiy nuwrana, wakhalfiy nuwrana, waaj'al liy nuwrana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala kuraybun wasab'un fiy alttaabuwti‏.‏ falaqiytu rajulaan min waladi al'abbaasi fahaddathaniy bihinna, fadhakara 'asabiy walahmiy wadamiy washa'ariy wabashariy, wadhakara khaslatayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:One night I slept at the house of Maimuna. The Prophet (ﷺ) woke up, answered the call of nature, washed his face and hands, and then slept. He got up (late at night), went to a water skin, opened the mouth thereof and performed ablution not using much water, yet he washed all the parts properly and then offered the prayer. I got up and straightened my back in order that the Prophet (ﷺ) might not feel that I was watching him, and then I performed the ablution, and when he got up to offer the prayer, I stood on his left. He caught hold of my ear and brought me over to his right side. He offered thirteen rak`at in all and then lay down and slept till he started blowing out his breath as he used to do when he slept. In the meantime Bilal informed the Prophet (ﷺ) of the approaching time for the (Fajr) prayer, and the Prophet offered the Fajr (Morning) prayer without performing new ablution. He used to say in his invocation, Allahumma ij`al fi qalbi nuran wa fi basari nuran, wa fi sam`i nuran, wa`an yamini nuran, wa`an yasari nuran, wa fawqi nuran, wa tahti nuran, wa amami nuran, wa khalfi nuran, waj`al li nuran." Kuraib (a sub narrator) said, "I have forgotten seven other words, (which the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned in this invocation). I met a man from the offspring of Al-`Abbas and he narrated those seven things to me, mentioning, '(Let there be light in) my nerves, my flesh, my blood, my hair and my body,' and he also mentioned two other things
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، سَمِعْتُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ يَتَهَجَّدُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، أَنْتَ الْحَقُّ وَوَعْدُكَ حَقٌّ، وَقَوْلُكَ حَقٌّ، وَلِقَاؤُكَ حَقٌّ، وَالْجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ، وَالسَّاعَةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، وَمُحَمَّدٌ حَقٌّ، اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ حَاكَمْتُ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ـ أَوْ ـ لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, sami'tu sulaymaana bna aabiy muslimin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa qaama mina alllayli yatahajjadu qaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma laka alhamdu, aanta nuwru alssamawaati waalaardi waman fiyhinna, walaka alhamdu aanta qayyimu alssamawaati waalaardi waman fiyhinna, walaka alhamdu, aanta alhaqqu wawa'duka haqqun, waqawluka haqqun, waliqaauuka haqqun, waaljannaau haqqun, waalnnaaru haqqun, waalssaa'aau haqqun, waalnnabiyyuwna haqqun, wamuhammadun haqqun, alllahumma laka aaslamtu wa'alayka tawakkaltu wabika amantu, waiilayka aanabtu, wabika khaasamtu, waiilayka haakamtu, faaghfir liy maa qaddamtu wamaa aakhhartu, wamaa aasrartu, wamaa aa'lantu, aanta almuqaddimu waaanta almuuakhhiru laa iilaha iilaaa aanta aaw laa iilaha ghayruka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) got up at night to offer the night prayer, he used to say: "Allahumma laka l-hamdu; Anta nuras-samawati wal ardi wa man fihinna. wa laka l-hamdu; Anta qaiyim as-samawati wal ardi wa man flhinna. Wa lakaI-hamdu; Anta-l-,haqqun, wa wa'daka haqqun, wa qauluka haqqun, wa liqauka haqqun, wal-jannatu haqqun, wannaru haqqun, was-sa atu haqqun, wan-nabiyyuna huqqun, Mahammadun haqqun, Allahumma laka aslamtu, wa Alaika tawakkaltu, wa bika amantu, wa ilaika anabtu, wa bika Khasamtu, wa ilaika hakamtu, faghfirli ma qaddamtu wa ma akh-khartu, wa ma asrartu, wa ma a'lantu. Anta al-muqaddimu, wa anta al-mu-'akhkhiru. La ilaha il-la anta (or La ilaha ghairuka)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ ـ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ ـ شَكَتْ مَا تَلْقَى فِي يَدِهَا مِنَ الرَّحَى، فَأَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَسْأَلُهُ خَادِمًا، فَلَمْ تَجِدْهُ، فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لِعَائِشَةَ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَخْبَرَتْهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَاءَنَا وَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مَضَاجِعَنَا، فَذَهَبْتُ أَقُومُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَكَانَكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَلَسَ بَيْنَنَا حَتَّى وَجَدْتُ بَرْدَ قَدَمَيْهِ عَلَى صَدْرِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكُمَا عَلَى مَا هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمَا مِنْ خَادِمٍ، إِذَا أَوَيْتُمَا إِلَى فِرَاشِكُمَا، أَوْ أَخَذْتُمَا مَضَاجِعَكُمَا، فَكَبِّرَا ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، وَسَبِّحَا ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، وَاحْمَدَا ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، فَهَذَا خَيْرٌ لَكُمَا مِنْ خَادِمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَعَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ خَالِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ قَالَ التَّسْبِيحُ أَرْبَعٌ وَثَلاَثُونَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'ani abni aabiy laylaa, 'an 'aliyyin, aanna faatimaaa 'alayhimaa alssalaamu shakat maa talqaa fiy yadihaa mina alrrahaa, faaatati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm tasaaluhu khaadimana, falam tajidhu, fadhakarat dhalika li'aaiishaaa, falammaa jaa'a aakhbarathu‏.‏ qaala fajaa'anaa waqad aakhadhnaa madaaji'anaa, fadhahabtu aaquwmu faqaala ‏"‏ makaanaki ‏"‏‏.‏ fajalasa baynanaa hattaa wajadtu barda qadamayhi 'alaa sadriy faqaala ‏"‏ aalaa aadullukumaa 'alaa maa huwa khayrun lakumaa min khaadimin, iidhaa aawaytumaa iilaa firaashikumaa, aaw aakhadhtumaa madaaji'akumaa, fakabbiraa thalaathana wathalaathiyna, wasabbihaa thalaathana wathalaathiyna, waahmadaa thalaathana wathalaathiyna, fahadhaa khayrun lakumaa min khaadimin ‏"‏‏.‏ wa'an shu'baaa 'an khaalidin 'ani abni siyriyna qaala alttasbiyhu aarba'un wathalaathuwna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:Fatima complained about the blisters on her hand because of using a mill-stone. She went to ask the Prophet for servant, but she did not find him (at home) and had to inform `Aisha of her need. When he came, `Aisha informed him about it. `Ali added: The Prophet (ﷺ) came to us when we had gone to our beds. When I was going to get up, he said, "'Stay in your places," and sat between us, till I felt the coolness of the feet on my chest. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Shall I not tell you of a thing which is better for you than a servant? When you (both) go to your beds, say 'Allahu Akbar' thirty-three times, and 'Subhan Allah' thirty-three times, 'Al hamdu 'illah' thirty-three times, for that is better for you than a servant." Ibn Seereen said, "Subhan Allah' (is to be said for) thirty-four times
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ نَفَثَ فِي يَدَيْهِ، وَقَرَأَ بِالْمُعَوِّذَاتِ، وَمَسَحَ بِهِمَا جَسَدَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylun, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'urwaau, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa aakhadha madja'ahu nafatha fiy yadayhi, waqaraaa bialmu'awwidhaati, wamasaha bihimaa jasadahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to bed, he used to blow on his hands while reciting the Mu'auwidhat ( i.e. Suratal-Falaq 113 and Surat-an-Nas 114) and then pass his hands over his body
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَوَى أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَلْيَنْفُضْ فِرَاشَهُ بِدَاخِلَةِ إِزَارِهِ، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَدْرِي مَا خَلَفَهُ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ أَبُو ضَمْرَةَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ يَحْيَى وَبِشْرٌ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ مَالِكٌ وَابْنُ عَجْلاَنَ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, hadaathanaa zuhayrun, hadaathanaa 'ubaydu allaahi bnu 'umara, hadaathaniy sa'iydu bnu aabiy sa'iydin almaqburiyuu, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa aawaa aahadukum iilaa firaashihi falyanfud firaashahu bidaakhilaai iizaarihi, faiinaahu laa yadriy maa khalafahu 'alayhi, thumaa yaquwlu biasmika rabii wada'tu janbiy, wabika aarfa'uhu, iin aamsakta nafsiy faarhamhaa, waiin aarsaltahaa faahfazhaa bimaa tahfazu bihi 'ibaadaka alsaaalihiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu aabuw damraaa waiismaa'iylu bnu zakariyaaa'a 'an 'ubaydi allaahi‏.‏ waqaala yahyaa wabishrun 'an 'ubaydi allaahi 'an sa'iydin 'an aabiy hurayraaa 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ warawaahu maalikun waabnu 'ajlaana 'an sa'iydin 'an aabiy hurayraaa 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you go to bed, he should shake out his bed with the inside of his waist sheet, for he does not know what has come on to it after him, and then he should say: 'Bismika Rabbi Wada`tu Janbi wa bika arfa'uhu, In amsakta nafsi farhamha wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi ibadakas-salihin
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَغَرِّ، وَأَبِي، سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَتَنَزَّلُ رَبُّنَا تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا حِينَ يَبْقَى ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرُ يَقُولُ مَنْ يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتَجِيبَ لَهُ، مَنْ يَسْأَلُنِي فَأُعْطِيَهُ، وَمَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُنِي فَأَغْفِرَ لَهُ?"‏‏‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi allaahi, hadaathanaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy 'abdi allaahi alaagharii, waaabiy, salamaaa bni 'abdi alraahmani 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanaa rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yatanazaalu rabuunaa tabaaraka wata'aalaa kulaa laylaain iilaa alsaamaa'i alduunyaa hiyna yabqaa thuluthu allaayli alakhiru yaquwlu man yad'uwniy faaastajiyba lahu, man yasaaluniy faau'tiyahu, waman yastaghfiruniy faaaghfira lahu?"‏‏‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When it is the last third of the night, our Lord, the Blessed, the Superior, descends every night to the heaven of the world and says, 'Is there anyone who invokes Me (demand anything from Me), that I may respond to his invocation; Is there anyone who asks Me for something that I may give (it to) him; Is there anyone who asks My forgiveness that I may forgive him?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا دَخَلَ الْخَلاَءَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ar'araaa, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni suhaybin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa dakhala alkhalaa'a qaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika mina alkhubuthi waalkhabaaiithi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went to the lavatory, he used to say: "Allahumma inni a`udhu bika min al-khubuthi wal khaba'ith
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، عَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ سَيِّدُ الاِسْتِغْفَارِ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ‏.‏ إِذَا قَالَ حِينَ يُمْسِي فَمَاتَ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ ـ أَوْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ـ وَإِذَا قَالَ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ فَمَاتَ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa husaynun, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu buraydaaa, 'an bushayri bni ka'bin, 'an shaddaadi bni aawsin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ sayyidu alaistighfaari alllahumma aanta rabbiy laa iilaha iilaaa aanta, khalaqtaniy waaanaa 'abduka, waaanaa 'alaa 'ahdika wawa'dika maa astata'tu, aabuw'u laka bini'matika, waaabuw'u laka bidhanbiy, faaghfir liy, faiinnahu laa yaghfiru aldhhunuwba iilaaa aanta, aa'uwdhu bika min sharri maa sana'tu‏.‏ iidhaa qaala hiyna yumsiy famaata dakhala aljannaaa aaw kaana min aahli aljannaai waiidhaa qaala hiyna yusbihu famaata min yawmihi ‏"‏‏.‏ mithlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Shaddad bin 'Aus:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most superior way of asking for forgiveness from Allah is: 'Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta. Khalaqtani wa ana `Abduka, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa Wa'dika mastata'tu abu'u Laka bi ni 'matika wa abu'u Laka bidhanbi; faghfirli fa'innahu la yaghfiru-dh-dhunuba ill a ant a. A'uidhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu.' If somebody recites this invocation during the night, and if he should die then, he will go to Paradise (or he will be from the people of Paradise). And if he recites it in the morning, and if he should die on the same day, he will have the same fate
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنَامَ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَإِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ مِنْ مَنَامِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an rib'iyyi bni hiraashin, 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aaraada aan yanaama qaala ‏"‏ biasmika alllahumma aamuwtu waaahyaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waiidhaa astayqaza min manaamihi qaala ‏"‏ alhamdu lillahi alladhiy aahyaanaa ba'da maa aamaatanaa, waiilayhi alnnushuwru ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hudhaifa:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to go to bed, he would recite: "Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya (With Your name, O Allah, I die and I live)." And when he woke up from his sleep, he would say: "Al-hamdu lil-lahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana; wa ilaihi an-nushur (All the Praises are for Allah Who has made us alive after He made us die (sleep) and unto Him is the Resurrection
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ، عَنْ خَرَشَةَ بْنِ الْحُرِّ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَإِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, 'an aabiy hamzaaa, 'an mansuwrin, 'an rib'iyyi bni hiraashin, 'an kharashaaa bni alhurri, 'an aabiy dharrin rda allh 'nh qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aakhadha madja'ahu mina alllayli qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma biasmika aamuwtu waaahyaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faiidhaa astayqaza qaala ‏"‏ alhamdu lillahi alladhiy aahyaanaa ba'da maa aamaatanaa waiilayhi alnnushuwru ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Dhar:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) lay on his bed, he used to say: "Allahumma bismika amutu wa ahya," and when he woke up he would say: "Al-hamdu lil-lahilladhi ahyana ba'da ma an atana, wa ilaihi an-nushur
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلِّمْنِي دُعَاءً أَدْعُو بِهِ فِي صَلاَتِي‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا، وَلاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، وَارْحَمْنِي، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَمْرٌو عَنْ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، إِنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy yaziydu, 'an aabiy alkhayri, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, 'an aabiy bakrin alssiddiyqi rda allh 'nh aannahu qaala lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'allimniy du'aa'an aad'uw bihi fiy salaatiy‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ quli alllahumma iinniy zalamtu nafsiy zulmana kathiyrana, walaa yaghfiru aldhhunuwba iilaaa aanta, faaghfir liy maghfiraaan min 'indika, waarhamniy, iinnaka aanta alghafuwru alrrahiymu ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala 'amrunw 'an yaziyda, 'an aabiy alkhayri, iinnahu sami'a 'abda alllahi bna 'amrinw, qaala aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Abu Bakr As-Siddiq said to the Prophet, "Teach me an invocation with which I may invoke (Allah) in my prayer." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Say: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran wala yaghfirudhdhunuba illa anta, Faghfirli maghfiratan min indika war-hamni, innaka antalGhafur-Rahim
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ سُعَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، ‏{‏وَلاَ تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاَتِكَ وَلاَ تُخَافِتْ بِهَا‏}‏ أُنْزِلَتْ فِي الدُّعَاءِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa maaliku bnu su'ayrin, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, ‏{‏walaa tajhar bisalaatika walaa tukhaafit bihaa‏}‏ aunzilat fiy alddu'aa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Verse: 'Neither say your prayer aloud, nor say it in a low tone.' (17.110) was revealed as regards invocation
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
