verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَكْثَرَ مَا أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ مَا يُخْرِجُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ مِنْ بَرَكَاتِ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قِيلَ وَمَا بَرَكَاتُ الأَرْضِ قَالَ ‏"‏ زَهْرَةُ الدُّنْيَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ هَلْ يَأْتِي الْخَيْرُ بِالشَّرِّ فَصَمَتَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ يُنْزَلُ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ جَعَلَ يَمْسَحُ عَنْ جَبِينِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ السَّائِلُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَا‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ لَقَدْ حَمِدْنَاهُ حِينَ طَلَعَ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَأْتِي الْخَيْرُ إِلاَّ بِالْخَيْرِ، إِنَّ هَذَا الْمَالَ خَضِرَةٌ حُلْوَةٌ، وَإِنَّ كُلَّ مَا أَنْبَتَ الرَّبِيعُ يَقْتُلُ حَبَطًا أَوْ يُلِمُّ، إِلاَّ آكِلَةَ الْخَضِرَةِ، أَكَلَتْ حَتَّى إِذَا امْتَدَّتْ خَاصِرَتَاهَا اسْتَقْبَلَتِ الشَّمْسَ، فَاجْتَرَّتْ وَثَلَطَتْ وَبَالَتْ، ثُمَّ عَادَتْ فَأَكَلَتْ، وَإِنَّ هَذَا الْمَالَ حُلْوَةٌ، مَنْ أَخَذَهُ بِحَقِّهِ وَوَضَعَهُ فِي حَقِّهِ، فَنِعْمَ الْمَعُونَةُ هُوَ، وَمَنْ أَخَذَهُ بِغَيْرِ حَقِّهِ، كَانَ الَّذِي يَأْكُلُ وَلاَ يَشْبَعُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna aakthara maa aakhaafu 'alaykum maa yukhriju alllahu lakum min barakaati alaardi ‏"‏‏.‏ qiyla wamaa barakaatu alaardi qaala ‏"‏ zahraau alddunyaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala lahu rajulun hal yaatiy alkhayru bialshharri fasamata alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa zanannaa aannahu yunzalu 'alayhi, thumma ja'ala yamsahu 'an jabiynihi faqaala ‏"‏ aayna alssaaiilu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aanaa‏.‏ qaala aabuw sa'iydin laqad hamidnaahu hiyna tala'a dhalika‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laa yaatiy alkhayru iilaaa bialkhayri, iinna hadhaa almaala khadiraaun hulwaaun, waiinna kulla maa aanbata alrrabiy'u yaqtulu habatana aaw yulimmu, iilaaa akilaaa alkhadiraai, aakalat hattaa iidhaa amtaddat khaasirataahaa astaqbalati alshhamsa, faajtarrat wathalatat wabaalat, thumma 'aadat faaakalat, waiinna hadhaa almaala hulwaaun, man aakhadhahu bihaqqihi wawada'ahu fiy haqqihi, fani'ma alma'uwnaau huwa, waman aakhadhahu bighayri haqqihi, kaana alladhiy yaakulu walaa yashba'u ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The thing I am afraid of most for your sake, is the worldly blessings which Allah will bring forth to you." It was said, "What are the blessings of this world?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The pleasures of the world." A man said, "Can the good bring forth evil?" The Prophet (ﷺ) kept quiet for a while till we thought that he was being inspired divinely. Then he started removing the sweat from his forehead and said," Where is the questioner?" That man said, "I (am present)." Abu Sa`id added: We thanked the man when the result (of his question) was such. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Good never brings forth but good. This wealth (of the world) is (like) green and sweet (fruit), and all the vegetation which grows on the bank of a stream either kills or nearly kills the animal that eats too much of it, except the animal that eats the Khadira (a kind of vegetation). Such an animal eats till its stomach is full and then it faces the sun and starts ruminating and then it passes out dung and urine and goes to eat again. This worldly wealth is (like) sweet (fruit), and if a person earns it (the wealth) in a legal way and spends it properly, then it is an excellent helper, and whoever earns it in an illegal way, he will be like the one who eats but is never satisfied
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَمْرَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي زَهْدَمُ بْنُ مُضَرِّبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عِمْرَانَ بْنَ حُصَيْنٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ خَيْرُكُمْ قَرْنِي، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عِمْرَانُ فَمَا أَدْرِي قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ قَوْلِهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏ ثُمَّ يَكُونُ بَعْدَهُمْ قَوْمٌ يَشْهَدُونَ وَلاَ يُسْتَشْهَدُونَ، وَيَخُونُونَ وَلاَ يُؤْتَمَنُونَ، وَيَنْذِرُونَ وَلاَ يَفُونَ وَيَظْهَرُ فِيهِمُ السِّمَنُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu aabaa jamraaa, qaala haddathaniy zahdamu bnu mudarribin, qaala sami'tu 'imraana bna husaynin rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ khayrukum qarniy, thumma alladhiyna yaluwnahum, thumma alladhiyna yaluwnahum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'imraanu famaa aadriy qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da qawlihi marratayni aaw thalaathana ‏"‏ thumma yakuwnu ba'dahum qawmun yashhaduwna walaa yustashhaduwna, wayakhuwnuwna walaa yuutamanuwna, wayandhiruwna walaa yafuwna wayazharu fiyhimu alssimanu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zahdam bin Mudarrib:`Imran bin Husain said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best people are my contemporaries (i.e., the present (my) generation) and then those who come after them (i.e., the next generation)." `Imran added: I am not sure whether the Prophet (ﷺ) repeated the statement twice after his first saying. The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "And after them there will come people who will bear witness, though they will not be asked to give their witness; and they will be treacherous and nobody will trust them, and they will make vows, but will not fulfill them, and fatness will appear among them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ خَيْرُ النَّاسِ قَرْنِي، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ، ثُمَّ يَجِيءُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قَوْمٌ تَسْبِقُ شَهَادَتُهُمْ أَيْمَانَهُمْ وَأَيْمَانُهُمْ شَهَادَتَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, 'an aabiy hamzaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'abiydaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ khayru alnnaasi qarniy, thumma alladhiyna yaluwnahum, thumma alladhiyna yaluwnahum, thumma yajiy'u min ba'dihim qawmun tasbiqu shahaadatuhum aaymaanahum waaaymaanuhum shahaadatahum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best people are those of my generation, and then those who will come after them (the next generation), and then those who will come after them (i.e. the next generation), and then after them, there will come people whose witness will precede their oaths, and whose oaths will precede their witness
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ خَبَّابًا، وَقَدِ اكْتَوَى يَوْمَئِذٍ سَبْعًا فِي بَطْنِهِ وَقَالَ لَوْلاَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَانَا أَنْ نَدْعُوَ بِالْمَوْتِ لَدَعَوْتُ بِالْمَوْتِ، إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَضَوْا وَلَمْ تَنْقُصْهُمُ الدُّنْيَا بِشَىْءٍ، وَإِنَّا أَصَبْنَا مِنَ الدُّنْيَا مَا لاَ نَجِدُ لَهُ مَوْضِعًا إِلاَّ التُّرَابَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an qaysin, qaala sami'tu khabbaabana, waqadi aktawaa yawmaiidhin sab'ana fiy batnihi waqaala lawlaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaanaa aan nad'uwa bialmawti lada'awtu bialmawti, iinna aashaaba muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm madawa walam tanqushumu alddunyaa bishaa'in, waiinnaa aasabnaa mina alddunyaa maa laa najidu lahu mawdi'ana iilaaa altturaaba‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qais:I heard Khabbab, who had branded his `Abdomen with seven brands, saying, "Had Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) not forbidden us to invoke Allah for death, I would have invoked Allah for death. The companions of Muhammad have left this world without taking anything of their reward in it (i.e., they will have perfect reward in the Hereafter), but we have collected of the worldly wealth what we cannot spend but on earth (i.e. on building houses)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي قَيْسٌ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ خَبَّابًا وَهْوَ يَبْنِي حَائِطًا لَهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَنَا الَّذِينَ مَضَوْا لَمْ تَنْقُصْهُمُ الدُّنْيَا شَيْئًا، وَإِنَّا أَصَبْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ شَيْئًا، لاَ نَجِدُ لَهُ مَوْضِعًا إِلاَّ التُّرَابَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathaniy qaysun, qaala aataytu khabbaabana wahwa yabniy haaiitana lahu faqaala iinna aashaabanaa alladhiyna madawa lam tanqushumu alddunyaa shayiana, waiinnaa aasabnaa min ba'dihim shayiana, laa najidu lahu mawdi'ana iilaaa altturaaba‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qais:I came to Khabbab while he was building a wall, and he (Khabbab) said, "Our companions who have left this world, did not enjoy anything of their reward therein, while we have collected after them, much wealth that we cannot spend but on earth (i.e., on building)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ خَبَّاب ٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ هَاجَرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, 'an sufyaana, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an khabbaab in rda allh 'nh qaala haajarnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Khabbab:We migrated with the Prophet..(This narration is related in the chapter of migration)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْقُرَشِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاذُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ ابْنَ أَبَانَ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ أَتَيْتُ عُثْمَانَ بِطَهُورٍ وَهْوَ جَالِسٌ عَلَى الْمَقَاعِدِ، فَتَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَوَضَّأَ وَهْوَ فِي هَذَا الْمَجْلِسِ، فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ مِثْلَ هَذَا الْوُضُوءِ، ثُمَّ أَتَى الْمَسْجِدَ فَرَكَعَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ جَلَسَ، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَغْتَرُّوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'du bnu hafsin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an yahyaa, 'an muhammadi bni iibraahiyma alqurashiyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy mu'aadhu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna abna aabaana, aakhbarahu qaala aataytu 'uthmaana bitahuwrin wahwa jaalisun 'alaa almaqaa'idi, fatawaddaaa faaahsana alwuduw'a thumma qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm tawaddaaa wahwa fiy hadhaa almajlisi, faaahsana alwuduw'a thumma qaala ‏"‏ man tawaddaaa mithla hadhaa alwuduw'i, thumma aataa almasjida faraka'a rak'atayni, thumma jalasa, ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala waqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa taghtarruwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I brought water to `Uthman bin `Affan to perform the ablution while he was sitting on his seat. He performed the ablution in a perfect way and said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) performing the ablution in this place and he performed it in a perfect way and said, "Whoever performs the ablution as I have done this time and then proceeds to the mosque and offers a two-rak`at prayer and then sits there (waiting for the compulsory congregational prayers), then all his past sins will be forgiven." The Prophet (ﷺ) further added, "Do not be conceited (thinking that your sins will be forgiven because of your prayer)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ بَيَانٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ مِرْدَاسٍ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَذْهَبُ الصَّالِحُونَ الأَوَّلُ فَالأَوَّلُ، وَيَبْقَى حُفَالَةٌ كَحُفَالَةِ الشَّعِيرِ أَوِ التَّمْرِ، لاَ يُبَالِيهِمُ اللَّهُ بَالَةً ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُقَالُ حُفَالَةٌ وَحُثَالَةٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu hammaadin, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an bayaanin, 'an qaysi bni aabiy haazimin, 'an mirdaasin alaaslamiyyi, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yadhhabu alssaalihuwna alaawwalu faalaawwalu, wayabqaa hufaalaaun kahufaalaai alshha'iyri aawi alttamri, laa yubaaliyhimu alllahu baalaaan ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi yuqaalu hufaalaaun wahuthaalaaun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mirdas Al-Aslami:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The righteous (pious people will depart (die) in succession one after the other, and there will remain (on the earth) useless people like the useless husk of barley seeds or bad dates
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَعِسَ عَبْدُ الدِّينَارِ وَالدِّرْهَمِ وَالْقَطِيفَةِ وَالْخَمِيصَةِ، إِنْ أُعْطِيَ رَضِيَ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يُعْطَ لَمْ يَرْضَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa aabuw bakrin, 'an aabiy hasiynin, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ta'isa 'abdu alddiynaari waalddirhami waalqatiyfaai waalkhamiysaai, iin au'tiya radiya, waiin lam yu'ta lam yarda ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Perish the slave of Dinar, Dirham, Qatifa (thick soft cloth), and Khamisa (a garment), for if he is given, he is pleased; otherwise he is dissatisfied
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لَوْ كَانَ لاِبْنِ آدَمَ وَادِيَانِ مِنْ مَالٍ لاَبْتَغَى ثَالِثًا، وَلاَ يَمْلأُ جَوْفَ ابْنِ آدَمَ إِلاَّ التُّرَابُ، وَيَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَى مَنْ تَابَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'an 'ataa'in, qaala sami'tu abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ law kaana laibni adama waadiyaani min maalin laabtaghaa thaalithana, walaa yamlau jawfa abni adama iilaaa altturaabu, wayatuwbu alllahu 'alaa man taaba ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "If the son of Adam (the human being) had two valleys of money, he would wish for a third, for nothing can fill the belly of Adam's son except dust, and Allah forgives him who repents to Him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءً، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لَوْ أَنَّ لاِبْنِ آدَمَ مِثْلَ وَادٍ مَالاً لأَحَبَّ أَنَّ لَهُ إِلَيْهِ مِثْلَهُ، وَلاَ يَمْلأُ عَيْنَ ابْنِ آدَمَ إِلاَّ التُّرَابُ، وَيَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَى مَنْ تَابَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَلاَ أَدْرِي مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ هُوَ أَمْ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadun, aakhbaranaa makhladun, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala sami'tu 'ataa'an, yaquwlu sami'tu abna 'abbaasin, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ law aanna laibni adama mithla waadin maalaan laahabba aanna lahu iilayhi mithlahu, walaa yamlau 'ayna abni adama iilaaa altturaabu, wayatuwbu alllahu 'alaa man taaba ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin falaa aadriy mina alqurani huwa aam laa‏.‏ qaala wasami'tu abna alzzubayri yaquwlu dhalika 'alaa alminbari‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "If the son of Adam had money equal to a valley, then he will wish for another similar to it, for nothing can satisfy the eye of Adam's son except dust. And Allah forgives him who repents to Him." Ibn `Abbas said: I do not know whether this saying was quoted from the Qur'an or not. `Ata' said, "I heard Ibn Az-Zubair saying this narration while he was on the pulpit
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الْغَسِيلِ، عَنْ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ بِمَكَّةَ فِي خُطْبَتِهِ يَقُولُ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لَوْ أَنَّ ابْنَ آدَمَ أُعْطِيَ وَادِيًا مَلأً مِنْ ذَهَبٍ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ ثَانِيًا، وَلَوْ أُعْطِيَ ثَانِيًا أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ ثَالِثًا، وَلاَ يَسُدُّ جَوْفَ ابْنِ آدَمَ إِلاَّ التُّرَابُ، وَيَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَى مَنْ تَابَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu sulaymaana bni alghasiyli, 'an 'abbaasi bni sahli bni sa'din, qaala sami'tu abna alzzubayri, 'alaa alminbari bimakkaaa fiy khutbatihi yaquwlu yaa aayyuhaa alnnaasu iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ law aanna abna adama au'tiya waadiyana malaan min dhahabin aahabba iilayhi thaaniyana, walaw au'tiya thaaniyana aahabba iilayhi thaalithana, walaa yasuddu jawfa abni adama iilaaa altturaabu, wayatuwbu alllahu 'alaa man taaba ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:I heard Ibn Az-Zubair who was on the pulpit at Mecca, delivering a sermon, saying, "O men! The Prophet used to say, "If the son of Adam were given a valley full of gold, he would love to have a second one; and if he were given the second one, he would love to have a third, for nothing fills the belly of Adam's son except dust. And Allah forgives he who repents to Him." Ubai said, "We considered this as a saying from the Qur'an till the Sura (beginning with) 'The mutual rivalry for piling up of worldly things diverts you..' (102.1) was revealed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْ أَنَّ لاِبْنِ آدَمَ وَادِيًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ وَادِيَانِ، وَلَنْ يَمْلأَ فَاهُ إِلاَّ التُّرَابُ، وَيَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَى مَنْ تَابَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ law aanna laibni adama waadiyana min dhahabin aahabba aan yakuwna lahu waadiyaani, walan yamlaa faahu iilaaa altturaabu, wayatuwbu alllahu 'alaa man taaba ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If Adam's son had a valley full of gold, he would like to have two valleys, for nothing fills his mouth except dust. And Allah forgives him who repents to Him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: وَقَالَ لَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أُبَىٍّ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَرَى هَذَا مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ حَتَّى نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏أَلْهَاكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ‏}‏
verses.translit: waqaala lanaa aabuw alwaliydi haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, 'an aubaaain, qaala kunnaa naraa hadhaa mina alqurani hattaa nazalat ‏{‏aalhaakumu alttakaathuru‏}‏
verses.translation: Ubayy said (referring to the hadith above), "We considered this as a saying from the Qur'an till the Surah (beginning with):"The mutual rivalry (for piling up of worldly things) diverts you' (102:1) was revealed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَعْطَانِي، ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ فَأَعْطَانِي، ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ فَأَعْطَانِي، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ هَذَا الْمَالُ ـ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ سُفْيَانُ قَالَ لِي يَا حَكِيمُ ـ إِنَّ هَذَا الْمَالَ خَضِرَةٌ حُلْوَةٌ، فَمَنْ أَخَذَهُ بِطِيبِ نَفْسٍ بُورِكَ لَهُ فِيهِ، وَمَنْ أَخَذَهُ بِإِشْرَافِ نَفْسٍ لَمْ يُبَارَكْ لَهُ فِيهِ، وَكَانَ كَالَّذِي يَأْكُلُ وَلاَ يَشْبَعُ، وَالْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala sami'tu alzzuhriyya, yaquwlu aakhbaraniy 'urwaau, wasa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, 'an hakiymi bni hizaamin, qaala saaaltu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faaa'taaniy, thumma saaaltuhu faaa'taaniy, thumma saaaltuhu faaa'taaniy, thumma qaala ‏ "‏ hadhaa almaalu warubbamaa qaala sufyaanu qaala liy yaa hakiymu iinna hadhaa almaala khadiraaun hulwaaun, faman aakhadhahu bitiybi nafsin buwrika lahu fiyhi, waman aakhadhahu biiishraafi nafsin lam yubaarak lahu fiyhi, wakaana kaalladhiy yaakulu walaa yashba'u, waalyadu al'ulyaa khayrun mina alyadi alssuflaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hakim bin Hizam:I asked the Prophet (for some money) and he gave me, and then again I asked him and he gave me, and then again I asked him and he gave me and he then said, "This wealth is (like) green and sweet (fruit), and whoever takes it without greed, Allah will bless it for him, but whoever takes it with greed, Allah will not bless it for him, and he will be like the one who eats but is never satisfied. And the upper (giving) hand is better than the lower (taking) hand
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَيُّكُمْ مَالُ وَارِثِهِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ مَالِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا مِنَّا أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ مَالُهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ مَالَهُ مَا قَدَّمَ، وَمَالُ وَارِثِهِ مَا أَخَّرَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, qaala haddathaniy iibraahiymu alttaymiyyu, 'ani alhaarithi bni suwaydin, qaala 'abdu alllahi qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aayyukum maalu waarithihi aahabbu iilayhi min maalihi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi maa minnaa aahadun iilaaa maaluhu aahabbu iilayhi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinna maalahu maa qaddama, wamaalu waarithihi maa aakhhara ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who among you considers the wealth of his heirs dearer to him than his own wealth?" They replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! There is none among us but loves his own wealth more." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "So his wealth is whatever he spends (in Allah's Cause) during his life (on good deeds) while the wealth of his heirs is whatever he leaves after his death
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ خَرَجْتُ لَيْلَةً مِنَ اللَّيَالِي فَإِذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْشِي وَحْدَهُ، وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُ إِنْسَانٌ ـ قَالَ ـ فَظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَمْشِيَ مَعَهُ أَحَدٌ ـ قَالَ ـ فَجَعَلْتُ أَمْشِي فِي ظِلِّ الْقَمَرِ فَالْتَفَتَ فَرَآنِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَبُو ذَرٍّ جَعَلَنِي اللَّهُ فِدَاءَكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ تَعَالَهْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَشَيْتُ مَعَهُ سَاعَةً فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الْمُكْثِرِينَ هُمُ الْمُقِلُّونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، إِلاَّ مَنْ أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا، فَنَفَحَ فِيهِ يَمِينَهُ وَشِمَالَهُ وَبَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَوَرَاءَهُ، وَعَمِلَ فِيهِ خَيْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَشَيْتُ مَعَهُ سَاعَةً فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ اجْلِسْ هَا هُنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَجْلَسَنِي فِي قَاعٍ حَوْلَهُ حِجَارَةٌ فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ اجْلِسْ هَا هُنَا حَتَّى أَرْجِعَ إِلَيْكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَانْطَلَقَ فِي الْحَرَّةِ حَتَّى لاَ أَرَاهُ فَلَبِثَ عَنِّي فَأَطَالَ اللُّبْثَ، ثُمَّ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُهُ وَهْوَ مُقْبِلٌ وَهْوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ سَرَقَ وَإِنْ زَنَى ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ لَمْ أَصْبِرْ حَتَّى قُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ جَعَلَنِي اللَّهُ فِدَاءَكَ مَنْ تُكَلِّمُ فِي جَانِبِ الْحَرَّةِ مَا سَمِعْتُ أَحَدًا يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْكَ شَيْئًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ذَلِكَ جِبْرِيلُ ـ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ـ عَرَضَ لِي فِي جَانِبِ الْحَرَّةِ، قَالَ بَشِّرْ أُمَّتَكَ أَنَّهُ مَنْ مَاتَ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ، قُلْتُ يَا جِبْرِيلُ وَإِنْ سَرَقَ وَإِنْ زَنَى قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ وَإِنْ سَرَقَ وَإِنْ زَنَى قَالَ نَعَمْ، وَإِنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ. قَالَ النَّضْرُ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، وَحَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبُ بْنُ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، وَالأَعْمَشُ، وَعَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ رُفَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، بِهَذَا‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدِيثُ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، مُرْسَلٌ، لاَ يَصِحُّ، إِنَّمَا أَرَدْنَا لِلْمَعْرِفَةِ، وَالصَّحِيحُ حَدِيثُ أَبِي ذَرٍّ‏.‏ قِيلَ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدِيثُ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ قَالَ مُرْسَلٌ أَيْضًا لاَ يَصِحُّ، وَالصَّحِيحُ حَدِيثُ أَبِي ذَرٍّ‏.‏ وَقَالَ اضْرِبُوا عَلَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ هَذَا‏.‏ إِذَا مَاتَ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, hadaathanaa jariyrun, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni rufay'in, 'an zaydi bni wahbin, 'an aabiy dharinn rda allh 'nh qaala kharajtu laylaaan mina allaayaaliy faiidhaa rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yamshiy wahdahu, walaysa ma'ahu iinsaanun qaala fazanantu aanaahu yakrahu aan yamshiya ma'ahu aahadun qaala faja'altu aamshiy fiy zilii alqamari faaltafata faraaniy faqaala ‏"‏ man hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu aabuw dharinn ja'alaniy allaahu fidaa'aka‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa dharinn ta'aalah ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala famashaytu ma'ahu saa'aaan faqaala ‏"‏ iinaa almukthiriyna humu almuqiluuwna yawma alqiyaamaai, iilaaa man aa'taahu allaahu khayrana, fanafaha fiyhi yamiynahu washimaalahu wabayna yadayhi wawaraa'ahu, wa'amila fiyhi khayrana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala famashaytu ma'ahu saa'aaan faqaala liy ‏"‏ ajlis haa hunaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faaajlasaniy fiy qaa'in hawlahu hijaaraaun faqaala liy ‏"‏ ajlis haa hunaa hataaa aarji'a iilayka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faantalaqa fiy alharaaai hataaa laa aaraahu falabitha 'aniiy faaataala alluubtha, thumaa iiniiy sami'tuhu wahwa muqbilun wahwa yaquwlu ‏"‏ waiin saraqa waiin zanaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala falamaaa jaa'a lam aasbir hataaa qultu yaa nabiyaa allaahi ja'alaniy allaahu fidaa'aka man tukaliimu fiy jaanibi alharaaai maa sami'tu aahadana yarji'u iilayka shayiana‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ dhalika jibriylu 'alayhi alsaalaamu 'arada liy fiy jaanibi alharaaai, qaala bashiir aumaataka aanaahu man maata laa yushriku biallaahi shayiana dakhala aljanaaaa, qultu yaa jibriylu waiin saraqa waiin zanaa qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala qultu waiin saraqa waiin zanaa qaala na'am, waiin shariba alkhamra. qaala alnaadru aakhbaranaa shu'baau, wahadaathanaa habiybu bnu aabiy thaabitin, waalaa'mashu, wa'abdu al'aziyzi bnu rufay'in, hadaathanaa zaydu bnu wahbin, bihadhaa‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi allaahi hadiythu aabiy saalihin 'an aabiy aldaardaa'i, mursalun, laa yasihuu, iinaamaa aaradnaa lilma'rifaai, waalsaahiyhu hadiythu aabiy dharinn‏.‏ qiyla laabiy 'abdi allaahi hadiythu 'ataa'i bni yasaarin 'an aabiy aldaardaa'i qaala mursalun aaydana laa yasihuu, waalsaahiyhu hadiythu aabiy dharinn‏.‏ waqaala adribuwa 'alaa hadiythi aabiy aldaardaa'i hadhaa‏.‏ iidhaa maata qaala laa iilaha iilaaa allaahu‏.‏ 'inda almawti‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Dhar:Once I went out at night and found Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) walking all alone accompanied by nobody, and I thought that perhaps he disliked that someone should accompany him. So I walked in the shade, away from the moonlight, but the Prophet (ﷺ) looked behind and saw me and said, "Who is that?" I replied, "Abu Dhar, let Allah get me sacrificed for you!" He said, "O Abu Dhar, come here!" So I accompanied him for a while and then he said, "The rich are in fact the poor (little rewarded) on the Day of Resurrection except him whom Allah gives wealth which he gives (in charity) to his right, left, front and back, and does good deeds with it. I walked with him a little longer. Then he said to me, "Sit down here." So he made me sit in an open space surrounded by rocks, and said to me, "Sit here till I come back to you." He went towards Al-Harra till I could not see him, and he stayed away for a long period, and then I heard him saying, while he was coming, "Even if he had committed theft, and even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse?" When he came, I could not remain patient and asked him, "O Allah's Prophet! Let Allah get me sacrificed for you! Whom were you speaking to by the side of Al-Harra? I did not hear anybody responding to your talk." He said, "It was Gabriel who appeared to me beside Al-Harra and said, 'Give the good news to your followers that whoever dies without having worshipped anything besides Allah, will enter Paradise.' I said, 'O Gabriel! Even if he had committed theft or committed illegal sexual intercourse?' He said, 'Yes.' I said, 'Even if he has committed theft or committed illegal sexual intercourse?' He said, 'Yes.' I said, 'Even if he has committed theft or committed illegal sexual intercourse?' He said, 'Yes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو ذَرٍّ كُنْتُ أَمْشِي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَرَّةِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَاسْتَقْبَلَنَا أُحُدٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا يَسُرُّنِي أَنَّ عِنْدِي مِثْلَ أُحُدٍ هَذَا ذَهَبًا، تَمْضِي عَلَىَّ ثَالِثَةٌ وَعِنْدِي مِنْهُ دِينَارٌ، إِلاَّ شَيْئًا أُرْصِدُهُ لِدَيْنٍ، إِلاَّ أَنْ أَقُولَ بِهِ فِي عِبَادِ اللَّهِ هَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَعَنْ شِمَالِهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ‏.‏ ثُمَّ مَشَى فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الأَكْثَرِينَ هُمُ الأَقَلُّونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِلاَّ مَنْ قَالَ هَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا ـ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَعَنْ شِمَالِهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ ـ وَقَلِيلٌ مَا هُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي ‏"‏ مَكَانَكَ لاَ تَبْرَحْ حَتَّى آتِيَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ فِي سَوَادِ اللَّيْلِ حَتَّى تَوَارَى فَسَمِعْتُ صَوْتًا قَدِ ارْتَفَعَ، فَتَخَوَّفْتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ قَدْ عَرَضَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ آتِيَهُ فَذَكَرْتُ قَوْلَهُ لِي ‏"‏ لاَ تَبْرَحْ حَتَّى آتِيَكَ ‏"‏ فَلَمْ أَبْرَحْ حَتَّى أَتَانِي، قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ صَوْتًا تَخَوَّفْتُ، فَذَكَرْتُ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَهَلْ سَمِعْتَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ذَاكَ جِبْرِيلُ أَتَانِي فَقَالَ مَنْ مَاتَ مِنْ أُمَّتِكَ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu alrrabiy'i, haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an zaydi bni wahbin, qaala qaala aabuw dharrin kuntu aamshiy ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy harraai almadiynaai faastaqbalanaa auhudun faqaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa dharrin ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labbayka yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ maa yasurruniy aanna 'indiy mithla auhudin hadhaa dhahabana, tamdiy 'alaaaa thaalithaaun wa'indiy minhu diynaarun, iilaaa shayiana aursiduhu lidaynin, iilaaa aan aaquwla bihi fiy 'ibaadi alllahi hakadhaa wahakadhaa wahakadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ 'an yamiynihi wa'an shimaalihi wamin khalfihi‏.‏ thumma mashaa faqaala ‏"‏ iinna alaakthariyna humu alaaqalluwna yawma alqiyaamaai iilaaa man qaala hakadhaa wahakadhaa wahakadhaa 'an yamiynihi wa'an shimaalihi wamin khalfihi waqaliylun maa hum ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala liy ‏"‏ makaanaka laa tabrah hattaa atiyaka ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma antalaqa fiy sawaadi alllayli hattaa tawaaraa fasami'tu sawtana qadi artafa'a, fatakhawwaftu aan yakuwna qad 'arada lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaaradtu aan atiyahu fadhakartu qawlahu liy ‏"‏ laa tabrah hattaa atiyaka ‏"‏ falam aabrah hattaa aataaniy, qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi laqad sami'tu sawtana takhawwaftu, fadhakartu lahu faqaala ‏"‏ wahal sami'tahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ dhaaka jibriylu aataaniy faqaala man maata min aummatika laa yushriku bialllahi shayiana dakhala aljannaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu waiin zanaa waiin saraqa qaala ‏"‏ waiin zanaa waiin saraqa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Dhar:While I was walking with the Prophet (ﷺ) in the Harra of Medina, Uhud came in sight. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Dhar!" I said, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "I would not like to have gold equal to this mountain of Uhud, unless nothing of it, not even a single Dinar of it remains with me for more than three days, except something which I will keep for repaying debts. I would have spent all of it (distributed it) amongst Allah's Slaves like this, and like this, and like this." The Prophet (ﷺ) pointed out with his hand towards his right, his left and his back (while illustrating it). He proceeded with his walk and said, "The rich are in fact the poor (little rewarded) on the Day of Resurrection except those who spend their wealth like this, and like this, and like this, to their right, left and back, but such people are few in number." Then he said to me, "Stay at your place and do not leave it till I come back." Then he proceeded in the darkness of the night till he went out of sight, and then I heard a loud voice, and was afraid that something might have happened to the Prophet (ﷺ) .1 intended to go to him, but I remembered what he had said to me, i.e. 'Don't leave your place till I come back to you,' so I remained at my place till he came back to me. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I heard a voice and I was afraid." So I mentioned the whole story to him. He said, "Did you hear it?" I replied, "Yes." He said, "It was Gabriel who came to me and said, 'Whoever died without joining others in worship with Allah, will enter Paradise.' I asked (Gabriel), 'Even if he had committed theft or committed illegal sexual intercourse? Gabriel said, 'Yes, even if he had committed theft or committed illegal sexual intercourse
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ يُونُسَ،‏.‏ وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَوْ كَانَ لِي مِثْلُ أُحُدٍ ذَهَبًا لَسَرَّنِي أَنْ لاَ تَمُرَّ عَلَىَّ ثَلاَثُ لَيَالٍ وَعِنْدِي مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ، إِلاَّ شَيْئًا أُرْصِدُهُ لِدَيْنٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an yuwnusa, ‏.‏ waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, qaala aabuw hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ law kaana liy mithlu auhudin dhahabana lasarraniy aan laa tamurra 'alaaaa thalaathu layaalin wa'indiy minhu shaa'un, iilaaa shayiana aursiduhu lidaynin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Apostle said, "If I had gold equal to the mountain of Uhud, it would not please me that anything of it should remain with me after three nights (i.e., I would spend all of it in Allah's Cause) except what I would keep for repaying debts
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa aabuw bakrin, haddathanaa aabuw hasiynin, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laysa alghinaa 'an kathraai al'aradi, walakinna alghinaa ghinaa alnnafsi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wealth is not in having many possessions, but rather (true) wealth is feeling sufficiency in the soul
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ مَرَّ رَجُلٌ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لِرَجُلٍ عِنْدَهُ جَالِسٍ ‏"‏ مَا رَأْيُكَ فِي هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَشْرَافِ النَّاسِ، هَذَا وَاللَّهِ حَرِيٌّ إِنْ خَطَبَ أَنْ يُنْكَحَ، وَإِنْ شَفَعَ أَنْ يُشَفَّعَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَكَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ مَرَّ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا رَأْيُكَ فِي هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا رَجُلٌ مِنْ فُقَرَاءِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، هَذَا حَرِيٌّ إِنْ خَطَبَ أَنْ لاَ يُنْكَحَ، وَإِنْ شَفَعَ أَنْ لاَ يُشَفَّعَ، وَإِنْ قَالَ أَنْ لاَ يُسْمَعَ لِقَوْلِهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَذَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ مِلْءِ الأَرْضِ مِثْلَ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi, aannahu qaala marra rajulun 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala lirajulin 'indahu jaalisin ‏"‏ maa raayuka fiy hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala rajulun min aashraafi alnnaasi, hadhaa waalllahi hariyyun iin khataba aan yunkaha, waiin shafa'a aan yushaffa'a‏.‏ qaala fasakata rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma marra rajulun faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa raayuka fiy hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi hadhaa rajulun min fuqaraa'i almuslimiyna, hadhaa hariyyun iin khataba aan laa yunkaha, waiin shafa'a aan laa yushaffa'a, waiin qaala aan laa yusma'a liqawlihi‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hadhaa khayrun min mil'i alaardi mithla hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`id:A man passed by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) asked a man sitting beside him, "What is your opinion about this (passer-by)?" He replied, "This (passer-by) is from the noble class of people. By Allah, if he should ask for a lady's hand in marriage, he ought to be given her in marriage, and if he intercedes for somebody, his intercession will be accepted. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept quiet, and then another man passed by and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked the same man (his companion) again, "What is your opinion about this (second) one?" He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This person is one of the poor Muslims. If he should ask a lady's hand in marriage, no-one will accept him, and if he intercedes for somebody, no one will accept his intercession, and if he talks, no-one will listen to his talk." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "This (poor man) is better than such a large number of the first type (i.e. rich men) as to fill the earth
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ، قَالَ عُدْنَا خَبَّابًا فَقَالَ هَاجَرْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نُرِيدُ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ، فَوَقَعَ أَجْرُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ، فَمِنَّا مَنْ مَضَى لَمْ يَأْخُذْ مِنْ أَجْرِهِ، مِنْهُمْ مُصْعَبُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ قُتِلَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ، وَتَرَكَ نَمِرَةً فَإِذَا غَطَّيْنَا رَأْسَهُ بَدَتْ رِجْلاَهُ، وَإِذَا غَطَّيْنَا رِجْلَيْهِ بَدَا رَأْسُهُ، فَأَمَرَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نُغَطِّيَ رَأْسَهُ، وَنَجْعَلَ عَلَى رِجْلَيْهِ مِنَ الإِذْخِرِ، وَمِنَّا مَنْ أَيْنَعَتْ لَهُ ثَمَرَتُهُ فَهْوَ يَهْدُبُهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhumaydiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, qaala sami'tu aabaa waaiilin, qaala 'udnaa khabbaabana faqaala haajarnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm nuriydu wajha alllahi, fawaqa'a aajrunaa 'alaa alllahi, faminnaa man madaa lam yaakhudh min aajrihi, minhum mus'abu bnu 'umayrin qutila yawma auhudin, wataraka namiraaan faiidhaa ghattaynaa raasahu badat rijlaahu, waiidhaa ghattaynaa rijlayhi badaa raasuhu, faaamaranaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan nughattiya raasahu, wanaj'ala 'alaa rijlayhi mina aliidhkhiri, waminnaa man aayna'at lahu thamaratuhu fahwa yahdubuhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Wail:We paid a visit to Khabbab who was sick, and he said, "We migrated with the Prophet (ﷺ) for Allah's Sake and our wages became due on Allah. Some of us died without having received anything of the wages, and one of them was Mus`ab bin `Umair, who was martyred on the day of the battle of Uhud, leaving only one sheet (to shroud him in). If we covered his head with it, his feet became uncovered, and if we covered his feet with it, his head became uncovered. So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to cover his head with it and put some Idhkhir (a kind of grass) over his feet. On the other hand, some of us have had the fruits (of our good deed) and are plucking them (in this world)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلْمُ بْنُ زَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو رَجَاءٍ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ اطَّلَعْتُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ فَرَأَيْتُ أَكْثَرَ أَهْلِهَا الْفُقَرَاءَ، وَاطَّلَعْتُ فِي النَّارِ فَرَأَيْتُ أَكْثَرَ أَهْلِهَا النِّسَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ أَيُّوبُ وَعَوْفٌ، وَقَالَ صَخْرٌ وَحَمَّادُ بْنُ نَجِيحٍ عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa salmu bnu zariyrin, haddathanaa aabuw rajaa'in, 'an 'imraana bni husaynin rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ attala'tu fiy aljannaai faraaaytu aakthara aahlihaa alfuqaraa'a, waattala'tu fiy alnnaari faraaaytu aakthara aahlihaa alnnisaa'a ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu aayyuwbu wa'awfun, waqaala sakhrun wahammaadu bnu najiyhin 'an aabiy rajaa'in 'ani abni 'abbaasin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I looked into Paradise and found that the majority of its dwellers were the poor people, and I looked into the (Hell) Fire and found that the majority of its dwellers were women
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمْ يَأْكُلِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى خِوَانٍ حَتَّى مَاتَ، وَمَا أَكَلَ خُبْزًا مُرَقَّقًا حَتَّى مَاتَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy 'aruwbaaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala lam yaakuli alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa khiwaanin hattaa maata, wamaa aakala khubzana muraqqaqana hattaa maata‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) did not eat at a table till he died, and he did not eat a thin nicely baked wheat bread till he died
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ لَقَدْ تُوُفِّيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَا فِي رَفِّي مِنْ شَىْءٍ يَأْكُلُهُ ذُو كَبِدٍ، إِلاَّ شَطْرُ شَعِيرٍ فِي رَفٍّ لِي، فَأَكَلْتُ مِنْهُ حَتَّى طَالَ عَلَىَّ، فَكِلْتُهُ، فَفَنِيَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat laqad tuwuffiya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wamaa fiy raffiy min shaa'in yaakuluhu dhuw kabidin, iilaaa shatru sha'iyrin fiy raffin liy, faaakaltu minhu hattaa taala 'alaaaa, fakiltuhu, fafaniya‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:When the Prophet (ﷺ) died, nothing which can be eaten by a living creature was left on my shelf except some barley grain. I ate of it for a period and when I measured it, it finished
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، بِنَحْوٍ مِنْ نِصْفِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ ذَرٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُجَاهِدٌ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، كَانَ يَقُولُ آللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ إِنْ كُنْتُ لأَعْتَمِدُ بِكَبِدِي عَلَى الأَرْضِ مِنَ الْجُوعِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتُ لأَشُدُّ الْحَجَرَ عَلَى بَطْنِي مِنَ الْجُوعِ، وَلَقَدْ قَعَدْتُ يَوْمًا عَلَى طَرِيقِهِمُ الَّذِي يَخْرُجُونَ مِنْهُ، فَمَرَّ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ آيَةٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ، مَا سَأَلْتُهُ إِلاَّ لِيُشْبِعَنِي، فَمَرَّ وَلَمْ يَفْعَلْ، ثُمَّ مَرَّ بِي عُمَرُ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ آيَةٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ، مَا سَأَلْتُهُ إِلاَّ لِيُشْبِعَنِي، فَمَرَّ فَلَمْ يَفْعَلْ، ثُمَّ مَرَّ بِي أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَبَسَّمَ حِينَ رَآنِي وَعَرَفَ، مَا فِي نَفْسِي وَمَا فِي وَجْهِي ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَبَا هِرٍّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْحَقْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَمَضَى فَتَبِعْتُهُ، فَدَخَلَ فَاسْتَأْذَنَ، فَأَذِنَ لِي، فَدَخَلَ فَوَجَدَ لَبَنًا فِي قَدَحٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مِنْ أَيْنَ هَذَا اللَّبَنُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا أَهْدَاهُ لَكَ فُلاَنٌ أَوْ فُلاَنَةُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَبَا هِرٍّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْحَقْ إِلَى أَهْلِ الصُّفَّةِ فَادْعُهُمْ لِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَهْلُ الصُّفَّةِ أَضْيَافُ الإِسْلاَمِ، لاَ يَأْوُونَ إِلَى أَهْلٍ وَلاَ مَالٍ، وَلاَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ، إِذَا أَتَتْهُ صَدَقَةٌ بَعَثَ بِهَا إِلَيْهِمْ، وَلَمْ يَتَنَاوَلْ مِنْهَا شَيْئًا، وَإِذَا أَتَتْهُ هَدِيَّةٌ أَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِمْ، وَأَصَابَ مِنْهَا وَأَشْرَكَهُمْ فِيهَا، فَسَاءَنِي ذَلِكَ فَقُلْتُ وَمَا هَذَا اللَّبَنُ فِي أَهْلِ الصُّفَّةِ كُنْتُ أَحَقُّ أَنَا أَنْ أُصِيبَ مِنْ هَذَا اللَّبَنِ شَرْبَةً أَتَقَوَّى بِهَا، فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَمَرَنِي فَكُنْتُ أَنَا أُعْطِيهِمْ، وَمَا عَسَى أَنْ يَبْلُغَنِي مِنْ هَذَا اللَّبَنِ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ مِنْ طَاعَةِ اللَّهِ وَطَاعَةِ رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بُدٌّ، فَأَتَيْتُهُمْ فَدَعَوْتُهُمْ فَأَقْبَلُوا، فَاسْتَأْذَنُوا فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ، وَأَخَذُوا مَجَالِسَهُمْ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا هِرٍّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ خُذْ فَأَعْطِهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَخَذْتُ الْقَدَحَ فَجَعَلْتُ أُعْطِيهِ الرَّجُلَ فَيَشْرَبُ حَتَّى يَرْوَى، ثُمَّ يَرُدُّ عَلَىَّ الْقَدَحَ، فَأُعْطِيهِ الرَّجُلَ فَيَشْرَبُ حَتَّى يَرْوَى، ثُمَّ يَرُدُّ عَلَىَّ الْقَدَحَ فَيَشْرَبُ حَتَّى يَرْوَى، ثُمَّ يَرُدُّ عَلَىَّ الْقَدَحَ، حَتَّى انْتَهَيْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ رَوِيَ الْقَوْمُ كُلُّهُمْ، فَأَخَذَ الْقَدَحَ فَوَضَعَهُ عَلَى يَدِهِ فَنَظَرَ إِلَىَّ فَتَبَسَّمَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَبَا هِرٍّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَقِيتُ أَنَا وَأَنْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ صَدَقْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اقْعُدْ فَاشْرَبْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَعَدْتُ فَشَرِبْتُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اشْرَبْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَشَرِبْتُ، فَمَا زَالَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اشْرَبْ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَتَّى قُلْتُ لاَ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ، مَا أَجِدُ لَهُ مَسْلَكًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَرِنِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَعْطَيْتُهُ الْقَدَحَ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَسَمَّى، وَشَرِبَ الْفَضْلَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw nu'aymin, binahwin min nisfi hadhaa alhadiythi haddathanaa 'umaru bnu dharrin, haddathanaa mujaahidun, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, kaana yaquwlu alllahi alladhiy laa iilaha iilaaa huwa iin kuntu laa'tamidu bikabidiy 'alaa alaardi mina aljuw'i, waiin kuntu laashuddu alhajara 'alaa batniy mina aljuw'i, walaqad qa'adtu yawmana 'alaa tariyqihimu alladhiy yakhrujuwna minhu, famarra aabuw bakrin, fasaaaltuhu 'an ayaain min kitaabi alllahi, maa saaaltuhu iilaaa liyushbi'aniy, famarra walam yaf'al, thumma marra biy 'umaru fasaaaltuhu 'an ayaain min kitaabi alllahi, maa saaaltuhu iilaaa liyushbi'aniy, famarra falam yaf'al, thumma marra biy aabuw alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm fatabassama hiyna raaniy wa'arafa, maa fiy nafsiy wamaa fiy wajhiy thumma qaala ‏"‏ aabaa hirrin ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labbayka yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ alhaq ‏"‏‏.‏ wamadaa fatabi'tuhu, fadakhala faastaadhana, faaadhina liy, fadakhala fawajada labanana fiy qadahin faqaala ‏"‏ min aayna hadhaa alllabanu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa aahdaahu laka fulaanun aaw fulaanaau‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aabaa hirrin ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labbayka yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ alhaq iilaa aahli alssuffaai faad'uhum liy ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala waaahlu alssuffaai aadyaafu aliislaami, laa yaawuwna iilaa aahlin walaa maalin, walaa 'alaa aahadin, iidhaa aatathu sadaqaaun ba'atha bihaa iilayhim, walam yatanaawal minhaa shayiana, waiidhaa aatathu hadiyyaaun aarsala iilayhim, waaasaaba minhaa waaashrakahum fiyhaa, fasaa'aniy dhalika faqultu wamaa hadhaa alllabanu fiy aahli alssuffaai kuntu aahaqqu aanaa aan ausiyba min hadhaa alllabani sharbaaan aataqawwaa bihaa, faiidhaa jaa'a aamaraniy fakuntu aanaa au'tiyhim, wamaa 'asaa aan yablughaniy min hadhaa alllabani, walam yakun min taa'aai alllahi wataa'aai rasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm buddun, faaataytuhum fada'awtuhum faaaqbaluwa, faastaadhanuwa faaadhina lahum, waaakhadhuwa majaalisahum mina albayti qaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa hirrin ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labbayka yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ khudh faaa'tihim ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faaakhadhtu alqadaha faja'altu au'tiyhi alrrajula fayashrabu hattaa yarwaa, thumma yaruddu 'alaaaa alqadaha, faau'tiyhi alrrajula fayashrabu hattaa yarwaa, thumma yaruddu 'alaaaa alqadaha fayashrabu hattaa yarwaa, thumma yaruddu 'alaaaa alqadaha, hattaa antahaytu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqad rawiya alqawmu kulluhum, faaakhadha alqadaha fawada'ahu 'alaa yadihi fanazara iilaaaa fatabassama faqaala ‏"‏ aabaa hirrin ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labbayka yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ baqiytu aanaa waaanta ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu sadaqta yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aq'ud faashrab ‏"‏‏.‏ faqa'adtu fasharibtu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ ashrab ‏"‏‏.‏ fasharibtu, famaa zaala yaquwlu ‏"‏ ashrab ‏"‏‏.‏ hattaa qultu laa waalladhiy ba'athaka bialhaqqi, maa aajidu lahu maslakana‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaariniy ‏"‏‏.‏ faaa'taytuhu alqadaha fahamida alllaha wasammaa, washariba alfadlaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:By Allah except Whom none has the right to- be worshipped, (sometimes) I used to lay (sleep) on the ground on my liver (abdomen) because of hunger, and (sometimes) I used to bind a stone over my belly because of hunger. One day I sat by the way from where they (the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions) used to come out. When Abu Bakr passed by, I asked him about a Verse from Allah's Book and I asked him only that he might satisfy my hunger, but he passed by and did not do so. Then `Umar passed by me and I asked him about a Verse from Allah's Book, and I asked him only that he might satisfy my hunger, but he passed by without doing so. Finally Abu-l-Qasim (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) passed by me and he smiled when he saw me, for he knew what was in my heart and on my face. He said, "O Aba Hirr (Abu Huraira)!" I replied, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said to me, "Follow me." He left and I followed him. Then he entered the house and I asked permission to enter and was admitted. He found milk in a bowl and said, "From where is this milk?" They said, "It has been presented to you by such-and-such man (or by such and such woman)." He said, "O Aba Hirr!" I said, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "Go and call the people of Suffa to me." These people of Suffa were the guests of Islam who had no families, nor money, nor anybody to depend upon, and whenever an object of charity was brought to the Prophet, he would send it to them and would not take anything from it, and whenever any present was given to him, he used to send some for them and take some of it for himself. The order of the Prophet upset me, and I said to myself, "How will this little milk be enough for the people of As- Suffa? though I was more entitled to drink from that milk in order to strengthen myself", but behold! The Prophet (ﷺ) came to order me to give that milk to them. I wondered what will remain of that milk for me, but anyway, I could not but obey Allah and His Apostle so I went to the people of As-Suffa and called them, and they came and asked the Prophet's permission to enter. They were admitted and took their seats in the house. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Aba-Hirr!" I said, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "Take it and give it to them." So I took the bowl (of milk) and started giving it to one man who would drink his fill and return it to me, whereupon I would give it to another man who, in his turn, would drink his fill and return it to me, and I would then offer it to another man who would drink his fill and return it to me. Finally, after the whole group had drunk their fill, I reached the Prophet (ﷺ) who took the bowl and put it on his hand, looked at me and smiled and said. "O Aba Hirr!" I replied, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "There remain you and I." I said, "You have said the truth, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "Sit down and drink." I sat down and drank. He said, "Drink," and I drank. He kept on telling me repeatedly to drink, till I said, "No. by Allah Who sent you with the Truth, I have no space for it (in my stomach)." He said, "Hand it over to me." When I gave him the bowl, he praised Allah and pronounced Allah's Name on it and drank the remaining milk
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدًا، يَقُولُ إِنِّي لأَوَّلُ الْعَرَبِ رَمَى بِسَهْمٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، وَرَأَيْتُنَا نَغْزُو، وَمَا لَنَا طَعَامٌ إِلاَّ وَرَقُ الْحُبْلَةِ وَهَذَا السَّمُرُ، وَإِنَّ أَحَدَنَا لَيَضَعُ كَمَا تَضَعُ الشَّاةُ، مَا لَهُ خِلْطٌ، ثُمَّ أَصْبَحَتْ بَنُو أَسَدٍ تُعَزِّرُنِي عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ، خِبْتُ إِذًا وَضَلَّ سَعْيِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa qaysun, qaala sami'tu sa'dana, yaquwlu iinniy laawwalu al'arabi ramaa bisahmin fiy sabiyli alllahi, waraaaytunaa naghzuw, wamaa lanaa ta'aamun iilaaa waraqu alhublaai wahadhaa alssamuru, waiinna aahadanaa layada'u kamaa tada'u alshhaaau, maa lahu khiltun, thumma aasbahat banuw aasadin tu'azziruniy 'alaa aliislaami, khibtu iidhana wadalla sa'yiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d:I was the first man among the Arabs to throw an arrow for Allah's Cause. We used to fight in Allah's Cause while we had nothing to eat except the leaves of the Hubla and the Sumur trees (desert trees) so that we discharged excrement like that of sheep (i.e. unmixed droppings). Today the (people of the) tribe of Bani Asad teach me the laws of Islam. If so, then I am lost, and all my efforts of that hard time had gone in vain
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُثْمَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا شَبِعَ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُنْذُ قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ مِنْ طَعَامِ بُرٍّ ثَلاَثَ لَيَالٍ تِبَاعًا حَتَّى قُبِضَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'uthmaanu, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat maa shabi'a alu muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm mundhu qadima almadiynaaa min ta'aami burrin thalaatha layaalin tibaa'ana hattaa qubida‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The family of Muhammad had never eaten their fill of wheat bread for three successive days since they had migrated to Medina till the death of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ ـ هُوَ الأَزْرَقُ ـ عَنْ مِسْعَرِ بْنِ كِدَامٍ، عَنْ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ مَا أَكَلَ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكْلَتَيْنِ فِي يَوْمٍ، إِلاَّ إِحْدَاهُمَا تَمْرٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma bni 'abdi alrrahmani, haddathanaa iishaaqu huwa alaazraqu 'an mis'ari bni kidaamin, 'an hilaalin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat maa aakala alu muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm aaklatayni fiy yawmin, iilaaa iihdaahumaa tamrun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The family of Muhammad did not eat two meals on one day, but one of the two was of dates
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ فِرَاشُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَدَمٍ، وَحَشْوُهُ مِنْ لِيفٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu aabiy rajaa'in, haddathanaa alnnadru, 'an hishaamin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana firaashu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min aadamin, wahashwuhu min liyfin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The bed mattress of the Prophet (ﷺ) was made of a leather case stuffed with palm fibres
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَأْتِي أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ وَخَبَّازُهُ قَائِمٌ وَقَالَ كُلُوا فَمَا أَعْلَمُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى رَغِيفًا مُرَقَّقًا، حَتَّى لَحِقَ بِاللَّهِ، وَلاَ رَأَى شَاةً سَمِيطًا بِعَيْنِهِ قَطُّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hudbaau bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamu bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa qataadaau, qaala kunnaa naatiy aanasa bna maalikin wakhabbaazuhu qaaiimun waqaala kuluwa famaa aa'lamu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa raghiyfana muraqqaqana, hattaa lahiqa bialllahi, walaa raaaa shaaaan samiytana bi'aynihi qattu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qatada:We used to go to Anas bin Malik and see his baker standing (preparing the bread). Anas said, "Eat. I have not known that the Prophet (ﷺ) ever saw a thin well-baked loaf of bread till he died, and he never saw a roasted sheep with his eyes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ يَأْتِي عَلَيْنَا الشَّهْرُ مَا نُوقِدُ فِيهِ نَارًا، إِنَّمَا هُوَ التَّمْرُ وَالْمَاءُ، إِلاَّ أَنْ نُؤْتَى بِاللُّحَيْمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaana yaatiy 'alaynaa alshhahru maa nuwqidu fiyhi naarana, iinnamaa huwa alttamru waalmaa'u, iilaaa aan nuutaa biallluhaymi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:A complete month would pass by during which we would not make a fire (for cooking), and our food used to be only dates and water unless we were given a present of some meat
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأُوَيْسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ رُومَانَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ لِعُرْوَةَ ابْنَ أُخْتِي إِنْ كُنَّا لَنَنْظُرُ إِلَى الْهِلاَلِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَهِلَّةٍ فِي شَهْرَيْنِ، وَمَا أُوقِدَتْ فِي أَبْيَاتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَارٌ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ مَا كَانَ يُعِيشُكُمْ قَالَتِ الأَسْوَدَانِ التَّمْرُ وَالْمَاءُ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ قَدْ كَانَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جِيرَانٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ كَانَ لَهُمْ مَنَائِحُ، وَكَانُوا يَمْنَحُونَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَبْيَاتِهِمْ، فَيَسْقِينَاهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi alauwaysiyyu, haddathaniy abnu aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an yaziyda bni ruwmaana, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat li'urwaaa abna aukhtiy iin kunnaa lananzuru iilaa alhilaali thalaathaaa aahillaain fiy shahrayni, wamaa auwqidat fiy aabyaati rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm naarun‏.‏ faqultu maa kaana yu'iyshukum qaalati alaaswadaani alttamru waalmaa'u iilaaa aannahu qad kaana lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jiyraanun mina alaansaari kaana lahum manaaiihu, wakaanuwa yamnahuwna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min aabyaatihim, fayasqiynaahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:that she said to `Urwa, "O, the son of my sister! We used to see three crescents in two months, and no fire used to be made in the houses of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (i.e. nothing used to be cooked)." `Urwa said, "What used to sustain you?" `Aisha said, "The two black things i.e. dates and water, except that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had neighbors from the Ansar who had some milch she-camels, and they used to give the Prophet (ﷺ) some milk from their house, and he used to make us drink it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ قُوتًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'umaaraaa, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alllahumma arzuq ala muhammadin quwtana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Give food to the family of Muhammad
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ مَسْرُوقًا، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَىُّ الْعَمَلِ كَانَ أَحَبَّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتِ الدَّائِمُ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ فَأَىَّ حِينٍ كَانَ يَقُومُ قَالَتْ كَانَ يَقُومُ إِذَا سَمِعَ الصَّارِخَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa aabiy, 'an shu'baaa, 'an aash'atha, qaala sami'tu aabiy qaala, sami'tu masruwqana, qaala saaaltu 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aaaau al'amali kaana aahabba iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalati alddaaiimu‏.‏ qaala qultu faaaaaa hiynin kaana yaquwmu qaalat kaana yaquwmu iidhaa sami'a alssaarikha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Masruq:I asked `Aisha "What deed was the most beloved to the Prophet?" She said, "The regular constant one." I said, "At what time did he use to get up at night (for the Tahajjud night prayer)?' She said, "He used to get up on hearing (the crowing of) the cock (the last third of the night)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ أَحَبُّ الْعَمَلِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الَّذِي يَدُومُ عَلَيْهِ صَاحِبُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, 'an maalikin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat kaana aahabbu al'amali iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alladhiy yaduwmu 'alayhi saahibuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The most beloved action to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was that whose doer did it continuously and regularly
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَنْ يُنَجِّيَ أَحَدًا مِنْكُمْ عَمَلُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا وَلاَ أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ أَنَا، إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِي اللَّهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ، سَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا، وَاغْدُوا وَرُوحُوا، وَشَىْءٌ مِنَ الدُّلْجَةِ‏.‏ وَالْقَصْدَ الْقَصْدَ تَبْلُغُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'an sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ lan yunajjiya aahadana minkum 'amaluhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa walaa aanta yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ walaa aanaa, iilaaa aan yataghammadaniy alllahu birahmaain, saddiduwa waqaaribuwa, waaghduwa waruwhuwa, washaa'un mina aldduljaai‏.‏ waalqasda alqasda tablughuwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The deeds of anyone of you will not save you (from the (Hell) Fire)." They said, "Even you (will not be saved by your deeds), O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "No, even I (will not be saved) unless and until Allah bestows His Mercy on me. Therefore, do good deeds properly, sincerely and moderately, and worship Allah in the forenoon and in the afternoon and during a part of the night, and always adopt a middle, moderate, regular course whereby you will reach your target (Paradise)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ سَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا، وَاعْلَمُوا أَنْ لَنْ يُدْخِلَ أَحَدَكُمْ عَمَلُهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَنَّ أَحَبَّ الأَعْمَالِ أَدْوَمُهَا إِلَى اللَّهِ، وَإِنْ قَلَّ ‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ saddiduwa waqaaribuwa, waa'lamuwa aan lan yudkhila aahadakum 'amaluhu aljannaaa, waaanna aahabba alaa'maali aadwamuhaa iilaa alllahi, waiin qalla ‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do good deeds properly, sincerely and moderately and know that your deeds will not make you enter Paradise, and that the most beloved deed to Allah is the most regular and constant even if it were little
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الأَعْمَالِ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اكْلَفُوا مِنَ الأَعْمَالِ مَا تُطِيقُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'ar'araaa, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aannahaa qaalat suiila alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aaaau alaa'maali aahabbu iilaa alllahi qaala ‏"‏ aadwamuhaa waiin qalla ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ aklafuwa mina alaa'maali maa tutiyquwna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked, "What deeds are loved most by Allah?" He said, "The most regular constant deeds even though they may be few." He added, 'Don't take upon yourselves, except the deeds which are within your ability
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَائِشَةَ قُلْتُ يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَمَلُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَلْ كَانَ يَخُصُّ شَيْئًا مِنَ الأَيَّامِ قَالَتْ لاَ، كَانَ عَمَلُهُ دِيمَةً، وَأَيُّكُمْ يَسْتَطِيعُ مَا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتَطِيعُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, qaala saaaltu aumma almuuminiyna 'aaiishaaa qultu yaa aumma almuuminiyna kayfa kaana 'amalu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm hal kaana yakhussu shayiana mina alaayyaami qaalat laa, kaana 'amaluhu diymaaan, waaayyukum yastatiy'u maa kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yastatiy'u‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Alqama:I asked `Aisha, mother of the believers, "O mother of the believers! How were the deeds of the Prophet? Did he use to do extra deeds of worship on special days?" She said, "No, but his deeds were regular and constant, and who among you is able to do what the Prophet (ﷺ) was able to do (i.e. in worshipping Allah)?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الزِّبْرِقَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ سَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا، وَأَبْشِرُوا، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يُدْخِلُ أَحَدًا الْجَنَّةَ عَمَلُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا وَلاَ، أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِي اللَّهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَرَحْمَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَظُنُّهُ عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سَدِّدُوا وَأَبْشِرُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ ‏{‏قَوْلاً سَدِيدًا‏}‏ وَسَدَادًا صِدْقًا‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'aliyuu bnu 'abdi allaahi, hadaathanaa muhamaadu bnu alziibriqaani, hadaathanaa muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alraahmani, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ sadiiduwa waqaaribuwa, waaabshiruwa, faiinaahu laa yudkhilu aahadana aljanaaaa 'amaluhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa walaa, aanta yaa rasuwla allaahi qaala ‏"‏ walaa aanaa iilaaa aan yataghamaadaniy allaahu bimaghfiraain warahmaain ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aazunuuhu 'an aabiy alnaadri 'an aabiy salamaaa 'an 'aaiishaaa‏.‏ waqaala 'afaaanu hadaathanaa wuhaybun, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, qaala sami'tu aabaa salamaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ sadiiduwa waaabshiruwa ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala mujaahidun ‏{‏qawlaan sadiydana‏}‏ wasadaadana sidqana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do good deeds properly, sincerely and moderately, and receive good news because one's good deeds will not make him enter Paradise." They asked, "Even you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "Even I, unless and until Allah bestows His pardon and Mercy on me
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُلَيْحٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى لَنَا يَوْمًا الصَّلاَةَ، ثُمَّ رَقِيَ الْمِنْبَرَ فَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ قِبَلَ قِبْلَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ قَدْ أُرِيتُ الآنَ ـ مُنْذُ صَلَّيْتُ لَكُمُ الصَّلاَةَ ـ الْجَنَّةَ وَالنَّارَ مُمَثَّلَتَيْنِ فِي قُبُلِ هَذَا الْجِدَارِ، فَلَمْ أَرَ كَالْيَوْمِ فِي الْخَيْرِ وَالشَّرِّ، فَلَمْ أَرَ كَالْيَوْمِ فِي الْخَيْرِ وَالشَّرِّ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fulayhin, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an hilaali bni 'aliyyin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tuhu yaquwlu iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa lanaa yawmana alssalaaaa, thumma raqiya alminbara faaashaara biyadihi qibala qiblaai almasjidi, faqaala ‏ "‏ qad auriytu alana mundhu sallaytu lakumu alssalaaaa aljannaaa waalnnaara mumathhalatayni fiy qubuli hadhaa aljidaari, falam aara kaalyawmi fiy alkhayri waalshharri, falam aara kaalyawmi fiy alkhayri waalshharri ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us in prayer and then (after finishing it) ascended the pulpit and pointed with his hand towards the Qibla of the mosque and said, "While I was leading you in prayer, both Paradise and Hell were displayed in front of me in the direction of this wall. I had never seen a better thing (than Paradise) and a worse thing (than Hell) as I have seen today, I had never seen a better thing and a worse thing as I have seen today
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ الرَّحْمَةَ يَوْمَ خَلَقَهَا مِائَةَ رَحْمَةٍ، فَأَمْسَكَ عِنْدَهُ تِسْعًا وَتِسْعِينَ رَحْمَةً، وَأَرْسَلَ فِي خَلْقِهِ كُلِّهِمْ رَحْمَةً وَاحِدَةً، فَلَوْ يَعْلَمُ الْكَافِرُ بِكُلِّ الَّذِي عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ لَمْ يَيْأَسْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ، وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُ الْمُؤْمِنُ بِكُلِّ الَّذِي عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ لَمْ يَأْمَنْ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'amriw bni aabiy 'amrinw, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha khalaqa alrrahmaaa yawma khalaqahaa miaiaaa rahmaain, faaamsaka 'indahu tis'ana watis'iyna rahmaaan, waaarsala fiy khalqihi kullihim rahmaaan waahidaaan, falaw ya'lamu alkaafiru bikulli alladhiy 'inda alllahi mina alrrahmaai lam yayaas mina aljannaai, walaw ya'lamu almuuminu bikulli alladhiy 'inda alllahi mina al'adhaabi lam yaaman mina alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, Verily Allah created Mercy. The day He created it, He made it into one hundred parts. He withheld with Him ninety-nine parts, and sent its one part to all His creatures. Had the non-believer known of all the Mercy which is in the Hands of Allah, he would not lose hope of entering Paradise, and had the believer known of all the punishment which is present with Allah, he would not consider himself safe from the Hell-Fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أُنَاسًا مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ سَأَلُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَسْأَلْهُ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ حَتَّى نَفِدَ مَا عِنْدَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ حِينَ نَفِدَ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ أَنْفَقَ بِيَدَيْهِ ‏ "‏ مَا يَكُنْ عِنْدِي مِنْ خَيْرٍ لاَ أَدَّخِرْهُ عَنْكُمْ، وَإِنَّهُ مَنْ يَسْتَعِفَّ يُعِفُّهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ يَتَصَبَّرْ يُصَبِّرْهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ يَسْتَغْنِ يُغْنِهِ اللَّهُ، وَلَنْ تُعْطَوْا عَطَاءً خَيْرًا وَأَوْسَعَ مِنَ الصَّبْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ataa'u bnu yaziyda, aanna aabaa sa'iydin, aakhbarahu aanna aunaasana mina alaansaari saaaluwa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falam yasaalhu aahadun minhum iilaaa aa'taahu hattaa nafida maa 'indahu faqaala lahum hiyna nafida kullu shaa'in aanfaqa biyadayhi ‏ "‏ maa yakun 'indiy min khayrin laa aaddakhirhu 'ankum, waiinnahu man yasta'iffa yu'iffuhu alllahu, waman yatasabbar yusabbirhu alllahu, waman yastaghni yughnihi alllahu, walan tu'tawa 'ataa'an khayrana waaawsa'a mina alssabri ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id:Some people from the Ansar asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (to give them something) and he gave to everyone of them, who asked him, until all that he had was finished. When everything was finished and he had spent all that was in his hand, he said to them, '"(Know) that if I have any wealth, I will not withhold it from you (to keep for somebody else); And (know) that he who refrains from begging others (or doing prohibited deeds), Allah will make him contented and not in need of others; and he who remains patient, Allah will bestow patience upon him, and he who is satisfied with what he has, Allah will make him self-sufficient. And there is no gift better and vast (you may be given) than patience
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
