verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلاَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ عِلاَقَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ شُعْبَةَ، يَقُولُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي حَتَّى تَرِمَ ـ أَوْ تَنْتَفِخَ ـ قَدَمَاهُ فَيُقَالُ لَهُ، فَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ أَفَلاَ أَكُونُ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalaaadu bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa mis'arun, haddathanaa ziyaadu bnu 'ilaaqaaa, qaala sami'tu almughiyraaa bna shu'baaa, yaquwlu kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy hattaa tarima aaw tantafikha qadamaahu fayuqaalu lahu, fayaquwlu ‏ "‏ aafalaa aakuwnu 'abdana shakuwrana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray so much that his feet used to become edematous or swollen, and when he was asked as to why he prays so much, he would say, "Shall I not be a thankful slave (to Allah)?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ حُصَيْنَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ كُنْتُ قَاعِدًا عِنْدَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ فَقَالَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ، هُمُ الَّذِينَ لاَ يَسْتَرْقُونَ، وَلاَ يَتَطَيَّرُونَ، وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu husayna bna 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala kuntu qaa'idana 'inda sa'iydi bni jubayrin faqaala 'ani abni 'abbaasin aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yadkhulu aljannaaa min aummatiy sab'uwna aalfana bighayri hisaabin, humu alladhiyna laa yastarquwna, walaa yatatayyaruwna, wa'alaa rabbihim yatawakkaluwna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Seventy thousand people of my followers will enter Paradise without accounts, and they are those who do not practice Ar-Ruqya and do not see an evil omen in things, and put their trust in their Lord
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا غَيْرُ، وَاحِدٍ، مِنْهُمْ مُغِيرَةُ وَفُلاَنٌ وَرَجُلٌ ثَالِثٌ أَيْضًا عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ وَرَّادٍ كَاتِبِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ أَنَّ مُعَاوِيَةَ كَتَبَ إِلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ أَنِ اكْتُبْ إِلَىَّ بِحَدِيثٍ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ الْمُغِيرَةُ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ عِنْدَ انْصِرَافِهِ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهْوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ قَالَ وَكَانَ يَنْهَى عَنْ قِيلَ وَقَالَ وَكَثْرَةِ السُّؤَالِ، وَإِضَاعَةِ الْمَالِ، وَمَنْعٍ وَهَاتِ، وَعُقُوقِ الأُمَّهَاتِ، وَوَأْدِ الْبَنَاتِ‏.‏ وَعَنْ هُشَيْمٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ وَرَّادًا يُحَدِّثُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa ghayru, waahidin, minhum mughiyraau wafulaanun warajulun thaalithun aaydana 'ani alshha'biyyi 'an warraadin kaatibi almughiyraai bni shu'baaa aanna mu'aawiyaaa kataba iilaa almughiyraai aani aktub iilaaaa bihadiythin sami'tahu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fakataba iilayhi almughiyraau aanniy sami'tuhu yaquwlu 'inda ansiraafihi mina alssalaaai ‏ "‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu, wahdahu laa shariyka lahu, lahu almulku, walahu alhamdu, wahwa 'alaa kulli shaa'in qadiyrun ‏"‏‏.‏ thalaatha marraatin qaala wakaana yanhaa 'an qiyla waqaala wakathraai alssuuaali, waiidaa'aai almaali, waman'in wahaati, wa'uquwqi alaummahaati, wawaadi albanaati‏.‏ wa'an hushaymin aakhbaranaa 'abdu almaliki bnu 'umayrin qaala sami'tu warraadana yuhaddithu hadhaa alhadiytha 'ani almughiyraai 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Warrad:(the clerk of Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba) Muawiya wrote to Al-Mughira: "Write to me a narration you have heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." So Al-Mughira wrote to him, "I heard him saying the following after each prayer: 'La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahu-l-mulk wa lahuI-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli Shai-in qadir.' He also used to forbid idle talk, asking too many questions (in religion), wasting money, preventing what should be given, and asking others for something (except in great need), being undutiful to mothers, and burying one's little daughters (alive)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، سَمِعَ أَبَا حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ يَضْمَنْ لِي مَا بَيْنَ لَحْيَيْهِ وَمَا بَيْنَ رِجْلَيْهِ أَضْمَنْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu 'aliyyin, sami'a aabaa haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man yadman liy maa bayna lahyayhi wamaa bayna rijlayhi aadman lahu aljannaaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever can guarantee (the chastity of) what is between his two jaw-bones and what is between his two legs (i.e. his tongue and his private parts), I guarantee Paradise for him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا، أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلاَ يُؤْذِ جَارَهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falyaqul khayrana, aaw liyasmut, waman kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falaa yuudhi jaarahu, waman kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falyukrim dayfahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should talk what is good or keep quiet, and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not hurt (or insult) his neighbor; and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should entertain his guest generously
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْخُزَاعِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعَ أُذُنَاىَ، وَوَعَاهُ، قَلْبِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ الضِّيَافَةُ ثَلاَثَةُ أَيَّامٍ جَائِزَتُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قِيلَ مَا جَائِزَتُهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَوْمٌ وَلَيْلَةٌ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا، أَوْ لِيَسْكُتْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa laythun, haddathanaa sa'iydun almaqburiyyu, 'an aabiy shurayhin alkhuzaa'iyyi, qaala sami'a audhunaaaa, wawa'aahu, qalbiy alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ alddiyaafaau thalaathaau aayyaamin jaaiizatuhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qiyla maa jaaiizatuhu qaala ‏"‏ yawmun walaylaaun, waman kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falyukrim dayfahu, waman kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falyaqul khayrana, aaw liyaskut ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Shuraih Al-Khuza`i:My ears heard and my heart grasped (the statement which) the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The period for keeping one's guest is three days (and don't forget) his reward." It was asked, "What is his reward?" He said, "In the first night and the day he should be given a high class quality of meals; and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should entertain his guest generously; and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should talk what is good (sense) or keep quiet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ لَيَتَكَلَّمُ بِالْكَلِمَةِ مَا يَتَبَيَّنُ فِيهَا، يَزِلُّ بِهَا فِي النَّارِ أَبْعَدَ مِمَّا بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu hamzaaa, haddathaniy abnu aabiy haazimin, 'an yaziyda, 'an muhammadi bni iibraahiyma, 'an 'iysaa bni talhaaa alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna al'abda layatakallamu bialkalimaai maa yatabayyanu fiyhaa, yazillu bihaa fiy alnnaari aab'ada mimmaa bayna almashriqi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "A slave of Allah may utter a word without thinking whether it is right or wrong, he may slip down in the Fire as far away a distance equal to that between the east
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُنِيرٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ يَعْنِي ابْنَ دِينَارٍ ـ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ لَيَتَكَلَّمُ بِالْكَلِمَةِ مِنْ رِضْوَانِ اللَّهِ لاَ يُلْقِي لَهَا بَالاً، يَرْفَعُ اللَّهُ بِهَا دَرَجَاتٍ، وَإِنَّ الْعَبْدَ لَيَتَكَلَّمُ بِالْكَلِمَةِ مِنْ سَخَطِ اللَّهِ لاَ يُلْقِي لَهَا بَالاً يَهْوِي بِهَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muniyrin, sami'a aabaa alnnadri, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'abdi alllahi ya'niy abna diynaarin 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna al'abda layatakallamu bialkalimaai min ridwaani alllahi laa yulqiy lahaa baalaan, yarfa'u alllahu bihaa darajaatin, waiinna al'abda layatakallamu bialkalimaai min sakhati alllahi laa yulqiy lahaa baalaan yahwiy bihaa fiy jahannama ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet; said, "A slave (of Allah) may utter a word which pleases Allah without giving it much importance, and because of that Allah will raise him to degrees (of reward): a slave (of Allah) may utter a word (carelessly) which displeases Allah without thinking of its gravity and because of that he will be thrown into the Hell-Fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي خُبَيْبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ سَبْعَةٌ يُظِلُّهُمُ اللَّهُ، رَجُلٌ ذَكَرَ اللَّهَ فَفَاضَتْ عَيْنَاهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy khubaybu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an hafsi bni 'aasimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ sab'aaun yuzilluhumu alllahu, rajulun dhakara alllaha fafaadat 'aynaahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said Allah will give shade to seven (types of people) under His Shade (on the Day of Resurrection). (one of them will be) a person who remembers Allah and his eyes are then flooded with tears
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ رِبْعِيٍّ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ كَانَ رَجُلٌ مِمَّنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ يُسِيءُ الظَّنَّ بِعَمَلِهِ، فَقَالَ لأَهْلِهِ إِذَا أَنَا مُتُّ فَخُذُونِي فَذَرُّونِي، فِي الْبَحْرِ فِي يَوْمٍ صَائِفٍ، فَفَعَلُوا بِهِ، فَجَمَعَهُ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى الَّذِي صَنَعْتَ قَالَ مَا حَمَلَنِي إِلاَّ مَخَافَتُكَ‏.‏ فَغَفَرَ لَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an rib'iyyin, 'an hudhayfaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ kaana rajulun mimman kaana qablakum yusiy'u alzzanna bi'amalihi, faqaala laahlihi iidhaa aanaa muttu fakhudhuwniy fadharruwniy, fiy albahri fiy yawmin saaiifin, fafa'aluwa bihi, fajama'ahu alllahu thumma qaala maa hamalaka 'alaa alladhiy sana'ta qaala maa hamalaniy iilaaa makhaafatuka‏.‏ faghafara lahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hudhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There was a man amongst the people who had suspicion as to the righteousness of his deeds. Therefore he said to his family, 'If I die, take me and burn my corpse and throw my ashes into the sea on a hot (or windy) day.' They did so, but Allah, collected his particles and asked (him), What made you do what you did?' He replied, 'The only thing that made me do it, was that I was afraid of You.' So Allah forgave him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْغَافِرِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ذَكَرَ رَجُلاً فِيمَنْ كَانَ سَلَفَ أَوْ قَبْلَكُمْ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً وَوَلَدًا ـ يَعْنِي أَعْطَاهُ قَالَ ـ فَلَمَّا حُضِرَ قَالَ لِبَنِيهِ أَىَّ أَبٍ كُنْتُ قَالُوا خَيْرَ أَبٍ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَبْتَئِرْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرًا ـ فَسَّرَهَا قَتَادَةُ لَمْ يَدَّخِرْ ـ وَإِنْ يَقْدَمْ عَلَى اللَّهِ يُعَذِّبْهُ فَانْظُرُوا، فَإِذَا مُتُّ فَأَحْرِقُونِي، حَتَّى إِذَا صِرْتُ فَحْمًا فَاسْحَقُونِي ـ أَوْ قَالَ فَاسْهَكُونِي ـ ثُمَّ إِذَا كَانَ رِيحٌ عَاصِفٌ فَأَذْرُونِي فِيهَا‏.‏ فَأَخَذَ مَوَاثِيقَهُمْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ وَرَبِّي فَفَعَلُوا فَقَالَ اللَّهُ كُنْ‏.‏ فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ قَائِمٌ، ثُمَّ قَالَ أَىْ عَبْدِي مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى مَا فَعَلْتَ قَالَ مَخَافَتُكَ ـ أَوْ فَرَقٌ مِنْكَ ـ فَمَا تَلاَفَاهُ أَنْ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَحَدَّثْتُ أَبَا عُثْمَانَ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَلْمَانَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ زَادَ فَأَذْرُونِي فِي الْبَحْرِ‏.‏ أَوْ كَمَا حَدَّثَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُعَاذٌ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa muwsaa, hadaathanaa mu'tamirun, sami'tu aabiy, hadaathanaa qataadaau, 'an 'uqbaaa bni 'abdi alghaafiri, 'an aabiy sa'iydin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏dhakara rajulaan fiyman kaana salafa aaw qablakum ataahu allaahu maalaan wawaladana ya'niy aa'taahu qaala falamaaa hudira qaala libaniyhi aaaaa aabin kuntu qaaluwa khayra aabin‏.‏ qaala faiinaahu lam yabtaiir 'inda allaahi khayrana fasaarahaa qataadaau lam yadaakhir waiin yaqdam 'alaa allaahi yu'adhiibhu faanzuruwa, faiidhaa mutuu faaahriquwniy, hataaa iidhaa sirtu fahmana faashaquwniy aaw qaala faashakuwniy thumaa iidhaa kaana riyhun 'aasifun faaadhruwniy fiyhaa‏.‏ faaakhadha mawaathiyqahum 'alaa dhalika warabiiy fafa'aluwa faqaala allaahu kun‏.‏ faiidhaa rajulun qaaiimun, thumaa qaala aaa 'abdiy maa hamalaka 'alaa maa fa'alta qaala makhaafatuka aaw faraqun minka famaa talaafaahu aan rahimahu allaahu ‏"‏‏.‏ fahadaathtu aabaa 'uthmaana faqaala sami'tu salmaana ghayra aanaahu zaada faaadhruwniy fiy albahri‏.‏ aaw kamaa hadaatha‏.‏ waqaala mu'aadhun hadaathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, sami'tu 'uqbaaa, sami'tu aabaa sa'iydin, 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned a man from the previous generation or from the people preceding your age whom Allah had given both wealth and children. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When the time of his death approached, he asked his children, 'What type of father have I been to you?' They replied: You have been a good father. He said, 'But he (i.e. your father) has not stored any good deeds with Allah (for the Hereafter): if he should face Allah, Allah will punish him. So listen, (O my children), when I die, burn my body till I become mere coal and then grind it into powder, and when there is a stormy wind, throw me (my ashes) in it.' So he took a firm promise from his children (to follow his instructions). And by Allah they (his sons) did accordingly(fulfilled their promise.) Then Allah said, "Be"' and behold! That man was standing there! Allah then said. "O my slave! What made you do what you did?" That man said, "Fear of You." So Allah forgave him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُ مَا بَعَثَنِي اللَّهُ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ أَتَى قَوْمًا فَقَالَ رَأَيْتُ الْجَيْشَ بِعَيْنَىَّ، وَإِنِّي أَنَا النَّذِيرُ الْعُرْيَانُ فَالنَّجَا النَّجَاءَ‏.‏ فَأَطَاعَتْهُ طَائِفَةٌ فَأَدْلَجُوا عَلَى مَهْلِهِمْ فَنَجَوْا، وَكَذَّبَتْهُ طَائِفَةٌ فَصَبَّحَهُمُ الْجَيْشُ فَاجْتَاحَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydi bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mathaliy wamathalu maa ba'athaniy alllahu kamathali rajulin aataa qawmana faqaala raaaytu aljaysha bi'aynaaaa, waiinniy aanaa alnnadhiyru al'uryaanu faalnnajaa alnnajaa'a‏.‏ faaataa'athu taaiifaaun faaadlajuwa 'alaa mahlihim fanajawa, wakadhhabathu taaiifaaun fasabbahahumu aljayshu faajtaahahum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. "My example and the example of the message with which Allah has sent me is like that of a man who came to some people and said, "I have seen with my own eyes the enemy forces, and I am a naked warner (to you) so save yourself, save yourself! A group of them obeyed him and went out at night, slowly and stealthily and were safe, while another group did not believe him and thus the army took them in the morning and destroyed them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُ النَّاسِ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ اسْتَوْقَدَ نَارًا، فَلَمَّا أَضَاءَتْ مَا حَوْلَهُ جَعَلَ الْفَرَاشُ وَهَذِهِ الدَّوَابُّ الَّتِي تَقَعُ فِي النَّارِ يَقَعْنَ فِيهَا، فَجَعَلَ يَنْزِعُهُنَّ وَيَغْلِبْنَهُ فَيَقْتَحِمْنَ فِيهَا، فَأَنَا آخُذُ بِحُجَزِكُمْ عَنِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتُمْ تَقْتَحِمُونَ فِيهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, aannahu haddathahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinnamaa mathaliy wamathalu alnnaasi kamathali rajulin astawqada naarana, falammaa aadaa'at maa hawlahu ja'ala alfaraashu wahadhihi alddawaabbu allatiy taqa'u fiy alnnaari yaqa'na fiyhaa, faja'ala yanzi'uhunna wayaghlibnahu fayaqtahimna fiyhaa, faaanaa akhudhu bihujazikum 'ani alnnaari, waaantum taqtahimuwna fiyhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "My example and the example of the people is that of a man who made a fire, and when it lighted what was around it, Moths and other insects started falling into the fire. The man tried (his best) to prevent them, (from falling in the fire) but they overpowered him and rushed into the fire. The Prophet (ﷺ) added: Now, similarly, I take hold of the knots at your waist (belts) to prevent you from falling into the Fire, but you insist on falling into it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو، يَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ، وَالْمُهَاجِرُ مَنْ هَجَرَ مَا نَهَى اللَّهُ عَنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, 'an 'aamirin, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna 'amrinw, yaquwlu qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ almuslimu man salima almuslimuwna min lisaanihi wayadihi, waalmuhaajiru man hajara maa nahaa alllahu 'anhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A Muslim is the one who avoids harming Muslims with his tongue or his hands. And a Muhajir (an emigrant) is the one who gives up (abandons) all what Allah has forbidden
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ كَانَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ مَا أَعْلَمُ لَضَحِكْتُمْ قَلِيلاً، وَلَبَكَيْتُمْ كَثِيرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, aanna aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh kaana yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ law ta'lamuwna maa aa'lamu ladahiktum qaliylaan, walabakaytum kathiyrana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If you knew that which I know you would laugh little and weep much
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ مَا أَعْلَمُ لَضَحِكْتُمْ قَلِيلاً وَلَبَكَيْتُمْ كَثِيرًا‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muwsaa bni aanasin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏law ta'lamuwna maa aa'lamu ladahiktum qaliylaan walabakaytum kathiyrana‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you knew that which I know, you would laugh little and weep much
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ حُجِبَتِ النَّارُ بِالشَّهَوَاتِ، وَحُجِبَتِ الْجَنَّةُ بِالْمَكَارِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ hujibati alnnaaru bialshhahawaati, wahujibati aljannaau bialmakaarihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The (Hell) Fire is surrounded by all kinds of desires and passions, while Paradise is surrounded by all kinds of disliked undesirable things
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، وَالأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْجَنَّةُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَى أَحَدِكُمْ مِنْ شِرَاكِ نَعْلِهِ، وَالنَّارُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muwsaa bnu mas'uwdin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an mansuwrin, waalaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aljannaau aaqrabu iilaa aahadikum min shiraaki na'lihi, waalnnaaru mithlu dhalika ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Paradise is nearer to any of you than the Shirak (leather strap) of his shoe, and so is the (Hell) Fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَصْدَقُ بَيْتٍ قَالَهُ الشَّاعِرُ أَلاَ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ مَا خَلاَ اللَّهَ بَاطِلُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aasdaqu baytin qaalahu alshhaa'iru aalaa kullu shaa'in maa khalaa alllaha baatilu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The truest poetic verse ever said by a poet, is: Indeed! Everything except Allah, is perishable
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا نَظَرَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى مَنْ فُضِّلَ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْخَلْقِ، فَلْيَنْظُرْ إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ أَسْفَلَ مِنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa nazara aahadukum iilaa man fuddila 'alayhi fiy almaali waalkhalqi, falyanzur iilaa man huwa aasfala minhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you looked at a person who was made superior to him in property and (in good) appearance, then he should also look at the one who is inferior to him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْدٌ أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو رَجَاءٍ الْعُطَارِدِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيمَا يَرْوِي عَنْ رَبِّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ قَالَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ الْحَسَنَاتِ وَالسَّيِّئَاتِ، ثُمَّ بَيَّنَ ذَلِكَ فَمَنْ هَمَّ بِحَسَنَةٍ فَلَمْ يَعْمَلْهَا كَتَبَهَا اللَّهُ لَهُ عِنْدَهُ حَسَنَةً كَامِلَةً، فَإِنْ هُوَ هَمَّ بِهَا فَعَمِلَهَا كَتَبَهَا اللَّهُ لَهُ عِنْدَهُ عَشْرَ حَسَنَاتٍ إِلَى سَبْعِمِائَةِ ضِعْفٍ إِلَى أَضْعَافٍ كَثِيرَةٍ، وَمَنْ هَمَّ بِسَيِّئَةٍ فَلَمْ يَعْمَلْهَا كَتَبَهَا اللَّهُ لَهُ عِنْدَهُ حَسَنَةً كَامِلَةً، فَإِنْ هُوَ هَمَّ بِهَا فَعَمِلَهَا كَتَبَهَا اللَّهُ لَهُ سَيِّئَةً وَاحِدَةً ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, haddathanaa ja'dun aabuw 'uthmaana, haddathanaa aabuw rajaa'in al'utaaridiyyu, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiymaa yarwiy 'an rabbihi 'azza wajalla qaala qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha kataba alhasanaati waalssayyiiaati, thumma bayyana dhalika faman hamma bihasanaain falam ya'malhaa katabahaa alllahu lahu 'indahu hasanaaan kaamilaaan, faiin huwa hamma bihaa fa'amilahaa katabahaa alllahu lahu 'indahu 'ashra hasanaatin iilaa sab'imiaiaai di'fin iilaa aad'aafin kathiyraain, waman hamma bisayyiiaain falam ya'malhaa katabahaa alllahu lahu 'indahu hasanaaan kaamilaaan, faiin huwa hamma bihaa fa'amilahaa katabahaa alllahu lahu sayyiiaaan waahidaaan ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) narrating about his Lord I'm and said, "Allah ordered (the appointed angels over you) that the good and the bad deeds be written, and He then showed (the way) how (to write). If somebody intends to do a good deed and he does not do it, then Allah will write for him a full good deed (in his account with Him); and if he intends to do a good deed and actually did it, then Allah will write for him (in his account) with Him (its reward equal) from ten to seven hundred times to many more times: and if somebody intended to do a bad deed and he does not do it, then Allah will write a full good deed (in his account) with Him, and if he intended to do it (a bad deed) and actually did it, then Allah will write one bad deed (in his account)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيٌّ، عَنْ غَيْلاَنَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَعْمَلُونَ أَعْمَالاً هِيَ أَدَقُّ فِي أَعْيُنِكُمْ مِنَ الشَّعَرِ، إِنْ كُنَّا نَعُدُّهَا عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمُوبِقَاتِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَعْنِي بِذَلِكَ الْمُهْلِكَاتِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa mahdiyyun, 'an ghaylaana, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala iinnakum lata'maluwna aa'maalaan hiya aadaqqu fiy aa'yunikum mina alshha'ari, iin kunnaa na'udduhaa 'alaa 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm almuwbiqaati‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi ya'niy bidhalika almuhlikaati‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ghailan:Anas said "You people do (bad) deeds (commit sins) which seem in your eyes as tiny (minute) than hair while we used to consider those (very deeds) during the life-time of the Prophet (ﷺ) as destructive sins
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، قَالَ نَظَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى رَجُلٍ يُقَاتِلُ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، وَكَانَ مِنْ أَعْظَمِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ غَنَاءً عَنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ فَلْيَنْظُرْ إِلَى هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَتَبِعَهُ رَجُلٌ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ حَتَّى جُرِحَ، فَاسْتَعْجَلَ الْمَوْتَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ بِذُبَابَةِ سَيْفِهِ، فَوَضَعَهُ بَيْنَ ثَدْيَيْهِ، فَتَحَامَلَ عَلَيْهِ، حَتَّى خَرَجَ مِنْ بَيْنِ كَتِفَيْهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ لَيَعْمَلُ فِيمَا يَرَى النَّاسُ عَمَلَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَإِنَّهُ لَمِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، وَيَعْمَلُ فِيمَا يَرَى النَّاسُ عَمَلَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ وَهْوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَإِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِخَوَاتِيمِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'ayyaashin, haddathanaa aabuw ghassaana, qaala haddathaniy aabuw haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi, qaala nazara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa rajulin yuqaatilu almushrikiyna, wakaana min aa'zami almuslimiyna ghanaa'an 'anhum faqaala ‏"‏ man aahabba aan yanzura iilaa rajulin min aahli alnnaari falyanzur iilaa hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ fatabi'ahu rajulun falam yazal 'alaa dhalika hattaa juriha, faasta'jala almawta‏.‏ faqaala bidhubaabaai sayfihi, fawada'ahu bayna thadyayhi, fatahaamala 'alayhi, hattaa kharaja min bayni katifayhi‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna al'abda laya'malu fiymaa yaraa alnnaasu 'amala aahli aljannaai, waiinnahu lamin aahli alnnaari, waya'malu fiymaa yaraa alnnaasu 'amala aahli alnnaari wahwa min aahli aljannaai, waiinnamaa alaa'maalu bikhawaatiymihaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d bin Sahl As-Sa`idi:The Prophet (ﷺ) looked at a man fighting against the pagans and he was one of the most competent persons fighting on behalf of the Muslims. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Let him who wants to look at a man from the dwellers of the (Hell) Fire, look at this (man)." Another man followed him and kept on following him till he (the fighter) was injured and, seeking to die quickly, he placed the blade tip of his sword between his breasts and leaned over it till it passed through his shoulders (i.e., committed suicide)." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "A person may do deeds that seem to the people as the deeds of the people of Paradise while in fact, he is from the dwellers of the (Hell) Fire: and similarly a person may do deeds that seem to the people as the deeds of the people of the (Hell) Fire while in fact, he is from the dwellers of Paradise. Verily, the (results of) deeds done, depend upon the last actions
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَىُّ النَّاسِ خَيْرٌ قَالَ ‏ "‏ رَجُلٌ جَاهَدَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ، وَرَجُلٌ فِي شِعْبٍ مِنَ الشِّعَابِ يَعْبُدُ رَبَّهُ، وَيَدَعُ النَّاسَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ الزُّبَيْدِيُّ وَسُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ وَالنُّعْمَانُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مَعْمَرٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ أَوْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ يُونُسُ وَابْنُ مُسَافِرٍ وَيَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy 'ataa'u bnu yaziyda, aanna aabaa sa'iydin, haddathahu qaala qiyla yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ waqaala muhammadu bnu yuwsufa haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu 'an 'ataa'i bni yaziyda alllaythiyyi 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi qaala jaa'a aa'raabiyyun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aaaau alnnaasi khayrun qaala ‏ "‏ rajulun jaahada binafsihi wamaalihi, warajulun fiy shi'bin mina alshhi'aabi ya'budu rabbahu, wayada'u alnnaasa min sharrihi ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu alzzubaydiyyu wasulaymaanu bnu kathiyrin waalnnu'maanu 'ani alzzuhriyyi‏.‏ waqaala ma'marun 'ani alzzuhriyyi 'an 'ataa'in aaw 'ubaydi alllahi 'an aabiy sa'iydin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ waqaala yuwnusu waabnu musaafirin wayahyaa bnu sa'iydin 'ani abni shihaabin 'an 'ataa'in 'an ba'di aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:A bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who is the best of mankind!" The Prophet said, "A man who strives for Allah's Cause with his life and property, and also a man who lives (all alone) in a mountain path among the mountain paths to worship his Lord and save the people from his evil
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمَاجِشُونُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يَأْتِي عَلَى النَّاسِ زَمَانٌ خَيْرُ مَالِ الرَّجُلِ الْمُسْلِمِ الْغَنَمُ، يَتْبَعُ بِهَا شَعَفَ الْجِبَالِ وَمَوَاقِعَ الْقَطْرِ، يَفِرُّ بِدِينِهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa almaajishuwnu, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy sa'sa'aaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, aannahu sami'ahu yaquwlu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ yaatiy 'alaa alnnaasi zamaanun khayru maali alrrajuli almuslimi alghanamu, yatba'u bihaa sha'afa aljibaali wamawaaqi'a alqatri, yafirru bidiynihi mina alfitani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id:I heard from the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "There will come a time upon the people when the best property of a Muslim will be sheep which he will take to the tops of mountains and to the places of rainfall, run away with his religion (in order to save it) from afflictions
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِلاَلُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا ضُيِّعَتِ الأَمَانَةُ فَانْتَظِرِ السَّاعَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ كَيْفَ إِضَاعَتُهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أُسْنِدَ الأَمْرُ إِلَى غَيْرِ أَهْلِهِ، فَانْتَظِرِ السَّاعَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu sinaanin, haddathanaa fulayhu bnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa hilaalu bnu 'aliyyin, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iidhaa duyyi'ati alaamaanaau faantaziri alssaa'aaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala kayfa iidaa'atuhaa yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ iidhaa ausnida alaamru iilaa ghayri aahlihi, faantaziri alssaa'aaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When honesty is lost, then wait for the Hour." It was asked, "How will honesty be lost, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "When authority is given to those who do not deserve it, then wait for the Hour
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُذَيْفَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدِيثَيْنِ رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَهُمَا وَأَنَا أَنْتَظِرُ الآخَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا ‏"‏ أَنَّ الأَمَانَةَ نَزَلَتْ فِي جَذْرِ قُلُوبِ الرِّجَالِ، ثُمَّ عَلِمُوا مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ، ثُمَّ عَلِمُوا مِنَ السُّنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا عَنْ رَفْعِهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ يَنَامُ الرَّجُلُ النَّوْمَةَ فَتُقْبَضُ الأَمَانَةُ مِنْ قَلْبِهِ، فَيَظَلُّ أَثَرُهَا مِثْلَ أَثَرِ الْوَكْتِ، ثُمَّ يَنَامُ النَّوْمَةَ فَتُقْبَضُ فَيَبْقَى أَثَرُهَا مِثْلَ الْمَجْلِ، كَجَمْرٍ دَحْرَجْتَهُ عَلَى رِجْلِكَ فَنَفِطَ، فَتَرَاهُ مُنْتَبِرًا، وَلَيْسَ فِيهِ شَىْءٌ، فَيُصْبِحُ النَّاسُ يَتَبَايَعُونَ فَلاَ يَكَادُ أَحَدٌ يُؤَدِّي الأَمَانَةَ، فَيُقَالُ إِنَّ فِي بَنِي فُلاَنٍ رَجُلاً أَمِينًا‏.‏ وَيُقَالُ لِلرَّجُلِ مَا أَعْقَلَهُ وَمَا أَظْرَفَهُ وَمَا أَجْلَدَهُ‏.‏ وَمَا فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ حَبَّةِ خَرْدَلٍ مِنْ إِيمَانٍ، وَلَقَدْ أَتَى عَلَىَّ زَمَانٌ وَمَا أُبَالِي أَيَّكُمْ بَايَعْتُ لَئِنْ كَانَ مُسْلِمًا رَدَّهُ الإِسْلاَمُ، وَإِنْ كَانَ نَصْرَانِيًّا رَدَّهُ عَلَىَّ سَاعِيهِ، فَأَمَّا الْيَوْمَ فَمَا كُنْتُ أُبَايِعُ إِلاَّ فُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ الْفِرَبْرِيُّ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَحْمَدَ بْنَ عَاصِمٍ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عُبَيْدٍ يَقُولُ قَالَ الأَصْمَعِيُّ وَأَبُو عَمْرٍو وَغَيْرُهُمَا جَذْرُ قُلُوبِ الرِّجَالِ الْجَذْرُ الأَصْلُ مِنْ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ، وَالْوَكْتُ أَثَرُ الشَّىْءِ الْيَسِيرُ مِنْهُ، وَالْمَجْلُ أَثَرُ الْعَمَلِ فِي الْكَفِّ إِذَا غَلُظَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an zaydi bni wahbin, haddathanaa hudhayfaau, qaala haddathanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hadiythayni raaaytu aahadahumaa waaanaa aantaziru alakhara, haddathanaa ‏"‏ aanna alaamaanaaa nazalat fiy jadhri quluwbi alrrijaali, thumma 'alimuwa mina alqurani, thumma 'alimuwa mina alssunnaai ‏"‏‏.‏ wahaddathanaa 'an raf'ihaa qaala ‏"‏ yanaamu alrrajulu alnnawmaaa fatuqbadu alaamaanaau min qalbihi, fayazallu aatharuhaa mithla aathari alwakti, thumma yanaamu alnnawmaaa fatuqbadu fayabqaa aatharuhaa mithla almajli, kajamrin dahrajtahu 'alaa rijlika fanafita, fataraahu muntabirana, walaysa fiyhi shaa'un, fayusbihu alnnaasu yatabaaya'uwna falaa yakaadu aahadun yuuaddiy alaamaanaaa, fayuqaalu iinna fiy baniy fulaanin rajulaan aamiynana‏.‏ wayuqaalu lilrrajuli maa aa'qalahu wamaa aazrafahu wamaa aajladahu‏.‏ wamaa fiy qalbihi mithqaalu habbaai khardalin min iiymaanin, walaqad aataa 'alaaaa zamaanun wamaa aubaaliy aayyakum baaya'tu laiin kaana muslimana raddahu aliislaamu, waiin kaana nasraaniyyana raddahu 'alaaaa saa'iyhi, faaammaa alyawma famaa kuntu aubaayi'u iilaaa fulaanana wafulaanana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala alfirabriyyu qaala aabuw ja'farin haddathtu aabaa 'abdi alllahi faqaala sami'tu aahmada bna 'aasimin yaquwlu sami'tu aabaa 'ubaydin yaquwlu qaala alaasma'iyyu waaabuw 'amrinw waghayruhumaa jadhru quluwbi alrrijaali aljadhru alaaslu min kulli shaa'in, waalwaktu aatharu alshhaa'i alyasiyru minhu, waalmajlu aatharu al'amali fiy alkaffi iidhaa ghaluza‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hudhaifa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) narrated to us two narrations, one of which I have seen (happening) and I am waiting for the other. He narrated that honesty was preserved in the roots of the hearts of men (in the beginning) and then they learnt it (honesty) from the Qur'an, and then they learnt it from the (Prophet's) Sunna (tradition). He also told us about its disappearance, saying, "A man will go to sleep whereupon honesty will be taken away from his heart, and only its trace will remain, resembling the traces of fire. He then will sleep whereupon the remainder of the honesty will also be taken away (from his heart) and its trace will resemble a blister which is raised over the surface of skin, when an ember touches one's foot; and in fact, this blister does not contain anything. So there will come a day when people will deal in business with each other but there will hardly be any trustworthy persons among them. Then it will be said that in such-and-such a tribe there is such-and-such person who is honest, and a man will be admired for his intelligence, good manners and strength, though indeed he will not have belief equal to a mustard seed in his heart." The narrator added: There came upon me a time when I did not mind dealing with anyone of you, for if he was a Muslim, his religion would prevent him from cheating; and if he was a Christian, his Muslim ruler would prevent him from cheating; but today I cannot deal except with so-and-so and so-and-so. (See Hadith No. 208, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا النَّاسُ كَالإِبِلِ الْمِائَةُ لاَ تَكَادُ تَجِدُ فِيهَا رَاحِلَةً ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinnamaa alnnaasu kaaliibili almiaiaau laa takaadu tajidu fiyhaa raahilaaan ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "People are just like camels, out of one hundred, one can hardly find a single camel suitable to ride
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ كُهَيْلٍ،‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جُنْدَبًا، يَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَمْ أَسْمَعْ أَحَدًا يَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرَهُ فَدَنَوْتُ مِنْهُ فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ سَمَّعَ سَمَّعَ اللَّهُ بِهِ، وَمَنْ يُرَائِي يُرَائِي اللَّهُ بِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, haddathaniy salamaau bnu kuhaylin, ‏.‏ wahaddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an salamaaa, qaala sami'tu jundabana, yaquwlu qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm walam aasma' aahadana yaquwlu qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ghayrahu fadanawtu minhu fasami'tuhu yaquwlu qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man samma'a samma'a alllahu bihi, waman yuraaiiy yuraaiiy alllahu bihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jundub:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who lets the people hear of his good deeds intentionally, to win their praise, Allah will let the people know his real intention (on the Day of Resurrection), and he who does good things in public to show off and win the praise of the people, Allah will disclose his real intention (and humiliate him)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَيْنَمَا أَنَا رَدِيفُ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْسَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ إِلاَّ آخِرَةُ الرَّحْلِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، ثُمَّ سَارَ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، ثُمَّ سَارَ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ بْنَ جَبَلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ‏:‏ لَبَّيْكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَسَعْدَيْكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ تَدْرِي مَا حَقُّ اللَّهِ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ حَقُّ اللَّهِ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ أَنْ يَعْبُدُوهُ، وَلاَ يُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَارَ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ بْنَ جَبَلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَسَعْدَيْكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ تَدْرِي مَا حَقُّ الْعِبَادِ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِذَا فَعَلُوهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ حَقُّ الْعِبَادِ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ لاَ يُعَذِّبَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hudbaau bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, 'an mu'aadhi bni jabalin rda allh 'nh qaala baynamaa aanaa radiyfu alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm laysa bayniy wabaynahu iilaaa akhiraau alrrahli faqaala ‏"‏ yaa mu'aadhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labbayka yaa rasuwla alllahi wasa'dayka, thumma saara saa'aaan thumma qaala ‏"‏ yaa mu'aadhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labbayka rasuwla alllahi wasa'dayka, thumma saara saa'aaan thumma qaala ‏"‏ yaa mu'aadhu bna jabalin ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu‏:‏ labbayka rasuwla alllahi wasa'dayka‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ hal tadriy maa haqqu alllahi 'alaa 'ibaadihi ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ haqqu alllahi 'alaa 'ibaadihi aan ya'buduwhu, walaa yushrikuwa bihi shayiana ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma saara saa'aaan thumma qaala ‏"‏ yaa mu'aadhu bna jabalin ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labbayka rasuwla alllahi wasa'dayka‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ hal tadriy maa haqqu al'ibaadi 'alaa alllahi iidhaa fa'aluwhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ haqqu al'ibaadi 'alaa alllahi aan laa yu'adhhibahum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mu`adh bin Jabal:While I was riding behind the Prophet (ﷺ) as a companion rider and there was nothing between me and him except the back of the saddle, he said, "O Mu`adh!" I replied, "Labbaik O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! And Sa`daik!" He proceeded for a while and then said, "O Mu`adh!" I said, "Labbaik and Sa`daik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He then proceeded for another while and said, "O Mu`adh bin Jabal!" I replied, "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Sa`daik!" He said, "Do you know what is Allah's right on His slaves?" I replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He said, "Allah's right on his slaves is that they should worship Him and not worship anything besides Him." He then proceeded for a while, and again said, "O Mu`adh bin Jabal!" I replied. "Labbaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Sa`daik." He said, "Do you know what is (Allah's) slaves' (people's) right on Allah if they did that?" I replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He said, "The right of (Allah's) slaves on Allah is that He should not punish them (if they did that)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَاقَةٌ‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا الْفَزَارِيُّ وَأَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ كَانَتْ نَاقَةٌ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تُسَمَّى الْعَضْبَاءَ، وَكَانَتْ لاَ تُسْبَقُ، فَجَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ عَلَى قَعُودٍ لَهُ فَسَبَقَهَا، فَاشْتَدَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَقَالُوا سُبِقَتِ الْعَضْبَاءُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ حَقًّا عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ لاَ يَرْفَعَ شَيْئًا مِنَ الدُّنْيَا إِلاَّ وَضَعَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa maaliku bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa humaydun, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh kaana lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm naaqaaun‏.‏ qaala wahaddathaniy muhammadun aakhbaranaa alfazaariyyu waaabuw khaalidin alaahmaru 'an humaydin alttawiyli 'an aanasin qaala kaanat naaqaaun lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm tusammaa al'adbaa'a, wakaanat laa tusbaqu, fajaa'a aa'raabiyyun 'alaa qa'uwdin lahu fasabaqahaa, faashtadda dhalika 'alaa almuslimiyna waqaaluwa subiqati al'adbaa'u, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna haqqana 'alaa alllahi aan laa yarfa'a shayiana mina alddunyaa iilaaa wada'ahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) had a she-camel called Al-`Adba' and it was too fast to surpass in speed. There came a bedouin riding a camel of his, and that camel outstripped it (i.e. Al-Aqba'). That result was hard on the Muslims who said sorrowfully, "Al- Adba has been outstripped." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is due from Allah that nothing would be raised high in this world except that He lowers or puts it down
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنِي شَرِيكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَالَ مَنْ عَادَى لِي وَلِيًّا فَقَدْ آذَنْتُهُ بِالْحَرْبِ، وَمَا تَقَرَّبَ إِلَىَّ عَبْدِي بِشَىْءٍ أَحَبَّ إِلَىَّ مِمَّا افْتَرَضْتُ عَلَيْهِ، وَمَا يَزَالُ عَبْدِي يَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَىَّ بِالنَّوَافِلِ حَتَّى أُحِبَّهُ، فَإِذَا أَحْبَبْتُهُ كُنْتُ سَمْعَهُ الَّذِي يَسْمَعُ بِهِ، وَبَصَرَهُ الَّذِي يُبْصِرُ بِهِ، وَيَدَهُ الَّتِي يَبْطُشُ بِهَا وَرِجْلَهُ الَّتِي يَمْشِي بِهَا، وَإِنْ سَأَلَنِي لأُعْطِيَنَّهُ، وَلَئِنِ اسْتَعَاذَنِي لأُعِيذَنَّهُ، وَمَا تَرَدَّدْتُ عَنْ شَىْءٍ أَنَا فَاعِلُهُ تَرَدُّدِي عَنْ نَفْسِ الْمُؤْمِنِ، يَكْرَهُ الْمَوْتَ وَأَنَا أَكْرَهُ مَسَاءَتَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'uthmaana, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, haddathaniy shariyku bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy namirin, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha qaala man 'aadaa liy waliyyana faqad adhantuhu bialharbi, wamaa taqarraba iilaaaa 'abdiy bishaa'in aahabba iilaaaa mimmaa aftaradtu 'alayhi, wamaa yazaalu 'abdiy yataqarrabu iilaaaa bialnnawaafili hattaa auhibbahu, faiidhaa aahbabtuhu kuntu sam'ahu alladhiy yasma'u bihi, wabasarahu alladhiy yubsiru bihi, wayadahu allatiy yabtushu bihaa warijlahu allatiy yamshiy bihaa, waiin saaalaniy lau'tiyannahu, walaiini asta'aadhaniy lau'iydhannahu, wamaa taraddadtu 'an shaa'in aanaa faa'iluhu taraddudiy 'an nafsi almuumini, yakrahu almawta waaanaa aakrahu masaa'atahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'I will declare war against him who shows hostility to a pious worshipper of Mine. And the most beloved things with which My slave comes nearer to Me, is what I have enjoined upon him; and My slave keeps on coming closer to Me through performing Nawafil (praying or doing extra deeds besides what is obligatory) till I love him, so I become his sense of hearing with which he hears, and his sense of sight with which he sees, and his hand with which he grips, and his leg with which he walks; and if he asks Me, I will give him, and if he asks My protection (Refuge), I will protect him; (i.e. give him My Refuge) and I do not hesitate to do anything as I hesitate to take the soul of the believer, for he hates death, and I hate to disappoint him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ بُعِثْتُ أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةَ هَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَيُشِيرُ بِإِصْبَعَيْهِ فَيَمُدُّ بِهِمَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, haddathanaa aabuw ghassaana, haddathanaa aabuw haazimin, 'an sahlin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ bu'ithtu aanaa waalssaa'aaa hakadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ wayushiyru biiisba'ayhi fayamuddu bihimaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have been sent and the Hour (is at hand) as these two," showing his two fingers and sticking (separating) them out
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ـ هُوَ الْجُعْفِيُّ ـ حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، وَأَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ بُعِثْتُ أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةَ كَهَاتَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin huwa alju'fiyyu haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, waaabiy alttayyaahi, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ bu'ithtu aanaa waalssaa'aaa kahaatayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have been sent and the Hour (is at hand) as these two (fingers)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ بُعِثْتُ أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةَ كَهَاتَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ يَعْنِي إِصْبَعَيْنِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa aabuw bakrin, 'an aabiy hasiynin, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ bu'ithtu aanaa waalssaa'aaa kahaatayni ‏"‏‏.‏ ya'niy iisba'ayni‏.‏ taaba'ahu iisraaiiylu 'an aabiy hasiynin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been sent and the Hour (is at hand) as these two (fingers)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، رضى الله عنه أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا، فَإِذَا طَلَعَتْ فَرَآهَا النَّاسُ آمَنُوا أَجْمَعُونَ، فَذَلِكَ حِينَ لاَ يَنْفَعُ نَفْسًا إِيمَانُهَا، لَمْ تَكُنْ آمَنَتْ مِنْ قَبْلُ، أَوْ كَسَبَتْ فِي إِيمَانِهَا خَيْرًا، وَلَتَقُومَنَّ السَّاعَةُ وَقَدْ نَشَرَ الرَّجُلاَنِ ثَوْبَهُمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَلاَ يَتَبَايَعَانِهِ وَلاَ يَطْوِيَانِهِ، وَلَتَقُومَنَّ السَّاعَةُ وَقَدِ انْصَرَفَ الرَّجُلُ بِلَبَنِ لِقْحَتِهِ فَلاَ يَطْعَمُهُ، وَلَتَقُومَنَّ السَّاعَةُ وَهْوَ يَلِيطُ حَوْضَهُ فَلاَ يَسْقِي فِيهِ، وَلَتَقُومَنَّ السَّاعَةُ وَقَدْ رَفَعَ أُكْلَتَهُ إِلَى فِيهِ فَلاَ يَطْعَمُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa tatlu'a alshhamsu min maghribihaa, faiidhaa tala'at faraahaa alnnaasu amanuwa aajma'uwna, fadhalika hiyna laa yanfa'u nafsana iiymaanuhaa, lam takun amanat min qablu, aaw kasabat fiy iiymaanihaa khayrana, walataquwmanna alssaa'aau waqad nashara alrrajulaani thawbahumaa baynahumaa falaa yatabaaya'aanihi walaa yatwiyaanihi, walataquwmanna alssaa'aau waqadi ansarafa alrrajulu bilabani liqhatihi falaa yat'amuhu, walataquwmanna alssaa'aau wahwa yaliytu hawdahu falaa yasqiy fiyhi, walataquwmanna alssaa'aau waqad rafa'a auklatahu iilaa fiyhi falaa yat'amuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established till the sun rises from the west, and when it rises (from the west) and the people see it, then all of them will believe (in Allah). But that will be the time when 'No good it will do to a soul to believe then. If it believed not before.."' (6.158) The Hour will be established (so suddenly) that two persons spreading a garment between them will not be able to finish their bargain, nor will they be able to fold it up. The Hour will be established while a man is carrying the milk of his she-camel, but cannot drink it; and the Hour will be established when someone is not able to prepare the tank to water his livestock from it; and the Hour will be established when some of you has raised his food to his mouth but cannot eat it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَحَبَّ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ، وَمَنْ كَرِهَ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ كَرِهَ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ أَوْ بَعْضُ أَزْوَاجِهِ إِنَّا لَنَكْرَهُ الْمَوْتَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَيْسَ ذَاكَ، وَلَكِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ إِذَا حَضَرَهُ الْمَوْتُ بُشِّرَ بِرِضْوَانِ اللَّهِ وَكَرَامَتِهِ، فَلَيْسَ شَىْءٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا أَمَامَهُ، فَأَحَبَّ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ وَأَحَبَّ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ، وَإِنَّ الْكَافِرَ إِذَا حُضِرَ بُشِّرَ بِعَذَابِ اللَّهِ وَعُقُوبَتِهِ، فَلَيْسَ شَىْءٌ أَكْرَهَ إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا أَمَامَهُ، كَرِهَ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ وَكَرِهَ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ اخْتَصَرَهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَعَمْرٌو عَنْ شُعْبَةَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ سَعْدٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa hajaaajun, hadaathanaa hamaaamun, hadaathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasin, 'an 'ubaadaaa bni alsaaamiti, 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ man aahabaa liqaa'a allaahi aahabaa allaahu liqaa'ahu, waman kariha liqaa'a allaahi kariha allaahu liqaa'ahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau aaw ba'du aazwaajihi iinaaa lanakrahu almawta‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laysa dhaaka, walakinaa almuumina iidhaa hadarahu almawtu bushiira biridwaani allaahi wakaraamatihi, falaysa shaa'un aahabaa iilayhi mimaaa aamaamahu, faaahabaa liqaa'a allaahi waaahabaa allaahu liqaa'ahu, waiinaa alkaafira iidhaa hudira bushiira bi'adhaabi allaahi wa'uquwbatihi, falaysa shaa'un aakraha iilayhi mimaaa aamaamahu, kariha liqaa'a allaahi wakariha allaahu liqaa'ahu ‏"‏‏.‏ akhtasarahu aabuw daawuda wa'amrunw 'an shu'baaa‏.‏ waqaala sa'iydun 'an qataadaaa 'an zuraaraaa 'an sa'din 'an 'aaiishaaa 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who-ever loves to meet Allah, Allah (too) loves to meet him and who-ever hates to meet Allah, Allah (too) hates to meet him". `Aisha, or some of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "But we dislike death." He said: It is not like this, but it is meant that when the time of the death of a believer approaches, he receives the good news of Allah's pleasure with him and His blessings upon him, and so at that time nothing is dearer to him than what is in front of him. He therefore loves the meeting with Allah, and Allah (too) loves the meeting with him. But when the time of the death of a disbeliever approaches, he receives the evil news of Allah's torment and His Requital, whereupon nothing is more hateful to him than what is before him. Therefore, he hates the meeting with Allah, and Allah too, hates the meeting with him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَحَبَّ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ، وَمَنْ كَرِهَ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ كَرِهَ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathaniy muhamaadu bnu al'alaa'i, hadaathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man aahabaa liqaa'a allaahi aahabaa allaahu liqaa'ahu, waman kariha liqaa'a allaahi kariha allaahu liqaa'ahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever loves to meet Allah, Allah loves to meet him; and whoever hates to meet Allah, Allah hates to meet him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَعُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، فِي رِجَالٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ وَهْوَ صَحِيحٌ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يُقْبَضْ نَبِيٌّ قَطُّ حَتَّى يَرَى مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ ثُمَّ يُخَيَّرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا نَزَلَ بِهِ، وَرَأْسُهُ عَلَى فَخِذِي، غُشِيَ عَلَيْهِ سَاعَةً، ثُمَّ أَفَاقَ، فَأَشْخَصَ بَصَرَهُ إِلَى السَّقْفِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ الرَّفِيقَ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ إِذًا لاَ يَخْتَارُنَا، وَعَرَفْتُ أَنَّهُ الْحَدِيثُ الَّذِي كَانَ يُحَدِّثُنَا بِهِ ـ قَالَتْ ـ فَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ آخِرَ كَلِمَةٍ تَكَلَّمَ بِهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَوْلُهُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ الرَّفِيقَ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathaniy yahyaa bnu bukayrin, hadaathanaa allaaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayaabi, wa'urwaau bnu alzuubayri, fiy rijaalin min aahli al'ilmi aanaa 'aaiishaaa zawja alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat kaana rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu wahwa sahiyhun ‏"‏ iinaahu lam yuqbad nabiyunn qatuu hataaa yaraa maq'adahu mina aljanaaai thumaa yukhayaaru ‏"‏‏.‏ falamaaa nazala bihi, waraasuhu 'alaa fakhidhiy, ghushiya 'alayhi saa'aaan, thumaa aafaaqa, faaashkhasa basarahu iilaa alsaaqfi thumaa qaala ‏"‏ allaahumaa alraafiyqa alaa'laa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu iidhana laa yakhtaarunaa, wa'araftu aanaahu alhadiythu alaadhiy kaana yuhadiithunaa bihi qaalat fakaanat tilka akhira kalimaain takalaama bihaa alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm qawluhu ‏"‏ allaahumaa alraafiyqa alaa'laa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in good health, he used to say, "No prophet's soul is ever captured unless he is shown his place in Paradise and given the option (to die or survive)." So when the death of the Prophet (ﷺ) approached and his head was on my thigh, he became unconscious for a while and then he came to his senses and fixed his eyes on the ceiling and said, "O Allah (with) the highest companions." (See Qur'an 4:69). I said' "Hence he is not going to choose us." And I came to know that it was the application of the narration which he (the Prophet) used to narrate to us. And that was the last statement of the Prophet (before his death) i.e., "O Allah! With the highest companions." (See Qur'an 4:)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا عَمْرٍو، ذَكْوَانَ مَوْلَى عَائِشَةَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ كَانَتْ تَقُولُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهَ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ رَكْوَةٌ ـ أَوْ عُلْبَةٌ فِيهَا مَاءٌ، يَشُكُّ عُمَرُ ـ فَجَعَلَ يُدْخِلُ يَدَيْهِ فِي الْمَاءِ، فَيَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا وَجْهَهُ وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، إِنَّ لِلْمَوْتِ سَكَرَاتٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ نَصَبَ يَدَهُ فَجَعَلَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ فِي الرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏‏.‏ حَتَّى قُبِضَ وَمَالَتْ يَدُهُ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْد اللَّهِ الْعُلْبَةُ مِنْ الْخَشَبِ وَالرَّكْوَةُ مِنْ الْأَدَمِ
verses.translit: hadaathaniy muhamaadu bnu 'ubaydi bni maymuwnin, hadaathanaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, 'an 'umara bni sa'iydin, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu aabiy mulaykaaa, aanaa aabaa 'amrinw, dhakwaana mawlaa 'aaiishaaa aakhbarahu aanaa 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha kaanat taquwlu iinaa rasuwla allaaha sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana bayna yadayhi rakwaaun aaw 'ulbaaun fiyhaa maa'un, yashukuu 'umaru faja'ala yudkhilu yadayhi fiy almaa'i, fayamsahu bihimaa wajhahu wayaquwlu ‏"‏ laa iilaha iilaaa allaahu, iinaa lilmawti sakaraatin ‏"‏‏.‏ thumaa nasaba yadahu faja'ala yaquwlu ‏"‏ fiy alraafiyqi alaa'laa ‏"‏‏.‏ hataaa qubida wamaalat yaduhu‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abd allaahi al'ulbaau min alkhashabi waalraakwaau min alaadami
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:There was a leather or wood container full of water in front of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (at the time of his death). He would put his hand into the water and rub his face with it, saying, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah! No doubt, death has its stupors." Then he raised his hand and started saying, "(O Allah!) with the highest companions." (See Qur'an 4:69) (and kept on saying it) till he expired and his hand dropped
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي صَدَقَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِنَ الأَعْرَابِ جُفَاةً يَأْتُونَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَسْأَلُونَهُ مَتَى السَّاعَةُ، فَكَانَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى أَصْغَرِهِمْ فَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنْ يَعِشْ هَذَا لاَ يُدْرِكْهُ الْهَرَمُ حَتَّى تَقُومَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَاعَتُكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ هِشَامٌ يَعْنِي مَوْتَهُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy sadaqaau, aakhbaranaa 'abdaau, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rijaalun mina alaa'raabi jufaaaan yaatuwna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fayasaaluwnahu mataa alssaa'aau, fakaana yanzuru iilaa aasgharihim fayaquwlu ‏ "‏ iin ya'ish hadhaa laa yudrikhu alharamu hattaa taquwma 'alaykum saa'atukum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala hishaamun ya'niy mawtahum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Some rough bedouins used to visit the Prophet (ﷺ) and ask him, "When will the Hour be?" He would look at the youngest of all of them and say, "If this should live till he is very old, your Hour (the death of the people addressed) will take place." Hisham said that he meant (by the Hour), their death
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَلْحَلَةَ، عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ بْنِ رِبْعِيٍّ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُرَّ عَلَيْهِ بِجِنَازَةٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مُسْتَرِيحٌ، وَمُسْتَرَاحٌ مِنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا الْمُسْتَرِيحُ وَالْمُسْتَرَاحُ مِنْهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْعَبْدُ الْمُؤْمِنُ يَسْتَرِيحُ مِنْ نَصَبِ الدُّنْيَا وَأَذَاهَا إِلَى رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ، وَالْعَبْدُ الْفَاجِرُ يَسْتَرِيحُ مِنْهُ الْعِبَادُ وَالْبِلاَدُ وَالشَّجَرُ وَالدَّوَابُّ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an muhammadi bni 'amriw bni halhalaaa, 'an ma'badi bni ka'bi bni maalikin, 'an aabiy qataadaaa bni rib'iyyin alaansaariyyi, aannahu kaana yuhaddithu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm murra 'alayhi bijinaazaain faqaala ‏"‏ mustariyhun, wamustaraahun minhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi maa almustariyhu waalmustaraahu minhu qaala ‏"‏ al'abdu almuuminu yastariyhu min nasabi alddunyaa waaadhaahaa iilaa rahmaai alllahi, waal'abdu alfaajiru yastariyhu minhu al'ibaadu waalbilaadu waalshhajaru waalddawaabbu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Qatada bin Rib'i Al-Ansari:A funeral procession passed by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who said, "Relieved or relieving?" The people asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is relieved and relieving?" He said, "A believer is relieved (by death) from the troubles and hardships of the world and leaves for the Mercy of Allah, while (the death of) a wicked person relieves the people, the land, the trees, (and) the animals from him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَلْحَلَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ كَعْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مُسْتَرِيحٌ، وَمُسْتَرَاحٌ مِنْهُ، الْمُؤْمِنُ يَسْتَرِيحُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'abdi rabbihi bni sa'iydin, 'an muhammadi bni 'amriw bni halhalaaa, haddathaniy abnu ka'bin, 'an aabiy qataadaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mustariyhun, wamustaraahun minhu, almuuminu yastariyhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Qatada:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Relieved or relieving. And a believer is relieved (by death)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَتْبَعُ الْمَيِّتَ ثَلاَثَةٌ، فَيَرْجِعُ اثْنَانِ وَيَبْقَى مَعَهُ وَاحِدٌ، يَتْبَعُهُ أَهْلُهُ وَمَالُهُ وَعَمَلُهُ، فَيَرْجِعُ أَهْلُهُ وَمَالُهُ، وَيَبْقَى عَمَلُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhumaydiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy bakri bni 'amriw bni hazmin, sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yatba'u almayyita thalaathaaun, fayarji'u athnaani wayabqaa ma'ahu waahidun, yatba'uhu aahluhu wamaaluhu wa'amaluhu, fayarji'u aahluhu wamaaluhu, wayabqaa 'amaluhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When carried to his grave, a dead person is followed by three, two of which return (after his burial) and one remains with him: his relative, his property, and his deeds follow him; relatives and his property go back while his deeds remain with him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا مَاتَ أَحَدُكُمْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ مَقْعَدُهُ غُدْوَةً وَعَشِيًّا، إِمَّا النَّارُ وَإِمَّا الْجَنَّةُ، فَيُقَالُ هَذَا مَقْعَدُكَ حَتَّى تُبْعَثَ ‏إِلَيْهِ"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw alnuu'maani, hadaathanaa hamaaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayuuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa maata aahadukum 'urida 'alayhi maq'aduhu ghudwaaan wa'ashiyanna, iimaaa alnaaaru waiimaaa aljanaaau, fayuqaalu hadhaa maq'aduka hataaa tub'atha ‏iilayhi"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you dies, his destination is displayed before him in the forenoon and in the afternoon, either in the (Hell) Fire or in Paradise, and it is said to him, "That is your place till you are resurrected and sent to it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْجَعْدِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَسُبُّوا الأَمْوَاتَ، فَإِنَّهُمْ قَدْ أَفْضَوْا إِلَى مَا قَدَّمُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu alja'di, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an mujaahidin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tasubbuwa alaamwaata, faiinnahum qad aafdawa iilaa maa qaddamuwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not abuse the dead, for they have reached the result of what they have done
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَالأَعْرَجِ، أَنَّهُمَا حَدَّثَاهُ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ اسْتَبَّ رَجُلاَنِ، رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَرَجُلٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ فَقَالَ الْمُسْلِمُ وَالَّذِي اصْطَفَى مُحَمَّدًا عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْيَهُودِيُّ وَالَّذِي اصْطَفَى مُوسَى عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ، قَالَ فَغَضِبَ الْمُسْلِمُ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ، فَلَطَمَ وَجْهَ الْيَهُودِيِّ، فَذَهَبَ الْيَهُودِيُّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ بِمَا كَانَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ وَأَمْرِ الْمُسْلِمِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تُخَيِّرُونِي عَلَى مُوسَى، فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ يَصْعَقُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، فَأَكُونُ فِي أَوَّلِ مَنْ يُفِيقُ، فَإِذَا مُوسَى بَاطِشٌ بِجَانِبِ الْعَرْشِ، فَلاَ أَدْرِي أَكَانَ مُوسَى فِيمَنْ صَعِقَ فَأَفَاقَ قَبْلِي، أَوْ كَانَ مِمَّنِ اسْتَثْنَى اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, waalaa'raji, aannahumaa haddathaahu aanna aabaa hurayraaa qaala astabba rajulaani, rajulun mina almuslimiyna warajulun mina alyahuwdi faqaala almuslimu waalladhiy astafaa muhammadana 'alaa al'aalamiyna‏.‏ faqaala alyahuwdiyyu waalladhiy astafaa muwsaa 'alaa al'aalamiyna, qaala faghadiba almuslimu 'inda dhalika, falatama wajha alyahuwdiyyi, fadhahaba alyahuwdiyyu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbarahu bimaa kaana min aamrihi waaamri almuslimi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tukhayyiruwniy 'alaa muwsaa, faiinna alnnaasa yas'aquwna yawma alqiyaamaai, faaakuwnu fiy aawwali man yufiyqu, faiidhaa muwsaa baatishun bijaanibi al'arshi, falaa aadriy aakaana muwsaa fiyman sa'iqa faaafaaqa qabliy, aaw kaana mimmani astathnaa alllahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Two men, a Muslim and a Jew, abused each other. The Muslim said, "By Him Who gave superiority to Muhammad over all the people." On that, the Jew said, "By Him Who gave superiority to Moses over all the people." The Muslim became furious at that and slapped the Jew in the face. The Jew went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him of what had happened between him and the Muslim. Allah's Apostle said, "Don't give me superiority over Moses, for the people will fall unconscious on the Day of Resurrection and I will be the first to gain consciousness, and behold ! Moses will be there holding the side of Allah's Throne. I will not know whether Moses has been among those people who have become unconscious and then has regained consciousness before me, or has been among those exempted by Allah from falling unconscious
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَصْعَقُ النَّاسُ حِينَ يَصْعَقُونَ، فَأَكُونُ أَوَّلَ مَنْ قَامَ، فَإِذَا مُوسَى آخِذٌ بِالْعَرْشِ، فَمَا أَدْرِي أَكَانَ فِيمَنْ صَعِقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ رَوَاهُ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yas'aqu alnnaasu hiyna yas'aquwna, faaakuwnu aawwala man qaama, faiidhaa muwsaa akhidhun bial'arshi, famaa aadriy aakaana fiyman sa'iqa ‏"‏‏.‏ rawaahu aabuw sa'iydin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people will fall down unconscious at the time when they should fall down (i.e., on the Day of Resurrection), and then I will be the first man to get up, and behold, Moses will be there holding (Allah's) Throne. I will not know whether he has been amongst those who have fallen unconscious
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
