verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَقْبِضُ اللَّهُ الأَرْضَ، وَيَطْوِي السَّمَاءَ بِيَمِينِهِ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ أَيْنَ مُلُوكُ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yaqbidu alllahu alaarda, wayatwiy alssamaa'a biyamiynihi, thumma yaquwlu aanaa almaliku aayna muluwku alaardi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah will take the whole earth (in His Hand) and will roll up the Heaven in His right Hand, and then He will say, "I am King! Where are the kings of the earth ?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَكُونُ الأَرْضُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ خُبْزَةً وَاحِدَةً، يَتَكَفَّؤُهَا الْجَبَّارُ بِيَدِهِ، كَمَا يَكْفَأُ أَحَدُكُمْ خُبْزَتَهُ فِي السَّفَرِ، نُزُلاً لأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَتَى رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ فَقَالَ بَارَكَ الرَّحْمَنُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ، أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكَ بِنُزُلِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَى ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ تَكُونُ الأَرْضُ خُبْزَةً وَاحِدَةً كَمَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَظَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَيْنَا، ثُمَّ ضَحِكَ حَتَّى بَدَتْ نَوَاجِذُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكَ بِإِدَامِهِمْ قَالَ إِدَامُهُمْ بَالاَمٌ وَنُونٌ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَمَا هَذَا قَالَ ثَوْرٌ وَنُونٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْ زَائِدَةِ كَبِدِهِمَا سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an khaalidin, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy hilaalin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ takuwnu alaardu yawma alqiyaamaai khubzaaan waahidaaan, yatakaffauuhaa aljabbaaru biyadihi, kamaa yakfaau aahadukum khubzatahu fiy alssafari, nuzulaan laahli aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏ faaataa rajulun mina alyahuwdi faqaala baaraka alrrahmanu 'alayka yaa aabaa alqaasimi, aalaa aukhbiruka binuzuli aahli aljannaai yawma alqiyaamaai qaala ‏"‏ balaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala takuwnu alaardu khubzaaan waahidaaan kamaa qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fanazara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaynaa, thumma dahika hattaa badat nawaajidhuhu thumma qaala aalaa aukhbiruka biiidaamihim qaala iidaamuhum baalaamun wanuwnun‏.‏ qaaluwa wamaa hadhaa qaala thawrun wanuwnun yaakulu min zaaiidaai kabidihimaa sab'uwna aalfana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The (planet of) earth will be a bread on the Day of Resurrection, and The resistible (Allah) will topple turn it with His Hand like anyone of you topple turns a bread with his hands while (preparing the bread) for a journey, and that bread will be the entertainment for the people of Paradise." A man from the Jews came (to the Prophet) and said, "May The Beneficent (Allah) bless you, O Abul Qasim! Shall I tell you of the entertainment of the people of Paradise on the Day of Resurrection?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." The Jew said, "The earth will be a bread," as the Prophet (ﷺ) had said. Thereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) looked at us and smiled till his premolar tooth became visible. Then the Jew further said, "Shall I tell you of the udm (additional food taken with bread) they will have with the bread?" He added, "That will be Balam and Nun." The people asked, "What is that?" He said, "It is an ox and a fish, and seventy thousand people will eat of the caudate lobe (i.e. extra lobe) of their livers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يُحْشَرُ النَّاسُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَى أَرْضٍ بَيْضَاءَ عَفْرَاءَ كَقُرْصَةِ نَقِيٍّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سَهْلٌ أَوْ غَيْرُهُ لَيْسَ فِيهَا مَعْلَمٌ لأَحَدٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaala haddathaniy aabuw haazimin, qaala sami'tu sahla bna sa'din, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ yuhsharu alnnaasu yawma alqiyaamaai 'alaa aardin baydaa'a 'afraa'a kaqursaai naqiyyin ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala sahlun aaw ghayruhu laysa fiyhaa ma'lamun laahadin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The people will be gathered on the Day of Resurrection on reddish white land like a pure loaf of bread (made of pure fine flour)." Sahl added: That land will have no landmarks for anybody (to make use of)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يُحْشَرُ النَّاسُ عَلَى ثَلاَثِ طَرَائِقَ، رَاغِبِينَ رَاهِبِينَ وَاثْنَانِ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ، وَثَلاَثَةٌ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ، وَأَرْبَعَةٌ عَلَى بَ��ِيرٍ، وَعَشَرَةٌ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ وَيَحْشُرُ بَقِيَّتَهُمُ النَّارُ، تَقِيلُ مَعَهُمْ حَيْثُ قَالُوا، وَتَبِيتُ مَعَهُمْ حَيْثُ بَاتُوا، وَتُصْبِحُ مَعَهُمْ حَيْثُ أَصْبَحُوا، وَتُمْسِي مَعَهُمْ حَيْثُ أَمْسَوْا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu aasadin, haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'ani abni taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yuhsharu alnnaasu 'alaa thalaathi taraaiiqa, raaghibiyna raahibiyna waathnaani 'alaa ba'iyrin, wathalaathaaun 'alaa ba'iyrin, waaarba'aaun 'alaa ba��iyrin, wa'asharaaun 'alaa ba'iyrin wayahshuru baqiyyatahumu alnnaaru, taqiylu ma'ahum haythu qaaluwa, watabiytu ma'ahum haythu baatuwa, watusbihu ma'ahum haythu aasbahuwa, watumsiy ma'ahum haythu aamsawa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people will be gathered in three ways: (The first way will be of) those who will wish or have a hope (for Paradise) and will have a fear (of punishment), (The second batch will be those who will gather) riding two on a camel or three on a camel or ten on a camel. (The third batch) the rest of the people will be urged to gather by the Fire which will accompany them at the time of their afternoon nap and stay with them where they will spend the night, and will be with them in the morning wherever they may be then, and will be with them in the afternoon wherever they may be then
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْبَغْدَادِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ يُحْشَرُ الْكَافِرُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلَيْسَ الَّذِي أَمْشَاهُ عَلَى الرِّجْلَيْنِ فِي الدُّنْيَا قَادِرًا عَلَى أَنَّ يُمْشِيَهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ بَلَى وَعِزَّةِ رَبِّنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa yuwnusu bnu muhammadin albaghdaadiyyu, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna rajulaan, qaala yaa nabiyya alllahi kayfa yuhsharu alkaafiru 'alaa wajhihi qaala ‏ "‏ aalaysa alladhiy aamshaahu 'alaa alrrijlayni fiy alddunyaa qaadirana 'alaa aanna yumshiyahu 'alaa wajhihi yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala qataadaau balaa wa'izzaai rabbinaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A man said, "O Allah's Prophet! Will a Kafir (disbeliever) be gathered (driven prone) on his face?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Is not He Who made him walk with his legs in this world, able to make him walk on his face on the Day of Resurrection?" (Qatada, a sub-narrator said: Yes, (He can), by the Power of Our Lord
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ عَمْرٌو سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّكُمْ مُلاَقُو اللَّهِ حُفَاةً عُرَاةً مُشَاةً غُرْلاً ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ هَذَا مِمَّا نَعُدُّ أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ سَمِعَهُ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala 'amrunw sami'tu sa'iyda bna jubayrin, sami'tu abna 'abbaasin, sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinnakum mulaaquw alllahi hufaaaan 'uraaaan mushaaaan ghurlaan ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu hadhaa mimmaa na'uddu aanna abna 'abbaasin sami'ahu mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You will meet Allah barefooted, naked, walking on feet, and uncircumcised
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّكُمْ مُلاَقُو اللَّهِ حُفَاةً عُرَاةً غُرْلاً ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu 'alaa alminbari yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinnakum mulaaquw alllahi hufaaaan 'uraaaan ghurlaan ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was delivering a sermon on a pulpit, saying, "You will meet Allah barefooted, naked, and uncircumcised
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَامَ فِينَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكُمْ مَحْشُورُونَ حُفَاةً عُرَاةً ‏{‏كَمَا بَدَأْنَا أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُعِيدُهُ‏}‏ الآيَةَ، وَإِنَّ أَوَّلَ الْخَلاَئِقِ يُكْسَى يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ، وَإِنَّهُ سَيُجَاءُ بِرِجَالٍ مِنْ أُمَّتِي، فَيُؤْخَذُ بِهِمْ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ‏.‏ فَأَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ أُصَيْحَابِي‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ إِنَّكَ لاَ تَدْرِي مَا أَحْدَثُوا بَعْدَكَ‏.‏ فَأَقُولُ كَمَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ ‏{‏وَكُنْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًا مَا دُمْتُ فِيهِمْ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏الْحَكِيمُ‏}‏ قَالَ فَيُقَالُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَزَالُوا مُرْتَدِّينَ عَلَى أَعْقَابِهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani almughiyraai bni alnnu'maani, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qaama fiynaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu faqaala ‏"‏ iinnakum mahshuwruwna hufaaaan 'uraaaan ‏{‏kamaa badaanaa aawwala khalqin nu'iyduhu‏}‏ alayaaa, waiinna aawwala alkhalaaiiqi yuksaa yawma alqiyaamaai iibraahiymu, waiinnahu sayujaa'u birijaalin min aummatiy, fayuukhadhu bihim dhaata alshhimaali‏.‏ faaaquwlu yaa rabbi ausayhaabiy‏.‏ fayaquwlu iinnaka laa tadriy maa aahdathuwa ba'daka‏.‏ faaaquwlu kamaa qaala al'abdu alssaalihu ‏{‏wakuntu 'alayhim shahiydana maa dumtu fiyhim‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏alhakiymu‏}‏ qaala fayuqaalu iinnahum lam yazaaluwa murtaddiyna 'alaa aa'qaabihim ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up among us and addressed (saying) "You will be gathered, barefooted, naked, and uncircumcised (as Allah says): 'As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it..' (21.104) And the first human being to be dressed on the Day of Resurrection will be (the Prophet) Abraham Al-Khalil. Then will be brought some men of my followers who will be taken towards the left (i.e., to the Fire), and I will say: 'O Lord! My companions whereupon Allah will say: You do not know what they did after you left them. I will then say as the pious slave, Jesus said, And I was witness over them while I dwelt amongst them..........(up to) ...the All-Wise.' (5.117-118). The narrator added: Then it will be said that those people (relegated from Islam, that is) kept on turning on their heels (deserted Islam)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ أَبِي صَغِيرَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تُحْشَرُونَ حُفَاةً عُرَاةً غُرْلاً ‏"‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الرِّجَالُ وَالنِّسَاءُ يَنْظُرُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى بَعْضٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ الأَمْرُ أَشَدُّ مِنْ أَنْ يُهِمَّهُمْ ذَاكِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qaysu bnu hafsin, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, haddathanaa haatimu bnu aabiy saghiyraaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy mulaykaaa, qaala haddathaniy alqaasimu bnu muhammadi bni aabiy bakrin, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ tuhsharuwna hufaaaan 'uraaaan ghurlaan ‏"‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi alrrijaalu waalnnisaa'u yanzuru ba'duhum iilaa ba'din‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ alaamru aashaddu min aan yuhimmahum dhaaki ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The people will be gathered barefooted, naked, and uncircumcised." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will the men and the women look at each other?" He said, "The situation will be too hard for them to pay attention to that
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي قُبَّةٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَرْضَوْنَ أَنْ تَكُونُوا رُبُعَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَرْضَوْنَ أَنْ تَكُونُوا ثُلُثَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَرْضَوْنَ أَنْ تَكُونُوا شَطْرَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ إِنِّي لأَرْجُو أَنْ تَكُونُوا نِصْفَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَذَلِكَ أَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ لاَ يَدْخُلُهَا إِلاَّ نَفْسٌ مُسْلِمَةٌ، وَمَا أَنْتُمْ فِي أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ إِلاَّ كَالشَّعْرَةِ الْبَيْضَاءِ فِي جِلْدِ الثَّوْرِ الأَسْوَدِ أَوْ كَالشَّعْرَةِ السَّوْدَاءِ فِي جِلْدِ الثَّوْرِ الأَحْمَرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an 'amriw bni maymuwnin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy qubbaain faqaala ‏"‏ aatardawna aan takuwnuwa rubu'a aahli aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏ qulnaa na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ tardawna aan takuwnuwa thulutha aahli aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏ qulnaa na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aatardawna aan takuwnuwa shatra aahli aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏ qulnaa na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ waalladhiy nafsu muhammadin biyadihi iinniy laarjuw aan takuwnuwa nisfa aahli aljannaai, wadhalika aanna aljannaaa laa yadkhuluhaa iilaaa nafsun muslimaaun, wamaa aantum fiy aahli alshhirki iilaaa kaalshha'raai albaydaa'i fiy jildi althhawri alaaswadi aaw kaalshha'raai alssawdaa'i fiy jildi althhawri alaahmari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:While we were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) in a tent he said, ''Would it please you to be one fourth of the people of Paradise?" We said, "Yes." He said, "Would It please you to be one-third of the people of Paradise?" We said, "Yes." He said, "Would it please you to be half of the people of Paradise?" We said, "Yes." Thereupon he said, "I hope that you will be one half of the people of Paradise, for none will enter Paradise but a Muslim soul, and you people, in comparison to the people who associate others in worship with Allah, are like a white hair on the skin of a black ox, or a black hair on the skin of a red ox
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي أَخِي، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ ثَوْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَوَّلُ مَنْ يُدْعَى يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ آدَمُ، فَتَرَاءَى ذُرِّيَّتُهُ فَيُقَالُ هَذَا أَبُوكُمْ آدَمُ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ أَخْرِجْ بَعْثَ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِكَ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ كَمْ أُخْرِجُ فَيَقُولُ أَخْرِجْ مِنْ كُلِّ مِائَةٍ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِذَا أُخِذَ مِنَّا مِنْ كُلِّ مِائَةٍ تِسْعَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ، فَمَاذَا يَبْقَى مِنَّا قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أُمَّتِي فِي الأُمَمِ كَالشَّعَرَةِ الْبَيْضَاءِ فِي الثَّوْرِ الأَسْوَدِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, haddathaniy aakhiy, 'an sulaymaana, 'an thawrin, 'an aabiy alghaythi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ aawwalu man yud'aa yawma alqiyaamaai adamu, fataraa'aa dhurriyyatuhu fayuqaalu hadhaa aabuwkum adamu‏.‏ fayaquwlu labbayka wasa'dayka‏.‏ fayaquwlu aakhrij ba'tha jahannama min dhurriyyatika‏.‏ fayaquwlu yaa rabbi kam aukhriju fayaquwlu aakhrij min kulli miaiaain tis'aaan watis'iyna ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi iidhaa aukhidha minnaa min kulli miaiaain tis'aaun watis'uwna, famaadhaa yabqaa minnaa qaala ‏"‏ iinna aummatiy fiy alaumami kaalshha'araai albaydaa'i fiy althhawri alaaswadi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The first man to be called on the Day of Resurrection will be Adam who will be shown his offspring, and it will be said to them, 'This is your father, Adam.' Adam will say (responding to the call), 'Labbaik and Sa`daik' Then Allah will say (to Adam), 'Take out of your offspring, the people of Hell.' Adam will say, 'O Lord, how many should I take out?' Allah will say, 'Take out ninety-nine out of every hundred." They (the Prophet's companions) said, "O Allah's Apostle! If ninety-nine out of every one hundred of us are taken away, what will remain out of us?" He said, "My followers in comparison to the other nations are like a white hair on a black ox
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ يَا آدَمُ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ فِي يَدَيْكَ‏.‏ قَالَ يَقُولُ أَخْرِجْ بَعْثَ النَّارِ‏.‏ قَالَ وَمَا بَعْثُ النَّارِ قَالَ مِنْ كُلِّ أَلْفٍ تِسْعَمِائَةٍ وَتِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ‏.‏ فَذَاكَ حِينَ يَشِيبُ الصَّغِيرُ، وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا، وَتَرَى النَّاسَ سَكْرَى وَمَا هُمْ بِسَكْرَى وَلَكِنَّ عَذَابَ اللَّهِ شَدِيدٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَاشْتَدَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَيُّنَا الرَّجُلُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَبْشِرُوا، فَإِنَّ مِنْ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ أَلْفٌ وَمِنْكُمْ رَجُلٌ ـ ثُمَّ قَالَ ـ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي فِي يَدِهِ إِنِّي لأَطْمَعُ أَنْ تَكُونُوا ثُلُثَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَمِدْنَا اللَّهَ وَكَبَّرْنَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي فِي يَدِهِ إِنِّي لأَطْمَعُ أَنْ تَكُونُوا شَطْرَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، إِنَّ مَثَلَكُمْ فِي الأُمَمِ كَمَثَلِ الشَّعَرَةِ الْبَيْضَاءِ فِي جِلْدِ الثَّوْرِ الأَسْوَدِ أَوِ الرَّقْمَةِ فِي ذِرَاعِ الْحِمَارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yuwsufu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaquwlu alllahu yaa adamu‏.‏ fayaquwlu labbayka wasa'dayka waalkhayru fiy yadayka‏.‏ qaala yaquwlu aakhrij ba'tha alnnaari‏.‏ qaala wamaa ba'thu alnnaari qaala min kulli aalfin tis'amiaiaain watis'aaan watis'iyna‏.‏ fadhaaka hiyna yashiybu alssaghiyru, watada'u kullu dhaati hamlin hamlahaa, wataraa alnnaasa sakraa wamaa hum bisakraa walakinna 'adhaaba alllahi shadiydun ‏"‏‏.‏ faashtadda dhalika 'alayhim faqaaluwa yaa rasuwlu alllahi aayyunaa alrrajulu qaala ‏"‏ aabshiruwa, faiinna min yaajuwja wamaajuwja aalfun waminkum rajulun thumma qaala waalladhiy nafsiy fiy yadihi iinniy laatma'u aan takuwnuwa thulutha aahli aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fahamidnaa alllaha wakabbarnaa, thumma qaala ‏"‏ waalladhiy nafsiy fiy yadihi iinniy laatma'u aan takuwnuwa shatra aahli aljannaai, iinna mathalakum fiy alaumami kamathali alshha'araai albaydaa'i fiy jildi althhawri alaaswadi aawi alrraqmaai fiy dhiraa'i alhimaari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah will say, 'O Adam!. Adam will reply, 'Labbaik and Sa`daik (I respond to Your Calls, I am obedient to Your orders), wal Khair fi Yadaik (and all the good is in Your Hands)!' Then Allah will say (to Adam), Bring out the people of the Fire.' Adam will say, 'What (how many) are the people of the Fire?' Allah will say, 'Out of every thousand (take out) nine hundred and ninety-nine (persons).' At that time children will become hoary-headed and every pregnant female will drop her load (have an abortion) and you will see the people as if they were drunk, yet not drunk; But Allah's punishment will be very severe." That news distressed the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) too much, and they said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who amongst us will be that man (the lucky one out of one-thousand who will be saved from the Fire)?" He said, "Have the good news that one-thousand will be from Gog and Magog, and the one (to be saved will be) from you." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, I Hope that you (Muslims) will be one third of the people of Paradise." On that, we glorified and praised Allah and said, "Allahu Akbar." The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, I hope that you will be one half of the people of Paradise, as your (Muslims) example in comparison to the other people (non-Muslims), is like that of a white hair on the skin of a black ox, or a round hairless spot on the foreleg of a donkey
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ ‏{‏يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ‏}‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَقُومُ أَحَدُهُمْ فِي رَشْحِهِ إِلَى أَنْصَافِ أُذُنَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu aabaana, haddathanaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa abnu 'awnin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ ‏{‏yawma yaquwmu alnnaasu lirabbi al'aalamiyna‏}‏ qaala ‏"‏ yaquwmu aahaduhum fiy rashhihi iilaa aansaafi audhunayhi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said (regarding the Verse), "A Day when all mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds,' (that day) they will stand, drowned in their sweat up to the middle of their ears
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَعْرَقُ النَّاسُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ عَرَقُهُمْ فِي الأَرْضِ سَبْعِينَ ذِرَاعًا، وَيُلْجِمُهُمْ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ آذَانَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy sulaymaanu, 'an thawri bni zaydin, 'an aabiy alghaythi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ ya'raqu alnnaasu yawma alqiyaamaai hattaa yadhhaba 'araquhum fiy alaardi sab'iyna dhiraa'ana, wayuljimuhum hattaa yablugha adhaanahum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The people will sweat so profusely on the Day of Resurrection that their sweat will sink seventy cubits deep into the earth, and it will rise up till it reaches the people's mouths and ears
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنِي شَقِيقٌ، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَوَّلُ مَا يُقْضَى بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالدِّمَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, haddathaniy shaqiyqun, sami'tu 'abda alllahi rda allh 'nh qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aawwalu maa yuqdaa bayna alnnaasi bialddimaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The cases which will be decided first (on the Day of Resurrection) will be the cases of blood-shedding
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَتْ عِنْدَهُ مَظْلَمَةٌ لأَخِيهِ فَلْيَتَحَلَّلْهُ مِنْهَا، فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ ثَمَّ دِينَارٌ وَلاَ دِرْهَمٌ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يُؤْخَذَ لأَخِيهِ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِهِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ حَسَنَاتٌ أُخِذَ مِنْ سَيِّئَاتِ أَخِيهِ، فَطُرِحَتْ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man kaanat 'indahu mazlamaaun laakhiyhi falyatahallalhu minhaa, faiinnahu laysa thamma diynaarun walaa dirhamun min qabli aan yuukhadha laakhiyhi min hasanaatihi, faiin lam yakun lahu hasanaatun aukhidha min sayyiiaati aakhiyhi, faturihat 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever has wronged his brother, should ask for his pardon (before his death), as (in the Hereafter) there will be neither a Dinar nor a Dirham. (He should secure pardon in this life) before some of his good deeds are taken and paid to his brother, or, if he has done no good deeds, some of the bad deeds of his brother are taken to be loaded on him (in the Hereafter)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي الصَّلْتُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، ‏{‏وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِمْ مِنْ غِلٍّ‏}‏ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ النَّاجِيِّ أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَخْلُصُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ مِنَ النَّارِ، فَيُحْبَسُونَ عَلَى قَنْطَرَةٍ بَيْنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ، فَيُقَصُّ لِبَعْضِهِمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ، مَظَالِمُ كَانَتْ بَيْنَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا، حَتَّى إِذَا هُذِّبُوا وَنُقُّوا أُذِنَ لَهُمْ فِي دُخُولِ الْجَنَّةِ، فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لأَحَدُهُمْ أَهْدَى بِمَنْزِلِهِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ مِنْهُ بِمَنْزِلِهِ كَانَ فِي الدُّنْيَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy alssaltu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, ‏{‏wanaza'naa maa fiy suduwrihim min ghillin‏}‏ qaala haddathanaa sa'iydun 'an qataadaaa 'an aabiy almutawakkili alnnaajiyyi aanna aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yakhlusu almuuminuwna mina alnnaari, fayuhbasuwna 'alaa qantaraain bayna aljannaai waalnnaari, fayuqassu liba'dihim min ba'din, mazaalimu kaanat baynahum fiy alddunyaa, hattaa iidhaa hudhhibuwa wanuqquwa audhina lahum fiy dukhuwli aljannaai, fawaalladhiy nafsu muhammadin biyadihi laahaduhum aahdaa bimanzilihi fiy aljannaai minhu bimanzilihi kaana fiy alddunyaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The believers, after being saved from the (Hell) Fire, will be stopped at a bridge between Paradise and Hell and mutual retaliation will be established among them regarding wrongs they have committed in the world against one another. After they are cleansed and purified (through the retaliation), they will be admitted into Paradise; and by Him in Whose Hand Muhammad's soul is, everyone of them will know his dwelling in Paradise better than he knew his dwelling in this world
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ نُوقِشَ الْحِسَابَ عُذِّبَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ أَلَيْسَ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ذَلِكِ الْعَرْضُ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ وَتَابَعَهُ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ وَأَيُّوبُ وَصَالِحُ بْنُ رُسْتُمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an 'uthmaana bni alaaswadi, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ man nuwqisha alhisaaba 'udhhiba ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat qultu aalaysa yaquwlu alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏fasawfa yuhaasabu hisaabana yasiyrana‏}‏‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ dhaliki al'ardu ‏"‏‏.‏ haddathaniy 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'uthmaana bni alaaswadi, sami'tu abna aabiy mulaykaaa, qaala sami'tu 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm mithlahu‏.‏ wataaba'ahu abnu jurayjin wamuhammadu bnu sulaymin waaayyuwbu wasaalihu bnu rustumin 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa 'an 'aaiishaaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:`Aisha said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Anybody whose account (record) is questioned will surely be punished.' I said, 'Doesn't Allah say: 'He surely will receive an easy reckoning?' (84.8) The Prophet (ﷺ) replied. 'This means only the presentation of the account."' Narrated `Aisha: The Prophet (ﷺ) said (as above)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ أَبِي صَغِيرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ يُحَاسَبُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِلاَّ هَلَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلَيْسَ قَدْ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ * فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا‏}‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا ذَلِكِ الْعَرْضُ، وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ يُنَاقَشُ الْحِسَابَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِلاَّ عُذِّبَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa haatimu bnu aabiy saghiyraaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy mulaykaaa, haddathaniy alqaasimu bnu muhammadin, haddathatniy 'aaiishaau, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laysa aahadun yuhaasabu yawma alqiyaamaai iilaaa halaka ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aalaysa qad qaala alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏faaammaa man auwtiya kitaabahu biyamiynihi * fasawfa yuhaasabu hisaabana yasiyrana‏}‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnamaa dhaliki al'ardu, walaysa aahadun yunaaqashu alhisaaba yawma alqiyaamaai iilaaa 'udhhiba ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), said, "None will be called to account on the Day of Resurrection, but will be ruined." I said "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Hasn't Allah said: 'Then as for him who will be given his record in his right hand, he surely will receive an easy reckoning? (84.7-8) -- Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "That (Verse) means only the presentation of the accounts, but anybody whose account (record) is questioned on the Day of Resurrection, will surely be punished
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يُجَاءُ بِالْكَافِرِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيُقَالُ لَهُ أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ كَانَ لَكَ مِلْءُ الأَرْضِ ذَهَبًا أَكُنْتَ تَفْتَدِي بِهِ فَيَقُولُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ لَهُ قَدْ كُنْتَ سُئِلْتَ مَا هُوَ أَيْسَرُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu ma'marin, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ yujaa'u bialkaafiri yawma alqiyaamaai fayuqaalu lahu aaraaayta law kaana laka mil'u alaardi dhahabana aakunta taftadiy bihi fayaquwlu na'am‏.‏ fayuqaalu lahu qad kunta suiilta maa huwa aaysaru min dhalika ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Prophet used to say, "A disbeliever will be brought on the Day of Resurrection and will be asked. "Suppose you had as much gold as to fill the earth, would you offer it to ransom yourself?" He will reply, "Yes." Then it will be said to him, "You were asked for something easier than that (to join none in worship with Allah (i.e. to accept Islam, but you refused)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنِي الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي خَيْثَمَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلاَّ وَسَيُكَلِّمُهُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، لَيْسَ بَيْنَ اللَّهِ وَبَيْنَهُ تُرْجُمَانٌ، ثُمَّ يَنْظُرُ فَلاَ يَرَى شَيْئًا قُدَّامَهُ، ثُمَّ يَنْظُرُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَتَسْتَقْبِلُهُ النَّارُ، فَمَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَتَّقِيَ النَّارَ وَلَوْ بِشِقِّ تَمْرَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy qaala, haddathaniy alaa'mashu, qaala haddathaniy khaythamaau, 'an 'adiyyi bni haatimin, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa minkum min aahadin iilaaa wasayukallimuhu alllahu yawma alqiyaamaai, laysa bayna alllahi wabaynahu turjumaanun, thumma yanzuru falaa yaraa shayiana quddaamahu, thumma yanzuru bayna yadayhi fatastaqbiluhu alnnaaru, famani astataa'a minkum aan yattaqiya alnnaara walaw bishiqqi tamraain ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There will be none among you but will be talked to by Allah on the Day of Resurrection, without there being an interpreter between him and Him (Allah) . He will look and see nothing ahead of him, and then he will look (again for the second time) in front of him, and the (Hell) Fire will confront him. So, whoever among you can save himself from the Fire, should do so even with one half of a date (to give in charity)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: قَالَ الأَعْمَشُ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اتَّقُوا النَّارَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ وَأَشَاحَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اتَّقُوا النَّارَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ وَأَشَاحَ ثَلاَثًا، حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اتَّقُوا النَّارَ وَلَوْ بِشِقِّ تَمْرَةٍ، فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَبِكَلِمَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala alaa'mashu haddathaniy 'amrunw, 'an khaythamaaa, 'an 'adiyyi bni haatimin, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ attaquwa alnnaara ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma aa'rada waaashaaha, thumma qaala ‏"‏ attaquwa alnnaara ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma aa'rada waaashaaha thalaathana, hattaa zanannaa aannahu yanzuru iilayhaa, thumma qaala ‏"‏ attaquwa alnnaara walaw bishiqqi tamraain, faman lam yajid fabikalimaain tayyibaain ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Protect yourself from the Fire." He then turned his face aside (as if he were looking at it) and said again, "Protect yourself from the Fire," and then turned his face aside (as if he were looking at it), and he said so for the third time till we thought he was looking at it. He then said, "Protect yourselves from the Fire, even if with one half of a date and he who hasn't got even this, (should do so) by (saying) a good, pleasant word
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ،‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي أَسِيدُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ عُرِضَتْ عَلَىَّ الأُمَمُ، فَأَخَذَ النَّبِيُّ يَمُرُّ مَعَهُ الأُمَّةُ، وَالنَّبِيُّ يَمُرُّ مَعَهُ النَّفَرُ، وَالنَّبِيُّ يَمُرُّ مَعَهُ الْعَشَرَةُ، وَالنَّبِيُّ يَمُرُّ مَعَهُ الْخَمْسَةُ، وَالنَّبِيُّ يَمُرُّ وَحْدَهُ، فَنَظَرْتُ فَإِذَا سَوَادٌ كَثِيرٌ قُلْتُ يَا جِبْرِيلُ هَؤُلاَءِ أُمَّتِي قَالَ لاَ وَلَكِنِ انْظُرْ إِلَى الأُفُقِ‏.‏ فَنَظَرْتُ فَإِذَا سَوَادٌ كَثِيرٌ‏.‏ قَالَ هَؤُلاَءِ أُمَّتُكَ، وَهَؤُلاَءِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا قُدَّامَهُمْ، لاَ حِسَابَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ عَذَابَ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَلِمَ قَالَ كَانُوا لاَ يَكْتَوُونَ، وَلاَ يَسْتَرْقُونَ، وَلاَ يَتَطَيَّرُونَ، وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ عُكَّاشَةُ بْنُ مِحْصَنٍ فَقَالَ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ قَالَ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ سَبَقَكَ بِهَا عُكَّاشَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'imraanu bnu maysaraaa, haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, haddathanaa husaynun, ‏.‏ wahaddathaniy aasiydu bnu zaydin, haddathanaa hushaymun, 'an husaynin, qaala kuntu 'inda sa'iydi bni jubayrin faqaala haddathaniy abnu 'abbaasin, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ 'uridat 'alaaaa alaumamu, faaakhadha alnnabiyyu yamurru ma'ahu alaummaau, waalnnabiyyu yamurru ma'ahu alnnafaru, waalnnabiyyu yamurru ma'ahu al'asharaau, waalnnabiyyu yamurru ma'ahu alkhamsaau, waalnnabiyyu yamurru wahdahu, fanazartu faiidhaa sawaadun kathiyrun qultu yaa jibriylu hauulaa'i aummatiy qaala laa walakini anzur iilaa alaufuqi‏.‏ fanazartu faiidhaa sawaadun kathiyrun‏.‏ qaala hauulaa'i aummatuka, wahauulaa'i sab'uwna aalfana quddaamahum, laa hisaaba 'alayhim walaa 'adhaaba‏.‏ qultu walima qaala kaanuwa laa yaktawuwna, walaa yastarquwna, walaa yatatayyaruwna, wa'alaa rabbihim yatawakkaluwna ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaama iilayhi 'ukkaashaau bnu mihsanin faqaala ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma aj'alhu minhum ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaama iilayhi rajulun akharu qaala ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ sabaqaka bihaa 'ukkaashaau ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people were displayed in front of me and I saw one prophet passing by with a large group of his followers, and another prophet passing by with only a small group of people, and another prophet passing by with only ten (persons), and another prophet passing by with only five (persons), and another prophet passed by alone. And then I looked and saw a large multitude of people, so I asked Gabriel, "Are these people my followers?' He said, 'No, but look towards the horizon.' I looked and saw a very large multitude of people. Gabriel said. 'Those are your followers, and those are seventy thousand (persons) in front of them who will neither have any reckoning of their accounts nor will receive any punishment.' I asked, 'Why?' He said, 'For they used not to treat themselves with branding (cauterization) nor with Ruqya (get oneself treated by the recitation of some Verses of the Qur'an) and not to see evil omen in things, and they used to put their trust (only) in their Lord." On hearing that, 'Ukasha bin Mihsan got up and said (to the Prophet), "Invoke Allah to make me one of them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah, make him one of them." Then another man got up and said (to the Prophet), "Invoke Allah to make me one of them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Ukasha has preceded you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ يَدْخُلُ مِنْ أُمَّتِي زُمْرَةٌ هُمْ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا، تُضِيءُ وُجُوهُهُمْ إِضَاءَةَ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَقَامَ عُكَّاشَةُ بْنُ مِحْصَنٍ الأَسَدِيُّ يَرْفَعُ نَمِرَةً عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ سَبَقَكَ عُكَّاشَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu aasadin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, haddathahu qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ yadkhulu min aummatiy zumraaun hum sab'uwna aalfana, tudiy'u wujuwhuhum iidaa'aaa alqamari laylaaa albadri ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala aabuw hurayraaa faqaama 'ukkaashaau bnu mihsanin alaasadiyyu yarfa'u namiraaan 'alayhi faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma aj'alhu minhum ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaama rajulun mina alaansaari faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ sabaqaka 'ukkaashaau ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "From my followers there will enter Paradise a crowd, seventy thousand in number, whose faces will glitter as the moon does when it is full." On hearing that, 'Ukasha bin Mihsan Al-Asdi got up, lifting his covering sheet, and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah that He may make me one of them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah, make him one of them." Another man from the Ansar got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah to make me one of them. "The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "'Ukasha has preceded you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَيَدْخُلَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا أَوْ سَبْعُمِائَةِ أَلْفٍ ـ شَكَّ فِي أَحَدِهِمَا ـ مُتَمَاسِكِينَ، آخِذٌ بَعْضُهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ، حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ أَوَّلُهُمْ وَآخِرُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَوُجُوهُهُمْ عَلَى ضَوْءِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, haddathanaa aabuw ghassaana, qaala haddathaniy aabuw haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ layadkhulanna aljannaaa min aummatiy sab'uwna aalfana aaw sab'umiaiaai aalfin shakka fiy aahadihimaa mutamaasikiyna, akhidhun ba'duhum biba'din, hattaa yadkhula aawwaluhum waakhiruhumu aljannaaa, wawujuwhuhum 'alaa daw'i alqamari laylaaa albadri ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Seventy-thousand or seven-hundred thousand of my followers (the narrator is in doubt as to the correct number) will enter Paradise holding each other till the first and the last of them enter Paradise at the same time, and their faces will have a glitter like that of the moon at night when it is full
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا دَخَلَ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَهْلُ النَّارِ النَّارَ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ مُؤَذِّنٌ بَيْنَهُمْ يَا أَهْلَ النَّارِ لاَ مَوْتَ، وَيَا أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ لاَ مَوْتَ، خُلُودٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, haddathanaa naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa dakhala aahlu aljannaai aljannaaa, waaahlu alnnaari alnnaara, thumma yaquwmu muuadhhinun baynahum yaa aahla alnnaari laa mawta, wayaa aahla aljannaai laa mawta, khuluwdun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet; said, "The people of Paradise will enter Paradise, and the people of the (Hell) Fire will enter the (Hell) Fire: then a call-maker will get up (and make an announcement) among them, 'O the people of the (Hell) Fire! No death anymore ! And O people of Paradise! No death (anymore) but Eternity
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يُقَالُ لأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ خُلُودٌ لاَ مَوْتَ‏.‏ وَلأَهْلِ النَّارِ يَا أَهْلَ النَّارِ خُلُودٌ لاَ مَوْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yuqaalu laahli aljannaai khuluwdun laa mawta‏.‏ walaahli alnnaari yaa aahla alnnaari khuluwdun laa mawta ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, " It will be said to the people of Paradise, 'O people of Paradise! Eternity (for you) and no death,' and to the people of the Fire, 'O people of the Fire, eternity (for you) and no death
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ الْهَيْثَمِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَوْفٌ، عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ اطَّلَعْتُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ فَرَأَيْتُ أَكْثَرَ أَهْلِهَا الْفُقَرَاءَ وَاطَّلَعْتُ فِي النَّارِ فَرَأَيْتُ أَكْثَرَ أَهْلِهَا النِّسَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu alhaythami, haddathanaa 'awfun, 'an aabiy rajaa'in, 'an 'imraana, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ attala'tu fiy aljannaai faraaaytu aakthara aahlihaa alfuqaraa'a waattala'tu fiy alnnaari faraaaytu aakthara aahlihaa alnnisaa'a ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Imran:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I looked into paradise and saw that the majority of its people were the poor, and I looked into the Fire and found that the majority of its people were women
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ قُمْتُ عَلَى باب الْجَنَّةِ فَكَانَ عَامَّةُ مَنْ دَخَلَهَا الْمَسَاكِينَ، وَأَصْحَابُ الْجَدِّ مَحْبُوسُونَ، غَيْرَ أَنَّ أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ قَدْ أُمِرَ بِهِمْ إِلَى النَّارِ، وَقُمْتُ عَلَى باب النَّارِ فَإِذَا عَامَّةُ مَنْ دَخَلَهَا النِّسَاءُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, aakhbaranaa sulaymaanu alttaymiyyu, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, 'an ausaamaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ qumtu 'alaa bab aljannaai fakaana 'aammaau man dakhalahaa almasaakiyna, waaashaabu aljaddi mahbuwsuwna, ghayra aanna aashaaba alnnaari qad aumira bihim iilaa alnnaari, waqumtu 'alaa bab alnnaari faiidhaa 'aammaau man dakhalahaa alnnisaa'u ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Usama:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I stood at the gate of Paradise and saw that the majority of the people who had entered it were poor people, while the rich were forbidden (to enter along with the poor, because they were waiting the reckoning of their accounts), but the people of the Fire had been ordered to be driven to the Fire. And I stood at the gate of the Fire and found that the majority of the people entering it were women
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا صَارَ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ، وَأَهْلُ النَّارِ إِلَى النَّارِ، جِيءَ بِالْمَوْتِ حَتَّى يُجْعَلَ بَيْنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ، ثُمَّ يُذْبَحُ، ثُمَّ يُنَادِي مُنَادٍ يَا أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ لاَ مَوْتَ، يَا أَهْلَ النَّارِ لاَ مَوْتَ، فَيَزْدَادُ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ فَرَحًا إِلَى فَرَحِهِمْ‏.‏ وَيَزْدَادُ أَهْلُ النَّارِ حُزْنًا إِلَى حُزْنِهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu aasadin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa 'umaru bnu muhammadi bni zaydin, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu haddathahu 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa saara aahlu aljannaai iilaa aljannaai, waaahlu alnnaari iilaa alnnaari, jiy'a bialmawti hattaa yuj'ala bayna aljannaai waalnnaari, thumma yudhbahu, thumma yunaadiy munaadin yaa aahla aljannaai laa mawta, yaa aahla alnnaari laa mawta, fayazdaadu aahlu aljannaai farahana iilaa farahihim‏.‏ wayazdaadu aahlu alnnaari huznana iilaa huznihim ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the people of Paradise have entered Paradise and the people of the Fire have entered the Fire, death will be brought and will be placed between the Fire and Paradise, and then it will be slaughtered, and a call will be made (that), 'O people of Paradise, no more death ! O people of the Fire, no more death ! ' So the people of Paradise will have happiness added to their previous happiness, and the people of the Fire will have sorrow added to their previous sorrow
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ لأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ يَا أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ‏.‏ يَقُولُونَ لَبَّيْكَ رَبَّنَا وَسَعْدَيْكَ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ هَلْ رَضِيتُمْ فَيَقُولُونَ وَمَا لَنَا لاَ نَرْضَى وَقَدْ أَعْطَيْتَنَا مَا لَمْ تُعْطِ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ أَنَا أُعْطِيكُمْ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَبِّ وَأَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَيَقُولُ أُحِلُّ عَلَيْكُمْ رِضْوَانِي فَلاَ أَسْخَطُ عَلَيْكُمْ بَعْدَهُ أَبَدًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu aasadin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa maaliku bnu aanasin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha yaquwlu laahli aljannaai yaa aahla aljannaai‏.‏ yaquwluwna labbayka rabbanaa wasa'dayka‏.‏ fayaquwlu hal radiytum fayaquwluwna wamaa lanaa laa nardaa waqad aa'taytanaa maa lam tu'ti aahadana min khalqika‏.‏ fayaquwlu aanaa au'tiykum aafdala min dhalika‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rabbi waaaaau shaa'in aafdalu min dhalika fayaquwlu auhillu 'alaykum ridwaaniy falaa aaskhatu 'alaykum ba'dahu aabadana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah will say to the people of Paradise, 'O the people of Paradise!' They will say, 'Labbaik, O our Lord, and Sa`daik!' Allah will say, 'Are you pleased?" They will say, 'Why should we not be pleased since You have given us what You have not given to anyone of Your creation?' Allah will say, 'I will give you something better than that.' They will reply, 'O our Lord! And what is better than that?' Allah will say, 'I will bestow My pleasure and contentment upon you so that I will never be angry with you after for-ever
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ أُصِيبَ حَارِثَةُ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ وَهْوَ غُلاَمٌ، فَجَاءَتْ أُمُّهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَدْ عَرَفْتَ مَنْزِلَةَ حَارِثَةَ مِنِّي، فَإِنْ يَكُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَصْبِرْ وَأَحْتَسِبْ، وَإِنْ تَكُنِ الأُخْرَى تَرَى مَا أَصْنَعُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ وَيْحَكِ ـ أَوَهَبِلْتِ ـ أَوَجَنَّةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ هِيَ جِنَانٌ كَثِيرَةٌ، وَإِنَّهُ لَفِي جَنَّةِ الْفِرْدَوْسِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau bnu 'amrinw, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, 'an humaydin, qaala sami'tu aanasana, yaquwlu ausiyba haarithaau yawma badrin wahwa ghulaamun, fajaa'at aummuhu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi qad 'arafta manzilaaa haarithaaa minniy, faiin yaku fiy aljannaai aasbir waaahtasib, waiin takuni alaukhraa taraa maa aasna'u‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ wayhaki aawahabilti aawajannaaun waahidaaun hiya jinaanun kathiyraaun, waiinnahu lafiy jannaai alfirdawsi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas: Haritha was martyred on the day (of the battle) of Badr while he was young. His mother came to the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You know the relation of Haritha to me (how fond of him I was); so, if he is in Paradise, I will remain patient and wish for Allah's reward, but if he is not there, then you will see what I will do." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "May Allah be merciful upon you! Have you gone mad? (Do you think) it is one Paradise? There are many Paradises and he is in the (most superior) Paradise of Al-Firdaus
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا الْفُضَيْلُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏مَا بَيْنَ مَنْكِبَىِ الْكَافِرِ مَسِيرَةُ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ لِلرَّاكِبِ الْمُسْرِعِ‏"‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu aasadin, aakhbaranaa alfadlu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa alfudaylu, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏maa bayna mankibaai alkaafiri masiyraau thalaathaai aayyaamin lilrraakibi almusri'i‏"‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The width between the two shoulders of a Kafir (disbeliever) will be equal to the distance covered by a fast rider in three days
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: وَقَالَ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَشَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ عَامٍ، لاَ يَقْطَعُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma aakhbaranaa almughiyraau bnu salamaaa, haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna fiy aljannaai lashajaraaan yasiyru alrraakibu fiy zillihaa miaiaaa 'aamin, laa yaqta'uhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa'd: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "In Paradise there is a tree so big that in its shade a rider may travel for one hundred years without being able to cross it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: قَالَ أَبُو حَازِمٍ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ، فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَشَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ الْجَوَادَ الْمُضَمَّرَ السَّرِيعَ مِائَةَ عَامٍ، مَا يَقْطَعُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala aabuw haazimin fahaddathtu bihi alnnu'maana bna aabiy 'ayyaashin, faqaala haddathaniy aabuw sa'iydin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna fiy aljannaai lashajaraaan yasiyru alrraakibu aljawaada almudammara alssariy'a miaiaaa 'aamin, maa yaqta'uhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa'id: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: There is a tree in Paradise (so huge) that a fast (or a trained) rider may travel: for one hundred years without being able to cross it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَيَدْخُلَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي سَبْعُونَ أَوْ سَبْعُمِائَةِ أَلْفٍ ـ لاَ يَدْرِي أَبُو حَازِمٍ أَيُّهُمَا قَالَ ـ مُتَمَاسِكُونَ، آخِذٌ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا، لاَ يَدْخُلُ أَوَّلُهُمْ حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ آخِرُهُمْ، وُجُوهُهُمْ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ layadkhulanna aljannaaa min aummatiy sab'uwna aaw sab'umiaiaai aalfin laa yadriy aabuw haazimin aayyuhumaa qaala mutamaasikuwna, akhidhun ba'duhum ba'dana, laa yadkhulu aawwaluhum hattaa yadkhula akhiruhum, wujuwhuhum 'alaa suwraai alqamari laylaaa albadri ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Seventy thousand or seven hundred thousand of my followers will enter Paradise. (Abu Hazim, the sub-narrator, is not sure as to which of the two numbers is correct.) They will be holding on to each other, the first will not entering the last one does, their faces like the moon on a full moon night
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ لَيَتَرَاءَوْنَ الْغُرَفَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ كَمَا تَتَرَاءَوْنَ الْكَوْكَبَ فِي السَّمَاءِ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sahlin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏iinna aahla aljannaai layataraa'awna alghurafa fiy aljannaai kamaa tataraa'awna alkawkaba fiy alssamaa'i‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people of Paradise will see the Ghuraf (special abodes) in Paradise as you see a star in the sky
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: قَالَ أَبِي فَحَدَّثْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ، فَقَالَ أَشْهَدُ لَسَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ يُحَدِّثُ وَيَزِيدُ فِيهِ ‏ "‏ كَمَا تَرَاءَوْنَ الْكَوْكَبَ الْغَارِبَ فِي الأُفُقِ الشَّرْقِيِّ وَالْغَرْبِيِّ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala aabiy fahaddathtu alnnu'maana bna aabiy 'ayyaashin, faqaala aashhadu lasami'tu aabaa sa'iydin yuhaddithu wayaziydu fiyhi ‏ "‏ kamaa taraa'awna alkawkaba alghaariba fiy alaufuqi alshharqiyyi waalgharbiyyi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa`id added:"As you see a glittering star remaining in the eastern horizon and the western horizon
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى لأَهْوَنِ أَهْلِ النَّارِ عَذَابًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ لَوْ أَنَّ لَكَ مَا فِي الأَرْضِ مِنْ شَىْءٍ أَكُنْتَ تَفْتَدِي بِهِ فَيَقُولُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ أَرَدْتُ مِنْكَ أَهْوَنَ مِنْ هَذَا وَأَنْتَ فِي صُلْبِ آدَمَ أَنْ لاَ تُشْرِكَ بِي شَيْئًا فَأَبَيْتَ إِلاَّ أَنْ تُشْرِكَ بِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy 'imraana, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yaquwlu alllahu ta'aalaa laahwani aahli alnnaari 'adhaabana yawma alqiyaamaai law aanna laka maa fiy alaardi min shaa'in aakunta taftadiy bihi fayaquwlu na'am‏.‏ fayaquwlu aaradtu minka aahwana min hadhaa waaanta fiy sulbi adama aan laa tushrika biy shayiana faaabayta iilaaa aan tushrika biy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah will say to the person who will have the minimum punishment in the Fire on the Day of Resurrection, 'If you had things equal to whatever is on the earth, would you ransom yourself (from the punishment) with it?' He will reply, Yes. Allah will say, 'I asked you a much easier thing than this while you were in the backbone of Adam, that is, not to worship others besides Me, but you refused and insisted to worship others besides Me
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَخْرُجُ مِنَ النَّارِ بِالشَّفَاعَةِ كَأَنَّهُمُ الثَّعَارِيرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ مَا الثَّعَارِيرُ قَالَ الضَّغَابِيسُ‏.‏ وَكَانَ قَدْ سَقَطَ فَمُهُ فَقُلْتُ لِعَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ سَمِعْتَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ يَخْرُجُ بِالشَّفَاعَةِ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an 'amrinw, 'an jaabirin rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ yakhruju mina alnnaari bialshhafaa'aai kaaannahumu althha'aariyru ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu maa althha'aariyru qaala alddaghaabiysu‏.‏ wakaana qad saqata famuhu faqultu li'amriw bni diynaarin aabaa muhammadin sami'ta jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi yaquwlu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ yakhruju bialshhafaa'aai mina alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hammad from `Amr from Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Some people will come out of the Fire through intercession looking like The Thaarir." I asked `Amr, "What is the Thaarir?" He said, Ad Dagh`Abis, and at that time he was toothless. Hammad added: I said to `Amr bin Dinar, "O Abu Muhammad! Did you hear Jabir bin `Abdullah saying, 'I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying: 'Some people will come out of the Fire through intercession?" He said, "Yes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَخْرُجُ قَوْمٌ مِنَ النَّارِ بَعْدَ مَا مَسَّهُمْ مِنْهَا سَفْعٌ، فَيَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ، فَيُسَمِّيهِمْ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ الْجَهَنَّمِيِّينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hudbaau bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yakhruju qawmun mina alnnaari ba'da maa massahum minhaa saf'un, fayadkhuluwna aljannaaa, fayusammiyhim aahlu aljannaai aljahannamiyyiyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Some people will come out of the Fire after they have received a touch of the Fire, changing their color, and they will enter Paradise, and the people of Paradise will name them 'Al- Jahannamiyin' the (Hell) Fire people
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا دَخَلَ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَهْلُ النَّارِ النَّارَ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ مِنْ إِيمَانٍ فَأَخْرِجُوهُ‏.‏ فَيُخْرَجُونَ قَدِ امْتُحِشُوا وَعَادُوا حُمَمًا، فَيُلْقَوْنَ فِي نَهَرِ الْحَيَاةِ، فَيَنْبُتُونَ كَمَا تَنْبُتُ الْحِبَّةُ فِي حَمِيلِ السَّيْلِ ـ أَوْ قَالَ ـ حَمِيَّةِ السَّيْلِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلَمْ تَرَوْا أَنَّهَا تَنْبُتُ صَفْرَاءَ مُلْتَوِيَةً ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu yahyaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iidhaa dakhala aahlu aljannaai aljannaaa, waaahlu alnnaari alnnaara yaquwlu alllahu man kaana fiy qalbihi mithqaalu habbaain min khardalin min iiymaanin faaakhrijuwhu‏.‏ fayukhrajuwna qadi amtuhishuwa wa'aaduwa humamana, fayulqawna fiy nahari alhayaaai, fayanbutuwna kamaa tanbutu alhibbaau fiy hamiyli alssayli aaw qaala hamiyyaai alssayli ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aalam tarawa aannahaa tanbutu safraa'a multawiyaaan ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the people of Paradise have entered Paradise, and the people of the Fire have entered the Fire, Allah will say. 'Take out (of the Fire) whoever has got faith equal to a mustard seed in his heart.' They will come out, and by that time they would have burnt and became like coal, and then they will be thrown into the river of Al-Hayyat (life) and they will spring up just as a seed grows on the bank of a rainwater stream." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Don't you see that the germinating seed comes out yellow and twisted?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ، سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏إِنَّ أَهْوَنَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ عَذَابًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ لَرَجُلٌ تُوضَعُ فِي أَخْمَصِ قَدَمَيْهِ جَمْرَةٌ يَغْلِي مِنْهَا دِمَاغُهُ‏"‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu aabaa iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu alnnu'maana, sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏iinna aahwana aahli alnnaari 'adhaabana yawma alqiyaamaai larajulun tuwda'u fiy aakhmasi qadamayhi jamraaun yaghliy minhaa dimaaghuhu‏"‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated An-Nu`man:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The person who will have the least punishment from amongst the Hell Fire people on the Day of Resurrection, will be a man under whose arch of the feet a smoldering ember will be placed so that his brain will boil because of it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَهْوَنَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ عَذَابًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ رَجُلٌ عَلَى أَخْمَصِ قَدَمَيْهِ جَمْرَتَانِ يَغْلِي مِنْهُمَا دِمَاغُهُ، كَمَا يَغْلِي الْمِرْجَلُ وَالْقُمْقُمُ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu rajaa'in, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna aahwana aahli alnnaari 'adhaabana yawma alqiyaamaai rajulun 'alaa aakhmasi qadamayhi jamrataani yaghliy minhumaa dimaaghuhu, kamaa yaghliy almirjalu waalqumqumu‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated An-Nu`man bin Bashir:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The least punished person of the (Hell) Fire people on the Day of Resurrection will be a man under whose arch of the feet two smoldering embers will be placed, because of which his brain will boil just like Al-Mirjal (copper vessel) or a Qum-qum (narrow-necked vessel) is boiling with water
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَكَرَ النَّارَ فَأَشَاحَ بِوَجْهِهِ فَتَعَوَّذَ مِنْهَا، ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ النَّارَ فَأَشَاحَ بِوَجْهِهِ فَتَعَوَّذَ مِنْهَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اتَّقُوا النَّارَ وَلَوْ بِشِقِّ تَمْرَةٍ، فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَبِكَلِمَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amrinw, 'an khaythamaaa, 'an 'adiyyi bni haatimin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dhakara alnnaara faaashaaha biwajhihi fata'awwadha minhaa, thumma dhakara alnnaara faaashaaha biwajhihi fata'awwadha minhaa, thumma qaala ‏ "‏ attaquwa alnnaara walaw bishiqqi tamraain, faman lam yajid fabikalimaain tayyibaain ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:The Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned the Fire and turned his face aside and asked for Allah's protection from it, and then again he mentioned the Fire and turned his face aside and asked for Allah's protection from it and said, "Protect yourselves from the Hell-Fire, even if with one half of a date, and he who cannot afford that, then (let him do so) by (saying) a good, pleasant word
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، وَالدَّرَاوَرْدِيُّ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ خَبَّابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَذُكِرَ عِنْدَهُ عَمُّهُ أَبُو طَالِبٍ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَعَلَّهُ تَنْفَعُهُ شَفَاعَتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيُجْعَلُ فِي ضَحْضَاحٍ مِنَ النَّارِ، يَبْلُغُ كَعْبَيْهِ، يَغْلِي مِنْهُ أُمُّ دِمَاغِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu hamzaaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy haazimin, waalddaraawardiyyu, 'an yaziyda, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni khabbaabin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wadhukira 'indahu 'ammuhu aabuw taalibin faqaala ‏ "‏ la'allahu tanfa'uhu shafaa'atiy yawma alqiyaamaai fayuj'alu fiy dahdaahin mina alnnaari, yablughu ka'bayhi, yaghliy minhu aummu dimaaghihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when his uncle, Abu Talib had been mentioned in his presence, saying, "May be my intercession will help him (Abu Talib) on the Day of Resurrection so that he may be put in a shallow place in the Fire, with fire reaching his ankles and causing his brain to boil
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 81 — To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَجْمَعُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيَقُولُونَ لَوِ اسْتَشْفَعْنَا عَلَى رَبِّنَا حَتَّى يُرِيحَنَا مِنْ مَكَانِنَا‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَ آدَمَ فَيَقُولُونَ أَنْتَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكَ اللَّهُ بِيَدِهِ، وَنَفَخَ فِيكَ مِنْ رُوحِهِ، وَأَمَرَ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ فَسَجَدُوا لَكَ، فَاشْفَعْ لَنَا عِنْدَ رَبِّنَا‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ ـ وَيَذْكُرُ خَطِيئَتَهُ وَيَقُولُ ـ ائْتُوا نُوحًا أَوَّلَ رَسُولٍ بَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَهُ فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ ـ وَيَذْكُرُ خَطِيئَتَهُ ـ ائْتُوا إِبْرَاهِيمَ الَّذِي اتَّخَذَهُ اللَّهُ خَلِيلاً‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَهُ، فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ ـ وَيَذْكُرُ خَطِيئَتَهُ ـ ائْتُوا مُوسَى الَّذِي كَلَّمَهُ اللَّهُ فَيَأْتُونَهُ فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ، فَيَذْكُرُ خَطِيئَتَهُ ـ ائْتُوا عِيسَى فَيَأْتُونَهُ فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ، ائْتُوا مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَدْ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ فَيَأْتُونِي فَأَسْتَأْذِنُ عَلَى رَبِّي، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُهُ وَقَعْتُ سَاجِدًا، فَيَدَعُنِي مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، ثُمَّ يُقَالُ ارْفَعْ رَأْسَكَ، سَلْ تُعْطَهْ، وَقُلْ يُسْمَعْ، وَاشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ‏.‏ فَأَرْفَعُ رَأْسِي، فَأَحْمَدُ رَبِّي بِتَحْمِيدٍ يُعَلِّمُنِي، ثُمَّ أَشْفَعُ فَيَحُدُّ لِي حَدًّا، ثُمَّ أُخْرِجُهُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ، وَأُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ، ثُمَّ أَعُودُ فَأَقَعُ سَاجِدًا مِثْلَهُ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ أَوِ الرَّابِعَةِ حَتَّى مَا بَقِيَ فِي النَّارِ إِلاَّ مَنْ حَبَسَهُ الْقُرْآنُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ قَتَادَةُ يَقُولُ عِنْدَ هَذَا أَىْ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ الْخُلُودُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yajma'u alllahu alnnaasa yawma alqiyaamaai fayaquwluwna lawi astashfa'naa 'alaa rabbinaa hattaa yuriyhanaa min makaaninaa‏.‏ fayaatuwna adama fayaquwluwna aanta alladhiy khalaqaka alllahu biyadihi, wanafakha fiyka min ruwhihi, waaamara almalaaiikaaa fasajaduwa laka, faashfa' lanaa 'inda rabbinaa‏.‏ fayaquwlu lastu hunaakum wayadhkuru khatiyiatahu wayaquwlu aituwa nuwhana aawwala rasuwlin ba'athahu alllahu‏.‏ fayaatuwnahu fayaquwlu lastu hunaakum wayadhkuru khatiyiatahu aituwa iibraahiyma alladhiy attakhadhahu alllahu khaliylaan‏.‏ fayaatuwnahu, fayaquwlu lastu hunaakum wayadhkuru khatiyiatahu aituwa muwsaa alladhiy kallamahu alllahu fayaatuwnahu fayaquwlu lastu hunaakum, fayadhkuru khatiyiatahu aituwa 'iysaa fayaatuwnahu fayaquwlu lastu hunaakum, aituwa muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm faqad ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi wamaa taaakhhara fayaatuwniy faaastaadhinu 'alaa rabbiy, faiidhaa raaaytuhu waqa'tu saajidana, fayada'uniy maa shaa'a alllahu, thumma yuqaalu arfa' raasaka, sal tu'tah, waqul yusma', waashfa' tushaffa'‏.‏ faaarfa'u raasiy, faaahmadu rabbiy bitahmiydin yu'allimuniy, thumma aashfa'u fayahuddu liy haddana, thumma aukhrijuhum mina alnnaari, waaudkhiluhumu aljannaaa, thumma aa'uwdu faaaqa'u saajidana mithlahu fiy althhaalithaai aawi alrraabi'aai hattaa maa baqiya fiy alnnaari iilaaa man habasahu alquranu ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana qataadaau yaquwlu 'inda hadhaa aaa wajaba 'alayhi alkhuluwdu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah will gather all the people on the Day of Resurrection and they will say, 'Let us request someone to intercede for us with our Lord so that He may relieve us from this place of ours.' Then they will go to Adam and say, 'You are the one whom Allah created with His Own Hands, and breathed in you of His soul, and ordered the angels to prostrate to you; so please intercede for us with our Lord.' Adam will reply, 'I am not fit for this undertaking, and will remember his sin, and will say, 'Go to Noah, the first Apostle sent by Allah' They will go to him and he will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking', and will remember his sin and say, 'Go to Abraham whom Allah took as a Khalil. They will go to him (and request similarly). He will reply, 'I am not fit for this undertaking,' and will remember his sin and say, 'Go to Moses to whom Allah spoke directly.' They will go to Moses and he will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking,' and will remember his sin and say, 'Go to Jesus.' They will go to him, and he will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking, go to Muhammad as Allah has forgiven his past and future sins.' They will come to me and I will ask my Lord's permission, and when I see Him, I will fall down in prostration to Him, and He will leave me in that state as long as (He) Allah will, and then I will be addressed. 'Raise up your head (O Muhammad)! Ask, and your request will be granted, and say, and your saying will be listened to; intercede, and your intercession will be accepted.' Then I will raise my head, and I will glorify and praise my Lord with a saying(i.e. invocation) He will teach me, and then I will intercede, Allah will fix a limit for me (i.e., certain type of people for whom I may intercede), and I will take them out of the (Hell) Fire and let them enter Paradise. Then I will come back (to Allah) and fall in prostration, and will do the same for the third and fourth times till no-one remains in the (Hell) Fire except those whom the Qur'an has imprisoned therein." (The sub-narrator, Qatada used to say at that point, "...those upon whom eternity (in Hell) has been imposed.") (See Hadith No. 3, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
