verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ يُجْلَدُ فَوْقَ عَشْرِ جَلَدَاتٍ إِلاَّ فِي حَدٍّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa alllaythu, haddathaniy yaziydu bnu aabiy habiybin, 'an bukayri bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy burdaaa rda allh 'nh qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa yujladu fawqa 'ashri jaladaatin iilaaa fiy haddin min huduwdi alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say, "Nobody should be flogged more than ten stripes except if he is guilty of a crime, the legal punishment of which is assigned by Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 86 — Limits and Punishments set by Allah (Hudood)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ جَابِرٍ، عَمَّنْ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ عُقُوبَةَ فَوْقَ عَشْرِ ضَرَبَاتٍ إِلاَّ فِي حَدٍّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa fudaylu bnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa muslimu bnu aabiy maryama, haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu jaabirin, 'amman sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa 'uquwbaaa fawqa 'ashri darabaatin iilaaa fiy haddin min huduwdi alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Jabir:On the authority of others, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No Punishment exceeds the flogging of the ten stripes, except if one is guilty of a crime necessitating a legal punishment prescribed by Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 86 — Limits and Punishments set by Allah (Hudood)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ بُكَيْرًا، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ بَيْنَمَا أَنَا جَالِسٌ، عِنْدَ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ إِذْ جَاءَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ جَابِرٍ فَحَدَّثَ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا بُرْدَةَ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَجْلِدُوا فَوْقَ عَشْرَةِ أَسْوَاطٍ إِلاَّ فِي حَدٍّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sulaymaana, haddathaniy abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, aanna bukayrana, haddathahu qaala baynamaa aanaa jaalisun, 'inda sulaymaana bni yasaarin iidh jaa'a 'abdu alrrahmani bnu jaabirin fahaddatha sulaymaana bna yasaarin, thumma aaqbala 'alaynaa sulaymaanu bnu yasaarin faqaala haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu jaabirin, aanna aabaahu, haddathahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa burdaaa alaansaariyya, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa tajliduwa fawqa 'ashraai aaswaatin iilaaa fiy haddin min huduwdi alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda Al-Ansari:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Do not flog anyone more than ten stripes except if he is involved in a crime necessitating Allah's legal Punishment
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 86 — Limits and Punishments set by Allah (Hudood)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْوِصَالِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رِجَالٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَإِنَّكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ تُوَاصِلُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَيُّكُمْ مِثْلِي إِنِّي أَبِيتُ يُطْعِمُنِي رَبِّي وَيَسْقِينِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَبَوْا أَنْ يَنْتَهُوا عَنِ الْوِصَالِ وَاصَلَ بِهِمْ يَوْمًا ثُمَّ يَوْمًا ثُمَّ رَأَوُا الْهِلاَلَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ تَأَخَّرَ لَزِدْتُكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ كَالْمُنَكِّلِ بِهِمْ حِينَ أَبَوْا‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ شُعَيْبٌ وَيَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ وَيُونُسُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathanaa aabuw salamaaa, aanna aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alwisaali faqaala lahu rijaalun mina almuslimiyna faiinnaka yaa rasuwla alllahi tuwaasilu‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aayyukum mithliy iinniy aabiytu yut'imuniy rabbiy wayasqiyni ‏"‏‏.‏ falammaa aabawa aan yantahuwa 'ani alwisaali waasala bihim yawmana thumma yawmana thumma raaawua alhilaala faqaala ‏"‏ law taaakhhara lazidtukum ‏"‏‏.‏ kaalmunakkili bihim hiyna aabawa‏.‏ taaba'ahu shu'aybun wayahyaa bnu sa'iydin wayuwnusu 'ani alzzuhriyyi‏.‏ waqaala 'abdu alrrahmani bnu khaalidin 'ani abni shihaabin 'an sa'iydin 'an aabiy hurayraaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Al-Wisal (fasting continuously for more than one day without taking any meals). A man from the Muslims said, "But you do Al-Wisal, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Who among you is similar to me? I sleep and my Lord makes me eat and drink." When the people refused to give up Al-Wisal, the Prophet (ﷺ) fasted along with them for one day, and did not break his fast but continued his fast for another day, and when they saw the crescent, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If the crescent had not appeared, I would have made you continue your fast (for a third day)," as if he wanted to punish them for they had refused to give up Al-Wisal
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 86 — Limits and Punishments set by Allah (Hudood)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَيَّاشُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يُضْرَبُونَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا اشْتَرَوْا طَعَامًا جِزَافًا أَنْ يَبِيعُوهُ فِي مَكَانِهِمْ حَتَّى يُئْوُوهُ إِلَى رِحَالِهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'ayyaashu bnu alwaliydi, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aannahum kaanuwa yudrabuwna 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa ashtarawa ta'aamana jizaafana aan yabiy'uwhu fiy makaanihim hattaa yuiwuwhu iilaa rihaalihim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Those people who used to buy foodstuff at random (without weighing or measuring it) were beaten in the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) if they sold it at the very place where they had bought it, till they carried it to their dwelling places
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 86 — Limits and Punishments set by Allah (Hudood)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ مَا انْتَقَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِنَفْسِهِ فِي شَىْءٍ يُؤْتَى إِلَيْهِ حَتَّى تُنْتَهَكَ مِنْ حُرُمَاتِ اللَّهِ فَيَنْتَقِمَ لِلَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy 'urwaau, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat maa antaqama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm linafsihi fiy shaa'in yuutaa iilayhi hattaa tuntahaka min hurumaati alllahi fayantaqima lillahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never took revenge for his own self in any matter presented to him till Allah's limits were exceeded, in which case he would take revenge for Allah's sake
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 86 — Limits and Punishments set by Allah (Hudood)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ الْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ وَأَنَا ابْنُ خَمْسَ، عَشْرَةَ، فَرَّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا فَقَالَ زَوْجُهَا كَذَبْتُ عَلَيْهَا إِنْ أَمْسَكْتُهَا‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَفِظْتُ ذَاكَ مِنَ الزُّهْرِيِّ ‏ "‏ إِنْ جَاءَتْ بِهِ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَهْوَ، وَإِنْ جَاءَتْ بِهِ كَذَا وَكَذَا كَأَنَّهُ وَحَرَةٌ فَهُوَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَسَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ يَقُولُ جَاءَتْ بِهِ لِلَّذِي يُكْرَهُ
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala alzzuhriyyu 'an sahli bni sa'din, qaala shahidtu almutalaa'inayni waaanaa abnu khamsa, 'ashraaa, farraqa baynahumaa faqaala zawjuhaa kadhabtu 'alayhaa iin aamsaktuhaa‏.‏ qaala fahafiztu dhaaka mina alzzuhriyyi ‏ "‏ iin jaa'at bihi kadhaa wakadhaa fahwa, waiin jaa'at bihi kadhaa wakadhaa kaaannahu waharaaun fahuwa ‏"‏‏.‏ wasami'tu alzzuhriyya yaquwlu jaa'at bihi lilladhiy yukrahu
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:I witnessed the case of Lian (the case of a man who charged his wife for committing illegal sexual intercourse when I was fifteen years old. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that they be divorced, and the husband said, "If I kept her, I would be a liar." I remember that Az-Zubair also said, "(It was said) that if that woman brought forth the child with such-and-such description, her husband would prove truthful, but if she brought it with such-and-such description looking like a Wahra (a red insect), he would prove untruthful." I heard Az-Zubair also saying, "Finally she gave birth to a child of description which her husband disliked
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 86 — Limits and Punishments set by Allah (Hudood)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ ذَكَرَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ الْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ هِيَ الَّتِي قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَوْ كُنْتُ رَاجِمًا امْرَأَةً عَنْ غَيْرِ بَيِّنَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ، تِلْكَ امْرَأَةٌ أَعْلَنَتْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, qaala dhakara abnu 'abbaasin almutalaa'inayni faqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu shaddaadin hiya allatiy qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ law kuntu raajimana amraaaaan 'an ghayri bayyinaain ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala laa, tilka amraaaaun aa'lanat‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Qasim bin Muhammad:Ibn `Abbas mentioned the couple who had taken the oath of Lian. `Abdullah bin Shaddad said (to him), "Was this woman about whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If I were ever to stone to death any woman without witnesses. (I would have stoned that woman to death)?' Ibn `Abbas replied," No, that lady exposed herself (by her suspicious behavior)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 86 — Limits and Punishments set by Allah (Hudood)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ذُكِرَ التَّلاَعُنُ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ عَاصِمُ بْنُ عَدِيٍّ فِي ذَلِكَ قَوْلاً، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ وَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ يَشْكُو أَنَّهُ وَجَدَ مَعَ أَهْلِهِ فَقَالَ عَاصِمٌ مَا ابْتُلِيتُ بِهَذَا إِلاَّ لِقَوْلِي فَذَهَبَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ بِالَّذِي وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ امْرَأَتَهُ، وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ مُصْفَرًّا، قَلِيلَ اللَّحْمِ، سَبِطَ الشَّعَرِ، وَكَانَ الَّذِي ادَّعَى عَلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ وَجَدَهُ عِنْدَ أَهْلِهِ آدَمَ، خَدْلاً، كَثِيرَ اللَّحْمِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ بَيِّنْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَوَضَعَتْ شَبِيهًا بِالرَّجُلِ الَّذِي ذَكَرَ زَوْجُهَا أَنَّهُ وَجَدَهُ عِنْدَهَا فَلاَعَنَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَهُمَا فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ هِيَ الَّتِي قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ رَجَمْتُ أَحَدًا بِغَيْرِ بَيِّنَةٍ رَجَمْتُ هَذِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ لاَ، تِلْكَ امْرَأَةٌ كَانَتْ تُظْهِرُ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ السُّوءَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa alllaythu, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasima, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma dhukira alttalaa'unu 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala 'aasimu bnu 'adiyyin fiy dhalika qawlaan, thumma ansarafa waaataahu rajulun min qawmihi yashkuw aannahu wajada ma'a aahlihi faqaala 'aasimun maa abtuliytu bihadhaa iilaaa liqawliy fadhahaba bihi iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbarahu bialladhiy wajada 'alayhi amraaatahu, wakaana dhalika alrrajulu musfarrana, qaliyla alllahmi, sabita alshha'ari, wakaana alladhiy adda'aa 'alayhi aannahu wajadahu 'inda aahlihi adama, khadlaan, kathiyra alllahmi, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alllahumma bayyin ‏"‏‏.‏ fawada'at shabiyhana bialrrajuli alladhiy dhakara zawjuhaa aannahu wajadahu 'indahaa falaa'ana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm baynahumaa faqaala rajulun laibni 'abbaasin fiy almajlisi hiya allatiy qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ law rajamtu aahadana bighayri bayyinaain rajamtu hadhihi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala laa, tilka amraaaaun kaanat tuzhiru fiy aliislaami alssuw'a‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Lian was mentioned in the presence of the Prophet, `Asim bin Adi said a statement about it, and when he left, a man from his tribe came to him complaining that he had seen a man with his wife. `Asim said, "I have been put to trial only because of my statement." So he took the man to the Prophet (ﷺ) and the man told him about the incident. The man (husband) was of yellow complexion, thin, and of lank hair, while the man whom he had accused of having been with his wife, was reddish brown with fat thick legs and fat body. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Reveal the truth." Later on the lady delivered a child resembling the man whom the husband had accused of having been with her. So the Prophet (ﷺ) made them take the oath of Lian. A man said to Ibn `Abbas in the gathering, "Was that the same lady about whom the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If I were to stone any lady (for committing illegal sexual intercourse) to death without witnesses, I would have stoned that lade to death?" Ibn `Abbas said, "No, that was another lady who used to behave in such a suspicious way among the Muslims that one might accuse her of committing illegal sexual intercourse
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 86 — Limits and Punishments set by Allah (Hudood)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ اجْتَنِبُوا السَّبْعَ الْمُوبِقَاتِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَا هُنَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ الشِّرْكُ بِاللَّهِ، وَالسِّحْرُ، وَقَتْلُ النَّفْسِ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ، وَأَكْلُ الرِّبَا، وَأَكْلُ مَالِ الْيَتِيمِ، وَالتَّوَلِّي يَوْمَ الزَّحْفِ، وَقَذْفُ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ الْغَافِلاَتِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, 'an thawri bni zaydin, 'an aabiy alghaythi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ ajtanibuwa alssab'a almuwbiqaati ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi wamaa hunna qaala ‏"‏ alshhirku bialllahi, waalssihru, waqatlu alnnafsi allatiy harrama alllahu iilaaa bialhaqqi, waaaklu alrribaa, waaaklu maali alyatiymi, waalttawalliy yawma alzzahfi, waqadhfu almuhsanaati almuuminaati alghaafilaati ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Avoid the seven great destructive sins." They (the people!) asked, "O Allah's Apostle! What are they?" He said, "To join partners in worship with Allah; to practice sorcery; to kill the life which Allah has forbidden except for a just cause (according to Islamic law); to eat up usury (Riba), to eat up the property of an orphan; to give one's back to the enemy and fleeing from the battle-field at the time of fighting and to accuse chaste women who never even think of anything touching chastity and are good believers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 86 — Limits and Punishments set by Allah (Hudood)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ غَزْوَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نُعْمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ، صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَذَفَ مَمْلُوكَهُ وَهْوَ بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا قَالَ، جُلِدَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ كَمَا قَالَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an fudayli bni ghazwaana, 'ani abni aabiy nu'min, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tu aabaa alqaasimi, sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man qadhafa mamluwkahu wahwa bariy'un mimmaa qaala, julida yawma alqiyaamaai, iilaaa aan yakuwna kamaa qaala ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Abu-l-Qasim (the Prophet) saying, "If somebody slanders his slave and the slave is free from what he says, he will be flogged on the Day of Resurrection unless the slave is really as he has described him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 86 — Limits and Punishments set by Allah (Hudood)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، قَالاَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَنْشُدُكَ اللَّهَ إِلاَّ قَضَيْتَ بَيْنَنَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَامَ خَصْمُهُ وَكَانَ أَفْقَهَ مِنْهُ فَقَالَ صَدَقَ، اقْضِ بَيْنَنَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، وَأْذَنْ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قُلْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنَّ ابْنِي كَانَ عَسِيفًا فِي أَهْلِ، هَذَا فَزَنَى بِامْرَأَتِهِ، فَافْتَدَيْتُ مِنْهُ بِمِائَةِ شَاةٍ وَخَادِمٍ وَإِنِّي سَأَلْتُ رِجَالاً مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ فَأَخْبَرُونِي أَنَّ عَلَى ابْنِي جَلْدَ مِائَةٍ وَتَغْرِيبَ عَامٍ، وَأَنَّ عَلَى امْرَأَةِ هَذَا الرَّجْمَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لأَقْضِيَنَّ بَيْنَكُمَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، الْمِائَةُ وَالْخَادِمُ رَدٌّ عَلَيْكَ، وَعَلَى ابْنِكَ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَتَغْرِيبُ عَامٍ، وَيَا أُنَيْسُ اغْدُ عَلَى امْرَأَةِ هَذَا فَسَلْهَا، فَإِنِ اعْتَرَفَتْ فَارْجُمْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَاعْتَرَفَتْ فَرَجَمَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, wazaydi bni khaalidin aljuhaniyyi, qaalaa jaa'a rajulun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala aanshuduka alllaha iilaaa qadayta baynanaa bikitaabi alllahi‏.‏ faqaama khasmuhu wakaana aafqaha minhu faqaala sadaqa, aqdi baynanaa bikitaabi alllahi, waadhan liy yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ qul ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala iinna abniy kaana 'asiyfana fiy aahli, hadhaa fazanaa biamraaatihi, faaftadaytu minhu bimiaiaai shaaain wakhaadimin waiinniy saaaltu rijaalaan min aahli al'ilmi faaakhbaruwniy aanna 'alaa abniy jalda miaiaain wataghriyba 'aamin, waaanna 'alaa amraaaai hadhaa alrrajma‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi laaqdiyanna baynakumaa bikitaabi alllahi, almiaiaau waalkhaadimu raddun 'alayka, wa'alaa abnika jaldu miaiaain wataghriybu 'aamin, wayaa aunaysu aghdu 'alaa amraaaai hadhaa fasalhaa, faiini a'tarafat faarjumhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faa'tarafat farajamahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I beseech you to judge us according to Allah's Laws." Then his opponent who was wiser than he, got up and said, "He has spoken the truth. So judge us according to Allah's Laws and please allow me (to speak), O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Speak." He said, "My son was a laborer for the family of this man and he committed illegal sexual intercourse with his wife, and I gave one-hundred sheep and a slave as a ransom (for my son), but I asked the religious learned people (regarding this case), and they informed me that my son should be flogged onehundred stripes, and be exiled for one year, and the wife of this man should be stoned (to death)."The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, I will Judge you (in this case) according to Allah's Laws. The one-hundred (sheep) and the slave shall be returned to you and your son shall be flogged one-hundred stripes and be exiled for one year. And O Unais! Go in the morning to the wife of this man and ask her, and if she confesses, stone her to death." She confessed and he stoned her to death
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُرَحْبِيلَ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَىُّ الذَّنْبِ أَكْبَرُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تَدْعُوَ لِلَّهِ نِدًّا، وَهْوَ خَلَقَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ أَىٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ أَنْ تَقْتُلَ وَلَدَكَ، أَنْ يَطْعَمَ مَعَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ أَىٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ أَنْ تُزَانِيَ بِحَلِيلَةِ جَارِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ تَصْدِيقَهَا ‏{‏وَالَّذِينَ لاَ يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ وَلاَ يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ وَلاَ يَزْنُونَ وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ‏ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, hadaathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'amriw bni shurahbiyla, qaala qaala 'abdu allaahi qaala rajulun yaa rasuwla allaahi aaauu aldhaanbi aakbaru 'inda allaahi qaala ‏"‏ aan tad'uwa lilaahi nidanna, wahwa khalaqaka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala thumaa aaaunn qaala ‏"‏ thumaa aan taqtula waladaka, aan yat'ama ma'aka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala thumaa aaaunn qaala ‏"‏ thumaa aan tuzaaniya bihaliylaai jaarika ‏"‏‏.‏ faaanzala allaahu 'azaa wajalaa tasdiyqahaa ‏{‏waalaadhiyna laa yad'uwna ma'a allaahi iilahana akhara walaa yaqtuluwna alnaafsa alaatiy haraama allaahu iilaaa bialhaqii walaa yaznuwna waman yaf'al dhalika‏ yalqa aathaamana}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Which sin is the greatest in Allah's Sight?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To set up a rival unto Allah though He Alone created you . " The man said, "What is next?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To kill your son lest he should share your food with you." The man said, "What is next?" The Prophet said, "To commit illegal sexual intercourse with the wife of your neighbor." So Allah revealed in confirmation of this narration:-- 'And those who invoke not with Allah, any other god. Nor kill, such life as Allah has forbidden except for just cause nor commit illegal sexual intercourse. And whoever does this shall receive the punishment
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَنْ يَزَالَ الْمُؤْمِنُ فِي فُسْحَةٍ مِنْ دِينِهِ، مَا لَمْ يُصِبْ دَمًا حَرَامًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu sa'iydi bni 'amriw bni sa'iydi bni al'aasi, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ lan yazaala almuuminu fiy fushaain min diynihi, maa lam yusib damana haraamana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A faithful believer remains at liberty regarding his religion unless he kills somebody unlawfully
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ إِنَّ مِنْ وَرْطَاتِ الأُمُورِ الَّتِي لاَ مَخْرَجَ لِمَنْ أَوْقَعَ نَفْسَهُ فِيهَا، سَفْكَ الدَّمِ الْحَرَامِ بِغَيْرِ حِلِّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu ya'quwba, haddathanaa iishaaqu, sami'tu aabiy yuhaddithu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, qaala iinna min wartaati alaumuwri allatiy laa makhraja liman aawqa'a nafsahu fiyhaa, safka alddami alharaami bighayri hillihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:One of the evil deeds with bad consequence from which there is no escape for the one who is involved in it is to kill someone unlawfully
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَوَّلُ مَا يُقْضَى بَيْنَ النَّاسِ فِي الدِّمَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aawwalu maa yuqdaa bayna alnnaasi fiy alddimaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The first cases to be decided among the people (on the Day of Resurrection) will be those of blood-shed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ الْمِقْدَادَ بْنَ عَمْرٍو الْكِنْدِيَّ حَلِيفَ بَنِي زُهْرَةَ حَدَّثَهُ وَكَانَ، شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنْ لَقِيتُ كَافِرًا فَاقْتَتَلْنَا، فَضَرَبَ يَدِي بِالسَّيْفِ فَقَطَعَهَا، ثُمَّ لاَذَ بِشَجَرَةٍ وَقَالَ أَسْلَمْتُ لِلَّهِ‏.‏ آقْتُلُهُ بَعْدَ أَنْ قَالَهَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَقْتُلْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّهُ طَرَحَ إِحْدَى يَدَىَّ، ثُمَّ قَالَ بَعْدَ مَا قَطَعَهَا، آقْتُلُهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَقْتُلْهُ، فَإِنْ قَتَلْتَهُ فَإِنَّهُ بِمَنْزِلَتِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقْتُلَهُ، وَأَنْتَ بِمَنْزِلَتِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُولَ كَلِمَتَهُ الَّتِي قَالَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ حَبِيبُ بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلْمِقْدَادِ ‏"‏ إِذَا كَانَ رَجُلٌ مُؤْمِنٌ يُخْفِي إِيمَانَهُ مَعَ قَوْمٍ كُفَّارٍ، فَأَظْهَرَ إِيمَانَهُ، فَقَتَلْتَهُ، فَكَذَلِكَ كُنْتَ أَنْتَ تُخْفِي إِيمَانَكَ بِمَكَّةَ مِنْ قَبْلُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi, haddathanaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, haddathanaa 'ataa'u bnu yaziyda, aanna 'ubayda alllahi bna 'adiyyin, haddathahu aanna almiqdaada bna 'amrinw alkindiyya haliyfa baniy zuhraaa haddathahu wakaana, shahida badrana ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iin laqiytu kaafirana faaqtatalnaa, fadaraba yadiy bialssayfi faqata'ahaa, thumma laadha bishajaraain waqaala aaslamtu lillahi‏.‏ aqtuluhu ba'da aan qaalahaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa taqtulhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi faiinnahu taraha iihdaa yadaaaa, thumma qaala ba'da maa qata'ahaa, aqtuluhu qaala ‏"‏ laa taqtulhu, faiin qataltahu faiinnahu bimanzilatika qabla aan taqtulahu, waaanta bimanzilatihi qabla aan yaquwla kalimatahu allatiy qaala ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala habiybu bnu aabiy 'amraaa 'an sa'iydin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm lilmiqdaadi ‏"‏ iidhaa kaana rajulun muuminun yukhfiy iiymaanahu ma'a qawmin kuffaarin, faaazhara iiymaanahu, faqataltahu, fakadhalika kunta aanta tukhfiy iiymaanaka bimakkaaa min qablu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Miqdad bin `Amr Al-Kindi:An ally of Bani Zuhra who took part in the battle of Badr with the Prophet, that he said, "O Allah's Apostle! If I meet an unbeliever and we have a fight, and he strikes my hand with the sword and cuts it off, and then takes refuge from me under a tree, and says, 'I have surrendered to Allah (i.e. embraced Islam),' may I kill him after he has said so?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not kill him." Al- Miqdad said, "But O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He had chopped off one of my hands and he said that after he had cut it off. May I kill him?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said. "Do not kill him for if you kill him, he would be in the position in which you had been before you kill him, and you would be in the position in which he was before he said the sentence." The Prophet (ﷺ) also said to Al-Miqdad, "If a faithful believer conceals his faith (Islam) from the disbelievers, and then when he declares his Islam, you kill him, (you will be sinful). Remember that you were also concealing your faith (Islam) at Mecca before
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تُقْتَلُ نَفْسٌ إِلاَّ كَانَ عَلَى ابْنِ آدَمَ الأَوَّلِ كِفْلٌ مِنْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni murraaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tuqtalu nafsun iilaaa kaana 'alaa abni adama alaawwali kiflun minhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No human being is killed unjustly, but a part of responsibility for the crime is laid on the first son of Adam who invented the tradition of killing (murdering) on the earth. (It is said that he was Qabil)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ وَاقِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَخْبَرَنِي عَنْ أَبِيهِ، سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَرْجِعُوا بَعْدِي كُفَّارًا يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala waaqidu bnu 'abdi alllahi aakhbaraniy 'an aabiyhi, sami'a 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tarji'uwa ba'diy kuffaarana yadribu ba'dukum riqaaba ba'din ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "After me (i.e. after my death), do not become disbelievers, by striking (cutting) the necks of one another
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُدْرِكٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا زُرْعَةَ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏ "‏ اسْتَنْصِتِ النَّاسَ، لاَ تَرْجِعُوا بَعْدِي كُفَّارًا يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ رَوَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرَةَ وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'aliyyi bni mudrikin, qaala sami'tu aabaa zur'aaa bna 'amriw bni jariyrin, 'an jariyrin, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i ‏ "‏ astansiti alnnaasa, laa tarji'uwa ba'diy kuffaarana yadribu ba'dukum riqaaba ba'din ‏"‏‏.‏ rawaahu aabuw bakraaa waabnu 'abbaasin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Zur'a bin `Amr bin Jarir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said during Hajjat-al-Wada`, "Let the people be quiet and listen to me. After me, do not become disbelievers, by striking (cutting) the necks of one another
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الْكَبَائِرُ الإِشْرَاكُ بِاللَّهِ، وَعُقُوقُ الْوَالِدَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْيَمِينُ الْغَمُوسُ ‏"‏‏.‏ شَكَّ شُعْبَةُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُعَاذٌ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْكَبَائِرُ الإِشْرَاكُ بِاللَّهِ، وَالْيَمِينُ الْغَمُوسُ، وَعُقُوقُ الْوَالِدَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَقَتْلُ النَّفْسِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an firaasin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ alkabaaiiru aliishraaku bialllahi, wa'uquwqu alwaalidayni ‏"‏‏.‏ aaw qaala ‏"‏ alyamiynu alghamuwsu ‏"‏‏.‏ shakka shu'baau‏.‏ waqaala mu'aadhun haddathanaa shu'baau qaala ‏"‏ alkabaaiiru aliishraaku bialllahi, waalyamiynu alghamuwsu, wa'uquwqu alwaalidayni ‏"‏‏.‏ aaw qaala ‏"‏ waqatlu alnnafsi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Al-Ka`ba'ir (the biggest sins) are: To join others (as partners) in worship with Allah, to be undutiful to one's parents," or said, "to take a false oath." (The sub-narrator, Shu`ba is not sure) Mu`adh said: Shu`ba said, "Al-Ka`ba'ir (the biggest sins) are: (1) Joining others as partners in worship with Allah, (2) to take a false oath (3) and to be undutiful to one's parents," or said, "to murder (someone unlawfully)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، سَمِعَ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الْكَبَائِرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَكْبَرُ الْكَبَائِرِ الإِشْرَاكُ بِاللَّهِ وَقَتْلُ النَّفْسِ، وَعُقُوقُ الْوَالِدَيْنِ، وَقَوْلُ الزُّورِ ‏"‏‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَشَهَادَةُ الزُّورِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu aabiy bakrin, sami'a aanasana rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ alkabaaiiru ‏"‏‏.‏ wahaddathanaa 'amrunw haddathanaa shu'baau 'ani abni aabiy bakrin 'an aanasi bni maalikin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ aakbaru alkabaaiiri aliishraaku bialllahi waqatlu alnnafsi, wa'uquwqu alwaalidayni, waqawlu alzzuwri ‏"‏‏.‏ aaw qaala ‏"‏ washahaadaau alzzuwri ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The biggest of Al-Ka`ba'ir (the great sins) are (1) to join others as partners in worship with Allah, (2) to murder a human being, (3) to be undutiful to one's parents (4) and to make a false statement," or said, "to give a false witness
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو ظَبْيَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يُحَدِّثُ قَالَ بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْحُرَقَةِ مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ ـ قَالَ ـ فَصَبَّحْنَا الْقَوْمَ فَهَزَمْنَاهُمْ ـ قَالَ ـ وَلَحِقْتُ أَنَا وَرَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ رَجُلاً مِنْهُمْ ـ قَالَ ـ فَلَمَّا غَشِينَاهُ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ـ قَالَ ـ فَكَفَّ عَنْهُ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، فَطَعَنْتُهُ بِرُمْحِي حَتَّى قَتَلْتُهُ ـ قَالَ ـ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا بَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ يَا أُسَامَةُ أَقَتَلْتَهُ بَعْدَ مَا قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا كَانَ مُتَعَوِّذًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَقَتَلْتَهُ بَعْدَ أَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا زَالَ يُكَرِّرُهَا عَلَىَّ حَتَّى تَمَنَّيْتُ أَنِّي لَمْ أَكُنْ أَسْلَمْتُ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu zuraaraaa, haddathanaa hushaymun, haddathanaa husaynun, haddathanaa aabuw zabyaana, qaala sami'tu ausaamaaa bna zaydi bni haarithaaa rda allh 'nhma yuhaddithu qaala ba'athanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa alhuraqaai min juhaynaaa qaala fasabbahnaa alqawma fahazamnaahum qaala walahiqtu aanaa warajulun mina alaansaari rajulaan minhum qaala falammaa ghashiynaahu qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu qaala fakaffa 'anhu alaansaariyyu, fata'antuhu birumhiy hattaa qataltuhu qaala falammaa qadimnaa balagha dhalika alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala faqaala liy ‏"‏ yaa ausaamaau aaqataltahu ba'da maa qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnamaa kaana muta'awwidhana‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aaqataltahu ba'da aan qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala famaa zaala yukarriruhaa 'alaaaa hattaa tamannaytu aanniy lam aakun aaslamtu qabla dhalika alyawmi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Usama bin Zaid bin Haritha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent us (to fight) against Al-Huraqa (one of the sub-tribes) of Juhaina. We reached those people in the morning and defeated them. A man from the Ansar and I chased one of their men and when we attacked him, he said, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah." The Ansari refrained from killing him but I stabbed him with my spear till I killed him. When we reached (Medina), this news reached the Prophet. He said to me, "O Usama! You killed him after he had said, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah?"' I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He said so in order to save himself." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You killed him after he had said, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah." The Prophet (ﷺ) kept on repeating that statement till I wished I had not been a Muslim before that day
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنِ الصُّنَابِحِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ إِنِّي مِنَ النُّقَبَاءِ الَّذِينَ بَايَعُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَايَعْنَاهُ عَلَى أَنْ لاَ نُشْرِكَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا، وَلاَ نَسْرِقَ وَلاَ نَزْنِيَ، وَلاَ نَقْتُلَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ، وَلاَ نَنْتَهِبَ، وَلاَ نَعْصِيَ، بِالْجَنَّةِ إِنْ فَعَلْنَا ذَلِكَ، فَإِنْ غَشِينَا مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا كَانَ قَضَاءُ ذَلِكَ إِلَى اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa alllaythu, haddathanaa yaziydu, 'an aabiy alkhayri, 'ani alssunaabihiyyi, 'an 'ubaadaaa bni alssaamiti rda allh 'nh qaala iinniy mina alnnuqabaa'i alladhiyna baaya'uwa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm baaya'naahu 'alaa aan laa nushrika bialllahi shayiana, walaa nasriqa walaa nazniya, walaa naqtula alnnafsa allatiy harrama alllahu, walaa nantahiba, walaa na'siya, bialjannaai iin fa'alnaa dhalika, faiin ghashiynaa min dhalika shayiana kaana qadaa'u dhalika iilaa alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samat:I was among those Naqibs (selected leaders) who gave the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). We gave the oath of allegiance, that we would not join partners in worship besides Allah, would not steal, would not commit illegal sexual intercourse, would not kill a life which Allah has forbidden, would not commit robbery, would not disobey (Allah and His Apostle), and if we fulfilled this pledge we would have Paradise, but if we committed any one of these (sins), then our case will be decided by Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ حَمَلَ عَلَيْنَا السِّلاَحَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا ‏"‏‏.‏ رَوَاهُ أَبُو مُوسَى عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa juwayriyaau, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man hamala 'alaynaa alssilaaha falaysa minnaa ‏"‏‏.‏ rawaahu aabuw muwsaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever carries arms against us, is not from us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، وَيُونُسُ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ الأَحْنَفِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ ذَهَبْتُ لأَنْصُرَ هَذَا الرَّجُلَ، فَلَقِيَنِي أَبُو بَكْرَةَ فَقَالَ أَيْنَ تُرِيدُ قُلْتُ أَنْصُرُ هَذَا الرَّجُلَ‏.‏ قَالَ ارْجِعْ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِذَا الْتَقَى الْمُسْلِمَانِ بِسَيْفَيْهِمَا فَالْقَاتِلُ وَالْمَقْتُولُ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا الْقَاتِلُ فَمَا بَالُ الْمَقْتُولِ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حَرِيصًا عَلَى قَتْلِ صَاحِبِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu almubaaraki, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, wayuwnusu, 'ani alhasani, 'ani alaahnafi bni qaysin, qaala dhahabtu laansura hadhaa alrrajula, falaqiyaniy aabuw bakraaa faqaala aayna turiydu qultu aansuru hadhaa alrrajula‏.‏ qaala arji' faiinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ iidhaa altaqaa almuslimaani bisayfayhimaa faalqaatilu waalmaqtuwlu fiy alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi hadhaa alqaatilu famaa baalu almaqtuwli qaala ‏"‏ iinnahu kaana hariysana 'alaa qatli saahibihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Ahnaf bin Qais:I went to help that man (i.e., `Ali), and on the way I met Abu Bakra who asked me, "Where are you going?" I replied, "I am going to help that man." He said, "Go back, for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'If two Muslims meet each other with their swords then (both) the killer and the killed one are in the (Hell) Fire.' I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! It is alright for the killer, but what about the killed one?' He said, 'The killed one was eager to kill his opponent
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ يَهُودِيًّا، رَضَّ رَأْسَ جَارِيَةٍ بَيْنَ حَجَرَيْنِ، فَقِيلَ لَهَا مَنْ فَعَلَ بِكِ هَذَا أَفُلاَنٌ أَوْ فُلاَنٌ حَتَّى سُمِّيَ الْيَهُودِيُّ، فَأُتِيَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَزَلْ بِهِ حَتَّى أَقَرَّ بِهِ، فَرُضَّ رَأْسُهُ بِالْحِجَارَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna yahuwdiyyana, radda raasa jaariyaain bayna hajarayni, faqiyla lahaa man fa'ala biki hadhaa aafulaanun aaw fulaanun hattaa summiya alyahuwdiyyu, faautiya bihi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm falam yazal bihi hattaa aaqarra bihi, farudda raasuhu bialhijaaraai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A Jew crushed the head of a girl between two stones, and the girl was asked, "Who has done that to you, so-and-so or so and so?" (Some names were mentioned for her) till the name of that Jew was mentioned (whereupon she agreed). The Jew was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) kept on questioning him till he confessed, whereupon his head was crushed with stones
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ خَرَجَتْ جَارِيَةٌ عَلَيْهَا أَوْضَاحٌ بِالْمَدِينَةِ ـ قَالَ ـ فَرَمَاهَا يَهُودِيٌّ بِحَجَرٍ ـ قَالَ ـ فَجِيءَ بِهَا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِهَا رَمَقٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فُلاَنٌ قَتَلَكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَفَعَتْ رَأْسَهَا، فَأَعَادَ عَلَيْهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ فُلاَنٌ قَتَلَكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَفَعَتْ رَأْسَهَا، فَقَالَ لَهَا فِي الثَّالِثَةِ ‏"‏ فُلاَنٌ قَتَلَكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَخَفَضَتْ رَأْسَهَا، فَدَعَا بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَتَلَهُ بَيْنَ الْحَجَرَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa, 'an shu'baaa, 'an hishaami bni zaydi bni aanasin, 'an jaddihi, aanasi bni maalikin qaala kharajat jaariyaaun 'alayhaa aawdaahun bialmadiynaai qaala faramaahaa yahuwdiyyun bihajarin qaala fajiy'a bihaa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wabihaa ramaqun faqaala lahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ fulaanun qatalaki ‏"‏‏.‏ farafa'at raasahaa, faaa'aada 'alayhaa qaala ‏"‏ fulaanun qatalaki ‏"‏‏.‏ farafa'at raasahaa, faqaala lahaa fiy althhaalithaai ‏"‏ fulaanun qatalaki ‏"‏‏.‏ fakhafadat raasahaa, fada'aa bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqatalahu bayna alhajarayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A girl wearing ornaments, went out at Medina. Somebody struck her with a stone. She was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) while she was still alive. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked her, "Did such-and-such a person strike you?" She raised her head, denying that. He asked her a second time, saying, "Did so-and-so strike you?" She raised her head, denying that. He said for the third time, "Did so-and-so strike you?" She lowered her head, agreeing. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then sent for the killer and killed him between two stones
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ دَمُ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ بِإِحْدَى ثَلاَثٍ النَّفْسُ بِالنَّفْسِ وَالثَّيِّبُ الزَّانِي، وَالْمَارِقُ مِنَ الدِّينِ التَّارِكُ الْجَمَاعَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni murraaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yahillu damu amriiin muslimin yashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waaanniy rasuwlu alllahi iilaaa biiihdaa thalaathin alnnafsu bialnnafsi waalthhayyibu alzzaaniy, waalmaariqu mina alddiyni alttaariku aljamaa'aaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The blood of a Muslim who confesses that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that I am His Apostle, cannot be shed except in three cases: In Qisas for murder, a married person who commits illegal sexual intercourse and the one who reverts from Islam (apostate) and leaves the Muslims
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ يَهُودِيًّا، قَتَلَ جَارِيَةً عَلَى أَوْضَاحٍ لَهَا، فَقَتَلَهَا بِحَجَرٍ، فَجِيءَ بِهَا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِهَا رَمَقٌ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَقَتَلَكِ فُلاَنٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَشَارَتْ بِرَأْسِهَا أَنْ لاَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ الثَّانِيَةَ، فَأَشَارَتْ بِرَأْسِهَا أَنْ لاَ، ثُمَّ سَأَلَهَا الثَّالِثَةَ فَأَشَارَتْ بِرَأْسِهَا أَنْ نَعَمْ، فَقَتَلَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِحَجَرَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an hishaami bni zaydin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh aanna yahuwdiyyana, qatala jaariyaaan 'alaa aawdaahin lahaa, faqatalahaa bihajarin, fajiy'a bihaa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wabihaa ramaqun faqaala ‏ "‏ aaqatalaki fulaanun ‏"‏‏.‏ faaashaarat biraasihaa aan laa, thumma qaala althhaaniyaaa, faaashaarat biraasihaa aan laa, thumma saaalahaa althhaalithaaa faaashaarat biraasihaa aan na'am, faqatalahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bihajarayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:A Jew killed a girl so that he may steal her ornaments. He struck her with a stone, and she was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) while she was still alive. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked her, "Did such-and-such person strike you?" She gestured with her head, expressing denial. He asked her for the second time, and she again gestured with her head, expressing denial. When he asked her for the third time, she beckoned, "Yes." So the Prophet (ﷺ) killed him (the Jew) with two stones
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ خُزَاعَةَ، قَتَلُوا رَجُلاً‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّهُ عَامَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ قَتَلَتْ خُزَاعَةُ رَجُلاً مِنْ بَنِي لَيْثٍ بِقَتِيلٍ لَهُمْ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَبَسَ عَنْ مَكَّةَ الْفِيلَ وَسَلَّطَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَسُولَهُ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ، أَلاَ وَإِنَّهَا لَمْ تَحِلَّ لأَحَدٍ قَبْلِي، وَلاَ تَحِلُّ لأَحَدٍ بَعْدِي، أَلاَ وَإِنَّمَا أُحِلَّتْ لِي سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ، أَلاَ وَإِنَّهَا سَاعَتِي هَذِهِ حَرَامٌ لاَ يُخْتَلَى شَوْكُهَا، وَلاَ يُعْضَدُ شَجَرُهَا، وَلاَ يَلْتَقِطُ سَاقِطَتَهَا إِلاَّ مُنْشِدٌ، وَمَنْ قُتِلَ لَهُ قَتِيلٌ فَهْوَ بِخَيْرِ النَّظَرَيْنِ إِمَّا يُودَى وَإِمَّا يُقَادُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ يُقَالُ لَهُ أَبُو شَاهٍ فَقَالَ اكْتُبْ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اكْتُبُوا لأَبِي شَاهٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ، فَإِنَّمَا نَجْعَلُهُ فِي بُيُوتِنَا وَقُبُورِنَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَتَابَعَهُ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ شَيْبَانَ فِي الْفِيلِ، قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَنْ أَبِي نُعَيْمٍ الْقَتْلَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ إِمَّا أَنْ يُقَادَ أَهْلُ الْقَتِيلِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna khuzaa'aaa, qataluwa rajulaan‏.‏ waqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu rajaa'in haddathanaa harbun 'an yahyaa haddathanaa aabuw salamaaa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa aannahu 'aama fathi makkaaa qatalat khuzaa'aau rajulaan min baniy laythin biqatiylin lahum fiy aljaahiliyyaai, faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ iinna alllaha habasa 'an makkaaa alfiyla wasallata 'alayhim rasuwlahu waalmuuminiyna, aalaa waiinnahaa lam tahilla laahadin qabliy, walaa tahillu laahadin ba'diy, aalaa waiinnamaa auhillat liy saa'aaan min nahaarin, aalaa waiinnahaa saa'atiy hadhihi haraamun laa yukhtalaa shawkuhaa, walaa yu'dadu shajaruhaa, walaa yaltaqitu saaqitatahaa iilaaa munshidun, waman qutila lahu qatiylun fahwa bikhayri alnnazarayni iimmaa yuwdaa waiimmaa yuqaadu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaama rajulun min aahli alyamani yuqaalu lahu aabuw shaahin faqaala aktub liy yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aktubuwa laabiy shaahin ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaama rajulun min qurayshin faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iilaaa aliidhkhira, faiinnamaa naj'aluhu fiy buyuwtinaa waqubuwrinaa‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iilaaa aliidhkhira ‏"‏‏.‏ wataaba'ahu 'ubaydu alllahi 'an shaybaana fiy alfiyli, qaala ba'duhum 'an aabiy nu'aymin alqatla‏.‏ waqaala 'ubaydu alllahi iimmaa aan yuqaada aahlu alqatiyli‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:In the year of the Conquest of Mecca, the tribe of Khuza`a killed a man from the tribe of Bani Laith in revenge for a killed person belonging to them in the Pre-Islamic Period of Ignorance. So Allah's Apostle got up saying, "Allah held back the (army having) elephants from Mecca, but He let His Apostle and the believers overpower the infidels (of Mecca). Beware! (Mecca is a sanctuary)! Verily! Fighting in Mecca was not permitted for anybody before me, nor will it be permitted for anybody after me; It was permitted for me only for a while (an hour or so) of that day. No doubt! It is at this moment a sanctuary; its thorny shrubs should not be uprooted; its trees should not be cut down; and its Luqata (fallen things) should not be picked up except by the one who would look for its owner. And if somebody is killed, his closest relative has the right to choose one of two things, i.e., either the Blood money or retaliation by having the killer killed." Then a man from Yemen, called Abu Shah, stood up and said, "Write that) for me, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to his companions), "Write that for Abu Shah." Then another man from Quraish got up, saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Except Al- Idhkhir (a special kind of grass) as we use it in our houses and for graves." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Except Al-idhkkir
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَتْ فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ قِصَاصٌ، وَلَمْ تَكُنْ فِيهِمُ الدِّيَةُ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ لِهَذِهِ الأُمَّةِ ‏{‏كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِصَاصُ فِي الْقَتْلَى‏}‏ إِلَى هَذِهِ الآيَةِ ‏{‏فَمَنْ عُفِيَ لَهُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ شَىْءٌ‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَالْعَفْوُ أَنْ يَقْبَلَ الدِّيَةَ فِي الْعَمْدِ، قَالَ ‏{‏فَاتِّبَاعٌ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ‏}‏ أَنْ يَطْلُبَ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَيُؤَدِّيَ بِإِحْسَانٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala kaanat fiy baniy iisraaiiyla qisaasun, walam takun fiyhimu alddiyaau faqaala alllahu lihadhihi alaummaai ‏{‏kutiba 'alaykumu alqisaasu fiy alqatlaa‏}‏ iilaa hadhihi alayaai ‏{‏faman 'ufiya lahu min aakhiyhi shaa'un‏}‏‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin faal'afwu aan yaqbala alddiyaaa fiy al'amdi, qaala ‏{‏faattibaa'un bialma'ruwfi‏}‏ aan yatluba bima'ruwfin wayuuaddiya biiihsaanin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:For the children of Israel the punishment for crime was Al-Qisas only (i.e., the law of equality in punishment) and the payment of Blood money was not permitted as an alternate. But Allah said to this nation (Muslims): 'O you who believe! Qisas is prescribed for you in case of murder, .....(up to) ...end of the Verse. (2.178) Ibn `Abbas added: Remission (forgiveness) in this Verse, means to accept the Blood-money in an intentional murder. Ibn `Abbas added: The Verse: 'Then the relatives should demand Blood-money in a reasonable manner.' (2.178) means that the demand should be reasonable and it is to be compensated with handsome gratitude
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَبْغَضُ النَّاسِ إِلَى اللَّهِ ثَلاَثَةٌ مُلْحِدٌ فِي الْحَرَمِ، وَمُبْتَغٍ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ سُنَّةَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، وَمُطَّلِبُ دَمِ امْرِئٍ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ لِيُهَرِيقَ دَمَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy husaynin, haddathanaa naafi'u bnu jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aabghadu alnnaasi iilaa alllahi thalaathaaun mulhidun fiy alharami, wamubtaghin fiy aliislaami sunnaaa aljaahiliyyaai, wamuttalibu dami amriiin bighayri haqqin liyuhariyqa damahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most hated persons to Allah are three: (1) A person who deviates from the right conduct, i.e., an evil doer, in the Haram (sanctuaries of Mecca and Medina); (2) a person who seeks that the traditions of the Pre-Islamic Period of Ignorance, should remain in Islam (3) and a person who seeks to shed somebody's blood without any right
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا فَرْوَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، هُزِمَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَرْوَانَ، يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي زَكَرِيَّاءَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ صَرَخَ إِبْلِيسُ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ فِي النَّاسِ يَا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ أُخْرَاكُمْ‏.‏ فَرَجَعَتْ أُولاَهُمْ عَلَى أُخْرَاهُمْ حَتَّى قَتَلُوا الْيَمَانَ فَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ أَبِي أَبِي‏.‏ فَقَتَلُوهُ، فَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَدْ كَانَ انْهَزَمَ مِنْهُمْ قَوْمٌ حَتَّى لَحِقُوا بِالطَّائِفِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa farwaau, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, huzima almushrikuwna yawma auhudin‏.‏ wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu harbin, haddathanaa aabuw marwaana, yahyaa bnu aabiy zakariyyaa'a 'an hishaamin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat sarakha iibliysu yawma auhudin fiy alnnaasi yaa 'ibaada alllahi aukhraakum‏.‏ faraja'at auwlaahum 'alaa aukhraahum hattaa qataluwa alyamaana faqaala hudhayfaau aabiy aabiy‏.‏ faqataluwhu, faqaala hudhayfaau ghafara alllahu lakum‏.‏ qaala waqad kaana anhazama minhum qawmun hattaa lahiquwa bialttaaiifi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The pagans were defeated on the day (of the battle) of Uhud. Satan shouted among the people on the day of Uhud, "O Allah's worshippers! Beware of what is behind you!" So the front file of the army attacked the back files (mistaking them for the enemy) till they killed Al-Yaman. Hudhaifa (bin Al- Yaman) shouted, "My father!" My father! But they killed him. Hudhaifa said, "May Allah forgive you." (The narrator added: Some of the defeated pagans fled till they reached Taif)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَبَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ يَهُودِيًّا، رَضَّ رَأْسَ جَارِيَةٍ بَيْنَ حَجَرَيْنِ، فَقِيلَ لَهَا مَنْ فَعَلَ بِكِ هَذَا أَفُلاَنٌ أَفُلاَنٌ حَتَّى سُمِّيَ الْيَهُودِيُّ فَأَوْمَأَتْ بِرَأْسِهَا، فَجِيءَ بِالْيَهُودِيِّ فَاعْتَرَفَ، فَأَمَرَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرُضَّ رَأْسُهُ بِالْحِجَارَةِ‏.‏ وَقَدْ قَالَ هَمَّامٌ بِحَجَرَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa habbaanu, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna yahuwdiyyana, radda raasa jaariyaain bayna hajarayni, faqiyla lahaa man fa'ala biki hadhaa aafulaanun aafulaanun hattaa summiya alyahuwdiyyu faaawmaaat biraasihaa, fajiy'a bialyahuwdiyyi faa'tarafa, faaamara bihi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm farudda raasuhu bialhijaaraai‏.‏ waqad qaala hammaamun bihajarayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A Jew crushed the head of a girl between two stones. It was said to her. "Who has done this to you, such-and-such person, such-and-such person?" When the name of the Jew was mentioned, she nodded with her head, agreeing. So the Jew was brought and he confessed. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that his head be crushed with the stones. (Hammam said, "with two stones)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَتَلَ يَهُودِيًّا بِجَارِيَةٍ قَتَلَهَا عَلَى أَوْضَاحٍ لَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qatala yahuwdiyyana bijaariyaain qatalahaa 'alaa aawdaahin lahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) killed a Jew for killing a girl in order to take her ornaments
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ لَدَدْنَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَرَضِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَلُدُّونِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا كَرَاهِيَةُ الْمَرِيضِ لِلدَّوَاءِ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَبْقَى أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ إِلاَّ لُدَّ، غَيْرَ الْعَبَّاسِ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَشْهَدْكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu aabiy 'aaiishaaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat ladadnaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy maradihi faqaala ‏"‏ laa taludduwniy ‏"‏‏.‏ faqulnaa karaahiyaau almariydi lilddawaa'i‏.‏ falammaa aafaaqa qaala ‏"‏ laa yabqaa aahadun minkum iilaaa ludda, ghayra al'abbaasi faiinnahu lam yashhadkum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:We poured medicine into the mouth of the Prophet (ﷺ) during his ailment. He said, "Don't pour medicine into my mouth." (We thought he said that) out of the aversion a patient usually has for medicines. When he improved and felt better he said, "There is none of you but will be forced to drink medicine, except Al-`Abbas, for he did not witness your deed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، أَنَّ الأَعْرَجَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ إِنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ نَحْنُ الآخِرُونَ السَّابِقُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَبِإِسْنَادِهِ ‏"‏ لَوِ اطَّلَعَ فِي بَيْتِكَ أَحَدٌ وَلَمْ تَأْذَنْ لَهُ، خَذَفْتَهُ بِحَصَاةٍ فَفَقَأْتَ عَيْنَهُ، مَا كَانَ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ جُنَاحٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, aanna alaa'raja, haddathahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu iinnahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ nahnu alakhiruwna alssaabiquwna yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏‏.‏ wabiiisnaadihi ‏"‏ lawi attala'a fiy baytika aahadun walam taadhan lahu, khadhaftahu bihasaaain fafaqaata 'aynahu, maa kaana 'alayka min junaahin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "We (Muslims) are the last (to come) but (will be) the foremost (on the Day of Resurrection)." And added, "If someone is peeping (looking secretly) into your house without your permission, and you throw a stone at him and destroy his eyes, there will be no blame on you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ،، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، اطَّلَعَ فِي بَيْتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَدَّدَ إِلَيْهِ مِشْقَصًا‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ مَنْ حَدَّثَكَ قَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an humaydin, , aanna rajulaan, attala'a fiy bayti alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaddada iilayhi mishqasana‏.‏ faqultu man haddathaka qaala aanasu bnu maalikin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Yahya:Humaid said, "A man peeped into the house of the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) aimed an arrow head at him to hit him." I asked, "Who told you that?" He said, "Anas bin Malik" (See Hadith No. 258 and 259, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ هِشَامٌ أَخْبَرَنَا عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ هُزِمَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ فَصَاحَ إِبْلِيسُ أَىْ عِبَادَ اللَّهِ أُخْرَاكُمْ‏.‏ فَرَجَعَتْ أُولاَهُمْ، فَاجْتَلَدَتْ هِيَ وَأُخْرَاهُمْ، فَنَظَرَ حُذَيْفَةُ فَإِذَا هُوَ بِأَبِيهِ الْيَمَانِ فَقَالَ أَىْ عِبَادَ اللَّهِ أَبِي أَبِي‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا احْتَجَزُوا حَتَّى قَتَلُوهُ‏.‏ قَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ فَمَا زَالَتْ فِي حُذَيْفَةَ مِنْهُ بَقِيَّةٌ حَتَّى لَحِقَ بِاللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa aabuw ausaamaaa, qaala hishaamun aakhbaranaa 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat lammaa kaana yawma auhudin huzima almushrikuwna fasaaha iibliysu aaa 'ibaada alllahi aukhraakum‏.‏ faraja'at auwlaahum, faajtaladat hiya waaukhraahum, fanazara hudhayfaau faiidhaa huwa biaabiyhi alyamaani faqaala aaa 'ibaada alllahi aabiy aabiy‏.‏ qaalat fawaalllahi maa ahtajazuwa hattaa qataluwhu‏.‏ qaala hudhayfaau ghafara alllahu lakum‏.‏ qaala 'urwaau famaa zaalat fiy hudhayfaaa minhu baqiyyaaun hattaa lahiqa bialllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:"When it was the day of (the battle of) Uhud, the pagans were defeated. Then Satan shouted, "O Allah's worshipers! Beware of what is behind you!" So the front files attacked the back files of the army. Hudhaifa looked, and behold, there was his father, Al-Yaman (being attacked) ! He shouted (to his companions), "O Allah's worshipers, my father, my father!" But by Allah, they did not stop till they killed him (i.e., Hudhaifa's father). Hudhaifa said, "May Allah forgive you." (`Urwa said, Hudhaifa continued asking Allah's Forgiveness for the killer of his father till he died)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى خَيْبَرَ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ أَسْمِعْنَا يَا عَامِرُ مِنْ هُنَيْهَاتِكَ‏.‏ فَحَدَا بِهِمْ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنِ السَّائِقُ ‏"‏ قَالُوا عَامِرٌ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلاَّ أَمْتَعْتَنَا بِهِ‏.‏ فَأُصِيبَ صَبِيحَةَ لَيْلَتِهِ فَقَالَ الْقَوْمُ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُ، قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا رَجَعْتُ وَهُمْ يَتَحَدَّثُونَ أَنَّ عَامِرًا حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُ، فَجِئْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ فَدَاكَ أَبِي وَأُمِّي، زَعَمُوا أَنَّ عَامِرًا حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ كَذَبَ مَنْ قَالَهَا، إِنَّ لَهُ لأَجْرَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ، إِنَّهُ لَجَاهِدٌ مُجَاهِدٌ، وَأَىُّ قَتْلٍ يَزِيدُهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa almakkiyyu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu aabiy 'ubaydin, 'an salamaaa, qaala kharajnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa khaybara faqaala rajulun minhum aasmi'naa yaa 'aamiru min hunayhaatika‏.‏ fahadaa bihim, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ mani alssaaiiqu ‏"‏ qaaluwa 'aamirun‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ rahimahu alllahu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi halaaa aamta'tanaa bihi‏.‏ faausiyba sabiyhaaa laylatihi faqaala alqawmu habita 'amaluhu, qatala nafsahu‏.‏ falammaa raja'tu wahum yatahaddathuwna aanna 'aamirana habita 'amaluhu, fajiitu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu yaa nabiyya alllahi fadaaka aabiy waaummiy, za'amuwa aanna 'aamirana habita 'amaluhu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ kadhaba man qaalahaa, iinna lahu laajrayni athnayni, iinnahu lajaahidun mujaahidun, waaaaau qatlin yaziyduhu 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salama:We went out with the Prophet (ﷺ) to Khaibar. A man (from the companions) said, "O 'Amir! Let us hear some of your Huda (camel-driving songs.)" So he sang some of them (i.e. a lyric in harmony with the camels walk). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who is the driver (of these camels)?" They said, "Amir." The Prophet said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on him !" The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Would that you let us enjoy his company longer!" Then 'Amir was killed the following morning. The people said, "The good deeds of 'Amir are lost as he has killed himself." I returned at the time while they were talking about that. I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Prophet! Let my father be sacrificed for you! The people claim that 'Amir's good deeds are lost." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever says so is a liar, for 'Amir will have a double reward as he exerted himself to obey Allah and fought in Allah's Cause. No other way of killing would have granted him greater reward
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زُرَارَةَ بْنَ أَوْفَى، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، عَضَّ يَدَ رَجُلٍ، فَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ مِنْ فَمِهِ، فَوَقَعَتْ ثَنِيَّتَاهُ، فَاخْتَصَمُوا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَعَضُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ كَمَا يَعَضُّ الْفَحْلُ، لاَ دِيَةَ لَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa qataadaau, qaala sami'tu zuraaraaa bna aawfaa, 'an 'imraana bni husaynin, aanna rajulaan, 'adda yada rajulin, fanaza'a yadahu min famihi, fawaqa'at thaniyyataahu, faakhtasamuwa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ ya'addu aahadukum aakhaahu kamaa ya'addu alfahlu, laa diyaaa laka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:A man bit another man's hand and the latter pulled his hand out of his mouth by force, causing two of his incisors (teeth) to fall out. They submitted their case to the Prophet, who said, "One of you bit his brother as a male camel bites. (Go away), there is no Diya (Blood-money) for you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَعْلَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ فِي غَزْوَةٍ، فَعَضَّ رَجُلٌ فَانْتَزَعَ ثَنِيَّتَهُ، فَأَبْطَلَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an safwaana bni ya'laa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kharajtu fiy ghazwaain, fa'adda rajulun faantaza'a thaniyyatahu, faaabtalahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ya`la:I went out in one of the Ghazwa and a man bit another man and as a result, an incisor tooth of the former was pulled out. The Prophet (ﷺ) cancelled the case
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الأَنْصَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ ابْنَةَ النَّضْرِ، لَطَمَتْ جَارِيَةً، فَكَسَرَتْ ثَنِيَّتَهَا، فَأَتَوُا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَمَرَ بِالْقِصَاصِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alaansaariyyu, haddathanaa humaydun, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh aanna abnaaa alnnadri, latamat jaariyaaan, fakasarat thaniyyatahaa, faaatawua alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faaamara bialqisaasi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The daughter of An-Nadr slapped a girl and broke her incisor tooth. They (the relatives of that girl), came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he gave the order of Qisas (equality in punishment)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ هَذِهِ وَهَذِهِ سَوَاءٌ ‏"‏، يَعْنِي الْخِنْصَرَ وَالإِبْهَامَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ hadhihi wahadhihi sawaa'un ‏"‏, ya'niy alkhinsara waaliibhaama‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This and this are the same." He meant the little finger and the thumb
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahwahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I heard the Prophet (saying the same as above Hadith)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ لِي ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ غُلاَمًا، قُتِلَ غِيلَةً فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لَوِ اشْتَرَكَ فِيهَا أَهْلُ صَنْعَاءَ لَقَتَلْتُهُمْ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُغِيرَةُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ إِنَّ أَرْبَعَةً قَتَلُوا صَبِيًّا فَقَالَ عُمَرُ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ وَأَقَادَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ وَعَلِيٌّ وَسُوَيْدُ بْنُ مُقَرِّنٍ مِنْ لَطْمَةٍ‏.‏ وَأَقَادَ عُمَرُ مِنْ ضَرْبَةٍ بِالدِّرَّةِ‏.‏ وَأَقَادَ عَلِيٌّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةِ أَسْوَاطٍ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ شُرَيْحٌ مِنْ سَوْطٍ وَخُمُوشٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala liy abnu bashhaarin haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna ghulaamana, qutila ghiylaaan faqaala 'umaru lawi ashtaraka fiyhaa aahlu san'aa'a laqataltuhum‏.‏ waqaala mughiyraau bnu hakiymin 'an aabiyhi iinna aarba'aaan qataluwa sabiyyana faqaala 'umaru mithlahu‏.‏ waaaqaada aabuw bakrin waabnu alzzubayri wa'aliyyun wasuwaydu bnu muqarrinin min latmaain‏.‏ waaaqaada 'umaru min darbaain bialddirraai‏.‏ waaaqaada 'aliyyun min thalaathaai aaswaatin‏.‏ waaqtassa shurayhun min sawtin wakhumuwshin‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar said:A boy was assassinated. 'Umar said, "If all the people of San'a took part in the assassination I would kill them all." Al-Mughira bin Hakim said that his father said, "Four persons killed a boy, and 'Umar said (as above)." Abu Bakr, Ibn Az-Zubair, 'Ali and Suwaid bin Muqarrin gave the judgement of Al-Qisas (equality in punishment) in cases of slapping. And 'Umar carried out Al-Qisas for a strike with a stick. And 'Ali carried out Al-Qisas for three lashes with a whip. And Shuraih carried out for one last and for scratching
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ لَدَدْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَرَضِهِ، وَجَعَلَ يُشِيرُ إِلَيْنَا ‏"‏ لاَ تَلُدُّونِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْنَا كَرَاهِيَةُ الْمَرِيضِ بِالدَّوَاءِ، فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَمْ أَنْهَكُمْ أَنْ تَلُدُّونِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْنَا كَرَاهِيَةٌ لِلدَّوَاءِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَبْقَى مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ لُدَّ ـ وَأَنَا أَنْظُرُ ـ إِلاَّ الْعَبَّاسَ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَشْهَدْكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu aabiy 'aaiishaaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaalat 'aaiishaau ladadnaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy maradihi, waja'ala yushiyru iilaynaa ‏"‏ laa taludduwniy ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faqulnaa karaahiyaau almariydi bialddawaa'i, falammaa aafaaqa qaala ‏"‏ aalam aanhakum aan taludduwniy ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala qulnaa karaahiyaaun lilddawaa'i‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa yabqaa minkum aahadun iilaaa ludda waaanaa aanzuru iilaaa al'abbaasa faiinnahu lam yashhadkum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:We poured medicine into the mouth of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during his illness, and he pointed out to us intending to say, "Don't pour medicine into my mouth." We thought that his refusal was out of the aversion a patient usually has for medicine. When he improved and felt a bit better he said (to us.) "Didn't I forbid you to pour medicine into my mouth?" We said, "We thought (you did so) because of the aversion, one usually have for medicine." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is none of you but will be forced to drink medicine, and I will watch you, except Al-`Abbas, for he did not witness this act of yours
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، زَعَمَ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ يُقَالُ لَهُ سَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ نَفَرًا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ انْطَلَقُوا إِلَى خَيْبَرَ فَتَفَرَّقُوا فِيهَا، وَوَجَدُوا أَحَدَهُمْ قَتِيلاً، وَقَالُوا لِلَّذِي وُجِدَ فِيهِمْ قَتَلْتُمْ صَاحِبَنَا‏.‏ قَالُوا مَا قَتَلْنَا وَلاَ عَلِمْنَا قَاتِلاً‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقُوا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ انْطَلَقْنَا إِلَى خَيْبَرَ فَوَجَدْنَا أَحَدَنَا قَتِيلاً‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ الْكُبْرَ الْكُبْرَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ تَأْتُونَ بِالْبَيِّنَةِ عَلَى مَنْ قَتَلَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا مَا لَنَا بَيِّنَةٌ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَيَحْلِفُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ نَرْضَى بِأَيْمَانِ الْيَهُودِ‏.‏ فَكَرِهَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُبْطِلَ دَمَهُ، فَوَدَاهُ مِائَةً مِنْ إِبِلِ الصَّدَقَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'ubaydin, 'an bushayri bni yasaarin, za'ama aanna rajulaan, mina alaansaari yuqaalu lahu sahlu bnu aabiy hathmaaa aakhbarahu aanna nafarana min qawmihi antalaquwa iilaa khaybara fatafarraquwa fiyhaa, wawajaduwa aahadahum qatiylaan, waqaaluwa lilladhiy wujida fiyhim qataltum saahibanaa‏.‏ qaaluwa maa qatalnaa walaa 'alimnaa qaatilaan‏.‏ faantalaquwa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi antalaqnaa iilaa khaybara fawajadnaa aahadanaa qatiylaan‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ alkubra alkubra ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala lahum ‏"‏ taatuwna bialbayyinaai 'alaa man qatalahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa maa lanaa bayyinaaun‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fayahlifuwna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa laa nardaa biaaymaani alyahuwdi‏.‏ fakariha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yubtila damahu, fawadaahu miaiaaan min iibili alssadaqaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Abi Hathma:(a man from the Ansar) that a number of people from his tribe went to Khaibar and dispersed, and then they found one of them murdered. They said to the people with whom the corpse had been found, "You have killed our companion!" Those people said, "Neither have we killed him, nor do we know his killer." The bereaved group went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We went to Khaibar and found one of us murdered." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Let the older among you come forward and speak." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, to them, "Bring your proof against the killer." They said "We have no proof." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then they (the defendants) will take an oath." They said, "We do not accept the oaths of the Jews." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not like that the Blood-money of the killed one be lost without compensation, so he paid one-hundred camels out of the camels of Zakat (to the relatives of the deceased) as Diya (Blood-money)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الأَسَدِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو رَجَاءٍ، مِنْ آلِ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو قِلاَبَةَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، أَبْرَزَ سَرِيرَهُ يَوْمًا لِلنَّاسِ، ثُمَّ أَذِنَ لَهُمْ فَدَخَلُوا فَقَالَ مَا تَقُولُونَ فِي الْقَسَامَةِ قَالَ
