'Umar said, "Do not do so, for I intended to do the same as you do. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to give me gifts and I used to say to him, 'Give it to a more needy one than me.' Once he gave me some money and I said, 'Give it to a more needy person than me,' whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Take it and keep it in your possession and then give it in charity. Take what ever comes to you of this money if you are not keen to have it and not asking for it; otherwise (i.e., if it does not come to you) do not seek to have it yourself
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَعَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنْ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعْطِينِي الْعَطَاءَ فَأَقُولُ أَعْطِهِ أَفْقَرَ إِلَيْهِ مِنِّي‏.‏ حَتَّى أَعْطَانِي مَرَّةً مَالاً فَقُلْتُ أَعْطِهِ مَنْ هُوَ أَفْقَرُ إِلَيْهِ مِنِّي‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ خُذْهُ فَتَمَوَّلْهُ وَتَصَدَّقْ بِهِ، فَمَا جَاءَكَ مِنْ هَذَا الْمَالِ وَأَنْتَ غَيْرُ مُشْرِفٍ وَلاَ سَائِلٍ فَخُذْهُ، وَمَا لاَ فَلاَ تُتْبِعْهُ نَفْسَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: wa'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aan 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, qaala sami'tu 'umara, yaquwlu kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yu'tiyniy al'ataa'a faaaquwlu aa'tihi aafqara iilayhi minniy‏.‏ hattaa aa'taaniy marraaan maalaan faqultu aa'tihi man huwa aafqaru iilayhi minniy‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ khudhhu fatamawwalhu watasaddaq bihi, famaa jaa'aka min hadhaa almaali waaanta ghayru mushrifin walaa saaiilin fakhudhhu, wamaa laa falaa tutbi'hu nafsaka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Umar:I have heard 'Umar saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to give me some money (grant) and I would say (to him), 'Give it to a more needy one than me.' Once he gave me some money and I said, 'Give it to a more needy one than me.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to me), 'Take it and keep it in your possession and then give it in charity. Take whatever comes to you of this money while you are not keen to have it and not asking for it; take it, but you should not seek to have what you are not given
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ الْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ وَأَنَا ابْنُ خَمْسَ، عَشْرَةَ فُرِّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala alzzuhriyyu 'an sahli bni sa'din, qaala shahidtu almutalaa'inayni waaanaa abnu khamsa, 'ashraaa furriqa baynahumaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:I witnessed a husband and a wife who were involved in a case of Lian. Then (the judgment of) divorce was passed. I was fifteen years of age, at that time
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ، أَخِي بَنِي سَاعِدَةَ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ جَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلاً وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً، أَيَقْتُلُهُ فَتَلاَعَنَا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَأَنَا شَاهِدٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy abnu shihaabin, 'an sahlin, aakhiy baniy saa'idaaa aanna rajulaan, mina alaansaari jaa'a iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala aaraaayta rajulaan wajada ma'a amraaatihi rajulaan, aayaqtuluhu fatalaa'anaa fiy almasjidi waaanaa shaahidun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl:(the brother of Bani Sa`ida) A man from the Ansar came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "If a man finds another man sleeping with his wife, should he kill him?" That man and his wife then did Lian in the mosque while I was present
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أَتَى رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَنَادَاهُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي زَنَيْتُ‏.‏ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا شَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَرْبَعًا قَالَ ‏"‏ أَبِكَ جُنُونٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اذْهَبُوا بِهِ فَارْجُمُوهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathaniy alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, wasa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala aataa rajulun rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa fiy almasjidi fanaadaahu faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy zanaytu‏.‏ faaa'rada 'anhu‏.‏ falammaa shahida 'alaa nafsihi aarba'ana qaala ‏"‏ aabika junuwnun ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala laa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ adhhabuwa bihi faarjumuwhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was in the mosque, and called him, saying, "O Allah's Apostle! I have committed illegal sexual intercourse." The Prophet (ﷺ) turned his face to the other side, but when the man gave four witnesses against himself, the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Are you mad?" The man said, "No." So the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to his companions), "Take him away and stone him to death
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَأَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنْتُ فِيمَنْ رَجَمَهُ بِالْمُصَلَّى‏.‏ رَوَاهُ يُونُسُ وَمَعْمَرٌ وَابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الرَّجْمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala abnu shihaabin faaakhbaraniy man, sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, qaala kuntu fiyman rajamahu bialmusallaa‏.‏ rawaahu yuwnusu wama'marun waabnu jurayjin 'ani alzzuhriyyi 'an aabiy salamaaa 'an jaabirin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alrrajmi‏.‏
verses.translation: (continued from above) Narrated Jabir bin Abdullah:I was one of those who stoned him at the Musalla in Al-Madina (See Hadith)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ، وَإِنَّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ إِلَىَّ، وَلَعَلَّ بَعْضَكُمْ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَلْحَنَ بِحُجَّتِهِ مِنْ بَعْضٍ فَأَقْضِي نَحْوَ مَا أَسْمَعُ، فَمَنْ قَضَيْتُ لَهُ بِحَقِّ أَخِيهِ شَيْئًا فَلاَ يَأْخُذْهُ، فَإِنَّمَا أَقْطَعُ لَهُ قِطْعَةً مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an zaynaba abnaai aabiy salamaaa, 'an aummi salamaaa rda allh 'nha aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa aanaa basharun, waiinnakum takhtasimuwna iilaaaa, wala'alla ba'dakum aan yakuwna aalhana bihujjatihi min ba'din faaaqdiy nahwa maa aasma'u, faman qadaytu lahu bihaqqi aakhiyhi shayiana falaa yaakhudhhu, faiinnamaa aaqta'u lahu qit'aaan mina alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Salama:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I am only a human being, and you people (opponents) come to me with your cases; and it may be that one of you can present his case eloquently in a more convincing way than the other, and I give my verdict according to what I hear. So if ever I judge (by error) and give the right of a brother to his other (brother) then he (the latter) should not take it, for I am giving him only a piece of Fire." (See Hadith No. 638, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي قَتَادَةَ أَنَّ أَبَا قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ ‏"‏ مَنْ لَهُ بَيِّنَةٌ عَلَى قَتِيلٍ قَتَلَهُ، فَلَهُ سَلَبُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ لأَلْتَمِسَ بَيِّنَةً عَلَى قَتِيلٍ، فَلَمْ أَرَ أَحَدًا يَشْهَدُ لِي، فَجَلَسْتُ، ثُمَّ بَدَا لِي فَذَكَرْتُ أَمْرَهُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ جُلَسَائِهِ سِلاَحُ هَذَا الْقَتِيلِ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ عِنْدِي‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَرْضِهِ مِنْهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ كَلاَّ لاَ يُعْطِهِ أُصَيْبِغَ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ وَيَدَعَ أَسَدًا مِنْ أُسْدِ اللَّهِ يُقَاتِلُ عَنِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَدَّاهُ إِلَىَّ فَاشْتَرَيْتُ مِنْهُ خِرَافًا فَكَانَ أَوَّلَ مَالٍ تَأَثَّلْتُهُ‏.‏ قَالَ لِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَدَّاهُ إِلَىَّ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَهْلُ الْحِجَازِ الْحَاكِمُ لاَ يَقْضِي بِعِلْمِهِ، شَهِدَ بِذَلِكَ فِي وِلاَيَتِهِ أَوْ قَبْلَهَا‏.‏ وَلَوْ أَقَرَّ خَصْمٌ عِنْدَهُ لآخَرَ بِحَقٍّ فِي مَجْلِسِ الْقَضَاءِ، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَقْضِي عَلَيْهِ فِي قَوْلِ بَعْضِهِمْ، حَتَّى يَدْعُوَ بِشَاهِدَيْنِ فَيُحْضِرَهُمَا إِقْرَارَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَعْضُ أَهْلِ الْعِرَاقِ مَا سَمِعَ أَوْ رَآهُ فِي مَجْلِسِ الْقَضَاءِ قَضَى بِهِ، وَمَا كَانَ فِي غَيْرِهِ لَمْ يَقْضِ إِلاَّ بِشَاهِدَيْنِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ آخَرُونَ مِنْهُمْ بَلْ يَقْضِي بِهِ، لأَنَّهُ مُؤْتَمَنٌ، وَإِنَّمَا يُرَادُ مِنَ الشَّهَادَةِ مَعْرِفَةُ الْحَقِّ، فَعِلْمُهُ أَكْثَرُ مِنَ الشَّهَادَةِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ يَقْضِي بِعِلْمِهِ فِي الأَمْوَالِ، وَلاَ يَقْضِي فِي غَيْرِهَا‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْقَاسِمُ لاَ يَنْبَغِي لِلْحَاكِمِ أَنْ يُمْضِيَ قَضَاءً بِعِلْمِهِ دُونَ عِلْمِ غَيْرِهِ، مَعَ أَنَّ عِلْمَهُ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ شَهَادَةِ غَيْرِهِ، وَلَكِنَّ فِيهِ تَعَرُّضًا لِتُهَمَةِ نَفْسِهِ عِنْدَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِيقَاعًا لَهُمْ فِي الظُّنُونِ، وَقَدْ كَرِهَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الظَّنَّ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا هَذِهِ صَفِيَّةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yahyaa, 'an 'umara bni kathiyrin, 'an aabiy muhammadin, mawlaa aabiy qataadaaa aanna aabaa qataadaaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma hunaynin ‏"‏ man lahu bayyinaaun 'alaa qatiylin qatalahu, falahu salabuhu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqumtu laaltamisa bayyinaaan 'alaa qatiylin, falam aara aahadana yashhadu liy, fajalastu, thumma badaa liy fadhakartu aamrahu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala rajulun min julasaaiihi silaahu hadhaa alqatiyli alladhiy yadhkuru 'indiy‏.‏ qaala faaardihi minhu‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin kalaaa laa yu'tihi ausaybigha min qurayshin wayada'a aasadana min ausdi alllahi yuqaatilu 'ani alllahi warasuwlihi‏.‏ qaala faaamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaaddaahu iilaaaa faashtaraytu minhu khiraafana fakaana aawwala maalin taaathhaltuhu‏.‏ qaala liy 'abdu alllahi 'ani alllaythi faqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faaaddaahu iilaaaa‏.‏ waqaala aahlu alhijaazi alhaakimu laa yaqdiy bi'ilmihi, shahida bidhalika fiy wilaayatihi aaw qablahaa‏.‏ walaw aaqarra khasmun 'indahu lakhara bihaqqin fiy majlisi alqadaa'i, faiinnahu laa yaqdiy 'alayhi fiy qawli ba'dihim, hattaa yad'uwa bishaahidayni fayuhdirahumaa iiqraarahu‏.‏ waqaala ba'du aahli al'iraaqi maa sami'a aaw raahu fiy majlisi alqadaa'i qadaa bihi, wamaa kaana fiy ghayrihi lam yaqdi iilaaa bishaahidayni‏.‏ waqaala akharuwna minhum bal yaqdiy bihi, laannahu muutamanun, waiinnamaa yuraadu mina alshhahaadaai ma'rifaau alhaqqi, fa'ilmuhu aaktharu mina alshhahaadaai‏.‏ waqaala ba'duhum yaqdiy bi'ilmihi fiy alaamwaali, walaa yaqdiy fiy ghayrihaa‏.‏ waqaala alqaasimu laa yanbaghiy lilhaakimi aan yumdiya qadaa'an bi'ilmihi duwna 'ilmi ghayrihi, ma'a aanna 'ilmahu aaktharu min shahaadaai ghayrihi, walakinna fiyhi ta'arrudana lituhamaai nafsihi 'inda almuslimiyna, waiiyqaa'ana lahum fiy alzzunuwni, waqad kariha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alzzanna faqaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa hadhihi safiyyaau ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Qatada:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the Day of (the battle of) Hunain, "Whoever has killed an infidel and has a proof or a witness for it, then the salb (arms and belongings of that deceased) will be for him." I stood up to seek a witness to testify that I had killed an infidel but I could not find any witness and then sat down. Then I thought that I should mention the case to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (and when I did so) a man from those who were sitting with him said, "The arms of the killed person he has mentioned, are with me, so please satisfy him on my behalf." Abu Bakr said, "No, he will not give the arms to a bird of Quraish and deprive one of Allah's lions of it who fights for the cause of Allah and His Apostle." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and gave it to me, and I bought a garden with its price, and that was my first property which I owned through the war booty. The people of Hijaz said, "A judge should not pass a judgment according to his knowledge, whether he was a witness at the time he was the judge or before that" And if a litigant gives a confession in favor of his opponent in the court, in the opinion of some scholars, the judge should not pass a judgment against him till the latter calls two witnesses to witness his confession. And some people of Iraq said, "A judge can pass a judgement according to what he hears or witnesses (the litigant's confession) in the court itself, but if the confession takes place outside the court, he should not pass the judgment unless two witnesses witness the confession." Some of them said, "A judge can pass a judgement depending on his knowledge of the case as he is trust-worthy, and that a witness is Required just to reveal the truth. The judge's knowledge is more than the witness." Some said, "A judge can judge according to his knowledge only in cases involving property, but in other cases he cannot." Al-Qasim said, "A judge ought not to pass a judgment depending on his knowledge if other people do not know what he knows, although his knowledge is more than the witness of somebody else because he might expose himself to suspicion by the Muslims and cause the Muslims to have unreasonable doubt
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَتْهُ صَفِيَّةُ بِنْتُ حُيَىٍّ فَلَمَّا رَجَعَتِ انْطَلَقَ مَعَهَا، فَمَرَّ بِهِ رَجُلاَنِ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَدَعَاهُمَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا هِيَ صَفِيَّةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالاَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَجْرِي مِنِ ابْنِ آدَمَ مَجْرَى الدَّمِ ‏"‏‏.‏ رَوَاهُ شُعَيْبٌ وَابْنُ مُسَافِرٍ وَابْنُ أَبِي عَتِيقٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ يَعْنِي ابْنَ حُسَيْنٍ ـ عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa iibraahiymu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'aliyyi bni husaynin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aatathu safiyyaau bintu huyaaain falammaa raja'ati antalaqa ma'ahaa, famarra bihi rajulaani mina alaansaari fada'aahumaa faqaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa hiya safiyyaau ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalaa subhaana alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinna alshhaytaana yajriy mini abni adama majraa alddami ‏"‏‏.‏ rawaahu shu'aybun waabnu musaafirin waabnu aabiy 'atiyqin waiishaaqu bnu yahyaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi 'an 'aliyyin ya'niy abna husaynin 'an safiyyaaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali bin Husain:Safiya bint (daughter of) Huyai came to the Prophet (in the mosque), and when she returned (home), the Prophet (ﷺ) accompanied her. It happened that two men from the Ansar passed by them and the Prophet called them saying, "She is Safiya!" those two men said, "Subhan Allah!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Satan circulates in the human body as blood does
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْعَقَدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي قَالَ، بَعَثَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبِي وَمُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ عَلَى الْيَمَنِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَسِّرَا وَلاَ تُعَسِّرَا، وَبَشِّرَا وَلاَ تُنَفِّرَا، وَتَطَاوَعَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو مُوسَى إِنَّهُ يُصْنَعُ بِأَرْضِنَا الْبِتْعُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ النَّضْرُ وَأَبُو دَاوُدَ وَيَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ وَوَكِيعٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa al'aqadiyyu, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy burdaaa, qaala sami'tu aabiy qaala, ba'atha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aabiy wamu'aadha bna jabalin 'alaa alyamani faqaala ‏"‏ yassiraa walaa tu'assiraa, wabashhiraa walaa tunaffiraa, watataawa'aa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala lahu aabuw muwsaa iinnahu yusna'u biaardinaa albit'u‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ kullu muskirin haraamun ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala alnnadru waaabuw daawuda wayaziydu bnu haaruwna wawakiy'un 'an shu'baaa 'an sa'iydin 'an aabiyhi 'an jaddihi 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent my father and Mu`adh bin Jabal to Yemen and said (to them), "Make things easy for the people and do not put hurdles in their way, and give them glad tiding, and don't let them have aversion (i.e. to make people to hate good deeds) and you both should work in cooperation and mutual understanding" Abu Musa said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "In our country a special alcoholic drink called Al- Bit', is prepared (for drinking)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every intoxicant is prohibited
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ فُكُّوا الْعَانِيَ وَأَجِيبُوا الدَّاعِيَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an sufyaana, haddathaniy mansuwrun, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an aabiy muwsaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ fukkuwa al'aaniya waaajiybuwa alddaa'iya ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Set free the captives and accept invitations
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُرْوَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو حُمَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيُّ، قَالَ اسْتَعْمَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلاً مِنْ بَنِي أَسَدٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ ابْنُ الأُتَبِيَّةِ عَلَى صَدَقَةٍ فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ قَالَ هَذَا لَكُمْ وَهَذَا أُهْدِيَ لِي‏.‏ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ـ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ أَيْضًا فَصَعِدَ الْمِنْبَرَ ـ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَالُ الْعَامِلِ نَبْعَثُهُ، فَيَأْتِي يَقُولُ هَذَا لَكَ وَهَذَا لِي‏.‏ فَهَلاَّ جَلَسَ فِي بَيْتِ أَبِيهِ وَأُمِّهِ فَيَنْظُرُ أَيُهْدَى لَهُ أَمْ لاَ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لاَ يَأْتِي بِشَىْءٍ إِلاَّ جَاءَ بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَحْمِلُهُ عَلَى رَقَبَتِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ بَعِيرًا لَهُ رُغَاءٌ، أَوْ بَقَرَةً لَهَا خُوَارٌ، أَوْ شَاةً تَيْعَرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى رَأَيْنَا عُفْرَتَىْ إِبْطَيْهِ ‏"‏ أَلاَ هَلْ بَلَّغْتُ ‏"‏ ثَلاَثًا‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ قَصَّهُ عَلَيْنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ‏.‏ وَزَادَ هِشَامٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ قَالَ سَمِعَ أُذُنَاىَ وَأَبْصَرَتْهُ عَيْنِي، وَسَلُوا زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ فَإِنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ مَعِي‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلِ الزُّهْرِيُّ سَمِعَ أُذُنِي‏.‏ ‏{‏خُوَارٌ‏}‏ صَوْتٌ، وَالْجُؤَارُ مِنْ تَجْأَرُونَ كَصَوْتِ الْبَقَرَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aannahu sami'a 'urwaaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw humaydin alssaa'idiyyu, qaala asta'mala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulaan min baniy aasadin yuqaalu lahu abnu alautabiyyaai 'alaa sadaqaain falammaa qadima qaala hadhaa lakum wahadhaa auhdiya liy‏.‏ faqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alminbari qaala sufyaanu aaydana fasa'ida alminbara fahamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi thumma qaala ‏"‏ maa baalu al'aamili nab'athuhu, fayaatiy yaquwlu hadhaa laka wahadhaa liy‏.‏ fahalaaa jalasa fiy bayti aabiyhi waaummihi fayanzuru aayuhdaa lahu aam laa, waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi laa yaatiy bishaa'in iilaaa jaa'a bihi yawma alqiyaamaai yahmiluhu 'alaa raqabatihi, iin kaana ba'iyrana lahu rughaa'un, aaw baqaraaan lahaa khuwaarun, aaw shaaaan tay'aru ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma rafa'a yadayhi hattaa raaaynaa 'ufrataa iibtayhi ‏"‏ aalaa hal ballaghtu ‏"‏ thalaathana‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu qassahu 'alaynaa alzzuhriyyu‏.‏ wazaada hishaamun 'an aabiyhi 'an aabiy humaydin qaala sami'a audhunaaaa waaabsarathu 'ayniy, wasaluwa zayda bna thaabitin faiinnahu sami'ahu ma'iy‏.‏ walam yaquli alzzuhriyyu sami'a audhuniy‏.‏ ‏{‏khuwaarun‏}‏ sawtun, waaljuuaaru min tajaaruwna kasawti albaqaraai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Humaid Al-Sa`idi:The Prophet (ﷺ) appointed a man from the tribe of Bani Asad, called Ibn Al-Utabiyya to collect the Zakat. When he returned (with the money) he said (to the Prophet), "This is for you and this has been given to me as a gift." The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up on the pulpit (Sufyan said he ascended the pulpit), and after glorifying and praising Allah, he said, "What is wrong with the employee whom we send (to collect Zakat from the public) that he returns to say, 'This is for you and that is for me?' Why didn't he stay at his father's and mother's house to see whether he will be given gifts or not? By Him in Whose Hand my life is, whoever takes anything illegally will bring it on the Day of Resurrection by carrying it over his neck: if it is a camel, it will be grunting: if it is a cow, it will be mooing: and if it is a sheep it will be bleating!" The Prophet (ﷺ) then raised both his hands till we saw the whiteness of his armpits (and he said), "No doubt! Haven't I conveyed Allah's Message?" And he repeated it three times
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَنَّ نَافِعًا، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ كَانَ سَالِمٌ مَوْلَى أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ يَؤُمُّ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ الأَوَّلِينَ وَأَصْحَابَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ، فِيهِمْ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ وَزَيْدٌ وَعَامِرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu saalihin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy abnu jurayjin, aanna naafi'ana, aakhbarahu aanna abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma aakhbarahu qaala kaana saalimun mawlaa aabiy hudhayfaaa yauummu almuhaajiriyna alaawwaliyna waaashaaba alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy masjidi qubaa'in, fiyhim aabuw bakrin wa'umaru waaabuw salamaaa wazaydun wa'aamiru bnu rabiy'aaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Salim, the freed salve of Abu Hudhaifa used to lead in prayer the early Muhajirin (emigrants) and the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) in the Quba mosque. Among those (who used to pray behind him) were Abu Bakr, `Umar, Abu Salama, and Amir bin Rabi`a
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي أُوَيْسٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ مَرْوَانَ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ، وَالْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَاهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ حِينَ أَذِنَ لَهُمُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ فِي عِتْقِ سَبْىِ هَوَازِنَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لاَ أَدْرِي مَنْ أَذِنَ مِنْكُمْ مِمَّنْ لَمْ يَأْذَنْ، فَارْجِعُوا حَتَّى يَرْفَعَ إِلَيْنَا عُرَفَاؤُكُمْ أَمْرَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَجَعَ النَّاسُ فَكَلَّمَهُمْ عُرَفَاؤُهُمْ، فَرَجَعُوا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرُوهُ أَنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ طَيَّبُوا وَأَذِنُوا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu aabiy auwaysin, haddathaniy iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an 'ammihi, muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa qaala abnu shihaabin haddathaniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna marwaana bna alhakami, waalmiswara bna makhramaaa, aakhbaraahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala hiyna aadhina lahumu almuslimuwna fiy 'itqi sabai hawaazina ‏ "‏ iinniy laa aadriy man aadhina minkum mimman lam yaadhan, faarji'uwa hattaa yarfa'a iilaynaa 'urafaauukum aamrakum ‏"‏‏.‏ faraja'a alnnaasu fakallamahum 'urafaauuhum, faraja'uwa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbaruwhu aanna alnnaasa qad tayyabuwa waaadhinuwa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:Marwan bin Al-Hakam and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama told him that when the Muslims were permitted to set free the captives of Hawazin, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I do not know who amongst you has agreed (to it) and who has not. Go back so that your 'Urafa' may submit your decision to us." So the people returned and their 'Urafa' talked to them and then came back to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him that the people had given their consent happily and permitted (their captives to be freed)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أُنَاسٌ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ إِنَّا نَدْخُلُ عَلَى سُلْطَانِنَا فَنَقُولُ لَهُمْ خِلاَفَ مَا نَتَكَلَّمُ إِذَا خَرَجْنَا مِنْ عِنْدِهِمْ قَالَ كُنَّا نَعُدُّهَا نِفَاقًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa 'aasimu bnu muhammadi bni zaydi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an aabiyhi, qaala aunaasun laibni 'umara iinnaa nadkhulu 'alaa sultaaninaa fanaquwlu lahum khilaafa maa natakallamu iidhaa kharajnaa min 'indihim qaala kunnaa na'udduhaa nifaaqana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muhammad bin Zaid bin `Abdullah bin `Umar:Some people said to Ibn `Umar, "When we enter upon our ruler(s) we say in their praise what is contrary to what we say when we leave them." Ibn `Umar said, "We used to consider this as hypocrisy
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ عِرَاكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنْ شَرَّ النَّاسِ ذُو الْوَجْهَيْنِ، الَّذِي يَأْتِي هَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ وَهَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'an 'iraakin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iin sharra alnnaasi dhuw alwajhayni, alladhiy yaatiy hauulaa'i biwajhin wahauulaa'i biwajhin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The worst of all mankind is the double-faced one, who comes to some people with one face and to others, with another face
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ هِنْدَ، قَالَتْ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ رَجُلٌ شَحِيحٌ، فَأَحْتَاجُ أَنْ آخُذَ مِنْ مَالِهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ خُذِي مَا يَكْفِيكِ وَوَلَدَكِ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna hinda, qaalat lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinna aabaa sufyaana rajulun shahiyhun, faaahtaaju aan akhudha min maalihi‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ khudhiy maa yakfiyki wawaladaki bialma'ruwfi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Hind (bint `Utba) said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "Abu Sufyan is a miserly man and I need to take some money of his wealth." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Take reasonably what is sufficient for you and your children
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ خُصُومَةً بِبَابِ حُجْرَتِهِ فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ، وَإِنَّهُ يَأْتِينِي الْخَصْمُ، فَلَعَلَّ بَعْضَكُمْ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَبْلَغَ مِنْ بَعْضٍ، فَأَحْسِبُ أَنَّهُ صَادِقٌ فَأَقْضِي لَهُ بِذَلِكَ، فَمَنْ قَضَيْتُ لَهُ بِحَقِّ مُسْلِمٍ، فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ قِطْعَةٌ مِنَ النَّارِ، فَلْيَأْخُذْهَا أَوْ لِيَتْرُكْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna zaynaba abnaaa aabiy salamaaa, aakhbarathu aanna aumma salamaaa zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarathaa 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu sami'a khusuwmaaan bibaabi hujratihi fakharaja iilayhim faqaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa aanaa basharun, waiinnahu yaatiyniy alkhasmu, fala'alla ba'dakum aan yakuwna aablagha min ba'din, faaahsibu aannahu saadiqun faaaqdiy lahu bidhalika, faman qadaytu lahu bihaqqi muslimin, faiinnamaa hiya qit'aaun mina alnnaari, falyaakhudhhaa aaw liyatrukhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Salama:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard some people quarreling at the door of his dwelling, so he went out to them and said, "I am only a human being, and litigants with cases of dispute come to me, and someone of you may happen to be more eloquent (in presenting his case) than the other, whereby I may consider that he is truthful and pass a judgment in his favor. If ever I pass a judgment in favor of somebody whereby he takes a Muslim's right unjustly, then whatever he takes is nothing but a piece of Fire, and it is up to him to take or leave
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ عُتْبَةُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ عَهِدَ إِلَى أَخِيهِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ أَنَّ ابْنَ وَلِيدَةِ زَمْعَةَ مِنِّي فَاقْبِضْهُ إِلَيْكَ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا كَانَ عَامُ الْفَتْحِ أَخَذَهُ سَعْدٌ فَقَالَ ابْنُ أَخِي، قَدْ كَانَ عَهِدَ إِلَىَّ فِيهِ، فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ عَبْدُ بْنُ زَمْعَةَ فَقَالَ أَخِي وَابْنُ وَلِيدَةِ أَبِي، وُلِدَ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ‏.‏ فَتَسَاوَقَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ابْنُ أَخِي، كَانَ عَهِدَ إِلَىَّ فِيهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ بْنُ زَمْعَةَ أَخِي وَابْنُ وَلِيدَةِ أَبِي، وُلِدَ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هُوَ لَكَ يَا عَبْدُ بْنَ زَمْعَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ، وَلِلْعَاهِرِ الْحَجَرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِسَوْدَةَ بِنْتِ زَمْعَةَ ‏"‏ احْتَجِبِي مِنْهُ ‏"‏، لِمَا رَأَى مِنْ شَبَهِهِ بِعُتْبَةَ، فَمَا رَآهَا حَتَّى لَقِيَ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa qaalat kaana 'utbaau bnu aabiy waqqaasin 'ahida iilaa aakhiyhi sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin aanna abna waliydaai zam'aaa minniy faaqbidhu iilayka‏.‏ falammaa kaana 'aamu alfathi aakhadhahu sa'dun faqaala abnu aakhiy, qad kaana 'ahida iilaaaa fiyhi, faqaama iilayhi 'abdu bnu zam'aaa faqaala aakhiy waabnu waliydaai aabiy, wulida 'alaa firaashihi‏.‏ fatasaawaqaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala sa'dun yaa rasuwla alllahi abnu aakhiy, kaana 'ahida iilaaaa fiyhi‏.‏ waqaala 'abdu bnu zam'aaa aakhiy waabnu waliydaai aabiy, wulida 'alaa firaashihi‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ huwa laka yaa 'abdu bna zam'aaa ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alwaladu lilfiraashi, walil'aahiri alhajaru ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala lisawdaaa binti zam'aaa ‏"‏ ahtajibiy minhu ‏"‏, limaa raaaa min shabahihi bi'utbaaa, famaa raahaa hattaa laqiya alllaha ta'aalaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) `Utba bin Abi Waqqas said to his brother Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas, "The son of the slave girl of Zam`a is from me, so take him into your custody." So in the year of Conquest of Mecca, Sa`d took him and said. (This is) my brother's son whom my brother has asked me to take into my custody." `Abd bin Zam`a got up before him and said, (He is) my brother and the son of the slave girl of my father, and was born on my father's bed." So they both submitted their case before Allah's Apostle. Sa`d said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This boy is the son of my brother and he entrusted him to me." `Abd bin Zam`a said, "This boy is my brother and the son of the slave girl of my father, and was born on the bed of my father." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The boy is for you, O `Abd bin Zam`a!" Then Allah's Apostle further said, "The child is for the owner of the bed, and the stone is for the adulterer," He then said to Sauda bint Zam`a, "Veil (screen) yourself before him," when he saw the child's resemblance to `Utba. The boy did not see her again till he met Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، وَالأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَحْلِفُ عَلَى يَمِينِ صَبْرٍ، يَقْتَطِعُ مَالاً وَهْوَ فِيهَا فَاجِرٌ، إِلاَّ لَقِيَ اللَّهَ وَهْوَ عَلَيْهِ غَضْبَانُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏ فَجَاءَ الأَشْعَثُ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ يُحَدِّثُهُمْ فَقَالَ فِيَّ نَزَلَتْ وَفِي رَجُلٍ خَاصَمْتُهُ فِي بِئْرٍ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلَكَ بَيِّنَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلْيَحْلِفْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ إِذًا يَحْلِفُ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa iishaaqu bnu nasrin, hadaathanaa 'abdu alraazaaaqi, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an mansuwrin, waalaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, qaala qaala 'abdu allaahi qaala alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa yahlifu 'alaa yamiyni sabrin, yaqtati'u maalaan wahwa fiyhaa faajirun, iilaaa laqiya allaaha wahwa 'alayhi ghadbaanu ‏"‏‏.‏ faaanzala allaahu ‏{‏iinaa alaadhiyna yashtaruwna bi'ahdi allaahi‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏ fajaa'a alaash'athu wa'abdu allaahi yuhadiithuhum faqaala fiyaa nazalat wafiy rajulin khaasamtuhu fiy biirin faqaala alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aalaka bayiinaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu laa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ falyahlif ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu iidhana yahlifu‏.‏ fanazalat ‏{‏iinaa alaadhiyna yashtaruwna bi'ahdi allaahi‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If somebody on the demand of a judge takes an oath to grab (a Muslim's) property and he is liar in it, he will meet Allah Who will be angry with him". So Allah revealed,:-- 'Verily! those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and their oaths..' (3.77) 'Al- Ashath came while `Abdullah was narrating (this) to the people. Al-Ashath said, "This verse was revealed regarding me and another man with whom I had a quarrel about a well. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to me), "Do you have any evidence?' I replied, 'No.' He said, 'Let your opponent take an oath.' I said: I am sure he would take a (false) oath." Thereupon it was revealed: 'Verily! those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant....' (3.77) (See Hadith No. 72, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ عَنْ أُمِّهَا أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ سَمِعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَلَبَةَ خِصَامٍ عِنْدَ بَابِهِ فَخَرَجَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ، وَإِنَّهُ يَأْتِينِي الْخَصْمُ، فَلَعَلَّ بَعْضًا أَنْ يَكُونَ أَبْلَغَ مِنْ بَعْضٍ، أَقْضِي لَهُ بِذَلِكَ وَأَحْسِبُ أَنَّهُ صَادِقٌ، فَمَنْ قَضَيْتُ لَهُ بِحَقِّ مُسْلِمٍ فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ قِطْعَةٌ مِنَ النَّارِ، فَلْيَأْخُذْهَا أَوْ لِيَدَعْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna zaynaba binta aabiy salamaaa, aakhbarathu 'an aummihaa aummi salamaaa, qaalat sami'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm jalabaaa khisaamin 'inda baabihi fakharaja 'alayhim faqaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa aanaa basharun, waiinnahu yaatiyniy alkhasmu, fala'alla ba'dana aan yakuwna aablagha min ba'din, aaqdiy lahu bidhalika waaahsibu aannahu saadiqun, faman qadaytu lahu bihaqqi muslimin faiinnamaa hiya qit'aaun mina alnnaari, falyaakhudhhaa aaw liyada'haa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Salama:The Prophet (ﷺ) heard the voices of some people quarreling near his gate, so he went to them and said, "I am only a human being and litigants with cases of disputes come to me, and maybe one of them presents his case eloquently in a more convincing and impressive way than the other, and I give my verdict in his favor thinking he is truthful. So if I give a Muslim's right to another (by mistake), then that (property) is a piece of Fire, which is up to him to take it or leave it." (See Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ بَلَغَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَجُلاً مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ أَعْتَقَ غُلاَمًا عَنْ دُبُرٍ، لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ غَيْرَهُ، فَبَاعَهُ بِثَمَانِمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ، ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَ بِثَمَنِهِ إِلَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, haddathanaa salamaau bnu kuhaylin, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabirin, qaala balagha alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna rajulaan min aashaabihi aa'taqa ghulaamana 'an duburin, lam yakun lahu maalun ghayrahu, fabaa'ahu bithamaanimiaiaai dirhamin, thumma aarsala bithamanihi iilayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to know that one of his companions had given the promise of freeing his slave after his death, but as he had no other property than that slave, the Prophet (ﷺ) sold that slave for 800 dirhams and sent the price to him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْثًا وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْهِمْ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ، فَطُعِنَ فِي إِمَارَتِهِ، وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ تَطْعَنُوا فِي إِمَارَتِهِ فَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ تَطْعَنُونَ فِي إِمَارَةِ أَبِيهِ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ، وَايْمُ اللَّهِ إِنْ كَانَ لَخَلِيقًا لِلإِمْرَةِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ لَمِنْ أَحَبِّ النَّاسِ إِلَىَّ، وَإِنَّ هَذَا لَمِنْ أَحَبِّ النَّاسِ إِلَىَّ بَعْدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muslimin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu diynaarin, qaala sami'tu abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'thana waaammara 'alayhim ausaamaaa bna zaydin, fatu'ina fiy iimaaratihi, waqaala ‏ "‏ iin tat'anuwa fiy iimaaratihi faqad kuntum tat'anuwna fiy iimaaraai aabiyhi min qablihi, waaymu alllahi iin kaana lakhaliyqana liliimraai, waiin kaana lamin aahabbi alnnaasi iilaaaa, waiinna hadhaa lamin aahabbi alnnaasi iilaaaa ba'dahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an army unit headed by Usama bin Zaid and the people criticized his leadership. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to the people), "If you are criticizing his leadership now, then you used to criticize his father's leadership before. By Allah, he (Usama's father) deserved the leadership and used to be one of the most beloved persons to me, and now his son (Usama) is one of the most beloved persons to me after him. " (See Hadith No. 745, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَبْغَضُ الرِّجَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ الأَلَدُّ الْخَصِمُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'ani abni jurayjin, sami'tu abna aabiy mulaykaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aabghadu alrrijaali iilaa alllahi alaaladdu alkhasimu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The most hated person in the sight of Allah, is the most quarrelsome person
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، بَعَثَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَالِدًا ح وَحَدَّثَنِي نُعَيْمٌ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ بَعَثَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَالِدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ إِلَى بَنِي جَذِيمَةَ فَلَمْ يُحْسِنُوا أَنْ يَقُولُوا أَسْلَمْنَا‏.‏ فَقَالُوا صَبَأْنَا صَبَأْنَا، فَجَعَلَ خَالِدٌ يَقْتُلُ وَيَأْسِرُ، وَدَفَعَ إِلَى كُلِّ رَجُلٌ مِنَّا أَسِيرَهُ، فَأَمَرَ كُلَّ رَجُلٍ مِنَّا أَنْ يَقْتُلَ أَسِيرَهُ، فَقُلْتُ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَقْتُلُ أَسِيرِي وَلاَ يَقْتُلُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِي أَسِيرَهُ‏.‏ فَذَكَرْنَا ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَبْرَأُ إِلَيْكَ مِمَّا صَنَعَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ ‏"‏، مَرَّتَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mahmuwdun, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara, ba'atha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm khaalidana h wahaddathaniy nu'aymun aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi aakhbaranaa ma'marun 'ani alzzuhriyyi 'an saalimin 'an aabiyhi qaala ba'atha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm khaalida bna alwaliydi iilaa baniy jadhiymaaa falam yuhsinuwa aan yaquwluwa aaslamnaa‏.‏ faqaaluwa sabaanaa sabaanaa, faja'ala khaalidun yaqtulu wayaasiru, wadafa'a iilaa kulli rajulun minnaa aasiyrahu, faaamara kulla rajulin minnaa aan yaqtula aasiyrahu, faqultu waalllahi laa aaqtulu aasiyriy walaa yaqtulu rajulun min aashaabiy aasiyrahu‏.‏ fadhakarnaa dhalika lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy aabraau iilayka mimmaa sana'a khaalidu bnu alwaliydi ‏"‏, marratayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent (an army unit under the command of) Khalid bin Al-Walid to fight against the tribe of Bani Jadhima and those people could not express themselves by saying, "Aslamna," but they said, "Saba'na! Saba'na! " Khalid kept on killing some of them and taking some others as captives, and he gave a captive to everyone of us and ordered everyone of us to kill his captive. I said, "By Allah, I shall not kill my captive and none of my companions shall kill his captive!" Then we mentioned that to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said, "O Allah! I am free from what Khalid bin Al-Walid has done," and repeated it twice
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَازِمٍ الْمَدِينِيُّ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، قَالَ كَانَ قِتَالٌ بَيْنَ بَنِي عَمْرٍو، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ، ثُمَّ أَتَاهُمْ يُصْلِحُ بَيْنَهُمْ، فَلَمَّا حَضَرَتْ صَلاَةُ الْعَصْرِ فَأَذَّنَ بِلاَلٌ وَأَقَامَ وَأَمَرَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَتَقَدَّمَ، وَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ فِي الصَّلاَةِ، فَشَقَّ النَّاسَ حَتَّى قَامَ خَلْفَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، فَتَقَدَّمَ فِي الصَّفِّ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ‏.‏ قَالَ وَصَفَّحَ الْقَوْمُ، وَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ إِذَا دَخَلَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ لَمْ يَلْتَفِتْ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ، فَلَمَّا رَأَى التَّصْفِيحَ لاَ يُمْسَكُ عَلَيْهِ الْتَفَتَ فَرَأَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَلْفَهُ، فَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنِ امْضِهْ وَأَوْمَأَ بِيَدِهِ هَكَذَا، وَلَبِثَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ هُنَيَّةً يَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ عَلَى قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ مَشَى الْقَهْقَرَى، فَلَمَّا رَأَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَلِكَ تَقَدَّمَ فَصَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالنَّاسِ، فَلَمَّا قَضَى صَلاَتَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذْ أَوْمَأْتُ إِلَيْكَ أَنْ لاَ تَكُونَ مَضَيْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لاِبْنِ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ أَنْ يَؤُمَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ لِلْقَوْمِ ‏"‏ إِذَا نَابَكُمْ أَمْرٌ، فَلْيُسَبِّحِ الرِّجَالُ، وَلْيُصَفِّحِ النِّسَاءُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aabuw haazimin almadiyniyyu, 'an sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi, qaala kaana qitaalun bayna baniy 'amrinw, fabalagha dhalika alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallaa alzzuhra, thumma aataahum yuslihu baynahum, falammaa hadarat salaaau al'asri faaadhhana bilaalun waaaqaama waaamara aabaa bakrin fataqaddama, wajaa'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin fiy alssalaaai, fashaqqa alnnaasa hattaa qaama khalfa aabiy bakrin, fataqaddama fiy alssaffi alladhiy yaliyhi‏.‏ qaala wasaffaha alqawmu, wakaana aabuw bakrin iidhaa dakhala fiy alssalaaai lam yaltafit hattaa yafrugha, falammaa raaaa alttasfiyha laa yumsaku 'alayhi altafata faraaaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm khalfahu, faaawmaaa iilayhi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aani amdih waaawmaaa biyadihi hakadhaa, walabitha aabuw bakrin hunayyaaan yahmadu alllaha 'alaa qawli alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma mashaa alqahqaraa, falammaa raaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm dhalika taqaddama fasallaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bialnnaasi, falammaa qadaa salaatahu qaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa bakrin maa mana'aka iidh aawmaatu iilayka aan laa takuwna madayta ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala lam yakun laibni aabiy quhaafaaa aan yauumma alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ waqaala lilqawmi ‏"‏ iidhaa naabakum aamrun, falyusabbihi alrrijaalu, walyusaffihi alnnisaa'u ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Saidi:There was some quarrel (sighting) among Bani `Amr, and when this news reached the Prophet, he offered the Zuhr prayer and went to establish peace among them. In the meantime the time of `Asr prayer was due, Bilal pronounced the Adhan and then the Iqama for the prayer and requested Abu Bakr (to lead the prayer) and Abu Bakr went forward. The Prophet (ﷺ) arrived while Abu Bakr was still praying. He entered the rows of praying people till he stood behind Abu Bakr in the (first) row. The people started clapping, and it was the habit of Abu Bakr that whenever he stood for prayer, he never glanced side-ways till he had finished it, but when Abu Bakr observed that the clapping was not coming to an end, he looked and saw the Prophet (ﷺ) standing behind him. The Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned him to carry on by waving his hand. Abu Bakr stood there for a while, thanking Allah for the saying of the Prophet (ﷺ) and then he retreated, taking his steps backwards. When the Prophet saw that, he went ahead and led the people in prayer. When he finished the prayer, he said, "O Abu Bakr! What prevented you from carrying on with the prayer after I beckoned you to do so?" Abu Bakr replied, "It does not befit the son of Abi Quhafa to lead the Prophet (ﷺ) in prayer." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to the people, "If some problem arises during prayers, then the men should say, Subhan Allah!; and the women should clap." (See Hadith No. 652, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ أَبُو ثَابِتٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ السَّبَّاقِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ بَعَثَ إِلَىَّ أَبُو بَكْرٍ لِمَقْتَلِ أَهْلِ الْيَمَامَةِ وَعِنْدَهُ عُمَرُ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ إِنَّ عُمَرَ أَتَانِي فَقَالَ إِنَّ الْقَتْلَ قَدِ اسْتَحَرَّ يَوْمَ الْيَمَامَةِ بِقُرَّاءِ الْقُرْآنِ، وَإِنِّي أَخْشَى أَنْ يَسْتَحِرَّ الْقَتْلُ بِقُرَّاءِ الْقُرْآنِ فِي الْمَوَاطِنِ كُلِّهَا، فَيَذْهَبَ قُرْآنٌ كَثِيرٌ، وَإِنِّي أَرَى أَنْ تَأْمُرَ بِجَمْعِ الْقُرْآنِ‏.‏ قُلْتُ كَيْفَ أَفْعَلُ شَيْئًا لَمْ يَفْعَلْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ عُمَرُ هُوَ وَاللَّهِ خَيْرٌ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ عُمَرُ يُرَاجِعُنِي فِي ذَلِكَ حَتَّى شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرِي لِلَّذِي شَرَحَ لَهُ صَدْرَ عُمَرَ، وَرَأَيْتُ فِي ذَلِكَ الَّذِي رَأَى عُمَرُ‏.‏ قَالَ زَيْدٌ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَإِنَّكَ رَجُلٌ شَابٌّ عَاقِلٌ لاَ نَتَّهِمُكَ، قَدْ كُنْتَ تَكْتُبُ الْوَحْىَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَتَبَّعِ الْقُرْآنَ فَاجْمَعْهُ‏.‏ قَالَ زَيْدٌ فَوَاللَّهِ لَوْ كَلَّفَنِي نَقْلَ جَبَلٍ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ مَا كَانَ بِأَثْقَلَ عَلَىَّ مِمَّا كَلَّفَنِي مِنْ جَمْعِ الْقُرْآنِ‏.‏ قُلْتُ كَيْفَ تَفْعَلاَنِ شَيْئًا لَمْ يَفْعَلْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ هُوَ وَاللَّهِ خَيْرٌ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَحُثُّ مُرَاجَعَتِي حَتَّى شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرِي لِلَّذِي شَرَحَ اللَّهُ لَهُ صَدْرَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ، وَرَأَيْتُ فِي ذَلِكَ الَّذِي رَأَيَا، فَتَتَبَّعْتُ الْقُرْآنَ أَجْمَعُهُ مِنَ الْعُسُبِ وَالرِّقَاعِ وَاللِّخَافِ وَصُدُورِ الرِّجَالِ، فَوَجَدْتُ آخِرَ سُورَةِ التَّوْبَةِ ‏{‏لَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِهَا مَعَ خُزَيْمَةَ أَوْ أَبِي خُزَيْمَةَ فَأَلْحَقْتُهَا فِي سُورَتِهَا، وَكَانَتِ الصُّحُفُ عِنْدَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ حَيَاتَهُ حَتَّى تَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ، ثُمَّ عِنْدَ عُمَرَ حَيَاتَهُ حَتَّى تَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ، ثُمَّ عِنْدَ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ عُمَرَ‏.‏ قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ اللِّخَافُ يَعْنِي الْخَزَفَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ubaydi alllahi aabuw thaabitin, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi bni alssabbaaqi, 'an zaydi bni thaabitin, qaala ba'atha iilaaaa aabuw bakrin limaqtali aahli alyamaamaai wa'indahu 'umaru faqaala aabuw bakrin iinna 'umara aataaniy faqaala iinna alqatla qadi astaharra yawma alyamaamaai biqurraa'i alqurani, waiinniy aakhshaa aan yastahirra alqatlu biqurraa'i alqurani fiy almawaatini kullihaa, fayadhhaba quranun kathiyrun, waiinniy aaraa aan taamura bijam'i alqurani‏.‏ qultu kayfa aaf'alu shayiana lam yaf'alhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala 'umaru huwa waalllahi khayrun‏.‏ falam yazal 'umaru yuraaji'uniy fiy dhalika hattaa sharaha alllahu sadriy lilladhiy sharaha lahu sadra 'umara, waraaaytu fiy dhalika alladhiy raaaa 'umaru‏.‏ qaala zaydun qaala aabuw bakrin waiinnaka rajulun shaabbun 'aaqilun laa nattahimuka, qad kunta taktubu alwahaa lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fatatabba'i alqurana faajma'hu‏.‏ qaala zaydun fawaalllahi law kallafaniy naqla jabalin mina aljibaali maa kaana biaathqala 'alaaaa mimmaa kallafaniy min jam'i alqurani‏.‏ qultu kayfa taf'alaani shayiana lam yaf'alhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala aabuw bakrin huwa waalllahi khayrun‏.‏ falam yazal yahuthhu muraaja'atiy hattaa sharaha alllahu sadriy lilladhiy sharaha alllahu lahu sadra aabiy bakrin wa'umara, waraaaytu fiy dhalika alladhiy raaayaa, fatatabba'tu alqurana aajma'uhu mina al'usubi waalrriqaa'i waalllikhaafi wasuduwri alrrijaali, fawajadtu akhira suwraai alttawbaai ‏{‏laqad jaa'akum rasuwlun min aanfusikum‏}‏ iilaa akhirihaa ma'a khuzaymaaa aaw aabiy khuzaymaaa faaalhaqtuhaa fiy suwratihaa, wakaanati alssuhufu 'inda aabiy bakrin hayaatahu hattaa tawaffaahu alllahu 'azza wajalla, thumma 'inda 'umara hayaatahu hattaa tawaffaahu alllahu, thumma 'inda hafsaaa binti 'umara‏.‏ qaala muhammadu bnu 'ubaydi alllahi alllikhaafu ya'niy alkhazafa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:Abu Bakr sent for me owing to the large number of casualties in the battle of Al-Yamama, while `Umar was sitting with him. Abu Bakr said (to me), `Umar has come to my and said, 'A great number of Qaris of the Holy Qur'an were killed on the day of the battle of Al-Yamama, and I am afraid that the casualties among the Qaris of the Qur'an may increase on other battle-fields whereby a large part of the Qur'an may be lost. Therefore I consider it advisable that you (Abu Bakr) should have the Qur'an collected.' I said, 'How dare I do something which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not do?' `Umar said, By Allah, it is something beneficial.' `Umar kept on pressing me for that till Allah opened my chest for that for which He had opened the chest of `Umar and I had in that matter, the same opinion as `Umar had." Abu Bakr then said to me (Zaid), "You are a wise young man and we do not have any suspicion about you, and you used to write the Divine Inspiration for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). So you should search for the fragmentary scripts of the Qur'an and collect it (in one Book)." Zaid further said: By Allah, if Abu Bakr had ordered me to shift a mountain among the mountains from one place to another it would not have been heavier for me than this ordering me to collect the Qur'an. Then I said (to `Umar and Abu Bakr), "How can you do something which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not do?" Abu Bakr said, "By Allah, it is something beneficial." Zaid added: So he (Abu Bakr) kept on pressing me for that until Allah opened my chest for that for which He had opened the chests of Abu Bakr and `Umar, and I had in that matter, the same opinion as theirs. So I started compiling the Qur'an by collecting it from the leafless stalks of the date-palm tree and from the pieces of leather and hides and from the stones, and from the chests of men (who had memorized the Qur'an). I found the last verses of Surat-at-Tauba: ("Verily there has come unto you an Apostle (Muhammad) from amongst yourselves--' (9.128-129) ) from Khuza`ima or Abi Khuza`ima and I added to it the rest of the Sura. The manuscripts of the Qur'an remained with Abu Bakr till Allah took him unto Him. Then it remained with `Umar till Allah took him unto Him, and then with Hafsa bint `Umar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي لَيْلَى، ح حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي لَيْلَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ هُوَ، وَرِجَالٌ، مِنْ كُبَرَاءِ قَوْمِهِ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ سَهْلٍ وَمُحَيِّصَةَ خَرَجَا إِلَى خَيْبَرَ مِنْ جَهْدٍ أَصَابَهُمْ، فَأُخْبِرَ مُحَيِّصَةُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ قُتِلَ وَطُرِحَ فِي فَقِيرٍ أَوْ عَيْنٍ، فَأَتَى يَهُودَ فَقَالَ أَنْتُمْ وَاللَّهِ قَتَلْتُمُوهُ‏.‏ قَالُوا مَا قَتَلْنَاهُ وَاللَّهِ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ حَتَّى قَدِمَ عَلَى قَوْمِهِ فَذَكَرَ لَهُمْ، وَأَقْبَلَ هُوَ وَأَخُوهُ حُوَيِّصَةُ ـ وَهْوَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْهُ ـ وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَهْلٍ، فَذَهَبَ لِيَتَكَلَّمَ وَهْوَ الَّذِي كَانَ بِخَيْبَرَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِمُحَيِّصَةَ ‏"‏ كَبِّرْ كَبِّرْ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُرِيدُ السِّنَّ، فَتَكَلَّمَ حُوَيِّصَةُ ثُمَّ تَكَلَّمَ مُحَيِّصَةُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِمَّا أَنْ يَدُوا صَاحِبَكُمْ، وَإِمَّا أَنْ يُؤْذِنُوا بِحَرْبٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَكَتَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَيْهِمْ بِهِ، فَكُتِبَ مَا قَتَلْنَاهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِحُوَيِّصَةَ وَمُحَيِّصَةَ وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏"‏ أَتَحْلِفُونَ وَتَسْتَحِقُّونَ دَمَ صَاحِبِكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَفَتَحْلِفُ لَكُمْ يَهُودُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لَيْسُوا بِمُسْلِمِينَ‏.‏ فَوَدَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ عِنْدِهِ مِائَةَ نَاقَةٍ حَتَّى أُدْخِلَتِ الدَّارَ‏.‏ قَالَ سَهْلٌ فَرَكَضَتْنِي مِنْهَا نَاقَةٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an aabiy laylaa, h haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, haddathaniy maalikun, 'an aabiy laylaa bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni sahlin, 'an sahli bni aabiy hathmaaa, aannahu aakhbarahu huwa, warijaalun, min kubaraa'i qawmihi aanna 'abda alllahi bna sahlin wamuhayyisaaa kharajaa iilaa khaybara min jahdin aasaabahum, faaukhbira muhayyisaau aanna 'abda alllahi qutila waturiha fiy faqiyrin aaw 'aynin, faaataa yahuwda faqaala aantum waalllahi qataltumuwhu‏.‏ qaaluwa maa qatalnaahu waalllahi‏.‏ thumma aaqbala hattaa qadima 'alaa qawmihi fadhakara lahum, waaaqbala huwa waaakhuwhu huwayyisaau wahwa aakbaru minhu wa'abdu alrrahmani bnu sahlin, fadhahaba liyatakallama wahwa alladhiy kaana bikhaybara faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm limuhayyisaaa ‏"‏ kabbir kabbir ‏"‏‏.‏ yuriydu alssinna, fatakallama huwayyisaau thumma takallama muhayyisaau faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iimmaa aan yaduwa saahibakum, waiimmaa aan yuudhinuwa biharbin ‏"‏‏.‏ fakataba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilayhim bihi, fakutiba maa qatalnaahu‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lihuwayyisaaa wamuhayyisaaa wa'abdi alrrahmani ‏"‏ aatahlifuwna watastahiqquwna dama saahibikum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa laa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aafatahlifu lakum yahuwdu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa laysuwa bimuslimiyna‏.‏ fawadaahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min 'indihi miaiaaa naaqaain hattaa audkhilati alddaara‏.‏ qaala sahlun farakadatniy minhaa naaqaaun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Laila bin `Abdullah bin `Abdur-Rahman bin Sahl:Sahl bin Abi Hathma and some great men of his tribe said, `Abdullah bin 'Sahl and Muhaiyisa went out to Khaibar as they were struck with poverty and difficult living conditions. Then Muhaiyisa was informed that `Abdullah had been killed and thrown in a pit or a spring. Muhaiyisa went to the Jews and said, "By Allah, you have killed my companion." The Jews said, "By Allah, we have not killed him." Muhaiyisa then came back to his people and told them the story. He, his elder brother Huwaiyisa and `Abdur-Rahman bin Sahl came (to the Prophet) and he who had been at Khaibar, proceeded to speak, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said to Muhaiyisa, "The eldest! The eldest!" meaning, "Let the eldest of you speak." So Huwaiyisa spoke first and then Muhaiyisa. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Jews should either pay the blood money of your (deceased) companion or be ready for war." After that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wrote a letter to the Jews in that respect, and they wrote that they had not killed him. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Huwaiyisa, Muhaiyisa and `Abdur-Rahman, "Can you take an oath by which you will be entitled to take the blood money?" They said, "No." He said (to them), "Shall we ask the Jews to take an oath before you?" They replied, "But the Jews are not Muslims." So Allah's Apostle gave them one-hundred she-camels as blood money from himself. Sahl added: When those she-camels were made to enter the house, one of them kicked me with its leg
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، قَالاَ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اقْضِ بَيْنَنَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَقَامَ خَصْمُهُ فَقَالَ صَدَقَ فَاقْضِ بَيْنَنَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الأَعْرَابِيُّ إِنَّ ابْنِي كَانَ عَسِيفًا عَلَى هَذَا فَزَنَى بِامْرَأَتِهِ، فَقَالُوا لِي عَلَى ابْنِكَ الرَّجْمُ‏.‏ فَفَدَيْتُ ابْنِي مِنْهُ بِمِائَةٍ مِنَ الْغَنَمِ وَوَلِيدَةٍ، ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُ أَهْلَ الْعِلْمِ فَقَالُوا إِنَّمَا عَلَى ابْنِكَ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَتَغْرِيبُ عَامٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لأَقْضِيَنَّ بَيْنَكُمَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، أَمَّا الْوَلِيدَةُ وَالْغَنَمُ فَرَدٌّ عَلَيْكَ، وَعَلَى ابْنِكَ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَتَغْرِيبُ عَامٍ، وَأَمَّا أَنْتَ يَا أُنَيْسُ ـ لِرَجُلٍ ـ فَاغْدُ عَلَى امْرَأَةِ هَذَا فَارْجُمْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَغَدَا عَلَيْهَا أُنَيْسٌ فَرَجَمَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, wazaydi bni khaalidin aljuhaniyyi, qaalaa jaa'a aa'raabiyyun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aqdi baynanaa bikitaabi alllahi faqaama khasmuhu faqaala sadaqa faaqdi baynanaa bikitaabi alllahi‏.‏ faqaala alaa'raabiyyu iinna abniy kaana 'asiyfana 'alaa hadhaa fazanaa biamraaatihi, faqaaluwa liy 'alaa abnika alrrajmu‏.‏ fafadaytu abniy minhu bimiaiaain mina alghanami wawaliydaain, thumma saaaltu aahla al'ilmi faqaaluwa iinnamaa 'alaa abnika jaldu miaiaain wataghriybu 'aamin‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laaqdiyanna baynakumaa bikitaabi alllahi, aammaa alwaliydaau waalghanamu faraddun 'alayka, wa'alaa abnika jaldu miaiaain wataghriybu 'aamin, waaammaa aanta yaa aunaysu lirajulin faaghdu 'alaa amraaaai hadhaa faarjumhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faghadaa 'alayhaa aunaysun farajamahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:A bedouin came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Judge between us according to Allah's Book (Laws)." His opponent stood up and said, "He has said the truth, so judge between us according to Allah's Laws." The bedouin said, "My son was a laborer for this man and committed illegal sexual intercourse with his wife. The people said to me, 'Your son is to be stoned to death,' so I ransomed my son for one hundred sheep and a slave girl. Then I asked the religious learned men and they said to me, 'Your son has to receive one hundred lashes plus one year of exile.' " The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I shall judge between you according to Allah's Book (Laws)! As for the slave girl and the sheep, it shall be returned to you, and your son shall receive one-hundred lashes and be exiled for one year. O you, Unais!" The Prophet (ﷺ) addressed some man, "Go in the morning to the wife of this man and stone her to death." So Unais went to her the next morning and stoned her to death
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ خَارِجَةُ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَتَعَلَّمَ كِتَابَ الْيَهُودِ، حَتَّى كَتَبْتُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كُتُبَهُ، وَأَقْرَأْتُهُ كُتُبَهُمْ إِذَا كَتَبُوا إِلَيْهِ، وَقَالَ عُمَرُ وَعِنْدَهُ عَلِيٌّ وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ وَعُثْمَانُ مَاذَا تَقُولُ هَذِهِ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ حَاطِبٍ فَقُلْتُ تُخْبِرُكَ بِصَاحِبِهِمَا الَّذِي صَنَعَ بِهِمَا‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو جَمْرَةَ كُنْتُ أُتَرْجِمُ بَيْنَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَبَيْنَ النَّاسِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَعْضُ النَّاسِ لاَ بُدَّ لِلْحَاكِمِ مِنْ مُتَرْجِمَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala khaarijaau bnu zaydi bni thaabitin 'an zaydi bni thaabitin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aamarahu aan yata'allama kitaaba alyahuwdi, hattaa katabtu lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm kutubahu, waaaqraatuhu kutubahum iidhaa katabuwa iilayhi, waqaala 'umaru wa'indahu 'aliyyun wa'abdu alrrahmani wa'uthmaanu maadhaa taquwlu hadhihi qaala 'abdu alrrahmani bnu haatibin faqultu tukhbiruka bisaahibihimaa alladhiy sana'a bihimaa‏.‏ waqaala aabuw jamraaa kuntu autarjimu bayna abni 'abbaasin wabayna alnnaasi‏.‏ waqaala ba'du alnnaasi laa budda lilhaakimi min mutarjimayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Kharija bin Zaid bin Thabit said that Zaid bin Thabit said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me to learn the writing of the Jews. I even wrote letters for the Prophet (ﷺ) (to the Jews) and also read their letters when they wrote to him." And 'Umar said in the presence of 'Ali, 'Abdur-Rahman, and 'Uthman, "What is this woman saying?" (the woman was non-Arab) 'Abdur-Rahman bin Hatib said:"She is informing you about her companion who has committed illegal sexual intercourse with her." Abu Jamra said, "I was an interpreter between Ibn 'Abbas and the people." Some people said, "A ruler should have two interpreters
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ بْنَ حَرْبٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ هِرَقْلَ أَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ فِي رَكْبٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لِتَرْجُمَانِهِ قُلْ لَهُمْ إِنِّي سَائِلٌ هَذَا، فَإِنْ كَذَبَنِي فَكَذِّبُوهُ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ فَقَالَ لِلتَّرْجُمَانِ قُلْ لَهُ إِنْ كَانَ مَا تَقُولُ حَقًّا فَسَيَمْلِكُ مَوْضِعَ قَدَمَىَّ هَاتَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin, aakhbarahu aanna aabaa sufyaana bna harbin aakhbarahu aanna hiraqla aarsala iilayhi fiy rakbin min qurayshin, thumma qaala litarjumaanihi qul lahum iinniy saaiilun hadhaa, faiin kadhabaniy fakadhhibuwhu‏.‏ fadhakara alhadiytha faqaala lilttarjumaani qul lahu iin kaana maa taquwlu haqqana fasayamliku mawdi'a qadamaaaa haatayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:That Abu Sufyan bin Harb told him that Heraclius had called him along with the members of a Quraish caravan and then said to his interpreter, "Tell them that I want to ask this (Abu Sufyan) a question, and if he tries to tell me a lie, they should contradict him." Then Abu Sufyan mentioned the whole narration and said that Heraclius said to the inter Peter, "Say to him (Abu Sufyan), 'If what you say is true, then he (the Prophet) will take over the place underneath my two feet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَعْمَلَ ابْنَ الأُتَبِيَّةِ عَلَى صَدَقَاتِ بَنِي سُلَيْمٍ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحَاسَبَهُ قَالَ هَذَا الَّذِي لَكُمْ، وَهَذِهِ هَدِيَّةٌ أُهْدِيَتْ لِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَهَلاَّ جَلَسْتَ فِي بَيْتِ أَبِيكَ وَبَيْتِ أُمِّكَ حَتَّى تَأْتِيَكَ هَدِيَّتُكَ، إِنْ كُنْتَ صَادِقًا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ وَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِنِّي أَسْتَعْمِلُ رِجَالاً مِنْكُمْ عَلَى أُمُورٍ مِمَّا وَلاَّنِي اللَّهُ، فَيَأْتِي أَحَدُكُمْ فَيَقُولُ هَذَا لَكُمْ وَهَذِهِ هَدِيَّةٌ أُهْدِيَتْ لِي فَهَلاَّ جَلَسَ فِي بَيْتِ أَبِيهِ وَبَيْتِ أُمِّهِ حَتَّى تَأْتِيَهُ هَدِيَّتُهُ إِنْ كَانَ صَادِقًا، فَوَاللَّهِ لاَ يَأْخُذُ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْهَا شَيْئًا ـ قَالَ هِشَامٌ ـ بِغَيْرِ حَقِّهِ إِلاَّ جَاءَ اللَّهَ يَحْمِلُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، أَلاَ فَلأَعْرِفَنَّ مَا جَاءَ اللَّهَ رَجُلٌ بِبَعِيرٍ لَهُ رُغَاءٌ، أَوْ بِبَقَرَةٍ لَهَا خُوَارٌ، أَوْ شَاةٍ تَيْعَرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى رَأَيْتُ بَيَاضَ إِبْطَيْهِ ‏"‏ أَلاَ هَلْ بَلَّغْتُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa muhamaadun, aakhbaranaa 'abdaau, hadaathanaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy humaydin alsaaa'idiyii, aanaa alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm asta'mala abna alautabiyaaai 'alaa sadaqaati baniy sulaymin, falamaaa jaa'a iilaa rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahaasabahu qaala hadhaa alaadhiy lakum, wahadhihi hadiyaaaun auhdiyat liy‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ fahalaaa jalasta fiy bayti aabiyka wabayti aumiika hataaa taatiyaka hadiyaatuka, iin kunta saadiqana ‏"‏‏.‏ thumaa qaama rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakhataba alnaaasa wahamida allaaha waaathnaa 'alayhi thumaa qaala ‏"‏ aamaaa ba'du faiiniiy aasta'milu rijaalaan minkum 'alaa aumuwrin mimaaa walaaaniy allaahu, fayaatiy aahadukum fayaquwlu hadhaa lakum wahadhihi hadiyaaaun auhdiyat liy fahalaaa jalasa fiy bayti aabiyhi wabayti aumiihi hataaa taatiyahu hadiyaatuhu iin kaana saadiqana, fawaallaahi laa yaakhudhu aahadukum minhaa shayiana qaala hishaamun bighayri haqiihi iilaaa jaa'a allaaha yahmiluhu yawma alqiyaamaai, aalaa falaa'rifanaa maa jaa'a allaaha rajulun biba'iyrin lahu rughaa'un, aaw bibaqaraain lahaa khuwaarun, aaw shaaain tay'aru ‏"‏‏.‏ thumaa rafa'a yadayhi hataaa raaaytu bayaada iibtayhi ‏"‏ aalaa hal balaaghtu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Humaid As-Sa`idi:The Prophet (ﷺ) employed Ibn Al-Utbiyya to collect Zakat from Bani Sulaim, and when he returned (with the money) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the Prophet (ﷺ) called him to account, and he said, "This (amount) is for you, and this was given to me as a present." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Why don't you stay at your father's house or your mother's house to see whether you will be given gifts or not, if you are telling the truth?" Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and addressed the people, and after glorifying and praising Allah, he said: Amma Ba'du (then after) I employ some men from among you for some job which Allah has placed in my charge, and then one of you comes to me and says, 'This (amount) is for you and this is a gift given to me.' Why doesn't he stay at the house of his father or the house of his mother and see whether he will be given gifts or not if he was telling the truth by Allah, none of you takes anything of it (i.e., Zakat) for himself (Hisham added: unlawfully) but he will meet Allah on the Day of Resurrection carrying it on his neck! I do not want to see any of you carrying a grunting camel or a mooing cow or a bleating sheep on meeting Allah." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) raised both his hands till I saw the whiteness of his armpits, and said, "(No doubt)! Haven't I conveyed Allah's Message
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَصْبَغُ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا بَعَثَ اللَّهُ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ وَلاَ اسْتَخْلَفَ مِنْ خَلِيفَةٍ، إِلاَّ كَانَتْ لَهُ بِطَانَتَانِ، بِطَانَةٌ تَأْمُرُهُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَتَحُضُّهُ عَلَيْهِ، وَبِطَانَةٌ تَأْمُرُهُ بِالشَّرِّ وَتَحُضُّهُ عَلَيْهِ، فَالْمَعْصُومُ مَنْ عَصَمَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ عَنْ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ بِهَذَا، وَعَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَتِيقٍ وَمُوسَى عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ مِثْلَهُ، وَقَالَ شُعَيْبٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ قَوْلَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الأَوْزَاعِيُّ وَمُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ سَلاَّمٍ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ قَوْلَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنِي صَفْوَانُ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aasbaghu, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa ba'atha alllahu min nabiyyin walaa astakhlafa min khaliyfaain, iilaaa kaanat lahu bitaanataani, bitaanaaun taamuruhu bialma'ruwfi watahudduhu 'alayhi, wabitaanaaun taamuruhu bialshharri watahudduhu 'alayhi, faalma'suwmu man 'asama alllahu ta'aalaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala sulaymaanu 'an yahyaa aakhbaraniy abnu shihaabin bihadhaa, wa'ani abni aabiy 'atiyqin wamuwsaa 'ani abni shihaabin mithlahu, waqaala shu'aybun 'ani alzzuhriyyi haddathaniy aabuw salamaaa 'an aabiy sa'iydin qawlahu‏.‏ waqaala alaawzaa'iyyu wamu'aawiyaau bnu salaaamin haddathaniy alzzuhriyyu haddathaniy aabuw salamaaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ waqaala abnu aabiy husaynin wasa'iydu bnu ziyaadin 'an aabiy salamaaa 'an aabiy sa'iydin qawlahu‏.‏ waqaala 'ubaydu alllahi bnu aabiy ja'farin haddathaniy safwaanu 'an aabiy salamaaa 'an aabiy aayyuwba qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah never sends a prophet or gives the Caliphate to a Caliph but that he (the prophet or the Caliph) has two groups of advisors: A group advising him to do good and exhorts him to do it, and the other group advising him to do evil and exhorts him to do it. But the protected person (against such evil advisors) is the one protected by Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَادَةُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ "بَايَعْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى السَّمْعِ وَالطَّاعَةِ فِي الْمَنْشَطِ وَالْمَكْرَهِ‏.‏ ‏‏وَأَنْ لاَ نُنَازِعَ الأَمْرَ أَهْلَهُ، وَأَنْ نَقُومَ ـ أَوْ نَقُولَ ـ بِالْحَقِّ حَيْثُمَا كُنَّا لاَ نَخَافُ فِي اللَّهِ لَوْمَةَ لاَئِمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa iismaa'iylu, hadaathaniy maalikun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaadaau bnu alwaliydi, aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an 'ubaadaaa bni alsaaamiti, qaala "baaya'naa rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alsaam'i waaltaaa'aai fiy almanshati waalmakrahi‏.‏ ‏‏waaan laa nunaazi'a alaamra aahlahu, waaan naquwma aaw naquwla bialhaqii haythumaa kunaaa laa nakhaafu fiy allaahi lawmaaa laaiimin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:We gave the oath of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that we would listen to and obey him both at the time when we were active and at the time when we were tired and that we would not fight against the ruler or disobey him, and would stand firm for the truth or say the truth wherever we might be, and in the Way of Allah we would not be afraid of the blame of the blamers. (See Hadith No. 178 and)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَدَاةٍ بَارِدَةٍ وَالْمُهَاجِرُونَ وَالأَنْصَارُ يَحْفِرُونَ الْخَنْدَقَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ الْخَيْرَ خَيْرُ الآخِرَهْ فَاغْفِرْ لِلأَنْصَارِ وَالْمُهَاجِرَهْ ‏"‏ فَأَجَابُوا نَحْنُ الَّذِينَ بَايَعُوا مُحَمَّدَا عَلَى الْجِهَادِ مَا بَقِينَا أَبَدَا
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, haddathanaa humaydun, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghadaaain baaridaain waalmuhaajiruwna waalaansaaru yahfiruwna alkhandaqa faqaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinna alkhayra khayru alakhirah faaghfir lilaansaari waalmuhaajirah ‏"‏ faaajaabuwa nahnu alladhiyna baaya'uwa muhammadaa 'alaa aljihaadi maa baqiynaa aabadaa
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out on a cold morning while the Muhajirin (emigrants) and the Ansar were digging the trench. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "O Allah! The real goodness is the goodness of the Here after, so please forgive the Ansar and the Muhajirin." They replied, "We are those who have given the Pledge of allegiance to Muhammad for to observe Jihad as long as we remain alive
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كُنَّا إِذَا بَايَعْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى السَّمْعِ وَالطَّاعَةِ يَقُولُ لَنَا ‏ "‏ فِيمَا اسْتَطَعْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala kunnaa iidhaa baaya'naa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alssam'i waalttaa'aai yaquwlu lanaa ‏ "‏ fiymaa astata'ta ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Whenever we gave the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for to listen to and obey, he used to say to us, for as much as you can
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ حَيْثُ اجْتَمَعَ النَّاسُ عَلَى عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ ـ قَالَ ـ كَتَبَ إِنِّي أُقِرُّ بِالسَّمْعِ وَالطَّاعَةِ لِعَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى سُنَّةِ اللَّهِ وَسُنَّةِ رَسُولِهِ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، وَإِنَّ بَنِيَّ قَدْ أَقَرُّوا بِمِثْلِ ذَلِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu diynaarin, qaala shahidtu abna 'umara haythu ajtama'a alnnaasu 'alaa 'abdi almaliki qaala kataba iinniy auqirru bialssam'i waalttaa'aai li'abdi almaliki aamiyri almuuminiyna 'alaa sunnaai alllahi wasunnaai rasuwlihi maa astata'tu, waiinna baniyya qad aaqarruwa bimithli dhalika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Dinar:I witnessed Ibn `Umar when the people gathered around `Abdul Malik. Ibn `Umar wrote: I gave the Pledge of allegiance that I will listen to and obey Allah's Slave, `Abdul Malik, Chief of the believers according to Allah's Laws and the Traditions of His Apostle as much as I can; and my sons too, give the same pledge
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَيَّارٌ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ بَايَعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى السَّمْعِ وَالطَّاعَةِ، فَلَقَّنَنِي، فِيمَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، وَالنُّصْحِ لِكُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa sayyaarun, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an jariyri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala baaya'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alssam'i waalttaa'aai, falaqqananiy, fiymaa astata'tu, waalnnushi likulli muslimin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I gave the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) that I would listen and obey, and he told me to add: 'As much as I can, and will give good advice to every Muslim
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا بَايَعَ النَّاسُ عَبْدَ الْمَلِكِ كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِنِّي أُقِرُّ بِالسَّمْعِ وَالطَّاعَةِ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، عَلَى سُنَّةِ اللَّهِ وَسُنَّةِ رَسُولِهِ، فِيمَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، وَإِنَّ بَنِيَّ قَدْ أَقَرُّوا بِذَلِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, qaala haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu diynaarin, qaala lammaa baaya'a alnnaasu 'abda almaliki kataba iilayhi 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara iilaa 'abdi alllahi 'abdi almaliki aamiyri almuuminiyna iinniy auqirru bialssam'i waalttaa'aai li'abdi alllahi 'abdi almaliki aamiyri almuuminiyna, 'alaa sunnaai alllahi wasunnaai rasuwlihi, fiymaa astata'tu, waiinna baniyya qad aaqarruwa bidhalika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Dinar:When the people took the oath of allegiance to `Abdul Malik, `Abdullah bin `Umar wrote to him: "To Allah's Slave, `Abdul Malik, Chief of the believers, I give the Pledge of allegiance that I will listen to and obey Allah's Slave, `Abdul Malik, Chief of the believers, according to Allah's Laws and the Traditions of His Apostle in whatever is within my ability; and my sons too, give the same pledge
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
