verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) arranged for a horse race, and the prepared horses were given less food for a few days before the race to win the race, and were allowed to run from Al-Hafya to Thaniyat-al- Wada`, and the unprepared horses were allowed to run between Thaniyat-al-Wada` and the mosque of Bani Zuraiq," `Abdullah was one of those who participated in the race
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ‏‏ ح. وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، وَابْنُ، إِدْرِيسَ وَابْنُ أَبِي غَنِيَّةَ عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّانَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ، عَلَى مِنْبَرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa qutaybaau 'an laythin 'an naafi'in 'ani abni 'umara‏‏ h. wahadaathaniy iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, waabnu, iidriysa waabnu aabiy ghaniyaaaa 'an aabiy hayaaana, 'ani alshaa'biyii, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala sami'tu 'umara, 'alaa minbari alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard `Umar (delivering a sermon) on the pulpit of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي السَّائِبُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، سَمِعَ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ، خَطَبَنَا عَلَى مِنْبَرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy alssaaiibu bnu yaziyda, sami'a 'uthmaana bna 'affaana, khatabanaa 'alaa minbari alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:That he heard `Uthman bin `Affan delivering a sermon on the pulpit of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، أَنَّ هِشَامَ بْنَ عُرْوَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ يُوضَعُ لِي وَلِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَذَا الْمِرْكَنُ فَنَشْرَعُ فِيهِ جَمِيعًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu hassaana, aanna hishaama bna 'urwaaa, haddathahu 'an aabiyhi, aanna 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana yuwda'u liy walirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hadhaa almirkanu fanashra'u fiyhi jamiy'ana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:This big copper vessel used to be put for me and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we would take water from it together (on taking a bath)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ حَالَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ الأَنْصَارِ وَقُرَيْشٍ فِي دَارِي الَّتِي بِالْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏ وَقَنَتَ شَهْرًا يَدْعُو عَلَى أَحْيَاءٍ مِنْ بَنِي سُلَيْمٍ
verses.translit: hadaathanaa musadaadun, hadaathanaa 'abaaadu bnu 'abaaadin, hadaathanaa 'aasimun alaahwalu, 'an aanasin, qaala haalafa alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna alaansaari waqurayshin fiy daariy alaatiy bialmadiynaai‏.‏ waqanata shahrana yad'uw 'alaa aahyaa'in min baniy sulaymin
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) brought the Ansar and the Quraish people into alliance in my house at Medina, and he invoked Allah for one month against the tribe of Bani Sulaim in (the last rak`a of each compulsory) prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا بُرَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، قَالَ قَدِمْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ فَلَقِيَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ فَقَالَ لِي انْطَلِقْ إِلَى الْمَنْزِلِ فَأَسْقِيَكَ فِي قَدَحٍ شَرِبَ فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَتُصَلِّي فِي مَسْجِدٍ صَلَّى فِيهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْتُ مَعَهُ، فَسَقَانِي سَوِيقًا، وَأَطْعَمَنِي تَمْرًا، وَصَلَّيْتُ فِي مَسْجِدِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa buraydun, 'an aabiy burdaaa, qaala qadimtu almadiynaaa falaqiyaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu salaamin faqaala liy antaliq iilaa almanzili faaasqiyaka fiy qadahin shariba fiyhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, watusalliy fiy masjidin sallaa fiyhi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faantalaqtu ma'ahu, fasaqaaniy sawiyqana, waaat'amaniy tamrana, wasallaytu fiy masjidihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda:When I arrived at Medina, `Abdullah bin Salam met me and said to me, "Accompany me to my house so that I may make you drink from a bowl from which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to drink, and that you may offer prayer in the mosque in which the Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray." I accompanied him, and he made me drink Sawiq and gave me dates to eat, and then I prayed in his mosque
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عِكْرِمَةُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَتَانِي اللَّيْلَةَ آتٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَهْوَ بِالْعَقِيقِ أَنْ صَلِّ فِي هَذَا الْوَادِي الْمُبَارَكِ وَقُلْ عُمْرَةٌ وَحَجَّةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ هَارُونُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ عُمْرَةٌ فِي حَجَّةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu alrrabiy'i, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu almubaaraki, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, haddathaniy 'ikrimaau, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna 'umara rda allh 'nh haddathahu qaala haddathaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aataaniy alllaylaaa atin min rabbiy wahwa bial'aqiyqi aan salli fiy hadhaa alwaadiy almubaaraki waqul 'umraaun wahajjaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala haaruwnu bnu iismaa'iyla haddathanaa 'aliyyun 'umraaun fiy hajjaain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Someone came to me tonight from my Lord while I was in the 'Aqiq (valley), and said to me, "Offer prayer in this blessed valley and say: 'Labbaik' for the (performance of) `Umra and Hajj
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، وَقَّتَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَرْنًا لأَهْلِ نَجْدٍ، وَالْجُحْفَةَ لأَهْلِ الشَّأْمِ، وَذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ لأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ هَذَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبَلَغَنِي أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَلأَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ يَلَمْلَمُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَذُكِرَ الْعِرَاقُ فَقَالَ لَمْ يَكُنْ عِرَاقٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'ani abni 'umara, waqqata alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qarnana laahli najdin, waaljuhfaaa laahli alshhaami, wadhaa alhulayfaai laahli almadiynaai‏.‏ qaala sami'tu hadhaa mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wabalaghaniy aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ walaahli alyamani yalamlamu ‏"‏‏.‏ wadhukira al'iraaqu faqaala lam yakun 'iraaqun yawmaiidhin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Dinar:Ibn `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) fixed Qarn as the Miqat (for assuming the Ihram) for the people of Najd, and Al-Juhfa for the people of Sham, and Dhul-Hulaifa for the people of Medina." Ibn `Umar added, "I heard this from the Prophet, and I have been informed that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The Miqat for the Yemenites is Yalamlam.' "When Iraq was mentioned, he said, "At that time it was not a Muslim country
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفُضَيْلُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ أُرِيَ وَهْوَ فِي مُعَرَّسِهِ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّكَ بِبَطْحَاءَ مُبَارَكَةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu almubaaraki, haddathanaa alfudaylu, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, haddathaniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu auriya wahwa fiy mu'arrasihi bidhiy alhulayfaai faqiyla lahu iinnaka bibathaa'a mubaarakaain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) had a dream in the last portion of the night when he was sleeping at Dhul-Hulaifa. (I n the dream) it was said to him, "You are in a blessed Batha' (i.e., valley)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِي الأَخِيرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ فُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ الأَمْرِ شَىْءٌ أَوْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَوْ يُعَذِّبَهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu muhammadin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara, aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu fiy salaaai alfajri rafa'a raasahu mina alrrukuw'i qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma rabbanaa walaka alhamdu fiy alaakhiyraai ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma al'an fulaanana wafulaanana ‏"‏‏.‏ faaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏laysa laka mina alaamri shaa'un aaw yatuwba 'alayhim aaw yu'adhhibahum faiinnahum zaalimuwna‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:That he heard the Prophet, after raising his head from the bowing in morning prayer, saying, "O Allah, our Lord! All the praises are for you." And in the last (rak`a) he said, "O Allah! Curse so-and-so and so--and-so." And then Allah revealed:-- 'Not for you (O Muhammad) is the decision, (but for Allah), whether He turns in mercy to them or punish them, for they are indeed wrongdoers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، ح حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَتَّابُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ، أَنَّ حُسَيْنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم طَرَقَهُ وَفَاطِمَةَ ـ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ ـ بِنْتَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ أَلاَ تُصَلُّونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا أَنْفُسُنَا بِيَدِ اللَّهِ، فَإِذَا شَاءَ أَنْ يَبْعَثَنَا بَعَثَنَا، فَانْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ قَالَ لَهُ ذَلِكَ وَلَمْ يَرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِ شَيْئًا، ثُمَّ سَمِعَهُ وَهْوَ مُدْبِرٌ يَضْرِبُ فَخِذَهُ وَهْوَ يَقُولُ ‏{‏وَكَانَ الإِنْسَانُ أَكْثَرَ شَىْءٍ جَدَلاً‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُقَالُ مَا أَتَاكَ لَيْلاً فَهْوَ طَارِقٌ‏.‏ وَيُقَالُ الطَّارِقُ النَّجْمُ، وَالثَّاقِبُ الْمُضِيءُ، يُقَالُ أَثْقِبْ نَارَكَ لِلْمُوقِدِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, h haddathaniy muhammadu bnu salaamin, aakhbaranaa 'attaabu bnu bashiyrin, 'an iishaaqa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy 'aliyyu bnu husaynin, aanna husayna bna 'aliyyin rda allh 'nhma aakhbarahu aanna 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin qaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm taraqahu wafaatimaaa 'alayhaa alssalaamu binta rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala lahum ‏"‏ aalaa tusalluwna ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala 'aliyyun faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnamaa aanfusunaa biyadi alllahi, faiidhaa shaa'a aan yab'athanaa ba'athanaa, faansarafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna qaala lahu dhalika walam yarji' iilayhi shayiana, thumma sami'ahu wahwa mudbirun yadribu fakhidhahu wahwa yaquwlu ‏{‏wakaana aliinsaanu aakthara shaa'in jadalaan‏}‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi yuqaalu maa aataaka laylaan fahwa taariqun‏.‏ wayuqaalu alttaariqu alnnajmu, waalthhaaqibu almudiy'u, yuqaalu aathqib naaraka lilmuwqidi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali bin Abi Talib:That Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to him and Fatima the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at their house at night and said, "Won't you pray?" `Ali replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Our souls are in the Hands of Allah and when he wants us to get up, He makes us get up." When `Ali said that to him, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) left without saying anything to him. While the Prophet (ﷺ) was leaving, `Ali heard him striking his thigh (with his hand) and saying, "But man is quarrelsome more than anything else
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ بَيْنَا نَحْنُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ انْطَلِقُوا إِلَى يَهُودَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَخَرَجْنَا مَعَهُ حَتَّى جِئْنَا بَيْتَ الْمِدْرَاسِ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَادَاهُمْ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مَعْشَرَ يَهُودَ أَسْلِمُوا تَسْلَمُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا بَلَّغْتَ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ذَلِكَ أُرِيدُ أَسْلِمُوا تَسْلَمُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا قَدْ بَلَّغْتَ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ذَلِكَ أُرِيدُ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَهَا الثَّالِثَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا الأَرْضُ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُجْلِيَكُمْ مِنْ هَذِهِ الأَرْضِ، فَمَنْ وَجَدَ مِنْكُمْ بِمَالِهِ شَيْئًا فَلْيَبِعْهُ، وَإِلاَّ فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا الأَرْضُ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an sa'iydin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala baynaa nahnu fiy almasjidi kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ antaliquwa iilaa yahuwda ‏"‏‏.‏ fakharajnaa ma'ahu hattaa jiinaa bayta almidraasi faqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fanaadaahum faqaala ‏"‏ yaa ma'shara yahuwda aaslimuwa taslamuwa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaaluwa ballaghta yaa aabaa alqaasimi‏.‏ qaala faqaala lahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ dhalika auriydu aaslimuwa taslamuwa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaaluwa qad ballaghta yaa aabaa alqaasimi‏.‏ faqaala lahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ dhalika auriydu ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaalahaa althhaalithaaa faqaala ‏"‏ a'lamuwa aannamaa alaardu lillahi warasuwlihi waiinniy auriydu aan aujliyakum min hadhihi alaardi, faman wajada minkum bimaalihi shayiana falyabi'hu, waiilaaa faa'lamuwa aannamaa alaardu lillahi warasuwlihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:While we were in the mosque, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out and said, "Let us proceed to the Jews." So we went out with him till we came to Bait-al-Midras. The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up there and called them, saying, "O assembly of Jews! Surrender to Allah (embrace Islam) and you will be safe!" They said, "You have conveyed Allah's message, O Aba-al-Qasim" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said to them, "That is what I want; embrace Islam and you will be safe." They said, "You have conveyed the message, O Aba-al- Qasim." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said to them, "That is what I want," and repeated his words for the third time and added, "Know that the earth is for Allah and I want to exile you from this land, so whoever among you has property he should sell it, otherwise, know that the land is for Allah and His Apostle
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يُجَاءُ بِنُوحٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيُقَالُ لَهُ هَلْ بَلَّغْتَ فَيَقُولُ نَعَمْ يَا رَبِّ‏.‏ فَتُسْأَلُ أُمَّتُهُ هَلْ بَلَّغَكُمْ فَيَقُولُونَ مَا جَاءَنَا مِنْ نَذِيرٍ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ مَنْ شُهُودُكَ فَيَقُولُ مُحَمَّدٌ وَأُمَّتُهُ‏.‏ فَيُجَاءُ بِكُمْ فَتَشْهَدُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏وَكَذَلِكَ جَعَلْنَاكُمْ أُمَّةً وَسَطًا‏}‏ قَالَ عَدْلاً ‏{‏لِتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيدًا‏}‏ وَعَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عَوْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, haddathanaa aabuw saalihin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yujaa'u binuwhin yawma alqiyaamaai fayuqaalu lahu hal ballaghta fayaquwlu na'am yaa rabbi‏.‏ fatusaalu aummatuhu hal ballaghakum fayaquwluwna maa jaa'anaa min nadhiyrin‏.‏ fayaquwlu man shuhuwduka fayaquwlu muhammadun waaummatuhu‏.‏ fayujaa'u bikum fatashhaduwna ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaraaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏{‏wakadhalika ja'alnaakum aummaaan wasatana‏}‏ qaala 'adlaan ‏{‏litakuwnuwa shuhadaa'a 'alaa alnnaasi wayakuwna alrrasuwlu 'alaykum shahiydana‏}‏ wa'an ja'fari bni 'awnin, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Noah will be brought (before Allah) on the Day of Resurrection, and will be asked, 'Did you convey the message of Allah?" He will reply, 'Yes, O Lord.' And then Noah's nation will be asked, 'Did he (Noah) convey Allah's message to you?' They will reply, 'No warner came to us.' Then Noah will be asked, 'Who are your witnesses?' He will reply. '(My witnesses are) Muhammad and his followers.' Thereupon you (Muslims) will be brought and you will bear witness." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited: 'And thus We have made of you (Muslims) a just and the best nation, that you might be witness over the nations, and the Apostle a witness over you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ بْنِ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، وَأَبَا، هُرَيْرَةَ حَدَّثَاهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ أَخَا بَنِي عَدِيٍّ الأَنْصَارِيَّ وَاسْتَعْمَلَهُ عَلَى خَيْبَرَ، فَقَدِمَ بِتَمْرٍ جَنِيبٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَكُلُّ تَمْرِ خَيْبَرَ هَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا لَنَشْتَرِي الصَّاعَ بِالصَّاعَيْنِ مِنَ الْجَمْعِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَفْعَلُوا، وَلَكِنْ مِثْلاً بِمِثْلٍ، أَوْ بِيعُوا هَذَا وَاشْتَرُوا بِثَمَنِهِ مِنْ هَذَا وَكَذَلِكَ الْمِيزَانُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an aakhiyhi, 'an sulaymaana bni bilaalin, 'an 'abdi almajiydi bni suhayli bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin, aannahu sami'a sa'iyda bna almusayyabi, yuhaddithu aanna aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya, waaabaa, hurayraaa haddathaahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'atha aakhaa baniy 'adiyyin alaansaariyya waasta'malahu 'alaa khaybara, faqadima bitamrin janiybin faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aakullu tamri khaybara hakadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala laa waalllahi yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaa lanashtariy alssaa'a bialssaa'ayni mina aljam'i‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa taf'aluwa, walakin mithlaan bimithlin, aaw biy'uwa hadhaa waashtaruwa bithamanihi min hadhaa wakadhalika almiyzaanu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri and Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent the brother of the tribe of Bani Adi Al-Ansari as governor of Khaibar. Then the man returned, bringing Janib (a good kind of date). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked him, "Are all the dates of Khaibar like that?" He replied, "No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We take one Sa' of these (good) dates for two Sas of mixed dates." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, "Do not do so. You should either take one Sa of this (kind) for one Sa' of the other; or sell one kind and then buy with its price the other kind (of dates), and you should do the same in weighing
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَيْسٍ، مَوْلَى عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا حَكَمَ الْحَاكِمُ فَاجْتَهَدَ ثُمَّ أَصَابَ فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ، وَإِذَا حَكَمَ فَاجْتَهَدَ ثُمَّ أَخْطَأَ فَلَهُ أَجْرٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ فَقَالَ هَكَذَا حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُطَّلِبِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'abdu allaahi bnu yaziyda, hadaathanaa haywaau, hadaathaniy yaziydu bnu 'abdi allaahi bni alhaadi, 'an muhamaadi bni iibraahiyma bni alhaarithi, 'an busri bni sa'iydin, 'an aabiy qaysin, mawlaa 'amriw bni al'aasi 'an 'amriw bni al'aasi, aanaahu sami'a rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iidhaa hakama alhaakimu faajtahada thumaa aasaaba falahu aajraani, waiidhaa hakama faajtahada thumaa aakhtaaa falahu aajrun ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fahadaathtu bihadhaa alhadiythi aabaa bakri bna 'amriw bni hazmin faqaala hakadhaa hadaathaniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alraahmani 'an aabiy hurayraaa‏.‏ waqaala 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu almutaalibi 'an 'abdi allaahi bni aabiy bakrin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm mithlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amr bin Al-`As:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "If a judge gives a verdict according to the best of his knowledge and his verdict is correct (i.e. agrees with Allah and His Apostle's verdict) he will receive a double reward, and if he gives a verdict according to the best of his knowledge and his verdict is wrong, (i.e. against that of Allah and His Apostle) even then he will get a reward
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءٌ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ اسْتَأْذَنَ أَبُو مُوسَى عَلَى عُمَرَ فَكَأَنَّهُ وَجَدَهُ مَشْغُولاً فَرَجَعَ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ أَلَمْ أَسْمَعْ صَوْتَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، ائْذَنُوا لَهُ‏.‏ فَدُعِيَ لَهُ فَقَالَ مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى مَا صَنَعْتَ فَقَالَ إِنَّا كُنَّا نُؤْمَرُ بِهَذَا‏.‏ قَالَ فَأْتِنِي عَلَى هَذَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ أَوْ لأَفْعَلَنَّ بِكَ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ إِلَى مَجْلِسٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالُوا لاَ يَشْهَدُ إِلاَّ أَصَاغِرُنَا‏.‏ فَقَامَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ فَقَالَ قَدْ كُنَّا نُؤْمَرُ بِهَذَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ خَفِيَ عَلَىَّ هَذَا مِنْ أَمْرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، أَلْهَانِي الصَّفْقُ بِالأَسْوَاقِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'ani abni jurayjin, haddathaniy 'ataa'un, 'an 'ubaydi bni 'umayrin, qaala astaadhana aabuw muwsaa 'alaa 'umara fakaaannahu wajadahu mashghuwlaan faraja'a, faqaala 'umaru aalam aasma' sawta 'abdi alllahi bni qaysin, aidhanuwa lahu‏.‏ fadu'iya lahu faqaala maa hamalaka 'alaa maa sana'ta faqaala iinnaa kunnaa nuumaru bihadhaa‏.‏ qaala faatiniy 'alaa hadhaa bibayyinaain aaw laaf'alanna bika‏.‏ faantalaqa iilaa majlisin mina alaansaari faqaaluwa laa yashhadu iilaaa aasaaghirunaa‏.‏ faqaama aabuw sa'iydin alkhudriyyu faqaala qad kunnaa nuumaru bihadhaa‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru khafiya 'alaaaa hadhaa min aamri alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, aalhaaniy alssafqu bialaaswaaqi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ubai bin `Umar:Abu Musa asked permission to enter upon `Umar, but seeing that he was busy, he went away. `Umar then said, "Didn't I hear the voice of `Abdullah bin Qais? Allow him to come in." He was called in and `Umar said to him, "What made you do what you did." He replied, "We have been instructed thus by the Prophet" `Umar said, "Bring proof (witness) for this, other wise I will do so-and-so to you." Then `Abdullah bin Qais went to a gathering of the Ansar who then said, "None but the youngest of us will give the witness for it." So Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri got up and said, "We used to be instructed thus (by the Prophet)." `Umar said, "This tradition of the Prophet (ﷺ) remained hidden from me. Business in the market kept me busy
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ مِنَ الأَعْرَجِ، يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يُكْثِرُ الْحَدِيثَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاللَّهُ الْمَوْعِدُ، إِنِّي كُنْتُ امْرَأً مِسْكِينًا أَلْزَمُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى مِلْءِ بَطْنِي، وَكَانَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ يَشْغَلُهُمُ الصَّفْقُ بِالأَسْوَاقِ، وَكَانَتِ الأَنْصَارُ يَشْغَلُهُمُ الْقِيَامُ عَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمْ، فَشَهِدْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ يَبْسُطْ رِدَاءَهُ حَتَّى أَقْضِيَ مَقَالَتِي ثُمَّ يَقْبِضْهُ، فَلَنْ يَنْسَى شَيْئًا سَمِعَهُ مِنِّي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَبَسَطْتُ بُرْدَةً كَانَتْ عَلَىَّ، فَوَالَّذِي بَعَثَهُ بِالْحَقِّ مَا نَسِيتُ شَيْئًا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathaniy alzzuhriyyu, aannahu sami'ahu mina alaa'raji, yaquwlu aakhbaraniy aabuw hurayraaa, qaala iinnakum taz'umuwna aanna aabaa hurayraaa, yukthiru alhadiytha 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalllahu almaw'idu, iinniy kuntu amraaan miskiynana aalzamu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa mil'i batniy, wakaana almuhaajiruwna yashghaluhumu alssafqu bialaaswaaqi, wakaanati alaansaaru yashghaluhumu alqiyaamu 'alaa aamwaalihim, fashahidtu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhaata yawmin waqaala ‏ "‏ man yabsut ridaa'ahu hattaa aaqdiya maqaalatiy thumma yaqbidhu, falan yansaa shayiana sami'ahu minniy ‏"‏‏.‏ fabasattu burdaaan kaanat 'alaaaa, fawaalladhiy ba'athahu bialhaqqi maa nasiytu shayiana sami'tuhu minhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-A'raj:Abu Huraira said, "You people claim that Abu Huraira narrates many narrations of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). (Anyhow) with Allah will be our appointment. I was a poor man, and used to stick to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) contented with what will fill my stomach, and the Muhajirin (emigrants) used to be busy trading in the markets, and the Ansar used to be busy looking after their properties. One-day I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'Who will spread his Rida' (a garment covering the upper part of the body) till I finished my speech and then fold it, (i.e. wrap it over your body), in which case he will never forget anything he had heard from me." So I spread my garment which I was wearing; and by Him Who sent Muhammad with the Truth, ever since, I have never forgotten whatever I heard from him (the Prophet)" (See, Hadith No. 119, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَحْلِفُ بِاللَّهِ أَنَّ ابْنَ الصَّائِدِ الدَّجَّالُ، قُلْتُ تَحْلِفُ بِاللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ يَحْلِفُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يُنْكِرْهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hammaadu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, qaala raaaytu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi yahlifu bialllahi aanna abna alssaaiidi alddajjaalu, qultu tahlifu bialllahi‏.‏ qaala iinniy sami'tu 'umara yahlifu 'alaa dhalika 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm falam yunkirhu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir:I saw Jabir bin `Abdullah swearing by Allah that Ibn Sayyad was the Dajjal. I said to Jabir, "How can you swear by Allah?" Jabir said, "I have heard `Umar swearing by Allah regarding this matter in the presence of the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) did not disapprove of it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الْخَيْلُ لِثَلاَثَةٍ لِرَجُلٍ أَجْرٌ، وَلِرَجُلٍ سِتْرٌ، وَعَلَى رَجُلٍ وِزْرٌ، فَأَمَّا الَّذِي لَهُ أَجْرٌ فَرَجُلٌ رَبَطَهَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَأَطَالَ فِي مَرْجٍ أَوْ رَوْضَةٍ، فَمَا أَصَابَتْ فِي طِيَلِهَا ذَلِكَ الْمَرْجِ وَالرَّوْضَةِ كَانَ لَهُ حَسَنَاتٍ، وَلَوْ أَنَّهَا قَطَعَتْ طِيَلَهَا فَاسْتَنَّتْ شَرَفًا أَوْ شَرَفَيْنِ كَانَتْ آثَارُهَا وَأَرْوَاثُهَا حَسَنَاتٍ لَهُ، وَلَوْ أَنَّهَا مَرَّتْ بِنَهَرٍ فَشَرِبَتْ مِنْهُ وَلَمْ يُرِدْ أَنْ يَسْقِيَ بِهِ كَانَ ذَلِكَ حَسَنَاتٍ لَهُ، وَهِيَ لِذَلِكَ الرَّجُلِ أَجْرٌ، وَرَجُلٌ رَبَطَهَا تَغَنِّيًا وَتَعَفُّفًا وَلَمْ يَنْسَ حَقَّ اللَّهِ فِي رِقَابِهَا وَلاَ ظُهُورِهَا، فَهْىَ لَهُ سِتْرٌ، وَرَجُلٌ رَبَطَهَا فَخْرًا وَرِيَاءً، فَهِيَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ وِزْرٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَسُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْحُمُرِ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَىَّ فِيهَا إِلاَّ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ الْفَاذَّةَ الْجَامِعَةَ ‏{‏فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ * وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, haddathaniy maalikun, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an aabiy saalihin alssammaani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ alkhaylu lithalaathaain lirajulin aajrun, walirajulin sitrun, wa'alaa rajulin wizrun, faaammaa alladhiy lahu aajrun farajulun rabatahaa fiy sabiyli alllahi faaataala fiy marjin aaw rawdaain, famaa aasaabat fiy tiyalihaa dhalika almarji waalrrawdaai kaana lahu hasanaatin, walaw aannahaa qata'at tiyalahaa faastannat sharafana aaw sharafayni kaanat athaaruhaa waaarwaathuhaa hasanaatin lahu, walaw aannahaa marrat binaharin fasharibat minhu walam yurid aan yasqiya bihi kaana dhalika hasanaatin lahu, wahiya lidhalika alrrajuli aajrun, warajulun rabatahaa taghanniyana wata'affufana walam yansa haqqa alllahi fiy riqaabihaa walaa zuhuwrihaa, fahaa lahu sitrun, warajulun rabatahaa fakhrana wariyaa'an, fahiya 'alaa dhalika wizrun ‏"‏‏.‏ wasuiila rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alhumuri qaala ‏"‏ maa aanzala alllahu 'alaaaa fiyhaa iilaaa hadhihi alayaaa alfaadhhaaa aljaami'aaa ‏{‏faman ya'mal mithqaala dharraain khayrana yarahu * waman ya'mal mithqaala dharraain sharrana yarahu‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Horses may be used for three purposes: For a man they may be a source of reward (in the Hereafter); for another, a means of protection; and for another, a source of sin. The man for whom they are a source of reward, is the one who keeps them for Allah's Cause and ties them with long ropes and lets them graze in a pasture or garden. Whatever those long ropes allow them to eat of that pasture or garden, will be written as good deeds for him and if they break their ropes and run one or two rounds, then all their footsteps and dung will be written as good deeds for him, and if they pass a river and drink from it though he has had no intention of watering them, even then, that will be written as good deeds for him. So such horses are a source of reward for that man. For the man who keeps horses for his livelihood in order not to ask others for help or beg his bread, and at the same time he does not forget Allah's right of what he earns through them and of their backs (that he presents it to be used in Allah's Cause), such horses are a shelter for him (from poverty). For the man who keeps them just out of pride and for showing off, they are a source of sin." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about donkeys. He said, "Allah has not revealed anything to me regarding them except this comprehensive Verse: "Then anyone who has done good, equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant) shall see it, and any one who has done evil, equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant) shall see it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ صَفِيَّةَ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، سَأَلَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ عُقْبَةَ ـ حَدَّثَنَا الْفُضَيْلُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ النُّمَيْرِيُّ الْبَصْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ابْنُ شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمِّي عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً سَأَلَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْحَيْضِ كَيْفَ تَغْتَسِلُ مِنْهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَأْخُذِينَ فِرْصَةً مُمَسَّكَةً فَتَوَضَّئِينَ بِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ كَيْفَ أَتَوَضَّأُ بِهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَوَضَّئِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ كَيْفَ أَتَوَضَّأُ بِهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَوَضَّئِينَ بِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَعَرَفْتُ الَّذِي يُرِيدُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَذَبْتُهَا إِلَىَّ فَعَلَّمْتُهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an mansuwri bni safiyyaaa, 'an aummihi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna amraaaaan, saaalati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ haddathanaa muhammadun huwa abnu 'uqbaaa haddathanaa alfudaylu bnu sulaymaana alnnumayriyyu albasriyyu haddathanaa mansuwru bnu 'abdi alrrahmani abnu shaybaaa haddathatniy aummiy 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna amraaaaan saaalati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alhaydi kayfa taghtasilu minhu qaala ‏"‏ taakhudhiyna firsaaan mumassakaaan fatawaddaiiyna bihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat kayfa aatawaddaau bihaa yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ tawaddaiiy ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat kayfa aatawaddaau bihaa yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ tawaddaiiyna bihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau fa'araftu alladhiy yuriydu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fajadhabtuhaa iilaaaa fa'allamtuhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:A woman asked the Prophet (Hadith 456). Narrated `Aisha: A woman asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about the periods: How to take a bath after the periods. He said, "Take a perfumed piece of cloth and clean yourself with it." She said,' "How shall I clean myself with it, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Clean yourself" She said again, "How shall I clean myself, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Clean yourself with it." Then I knew what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) meant. So I pulled her aside and explained it to her
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ أُمَّ حُفَيْدٍ بِنْتَ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ حَزْنٍ، أَهْدَتْ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمْنًا وَأَقِطًا وَأَضُبًّا، فَدَعَا بِهِنَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأُكِلْنَ عَلَى مَائِدَتِهِ، فَتَرَكَهُنَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَالْمُتَقَذِّرِ لَهُ، وَلَوْ كُنَّ حَرَامًا مَا أُكِلْنَ عَلَى مَائِدَتِهِ، وَلاَ أَمَرَ بِأَكْلِهِنَّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna aumma hufaydin binta alhaarithi bni haznin, aahdat iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm samnana waaaqitana waaadubbana, fada'aa bihinna alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faaukilna 'alaa maaiidatihi, fatarakahunna alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm kaalmutaqadhhiri lahu, walaw kunna haraamana maa aukilna 'alaa maaiidatihi, walaa aamara biaaklihinna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Um Hufaid bint Al-Harith bin Hazn presented the Prophet (ﷺ) with some butter, dried yoghurt (curd milk) and mastigures as a gift. The Prophet (ﷺ) then asked for a meal (mastigures etc. to be put) and it was eaten over his table cloth, but the Prophet (ﷺ) did not eat of it, as he had aversion to it. But if it had been illegal to eat, it would not have been eaten over his table cloth nor would he have ordered that (mastigures meat) to be eaten
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ أَكَلَ ثُومًا أَوْ بَصَلاً، فَلْيَعْتَزِلْنَا أَوْ لِيَعْتَزِلْ مَسْجِدَنَا، وَلْيَقْعُدْ فِي بَيْتِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَإِنَّهُ أُتِيَ بِبَدْرٍ ـ قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ يَعْنِي طَبَقًا ـ فِيهِ خَضِرَاتٌ مِنْ بُقُولٍ، فَوَجَدَ لَهَا رِيحًا فَسَأَلَ عَنْهَا ـ أُخْبِرَ بِمَا فِيهَا مِنَ الْبُقُولِ ـ فَقَالَ قَرِّبُوهَا فَقَرَّبُوهَا إِلَى بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ كَانَ مَعَهُ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُ كَرِهَ أَكْلَهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ كُلْ، فَإِنِّي أُنَاجِي مَنْ لاَ تُنَاجِي ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عُفَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ بِقِدْرٍ فِيهِ خَضِرَاتٌ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ اللَّيْثُ وَأَبُو صَفْوَانَ عَنْ يُونُسَ قِصَّةَ الْقِدْرِ، فَلاَ أَدْرِي هُوَ مِنْ قَوْلِ الزُّهْرِيِّ أَوْ فِي الْحَدِيثِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu saalihin, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'ataa'u bnu aabiy rabaahin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man aakala thuwmana aaw basalaan, falya'tazilnaa aaw liya'tazil masjidanaa, walyaq'ud fiy baytihi ‏"‏‏.‏ waiinnahu autiya bibadrin qaala abnu wahbin ya'niy tabaqana fiyhi khadiraatun min buquwlin, fawajada lahaa riyhana fasaaala 'anhaa aukhbira bimaa fiyhaa mina albuquwli faqaala qarribuwhaa faqarrabuwhaa iilaa ba'di aashaabihi kaana ma'ahu, falammaa raahu kariha aaklahaa qaala ‏"‏ kul, faiinniy aunaajiy man laa tunaajiy ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala abnu 'ufayrin 'ani abni wahbin biqidrin fiyhi khadiraatun‏.‏ walam yadhkuri alllaythu waaabuw safwaana 'an yuwnusa qissaaa alqidri, falaa aadriy huwa min qawli alzzuhriyyi aaw fiy alhadiythi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever has eaten garlic or onion, should keep away from us, or should keep away from our mosque and should stay at home." Ibn Wahb said, "Once a plate full of cooked vegetables was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) at Badr. Detecting a bad smell from it, he asked about the dish and was informed of the kinds of vegetables in contained. He then said, "Bring it near," and so it was brought near to one of his companions who was with him. When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw it, he disliked eating it and said (to his companion), "Eat, for I talk in secret to ones whom you do not talk to
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَعَمِّي، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، جُبَيْرَ بْنَ مُطْعِمٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكَلَّمَتْهُ فِي شَىْءٍ، فَأَمَرَهَا بِأَمْرٍ فَقَالَتْ أَرَأَيْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنْ لَمْ أَجِدْكَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ لَمْ تَجِدِينِي فَأْتِي أَبَا بَكْرٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ زَادَ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ كَأَنَّهَا تَعْنِي الْمَوْتَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'di bni iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aabiy wa'ammiy, qaalaa haddathanaa aabiy, 'an aabiyhi, aakhbaraniy muhammadu bnu jubayrin, aanna aabaahu, jubayra bna mut'imin aakhbarahu aanna amraaaaan aatat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakallamathu fiy shaa'in, faaamarahaa biaamrin faqaalat aaraaayta yaa rasuwla alllahi iin lam aajidka qaala ‏ "‏ iin lam tajidiyniy faatiy aabaa bakrin ‏"‏‏.‏ zaada alhumaydiyyu 'an iibraahiyma bni sa'din kaaannahaa ta'niy almawta‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:A lady came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and she talked to him about something, and he gave her some order. She said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If I should not find you?" He said, "If you should not find me, then go to Abu Bakr." Ibrahim bin Sa`d said, "As if she meant the death (of the Prophet)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: وَقَالَ أَبُو الْيَمَانِ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، سَمِعَ مُعَاوِيَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ رَهْطًا مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ بِالْمَدِينَةِ، وَذَكَرَ كَعْبَ الأَحْبَارِ فَقَالَ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَصْدَقِ هَؤُلاَءِ الْمُحَدِّثِينَ الَّذِينَ يُحَدِّثُونَ عَنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ، وَإِنْ كُنَّا مَعَ ذَلِكَ لَنَبْلُو عَلَيْهِ الْكَذِبَ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala aabuw alyamaani aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy humaydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, sami'a mu'aawiyaaa, yuhaddithu rahtana min qurayshin bialmadiynaai, wadhakara ka'ba alaahbaari faqaala iin kaana min aasdaqi hauulaa'i almuhaddithiyna alladhiyna yuhaddithuwna 'an aahli alkitaabi, waiin kunnaa ma'a dhalika lanabluw 'alayhi alkadhiba‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Humaid bin 'Abdur-Rahman that he heard Mu'awiya talking to a group of people from Quraish at Al-Madina, and on mentioning Ka'b Al-Ashbar, he said, "He was one of the most truthful of those who used to talk about the people of the Scripture, yet we used to detect certain faults in his information
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ يَقْرَءُونَ التَّوْرَاةَ بِالْعِبْرَانِيَّةِ وَيُفَسِّرُونَهَا بِالْعَرَبِيَّةِ لأَهْلِ الإِسْلاَمِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تُصَدِّقُوا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ، وَلاَ تُكَذِّبُوهُمْ وَقُولُوا ‏{‏آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara, aakhbaranaa 'aliyyu bnu almubaaraki, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala kaana aahlu alkitaabi yaqra'uwna alttawraaaa bial'ibraaniyyaai wayufassiruwnahaa bial'arabiyyaai laahli aliislaami faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa tusaddiquwa aahla alkitaabi, walaa tukadhhibuwhum waquwluwa ‏{‏amannaa bialllahi wamaa aunzila iilaynaa wamaa aunzila iilaykum‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The people of the Book used to read the Torah in Hebrew and then explain it in Arabic to the Muslims. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to the Muslims). "Do not believe the people of the Book, nor disbelieve them, but say, 'We believe in Allah and whatever is revealed to us, and whatever is revealed to you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُونَ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ عَنْ شَىْءٍ، وَكِتَابُكُمُ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْدَثُ، تَقْرَءُونَهُ مَحْضًا لَمْ يُشَبْ وَقَدْ حَدَّثَكُمْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ بَدَّلُوا كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَغَيَّرُوهُ وَكَتَبُوا بِأَيْدِيهِمُ الْكِتَابَ وَقَالُوا هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ لِيَشْتَرُوا بِهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلاً، أَلاَ يَنْهَاكُمْ مَا جَاءَكُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ عَنْ مَسْأَلَتِهِمْ، لاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا رَأَيْنَا مِنْهُمْ رَجُلاً يَسْأَلُكُمْ عَنِ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa iibraahiymu, aakhbaranaa abnu shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, aanna abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala kayfa tasaaluwna aahla alkitaabi 'an shaa'in, wakitaabukumu alladhiy aunzila 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahdathu, taqra'uwnahu mahdana lam yushab waqad haddathakum aanna aahla alkitaabi baddaluwa kitaaba alllahi waghayyaruwhu wakatabuwa biaaydiyhimu alkitaaba waqaaluwa huwa min 'indi alllahi‏.‏ liyashtaruwa bihi thamanana qaliylaan, aalaa yanhaakum maa jaa'akum mina al'ilmi 'an masaalatihim, laa waalllahi maa raaaynaa minhum rajulaan yasaalukum 'ani alladhiy aunzila 'alaykum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ubaidullah:Ibn `Abbas said, "Why do you ask the people of the scripture about anything while your Book (Qur'an) which has been revealed to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is newer and the latest? You read it pure, undistorted and unchanged, and Allah has told you that the people of the scripture (Jews and Christians) changed their scripture and distorted it, and wrote the scripture with their own hands and said, 'It is from Allah,' to sell it for a little gain. Does not the knowledge which has come to you prevent you from asking them about anything? No, by Allah, we have never seen any man from them asking you regarding what has been revealed to you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ سَلاَّمِ بْنِ أَبِي مُطِيعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، عَنْ جُنْدَبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ مَا ائْتَلَفَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ فَإِذَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فَقُومُوا عَنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْد اللَّهِ سَمِعَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ سَلَّامًا
verses.translit: hadaathanaa iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alraahmani bnu mahdiyinn, 'an salaaami bni aabiy mutiy'in, 'an aabiy 'imraana aljawniyii, 'an jundabi bni 'abdi allaahi, qaala qaala rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aqra'uwa alqurana maa aitalafat quluwbukum faiidhaa akhtalaftum faquwmuwa 'anhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abd allaahi sami'a 'abdu alraahmani salaaamana
verses.translation: Narrated Jundab bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Recite (and study) the Qur'an as long as you are in agreement as to its interpretation and meanings, but when you have differences regarding its interpretation and meanings, then you should stop reciting it (for the time being.) (See Hadith No 581, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ، عَنْ جُنْدَبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ مَا ائْتَلَفَتْ عَلَيْهِ قُلُوبُكُمْ، فَإِذَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فَقُومُوا عَنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ هَارُونَ الأَعْوَرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ، عَنْ جُنْدَبٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alssamadi, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa aabuw 'imraana aljawniyyu, 'an jundabi bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aqra'uwa alqurana maa aitalafat 'alayhi quluwbukum, faiidhaa akhtalaftum faquwmuwa 'anhu ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala yaziydu bnu haaruwna 'an haaruwna alaa'wari, haddathanaa aabuw 'imraana, 'an jundabin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jundab bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Recite (and study) the Qur'an as long as your hearts are in agreement as to its meanings, but if you have differences as regards its meaning, stop reading it then
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا حُضِرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَ وَفِي الْبَيْتِ رِجَالٌ فِيهِمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ـ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلُمَّ أَكْتُبْ لَكُمْ كِتَابًا لَنْ تَضِلُّوا بَعْدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَلَبَهُ الْوَجَعُ وَعِنْدَكُمُ الْقُرْآنُ، فَحَسْبُنَا كِتَابُ اللَّهِ‏.‏ وَاخْتَلَفَ أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ وَاخْتَصَمُوا، فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ قَرِّبُوا يَكْتُبْ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كِتَابًا لَنْ تَضِلُّوا بَعْدَهُ‏.‏ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ مَا قَالَ عُمَرُ، فَلَمَّا أَكْثَرُوا اللَّغَطَ وَالاِخْتِلاَفَ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قُومُوا عَنِّي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَكَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ إِنَّ الرَّزِيَّةَ كُلَّ الرَّزِيَّةِ مَا حَالَ بَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ لَهُمْ ذَلِكَ الْكِتَابَ مِنِ اخْتِلاَفِهِمْ وَلَغَطِهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala lammaa hudira alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala wafiy albayti rijaalun fiyhim 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi qaala ‏"‏ halumma aaktub lakum kitaabana lan tadilluwa ba'dahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'umaru iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ghalabahu alwaja'u wa'indakumu alquranu, fahasbunaa kitaabu alllahi‏.‏ waakhtalafa aahlu albayti waakhtasamuwa, faminhum man yaquwlu qarribuwa yaktub lakum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kitaabana lan tadilluwa ba'dahu‏.‏ waminhum man yaquwlu maa qaala 'umaru, falammaa aaktharuwa alllaghata waalaikhtilaafa 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ quwmuwa 'anniy ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'ubaydu alllahi fakaana abnu 'abbaasin yaquwlu iinna alrraziyyaaa kulla alrraziyyaai maa haala bayna rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wabayna aan yaktuba lahum dhalika alkitaaba mini akhtilaafihim walaghatihim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the time of the death of the Prophet (ﷺ) approached while there were some men in the house, and among them was `Umar bin Al-Khatttab, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Come near let me write for you a writing after which you will never go astray." `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) is seriously ill, and you have the Qur'an, so Allah's Book is sufficient for us." The people in the house differed and disputed. Some of them said, "Come near so that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) may write for you a writing after which you will not go astray," while some of them said what `Umar said. When they made much noise and differed greatly before the Prophet, he said to them, "Go away and leave me." Ibn `Abbas used to say, "It was a great disaster that their difference and noise prevented Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from writing that writing for them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ عَطَاءٌ قَالَ جَابِرٌ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَقَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، فِي أُنَاسٍ مَعَهُ قَالَ أَهْلَلْنَا أَصْحَابَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْحَجِّ خَالِصًا لَيْسَ مَعَهُ عُمْرَةٌ ـ قَالَ عَطَاءٌ قَالَ جَابِرٌ ـ فَقَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صُبْحَ رَابِعَةٍ مَضَتْ مِنْ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا أَمَرَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نَحِلَّ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَحِلُّوا وَأَصِيبُوا مِنَ النِّسَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَطَاءٌ قَالَ جَابِرٌ وَلَمْ يَعْزِمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَكِنْ أَحَلَّهُنَّ لَهُمْ فَبَلَغَهُ أَنَّا نَقُولُ لَمَّا لَمْ يَكُنْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ عَرَفَةَ إِلاَّ خَمْسٌ أَمَرَنَا أَنْ نَحِلَّ إِلَى نِسَائِنَا فَنَأْتِي عَرَفَةَ تَقْطُرُ مَذَاكِيرُنَا الْمَذْىَ قَالَ وَيَقُولُ جَابِرٌ بِيَدِهِ هَكَذَا وَحَرَّكَهَا فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ قَدْ عَلِمْتُمْ أَنِّي أَتْقَاكُمْ لِلَّهِ وَأَصْدَقُكُمْ وَأَبَرُّكُمْ وَلَوْلاَ هَدْيِي لَحَلَلْتُ كَمَا تَحِلُّونَ فَحِلُّوا فَلَوِ اسْتَقْبَلْتُ مِنْ أَمْرِي مَا اسْتَدْبَرْتُ مَا أَهْدَيْتُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَحَلَلْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa almakkiyyu bnu iibraahiyma, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala 'ataa'un qaala jaabirun‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi waqaala muhammadu bnu bakrin haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, fiy aunaasin ma'ahu qaala aahlalnaa aashaaba rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alhajji khaalisana laysa ma'ahu 'umraaun qaala 'ataa'un qaala jaabirun faqadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm subha raabi'aain madat min dhiy alhijjaai falammaa qadimnaa aamaranaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan nahilla waqaala ‏"‏ aahilluwa waaasiybuwa mina alnnisaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'ataa'un qaala jaabirun walam ya'zim 'alayhim walakin aahallahunna lahum fabalaghahu aannaa naquwlu lammaa lam yakun baynanaa wabayna 'arafaaa iilaaa khamsun aamaranaa aan nahilla iilaa nisaaiinaa fanaatiy 'arafaaa taqturu madhaakiyrunaa almadhaa qaala wayaquwlu jaabirun biyadihi hakadhaa waharrakahaa faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ qad 'alimtum aanniy aatqaakum lillahi waaasdaqukum waaabarrukum walawlaa hadyiy lahalaltu kamaa tahilluwna fahilluwa falawi astaqbaltu min aamriy maa astadbartu maa aahdaytu ‏"‏‏.‏ fahalalnaa wasami'naa waaata'naa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ata:I heard Jabir bin `Abdullah in a gathering saying, "We, the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assumed the state of Ihram to perform only Hajj without `Umra." Jabir added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) arrived (at Mecca) on the fourth of Dhul-Hijja. And when we arrived (in Mecca) the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to finish the state of Ihram, saying, "Finish your Ihram and go to your wives (for sexual relation)." Jabir added, "The Prophet did not oblige us (to go to our wives) but he only made that legal for us. Then he heard that we were saying, "When there remains only five days between us and the Day of `Arafat he orders us to finish our Ihram by sleeping with our wives in which case we will proceed to `Arafat with our male organs dribbling with semen?' (Jabir pointed out with his hand illustrating what he was saying). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and said, 'You (People) know that I am the most Allah-fearing, the most truthful and the best doer of good deeds (pious) from among you. If I had not brought the Hadi with me, I would have finished my Ihram as you will do, so finish your Ihram. If I had formerly known what I came to know lately, I would not have brought the Hadi with me.' So we finished our Ihram and listened to the Prophet (ﷺ) and obeyed him." (See Hadith No. 713, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيُّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ صَلُّوا قَبْلَ صَلاَةِ الْمَغْرِبِ ـ قَالَ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ ـ لِمَنْ شَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏ كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَهَا النَّاسُ سُنَّةً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'ani alhusayni, 'ani abni buraydaaa, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi almuzaniyyu, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ salluwa qabla salaaai almaghribi qaala fiy althhaalithaai liman shaa'a ‏"‏‏.‏ karaahiyaaa aan yattakhidhahaa alnnaasu sunnaaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah Al Muzam:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Perform (an optional) prayer before Maghrib prayer." (He repeated it thrice) and the third time he said, "Whoever wants to offer it can do so," lest the people should take it as a Sunna (tradition). (See Hadith No. 277, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الأُوَيْسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ، وَابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَعَلْقَمَةُ بْنُ وَقَّاصٍ، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ حِينَ قَالَ لَهَا أَهْلُ الإِفْكِ قَالَتْ وَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ وَأُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ حِينَ اسْتَلْبَثَ الْوَحْىُ يَسْأَلُهُمَا، وَهْوَ يَسْتَشِيرُهُمَا فِي فِرَاقِ أَهْلِهِ، فَأَمَّا أُسَامَةُ فَأَشَارَ بِالَّذِي يَعْلَمُ مِنْ بَرَاءَةِ أَهْلِهِ، وَأَمَّا عَلِيٌّ فَقَالَ لَمْ يُضَيِّقِ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ، وَالنِّسَاءُ سِوَاهَا كَثِيرٌ، وَسَلِ الْجَارِيَةَ تَصْدُقْكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ رَأَيْتِ مِنْ شَىْءٍ يَرِيبُكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ مَا رَأَيْتُ أَمْرًا أَكْثَرَ مِنْ أَنَّهَا جَارِيَةٌ حَدِيثَةُ السِّنِّ تَنَامُ عَنْ عَجِينِ أَهْلِهَا فَتَأْتِي الدَّاجِنُ فَتَأْكُلُهُ‏.‏ فَقَامَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مَعْشَرَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ مَنْ يَعْذِرُنِي مِنْ رَجُلٍ بَلَغَنِي أَذَاهُ فِي أَهْلِي، وَاللَّهِ مَا عَلِمْتُ عَلَى أَهْلِي إِلاَّ خَيْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بَرَاءَةَ عَائِشَةَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alauwaysiyyu, haddathanaa iibraahiymu, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy 'urwaau, waabnu almusayyabi, wa'alqamaau bnu waqqaasin, wa'ubaydu alllahi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha hiyna qaala lahaa aahlu aliifki qaalat wada'aa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin waausaamaaa bna zaydin hiyna astalbatha alwahau yasaaluhumaa, wahwa yastashiyruhumaa fiy firaaqi aahlihi, faaammaa ausaamaau faaashaara bialladhiy ya'lamu min baraa'aai aahlihi, waaammaa 'aliyyun faqaala lam yudayyiqi alllahu 'alayka, waalnnisaa'u siwaahaa kathiyrun, wasali aljaariyaaa tasduqka‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ hal raaayti min shaa'in yariybuki ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat maa raaaytu aamrana aakthara min aannahaa jaariyaaun hadiythaau alssinni tanaamu 'an 'ajiyni aahlihaa fataatiy alddaajinu fataakuluhu‏.‏ faqaama 'alaa alminbari faqaala ‏"‏ yaa ma'shara almuslimiyna man ya'dhiruniy min rajulin balaghaniy aadhaahu fiy aahliy, waalllahi maa 'alimtu 'alaa aahliy iilaaa khayrana ‏"‏‏.‏ fadhakara baraa'aaa 'aaiishaaa‏.‏ waqaala aabuw ausaamaaa 'an hishaamin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:After the slanderers had given a forged statement against her, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called `Ali bin Abi Talib and Usama bin Zaid when the Divine Inspiration was delayed. He wanted to ask them and consult them about the question of divorcing me. Usama gave his evidence that was based on what he knew about my innocence, but `Ali said, "Allah has not put restrictions on you and there are many women other than her. Furthermore you may ask the slave girl who will tell you the truth." So the Prophet (ﷺ) asked Barira (my salve girl), "Have you seen anything that may arouse your suspicion?" She replied, "I have not seen anything more than that she is a little girl who sleeps, leaving the dough of her family (unguarded) that the domestic goats come and eat it." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) stood on the pulpit and said, "O Muslims! Who will help me against the man who has harmed me by slandering my wife? By Allah, I know nothing about my family except good." The narrator added: Then the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned the innocence of `Aisha. (See Hadith No. 274, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 96 — Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي زَكَرِيَّاءَ الْغَسَّانِيُّ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَطَبَ النَّاسَ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا تُشِيرُونَ عَلَىَّ فِي قَوْمٍ يَسُبُّونَ أَهْلِي مَا عَلِمْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ سُوءٍ قَطُّ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَعَنْ عُرْوَةَ قَالَ لَمَّا أُخْبِرَتْ عَا��ِشَةُ بِالأَمْرِ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَنْطَلِقَ إِلَى أَهْلِي‏.‏ فَأَذِنَ لَهَا وَأَرْسَلَ مَعَهَا الْغُلاَمَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ سُبْحَانَكَ مَا يَكُونُ لَنَا أَنْ نَتَكَلَّمَ بِهَذَا، سُبْحَانَكَ هَذَا بُهْتَانٌ عَظِيمٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aabiy zakariyyaa'a alghassaaniyyu, 'an hishaamin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khataba alnnaasa fahamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi waqaala ‏ "‏ maa tushiyruwna 'alaaaa fiy qawmin yasubbuwna aahliy maa 'alimtu 'alayhim min suw'in qattu ‏"‏‏.‏ wa'an 'urwaaa qaala lammaa aukhbirat 'aa��ishaau bialaamri qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi aataadhanu liy aan aantaliqa iilaa aahliy‏.‏ faaadhina lahaa waaarsala ma'ahaa alghulaama‏.‏ waqaala rajulun mina alaansaari subhaanaka maa yakuwnu lanaa aan natakallama bihadhaa, subhaanaka hadhaa buhtaanun 'aziymun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed the people, and after praising and glorifying Allah, he said, "What do you suggest me regarding those people who are abusing my wife? I have never known anything bad about her." The sub-narrator, `Urwa, said: When `Aisha was told of the slander, she said, "O Allah's Apostle! Will you allow me to go to my parents' home?" He allowed her and sent a slave along with her. An Ansari man said, "Subhanaka! It is not right for us to speak about this. Subhanaka! This is a great lie
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صَيْفِيٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْبَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ مُعَاذًا إِلَى الْيَمَنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu iishaaqa, 'an yahyaa bni 'abdi alllahi bni sayfiyyin, 'an aabiy ma'badin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'atha mu'aadhana iilaa alyamani‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas (ra):The Prophet (ﷺ) sent Mu'adh to Yemen
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ صَيْفِيٍّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا مَعْبَدٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ لَمَّا بَعَثَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُعَاذًا نَحْوَ الْيَمَنِ قَالَ لَهُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّكَ تَقْدَمُ عَلَى قَوْمٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ فَلْيَكُنْ أَوَّلَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى أَنْ يُوَحِّدُوا اللَّهَ تَعَالَى فَإِذَا عَرَفُوا ذَلِكَ فَأَخْبِرْهُمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ فَرَضَ عَلَيْهِمْ خَمْسَ صَلَوَاتٍ فِي يَوْمِهِمْ وَلَيْلَتِهِمْ، فَإِذَا صَلُّوا فَأَخْبِرْهُمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ افْتَرَضَ عَلَيْهِمْ زَكَاةً فِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ تُؤْخَذُ مِنْ غَنِيِّهِمْ فَتُرَدُّ عَلَى فَقِيرِهِمْ، فَإِذَا أَقَرُّوا بِذَلِكَ فَخُذْ مِنْهُمْ وَتَوَقَّ كَرَائِمَ أَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy alaaswadi, haddathanaa alfadlu bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu aumayyaaa, 'an yahyaa bni 'abdi alllahi bni muhammadi bni sayfiyyin, aannahu sami'a aabaa ma'badin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin yaquwlu sami'tu abna 'abbaasin, yaquwlu lammaa ba'atha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm mu'aadhana nahwa alyamani qaala lahu ‏ "‏ iinnaka taqdamu 'alaa qawmin min aahli alkitaabi falyakun aawwala maa tad'uwhum iilaa aan yuwahhiduwa alllaha ta'aalaa faiidhaa 'arafuwa dhalika faaakhbirhum aanna alllaha farada 'alayhim khamsa salawaatin fiy yawmihim walaylatihim, faiidhaa salluwa faaakhbirhum aanna alllaha aftarada 'alayhim zakaaaan fiy aamwaalihim tuukhadhu min ghaniyyihim faturaddu 'alaa faqiyrihim, faiidhaa aaqarruwa bidhalika fakhudh minhum watawaqqa karaaiima aamwaali alnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) sent Mu`adh to Yemen, he said to him, "You are going to a nation from the people of the Scripture, so let the first thing to which you will invite them, be the Tauhid of Allah. If they learn that, tell them that Allah has enjoined on them, five prayers to be offered in one day and one night. And if they pray, tell them that Allah has enjoined on them Zakat of their properties and it is to be taken from the rich among them and given to the poor. And if they agree to that, then take from them Zakat but avoid the best property of the people
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، وَالأَشْعَثِ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، سَمِعَا الأَسْوَدَ بْنَ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ أَتَدْرِي مَا حَقُّ اللَّهِ عَلَى الْعِبَادِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ يَعْبُدُوهُ وَلاَ يُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا، أَتَدْرِي مَا حَقُّهُمْ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ لاَ يُعَذِّبَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy hasiynin, waalaash'athi bni sulaymin, sami'aa alaaswada bna hilaalin, 'an mu'aadhi bni jabalin, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaa mu'aadhu aatadriy maa haqqu alllahi 'alaa al'ibaadi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aan ya'buduwhu walaa yushrikuwa bihi shayiana, aatadriy maa haqquhum 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aan laa yu'adhhibahum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mu`adh bin Jabal:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Mu`adh! Do you know what Allah's Right upon His slaves is?" I said, "Allah and His Apostle know best." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To worship Him (Allah) Alone and to join none in worship with Him (Allah). Do you know what their right upon Him is?" I replied, "Allah and His Apostle know best." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Not to punish them (if they do so)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَمِعَ رَجُلاً، يَقْرَأُ ‏{‏قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ‏}‏ يُرَدِّدُهَا، فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ جَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ لَهُ ذَلِكَ، وَكَأَنَّ الرَّجُلَ يَتَقَالُّهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ إِنَّهَا لَتَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ زَادَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَخِي، قَتَادَةُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, haddathaniy maalikun, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy sa'sa'aaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna rajulaan, sami'a rajulaan, yaqraau ‏{‏qul huwa alllahu aahadun‏}‏ yuraddiduhaa, falammaa aasbaha jaa'a iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara lahu dhalika, wakaaanna alrrajula yataqaalluhaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi iinnahaa lata'dilu thulutha alqurani ‏"‏‏.‏ zaada iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin 'an maalikin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, aakhbaraniy aakhiy, qataadaau bnu alnnu'maani 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:A man heard another man reciting (in the prayers): 'Say (O Muhammad): "He is Allah, the One." (112.1) And he recited it repeatedly. When it was morning, he went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him about that as if he considered that the recitation of that Sura by itself was not enough. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my life is, it is equal to one-third of the Qur'an
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا الرِّجَالِ، مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ وَكَانَتْ فِي حَجْرِ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ رَجُلاً عَلَى سَرِيَّةٍ، وَكَانَ يَقْرَأُ لأَصْحَابِهِ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَيَخْتِمُ بِ ـ ‏{‏قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ‏}‏ فَلَمَّا رَجَعُوا ذَكَرُوا ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ سَلُوهُ لأَىِّ شَىْءٍ يَصْنَعُ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَسَأَلُوهُ فَقَالَ لأَنَّهَا صِفَةُ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَأَنَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ بِهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَخْبِرُوهُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aahmadu bnu saalihin, hadaathanaa abnu wahbin, hadaathanaa 'amrunw, 'ani abni aabiy hilaalin, aanaa aabaa alriijaali, muhamaada bna 'abdi alraahmani hadaathahu 'an aumiihi, 'amraaa binti 'abdi alraahmani wakaanat fiy hajri 'aaiishaaa zawji alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an 'aaiishaaa aanaa alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'atha rajulaan 'alaa sariyaaain, wakaana yaqraau laashaabihi fiy salaatihi fayakhtimu bi ‏{‏qul huwa allaahu aahadun‏}‏ falamaaa raja'uwa dhakaruwa dhalika lilnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ saluwhu laaaii shaa'in yasna'u dhalika ‏"‏‏.‏ fasaaaluwhu faqaala laanaahaa sifaau alraahmani, waaanaa auhibuu aan aaqraaa bihaa‏.‏ faqaala alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aakhbiruwhu aanaa allaaha yuhibuuhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent (an army unit) under the command of a man who used to lead his companions in the prayers and would finish his recitation with (the Sura 112): 'Say (O Muhammad): "He is Allah, the One." ' (112.1) When they returned (from the battle), they mentioned that to the Prophet. He said (to them), "Ask him why he does so." They asked him and he said, "I do so because it mentions the qualities of the Beneficent and I love to recite it (in my prayer)." The Prophet; said (to them), "Tell him that Allah loves him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، وَأَبِي، ظَبْيَانَ عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَمُ النَّاسَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an zaydi bni wahbin, waaabiy, zabyaana 'an jariyri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yarhamu alllahu man laa yarhamu alnnaasa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jarir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah will not be merciful to those who are not merciful to mankind
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ جَاءَهُ رَسُولُ إِحْدَى بَنَاتِهِ يَدْعُوهُ إِلَى ابْنِهَا فِي الْمَوْتِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ارْجِعْ فَأَخْبِرْهَا أَنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى، فَمُرْهَا فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَعَادَتِ الرَّسُولَ أَنَّهَا أَقْسَمَتْ لَتَأْتِيَنَّهَا، فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَامَ مَعَهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ وَمُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ، فَدُفِعَ الصَّبِيُّ إِلَيْهِ وَنَفْسُهُ تَقَعْقَعُ كَأَنَّهَا فِي شَنٍّ فَفَاضَتْ عَيْنَاهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ سَعْدٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَذِهِ رَحْمَةٌ جَعَلَهَا اللَّهُ فِي قُلُوبِ عِبَادِهِ، وَإِنَّمَا يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الرُّحَمَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an 'aasimin alaahwali, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana alnnahdiyyi, 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin, qaala kunnaa 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh jaa'ahu rasuwlu iihdaa banaatihi yad'uwhu iilaa abnihaa fiy almawti faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ arji' faaakhbirhaa aanna lillahi maa aakhadha, walahu maa aa'taa, wakullu shaa'in 'indahu biaajalin musammana, famurhaa faltasbir waltahtasib ‏"‏‏.‏ faaa'aadati alrrasuwla aannahaa aaqsamat lataatiyannahaa, faqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaama ma'ahu sa'du bnu 'ubaadaaa wamu'aadhu bnu jabalin, fadufi'a alssabiyyu iilayhi wanafsuhu taqa'qa'u kaaannahaa fiy shannin fafaadat 'aynaahu faqaala lahu sa'dun yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ hadhihi rahmaaun ja'alahaa alllahu fiy quluwbi 'ibaadihi, waiinnamaa yarhamu alllahu min 'ibaadihi alrruhamaa'a ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) when suddenly there came to him a messenger from one of his daughters who was asking him to come and see her son who was dying. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to the messenger), "Go back and tell her that whatever Allah takes is His, and whatever He gives is His, and everything with Him has a limited fixed term (in this world). So order her to be patient and hope for Allah's reward." But she sent the messenger to the Prophet (ﷺ) again, swearing that he should come to her. So the Prophet got up, and so did Sa`d bin 'Ubada and Mu`adh bin Jabal (and went to her). When the child was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) his breath was disturbed in his chest as if it were in a water skin. On that the eyes of the Prophet (ﷺ) became flooded with tears, whereupon Sa`d said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is this?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is mercy which Allah has put in the heart of His slaves, and Allah bestows His mercy only on those of His slaves who are merciful (to others)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا أَحَدٌ أَصْبَرُ عَلَى أَذًى سَمِعَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ، يَدَّعُونَ لَهُ الْوَلَدَ، ثُمَّ يُعَافِيهِمْ وَيَرْزُقُهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, 'an aabiy hamzaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'an aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani alssulamiyyi, 'an aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa aahadun aasbaru 'alaa aadhana sami'ahu mina alllahi, yadda'uwna lahu alwalada, thumma yu'aafiyhim wayarzuquhum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None is more patient than Allah against the harmful and annoying words He hears (from the people): They ascribe children to Him, yet He bestows upon them health and provision
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَفَاتِيحُ الْغَيْبِ خَمْسٌ لاَ يَعْلَمُهَا إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، لاَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَغِيضُ الأَرْحَامُ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَلاَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي غَدٍ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَلاَ يَعْلَمُ مَتَى يَأْتِي الْمَطَرُ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَلاَ تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ بِأَىِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَلاَ يَعْلَمُ مَتَى تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu diynaarin, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mafaatiyhu alghaybi khamsun laa ya'lamuhaa iilaaa alllahu, laa ya'lamu maa taghiydu alaarhaamu iilaaa alllahu, walaa ya'lamu maa fiy ghadin iilaaa alllahu, walaa ya'lamu mataa yaatiy almataru aahadun iilaaa alllahu, walaa tadriy nafsun biaaaai aardin tamuwtu iilaaa alllahu, walaa ya'lamu mataa taquwmu alssaa'aau iilaaa alllahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The keys of the unseen are five and none knows them but Allah: (1) None knows (the sex) what is in the womb, but Allah: (2) None knows what will happen tomorrow, but Allah; (3) None knows when it will rain, but Allah; (4) None knows where he will die, but Allah (knows that); (5) and none knows when the Hour will be established, but Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ مَنْ حَدَّثَكَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى رَبَّهُ فَقَدْ كَذَبَ وَهْوَ يَقُولُ ‏{‏لاَ تُدْرِكُهُ الأَبْصَارُ‏}‏ وَمَنْ حَدَّثَكَ أَنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ فَقَدْ كَذَبَ، وَهْوَ يَقُولُ لاَ يَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an iismaa'iyla, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat man haddathaka aanna muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa rabbahu faqad kadhaba wahwa yaquwlu ‏{‏laa tudrikuhu alaabsaaru‏}‏ waman haddathaka aannahu ya'lamu alghayba faqad kadhaba, wahwa yaquwlu laa ya'lamu alghayba iilaaa alllahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Masruq:`Aisha said, "If anyone tells you that Muhammad has seen his Lord, he is a liar, for Allah says: 'No vision can grasp Him.' (6.103) And if anyone tells you that Muhammad has seen the Unseen, he is a liar, for Allah says: "None has the knowledge of the Unseen but Allah
