verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ حَسَدَ إِلاَّ فِي اثْنَتَيْنِ رَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ الْقُرْآنَ فَهْوَ يَتْلُوهُ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَآنَاءَ النَّهَارِ، وَرَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً فَهْوَ يُنْفِقُهُ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَآنَاءَ النَّهَارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ مِرَارًا لَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ يَذْكُرُ الْخَبَرَ وَهْوَ مِنْ صَحِيحِ حَدِيثِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala alzzuhriyyu 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa hasada iilaaa fiy athnatayni rajulun ataahu alllahu alqurana fahwa yatluwhu anaa'a alllayli waanaa'a alnnahaari, warajulun ataahu alllahu maalaan fahwa yunfiquhu anaa'a alllayli waanaa'a alnnahaari ‏"‏‏.‏ sami'tu sufyaana miraarana lam aasma'hu yadhkuru alkhabara wahwa min sahiyhi hadiythihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salim's father:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Not to wish to be the like of except the like of two (persons): a man whom Allah has given the knowledge of the Qur'an and he recites it during the hours of the night and the hours of the day; and a man whom Allah has given wealth and he spends it (in Allah's Cause) during the hours of the night and during the hours of the day
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الرَّقِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيُّ، وَزِيَادُ بْنُ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ حَيَّةَ، عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ حَيَّةَ، قَالَ الْمُغِيرَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا نَبِيُّنَا، صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ رِسَالَةِ، رَبِّنَا ‏ "‏ أَنَّهُ مَنْ قُتِلَ مِنَّا صَارَ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alfadlu bnu ya'quwba, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu ja'farin alrraqqiyyu, haddathanaa almu'tamiru bnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'ubaydi alllahi althhaqafiyyu, haddathanaa bakru bnu 'abdi alllahi almuzaniyyu, waziyaadu bnu jubayri bni hayyaaa, 'an jubayri bni hayyaaa, qaala almughiyraau aakhbaranaa nabiyyunaa, sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an risaalaai, rabbinaa ‏ "‏ aannahu man qutila minnaa saara iilaa aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Mughira:Our Prophet has informed us our Lord's Message that whoever of us is martyred, will go to Paradise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ مَنْ حَدَّثَكَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم كَتَمَ شَيْئًا وَقَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ مَنْ حَدَّثَكَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَتَمَ شَيْئًا مِنَ الْوَحْىِ، فَلاَ تُصَدِّقْهُ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى يَقُولُ ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ وَإِنْ لَمْ تَفْعَلْ فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an iismaa'iyla, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat man haddathaka aanna muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm katama shayiana waqaala muhammadun haddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin al'aqadiyyu haddathanaa shu'baau 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin 'ani alshha'biyyi 'an masruwqin 'an 'aaiishaaa qaalat man haddathaka aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm katama shayiana mina alwahai, falaa tusaddiqhu, iinna alllaha ta'aalaa yaquwlu ‏{‏yaa aayyuhaa alrrasuwlu balligh maa aunzila iilayka min rabbika waiin lam taf'al famaa ballaghta risaalatahu‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Whoever tells you that the Prophet (ﷺ) concealed something of the Divine Inspiration, do not believe him, for Allah said: 'O Apostle Muhammad! Proclaim (the Message) which has been sent down to you from your Lord, and if you do it not, then you have not conveyed His Message
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُرَحْبِيلَ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَىُّ الذَّنْبِ أَكْبَرُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تَدْعُوَ لِلَّهِ نِدًّا، وَهْوَ خَلَقَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ أَىّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ أَنْ تَقْتُلَ وَلَدَكَ، أَنْ يَطْعَمَ مَعَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ أَىّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تُزَانِيَ حَلِيلَةَ جَارِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَصْدِيقَهَا ‏{‏وَالَّذِينَ لاَ يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ وَلاَ يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ وَلاَ يَزْنُونَ وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'amriw bni shurahbiyla, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi qaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi aaaau aldhhanbi aakbaru 'inda alllahi qaala ‏"‏ aan tad'uwa lillahi niddana, wahwa khalaqaka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala thumma aaaa qaala ‏"‏ thumma aan taqtula waladaka, aan yat'ama ma'aka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala thumma aaaa qaala ‏"‏ aan tuzaaniya haliylaaa jaarika ‏"‏‏.‏ faaanzala alllahu tasdiyqahaa ‏{‏waalladhiyna laa yad'uwna ma'a alllahi iilahana akhara walaa yaqtuluwna alnnafsa allatiy harrama alllahu iilaaa bialhaqqi walaa yaznuwna waman yaf'al dhalika‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Which sin is the biggest in Allah's Sight?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To set up rivals unto Allah though He Alone created you." That man said, "What is next?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To kill your son lest he should share your food with you.'' The man said, "What is next?" The Prophet said, "To commit illegal sexual intercourse with the wife of your neighbor." Then Allah revealed in confirmation of that: "And those who invoke not with Allah any other god, nor kill such life as Allah has made sacred except for just cause, nor commit illegal sexual intercourse and whoever does this shall receive the punishment
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا بَقَاؤُكُمْ فِيمَنْ سَلَفَ مِنَ الأُمَمِ كَمَا بَيْنَ صَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ إِلَى غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ، أُوتِيَ أَهْلُ التَّوْرَاةِ التَّوْرَاةَ فَعَمِلُوا بِهَا حَتَّى انْتَصَفَ النَّهَارُ، ثُمَّ عَجَزُوا فَأُعْطُوا قِيرَاطًا قِيرَاطًا، ثُمَّ أُوتِيَ أَهْلُ الإِنْجِيلِ الإِنْجِيلَ فَعَمِلُوا بِهِ حَتَّى صُلِّيَتِ الْعَصْرُ، ثُمَّ عَجَزُوا فَأُعْطُوا قِيرَاطًا قِيرَاطًا، ثُمَّ أُوتِيتُمُ الْقُرْآنَ فَعَمِلْتُمْ بِهِ حَتَّى غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ، فَأُعْطِيتُمْ قِيرَاطَيْنِ قِيرَاطَيْنِ، فَقَالَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ هَؤُلاَءِ أَقَلُّ مِنَّا عَمَلاً وَأَكْثَرُ أَجْرًا‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ هَلْ ظَلَمْتُكُمْ مِنْ حَقِّكُمْ شَيْئًا قَالُوا لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَهْوَ فَضْلِي أُوتِيهِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy saalimun, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa baqaauukum fiyman salafa mina alaumami kamaa bayna salaaai al'asri iilaa ghuruwbi alshhamsi, auwtiya aahlu alttawraaai alttawraaaa fa'amiluwa bihaa hattaa antasafa alnnahaaru, thumma 'ajazuwa faau'tuwa qiyraatana qiyraatana, thumma auwtiya aahlu aliinjiyli aliinjiyla fa'amiluwa bihi hattaa sulliyati al'asru, thumma 'ajazuwa faau'tuwa qiyraatana qiyraatana, thumma auwtiytumu alqurana fa'amiltum bihi hattaa gharabati alshhamsu, faau'tiytum qiyraatayni qiyraatayni, faqaala aahlu alkitaabi hauulaa'i aaqallu minnaa 'amalaan waaaktharu aajrana‏.‏ qaala alllahu hal zalamtukum min haqqikum shayiana qaaluwa laa‏.‏ qaala fahwa fadliy auwtiyhi man aashaa'u ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Your stay (in this world) in comparison to the stay of the nations preceding you, is like the period between `Asr prayer and the sun set (in comparison to a whole day). The people of the Torah were given the Torah and they acted on it till midday and then they were unable to carry on. And they were given (a reward equal to) one Qirat each. Then the people of the Gospel were given the Gospel and they acted on it till `Asr Prayer and then they were unable to carry on, so they were given la reward equal to) one Qirat each. Then you were given the Qur'an and you acted on it till sunset, therefore you were given (a reward equal to) two Qirats each. On that, the people of the Scriptures said, 'These people (Muslims) did less work than we but they took a bigger reward.' Allah said (to them). 'Have I done any oppression to you as regards your rights?' They said, "No." Then Allah said, 'That is My Blessing which I grant to whomsoever I will
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ،‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبَّادُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الأَسَدِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ الْعَوَّامِ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ الْعَيْزَارِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الأَعْمَالِ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الصَّلاَةُ لِوَقْتِهَا، وَبِرُّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ، ثُمَّ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy sulaymaanu, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alwaliydi, ‏.‏ wahaddathaniy 'abbaadu bnu ya'quwba alaasadiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abbaadu bnu al'awwaami, 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'ani alwaliydi bni al'ayzaari, 'an aabiy 'amrinw alshhaybaaniyyi, 'ani abni mas'uwdin rda allh 'nh aanna rajulaan, saaala alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aaaau alaa'maali aafdalu qaala ‏ "‏ alssalaaau liwaqtihaa, wabirru alwaalidayni, thumma aljihaadu fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:A man asked the Prophet (ﷺ) "What deeds are the best?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "(1) To perform the (daily compulsory) prayers at their (early) stated fixed times, (2) to be good and dutiful to one's own parents, (3) and to participate in Jihad in Allah's Cause
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ تَغْلِبَ، قَالَ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَالٌ فَأَعْطَى قَوْمًا وَمَنَعَ آخَرِينَ فَبَلَغَهُ أَنَّهُمْ عَتَبُوا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي أُعْطِي الرَّجُلَ وَأَدَعُ الرَّجُلَ، وَالَّذِي أَدَعُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنَ الَّذِي أُعْطِي، أُعْطِي أَقْوَامًا لِمَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مِنَ الْجَزَعِ وَالْهَلَعِ، وَأَكِلُ أَقْوَامًا إِلَى مَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مِنَ الْغِنَى وَالْخَيْرِ مِنْهُمْ عَمْرُو بْنُ تَغْلِبَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَمْرٌو مَا أُحِبُّ أَنَّ لِي بِكَلِمَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حُمْرَ النَّعَمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, 'ani alhasani, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu taghliba, qaala aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm maalun faaa'taa qawmana wamana'a akhariyna fabalaghahu aannahum 'atabuwa faqaala ‏ "‏ iinniy au'tiy alrrajula waaada'u alrrajula, waalladhiy aada'u aahabbu iilaaaa mina alladhiy au'tiy, au'tiy aaqwaamana limaa fiy quluwbihim mina aljaza'i waalhala'i, waaakilu aaqwaamana iilaa maa ja'ala alllahu fiy quluwbihim mina alghinaa waalkhayri minhum 'amruw bnu taghliba ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala 'amrunw maa auhibbu aanna liy bikalimaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm humra alnna'ami‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Hasan:`Amr bin Taghlib said, "Some property was given to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he gave it to some people and withheld it from some others. Then he came to know that they (the latter) were dissatisfied. So the Prophet said, 'I give to one man and leave (do not give) another, and the one to whom I do not give is dearer to me than the one to whom I give. I give to some people because of the impatience and discontent present in their hearts, and leave other people because of the content and goodness Allah has bestowed on them, and one of them is `Amr bin Taghlib." `Amr bin Taghlib said, "The sentence which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said in my favor is dearer to me than the possession of nice red camels
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ، سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ الْهَرَوِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ رَبِّهِ، قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا تَقَرَّبَ الْعَبْدُ إِلَىَّ شِبْرًا تَقَرَّبْتُ إِلَيْهِ ذِرَاعًا، وَإِذَا تَقَرَّبَ مِنِّي ذِرَاعًا تَقَرَّبْتُ مِنْهُ بَاعًا، وَإِذَا أَتَانِي مَشْيًا أَتَيْتُهُ هَرْوَلَةً ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahiymi, haddathanaa aabuw zaydin, sa'iydu bnu alrrabiy'i alharawiyyu haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yarwiyhi 'an rabbihi, qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa taqarraba al'abdu iilaaaa shibrana taqarrabtu iilayhi dhiraa'ana, waiidhaa taqarraba minniy dhiraa'ana taqarrabtu minhu baa'ana, waiidhaa aataaniy mashyana aataytuhu harwalaaan ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "My Lord says, 'If My slave comes nearer to me for a span, I go nearer to him for a cubit; and if he comes nearer to Me for a cubit, I go nearer to him for the span of outstretched arms; and if he comes to Me walking, I go to him running
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنِ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ ـ رُبَّمَا ذَكَرَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا تَقَرَّبَ الْعَبْدُ مِنِّي شِبْرًا تَقَرَّبْتُ مِنْهُ ذِرَاعًا وَإِذَا تَقَرَّبَ مِنِّي ذِرَاعًا تَقَرَّبْتُ مِنْهُ بَاعًا أَوْ بُوعًا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُعْتَمِرٌ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، ‏{‏عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ،‏}‏ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ رَبِّهِ، عَزَّ وَجَلَّ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa musadaadun, 'an yahyaa, 'ani altaaymiyii, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala rubaamaa dhakara alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa taqaraaba al'abdu miniiy shibrana taqaraabtu minhu dhiraa'ana waiidhaa taqaraaba miniiy dhiraa'ana taqaraabtu minhu baa'ana aaw buw'ana ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala mu'tamirun sami'tu aabiy, sami'tu aanasana, ‏{‏'an aabiy hurayraaa, ‏}‏ 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm yarwiyhi 'an rabiihi, 'azaa wajalaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Perhaps the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned the following (as Allah's Saying): "If My slave comes nearer to Me for a span, I go nearer to him for a cubit; and if he comes nearer to Me for a cubit; I go nearer to him for the span of outstretched arms. (See Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ رَبِّكُمْ، قَالَ ‏ "‏ لِكُلِّ عَمَلٍ كَفَّارَةٌ، وَالصَّوْمُ لِي وَأَنَا أَجْزِي بِهِ، وَلَخَلُوفُ فَمِ الصَّائِمِ أَطْيَبُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ رِيحِ الْمِسْكِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ziyaadin, qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yarwiyhi 'an rabbikum, qaala ‏ "‏ likulli 'amalin kaffaaraaun, waalssawmu liy waaanaa aajziy bihi, walakhaluwfu fami alssaaiimi aatyabu 'inda alllahi min riyhi almiski ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said that your Lord said, "Every (sinful) deed can be expiated; and the fast is for Me, so I will give the reward for it; and the smell which comes out of the mouth of a fasting person, is better in Allah's Sight than the smell of musk." (See Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ،‏.‏ وَقَالَ لِي خَلِيفَةُ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيمَا يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ رَبِّهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَنْبَغِي لِعَبْدٍ أَنْ يَقُولَ إِنَّهُ خَيْرٌ مِنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ مَتَّى ‏"‏‏.‏ وَنَسَبَهُ إِلَى أَبِيهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, ‏.‏ waqaala liy khaliyfaau haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aabiy al'aaliyaai, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiymaa yarwiyhi 'an rabbihi qaala ‏ "‏ laa yanbaghiy li'abdin aan yaquwla iinnahu khayrun min yuwnusa bni mattaa ‏"‏‏.‏ wanasabahu iilaa aabiyhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said that his Lord said: "It does not befit a slave that he should say that he is better than Jonah (Yunus) bin Matta
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي سُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ الْمُزَنِيِّ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ عَلَى نَاقَةٍ لَهُ يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْفَتْحِ، أَوْ مِنْ سُورَةِ الْفَتْحِ ـ قَالَ ـ فَرَجَّعَ فِيهَا ـ قَالَ ـ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ مُعَاوِيَةُ يَحْكِي قِرَاءَةَ ابْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْلاَ أَنْ يَجْتَمِعَ النَّاسُ عَلَيْكُمْ لَرَجَّعْتُ كَمَا رَجَّعَ ابْنُ مُغَفَّلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ يَحْكِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ لِمُعَاوِيَةَ كَيْفَ كَانَ تَرْجِيعُهُ قَالَ آ آ آ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu aabiy surayjin, aakhbaranaa shabaabaau, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni qurraaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mughaffalin almuzaniyyi, qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alfathi 'alaa naaqaain lahu yaqraau suwraaa alfathi, aaw min suwraai alfathi qaala farajja'a fiyhaa qaala thumma qaraaa mu'aawiyaau yahkiy qiraa'aaa abni mughaffalin waqaala ‏ "‏ lawlaa aan yajtami'a alnnaasu 'alaykum larajja'tu kamaa rajja'a abnu mughaffalin ‏"‏‏.‏ yahkiy alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu limu'aawiyaaa kayfa kaana tarjiy'uhu qaala a a a thalaatha marraatin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Shu`ba:Mu'awiya bin Qurra reported that `Abdullah bin Al-Maghaffal Al-Muzani said, "I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of the Conquest of Mecca, riding his she-camel and reciting Surat-al-Fath (48) or part of Surat-al-Fath. He recited it in a vibrating and pleasant voice. Then Mu'awiya recited as `Abdullah bin Mughaffal had done and said, "Were I not afraid that the people would crowd around me, I would surely recite in a vibrating pleasant voice as Ibn Mughaffal did, imitating the Prophet." I asked Muawiya, "How did he recite in that tone?" He said thrice, "A, A , A
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سُفْيَانَ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، أَنَّ هِرَقْلَ، دَعَا تَرْجُمَانَهُ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِكِتَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَرَأَهُ ‏"‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ إِلَى هِرَقْلَ، وَ‏{‏يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ تَعَالَوْا إِلَى كَلِمَةٍ سَوَاءٍ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ ‏}‏‏"‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala abnu 'abbaasin aakhbaraniy aabuw sufyaana bnu harbin, aanna hiraqla, da'aa tarjumaanahu, thumma da'aa bikitaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaraaahu ‏"‏ bismi alllahi alrrahmani alrrahiymi min muhammadin 'abdi alllahi warasuwlihi iilaa hiraqla, wa‏{‏yaa aahla alkitaabi ta'aalawa iilaa kalimaain sawaa'in baynanaa wabaynakum ‏}‏‏"‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: And Ibn 'Abbas narrated:Abu Sufyan bin Harb told me that Heraclius called for his translator and then asked for the letter of the Prophet (ﷺ), and the former read it (thus): "In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Merciful. (This letter is) from Muhammad bin 'Abdullah, to Heraclius. "...O people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians): Come to a word that is just between us and you that we worship none but Allah..." (V.3:)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ يَقْرَءُونَ التَّوْرَاةَ بِالْعِبْرَانِيَّةِ، وَيُفَسِّرُونَهَا بِالْعَرَبِيَّةِ لأَهْلِ الإِسْلاَمِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تُصَدِّقُوا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ، وَلاَ تُكَذِّبُوهُمْ وَ‏{‏قُولُوا آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ‏}‏ الآيَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara, aakhbaranaa 'aliyyu bnu almubaaraki, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala kaana aahlu alkitaabi yaqra'uwna alttawraaaa bial'ibraaniyyaai, wayufassiruwnahaa bial'arabiyyaai laahli aliislaami faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa tusaddiquwa aahla alkitaabi, walaa tukadhhibuwhum wa‏{‏quwluwa amannaa bialllahi wamaa aunzila‏}‏ alayaaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The people of the Scripture used to read the Torah in Hebrew and explain it to the Muslims in Arabic. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not believe the people of the Scripture, and do not disbelieve them, but say, 'We believe in Allah and whatever has been revealed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَجُلٍ وَامْرَأَةٍ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ قَدْ زَنَيَا فَقَالَ لِلْيَهُودِ ‏"‏ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ بِهِمَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا نُسَخِّمُ وُجُوهَهُمَا وَنُخْزِيهِمَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ‏{‏فَأْتُوا بِالتَّوْرَاةِ فَاتْلُوهَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَاءُوا فَقَالُوا لِرَجُلٍ مِمَّنْ يَرْضَوْنَ يَا أَعْوَرُ اقْرَأْ‏.‏ فَقَرَأَ حَتَّى انْتَهَى عَلَى مَوْضِعٍ مِنْهَا فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْفَعْ يَدَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَفَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا فِيهِ آيَةُ الرَّجْمِ تَلُوحُ فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ إِنَّ عَلَيْهِمَا الرَّجْمَ‏.‏ وَلَكِنَّا نُكَاتِمُهُ بَيْنَنَا‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِهِمَا فَرُجِمَا، فَرَأَيْتُهُ يُجَانِئُ عَلَيْهَا الْحِجَارَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala autiya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm birajulin waamraaaain mina alyahuwdi qad zanayaa faqaala lilyahuwdi ‏"‏ maa tasna'uwna bihimaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa nusakhhimu wujuwhahumaa wanukhziyhimaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ ‏{‏faatuwa bialttawraaai faatluwhaa iin kuntum saadiqiyna‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ fajaa'uwa faqaaluwa lirajulin mimman yardawna yaa aa'waru aqraa‏.‏ faqaraaa hattaa antahaa 'alaa mawdi'in minhaa fawada'a yadahu 'alayhi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ arfa' yadaka ‏"‏‏.‏ farafa'a yadahu faiidhaa fiyhi ayaau alrrajmi taluwhu faqaala yaa muhammadu iinna 'alayhimaa alrrajma‏.‏ walakinnaa nukaatimuhu baynanaa‏.‏ faaamara bihimaa farujimaa, faraaaytuhu yujaaniiu 'alayhaa alhijaaraaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:A Jew and Jewess were brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) on a charge of committing an illegal sexual intercourse. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked the Jews, "What do you (usually) do with them?" They said, "We blacken their faces and disgrace them." He said, "Bring here the Torah and recite it, if you are truthful." They (fetched it and) came and asked a one-eyed man to recite. He went on reciting till he reached a portion on which he put his hand. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Lift up your hand!" He lifted his hand up and behold, there appeared the verse of Ar-Rajm (stoning of the adulterers to death). Then he said, "O Muhammad! They should be stoned to death but we conceal this Divine Law among ourselves." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that the two sinners be stoned to death and, and they were stoned to death, and I saw the man protecting the woman from the stones. (See Hadith No. 809, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَا أَذِنَ اللَّهُ لِشَىْءٍ مَا أَذِنَ لِنَبِيٍّ حَسَنِ الصَّوْتِ بِالْقُرْآنِ يَجْهَرُ بِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu hamzaaa, haddathaniy abnu aabiy haazimin, 'an yaziyda, 'an muhammadi bni iibraahiyma, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ maa aadhina alllahu lishaa'in maa aadhina linabiyyin hasani alssawti bialqurani yajharu bihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Allah does not listen to anything as He listens to the recitation of the Qur'an by a Prophet who recites it in attractive audible sweet sounding voice
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَعَلْقَمَةُ بْنُ وَقَّاصٍ، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ حَدِيثِ، عَائِشَةَ حِينَ قَالَ لَهَا أَهْلُ الإِفْكِ مَا قَالُوا ـ وَكُلٌّ حَدَّثَنِي طَائِفَةً مِنَ الْحَدِيثِ ـ قَالَتْ فَاضْطَجَعْتُ عَلَى فِرَاشِي، وَأَنَا حِينَئِذٍ أَعْلَمُ أَنِّي بَرِيئَةٌ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ يُبَرِّئُنِي، وَلَكِنْ وَاللَّهِ مَا كُنْتُ أَظُنُّ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُنْزِلُ فِي شَأْنِي وَحْيًا يُتْلَى، وَلَشَأْنِي فِي نَفْسِي كَانَ أَحْقَرَ مِنْ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ اللَّهُ فِيَّ بِأَمْرٍ يُتْلَى، وَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏إِنَّ الَّذِينَ جَاءُوا بِالإِفْكِ‏}‏ الْعَشْرَ الآيَاتِ كُلَّهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, wasa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, wa'alqamaau bnu waqqaasin, wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an hadiythi, 'aaiishaaa hiyna qaala lahaa aahlu aliifki maa qaaluwa wakullun haddathaniy taaiifaaan mina alhadiythi qaalat faadtaja'tu 'alaa firaashiy, waaanaa hiynaiidhin aa'lamu aanniy bariyiaaun waaanna alllaha yubarriiuniy, walakin waalllahi maa kuntu aazunnu aanna alllaha yunzilu fiy shaaniy wahyana yutlaa, walashaaniy fiy nafsiy kaana aahqara min aan yatakallama alllahu fiyya biaamrin yutlaa, waaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏iinna alladhiyna jaa'uwa bialiifki‏}‏ al'ashra alayaati kullahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(when the slanderers said what they said about her): I went to my bed knowing at that time that I was innocent and that Allah would reveal my innocence, but by Allah, I never thought that Allah would reveal in my favor a revelation which would be recited, for I considered myself too unimportant to be talked about by Allah in the Divine Revelation that was to be recited. So Allah revealed the ten Verses (of Surat-an-Nur). 'Those who brought a false charge
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، أُرَاهُ عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْعِشَاءِ ‏{‏وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ‏}‏ فَمَا سَمِعْتُ أَحَدًا أَحْسَنَ صَوْتًا أَوْ قِرَاءَةً مِنْهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa mis'arun, 'an 'adiyyi bni thaabitin, auraahu 'ani albaraa'i, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau fiy al'ishaa'i ‏{‏waalttiyni waalzzaytuwni‏}‏ famaa sami'tu aahadana aahsana sawtana aaw qiraa'aaan minhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara':I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting Surat at-Tin waz Zaitun (By the Fig and the Olive) in the `Isha' prayer and I have never heard anybody with a better voice or recitation than his
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُتَوَارِيًا بِمَكَّةَ، وَكَانَ يَرْفَعُ صَوْتَهُ، فَإِذَا سَمِعَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ سَبُّوا الْقُرْآنَ وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِهِ، فَقَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لِنَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏وَلاَ تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاَتِكَ وَلاَ تُخَافِتْ بِهَا‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa hushaymun, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm mutawaariyana bimakkaaa, wakaana yarfa'u sawtahu, faiidhaa sami'a almushrikuwna sabbuwa alqurana waman jaa'a bihi, faqaala alllahu 'azza wajalla linabiyyihi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏{‏walaa tajhar bisalaatika walaa tukhaafit bihaa‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was hiding himself in Mecca and used to recite the (Qur'an) in a loud voice. When the pagans heard him they would abuse the Qur'an and the one who brought it, so Allah said to His Prophet: 'Neither say your prayer aloud, nor say it in a low tone
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَهُ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي أَرَاكَ تُحِبُّ الْغَنَمَ وَالْبَادِيَةَ، فَإِذَا كُنْتَ فِي غَنَمِكَ أَوْ بَادِيَتِكَ فَأَذَّنْتَ لِلصَّلاَةِ فَارْفَعْ صَوْتَكَ بِالنِّدَاءِ، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَسْمَعُ مَدَى صَوْتِ الْمُؤَذِّنِ جِنٌّ وَلاَ إِنْسٌ وَلاَ شَىْءٌ، إِلاَّ شَهِدَ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, haddathaniy maalikun, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy sa'sa'aaa, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu aakhbarahu aanna aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya rda allh 'nh qaala lahu ‏ "‏ iinniy aaraaka tuhibbu alghanama waalbaadiyaaa, faiidhaa kunta fiy ghanamika aaw baadiyatika faaadhhanta lilssalaaai faarfa' sawtaka bialnnidaa'i, faiinnahu laa yasma'u madaa sawti almuuadhhini jinnun walaa iinsun walaa shaa'un, iilaaa shahida lahu yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw sa'iydin sami'tuhu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abdur-Rahman:that Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri said to him, "I see that you like sheep and the desert, so when you are looking after your sheep or when you are in the desert and want to pronounce the Adhan, raise your voice, for no Jinn, human being or any other things hear the Mu`adh-dhin's voice but will be a witness for him on the Day of Resurrection." Abu Sa`id added, "I heard this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَرَأْسُهُ فِي حَجْرِي وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aummihi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau alqurana waraasuhu fiy hajriy waaanaa haaiidun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite the Qur'an with his head in my lap while I used to be in my periods (having menses)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ، أَنَّ الْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ، وَعَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَبْدٍ الْقَارِيَّ، حَدَّثَاهُ أَنَّهُمَا، سَمِعَا عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ هِشَامَ بْنَ حَكِيمٍ، يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْفُرْقَانِ فِي حَيَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَمَعْتُ لِقِرَاءَتِهِ، فَإِذَا هُوَ يَقْرَأُ عَلَى حُرُوفٍ كَثِيرَةٍ لَمْ يُقْرِئْنِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَكِدْتُ أُسَاوِرُهُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ، فَتَصَبَّرْتُ حَتَّى سَلَّمَ، فَلَبَبْتُهُ بِرِدَائِهِ فَقُلْتُ مَنْ أَقْرَأَكَ هَذِهِ السُّورَةَ الَّتِي سَمِعْتُكَ تَقْرَأُ قَالَ أَقْرَأَنِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ كَذَبْتَ، أَقْرَأَنِيهَا عَلَى غَيْرِ مَا قَرَأْتَ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْتُ بِهِ أَقُودُهُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ هَذَا يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْفُرْقَانِ عَلَى حُرُوفٍ لَمْ تُقْرِئْنِيهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَرْسِلْهُ، اقْرَأْ يَا هِشَامُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَرَأَ الْقِرَاءَةَ الَّتِي سَمِعْتُهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كَذَلِكَ أُنْزِلَتْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اقْرَأْ يَا عُمَرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَرَأْتُ الَّتِي أَقْرَأَنِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ كَذَلِكَ أُنْزِلَتْ، إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ أُنْزِلَ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَحْرُفٍ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy 'urwaau, aanna almiswara bna makhramaaa, wa'abda alrrahmani bna 'abdin alqaariyya, haddathaahu aannahumaa, sami'aa 'umara bna alkhattaabi, yaquwlu sami'tu hishaama bna hakiymin, yaqraau suwraaa alfurqaani fiy hayaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faastama'tu liqiraa'atihi, faiidhaa huwa yaqraau 'alaa huruwfin kathiyraain lam yuqriiniyhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fakidtu ausaawiruhu fiy alssalaaai, fatasabbartu hattaa sallama, falababtuhu biridaaiihi faqultu man aaqraaaka hadhihi alssuwraaa allatiy sami'tuka taqraau qaala aaqraaaniyhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu kadhabta, aaqraaaniyhaa 'alaa ghayri maa qaraata‏.‏ faantalaqtu bihi aaquwduhu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu iinniy sami'tu hadhaa yaqraau suwraaa alfurqaani 'alaa huruwfin lam tuqriiniyhaa‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aarsilhu, aqraa yaa hishaamu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaraaa alqiraa'aaa allatiy sami'tuhu‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ kadhalika aunzilat ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aqraa yaa 'umaru ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaraatu allatiy aaqraaaniy faqaala ‏"‏ kadhalika aunzilat, iinna hadhaa alqurana aunzila 'alaa sab'aai aahrufin faaqra'uwa maa tayassara minhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:I heard Hisham bin Hakim reciting Surat-al-Furqan during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I listened to his recitation and noticed that he was reciting in a way that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had not taught me. I was about to jump over him while He was still in prayer, but I waited patiently and when he finished his prayer, I put my sheet round his neck (and pulled him) and said, "Who has taught you this Sura which I have heard you reciting?" Hisham said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) taught it to me." I said, "You are telling a lie, for he taught it to me in a way different from the way you have recited it!" Then I started leading (dragged) him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said (to the Prophet), " I have heard this man reciting Surat-al- Furqan in a way that you have not taught me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "(O `Umar) release him! Recite, O Hisham." Hisham recited in the way I heard him reciting. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It was revealed like this." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Recite, O `Umar!" I recited in the way he had taught me, whereupon he said, "It was revealed like this," and added, "The Qur'an has been revealed to be recited in seven different ways, so recite of it whichever is easy for you ." (See Hadith No. 514, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، قَالَ يَزِيدُ حَدَّثَنِي مُطَرِّفُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فِيمَا يَعْمَلُ الْعَامِلُونَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ كُلٌّ مُيَسَّرٌ لِمَا خُلِقَ لَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, qaala yaziydu haddathaniy mutarrifu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'imraana, qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi fiymaa ya'malu al'aamiluwna qaala ‏ "‏ kullun muyassarun limaa khuliqa lahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Imran:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why should a doer (people) try to do good deeds?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Everybody will find easy to do such deeds as will lead him to his destined place for which he has been created
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، وَالأَعْمَشِ، سَمِعَا سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ فِي جِنَازَةٍ فَأَخَذَ عُودًا فَجَعَلَ يَنْكُتُ فِي الأَرْضِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلاَّ كُتِبَ مَقْعَدُهُ مِنَ النَّارِ أَوْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا أَلاَ نَتَّكِلُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اعْمَلُوا فَكُلٌّ مُيَسَّرٌ ‏{‏فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَى وَاتَّقَى‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an mansuwrin, waalaa'mashi, sami'aa sa'da bna 'ubaydaaa, 'an aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'aliyyin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu kaana fiy jinaazaain faaakhadha 'uwdana faja'ala yankutu fiy alaardi faqaala ‏"‏ maa minkum min aahadin iilaaa kutiba maq'aduhu mina alnnaari aaw mina aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa aalaa nattakilu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ a'maluwa fakullun muyassarun ‏{‏faaammaa man aa'taa waattaqaa‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was in a funeral procession, he took a stick and started scraping the earth with it and said, "There is none of you but has his place assigned either in Hell or in Paradise." They (the people) said, "Shall we not depend upon that (and give up doing any deeds)?' He said, " Carry on doing (good deeds) for everybody will find it easy to do such deeds as will lead him to his destined place for which he has been created ." (And then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited the Verse):-- 'As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ لِي خَلِيفَةُ بْنُ خَيَّاطٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَمَّا قَضَى اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ كَتَبَ كِتَابًا عِنْدَهُ غَلَبَتْ ـ أَوْ قَالَ سَبَقَتْ ـ رَحْمَتِي غَضَبِي‏.‏ فَهْوَ عِنْدَهُ فَوْقَ الْعَرْشِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala liy khaliyfaau bnu khayyaatin haddathanaa mu'tamirun, sami'tu aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ lammaa qadaa alllahu alkhalqa kataba kitaabana 'indahu ghalabat aaw qaala sabaqat rahmatiy ghadabiy‏.‏ fahwa 'indahu fawqa al'arshi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Before Allah created the creations, He wrote a Book (wherein He has written): My Mercy has preceded my Anger." and that (Book) is written with Him over the Throne
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي غَالِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَقُولُ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، أَنَّ أَبَا رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ كِتَابًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْلُقَ الْخَلْقَ إِنَّ رَحْمَتِي سَبَقَتْ غَضَبِي‏.‏ فَهْوَ مَكْتُوبٌ عِنْدَهُ فَوْقَ الْعَرْشِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu aabiy ghaalibin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, sami'tu aabiy yaquwlu, haddathanaa qataadaau, aanna aabaa raafi'in, haddathahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha kataba kitaabana qabla aan yakhluqa alkhalqa iinna rahmatiy sabaqat ghadabiy‏.‏ fahwa maktuwbun 'indahu fawqa al'arshi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Hurairah (ra):I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: "Before Allah created the creations, He wrote a Book (wherein He has written): "My Mercy has preceded my Anger.' And that is written with Him over the Throne." (see Hadith)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، وَالْقَاسِمِ التَّمِيمِيِّ، عَنْ زَهْدَمٍ، قَالَ كَانَ بَيْنَ هَذَا الْحَىِّ مِنْ جُرْمٍ وَبَيْنَ الأَشْعَرِيِّينَ وُدٌّ وَإِخَاءٌ، فَكُنَّا عِنْدَ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ فَقُرِّبَ إِلَيْهِ الطَّعَامُ فِيهِ لَحْمُ دَجَاجٍ، وَعِنْدَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي تَيْمِ اللَّهِ كَأَنَّهُ مِنَ الْمَوَالِي، فَدَعَاهُ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُهُ يَأْكُلُ شَيْئًا ف��قَذِرْتُهُ، فَحَلَفْتُ لاَ آكُلُهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ هَلُمَّ فَلأُحَدِّثْكَ عَنْ ذَاكَ، إِنِّي أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي نَفَرٍ مِنَ الأَشْعَرِيِّينَ نَسْتَحْمِلُهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَحْمِلُكُمْ وَمَا عِنْدِي مَا أَحْمِلُكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَهْبِ إِبِلٍ فَسَأَلَ عَنَّا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ النَّفَرُ الأَشْعَرِيُّونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ لَنَا بِخَمْسِ ذَوْدٍ غُرِّ الذُّرَى، ثُمَّ انْطَلَقْنَا قُلْنَا مَا صَنَعْنَا حَلَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ يَحْمِلُنَا، وَمَا عِنْدَهُ مَا يَحْمِلُنَا، ثُمَّ حَمَلَنَا، تَغَفَّلْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمِينَهُ، وَاللَّهِ لاَ نُفْلِحُ أَبَدًا، فَرَجَعْنَا إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَسْتُ أَنَا أَحْمِلُكُمْ، وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ حَمَلَكُمْ، إِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَحْلِفُ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَأَرَى غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا، إِلاَّ أَتَيْتُ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ، وَتَحَلَّلْتُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alwahhaabi, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, waalqaasimi alttamiymiyyi, 'an zahdamin, qaala kaana bayna hadhaa alhaaai min jurmin wabayna alaash'ariyyiyna wuddun waiikhaa'un, fakunnaa 'inda aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi faqurriba iilayhi altta'aamu fiyhi lahmu dajaajin, wa'indahu rajulun min baniy taymi alllahi kaaannahu mina almawaaliy, fada'aahu iilayhi faqaala iinniy raaaytuhu yaakulu shayiana f��qadhirtuhu, fahalaftu laa akuluhu‏.‏ faqaala halumma falauhaddithka 'an dhaaka, iinniy aataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy nafarin mina alaash'ariyyiyna nastahmiluhu qaala ‏"‏ waalllahi laa aahmilukum wamaa 'indiy maa aahmilukum ‏"‏‏.‏ faautiya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm binahbi iibilin fasaaala 'annaa faqaala ‏"‏ aayna alnnafaru alaash'ariyyuwna ‏"‏‏.‏ faaamara lanaa bikhamsi dhawdin ghurri aldhhuraa, thumma antalaqnaa qulnaa maa sana'naa halafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laa yahmilunaa, wamaa 'indahu maa yahmilunaa, thumma hamalanaa, taghaffalnaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yamiynahu, waalllahi laa nuflihu aabadana, faraja'naa iilayhi faqulnaa lahu faqaala ‏"‏ lastu aanaa aahmilukum, walakinna alllaha hamalakum, iinniy waalllahi laa aahlifu 'alaa yamiynin faaaraa ghayrahaa khayrana minhaa, iilaaa aataytu alladhiy huwa khayrun minhu, watahallaltuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zahdam:There were good relations and brotherhood between this tribe of Jurm and the Ash`ariyyin. Once, while we were sitting with Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari, there was brought to him a meal which contained chicken meat, and there was sitting beside him, a man from the tribe of Bani Taimul-lah who looked like one of the Mawali. Abu Musa invited the man to eat but the man said, "I have seen chicken eating some dirty things, and I have taken an oath not to eat chicken." Abu Musa said to him, "Come along, let me tell you something in this regard. Once I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) with a few men from Ash`ariyyin and we asked him for mounts. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, By Allah, I will not mount you on anything; besides I do not have anything to mount you on.' Then a few camels from the war booty were brought to the Prophet, and he asked about us, saying, 'Where are the group of Ash`ariyyin?' So he ordered for five fat camels to be given to us and then we set out. We said, 'What have we done? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took an oath that he would not give us anything to ride and that he had nothing for us to ride, yet he provided us with mounts. We made Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forget his oath! By Allah, we will never be successful.' So we returned to him and reminded him of his oath. He said, 'I have not provided you with the mount, but Allah has done so. By Allah, I may take an oath to do something, but on finding something else which is better, I do that which is better and make the expiation for my oath
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَمْرَةَ الضُّبَعِيُّ، قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ قَدِمَ وَفْدُ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا إِنَّ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ مِنْ مُضَرَ، وَإِنَّا لاَ نَصِلُ إِلَيْكَ إِلاَّ فِي أَشْهُرٍ حُرُمٍ، فَمُرْنَا بِجُمَلٍ مِنَ الأَمْرِ، إِنْ عَمِلْنَا بِهِ دَخَلْنَا الْجَنَّةَ، وَنَدْعُو إِلَيْهَا مَنْ وَرَاءَنَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ آمُرُكُمْ بِأَرْبَعٍ وَأَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْ أَرْبَعٍ، آمُرُكُمْ بِالإِيمَانِ بِاللَّهِ، وَهَلْ تَدْرُونَ مَا الإِيمَانُ بِاللَّهِ شَهَادَةُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَإِقَامُ الصَّلاَةِ، وَإِيتَاءُ الزَّكَاةِ، وَتُعْطُوا مِنَ الْمَغْنَمِ الْخُمُسَ، وَأَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْ أَرْبَعٍ لاَ تَشْرَبُوا فِي الدُّبَّاءِ، وَالنَّقِيرِ، وَالظُّرُوفِ الْمُزَفَّتَةِ، وَالْحَنْتَمَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, haddathanaa qurraau bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa aabuw jamraaa aldduba'iyyu, qultu laibni 'abbaasin faqaala qadima wafdu 'abdi alqaysi 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa iinna baynanaa wabaynaka almushrikiyna min mudara, waiinnaa laa nasilu iilayka iilaaa fiy aashhurin hurumin, famurnaa bijumalin mina alaamri, iin 'amilnaa bihi dakhalnaa aljannaaa, wanad'uw iilayhaa man waraa'anaa‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ amurukum biaarba'in waaanhaakum 'an aarba'in, amurukum bialiiymaani bialllahi, wahal tadruwna maa aliiymaanu bialllahi shahaadaau aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu, waiiqaamu alssalaaai, waiiytaa'u alzzakaaai, watu'tuwa mina almaghnami alkhumusa, waaanhaakum 'an aarba'in laa tashrabuwa fiy alddubbaa'i, waalnnaqiyri, waalzzuruwfi almuzaffataai, waalhantamaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The delegates of `Abdul Qais came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "The pagans of the tribe of Mudar intervene between you and us therefore we cannot come to you except in the Holy months. So please order us to do something good (Religious deeds) by which we may enter Paradise (by acting on them) and we may inform our people whom we have left behind to observe it." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I order you to do four things and forbid you from four things: I order you to believe in Allah. Do you know what is meant by belief in Allah? It is to testify that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, to offer prayers perfectly, to give Zakat, and to give Al-Khumus (one-fifth of the war booty) (in Allah's Cause). And I forbid you four things, (i.e., Do not drink alcoholic drinks) Ad-Dubba, An- Naqir, (pitched water skins), Az-Zuruf, Al-Muzaffat and Al--Hantam (names of utensils used for the preparation of alcoholic drinks)." (See Hadith No. 50, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ هَذِهِ الصُّوَرِ يُعَذَّبُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ أَحْيُوا مَا خَلَقْتُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an naafi'in, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna aashaaba hadhihi alssuwari yu'adhhabuwna yawma alqiyaamaai, wayuqaalu lahum aahyuwa maa khalaqtum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The painter of these pictures will be punished on the Day of Resurrection, and it will be said to them, Make alive what you have created
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ هَذِهِ الصُّوَرِ يُعَذَّبُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ أَحْيُوا مَا خَلَقْتُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna aashaaba hadhihi alssuwari yu'adhhabuwna yawma alqiyaamaai, wayuqaalu lahum aahyuwa maa khalaqtum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The painters of these pictures will be punished on the Day of Resurrection, and it will be said to them, 'Make alive what you have created
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذَهَبَ يَخْلُقُ كَخَلْقِي، فَلْيَخْلُقُوا ذَرَّةً، أَوْ لِيَخْلُقُوا حَبَّةً أَوْ شَعِيرَةً ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, 'an 'umaaraaa, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ qaala alllahu 'azza wajalla waman aazlamu mimman dhahaba yakhluqu kakhalqiy, falyakhluquwa dharraaan, aaw liyakhluquwa habbaaan aaw sha'iyraaan ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Allah said, 'Who are most unjust than those who try to create something like My creation? I challenge them to create even a smallest ant, a wheat grain or a barley grain
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَالأُتْرُجَّةِ، طَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَرِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ، وَالَّذِي لاَ يَقْرَأُ كَالتَّمْرَةِ، طَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَلاَ رِيحَ لَهَا، وَمَثَلُ الْفَاجِرِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَمَثَلِ الرَّيْحَانَةِ، رِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَطَعْمُهَا مُرٌّ، وَمَثَلُ الْفَاجِرِ الَّذِي لاَ يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَمَثَلِ الْحَنْظَلَةِ، طَعْمُهَا مُرٌّ وَلاَ رِيحَ لَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa hudbaau bnu khaalidin, hadaathanaa hamaaamun, hadaathanaa qataadaau, hadaathanaa aanasun, 'an aabiy muwsaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mathalu almuumini alaadhiy yaqraau alqurana kaalautrujaaai, ta'muhaa tayiibun wariyhuhaa tayiibun, waalaadhiy laa yaqraau kaaltaamraai, ta'muhaa tayiibun walaa riyha lahaa, wamathalu alfaajiri alaadhiy yaqraau alqurana kamathali alraayhaanaai, riyhuhaa tayiibun wata'muhaa murunn, wamathalu alfaajiri alaadhiy laa yaqraau alqurana kamathali alhanzalaai, ta'muhaa murunn walaa riyha lahaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The example of a believer who recites the Qur'an is that of a citron (a citrus fruit) which is good in taste and good in smell. And the believer who does not recite the Qur'an is like a date which has a good taste but no smell. And the example of an impious person who recites the Qur'an is that of Ar-Rihana (an aromatic plant) which smells good but is bitter in taste. And the example of an impious person who does not recite the Qur'an is that of a colocynth which is bitter in taste and has no smell
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَنْبَسَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ سَأَلَ أُنَاسٌ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْكُهَّانِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُمْ لَيْسُوا بِشَىْءٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّهُمْ يُحَدِّثُونَ بِالشَّىْءِ يَكُونُ حَقًّا‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تِلْكَ الْكَلِمَةُ مِنَ الْحَقِّ يَخْطَفُهَا الْجِنِّيُّ فَيُقَرْقِرُهَا فِي أُذُنِ وَلِيِّهِ كَقَرْقَرَةِ الدَّجَاجَةِ، فَيَخْلِطُونَ فِيهِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ مِائَةِ كَذْبَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'aliyunn, hadaathanaa hishaamun, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzuuhriyii, h wahadaathaniy aahmadu bnu saalihin, hadaathanaa 'anbasaau, hadaathanaa yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy yahyaa bnu 'urwaaa bni alzuubayri, aanaahu sami'a 'urwaaa bna alzuubayri, qaalat 'aaiishaau rda allh 'nha saaala aunaasun alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alkuhaaani faqaala ‏"‏ iinaahum laysuwa bishaa'in ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla allaahi faiinaahum yuhadiithuwna bialshaaa'i yakuwnu haqanna‏.‏ qaala faqaala alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ tilka alkalimaau mina alhaqii yakhtafuhaa aljiniiyuu fayuqarqiruhaa fiy audhuni waliyiihi kaqarqaraai aldaajaajaai, fayakhlituwna fiyhi aakthara min miaiaai kadhbaain ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Some people asked the Prophet (ﷺ) regarding the soothsayers. He said, "They are nothing." They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Some of their talks come true." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That word which happens to be true is what a Jinn snatches away by stealth (from the Heaven) and pours it in the ears of his friend (the foreteller) with a sound like the cackling of a hen. The soothsayers then mix with that word, one hundred lies
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ سِيرِينَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَخْرُجُ نَاسٌ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْمَشْرِقِ وَيَقْرَءُونَ الْقُرْآنَ لاَ يُجَاوِزُ تَرَاقِيَهُمْ، يَمْرُقُونَ مِنَ الدِّينِ كَمَا يَمْرُقُ السَّهْمُ مِنَ الرَّمِيَّةِ، ثُمَّ لاَ يَعُودُونَ فِيهِ حَتَّى يَعُودَ السَّهْمُ إِلَى فُوقِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قِيلَ مَا سِيمَاهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ سِيمَاهُمُ التَّحْلِيقُ ‏"‏‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ التَّسْبِيدُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw alnuu'maani, hadaathanaa mahdiyuu bnu maymuwnin, sami'tu muhamaada bna siyriyna, yuhadiithu 'an ma'badi bni siyriyna, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyii rda allh 'nh 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ yakhruju naasun min qibali almashriqi wayaqra'uwna alqurana laa yujaawizu taraaqiyahum, yamruquwna mina aldiiyni kamaa yamruqu alsaahmu mina alraamiyaaai, thumaa laa ya'uwduwna fiyhi hataaa ya'uwda alsaahmu iilaa fuwqihi ‏"‏‏.‏ qiyla maa siymaahum‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ siymaahumu altaahliyqu ‏"‏‏.‏ aaw qaala ‏"‏ altaasbiydu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There will emerge from the East some people who will recite the Qur'an but it will not exceed their throats and who will go out of (renounce) the religion (Islam) as an arrow passes through the game, and they will never come back to it unless the arrow, comes back to the middle of the bow (by itself) (i.e., impossible). The people asked, "What will their signs be?" He said, "Their sign will be the habit of shaving (of their beards and their heads). (Fath-ul-Bari, Page 322, Vol. 17th)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِشْكَابٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كَلِمَتَانِ حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ، خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu iishkaabin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, 'an 'umaaraaa bni alqa'qaa'i, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ kalimataani habiybataani iilaa alrrahmani, khafiyfataani 'alaa alllisaani, thaqiylataani fiy almiyzaani subhaana alllahi wabihamdihi, subhaana alllahi al'aziymi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(There are) two words which are dear to the Beneficent (Allah) and very light (easy) for the tongue (to say), but very heavy in weight in the balance. They are: ''Subhan Allah wa-bi hamdihi'' and ''Subhan Allah Al-`Azim." (see Hadith)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
